beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the Bloomsbury café, Imogen Hartley is waiting at a window table. Her bag is by her feet. She lifts a finished balloon dog and looks towards you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在布卢姆茨伯里咖啡馆，伊莫金·哈特利坐在窗边小桌旁等人。她的包放在自己脚边。她拿起一只已经做好的气球狗，看向附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: At first glance, does this look like a dog?
beats.chinese: 第一眼看，这是狗吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds it above the table. A handwritten food list lies beside her pen.
beats.chinese: 她把气球狗举在桌面上方。笔旁放着一张手写的食物清单。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's for my niece. My sister's collecting it in a bit.
beats.chinese: 给我外甥女做的。我姐姐一会儿来拿。

choices.english: Could you show it to me?
choices.chinese: 可以给我看看吗？

choices.english: I can't quite see the back legs from here.
choices.chinese: 从这里看不太清后腿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Imogen holds the balloon dog nearer so you can see it clearly.
beats.chinese: 伊莫金把气球狗递近一些，让你看清楚。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There you go.
beats.chinese: 看吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the dog back in the bag by her feet, then shifts the handwritten food list towards herself. Twelve names run down one edge.
beats.chinese: 她把气球狗放回脚边的包里，再把手写的食物清单移向自己。纸的一侧列着十二个人名。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Family lunch on Sunday. My sister wants three desserts. I've put her name beside all three.
beats.chinese: 周日家里聚餐。我姐姐想要三道甜点。我在三道旁边都写了她的名字。

choices.english: So she's making the desserts?
choices.chinese: 所以甜点都由她做？

choices.english: Thanks for showing me. I'll leave you to your list.
choices.chinese: 谢谢你给我看。你继续写清单吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Imogen pauses, holding the balloon dog where it is.
beats.chinese: 伊莫金停了一下，仍把气球狗举在原处。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One's behind my hand.
beats.chinese: 一条被我的手挡住了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lowers the dog into the bag by her feet, keeping its ears clear of the handles.
beats.chinese: 她把气球狗放回脚边的包里，避开包带，没让它勾住耳朵。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's finished. I'm leaving the legs as they are.
beats.chinese: 已经做好了。腿就这样，不改了。

choices.english: Could you hold it closer so I can see?
choices.chinese: 你可以拿近一点给我看看吗？

choices.english: No need for a closer look, thanks. I'll leave you to it.
choices.chinese: 不用拿近看了，谢谢。不打扰你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Imogen puts a small tick beside her sister's name. The bag stays by her feet.
beats.chinese: 伊莫金在姐姐的名字旁打了个小钩。包仍放在她脚边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If she wants three, yes. I'm doing the roast.
beats.chinese: 她要三道的话，就由她做。我负责烤肉。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She adds 'desserts' beside the name, folds the list and puts it away, ending the brief conversation.
beats.chinese: 她在名字旁补上“甜点”，把清单折好收起，结束了这段简短的交谈。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That leaves me one oven to worry about. Right then. Sorted.
beats.chinese: 这样我就只用操心一个烤箱了。行，这事定了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Imogen nods and turns the food list towards herself.
beats.chinese: 伊莫金点点头，把食物清单转向自己。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course.
beats.chinese: 当然。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She counts the names with the end of her pen, adds 'gravy' at the bottom and caps the pen. She makes no further attempt at conversation.
beats.chinese: 她用笔尾数过名单，在最下面添上“肉汁”，然后盖好笔帽，没有再找话说。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's the list done. Just waiting for my sister now.
beats.chinese: 清单写完了。现在就等我姐姐来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Imogen lifts the balloon dog out of the bag and holds it nearer. One back leg is noticeably longer than the other.
beats.chinese: 伊莫金从包里拿出气球狗，递近一些。它的一条后腿明显比另一条长。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. I started making them after a colleague's leaving party.
beats.chinese: 可以。我是在一个同事的欢送会之后开始做这个的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the knot and lowers the dog into the bag again, finishing the small display.
beats.chinese: 她检查了一下打结的地方，把气球狗放回包里，结束了这次小小的展示。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The extra leg length wasn't ordered. She gets that free.
beats.chinese: 多出来的那截腿不是她订的。免费送她。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You end the exchange. Imogen looks down at the bag by her feet.
beats.chinese: 你结束交谈。伊莫金低头看了看脚边的包。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. Thanks for saying.
beats.chinese: 好。谢谢你说清楚。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tucks the handles inside the bag so they cannot catch the balloon ears, then settles back at her table.
beats.chinese: 她把包带塞进包里，免得勾住气球耳朵，然后重新坐好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave it there, then. Enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 那我就先放这里了。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the Bloomsbury café, Imogen is at a window table. She recognises you, then notices the seams showing on the outside of her cardigan.
beats.chinese: 在布卢姆茨伯里咖啡馆，伊莫金正坐在窗边小桌旁。她认出了你，随后发现自己开衫的缝线露在外面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I've been wearing this inside out.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我这件衣服一直穿反了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips off the cardigan, leaving her shirt underneath, turns it the right way round and puts it back on.
beats.chinese: 她脱下开衫，里面还穿着衬衫，把开衫翻到正面后重新穿好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Nobody mentioned it. Fair enough. I didn't ask.
beats.chinese: 好了。没人提过。也行，我也没问。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At a window table in the Bloomsbury café, Lwazi Ncube is waiting for a colleague before returning to his London archive training. His bag is by his feet. As you stand nearby, he partly closes his pocket notebook and looks up.
beats.chinese: 在布卢姆茨伯里咖啡馆的窗边小桌旁，Lwazi Ncube正等同事，之后要回伦敦的档案馆继续培训。他的包放在脚边。你站在附近，他把小笔记本合上一半，抬起头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Can I ask you a quick music question? Is there a little bit of a song you'd go back and play again? You don't need the terms.
beats.chinese: 能问一个听歌的小问题吗？有没有哪一小段，会让你倒回去再听一次？不用知道术语。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps one finger between the pages and waits for your answer.
beats.chinese: 他用一根手指夹着书页，等你回答。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Lwazi. It's just something I like asking people. No pressure if you'd rather look out of the window.
beats.chinese: 我叫Lwazi。我就是喜欢问问大家这个。你要是只想看看窗外，也没关系。

choices.english: Sure. I'll sit here. Is that a music notebook?
choices.chinese: 可以聊聊。我坐这儿吧。这是记音乐的本子吗？

choices.english: No thanks. I was just looking out of the window.
choices.chinese: 不用，谢谢。我只是想看看窗外。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You take the spare chair. Lwazi opens the notebook again and keeps it on his side of the little table, with a pencil resting across one page.
beats.chinese: 你坐上空椅子。Lwazi重新翻开本子，把它留在小桌靠自己的一侧，一支铅笔横放在纸页上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, just songs I've listened to. This one starts far too slowly.
beats.chinese: 对，记些我听过的歌。这首开头拖得太久了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances at a note marked 'cousin' and taps the words 'gentle opening' with his pencil.
beats.chinese: 他瞥见一条标着“表亲说”的笔记，用铅笔点了点“轻柔的开头”几个字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She called it gentle. Yes, that's it. A lovely opening, actually.
beats.chinese: 她说那叫轻柔。嗯，对，就是这样。其实开头挺好听的。

choices.english: You changed your mind halfway through that.
choices.chinese: 你说到一半就改主意了。

choices.english: I'll let you get back to your notes.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你记笔记了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The chair remains empty. Lwazi glances from his notebook to the window beside you.
beats.chinese: 椅子仍然空着。Lwazi的视线从本子移到你身旁的窗户。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah, the window. I chose this seat and then spent the whole time staring at paper.
beats.chinese: 啊，看窗外。我特意选了这里，结果一直在盯着纸看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes the notebook around his pencil and rests his hands on the cover.
beats.chinese: 他把铅笔夹在本子里合上，双手放在封面上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I'll leave you to the view.
beats.chinese: 当然。你慢慢看，我不打扰了。

choices.english: Keep your seat. I was curious about the notebook.
choices.chinese: 你坐着就好。我倒是有点好奇那本笔记。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll look out for a moment and leave you to it.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。我看一会儿窗外，就不打扰你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Lwazi looks down at the two descriptions on the page, then gives a short laugh.
beats.chinese: Lwazi低头看看纸上那两种评价，短促地笑了一声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I did. My cousin's very convincing when she's nowhere near me.
beats.chinese: 还真是。她人都不在这里，说服力倒是一点不少。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He writes 'turned it up when the bass came in', closes the notebook and rests it on his bag.
beats.chinese: 他写下“低音进来时调大了音量”，合上本子，放到包上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That bit I remember clearly. Anyway, I'll let you settle in.
beats.chinese: 那一段我倒记得很清楚。好啦，你慢慢坐。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Lwazi turns the notebook back towards himself, leaving the space in front of your chair clear.
beats.chinese: Lwazi把本子转回自己面前，让你座位前的桌面空着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I'm trying to get one song down before my colleague gets here.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我想趁同事来之前，把一首歌记下来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He writes 'lovely', pauses, then rubs it out. He starts a fresh line lower down the page.
beats.chinese: 他写下“好听”，停了一下，又擦掉，接着在下面另起一行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And you've got room for your elbows now. I was taking rather a lot of table.
beats.chinese: 现在你也有地方放胳膊了。我刚才占了挺大一块桌面。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Lwazi stays seated and opens the notebook again. The page contains short phrases, with several crossed out.
beats.chinese: Lwazi没有起身，又翻开本子。纸上都是短句，其中几处被划掉了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Listening notes. This one's about the moment everyone stops singing except one voice. I played that bit three times.
beats.chinese: 听歌的笔记。这条记的是其他人都停下来，只剩一个人唱的地方。那一段我放了三遍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He adds 'one voice left', then puts the closed notebook inside his bag instead of passing it over.
beats.chinese: 他补上“只剩一个声音”，随后合起本子放进包里，没有递过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I keep scores in order for a singing competition back in Cape Town. These are just my own notes. Anyway, I'll leave you the window.
beats.chinese: 我在开普敦给一个歌唱比赛整理伴奏乐谱。这些只是我自己的笔记。好了，不耽误你看窗外。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You turn your attention to the view through the window. Lwazi gives a small nod without trying to extend the conversation.
beats.chinese: 你把注意力转向窗外。Lwazi轻轻点头，没有继续搭话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No problem.
beats.chinese: 没问题。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He reopens the notebook and picks up his pencil, leaving his bag by his feet.
beats.chinese: 他重新翻开本子，拿起铅笔，包仍放在脚边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy the rest of your day.
beats.chinese: 祝你接下来过得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the Bloomsbury café, you see Lwazi writing at a window table. He looks up and recognises you.
beats.chinese: 在布卢姆茨伯里咖啡馆，你看见Lwazi正在窗边小桌旁写字。他抬起头，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello! I'm not asking anyone what they like today. I want to write down one answer of my own first.
beats.chinese: 噢，你好！今天我先不问别人喜欢什么了。我想先给自己留下一句答案。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He finishes a short line, closes the notebook and smiles at you.
beats.chinese: 他写完一小行，合上本子，朝你笑了笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll count that one as mine today. It's really good to see you.
beats.chinese: 今天这句先算我的。见到你真好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Borough Market, Kevin Mwangi stands clear of the customer aisle near Jumi Cheese. He came to buy cheese for supper. He holds a short knotted cord and a folded shopping list.
beats.chinese: 在博罗市场，Kevin Mwangi 站在 Jumi Cheese 附近，避开顾客通道。他来买晚餐吃的奶酪，手里拿着一根打了结的短绳和一张折起的购物清单。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I need a moment here to check a name. I'm not in the queue. You can go ahead.
beats.chinese: 我得在这里停一小会儿，查一个名字。我没在排队，你可以先过去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks down at the knot, turning it between his fingers.
beats.chinese: 他低头看着绳结，用手指转了转。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I remember what I promised. I can't remember who I promised it to.
beats.chinese: 答应的事我记得。答应了谁，我想不起来了。

choices.english: What's the knot for?
choices.chinese: 那个结是做什么的？

choices.english: Thanks. I'll keep going.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，那我继续逛了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kevin holds up the knotted section without stepping into the aisle.
beats.chinese: Kevin 举起打结的那一段，没有踏进通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A promise to send someone a photograph. A chocolate mould from 1956.
beats.chinese: 提醒我答应过给人发张照片。一个1956年的巧克力模具。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes out a pocket notebook. A receipt and several scraps of paper stick out between its pages.
beats.chinese: 他拿出一本袖珍笔记本。页间夹着一张收据和好几片零散纸条。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I remember the year. I can't remember who asked. I wrote it down somewhere.
beats.chinese: 年份我记得。谁要的，我想不起来了。我在什么地方记过。

choices.english: I'll wait while you find it.
choices.chinese: 你找吧，我等一下。

choices.english: I'll leave you to it. Enjoy the market.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你找了。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kevin nods and gathers the cord's loose ends into his palm, keeping clear of your path.
beats.chinese: Kevin 点点头，把松散的绳头拢进掌心，仍避开你要走的路线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy the market. I tie these for fun. This one's three millimetres thick.
beats.chinese: 祝你逛得愉快。我喜欢打绳结。这根绳子有三毫米粗。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He separates the knotted section from the loose ends with one finger.
beats.chinese: 他用一根手指把打结的部分和松散的绳头分开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That knot is a reminder. It needs to stay tied until I've done the thing.
beats.chinese: 这个结是个提醒。事情办完之前，得留着。

choices.english: May I have a closer look at it?
choices.chinese: 我可以凑近看看吗？

choices.english: I'll keep going. Take care.
choices.chinese: 我继续逛了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kevin turns two pages, then lifts a receipt covering a handwritten name.
beats.chinese: Kevin 翻了两页，掀开一张收据，下面露出一个手写的名字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Daniel. He asked on Thursday. There it is.
beats.chinese: Daniel。他星期四问我要的。在这儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes out his phone, finds the mould photograph and sends it. Only then does he loosen the knot and put the cord away.
beats.chinese: 他拿出手机，找到模具照片并发出去。这才解开绳结，把绳子收好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sent. Thanks for waiting. Now, cheese.
beats.chinese: 发了。谢谢你等我。现在，买奶酪。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kevin stops turning pages long enough to look up at you.
beats.chinese: Kevin 暂时停下翻页，抬头看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. You too.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。你也是。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the cord safely in his pocket and spreads two scraps across the open notebook, staying clear of passing customers.
beats.chinese: 他把绳子稳妥地放进口袋，将两张纸条摊在翻开的笔记本上，仍给经过的顾客留着路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll check these before I put anything else in that pocket. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 往那个口袋里再塞东西之前，我先把这些看完。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kevin holds the knot flat on his open palm, close enough for you to see without either of you moving into the aisle.
beats.chinese: Kevin 摊开手掌，把绳结平放在掌心，让你能看清，也不用让任何人挪进通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Blue cord, red thread at the end. I made that bit on the bus.
beats.chinese: 看。蓝绳子，末端缠着红线。那一段是我在公交车上做的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: After a brief look, he closes his hand around it and tucks it into a zipped pocket. He turns his attention back to the cheese counter.
beats.chinese: 让你看了一会儿后，他合拢手掌，把绳子收进带拉链的口袋，重新看向奶酪柜台。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Back to my shopping. Enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 我接着买东西了。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kevin puts the cord away immediately, leaving the space beside you clear.
beats.chinese: Kevin 随即收好绳子，让你身旁的空间保持畅通。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too.
beats.chinese: 你也是。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He unfolds his shopping list again and looks towards the cheese counter.
beats.chinese: 他重新展开购物清单，朝奶酪柜台看去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Time to choose some cheese. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 该挑奶酪了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Borough Market, Kevin is beneath the covered stall area, looking up at the festive lights. He notices you and gives a small wave, keeping clear of the customer aisle.
beats.chinese: 在博罗市场，Kevin 正站在棚下摊区，抬头看节日灯饰。他注意到你，轻轻挥了挥手，仍避着顾客通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I came for a quick look around. I've spent five minutes looking at those lights.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我本来只是来随便逛逛，结果看那些灯看了五分钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks his watch, then lowers his gaze from the canopy to the stalls.
beats.chinese: 他看了一眼手表，把视线从棚架移回摊位。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I do this in theatres too. Sometimes I miss an entrance. Anyway, good to see you.
beats.chinese: 我在剧院也这样。有时连演员上场都错过。总之，很高兴见到你。

causality.presenceReason: Kevin 在玩家出现前已来市场为自己的晚餐买奶酪，停在 Jumi Cheese 附近核对一个与承诺有关的名字。

causality.currentGoal: 查清绳结所提醒的承诺对象，再继续购物。绳子始终由他拿着，没有掉落或请玩家拾取。
causality.currentState: 独自办事，话少但礼貌，记得承诺内容和物品细节，却一时想不起对应的人。他愿意简短回应，也接受玩家直接离开。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Borough Market, Morgan Vale stands at the side of the Jumi Cheese counter, near you, with their tote against their leg. They came to buy cheese before their climbing social. They stop the timer on their wristwatch.
beats.chinese: 在博罗市场，Morgan Vale 站在 Jumi Cheese 柜台侧边，离你不远，手提袋贴着腿。他们打算参加攀岩聚会前先买点奶酪。他们停下了腕表上的计时。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Are you waiting to buy something? I haven't joined the queue yet, so don't count me in.
beats.chinese: 你在等着买东西吗？我还没开始排队，别把我算进去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Having made their place outside the queue clear, Morgan checks their watch and the short shopping list.
beats.chinese: 说明自己还没排队后，Morgan 看了看腕表和那张简短的购物清单。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Six minutes here and I haven't bought anything. Five was my record for the whole cheese mission.
beats.chinese: 在这里六分钟了，东西还没买。以前整趟买奶酪的纪录是五分钟。

choices.english: You're timing the cheese shopping?
choices.chinese: 你买奶酪还计时？

choices.english: No, I'm just looking.
choices.chinese: 没有，我只是看看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Morgan turns the list over. A small 5:42 is written beneath the single shopping item.
beats.chinese: Morgan 翻过清单。唯一一项购物内容下面，写着小小的“5:42”。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Five minutes forty-two, to be precise. I rounded down.
beats.chinese: 准确说是五分四十二秒。我把零头抹了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They check the watch again, catch themselves doing it, and lower their wrist.
beats.chinese: 他们又看了一眼表，意识到自己的动作，便放下手腕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I help run a table football league. Usually there's an actual opponent.
beats.chinese: 我帮忙组织桌上足球联赛。通常还是有个真正的对手的。

choices.english: Then you'd better join the queue.
choices.chinese: 那你最好赶紧排队。

choices.english: Put the watch away. Have a look first.
choices.chinese: 先别看表了。看看有什么吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Morgan stays at the side of the counter, outside the queue.
beats.chinese: Morgan 仍站在柜台侧边，没有加入队伍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. Take your time.
beats.chinese: 当然。你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They fold the empty sides of the tote inward and hold it flat against their coat.
beats.chinese: 他们把空手提袋的两侧折进去，贴着外套拿好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One thing on the list, and I've brought a bag with the turning circle of a delivery van.
beats.chinese: 清单上就一样东西，我却带了个转弯半径跟送货车一样大的袋子。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll leave you to it.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。那不打扰你了。

choices.english: I'll stay on this side and look at the cheese.
choices.chinese: 我就在这一侧看看奶酪。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Morgan joins the back of the customers waiting at Jumi Cheese. The person ahead is taking time over a selection.
beats.chinese: Morgan 排到 Jumi Cheese 等候顾客的末尾。前面的人正慢慢挑选。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Back of the queue.
beats.chinese: 好。排到队尾。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their wrist rises towards their face once more. They lower it without looking and settle behind the waiting customer.
beats.chinese: 他们又一次抬起手腕，却没看表就放下了，站定在前面的顾客身后。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There goes the record. I'm keeping my place, though. See you.
beats.chinese: 纪录没戏了。不过队还是要排的。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Morgan stays beside the stall rather than joining the queue. From the edge, they finally examine the cheese on display.
beats.chinese: Morgan 没有去排队，而是留在摊位旁，从侧边仔细看起了陈列的奶酪。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I haven't actually looked at what they've got.
beats.chinese: 我还真没看他们都有什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn the watch face to the inside of their wrist and fold the timed shopping list into a pocket.
beats.chinese: 他们把表盘转到手腕内侧，将那张记着时间的购物清单折好放进口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That one looks worth a proper look. I'll stay here a bit. See you.
beats.chinese: 那一块值得仔细看看。我在这儿多看一会儿。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You turn to leave Morgan to their shopping. They remain beside the stall, with the tote against their leg.
beats.chinese: 你转身准备离开，让 Morgan 继续采购。他们留在摊位旁，手提袋贴着腿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. See you.
beats.chinese: 好。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Morgan gives you a brief nod, then turns towards the cheese counter without calling you back.
beats.chinese: Morgan 朝你轻轻点头，随后转向奶酪柜台，没有再叫住你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy the market.
beats.chinese: 逛得开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You stay at the side to look at the cheese. Morgan joins the waiting customers, leaving space between you and the queue.
beats.chinese: 你留在一侧看奶酪。Morgan 加入等候的顾客，在你和队伍之间留出了空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave you room to look. I know which one I'm after.
beats.chinese: 我给你留点地方看。我已经知道要哪块了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: When their turn comes, Morgan buys a wrapped piece of cheese. They put it in the tote and fold the list away without checking the time.
beats.chinese: 轮到 Morgan 时，他们买了一块包好的奶酪，放进手提袋，又收起清单，没有看时间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One thing bought. That'll do. Enjoy your browse.
beats.chinese: 买好一样。够了。你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Borough Market, Morgan is looking at the cheese on display beside Jumi Cheese, with their shopping bag held at their side. They recognise you.
beats.chinese: 在博罗市场，Morgan 正在 Jumi Cheese 旁看陈列的奶酪，购物袋收在身侧。他们认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I fancy a different cheese today. Something other than my usual one.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天想换一块奶酪，不拿平时那种。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Morgan folds their shopping list and continues comparing the cheeses in front of them, leaving their wristwatch unchecked.
beats.chinese: Morgan 把购物清单折好，继续认真比较眼前的奶酪，没有看腕表。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I feel like something different today. Still deciding. Take your time looking.
beats.chinese: 今天想吃点不一样的，还没选好。你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Borough Market, Aisha Grant stands beside the Jumi Cheese counter, clear of the customer passage. She came to buy cheese for lunch. Catching the smell of the cheese nearby, she smiles at you.
beats.chinese: 在博罗市场，Aisha Grant站在Jumi Cheese柜台侧边，没有占住顾客通道。她来买午餐要吃的奶酪。闻到近处奶酪的气味，她朝你笑了笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No need for scent strips here. You know straight away what you've come to buy. I'm just here for lunch.
beats.chinese: 这里倒不用试香纸，一下就知道自己来买什么了。我只是来买午饭的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the paper list in her hand, then opens it once more. Her finger stops on the same short line.
beats.chinese: 她折起手里的纸质清单，又打开了一次。手指停在同一行短短的字上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've checked it twice already. It hasn't changed.
beats.chinese: 我已经检查两遍了。内容没变。

choices.english: What are you getting?
choices.chinese: 你要买什么？

choices.english: I'm just looking.
choices.chinese: 我只是看看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aisha stays beside the stall while other customers finish. She turns the list over, revealing a blank back.
beats.chinese: Aisha留在摊位侧边，等其他顾客办完。她把清单翻过来，背面一片空白。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheese for lunch. A mature decision.
beats.chinese: 午餐吃的奶酪。一个很“成熟”的决定。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Putting the list away, she pulls a small tin from the same jacket pocket. She keeps its lid firmly closed.
beats.chinese: 收清单时，她从夹克的同一个口袋里带出一只小铁盒。盒盖始终扣得紧紧的。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Perfume strips in here. I make little blends at home. The lid stays on near food.
beats.chinese: 里面是香水试香纸。我在家调着玩。靠近食物时，盖子得盖好。

choices.english: So it's just for fun?
choices.chinese: 所以只是兴趣？

choices.english: You could turn that into a little business.
choices.chinese: 你可以把它做成一门小生意。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aisha lowers the list and leaves the space in front of the counter open. Above the covered stalls, festive lights hang from the framework.
beats.chinese: Aisha放下清单，把柜台前的空间留了出来。棚下摊区上方，节日灯饰挂在棚架上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I meant to look round before getting lunch.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我本来想买午餐之前先逛逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She counts two items on her fingers, then glances from the list to the lights.
beats.chinese: 她掰着手指数了两项，目光又从清单移到灯饰上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I check wiring all week. Apprentice electrician. Apparently I also need to inspect my lunch plans.
beats.chinese: 我一周都在检查线路。我是电工学徒。看来午餐计划也得检查。

choices.english: The lights are worth a look.
choices.chinese: 这些灯饰值得看看。

choices.english: I'll leave you to your lunch shopping.
choices.chinese: 那不打扰你买午餐了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aisha turns the closed tin over in her hand. A small handwritten label covers an older, longer one.
beats.chinese: Aisha把扣好的铁盒在手里翻了个面。一张手写的小标签盖住了下面更长的旧标签。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Exactly. Library books, cheap ingredients. One name was so grand my study group teased me for a week.
beats.chinese: 对。靠图书馆的书和便宜原料。有个名字起得太气派，学习小组的人笑了我一星期。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She briefly covers the old label with her thumb, then pockets the tin. She gives you a small wave as she turns her attention back to the stall.
beats.chinese: 她用拇指挡了一下旧标签，随后把铁盒收进口袋。她朝你轻轻挥手，把注意力转回摊位。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's called Soap now. Much harder to live up to. Enjoy looking round.
beats.chinese: 现在叫“肥皂”。这名字反而更难配得上。慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aisha slips the tin straight back into her jacket. Her expression stays friendly, but she gives one small shake of her head.
beats.chinese: Aisha直接把铁盒放回夹克口袋。她神情依然友善，只轻轻摇了一下头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Then I'd have customers wanting the same smell twice. I don't even manage that for myself.
beats.chinese: 那顾客就会要求两次闻起来一样。我给自己做都不一定办得到。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the shopping list without reopening it and moves toward the counter when space becomes available.
beats.chinese: 她折好购物清单，没有再次打开。柜台前空出位置后，她走了过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm keeping that one as a hobby. Anyway, I'd better get my cheese. Nice talking to you.
beats.chinese: 这个我还是留着当爱好吧。好了，我得买奶酪了。和你聊天很愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aisha looks up at the festive lights. She remains beside the stall, leaving the customer passage clear.
beats.chinese: Aisha抬头看向节日灯饰，仍站在摊位侧边，让顾客通道保持畅通。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They are. And nobody's asked me to check a connection.
beats.chinese: 确实。而且没人让我检查接线。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the list deep into her pocket and turns away from the counter to take in the decorations.
beats.chinese: 她把清单塞进口袋深处，转过身，不再盯着柜台，而是看起了装饰。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, lunch can wait a minute. I'll have my look first. Have a good day.
beats.chinese: 好，午餐可以等一分钟。我先看看。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aisha nods and folds the list into a small square. This time she keeps it folded.
beats.chinese: Aisha点点头，把清单折成一个小方块。这次她没有再打开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I should let lunch happen before I need dinner.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我得赶在该吃晚饭之前，把午餐落实了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: When a space opens at the counter, she steps into it and puts the folded list away. She gives you a brief nod goodbye.
beats.chinese: 柜台前空出位置后，她走过去，收好了折起的清单，又朝你点头道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care. I'll manage the cheese from here.
beats.chinese: 回见。接下来奶酪的事，我自己能处理。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Borough Market, Aisha Grant stands under the canopy near Jumi Cheese, clear of the customer passage. She holds a word puzzle folded into a small square. She notices you and smiles in recognition.
beats.chinese: 在博罗市场，Aisha Grant站在Jumi Cheese附近的棚下，没有占住顾客通道。她拿着一张折成小方块的字谜纸。她发现了你，认出你后露出笑容。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I've bought my lunch. Just one word left to fill in.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我买好午饭了。现在只剩一个词没填。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds her pen tip over the empty squares and thinks for a moment. Then she lowers the pen and looks back at you with a smile.
beats.chinese: 她把笔尖停在空格上方，想了片刻。随后她放低笔，笑着重新看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave it blank for now. Lunch doesn't have to wait for me to solve it. Good to see you.
beats.chinese: 先空着。午饭不用等它解出来。见到你真好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Borough Market, Priya Raval has paused near Jumi Cheese to sort out her reversible scarf. Her sisters are choosing food a little farther along. Priya holds their shared shopping list.
beats.chinese: 在博罗市场，Priya Raval停在Jumi Cheese附近整理两面可戴的围巾。姐妹们在前面不远处挑吃的，她拿着大家的采购清单。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Red side or black side? Oh, sorry. I looked straight at you when I said that.
beats.chinese: 红面还是黑面？哎，不好意思，我说的时候正好直直看着你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gathers the loose scarf ends against her top, leaving the customer aisle clear.
beats.chinese: 她把垂下的围巾两端拢在身前，没有占着顾客通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Priya. You haven't accidentally joined a styling committee. I was talking to myself.
beats.chinese: 我叫 Priya。你没有莫名其妙加入什么穿搭评审团。我刚才是在自言自语。

choices.english: You can think out loud. What's the dilemma?
choices.chinese: 你可以说出来理一理。纠结什么呢？

choices.english: No worries. I wasn't sure you meant me.
choices.chinese: 没关系。我刚才也不确定你是不是在问我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya holds up the two sides of the scarf without moving closer.
beats.chinese: Priya 把围巾的两面展示出来，没有往你面前凑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Black goes with everything. Red actually shows up. I assist at a wig-fitting studio, and I've worn very sensible clothes all week.
beats.chinese: 黑色什么都能配。红色才显眼。我在假发试戴造型工作室做助理，这一周穿得都特别规矩。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: While explaining, she drapes the scarf around her neck with the red side facing out.
beats.chinese: 她一边解释，一边把围巾搭上脖子，红色那面朝外。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Okay, but hear me out. The black is easier. Which would you pick?
beats.chinese: 不过，听我说，黑色确实省心。你会选哪个？

choices.english: Black. It works with what you're wearing.
choices.chinese: 黑色。和你现在穿的很搭。

choices.english: You've already put the red on. I don't think you need my vote.
choices.chinese: 你都已经把红色戴上了。我觉得你不需要我投票。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya lowers the scarf and gives a quick, apologetic smile.
beats.chinese: Priya 放下围巾，带着歉意飞快地笑了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. You happened to be standing where my thoughts came out.
beats.chinese: 完全理解。只是我脑子里的话冒出来时，你刚好站在那个方向。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the scarf over her forearm and unfolds her shopping list.
beats.chinese: 她把围巾叠搭在小臂上，展开购物清单。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My sisters are doing the food. We're going out together afterwards. I've been left in charge of the list. And apparently the scarf.
beats.chinese: 姐妹们负责买吃的。等会儿我们一起出去。我被留下来看清单，还有这条围巾。

choices.english: An evening with your sisters sounds nice.
choices.chinese: 和姐妹们一起过一晚，听起来不错。

choices.english: I'll let you get on with your shopping. Enjoy your evening.
choices.chinese: 那不耽误你买东西了。祝你们晚上愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya turns one end to the black side, studies it briefly, then turns it red again.
beats.chinese: Priya 把一端翻成黑色，端详片刻，又翻回了红色。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, it does. And I'm keeping the red. Ah. I should have mentioned that saying it aloud often makes me choose the first thing.
beats.chinese: 对，确实很搭。不过我还是要红色。啊，我该先说的，我常常是说着说着，就决定选最初那个了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She secures the red scarf and lifts the shopping list when one of her sisters looks back towards her.
beats.chinese: 她系好红色朝外的围巾。一位姐妹回头看她，她便举起采购清单示意。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry for asking as if it were a vote. Thanks for giving me a real answer. I'll leave you to your visit.
beats.chinese: 抱歉，问得好像真要投票决定一样。谢谢你认真回答。你慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya looks down at the red scarf already resting against her top.
beats.chinese: Priya 低头看看早已搭在身前的红色围巾。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh. Yes. I've even tucked the end in. That was a fairly strong clue.
beats.chinese: 噢，也是。我连围巾尾巴都掖好了。这线索够明显的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes her hands off the scarf and turns her attention to the shopping list, staying clear of the aisle.
beats.chinese: 她不再摆弄围巾，把注意力转回购物清单，仍然让开通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I made you listen to the entire decision after I'd made it. Sorry about that. I'd better catch up with my sisters. Enjoy looking around.
beats.chinese: 我都决定好了，还让你听了整套纠结过程。不太好意思。我得跟上姐妹们了，你慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya's smile widens. The folded scarf stays on her arm.
beats.chinese: Priya 笑得更开了些，叠好的围巾仍搭在胳膊上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It should be. There are three of us. Growing up in Wembley, we'd borrow each other's clothes and argue about who stretched the sleeves.
beats.chinese: 应该会挺好。我们姐妹三个，小时候在温布利，老是互相借衣服，然后争是谁把袖子撑松了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: One of her sisters waves from farther along the customer aisle. Priya folds the list and raises a hand in reply.
beats.chinese: 一位姐妹在前方的顾客通道里挥手。Priya折好清单，也抬手回应。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They're ready. Three of us and we've managed to buy everything on one list. The rest of the day should be easy. Lovely talking to you.
beats.chinese: 她们买好了。姐妹三个，总算把一张清单买齐了。接下来应该省心点。很高兴和你聊聊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya folds the list and gathers it with the scarf in one hand.
beats.chinese: Priya折好清单，和围巾一起收在一只手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. Hope you enjoy the market.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。也祝你逛得开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She waves with her free hand, then walks along the aisle to join her sisters.
beats.chinese: 她用空着的手挥了挥，随后沿通道走去找姐妹们。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye!
beats.chinese: 再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Borough Market, Priya Raval pauses outside the flow of shoppers to check a photograph. She recognises you and looks up.
beats.chinese: 在博罗市场，Priya Raval停在购物人流一侧看照片。她认出你，抬起头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. We've finally got a picture with all three sisters looking at the camera. Only took six goes.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。总算拍到姐妹三个都看镜头的一张。才试了六次。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A voice calls her name from farther along the aisle. She turns the phone towards herself and saves the photograph before waving back.
beats.chinese: 通道前方有人喊她的名字。她把手机转回自己面前，保存照片，朝那边挥挥手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's them. They'll say I kept everyone waiting. They'd be right. See you!
beats.chinese: 她们在叫我。准要说我让大家等了。说得也对。回头见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Marylebone bookshop, Daniel Reed stands beside a table, comparing a cookbook with a handwritten recipe he brought from home. He keeps the recipe pressed inside his open notebook.
beats.chinese: 在马里波恩书店，丹尼尔·里德站在一张书桌旁，把一本食谱和从家里带来的手写菜谱放在一起对照。菜谱一直压在他摊开的笔记本里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Could you help me read one word? Does this say 'spoon' or 'handful'?
beats.chinese: 能帮我辨认一个字吗？这里写的是“勺”，还是“把”？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tilts the open notebook towards you, holding the recipe firmly against the page.
beats.chinese: 他把摊开的笔记本朝你倾斜，稳稳地将菜谱压在本子里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just the handwriting. You don't need to work out how much salt he meant.
beats.chinese: 只辨认字迹就好，不用替我判断他到底想放多少盐。

choices.english: What recipe is it?
choices.chinese: 是什么菜谱？

choices.english: Sorry, I can't help with that.
choices.chinese: 抱歉，这个我帮不上忙。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Daniel lifts his open notebook slightly, keeping the recipe pressed against the page with his thumb.
beats.chinese: 丹尼尔稍稍抬起摊开的笔记本，仍用拇指把菜谱压在本子里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My father's soup. I think he wrote 'the good spoon of salt'. He owned several spoons, so that leaves quite a range.
beats.chinese: 我父亲的汤。我猜他写的是“用那把好勺子加盐”。他有好几把勺子，所以这个范围可不小。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He adjusts the recipe twice to line up its corners with the notebook, then looks up.
beats.chinese: 他调整了两次菜谱，让纸角与笔记本对齐，才抬起头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I organise data at a local library. I started transcribing his recipes expecting a fairly tidy little task.
beats.chinese: 我在附近一家图书馆做数据整理。开始录入他的菜谱时，我以为这会是一件挺规整的小差事。

choices.english: Could I see the recipe? You can hold it.
choices.chinese: 能让我看看菜谱吗？你拿着就好。

choices.english: I'll leave you to your soup research.
choices.chinese: 那我就不打扰你研究汤了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Daniel nods at your brief reply, then glances between the cookbook and his notebook.
beats.chinese: 听到你简短的回应，丹尼尔点点头，又看了看食谱和自己的笔记本。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I'll check the cookbook myself. First, for a usual amount. Second, for the size of spoon—
beats.chinese: 当然。我自己查查这本食谱。首先，看看通常放多少。其次，看看用多大的勺子——

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stops with one finger raised, lowers it, and closes the notebook over the recipe.
beats.chinese: 他举着一根手指停住了，随后放下手，把夹着菜谱的笔记本合上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry. You don't need the full explanation.
beats.chinese: 抱歉，你用不着听这一整套解释。

choices.english: No rush. I'll look here while you put things away.
choices.chinese: 不急。你收东西，我在这里看看。

choices.english: It's fine. I'll go past now.
choices.chinese: 没事。那我先过去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Daniel raises the open notebook so you can see the recipe, keeping the sheet pressed against the page.
beats.chinese: 丹尼尔举起摊开的笔记本给你看，菜谱仍稳稳压在本子里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Under the onions. The next instruction is 'cook until it looks right'. No time, no colour.
beats.chinese: 看，就在洋葱下面。下一条是“煮到看着合适”。没写时间，也没写颜色。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: After showing you the lines, he puts the sheet away and opens the cookbook at its soup recipes.
beats.chinese: 给你看完那几行字后，他收好纸张，把食谱翻到汤的部分。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Strictly speaking, I can't tell you how he made it yet. Thanks for taking a look. I'll try the printed recipes now.
beats.chinese: 严格来说，我现在还说不清他到底怎么做的。谢谢你看了看。我接着研究印出来的菜谱吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Daniel lowers his notebook and gives you a small nod.
beats.chinese: 丹尼尔放下笔记本，向你轻轻点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I've already made soup sound like paperwork.
beats.chinese: 当然。我已经把煮汤说得像处理文书了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lays his notebook well back from the table edge and returns his attention to the cookbook.
beats.chinese: 他把笔记本放到远离桌沿的位置，重新看起食谱。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy your browse.
beats.chinese: 你慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Daniel closes the notebook while you look over the table.
beats.chinese: 你看着桌上的书，丹尼尔合上了笔记本。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. I'm finished with the comparison, anyway. Neither version tells me which spoon he meant.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。反正我也对照完了。两份都没告诉我，他指的究竟是哪把勺子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts his notebook into his bag, leaves the cookbook neatly on the table, and moves away from the table into a clear part of the same aisle.
beats.chinese: 他把笔记本装进包里，将食谱端正地留在桌上，随后离开桌边，走到同一条通道的空处。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's everything of mine. The table's clear now. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 我的东西都收好了。桌边空出来了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Daniel draws his bag close to his leg and steps out of your way.
beats.chinese: 丹尼尔把包拢到腿边，侧身让开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Certainly. There's room now.
beats.chinese: 当然。现在可以过了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you pass, he checks that the loose paper is fully inside his notebook, then turns back to the table.
beats.chinese: 你从旁边经过时，他确认散页已经完全夹进笔记本，随后转回桌边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry for the obstruction. Enjoy the bookshop.
beats.chinese: 抱歉挡路了。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Marylebone bookshop, Daniel closes an astronomy book beside a table on the same floor as you. He looks up and recognises you.
beats.chinese: 在马里波恩书店，丹尼尔站在与你同层的书桌旁，合上一本天文书。他抬起头，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I'm only planning to take one book home today. I've already chosen it.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我今天只准备带走一本书，已经选好了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slips his book list into his own notebook, keeping the chosen book in his hand.
beats.chinese: 他将书单夹进自己的笔记本，手里留着选中的书。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There are three reasons, though I don't need to go through them now. Good to see you.
beats.chinese: 理由有三点，不过不必现在逐条讲。很高兴见到你。

causality.presenceReason: 丹尼尔带着父亲的英文手写菜谱来到马里波恩书店，想对照食谱，弄清含糊的用量。
causality.placeAttitude: 他把书店当作可以认真翻阅、核对文字的地方，此刻专注于自己的私人事务，并非来指导别人。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须留下的硬性限制，他只是尚未完成对照。个人物品收好后可以离开桌边，也会给经过的人让出通道。
causality.currentGoal: 先辨认父亲汤谱中的英文究竟是 spoon 还是 handful，再自行查阅食谱。中文以“勺”和“把”传达用量差别，不要求玩家判断该放多少盐。
causality.currentState: 注意力集中、略显较真，愿意为一个具体的辨字问题主动开口。他仍容易解释过多，但接受婉拒，也不会假装已经确认字迹或用量。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the Marylebone bookshop, Simon Holt is checking titles against a list for the children's library group he writes puppet plays for. His bag is by his feet, clear of the passage. Beside the book table near you, he has a felt puppet over his fingers. He quietly tries a line in a higher, warmer voice.
beats.chinese: 在马里波恩书店，西蒙·霍尔特正对照清单查找书名，为他编写木偶剧的儿童图书馆小组挑书。他的包收在脚边，没有占用通道。他站在你附近的书桌旁，手指上套着一只毛毡木偶，用更高、更温暖的声音低声试了一句台词。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good afternoon, fellow giant.
beats.chinese: 下午好，巨人同胞。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He notices you nearby and lowers the puppet slightly. When he speaks again, his voice is flatter.
beats.chinese: 他注意到你就在附近，把木偶稍稍放低。再开口时，他的声音平了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I was trying out a line. Still, good afternoon. I'm Simon.
beats.chinese: 刚才在试一句台词。不过，下午好。我叫西蒙。

choices.english: Hello, small person. What's your name?
choices.chinese: 你好，小个子。你叫什么名字？

choices.english: Hello, Simon. Is that list for work?
choices.chinese: 你好，西蒙。那张清单是工作用的吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Simon looks down at the puppet. His free hand hovers over the list, then stops.
beats.chinese: 西蒙低头看看木偶。空着的那只手停在清单上方，又收住了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He hasn't got a name yet. I've crossed out seven. Eight, actually.
beats.chinese: 他还没有名字。我已经划掉七个了。准确地说，是八个。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the puppet's mouth, considers something, then closes it again. He leaves the pencil tucked inside his folded list.
beats.chinese: 他张开木偶的嘴，想了想，又把它合上。铅笔仍然夹在折起的清单里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave that alone for now. He does have a scene. Very short. Or I can put him away.
beats.chinese: 名字先放一放。他倒是有一场戏。很短。或者我可以把他收起来。

choices.english: Let's hear his very short scene.
choices.chinese: 那就听听他那场很短的戏吧。

choices.english: You can put him away. I'd rather hear you.
choices.chinese: 可以把他收起来。我更想听你自己说话。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Simon folds the puppet into his bag and picks up the list. Several titles have small, carefully drawn ticks beside them.
beats.chinese: 西蒙把木偶叠好放进包里，拿起清单。几个书名旁边画着小小的、工整的对勾。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Library business. Unpaid. My paid work is tax advice. This list is rather more appealing.
beats.chinese: 图书馆的事。不收钱的。我有报酬的工作是税务咨询。这张清单要讨喜一些。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks two titles against books on the table, then returns his finger to the top of the list.
beats.chinese: 他对着桌上的书核查了两个书名，随后又把手指移回清单最上方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The third one isn't here. I always check them in order. I'll just check the first two again.
beats.chinese: 第三本不在这里。我一向按顺序查。我再核对一遍前两本。

choices.english: I'll leave you to it.
choices.chinese: 那我就不打扰你了。

choices.english: You could try the next title.
choices.chinese: 你可以试试下一个书名。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Simon holds the puppet at chest height, keeping close to the table. The puppet lifts its chin towards him.
beats.chinese: 西蒙靠着书桌，把木偶举到胸前。木偶朝他抬起下巴。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I demand a larger role. And a dressing room.
beats.chinese: 我要求更重要的角色。还要一间化妆室。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Simon looks from the puppet to his bag. In his own lower voice, he answers it, then gently folds it away.
beats.chinese: 西蒙看看木偶，又看看自己的包。他用自己低一些的声音回答，随后轻轻把木偶叠好收起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can have the other pocket. That's the entire negotiation. Thank you for listening.
beats.chinese: 另一个口袋可以给你。谈判到此结束。谢谢你听完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Simon takes the puppet off his hand and lays it inside his bag. He pauses with his fingers on the opening.
beats.chinese: 西蒙把木偶从手上脱下来，放进包里。他的手指停在包口，顿了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. I can manage that. I write his arguments. He tends to win.
beats.chinese: 好。我能做到。他那些争辩都是我写的。通常还是他赢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He straightens the list twice, then looks up at you instead of reaching for the puppet.
beats.chinese: 他把清单摆正了两次，随后抬头看向你，没有再去拿木偶。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That was a kind way to put it. Thank you. It was nice meeting you. I'll let you get back to the books.
beats.chinese: 你说得很体贴。谢谢。很高兴认识你。我不耽误你看书了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Simon lowers the list and gives you a small nod. He draws his bag closer to his feet.
beats.chinese: 西蒙放低清单，朝你轻轻点头，又把包往脚边挪近了一些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. Nice meeting you.
beats.chinese: 当然。很高兴认识你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns back to the table and checks the first two titles again. This time he adds a second tiny tick beside each.
beats.chinese: 他转回书桌，再次核对前两个书名。这一回，他在每个书名旁又添了一个小对勾。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. Those two are definitely accounted for.
beats.chinese: 嗯。这两本确实核对过了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Simon's finger stays on the third title for a moment. He glances at the next line without moving it.
beats.chinese: 西蒙的手指在第三个书名上停了一会儿。他瞥向下一行，手指却没有动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I usually finish each line first. Although there isn't much more I can do with an absent book.
beats.chinese: 我通常会先处理完每一行。不过，一本不在这里的书，我也确实拿它没什么办法。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He moves his finger down, finds the fourth title on the table and opens the book. He keeps the list inside his own hand.
beats.chinese: 他把手指向下移，在桌上找到了第四本书，并将它翻开。清单仍然握在他自己手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There it is. I'll have a look at this one. Thanks for the nudge. I'll leave you to your browsing.
beats.chinese: 找到了。我先翻翻这本。谢谢你提醒。我不打扰你看书了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the Marylebone bookshop, you recognise Simon beside a book table on the same floor as you. He is holding a very thick book. He notices you and smiles.
beats.chinese: 在马里波恩书店，你认出西蒙正站在同一楼层的一张书桌旁，手里捧着一本很厚的书。他也注意到了你，露出微笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I picked this up for a quick look. That was optimistic.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我拿起这本书，本来想随便翻翻。想得太乐观了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers the book onto a clear part of the table and opens it carefully, keeping both hands under its covers.
beats.chinese: 他把书放到桌上空着的地方，小心翻开，两只手仍托着书封。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Small print. Four hundred pages. I'll try the first paragraph.
beats.chinese: 小字。四百页。我先试试第一段。

causality.presenceReason: 西蒙先到书店，为自己编写木偶剧的儿童图书馆小组按清单找书，随身带着木偶。

causality.currentGoal: 找到清单上的书并翻阅，决定哪些适合小组参考。
causality.currentState: 起初专注而拘谨，手上已套着木偶，低声试台词时比用本人声音温暖。发现附近有人可能把台词听成招呼，便用本人平直的声音解释并正式问好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the Marylebone bookshop, Sylvie Bancroft is browsing novels with maps inside. As she closes her own paper notebook beside a book table, a small inked scrap slips out and lands beside your shoe.

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's my island by your shoe. May I reach down?
beats.chinese: 你鞋边那座岛是我的。我可以弯腰捡一下吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sylvie points to the scrap. A blue coastline runs around its uneven edges.
beats.chinese: Sylvie 指了指纸片。一圈蓝色海岸线沿着参差的纸边延伸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It slipped out of my notebook. The rest of the country is behaving.
beats.chinese: 它从我的笔记本里滑出来了。这个国家其余的地方倒还安分。

choices.english: Of course. Is it a real place?
choices.chinese: 当然可以。这是真实的地方吗？

choices.english: Of course. I thought it was a bookmark.
choices.chinese: 当然可以。我还以为是书签呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sylvie picks up the scrap and holds it beside the open notebook. The same blue coast continues across a larger sheet.
beats.chinese: Sylvie 捡起纸片，把它放在打开的笔记本旁。同样的蓝色海岸线延续到一张更大的纸上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Entirely invented. I used to draw the atlas on a tablet. Now I use paper, which sheds rather more territory.
beats.chinese: 完全是虚构的。我以前在平板上画这套地图集。现在改用纸，领土掉得也多了些。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the little island upright and holds it out without moving it into your space.
beats.chinese: 她把小岛转正，向你递出一点，手仍停在自己身前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can have this piece, if you'd like.
beats.chinese: 你喜欢的话，可以拿走这一小片。

choices.english: Yes, thank you. I'll take the little island.
choices.chinese: 好，谢谢。那我收下这座小岛。

choices.english: No, thank you. I'd rather just look at the map.
choices.chinese: 不用了，谢谢。我只想看看地图。

beats.speaker: narrator

beats.chinese: Sylvie 捡回纸片，把它稳稳夹进笔记本的两页之间。

beats.speaker: npc

beats.chinese: 也可以当书签。做了将近四十年的手套样版，我还是会弄出尺寸不太合适的东西。

beats.speaker: narrator

beats.speaker: npc

beats.chinese: 我在找带地图的小说。我喜欢知道大家都往哪个方向迷了路。

choices.english: I'll leave you to look. Enjoy your browsing.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你找书了。慢慢看。

choices.english: Do you read the map before the story?
choices.chinese: 你会先看地图，再看故事吗？

beats.speaker: narrator

beats.chinese: Sylvie 把小纸片放到你手里，随后把大地图收回笔记本。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There you are. The ink's dry.
beats.chinese: 给你。墨已经干了。

beats.speaker: narrator

beats.speaker: npc

beats.chinese: 哦。我也可以给你大一点的。

beats.speaker: narrator

beats.chinese: 她的手指搭上大纸张，又停住了。她把打开的笔记本朝向你，让你看了一会儿，随后合上本子，把两张纸都收好。

beats.speaker: npc

beats.chinese: 只是看看。对。那我接着看这些书了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sylvie settles the bag strap on her shoulder and turns fully toward the book table.
beats.chinese: Sylvie 整理好肩上的包带，转身面向书桌。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. I've only examined three, despite appearances.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。别看我这副架势，其实才翻了三本。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts a novel and checks its opening pages, keeping herself and her bag clear of the passage.
beats.chinese: 她拿起一本小说，查看前面的几页，人和包都留在通道外侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Goodbye. Enjoy your visit.
beats.chinese: 再见。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sylvie rests her hand on a closed novel, considering the question.
beats.chinese: Sylvie 把手搭在一本合着的小说上，想了想你的问题。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Usually. Then someone takes a boat and I spend twenty pages checking the wrong coast.
beats.chinese: 通常会。然后有人坐船出发，我就对着错误的海岸查上二十页。

beats.speaker: narrator

beats.chinese: 她翻到故事的第一页，没有继续在书前寻找地图。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll try the first paragraph of this one. I'll leave you to your browsing.
beats.chinese: 这一本，我先读读第一段。你也慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the Marylebone bookshop, Sylvie stands beside a book table on the same floor as you, holding a novel. She recognises you and looks up from the page.
beats.chinese: 在马里波恩书店，Sylvie 正站在与你同层的书桌旁，手里拿着一本小说。她认出了你，从书页上抬起头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. The map's lovely. The story hasn't made me want to read on yet.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。地图很好看。正文还没让我想往下读。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She finishes the paragraph in front of her, then closes the novel and gently returns it to its place on the table.
beats.chinese: 她读完眼前这一段，随后合上小说，轻轻放回桌上原处。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A lovely coastline can't do the story's work. I'll look for another one.
beats.chinese: 海岸线漂亮，也不能替故事干活。再找一本。

beats.speaker: narrator

beats.chinese: 樱草山的草坡上，鲁思·默瑟正在写明信片，卡片牢牢夹在笔记本上。她抬头望了望远处的天际线，又转向附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Would 'open' be accurate for this view? Just that word.
beats.chinese: 这景色，用“开阔”算准确吗？只问这个词。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps her pencil above the clipped card, leaving the rest of the draft out of the discussion.
beats.chinese: 她的铅笔停在夹稳的卡片上方，没有把其余草稿拿出来讨论。

beats.english: I'm Ruth. The rest of the sentence is my problem.
beats.chinese: 我叫鲁思。句子的其余部分归我操心。

choices.english: Yes. 'Open' fits this view.
choices.chinese: 算。“开阔”适合这里的景色。

choices.english: I'd rather not choose your words for you.
choices.chinese: 我还是不替你选词了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ruth looks back down at the postcard clipped to her notebook.
beats.chinese: 鲁思低头看回夹在笔记本上的明信片。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. One postcard. Six attempts at the message.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。一张明信片。正文试写了六遍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks down at her pencil draft, counting on her fingertips.
beats.chinese: 她低头看着铅笔写的草稿，用指尖数着词。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came up here to see the skyline. Eight words. 'Here' can go.
beats.chinese: 我到这里来看看天际线。英文八个词。可以删掉“这里”。

choices.english: I'd keep 'here.' You're writing from here.
choices.chinese: 我会留着“这里”。你就是在这里写的嘛。

choices.english: I'll leave you to your postcard. Enjoy the view.
choices.chinese: 那就不打扰你写明信片了。好好看风景。

beats.speaker: narrator

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I'll choose it myself.
beats.chinese: 好。那我自己选。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She rests her pencil against the clip, then looks past the notebook towards the skyline.
beats.chinese: 她把铅笔抵在夹子旁，随后越过笔记本，望向天际线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came up to write about the view. I've mostly looked at this sentence.
beats.chinese: 我是上来写几句风景的。结果大部分时间都在看这句话。

choices.english: What's keeping you at that sentence?
choices.chinese: 是什么让你一直改那句话？

choices.english: I'll give you some space. Turn your attention to the skyline.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰了。把目光转向天际线。

beats.speaker: narrator

beats.chinese: 鲁思想了想你的建议，铅笔悬在卡片上方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The picture supplies the location. I'm crossing it out.
beats.chinese: 图片已经交代地点了。我要把它划掉。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She strikes through the word, adds her name and closes the notebook with the completed postcard still clipped inside.
beats.chinese: 她划掉那个词，签上名字，合起笔记本，写好的明信片仍夹在里面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Done. Thank you. That word was taking up useful space.
beats.chinese: 好了，谢谢。那个词确实有点占地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ruth lowers the notebook with the postcard still clipped to it and gives you a small nod.
beats.chinese: 鲁思放低笔记本，明信片仍夹在上面，向你轻轻点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. I'll see how it reads.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我再读读看。

beats.speaker: narrator

beats.chinese: 她在草地上坐下，把笔记本横放在膝头，用拇指压住明信片。

beats.speaker: npc

beats.chinese: 得赶在想出第七稿之前写完。

beats.speaker: narrator

beats.chinese: 鲁思看着那段简短的铅笔稿，停了一会儿才回答。

beats.speaker: narrator

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That can wait. I'll have a look while I'm here. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 那个可以等等。既然来了，我先看看。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ruth notices your attention return to the skyline and lowers her voice.
beats.chinese: 鲁思注意到你重新看向天际线，放轻了声音。

beats.chinese: 好。慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator

beats.chinese: 她沿草地走开几步，避开路径，转身背对着风，护住卡片。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This end of the conversation is going back to pencil.
beats.chinese: 我这边要换回铅笔说话了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Primrose Hill, Ruth Mercer is standing on the grass beside the path with one earbud in. She pauses her music when she recognises you.
beats.chinese: 在樱草山，Ruth Mercer戴着一只耳机站在草坡步道旁。认出你后，她暂停音乐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. A track I'm making. Six minutes, mostly the same bass phrase. I rather like it.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我自己做的曲子。六分钟，大部分都是同一句低音。我挺喜欢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the running time, moves the playhead back a few seconds and leaves the audio paused while she speaks.
beats.chinese: 她看看时长，把播放位置往回调了几秒，说话时仍停着音乐。

beats.speaker: npc

beats.chinese: 还能缩短。不过我不想。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Primrose Hill, Nora Price sits on the grass beside the path. After helping with adult swimming lessons, she has come up for a quiet break. As you come within earshot, a voice starts playing from the battered tape recorder in her bag.
beats.chinese: 在樱草山，诺拉·普赖斯坐在路径旁的草地上。协助完成人游泳课后，她来这里安静地歇一会儿。你走到附近时，她包里那台旧录音机突然传出了说话声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry. Wrong button. That was a recording, not me calling you.
beats.chinese: 抱歉，按错键了。那是录音，不是我在叫你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stops the tape and lifts the recorder clear of her bag.
beats.chinese: 她关掉录音，把录音机从包里拿出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Nora. Usually I can manage a stop button.
beats.chinese: 我叫诺拉。平常我还是会按停止键的。

choices.english: What were you listening to?
choices.chinese: 你刚才在听什么？

choices.english: No harm done. Taking a break?
choices.chinese: 没关系。你在休息吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Nora turns the recorder over. A handwritten label covers one side of the cassette.
beats.chinese: 诺拉把录音机翻过来。磁带的一面贴着手写标签。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: People's memories. This one's a baker describing her first night shift. She said I could play this part to other people.
beats.chinese: 一些人的回忆。这段是一位面包师在讲她第一次上夜班。她同意我把这一段放给别人听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her thumb rests beside the play button without pressing it.
beats.chinese: 她的拇指停在播放键旁，没有按下去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's a good twenty seconds here. You can hear her counting the trays again.
beats.chinese: 这里有二十秒挺有意思。能听见她又开始数烤盘。

choices.english: I'd like to hear those twenty seconds.
choices.chinese: 我想听听那二十秒。

choices.english: I'd rather hear how you got into collecting these.
choices.chinese: 我更想听听你怎么开始收集这些录音的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Nora settles the recorder on top of her closed bag, safely away from the path.
beats.chinese: 诺拉把包合上，将录音机放在包上，离路径远远的。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. I help with adult beginner swimming classes. I've heard quite enough instructions for one morning.
beats.chinese: 是啊。我协助教成人游泳入门课。今天上午听的指令已经够多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks that the recorder is off, then rests both hands on her knees.
beats.chinese: 她确认录音机已经关好，随后把双手放在膝盖上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came up for ten quiet minutes. Apparently I needed instructions for the recorder too.
beats.chinese: 我上来是想安静十分钟。看来我还需要有人教我怎么用录音机。

choices.english: Would you mind some company? No instructions.
choices.chinese: 介意有人陪你坐会儿吗？保证不发指令。

choices.english: Enjoy the break. I'll keep walking.
choices.chinese: 好好休息。我继续走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Nora plays the short passage at a low volume. The recorded woman counts trays, loses her place, then laughs and starts again.
beats.chinese: 诺拉调低音量，播放了那一小段。录音里的女人数着烤盘，数乱了，笑了一声，又从头开始。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She remembered every tray. Couldn't remember the manager's name.
beats.chinese: 每个烤盘她都记得。经理叫什么倒是忘了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the end of the passage, Nora presses stop and puts the recorder in her bag. She stands and brushes grass from her trousers.
beats.chinese: 片段结束，诺拉按下停止键，把录音机放回包里。她站起来，拍掉裤子上的草屑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's the bit I wanted to hear again. Right then. I'll be on my way. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 我想重听的就是这一段。好了，我该走了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Nora leaves the tape stopped. She looks down at its handwritten label before answering.
beats.chinese: 诺拉没有播放磁带。回答之前，她低头看了看那张手写标签。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thirty years as a postal clerk. I heard plenty of stories. Eventually I asked a few people if I could keep theirs on tape.
beats.chinese: 我做过三十年邮局柜员，听过不少故事。后来我问了几个人，能不能把他们的故事录下来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes a single earpiece from her bag and plugs it into the recorder.
beats.chinese: 她从包里取出一只单耳耳机，插到录音机上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's my own history for now. I'm going back to hers. Nice talking to you.
beats.chinese: 我的故事就先讲这些。我接着听她的了。很高兴和你聊了几句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Nora gestures towards an empty patch of grass beside her, leaving plenty of space between it and her bag.
beats.chinese: 诺拉示意了一下身旁的一块空草地，那里与她的包之间留着宽宽的距离。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's fine. I'm leaving this switched off.
beats.chinese: 可以。这东西我就不开了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A few minutes later, Nora checks her watch. She puts the recorder away, closes her bag and gets to her feet.
beats.chinese: 几分钟后，诺拉看了看手表。她收起录音机，合上包，站起身。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My ten minutes are up. I'll leave you the view. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 我的十分钟到了。风景留给你慢慢看。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the path. Nora stays on the grass and draws her bag closer to her feet.
beats.chinese: 你沿着路径继续走。诺拉仍坐在草地上，把包拉近脚边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She notices the recorder's loose strap against the controls, tucks it inside the bag and pulls the zip shut.
beats.chinese: 她发现录音机松垂的带子抵着按键，便把带子塞进包里，拉好拉链。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. That should keep it out of the conversation.
beats.chinese: 好了。这下它应该不会插话了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Primrose Hill, Nora Price is putting a book into her bag beside the grass path. She recognises you and gives a quick wave.
beats.chinese: 在樱草山，Nora Price站在草坡步道旁，正把书放进包里。她认出你，很快挥了挥手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I'm meeting someone I used to work with at the post office. Lunch. She's promised to tell me absolutely everything.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我约了以前邮局的同事吃午饭。她保证要把所有事都讲给我听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A woman approaches along the path and calls her name. Nora smiles broadly and closes her bag.
beats.chinese: 一位女士沿步道走来，喊了她的名字。Nora笑开了，把包合上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There she is. Good, I'm starving. See you around.
beats.chinese: 她来了。太好了，我都饿了。回头见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Primrose Hill, Ollie Sandbrook stands on the grass beside the path, holding up his phone towards the skyline. The apprentice urban tree surveyor has come for the view on his day off.
beats.chinese: 在樱草山，Ollie Sandbrook站在路径旁的草坡上，举着手机对准远处的天际线。这位城市树木调查员学徒今天休息，特地来看看风景。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I was about to take a photo. You're at the edge of it, so I'll wait. I'm Ollie.
beats.chinese: 我正准备拍照。你在画面边上，我先等等。我叫Ollie。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers the phone instead of taking the picture.
beats.chinese: 他放下手机，没有按快门。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Usually it's trees on my phone. Giving the buildings a turn.
beats.chinese: 我手机里通常都是树。今天也轮到楼房出个镜。

choices.english: Go ahead. I don't mind being at the edge.
choices.chinese: 拍吧。我不介意出现在画面边上。

choices.english: I'd rather stay out of the picture, thanks.
choices.chinese: 我还是不想入镜，谢谢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Before Ollie raises the camera again, his phone sounds an alarm. He glances at the screen.
beats.chinese: Ollie还没重新举起手机，闹钟就响了。他看了一眼屏幕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's my get-going alarm. I've left myself two minutes for this.
beats.chinese: 这是提醒我该走的闹钟。我给拍照留了两分钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He dismisses the alarm and opens the camera again, keeping the phone pointed down.
beats.chinese: 他关掉闹钟，重新打开相机，镜头仍然朝下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I set it early. Otherwise I take twelve versions of the same picture.
beats.chinese: 我特意设早了。不然同一个画面我能拍上十二遍。

choices.english: All right. I'll leave you to get your picture.
choices.chinese: 好，那我不打扰你拍照了。

choices.english: You should check the time again, just to be sure.
choices.chinese: 你还是再看一眼时间吧，保险一点。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ollie turns the phone towards his own chest. He stays on the grass, leaving the path clear.
beats.chinese: Ollie把手机转向自己胸前。他仍站在草地上，没有占着路径。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I haven't taken anything.
beats.chinese: 当然。我还一张都没拍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He locks the screen and holds the phone loosely at his side.
beats.chinese: 他锁上屏幕，随意地把手机垂在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No rush. The buildings look fairly settled.
beats.chinese: 不着急。那些楼看着也没打算挪地方。

choices.english: What do you usually take photos of?
choices.chinese: 你平时都拍些什么？

choices.english: Step away from the frame. Thanks. I'll leave you to it.
choices.chinese: 走出取景范围。谢谢，你拍吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: With your permission to remain at the edge of the frame, Ollie raises the phone towards the skyline.
beats.chinese: 你已经同意出现在画面边缘，Ollie便举起手机，对准天际线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. One picture. That's the plan, anyway.
beats.chinese: 谢了。就拍一张。至少计划是这样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes one photo, briefly checks it, then pockets the phone without trying another angle.
beats.chinese: 他拍了一张，简单看了看，便把手机收进口袋，没有再找别的角度。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Managed to stop at one. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 好了。真在一张停住了。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ollie's thumb stops above the camera button. His jaw tightens.
beats.chinese: Ollie的拇指停在快门键上方，下颌绷紧了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've checked it. You can leave that bit to me.
beats.chinese: 我看过了。这事让我自己管就行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pockets the phone without taking a picture and turns towards the path. After a moment, his shoulders loosen.
beats.chinese: 他没拍照就把手机收起来，转身朝向路径。片刻后，他的肩膀放松下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That came out sharp. Sorry. I'm heading off. Enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 刚才语气冲了，抱歉。我先走了。慢慢看风景吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ollie slips the locked phone into his pocket and turns away from his planned shot.
beats.chinese: Ollie把锁屏的手机放进口袋，转过身，不再对着原先的取景方向。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: London trees, mostly. I map the interesting ones for myself. Work's got enough forms already.
beats.chinese: 主要是伦敦的树。我会自己标下那些有意思的。工作里的表格已经够多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rubs a small patch of chain grease on his thumb and gives a short laugh.
beats.chinese: 他搓了搓拇指上的一小块链条油污，短促地笑了一声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My old bike gets photos too. Mostly to prove where a bit went before I took it off. Anyway, enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 我那辆旧自行车也常入镜。主要是拆零件前，留个证据证明它原来装在哪儿。好了，祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ollie waits while you step out of the frame, keeping his phone lowered.
beats.chinese: 你走出取景范围时，Ollie一直放低手机等着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. That gives me a clear shot.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。这样就不会拍到你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He angles the phone towards the skyline, away from you, and takes his photo. He lowers it again before giving you a small nod.
beats.chinese: 他将手机朝向天际线，避开你，拍下照片。随后他放下手机，向你轻轻点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Got it. Have a good one.
beats.chinese: 拍好了。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Primrose Hill, Ollie stands on the grass beside the path, turning over a small bicycle part he brought along to examine. He recognises you and smiles.
beats.chinese: 在樱草山，Ollie站在路径旁的草地上，将特意带来查看的自行车小零件在掌心翻过一面。他认出了你，笑了笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. I'm halfway through fixing my bike at home. Came out to clear my head.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。我在家修车修到一半，出来换换脑子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He carefully wraps the part in a tissue, secures it in a zipped pocket and turns towards the skyline.
beats.chinese: 他用纸巾仔细包好零件，收进带拉链的口袋，然后转向天际线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave it for now. Get back to it when I'm home. Good to see you.
beats.chinese: 这会儿先不琢磨它，回去再接着修。见到你真好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the High Line, Jonah Petrov is taking a walk after a shift building bicycle wheels. Beside the railing and late-winter grasses, Jonah holds an old magazine securely inside an open folder. A picture of a kettle is visible on the page.
beats.chinese: 高线公园里，Jonah Petrov结束了一班自行车轮组制作工作，来这里散步。在护栏与冬末的枯草带旁，Jonah把一本旧杂志稳稳夹在打开的文件夹里。书页上露出一张水壶的图片。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Excuse me. This kettle looks red, doesn't it? I remembered it as orange.
beats.chinese: 打扰一下。这只壶看着是红的吧？我一直记成橙色。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah angles the magazine toward you without handing it over, staying beside the railing and leaving the walking lane clear.
beats.chinese: Jonah把杂志朝向你，没有递过来，仍站在护栏旁，留出通行的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just the kettle in the corner.
beats.chinese: 就是角落里那只水壶。

choices.english: Yes, red. Did you bring the magazine to read?
choices.chinese: 是红的。你带杂志来是想读吗？

choices.english: Looks red to me. It's windy up here.
choices.chinese: 我看是红的。上面风挺大的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah holds the open magazine flat against the folder. The magazine has several neat rectangular gaps.
beats.chinese: Jonah把打开的杂志按平在文件夹上。杂志里有几处裁得整整齐齐的长方形缺口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: For a collage at home. I remembered a picture in here halfway through my walk.
beats.chinese: 是给家里的拼贴画用的。走到一半，我想起里面有张图片。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah lifts one corner of the page, keeping the rest pinned down with a thumb.
beats.chinese: Jonah掀起纸页的一角，拇指仍然压着其余部分。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I have a whole wall of unfinished ones. Finding another picture is easier than finishing anything.
beats.chinese: 我有一整面墙都挂着没做完的。再找一张图片，比完成哪一幅都容易。

choices.english: What stood out about the picture?
choices.chinese: 这张图片有什么特别显眼的地方？

choices.english: I'll leave you to your walk.
choices.chinese: 那就不打扰你散步了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah lowers the magazine against the folder and holds the cover down with a forearm.
beats.chinese: Jonah放低杂志，让它贴着文件夹，用前臂压住封面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. I only opened it to check that picture.
beats.chinese: 是啊。我打开它，只是想确认一下那张图片。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah tries to slide the magazine into the folder, but one corner catches.
beats.chinese: Jonah试着把杂志塞回文件夹，一个角却卡住了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Almost.
beats.chinese: 好了。差一点。

choices.english: You could fold it in half.
choices.chinese: 可以把它对折一下。

choices.english: I'll let you get that sorted. Enjoy your walk.
choices.chinese: 你慢慢收好吧。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah angles the open magazine so the rest of the old advertisement is visible. The red kettle fills one corner.
beats.chinese: Jonah调整打开的杂志的角度，让你也能看见那则旧广告的其他部分。红水壶占据了其中一个角落。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That kettle. Most of the page is beige, and then there's this very loud red thing.
beats.chinese: 那只水壶。整页大半都是米色，偏偏这里有个特别抢眼的红东西。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah slides the magazine into the folder and closes it firmly, remaining beside the railing.
beats.chinese: Jonah把杂志放进文件夹，牢牢合上，仍站在护栏旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's the one. I'll deal with the scissors at home. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 就是它了。剪刀的事回家再说。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah stops looking through the magazine and closes its cover.
beats.chinese: Jonah不再翻看杂志，合上了封面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I came out to walk and immediately gave myself something else to do.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我明明出来散步，立刻又给自己找了件别的事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: With the closed folder tucked under one arm, Jonah turns along the path and takes a few steps.
beats.chinese: Jonah把合好的文件夹夹在臂下，转身沿步道往前走了几步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care.
beats.chinese: 再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah pauses with the magazine halfway inside the folder, then gently pulls it back out.
beats.chinese: 杂志塞到一半，Jonah停了一下，又轻轻把它抽出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hm, no. I don't like a crease through the pictures. Even the ones I'm going to cut up.
beats.chinese: 嗯，还是不了。我不喜欢图片中间有折痕。就算准备剪碎的也一样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah straightens the caught corner and slides the magazine in flat. The folder closes at last.
beats.chinese: Jonah理平卡住的纸角，把杂志平整地送进去。文件夹终于合上了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That took longer than it deserved. Thanks, though. Have a good walk.
beats.chinese: 为这点事花的时间可真够长的。不过还是谢谢。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah stops trying to fit the magazine inside and lays it against the closed folder instead.
beats.chinese: Jonah不再往里塞杂志，转而把它贴在合上的文件夹外侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. This will do until I'm indoors.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。进屋之前，先这样拿着就行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah secures both beneath one arm and turns back along the same stretch of walkway.
beats.chinese: Jonah把两样东西一起夹稳在臂下，转身沿着这段步道往回走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beside the railing on the side of the High Line walkway, Jonah Petrov closes a folder containing old magazines, then looks up and recognizes you.
beats.chinese: 在高线公园步道同一侧的护栏旁，Jonah Petrov合上装着旧杂志的文件夹，抬头认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello. On my walk today, I finally worked out which part of my collage at home to leave blank.
beats.chinese: 哦，你好。今天散步时，我终于想好了家里的拼贴画该在哪儿留一块空白。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jonah keeps the folder closed and glances at the dry grasses, looking satisfied. With the folder tucked under one arm, Jonah turns to continue along the same walkway.
beats.chinese: Jonah没有重新打开文件夹，只望了一眼枯草带，神情满足。把文件夹夹在臂下后，Jonah转身，准备沿原步道继续向前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Leaving that space blank is the right choice. All right, I'll keep walking.
beats.chinese: 留着那块空白就对了。好了，我继续走走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the High Line, Dolores Camacho has stopped beside the railing after her sculpture-cleaning shift to loosen her shoulders. Dry winter grass borders the walkway. As you come level with her, a flap of the paper model in her hands springs toward your sleeve.
beats.chinese: 高线公园里，Dolores Camacho结束了清洗雕塑的工作，停在护栏旁活动肩膀。冬末的枯草沿着步道生长。你来到她身边时，她手中纸模型的一片折翼突然弹向你的袖口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry. Did that catch your sleeve?
beats.chinese: 抱歉。碰到你的袖子了吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She draws the model close to her coat and holds the loose flap between two fingers.
beats.chinese: 她把模型收回外套前，用两根手指夹住松开的折翼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That bit opens farther than I remembered.
beats.chinese: 这部分展开的幅度比我记得的大。

choices.english: It brushed me. No harm. What is it?
choices.chinese: 擦到了一下，没事。这是什么？

choices.english: It missed. You caught it in time.
choices.chinese: 没碰到。你及时收回去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dolores turns the model sideways. It is a small paper bird with several folds tucked beneath its wings.
beats.chinese: Dolores把模型侧过来。那是一只小纸鸟，翅膀下藏着几道折叠。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A bird with moving wings. I'm Dolores. I fold these at home, usually with a cat trying to sit on the paper.
beats.chinese: 一只翅膀会动的鸟。我叫Dolores。我在家折这些，通常还有只猫想坐到纸上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her thumb stops on a crease. She looks toward your sleeve again, then notices that she has stopped showing you the bird.
beats.chinese: 她的拇指停在一道折痕上，又朝你的袖口看了一眼，随后才发觉自己停下了展示。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And the sleeve's all right? You did say no harm. Yes. Sorry.
beats.chinese: 袖子也没事吧？你确实说了没事。对。抱歉。

choices.english: We're fine. I'd like to see the wings move.
choices.chinese: 真的没事。我想看看翅膀怎么动。

choices.english: It's fine. May I hold it?
choices.chinese: 没事。我可以拿着看看吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dolores checks that both paper wings are tucked in. She stays beside the railing, leaving the walking space clear.
beats.chinese: Dolores检查了一下，确认两边纸翅膀都收好了。她留在护栏旁，让出通行的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. I'm Dolores. I've finished work, but my hands apparently haven't.
beats.chinese: 那就好。我叫Dolores。我已经下班了，看来手还没下班。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lowers the bird and rolls one shoulder, then the other.
beats.chinese: 她放低纸鸟，先转了转一侧肩膀，又转了转另一侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came up for a short walk. Standing here folding things wasn't the plan.
beats.chinese: 我本来是上来走一小段的，没打算站在这儿折东西。

choices.english: I'll let you get to your walk. Take care.
choices.chinese: 那就不耽误你散步了。再见。

choices.english: What sort of work do you do?
choices.chinese: 你做什么工作？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dolores holds the bird low between you, well away from your clothes and the passing space.
beats.chinese: Dolores把纸鸟放低，举在你们之间，离你的衣服和通行区域都远一些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. This one gets two good flaps before something slips.
beats.chinese: 好。这只能好好扑腾两下，之后就有地方会松。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She moves the tail. Both wings lift twice, then one sticks upright. She presses it flat and puts the bird in her coat pocket.
beats.chinese: 她动了动尾巴。两只翅膀抬起两次，随后一只竖着卡住了。她把它压平，将纸鸟放进外套口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Two. Better stop while it's keeping its promise. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 两下。趁它还算说话算话，就到这里吧。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dolores keeps the bird in her own hands, with her fingers supporting the folded body.
beats.chinese: Dolores仍把纸鸟拿在自己手里，手指托住折起来的鸟身。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd rather keep hold of it. A fold inside is splitting.
beats.chinese: 我还是自己拿着吧。里面有道折痕快裂了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tilts it once so the small tear is visible, then carefully folds both wings against the body and puts it away.
beats.chinese: 她把纸鸟倾斜了一下，让那道小裂口露出来，随后小心地将双翼贴着鸟身折好，收了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's enough handling for this one. Nice talking to you. Take care.
beats.chinese: 这只今天经不起再摆弄了。很高兴和你聊了几句。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The conversation ends as you continue along the walkway. Dolores remains beside the railing.
beats.chinese: 你沿着步道继续前行，对话就此结束。Dolores留在护栏旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. Thanks for letting me know it missed.
beats.chinese: 你也是。谢谢你告诉我没碰到。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the folded bird securely into her pocket and closes the pocket flap.
beats.chinese: 她把折好的纸鸟稳稳放进口袋，盖好袋盖。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. That can stay put for a bit. Bye.
beats.chinese: 好了。让它在里面待一会儿。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dolores tucks the bird away. She rubs her thumb across a faint dry patch on one knuckle.
beats.chinese: Dolores收起纸鸟，用拇指擦了擦另一只手指关节上一小块干燥的皮肤。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: City sculpture cleaning crew. Nineteen years. Bronze, granite, whatever needs the right treatment.
beats.chinese: 市里的雕塑清洗队。干了十九年。青铜、花岗岩，各有各的处理办法。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She opens and closes her hand, then turns along the clear walkway to begin her own walk.
beats.chinese: 她张开手，又握了一下，随后转向畅通的步道，开始自己的散步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mostly careful work, with some hard scrubbing. My shoulders have had enough of both today. Nice meeting you.
beats.chinese: 大部分时候得细心，有时也得用力刷。今天这两样，我的肩膀都受够了。很高兴认识你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the High Line, Dolores stands beside the railing with her arms hanging loosely at her sides. She recognizes you and smiles.
beats.chinese: 在高线公园，Dolores站在护栏旁，双臂自然垂在身侧。她认出了你，笑了笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. My shoulders are tired today. This is as far as I'm walking.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天肩膀累，我就走到这里。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slowly rolls one shoulder once, then stops. She lets her arms rest at her sides, leaving the walkway clear.
beats.chinese: 她慢慢转动了一次肩膀，随后停下，让双臂垂在身侧休息，没有占住通行的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A walk isn't an extra shift. I'll stand here a little longer. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 散步不是补一班工。我再站一会儿，你慢慢走。

causality.presenceReason: Dolores清洗雕塑下班后，已独自来到高线公园短走、活动肩膀，停步时拿出了随身纸机关。

causality.currentGoal: 收好意外弹开的纸翼，确认没有碰坏对方衣物，然后继续自己的散步。
causality.currentState: 肩膀疲劳，态度温和，愿意短聊。得到没事的回答后，仍会走神复核小小的过失。
causality.contactTrigger: 玩家来到身边时，纸机关的一片折翼突然朝袖口弹开，Dolores主动询问是否碰到。
