beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the High Line, Theo Marchetti is taking an after-work walk with a pocket maze book he brought for a break. As you reach him, he moves toward the railing, leaving the walkway clear beside the dry grasses.
beats.chinese: 在高线公园，Theo Marchetti正下班散步，随身带着一本休息时翻的小迷宫册。你来到他附近时，他往护栏一侧靠了靠，让枯草带旁的通行面保持畅通。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Go ahead. I'm stopping here. Walking and looking at this was a poor combination.
beats.chinese: 你先过吧，我在这儿停一会儿。边走边看这个，实在不太合适。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers the book. One pencil line already reaches the maze's exit, but his pencil is resting at the entrance again.
beats.chinese: 他放低小册子。一条铅笔线已经通到了迷宫出口，他的笔尖却又停在入口处。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Theo. I've found the way out. Apparently I also need to investigate the bad options.
beats.chinese: 我叫Theo。出去的路已经找到了。看来我还非得研究一下那些糟糕的选项。

choices.english: What are you trying this time?
choices.chinese: 这次你准备怎么走？

choices.english: Thanks. I'll let you get back to it.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，那就不打扰你继续研究了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Theo angles the book toward you without stepping back into the walking space. His pencil follows a narrow branch away from the completed route.
beats.chinese: Theo把小册子朝你倾过来，没有退回通行面。他的笔尖沿着一条狭窄岔路移动，离已经画好的路线越来越远。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This branch. It looks terrible, but there's a little turn behind that wall I haven't tried.
beats.chinese: 这条岔路。看着就不妙，不过那堵墙后面有个小弯，我还没试过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He starts down the branch, pauses at the obvious route to the exit, and deliberately carries on past it.
beats.chinese: 他沿岔路画下去，在那条明显通向出口的路旁停了一下，又有意绕了过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I edit rules for children's board games. At work, I have to catch every dead end. This one can waste a little of my evening.
beats.chinese: 我是儿童桌游的规则编辑。工作时，每一条走不通的路都得查出来。这一条嘛，可以让它浪费我一点晚上的时间。

choices.english: I'll watch one attempt, then move on.
choices.chinese: 我看你试一次，然后就继续走。

choices.english: I'd stop once I'd found the exit. Enjoy your puzzle.
choices.chinese: 换作我，找到出口就收手了。你慢慢玩。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Theo draws the book closer to his chest and turns his shoulders toward the railing. There is clear space to pass.
beats.chinese: Theo把小册子收近胸前，身体转向护栏，旁边留出了足够的通行空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure. Have a good walk.
beats.chinese: 好，散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks the pencil tip, then holds it above the page without making another mark.
beats.chinese: 他检查了一下笔尖，随后把笔悬在纸页上，没有再落笔。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll stay out of the traffic up here.
beats.chinese: 我就靠边待着，不挡这里的路。

choices.english: Give him a nod and continue along the walkway.
choices.chinese: 向他点点头，沿步道继续走。

choices.english: Before moving on, ask, “Do you make those puzzles?”
choices.chinese: 离开前问一句：“这些谜题是你设计的吗？”

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Theo traces the little turn. It leads into a closed square, a few millimeters from the route he already knows works.
beats.chinese: Theo沿着那个小弯画过去，结果钻进了一个封闭方格，离那条已知可行的路线只有几毫米。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There it is. A very thorough dead end.
beats.chinese: 找到了。一条堵得相当彻底的死路。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lifts his pencil and smiles. As you move on after the agreed attempt, he turns the book slightly and studies the same branch again.
beats.chinese: 他抬起铅笔，笑了笑。看完说好的一次尝试后，你继续前行。他却把小册子转了个角度，又端详起同一条岔路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That was your one attempt. Thanks for stopping. I'm checking whether I missed a gap.
beats.chinese: 说好的一次试完了。谢谢你停下来看看。我再检查一下，是不是漏了个缺口。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Theo glances from the finished route to the unfinished pencil line. His pencil hovers over the next turn.
beats.chinese: Theo看看已经走通的路线，又看看没画完的铅笔线。笔尖悬在下一个转弯上方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I did come up here for a walk.
beats.chinese: 也对。我本来是上来散步的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He almost touches the pencil to the page, then closes the book and puts both in his coat pocket. He turns to look at the vehicles moving below.
beats.chinese: 铅笔差一点又落到纸上，他却合起小册子，把书和笔都放进外套口袋，转头望向下方行驶的车辆。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm putting it away before I find another excuse. Enjoy the rest of your walk.
beats.chinese: 趁我还没找到别的借口，先收起来。祝你接下来逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You nod and continue along the High Line. Theo stays beside the railing rather than falling into step with you.
beats.chinese: 你点点头，沿高线公园继续走。Theo留在护栏边，没有跟上来同行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care.
beats.chinese: 慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He raises his pencil in a brief goodbye, then looks down and adds another short line to the maze.
beats.chinese: 他举了举铅笔，简短地道别，随后低头，在迷宫里又添了一小段线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. One more corner.
beats.chinese: 好，再看一个拐角。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Theo looks up at your question and closes the book around his pencil.
beats.chinese: 听见你的问题，Theo抬起头，把铅笔夹进小册子里，合上书。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No, I buy these. I edit rulebooks for children's board games. Enough tiny print to keep me busy.
beats.chinese: 不是，这些是我买的。我做儿童桌游的规则书编辑。那些小字就够我忙的了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pockets the book, checks the space beside him, and resumes his own walk along the same side of the elevated path.
beats.chinese: 他把小册子放进口袋，确认身旁有空当，便沿着高架步道的同一侧继续自己的散步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And that's enough small print for one evening. Nice meeting you.
beats.chinese: 今晚的小字也看够了。很高兴认识你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the High Line, Theo Marchetti recognises you beside the railing. A small boxed game is tucked under his arm.
beats.chinese: 在高线公园，Theo Marchetti在栏杆旁认出你，腋下夹着一小盒桌游。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Found this in a Queens game shop. Never heard of it. Two players, twenty minutes, according to the box.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。在皇后区一家游戏店找到这个，从没听过。盒上写两个人、二十分钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the box to read the description, smiling, then secures it under his arm again.
beats.chinese: 他把盒子转过来读了读介绍，笑着重新夹稳。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: For once I don't know the winning move. Looking forward to that. I'll ask who's free tonight. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 这回总算不知道哪步能赢了。挺期待。问问今晚谁有空。散步愉快。

causality.presenceReason: Theo下班后已在高线公园散步，随身带着供休息消遣的小迷宫册，先于玩家到场。

stories.titleZh: 海泽尔把结尾说在了前头

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On New York's High Line, Hazel Wroe has paused beside the winter-brown grasses to read a message from her sister Ruth. She came for a short walk between sessions on a temporary archive project. As you come within earshot, she laughs and looks up.
beats.chinese: 在纽约高线公园，海泽尔·罗停在冬末枯草带旁，读姐姐露丝发来的消息。她正参与一个临时档案项目，趁工作间隙来走走。你进入她说话可听见的范围时，她笑出了声，抬起头来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, I'm laughing at this, love. Nothing you've done. I'm Hazel.
beats.chinese: 哦，我是在笑这个，亲爱的，跟你没关系。我叫海泽尔。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts her phone away, still smiling, and stays close to the grass edge so others can pass.
beats.chinese: 她收起手机，脸上还带着笑，站在靠近草带的一侧，让其他人通行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My sister's reminded me of a daft joke from work. I've already started laughing too early.
beats.chinese: 我姐姐让我想起了单位里的一个傻笑话。我这还没讲呢，就先笑上了。

choices.english: Go on, what's the joke?
choices.chinese: 说来听听，什么笑话？

choices.english: No worries. I'll leave you to your walk.
choices.chinese: 没事。那我不打扰你散步了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Hazel turns towards you without moving farther into the walkway. Her smile widens before she gets a word out.
beats.chinese: 海泽尔转向你，没有往通行面中间挪。话还没出口，她的笑容就更大了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He says, 'If we find them, they're not missing!' And I—no wait, I've missed the beginning.
beats.chinese: 他说，‘要是找着了，那就不算遗失了！’然后我——等等，我把开头漏了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She presses her lips together, trying to stop another laugh, then opens both hands.
beats.chinese: 她抿住嘴，努力忍住又一阵笑，随后摊开双手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I check script licences at a regional TV archive. A colleague labelled an empty folder 'Missing Scripts'. That bit was supposed to come first.
beats.chinese: 我在一家地方电视档案馆核查剧本授权。有个同事给一个空文件夹贴了‘遗失剧本’的标签。这部分本来该先说。

choices.english: Start again. Give me the whole thing in order.
choices.chinese: 重新来吧。按顺序讲一遍。

choices.english: No restart for me, thanks. I'd rather look at the view.
choices.chinese: 不用重讲了，谢谢。我想看看风景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Hazel nods and turns slightly along the walkway, leaving the conversation easy to end.
beats.chinese: 海泽尔点点头，身体稍稍转向步道前方，没有拦着你继续交谈。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I only meant to explain the laughing.
beats.chinese: 好啊。我就是解释一下刚才为什么笑。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes a step, then looks back with one finger raised. The finger drops almost immediately.
beats.chinese: 她迈出一步，又回过头，竖起一根手指。那根手指几乎立刻就放下了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It starts with an empty folder—oh, you've said you're going. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 开头是一个空文件夹——哦，你都说要走了。散步愉快。

choices.english: Thanks. Enjoy yours. (Continue along the walkway.)
choices.chinese: 谢谢，你也是。（沿步道继续走。）

choices.english: All right, give me the short version.
choices.chinese: 好吧，那就讲个简短版。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Hazel settles her hands at her sides and makes a serious attempt to begin properly.
beats.chinese: 海泽尔把双手放回身侧，认认真真地试着从头讲。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: An empty folder says 'Missing Scripts'. I ask what goes inside. My colleague says, 'Nothing. Once we find a script, it belongs somewhere else.'
beats.chinese: 一个空文件夹上写着‘遗失剧本’。我问里面放什么。同事说，‘什么都不放。剧本一旦找着，就该放别处了。’

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gets through the final sentence, then breaks into a laugh of her own and begins walking along the same side of the path.
beats.chinese: 她总算把最后一句说完整，接着自己笑了起来，沿着步道同一侧往前走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There, a beginning and an end. Cheers for letting me get both out. Enjoy the rest of your walk.
beats.chinese: 这回有头有尾了。谢谢你肯让我把两头都讲出来。接着好好散步吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Hazel's mouth is already open for another attempt when your refusal reaches her.
beats.chinese: 听见你不想再听时，海泽尔已经张开嘴，准备再讲一遍了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The folder was empty because—yes, right. No restart.
beats.chinese: 文件夹空着是因为——嗯，好。不重讲。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She shuts her mouth, gives a small nod, and turns towards the grasses, ending the conversation without moving into your space.
beats.chinese: 她合上嘴，轻轻点头，转向枯草带，没有往你这边挤，交谈就此结束。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy the view. I'll keep the rest to myself.
beats.chinese: 好好看风景吧。剩下的我就不说了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the walkway, Hazel remains beside the grass edge.
beats.chinese: 你沿步道继续前行，海泽尔留在草带旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers, love. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 谢谢，亲爱的。祝你下午过得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives one brief wave, then takes out her phone and begins typing a reply to Ruth.
beats.chinese: 她简短地挥了一下手，随后拿出手机，开始给露丝回消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, Ruth. You're getting the long version.
beats.chinese: 好了，露丝。完整版归你听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Hazel turns back towards you and holds up two fingers, counting out her shortened version.
beats.chinese: 海泽尔转回身，竖起两根手指，数着讲她的简短版。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Empty folder labelled 'Missing Scripts'. I ask what goes in it. 'Nothing. Find them and they're not missing.' That's the lot.
beats.chinese: 空文件夹上贴着‘遗失剧本’。我问里面放什么。‘什么都不放。找着了，就不算遗失。’讲完了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds both fingers down, pleased to have kept it brief, and turns to resume her walk.
beats.chinese: 她把两根手指收起来，很满意这回讲得够短，转身继续散步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Managed it without a detour. I'll leave you to it now. Bye!
beats.chinese: 这回总算没绕弯。现在不耽误你了。再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: During another work break on the High Line, Hazel Wroe stands near the grass edge, typing a reply to her sister Ruth. She looks up and recognises you.
beats.chinese: 又一次工作间隙，海泽尔·罗站在高线步道的草带旁，打字回复姐姐露丝。她抬起头，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again, love! I need to finish this reply to Ruth first.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了，亲爱的！我得先把给露丝这条回完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks down and finishes the last sentence. Her smile fades as she reads it through carefully to check the wording, then sends it and puts her phone away.
beats.chinese: 她低头补完最后一句，收起笑意，认真通读一遍，确认措辞后发送，再把手机收起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Some things are better written out clearly than made into a joke. I've still got a few minutes. I'm going for a walk.
beats.chinese: 有些话打清楚比讲个笑话管用。我还剩几分钟，走走去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the upper platform overlooking Grand Central Terminal's main concourse, Herbert Nussbaum is waiting for his wife to arrive by train. He holds a sheet of lettering practice close in front of him, looking at one letter.
beats.chinese: 在中央车站俯瞰大厅的上层平台上，Herbert Nussbaum正等妻子乘火车到站。他把一张练字纸收在自己身前，看着其中一个字母。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That g. Finally got it right.
beats.chinese: 这个g，总算写顺了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He says it softly, with a pleased smile, then glances toward you nearby. Several versions of the same names cover the sheet, each written in careful, rounded letters.
beats.chinese: 他轻声说着，满意地笑了笑，随后看向近处的你。纸上反复写着几个相同的名字，字母圆润，一笔一画都很仔细。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I was talking to this letter. Names for a small dinner. I brought this to finish while I wait for my wife.
beats.chinese: 我是在跟这个字母说话。给一顿小聚餐写的名字。我带来，想等我太太的时候写完。

choices.english: Are you making place cards?
choices.chinese: 你在做座位名卡吗？

choices.english: I'd like to look at the hall quietly for a while.
choices.chinese: 我想安静地看看大厅。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Herbert turns the sheet inward so it stays within the width of his shoulders. A few names have tiny pencil marks underneath.
beats.chinese: Herbert把纸向内转了转，让它不再超出肩膀的宽度。有几个名字下面画着细小的铅笔记号。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. Eight people, one meal. Then a memory from each person. No photographs.
beats.chinese: 是。八个人，一顿饭。然后每人讲一段回忆。不拍照。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His finger stops beneath a lowercase g. He smiles, then notices a neighboring letter and presses his lips together.
beats.chinese: 他的手指停在一个小写g下面，脸上露出笑意。接着他看到旁边的字母，又抿起了嘴。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That g came out well. The next letter leans. That's why George has been written six times.
beats.chinese: 这个g写得挺好。后面那个字母歪了。所以George这个名字写了六遍。

choices.english: May I have a closer look at that g?
choices.chinese: 我能凑近看看那个g吗？

choices.english: Did your work involve lettering?
choices.chinese: 你以前的工作跟写字有关吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Herbert nods and lowers the sheet, keeping clear of the people passing along the platform. He brings the two edges of the sheet together.
beats.chinese: Herbert点点头，放低纸，也避开了平台上经过的人。他把纸的两边对齐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I'll leave you to the view.
beats.chinese: 当然。你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The corners fail to meet. He opens the sheet and starts the fold again, more slowly.
beats.chinese: 两个纸角没对上。他重新展开纸，更慢地折了一次。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It fits my bag when it's folded properly.
beats.chinese: 折齐了才能放进包里。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll leave you to it.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。你慢慢弄，我不打扰了。

choices.english: You could just tuck it in. A crease won't hurt it.
choices.chinese: 直接塞进去也行吧。有道折痕又不会弄坏。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Herbert holds the sheet upright at chest height, with the small g facing you. The paper stays close to him as people pass.
beats.chinese: Herbert把纸竖在胸前，让那个小写g朝着你。有人经过时，他也始终把纸收在身前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here. The tail clears the letter beside it. Just enough space.
beats.chinese: 这里。它的尾巴跟旁边那个字母分开了。距离刚刚好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He leaves it visible for a few seconds, smiling at the letter himself. Then he folds the sheet and puts it away.
beats.chinese: 他把纸展示了几秒，自己也望着那个字母笑了笑。随后，他折好纸，收了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm keeping that version. Enjoy the view. I'll watch for my wife.
beats.chinese: 这一版我要留下。你慢慢看风景，我留意一下我太太。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Herbert lowers the sheet. He shakes his head once, with a small smile.
beats.chinese: Herbert放低纸，轻轻摇了一下头，露出一点笑意。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Tea inspection. Twenty-six years with a bubble tea chain, going around the boroughs. Brew strength, steep times, tapioca texture.
beats.chinese: 茶饮质检。在一家珍珠奶茶连锁店干了二十六年，跑纽约各个区。查茶的浓度、浸泡时间，还有珍珠的口感。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds the practice sheet into his bag, then looks down at the concourse from the same upper platform.
beats.chinese: 他把练字纸折好放进包里，随后仍站在同一上层平台上，向下看大厅。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Retired four years ago. I don't miss the commuting. Well, I'll get back to watching for my wife. Nice talking with you.
beats.chinese: 四年前退休了。我可不怀念通勤。好了，我得接着留意我太太了。跟你聊得很愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Herbert stops folding long enough to give you a small nod. He keeps the sheet close to him.
beats.chinese: Herbert暂时停下折纸，向你轻轻点头。他仍把纸收在身前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. Enjoy your visit.
beats.chinese: 好。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns slightly away and lines up the paper's corners. Once they meet, he smooths the fold with his thumb.
beats.chinese: 他稍稍转过身，把纸角对齐。对好后，他用拇指压平折痕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. That fits.
beats.chinese: 好了。这下放得进去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Herbert pauses with the sheet half folded. He looks down at its uneven edges rather than putting it into his bag.
beats.chinese: Herbert拿着折到一半的纸停了一下。他低头看着没对齐的纸边，没有把它放进包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It won't hurt the paper. It'll bend the corners, though.
beats.chinese: 纸是不会坏。不过纸角会翘起来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens it again and carefully matches the corners. He finishes the fold before putting the sheet away.
beats.chinese: 他再次展开纸，仔细把几个角对齐。折好之后，他才把纸收起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I want them flat when I write. All done now. I'll let you get on.
beats.chinese: 我写字时希望纸是平的。现在弄好了。不耽误你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Grand Central Terminal, you see Herbert on the upper platform above the main concourse. He recognizes you while tapping three fingers against his trouser seam.
beats.chinese: 在中央车站，你在大厅上方的平台看到了Herbert。他认出了你，三根手指还在裤缝边轻轻敲着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I've had three notes in my head since handbell rehearsal.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。手铃排练以后，三个音就一直在我脑子里转。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His fingers repeat the pattern once. He notices, opens his hand, and rests it against his leg.
beats.chinese: 他的手指又敲了一遍那个节奏。他察觉后，张开手，把手掌贴在腿边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We finally got that bit together. I can give it a rest now. Good to see you.
beats.chinese: 我们总算把那一小段合上了。现在可以歇歇了。见到你真好。

causality.presenceReason: Herbert先到中央车站等乘火车来的妻子，随身带了聚餐名卡的练字稿，想利用等候时间完成。
causality.placeAttitude: 把上层平台当作普通等候地点，也接受别人来此看大厅，没有主动充当导游。
causality.stayingConstraint: 尚在等妻子，因此结束交谈后仍留在上层平台留意下方大厅。
causality.currentGoal: 检查聚餐名卡上名字的字形，并把练字纸妥善收好。
causality.currentState: 不赶时间，专注于纸上细节，因一个小写g终于写顺而轻声表达喜悦。愿意短聊，但对折纸和字形略显固执。
causality.contactTrigger: 练字纸始终保持在自己身前。他看着字母轻声说这个g终于写顺，随后向近处的玩家解释自己是在跟字母说话，并说明在写聚餐用的名字。不道歉、不索取评价，玩家可选择询问名卡或表示想安静看大厅。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留退休茶饮质检员、手铃团成员和字形爱好者身份。通过对小写g的喜悦、反复写名字和坚持对齐纸角表现细致与固执，聚餐不拍照的界限保持明确。玩家想安静看大厅时，他礼貌接受，不要求继续交谈。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家询问名卡后，aa按玩家请求短暂展示小写g，再收纸结束。ab简答职业问题后，仍在同一上层平台向下看大厅，继续等妻子。玩家表示想安静看大厅后，他开始收纸。ba接受玩家结束交流，独自折纸。bb没有采纳随手塞纸的建议，完成整齐折叠后道别。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全部发生在照片所示俯瞰大厅的同一上层平台。练字纸保持在Herbert身前，收纸时避开经过的人，不新增设施，不下楼，也不进入其他场景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Grand Central Terminal, Cecil Grantley stands on the upper platform overlooking the main concourse. They arrived early to meet their nephew. With you nearby, they give a crisp, practiced greeting.
beats.chinese: 中央车站里，Cecil Grantley站在俯瞰大厅的上层平台上。他们来早了，正在等侄子。你就在附近，他们字正腔圆、十分熟练地打了声招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good evening. Here is the—oh, hello.
beats.chinese: 晚上好。现在为您播报——哦，你好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cecil stops halfway through a small announcing gesture and lowers their hand.
beats.chinese: Cecil那只配合播报而抬起的手停在半空，随后放了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Cecil. I used to read the news. That greeting comes out when I'm waiting. My nephew isn't here yet.
beats.chinese: 我叫Cecil，以前是新闻播音员。等人的时候，这句开场白就会自己冒出来。我侄子还没到。

choices.english: You can finish that introduction.
choices.chinese: 你可以把那句开场白说完。

choices.english: Hello, Cecil. I'd like to look at the hall quietly.
choices.chinese: 你好，Cecil。我想安静地看看大厅。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cecil straightens a little and addresses you in an even, carefully paced voice.
beats.chinese: Cecil稍稍站直，用平稳而讲究节奏的声音对你说话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here is the news, read by Cecil Grantley. That's how we opened in Kingston.
beats.chinese: 现在由Cecil Grantley为您播报新闻。我们在金斯敦就是这样开场的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They smile. After a brief pause, their fingers begin marking out another sentence.
beats.chinese: 他们笑了笑。才停顿片刻，手指又开始随着下一句话打起拍子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thirty years of that. Nine years retired. And now the weather—sorry, you only asked for the introduction.
beats.chinese: 这样播了三十多年，退休也九年了。接下来是天气——抱歉，你只让我说完开场白。

choices.english: I'd like one short story about the station.
choices.chinese: 我想听一个关于电台的小故事，简短的就好。

choices.english: That's enough broadcasting for me. I'll be on my way. Goodbye, Cecil.
choices.chinese: 我听到这里就够了。我该走了。再见，Cecil。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cecil turns slightly toward the concourse, leaving you out of their direct line of sight.
beats.chinese: Cecil稍稍转向大厅，不再正面看着你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I'll leave you to the view.
beats.chinese: 当然。你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A few seconds pass. Their thumb taps against their fingertips, and they glance toward the distant clock.
beats.chinese: 几秒钟过去。他们用拇指轻点其他手指，朝远处的钟看了一眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That clock is a long way off. I used to keep one beside the microphone. Oh. I was going to be quiet.
beats.chinese: 那座钟离这里真远。我以前会在麦克风旁边放一只钟。哦，我刚才说好不出声的。

choices.english: I'll move farther along the platform. Enjoy meeting your nephew.
choices.chinese: 我往平台那边挪一挪。祝你和侄子见面愉快。

choices.english: A little conversation is fine. What keeps you busy at home?
choices.chinese: 聊一小会儿也可以。你在家都忙些什么？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cecil lifts one finger, marking your request for a single story.
beats.chinese: Cecil竖起一根手指，记着你只要一个故事。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Our transmitter used to drop out in the rain. Once, I finished a whole item before the producer told me nobody could hear it. I even read the correction.
beats.chinese: 我们以前的发射机一下雨就会断讯。有一次，我把整条新闻念完，制作人才告诉我根本没人听得到。连更正稿我都念了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Someone farther along the same platform waves. Cecil recognizes their nephew, returns the wave, and turns toward him.
beats.chinese: 同一平台稍远处有人挥手。Cecil认出是侄子，挥手回应，转身朝向他。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's my nephew. I'll spare him the repeat bulletin. It was good talking with you. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 我侄子来了。就不给他重播一遍了。很高兴和你聊了聊，再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cecil draws breath as if to add something, then closes their mouth and nods.
beats.chinese: Cecil吸了口气，像是还想补充什么，随后闭上嘴，点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I nearly started another item.
beats.chinese: 当然。我差点又要播下一条了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They give a small wave as you continue along the platform, then turn back to look for their nephew.
beats.chinese: 你沿着平台继续走去，他们轻轻挥手，随后转回去寻找侄子的身影。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Goodbye. Enjoy your visit.
beats.chinese: 再见。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You move farther along the same platform. Cecil makes no move to follow.
beats.chinese: 你往同一平台的另一边走开一些。Cecil没有跟过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. Take care.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cecil clasps their hands and turns to watch for their nephew, ending the exchange across the growing distance.
beats.chinese: Cecil双手交握，转头留意侄子是否来了。随着距离拉开，这段交谈也结束了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll stay here so he can find me.
beats.chinese: 我就在这里等，方便他找到我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cecil turns back toward you, their hands opening briefly as they begin.
beats.chinese: Cecil转回身面向你，刚开口，双手便轻轻摊开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I restore pictures from old video games. My nephew's discarded console started it. These days I can spend an evening fixing six red squares.
beats.chinese: 我会修复老电子游戏里的图像。这爱好是从侄子淘汰的游戏机开始的。现在我能花一整晚，就修好六个红色小方块。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They trace a small square in the air, start to trace another, then lower their hand and glance along the platform.
beats.chinese: 他们在空中比画一个小方块，正要再画一个，又放下手，沿平台望了望。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could give you the history of all six. I'll stop there and get back to waiting. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 这六个方块，每一个的来历我都能讲。我就说到这里，继续等人了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Grand Central Terminal, Cecil is on the upper platform, looking over the concourse. They recognize you and give a small wave.
beats.chinese: 在中央车站，Cecil正在上层平台俯看大厅。他们认出你，轻轻挥手打招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I'm not meeting anyone today. I just came to look at the hall.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天没约人。我就是来看看大厅。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: After a pause, Cecil draws breath as if to add something. They let it out without speaking and turn their gaze back to the concourse.
beats.chinese: 话停了片刻，Cecil吸了口气，像是还想补上一句。他们最终没有继续，只把气呼出来，目光回到大厅。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I haven't got another news item just now. You don't have to fill the gap for me.
beats.chinese: 我暂时没有下一条新闻。你也不用替我接话。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the upper platform overlooking Grand Central Terminal's main concourse, Bernard Ellison has stopped on his way home to photograph the hall for himself. As he raises his pocket camera, he notices you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在中央车站俯瞰大厅的上层平台，Bernard Ellison回家途中停下来，想给自己拍张大厅的照片。他举起便携相机，注意到旁边的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, sorry. Am I getting in your view?
beats.chinese: 哦，抱歉。我挡着你看了吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers the camera to his chest and turns slightly toward you.
beats.chinese: 他把相机放低到胸前，稍稍转向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can put this down. I'm only taking a picture for myself.
beats.chinese: 我可以先放下。我就是自己随便拍一张。

choices.english: You're fine. What caught your eye?
choices.chinese: 没挡着。什么吸引了你？

choices.english: I'd like a clear view, thanks.
choices.chinese: 我想不受遮挡地看看，谢谢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bernard keeps the camera lowered and looks across the concourse.
beats.chinese: Bernard没有重新举起相机，而是望向大厅。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The way people get around each other down there. I'd have three camera cables tangled in about a minute.
beats.chinese: 下面那些人互相让开、各走各的，挺有意思。换我带着三根摄像机线，一分钟准缠上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His finger traces a short route in the air. He starts another gesture, then lets his hand drop.
beats.chinese: 他用手指在空中划出一小段路线，刚想接着比画，又把手放了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You'd have to run the cables along—well, nobody asked me to wire the place.
beats.chinese: 那些线就得沿着——得，也没人请我给这儿布线。

choices.english: I was looking at the building. That clock caught my eye.
choices.chinese: 我在看建筑。那座钟挺吸引我的。

choices.english: I'll leave you to your picture. Enjoy it.
choices.chinese: 那我不耽误你拍照了。慢慢拍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bernard shifts out of your sightline, keeping to the same platform.
beats.chinese: Bernard往旁边挪了一点，让开你的视线，仍留在同一平台上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. There you go.
beats.chinese: 当然。这下可以了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He switches off the camera and slips it into his coat pocket.
beats.chinese: 他关掉相机，放进外套口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I pass through after my shift at the community TV station. Usually I only stop because I've forgotten which pocket my ticket's in.
beats.chinese: 我在社区电视台下班后会经过这里。平常停下来，都是因为忘了车票放在哪个口袋。

choices.english: Do you work at the station?
choices.chinese: 你在那家电视台工作吗？

choices.english: Thanks. I'll just look at the hall.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。我就看看大厅。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bernard follows your reference to the distant clock. His camera stays lowered.
beats.chinese: Bernard顺着你的话望向远处的钟，相机仍然垂在手边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah, the clock. Yes. I went straight past that and started planning a cable run.
beats.chinese: 啊，那座钟。是啊。我直接把它略过去，开始琢磨怎么走线了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He chuckles, pockets the camera, and gives the clock a proper look before taking a few steps along the platform.
beats.chinese: 他笑了笑，收起相机，认真看了看那座钟，再沿平台走开几步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Glad you pointed it out. Enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 幸好你提了一句。慢慢看吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bernard checks that his camera will stay clear of your view.
beats.chinese: Bernard确认了一下，自己的相机不会挡住你的视线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. One picture, then I'll stop pretending I'm on a camera shift.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。拍一张，然后就别再弄得跟值摄像班似的了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes one photograph of the hall, lowers the camera, and gives you a small farewell nod.
beats.chinese: 他拍下一张大厅的照片，放下相机，朝你轻轻点头道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. That's enough fiddling with it. Take care.
beats.chinese: 好了。不折腾它了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bernard turns toward you again without moving back into your view.
beats.chinese: Bernard再次转向你，但没有挪回去挡住视线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Part-time camera assistant. Seventy-one, and I can still spend a whole evening talking about a loose connection.
beats.chinese: 兼职摄像助理。七十一岁了，还能为了一个松动的接头说上一整晚。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He begins to demonstrate a cable connection with his fingers, catches himself, and puts his hands into his coat pockets.
beats.chinese: 他刚想用手指比画接线，便自己停下来，把双手放回外套口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll spare you the demonstration. Better get home before I start planning another camera position. Nice talking to you.
beats.chinese: 就不给你现场演示了。趁我还没开始规划另一个机位，赶紧回家。很高兴聊这几句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bernard nods and leaves the camera in his pocket.
beats.chinese: Bernard点点头，没有再把相机拿出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure. I'll stay out of your way.
beats.chinese: 好。我不挡着你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He moves a little farther along the same platform and looks out over the concourse, leaving your sightline clear.
beats.chinese: 他沿同一平台挪远一点，望向大厅，留出你的视线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Grand Central Terminal, you see Bernard on the upper platform overlooking the hall. He has arrived early to look around before meeting a friend. He is reviewing his personal photos on a pocket camera when he recognizes you.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到中央车站时，你又在俯瞰大厅的同一上层平台看见Bernard。他约了朋友，提前来看看大厅。他正用便携相机查看自己拍的私人照片，这时认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello. Good to see you. These came out clear enough. I haven't quite caught what I like about this place, though.
beats.chinese: 哦，你好。见到你真好。这几张拍得倒是挺清楚。不过，我还没拍出自己喜欢这里的原因。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers the camera and looks across the whole hall again, making no move to take another picture yet.
beats.chinese: 他把相机放低，重新望向整个大厅，暂时没有急着再拍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll look a little longer. My friend isn't here yet. No rush to take this one.
beats.chinese: 我再看一会儿。朋友还没到，不赶这一张。

causality.presenceReason: Bernard从社区电视台下班后途经中央车站，自行停在上层平台拍大厅的私人照片。

causality.currentGoal: 拍一张自己喜欢的大厅照片再回家。
causality.currentState: 今天不赶时间，愿意闲聊，但注意力很容易滑向摄像工作的技术细节。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the upper platform overlooking Grand Central's main concourse, Marisol Vega has just put a small notebook into their bag. They turn toward you.
beats.chinese: 在俯瞰中央车站大厅的上层平台，Marisol Vega刚把一本小笔记本收进包里。他们转向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Excuse me, do you have the time? I'm meeting someone from my handbell ensemble. Just checking how much longer I've got to wait.
beats.chinese: 打扰一下，现在几点了？我约了手铃团的人，想确认还要等多久。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol pauses, then shifts their bag to their side and adjusts the strap. They look across the concourse.
beats.chinese: Marisol停了停，把包挪到身侧，调整背带，朝大厅望去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Marisol. I'll give them a few more minutes. Now I can watch for them.
beats.chinese: 我叫Marisol。我再等他们几分钟。这样就能留意他们过来了。

choices.english: Is that a sketchbook?
choices.chinese: 那是速写本吗？

choices.english: No problem. I'll leave you to it.
choices.chinese: 没事。那我不打扰你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol pulls the notebook halfway out again. A thumb stays firmly over its closed edge.
beats.chinese: Marisol又把笔记本抽出一半，一只拇指牢牢按住合拢的书页边缘。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Lesson log. I'm an apprentice on a canal lock maintenance crew. Teacher, date, number of tries. Denny showed me the seal gauge on March second, and that took—
beats.chinese: 学习记录。我在运河船闸维修队当学徒。记老师、日期、试了几次。三月二号，Denny教我用密封量规，那次我学了——

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their thumb presses harder. They slide the notebook back into the bag without opening it.
beats.chinese: 他们的拇指按得更紧了，随后没翻开本子，就把它塞回包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Anyway. I keep the pages private. You asked about the cover and nearly got the full contents.
beats.chinese: 总之，里面的内容我不让人看。你只是问问这是什么本子，我差点把整本都讲了。

choices.english: No need to show me. I'll let you get back to it.
choices.chinese: 不用给我看。你继续忙吧。

choices.english: You can keep it closed. Why write down who taught you?
choices.chinese: 不用打开。为什么还要记下是谁教的？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol finishes adjusting the strap and holds the bag upright against their hip.
beats.chinese: Marisol调整好包带，把包竖着贴在胯边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure. I'm only waiting for someone from handbells. There's no luggage inspection you need to stay for.
beats.chinese: 好。我只是在等手铃团的人。这里没有什么行李检查需要你留下旁观。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol checks the strap once more, then releases their grip.
beats.chinese: Marisol又检查了一遍包带，随后松开了手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Inspection cancelled. Management has lost interest.
beats.chinese: 检查取消。管理人员已经没兴趣了。

choices.english: Good luck with rehearsal. [Move on.]
choices.chinese: 祝你排练顺利。[继续走。]

choices.english: At least the bag isn't arguing.
choices.chinese: 至少这个包没跟你顶嘴。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you turn away, Marisol settles the notebook fully inside the bag.
beats.chinese: 你转身离开时，Marisol把笔记本完全收进包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. It gets a bit crowded in there without an audience.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。就算没人旁观，里面的内容也已经够挤了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They give you a small parting wave, then lift the notebook out once more, keeping its pages turned toward their chest.
beats.chinese: 他们向你轻轻挥手道别，随后又取出笔记本，把书页朝向自己胸前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. One date to check before rehearsal. Take care.
beats.chinese: 好了。排练前核对一个日期。慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: With the notebook safely inside the bag, Marisol's hand relaxes.
beats.chinese: 笔记本稳妥地收在包里，Marisol的手放松下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Otherwise I remember the thing and forget the person who stood there while I got it wrong four times. Denny deserves his name on the page.
beats.chinese: 不然我会记住学到的东西，却忘了是谁站在旁边，看着我弄错四次。那页上应该写着Denny的名字。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They start reaching into the bag, catch themselves, and put both hands around its strap instead.
beats.chinese: 他们刚想把手伸进包里，又停住，改用双手握住包带。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And that nearly became a demonstration of how I write a name. I'll stop there. Enjoy the station.
beats.chinese: 我差点又要示范自己怎么写人名了。就说到这儿吧。祝你在车站逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You move on across the platform. Marisol stays where they arranged to meet their ensemble partner.
beats.chinese: 你继续沿平台走去。Marisol留在与团员约好的碰头地点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I'm on bells today. The bag doesn't get a part.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。今天由我摇铃。这个包没有演奏的份。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They raise a hand in farewell, then turn their attention toward the people passing across the platform.
beats.chinese: 他们抬手道别，随后望向平台上来往的人，继续等候。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye.
beats.chinese: 再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol looks from you to the bag at their side and laughs.
beats.chinese: Marisol看看你，又看看身侧的包，笑出了声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: True. I'm supplying both sides of the argument. Very efficient. Terrible meeting.
beats.chinese: 确实。争论双方都由我负责。效率很高，会议质量很差。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They put the strap over their shoulder and let the bag hang as it is, finished with the adjustments.
beats.chinese: 他们把包带挂上肩，让包保持原样垂着，不再调整。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. I'm leaving it alone now. Thanks for the laugh. Have a good day.
beats.chinese: 好了。现在不管它了。谢谢你逗我笑。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the upper platform overlooking Grand Central's main concourse, Marisol is waiting for someone from their handbell ensemble, their bag settled at their side. They recognize you and raise a hand.
beats.chinese: 在俯瞰中央车站大厅的上层平台，Marisol正等一位手铃团员，包已经妥当地放在身侧。他们认出你，抬手打了个招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. My turn to get here first today. I'm going over what I need for rehearsal.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天轮到我先到。我正在心里过一遍排练要带的东西。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They quietly count the last item, then pat the outside of the bag to check it is there. The notebook stays inside.
beats.chinese: 他们低声数到最后一项，隔着包摸了一下，确认东西在里面，没有拿出笔记本。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's everything. Just waiting for the person now. Good to see you. I'll wait here.
beats.chinese: 都齐了，现在只差人。见到你真好，我在这儿等。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Union Square Greenmarket, Bernadette Toups has finished buying ingredients for a family supper. She is waiting beside the wide passage between the tents while her daughter finishes shopping. She looks your way, her full cloth bag beside her leg.
beats.chinese: 在联合广场农夫市集，Bernadette Toups已经买好了家庭晚餐的食材，正在帐篷间的宽通道旁等女儿买完东西。她看向你，鼓鼓的布袋放在腿边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If you hear me say I need one more thing, don't believe me. I've got plenty for supper already. I'm Bernadette.
beats.chinese: 你要是听见我说还缺一样，别信。我家今晚已经够吃了。我叫Bernadette。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gathers the bag handles in one hand and stays beside the passage, leaving room for shoppers to pass.
beats.chinese: 她把袋子的提手拢在一只手里，仍站在通道旁，留出空间让顾客经过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Family supper. I came with a list and bought enough to need another list.
beats.chinese: 要做家庭晚餐。我带着清单来的，结果买得都够再写一张了。

choices.english: What are you making?
choices.chinese: 你打算做什么？

choices.english: I'll leave you to it, then.
choices.chinese: 那我就不打扰你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bernadette turns toward you, keeping her bag tucked beside her feet and out of the passing shoppers' way.
beats.chinese: Bernadette转过身面对你，袋子贴着脚边，没有挡住来往的顾客。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Chicken and rice. Plenty of carrots, apparently. My daughter lives near me, so she gets the leftovers.
beats.chinese: 鸡肉饭。看来还得加上好多胡萝卜。我女儿住得近，剩菜就归她了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds her shopping list, then opens it again when she notices a note on the back.
beats.chinese: 她把购物清单折起来，注意到背面的一条备注，又把它展开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And I need to clear my kitchen table. There's a little soldering kit spread all over it.
beats.chinese: 我还得收拾餐桌。现在上面摊着一整套小焊接套件。

choices.english: What are you building?
choices.chinese: 你在组装什么？

choices.english: I'll look at the stalls while you tell me.
choices.chinese: 你接着说，我边看摊位边听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bernadette nods and shifts her bag farther from the passage. A large bunch of carrots tilts out of the top.
beats.chinese: Bernadette点点头，把袋子往通道外又挪了挪。一大把胡萝卜从袋口歪了出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. I've bought mine. Just waiting on my daughter.
beats.chinese: 好啊。我已经买完了，就等我女儿了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tucks the carrots back in and glances at her list.
beats.chinese: 她把胡萝卜塞好，瞥了一眼清单。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She wrote six carrots. I counted the bunches. That'll teach her to send me shopping hungry.
beats.chinese: 她写的是六根胡萝卜，我数成六把了。下回她就知道，不能让我饿着肚子来买菜。

choices.english: Enjoy your supper. I'll keep looking around.
choices.chinese: 祝你们晚餐愉快。我接着逛逛。

choices.english: Six bunches? That sounds like a whole week of soup.
choices.chinese: 六把？听起来够喝一个星期的汤了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bernadette leaves the list unfolded in her hand. Her attention returns fully to you.
beats.chinese: Bernadette把展开的清单拿在手里，注意力又全回到了你身上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A little radio. Thirty-one years assembling wiring harnesses for car stereos, and I retire into more wires.
beats.chinese: 一台小收音机。我给汽车音响组装了三十一年线束，退休了又接着摆弄电线。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She laughs, folds the list into her bag, and lifts the handles together.
beats.chinese: 她笑了，把清单折好放进袋子，再把两个提手拢到一起。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I like the little kits. Fewer parts to spread around. Well, that's enough shop talk from me. Enjoy the market.
beats.chinese: 我喜欢这种小套件，零件少，摊不开太大一片。好了，我这行当就聊到这儿。逛得开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bernadette's smile tightens a little. She turns her list over and smooths its corners against her palm.
beats.chinese: Bernadette的笑容微微收了收。她把清单翻过来，在掌心压平纸角。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, you go look. I've got this list to sort out.
beats.chinese: 哦，你去看吧。我得理理这张清单。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the items against her bag, carefully moving a bunch of carrots from one side to the other.
beats.chinese: 她对着袋子核对清单，仔细地把一把胡萝卜从一边挪到另一边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There now. Plenty here to keep me busy. Take care.
beats.chinese: 好了。我这儿有的是事要忙。慢走啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue looking around, Bernadette draws the last loose carrot leaves against her bag.
beats.chinese: 你继续逛市集，Bernadette把最后几片散开的胡萝卜叶拢到袋子旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. It'll certainly be a big supper.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。这顿晚餐肯定少不了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives you a small wave, then turns toward the tents to watch for her daughter.
beats.chinese: 她朝你轻轻挥手，然后转向帐篷，留意女儿的身影。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bernadette looks down at the carrots and lets out a short laugh.
beats.chinese: Bernadette低头看着胡萝卜，笑出了声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Soup Monday. Soup Tuesday. By Wednesday, I'll be answering the door with a saucepan.
beats.chinese: 周一喝汤，周二喝汤。到周三，我就该端着汤锅去开门了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the list around the carrot leaves to tuck them inside, then settles the bag securely at her feet.
beats.chinese: 她用清单拢住胡萝卜叶，把叶子塞进袋里，再把袋子稳稳地放在脚边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Well, all right then. That's my menu settled. You enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 好吧，那就这么定了。我的菜单算是安排好了。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another market day at Union Square, Bernadette recognizes you between the tents. She is carrying a cloth bag of vegetables she has already bought.
beats.chinese: 另一个开市日，在联合广场的帐篷之间，Bernadette认出了你。她提着布袋，里面装着已经买好的蔬菜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello there. I've got to get home and clear my kitchen table today.
beats.chinese: 哎，你好啊。我今天得赶回家收拾餐桌。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Standing clear of passing shoppers, she checks her shopping list once and puts it away. She keeps her attention off the stalls.
beats.chinese: 她站在不妨碍顾客通行的地方，核对了一遍购物清单便收起来，没有再看摊位。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My soldering kit is still taking up the place where we eat. I can't stop for a long chat today. Good to see you.
beats.chinese: 焊接套件还占着吃饭的地方。今天先不聊长的，见到你真好。

causality.presenceReason: 她为家庭晚餐买完食材，在市集等仍在购物的女儿，早于玩家到场便有明确事务。

causality.stayingConstraint: 女儿尚未买完，她提着自己的菜在帐篷间宽通道旁等候，不需要玩家陪同。
causality.currentGoal: 不再追加采购，等女儿会合，回家前记得清出摆满焊接套件的餐桌。
causality.currentState: 今天精神足、愿意聊天，谈起家常很主动，但对注意力被分走仍然敏感。
causality.contactTrigger: 她在等女儿时主动向近处的玩家搭话，开玩笑说若听见她声称还缺一样就别信，因为今晚已经够吃，并自报姓名。这是给自己过量采购踩刹车的社交招呼，不要求玩家提供建议或承担监督责任。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the open Union Square Market, Devon Achebe is waiting between the tents for a coworker. He has already bought apples for a birthday lunch at their tailoring shop. He looks into the tote, quietly rehearsing an introduction.
beats.chinese: 联合广场农夫市集正在营业。Devon Achebe在帐篷之间等同事，已经买好了裁缝店生日午餐要用的苹果。他看着购物袋里的苹果，小声排练登场介绍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Please welcome the apples. They've come a long way in this bag.
beats.chinese: 有请苹果登场。它们坐着这个袋子，一路远道而来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He notices you nearby and looks up. He gathers both straps into one hand and brings the tote close to his leg, leaving the wide aisle clear.
beats.chinese: 他注意到近处的你，抬起头。他把两根袋带攥到一只手里，让袋子贴着腿，留出宽敞的通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Shop birthday lunch. I'm in charge of apples. I never agreed to a speech. That one didn't count. I'm Devon.
beats.chinese: 店里生日午餐。我负责苹果，可没答应负责致辞。刚才那句不算。我叫Devon。

choices.english: Do the apples get a proper introduction?
choices.chinese: 那苹果能得到一次正式介绍吗？

choices.english: Got it. I'm just looking around.
choices.chinese: 明白了。我只是随便看看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon lifts the tote a few inches as though presenting the apples, keeping it beside his leg.
beats.chinese: Devon把袋子稍稍提起，像在向人介绍苹果，始终没让它离开腿边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Absolutely. They show up looking polished and never interrupt. Tough competition for me.
beats.chinese: 当然。它们出场时个个光鲜亮丽，还从不插嘴。对我来说是劲敌。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers the bag. His voice drops briefly, then picks up speed again.
beats.chinese: 他放低袋子，声音短暂地低下来，随即又加快了语速。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I do measurements at a tailoring shop in Brooklyn. Somehow I got the birthday announcements too. I can introduce a cake. Solemn speeches need another host.
beats.chinese: 我在布鲁克林一家裁缝店负责量尺寸。不知怎么，生日主持也归我了。介绍蛋糕我可以，郑重致辞得另请主持。

choices.english: You can skip the speech with me.
choices.chinese: 跟我就不用致辞了。

choices.english: Then introduce the apples.
choices.chinese: 那就介绍一下这些苹果吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon angles his shoulders away to give you room, then turns his head back with another grin.
beats.chinese: Devon侧过身给你留出空间，随后又转回头，咧嘴笑起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure, take your time. I'm waiting for my coworker anyway.
beats.chinese: 好，慢慢看。我反正也在等同事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances into the tote, then raises his free hand as if reporting an impressive achievement.
beats.chinese: 他往购物袋里瞥了一眼，又抬起空着的手，像要汇报一项了不起的成就。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I measure people at a Brooklyn tailoring shop. Thirty inseams yesterday. Today, rehearsing for apples. Excellent range.
beats.chinese: 我在布鲁克林一家裁缝店给人量尺寸。昨天量了三十条裤子的内长，今天给苹果排练登场介绍。业务范围真广。

choices.english: I'd like to look around without chatting, please.
choices.chinese: 我想自己看看，先不聊天了，谢谢。

choices.english: One more joke is fine, if it's about you.
choices.chinese: 可以再讲一个，不过得拿你自己开玩笑。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon starts to raise his free hand for another introduction, then holds it halfway up.
beats.chinese: Devon刚要抬起空着的手再做一番介绍，动作停在半途。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. No speech. The apples have also declined interviews.
beats.chinese: 好，不致辞。苹果也拒绝接受采访。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens his mouth, closes it, and lowers his hand. After checking the aisle, he moves a few paces farther along it to wait.
beats.chinese: 他张了张嘴，又闭上，把手放下。确认通道畅通后，他沿着原来的通道走开几步，继续等人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Okay, leaving it there. Have a good one.
beats.chinese: 好，就说到这儿。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon squares his shoulders toward the tote, giving the apples his full ceremonial attention.
beats.chinese: Devon朝着购物袋挺直肩膀，煞有介事地把全部注意力交给苹果。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Please welcome the apples. No speech prepared, excellent attendance, and every single one remembered to wear a sticker.
beats.chinese: 有请苹果登场。没准备发言，出勤率优秀，而且每一位都记得佩戴贴纸。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives the bag a tiny bow, then settles it against his leg and offers you a quick farewell wave.
beats.chinese: 他向袋子微微鞠躬，随后让它重新贴好腿，朝你挥手道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's the whole ceremony. Thanks for coming. I'll let you get back to the market.
beats.chinese: 仪式到此结束。感谢出席。你继续逛吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon's raised hand drops immediately. He turns slightly so he is no longer facing you directly.
beats.chinese: Devon立刻放下抬着的手，稍稍转身，不再正面对着你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Got it. Enjoy looking around.
beats.chinese: 明白。慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He adjusts his grip on the tote and turns his attention down the aisle toward the passing shoppers.
beats.chinese: 他重新握稳购物袋，把注意力转向通道里来往的顾客。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll wait here for my coworker. Take care.
beats.chinese: 我在这儿等同事。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon taps his own chest with his free hand, accepting the restriction without looking for another target.
beats.chinese: Devon用空着的手拍拍自己的胸口，接受了这个限制，没有另找取笑对象。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Easy. No surprise roasts. I played badminton this week. My best shot was apologizing to the shuttle.
beats.chinese: 没问题。不搞突然袭击式吐槽。我这周打羽毛球了，发挥最好的一下，是向球道歉。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He mimes one small, hopeless swing close to his body, then closes his hand around the tote straps again.
beats.chinese: 他贴着身体比画了一个毫无胜算的小挥拍动作，随后重新攥住袋带。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's my one. Enjoy the market. I'm going to stand here and look like a responsible apple owner.
beats.chinese: 一个讲完。逛得开心。我得站在这儿，装成一个负责任的苹果持有人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the open Union Square Market, Devon Achebe recognizes you beside the wide aisle between the tents. He smiles and lifts a hand in greeting.
beats.chinese: 后来一次逛正在营业的联合广场农夫市集时，Devon Achebe在帐篷间的宽通道旁认出了你。他笑着抬手打招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. Just here for bread today. Don't really feel like being in charge of the mood.
beats.chinese: 嘿，今天只想买点面包。暂时不太想负责活跃气氛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks toward the stalls for a little while without adding another joke, keeping the aisle clear.
beats.chinese: 他朝摊位方向安静地看了一会儿，没有追加笑话，也没有挡住通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm taking a break today. You haven't made things awkward. Good to see you.
beats.chinese: 我今天歇会儿。不是你冷场。见到你挺好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Union Square Market, Marcus Feld stands clear of the flow between the tents, his shopping bag against his leg. He lifts one leaf just above the bag, keeping it in front of himself.
beats.chinese: 联合广场农夫市集里，Marcus Feld站在帐篷之间、不妨碍人流的位置，购物袋贴在腿边。他把一片叶子稍稍举到袋口上方，收在自己身前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I bought this mainly for printing onto fabric. What do you notice first, the veins or the edges? I'm Marcus.
beats.chinese: 我买它主要为了在布上拓印。你第一眼注意的是叶脉，还是边缘？我叫Marcus。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks from the leaf to your face, openly waiting for a reaction. The bag stays against his leg.
beats.chinese: 他的视线从叶子移到你脸上，毫不掩饰地等着你的反应。袋子始终贴在他的腿边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm waiting for my friend to finish shopping. I've been staring at these so long, I wanted a fresh pair of eyes.
beats.chinese: 我在等朋友买完东西。这些叶子我盯着看太久了，就想听听别人第一眼会注意到什么。

choices.english: The veins. How do you use the leaves?
choices.chinese: 叶脉。你怎么用这些叶子？

choices.english: I'd rather not hear a long story.
choices.chinese: 我不太想听长篇故事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcus lifts one leafy stem just above the bag. He keeps it close.
beats.chinese: Marcus把一根带叶子的茎稍稍提到袋口上方，收在身前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We put leaves against fabric and hammer the colour through. I cut wooden jigsaw puzzles all week. Weekends, different noise.
beats.chinese: 把叶子贴着布敲，让颜色印上去。我平时整周都切木头拼图，周末换一种响声。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He watches your face, his grin lingering. Then he lowers the stem.
beats.chinese: 他看着你的表情，脸上的笑容迟迟没收起来。随后，他把茎放低。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Even the tiny veins can leave a mark. Those little branching lines. Were those what caught your eye?
beats.chinese: 连细小的叶脉都能留下印子。就是那些分叉的小线条。你注意到的是那些吗？

choices.english: Yes, those little lines. I'll leave you to your friend. Goodbye.
choices.chinese: 对，就是那些小线条。你等朋友吧，再见。

choices.english: Just the short leaf story, please. Then I'll go.
choices.chinese: 简单讲讲叶子的事就好。听完我就走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcus nods and tucks the loose leaves inward, keeping the bag against his leg.
beats.chinese: Marcus点点头，把散开的叶子拢进袋子，袋子仍贴在腿边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I'll keep it short.
beats.chinese: 当然。我简短点说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He starts to raise the bag again, catches himself, and keeps it against his leg.
beats.chinese: 他刚想再提起袋子，又停住了，继续把它贴在腿边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My friend's finishing their shopping. I'll wait here and keep these tucked in.
beats.chinese: 我朋友还在买最后几样东西。我就在这里等，把叶子收好。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll carry on. Goodbye.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。那我继续走了，再见。

choices.english: Before I go, are the beets for dinner?
choices.chinese: 走之前问一句，甜菜是准备当晚饭的吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcus's grin widens immediately. He gives a small bow without swinging the bag.
beats.chinese: Marcus立刻笑得更开了。他微微欠身，手里的袋子倒是稳稳没动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. That's exactly what I'm hoping to get on the fabric.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我就希望能把那些线条印在布上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He raises his free hand in farewell, then turns his attention toward the shoppers between the tents.
beats.chinese: 他抬起空着的手道别，随后转头望向帐篷间的购物人群。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye! Enjoy the market.
beats.chinese: 再见！祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcus draws breath for a longer answer, then closes his mouth briefly and holds up one finger.
beats.chinese: Marcus吸了口气，像是准备长篇大论，随即短暂地闭上嘴，竖起一根手指。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Short version. My friends bring the fabric, I bring leaves, and we see what marks they leave. I usually bring far too many.
beats.chinese: 简短版。朋友带布，我带叶子，大家看看能印出什么样。我一般都带得太多。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He settles the greens inside the bag and folds its top loosely around them, ending the display.
beats.chinese: 他把菜叶放回袋子里，松松地拢好袋口，结束了展示。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. I managed the short version. Thanks for stopping. Bye.
beats.chinese: 好了。居然真让我讲了个简短版。谢谢你停下来聊，再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcus keeps the bag against his leg and gives a quick nod.
beats.chinese: Marcus把袋子贴在腿边，轻轻点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye. I'll let you get on.
beats.chinese: 再见。不耽误你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns sideways to keep the passage open and scans the market for his friend.
beats.chinese: 他侧过身，让通道保持畅通，转而在人群里寻找朋友。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy the market.
beats.chinese: 祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcus looks down into the bag as though the beets have only just become his responsibility.
beats.chinese: Marcus低头看看袋子，仿佛直到这时才想起自己还得处理那些甜菜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They are now. I'll roast them. I got so pleased with the leaves that I forgot the rest was coming home too.
beats.chinese: 现在是了。我会把它们烤了。刚才光顾着高兴叶子不错，都忘了剩下的部分也得一起带回家。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes a folded shopping list from his pocket and adds a word in pencil. His attention settles on the list.
beats.chinese: 他从口袋里掏出折好的购物清单，用铅笔添了一个词，注意力也落到了清单上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oil. Nearly forgot that. Thanks for the reminder, and goodbye.
beats.chinese: 油。差点忘了。谢谢提醒，再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another market day at Union Square Market, Marcus Feld checks his dinner shopping list, standing clear of the flow between the tents. He recognizes you and lifts a hand.
beats.chinese: 另一个开市日，Marcus Feld站在联合广场农夫市集帐篷间通道的人流外，核对晚餐采购清单。他认出你，抬手招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello! Good to see you. I'm using both the beets and the leaves tonight. Just deciding what to start first.
beats.chinese: 噢，你好！见到你真好。今晚我打算把甜菜和叶子都用上。正在决定先做哪一道。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He uses his pencil to swap the order of two steps on the paper. He reads them through carefully, then smiles as he makes up his mind.
beats.chinese: 他用铅笔在纸上把两个步骤交换了顺序，认真看了一遍，露出拿定主意的笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Leaves first. The beets can roast slowly. I still need one more thing. I'll go look for it.
beats.chinese: 好了，先弄叶子，甜菜慢慢烤。我还缺一样，去找找。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At New York's Union Square Market, Clive Bennett has finished buying apples. He stands at the edge of the aisle between the tents, clear of the moving crowd, holding his shopping bag securely and running his thumb over a broad canvas handle. He notices you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在纽约联合广场农夫市集，Clive Bennett刚买好苹果。他站在帐篷间通道的边上，不挡来往人流，稳稳提着购物袋，用拇指摸着宽宽的帆布提手。他注意到近处的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If you're looking for a shopping bag, wide handles are worth a feel. This one's full of apples and it doesn't dig into my hand.
beats.chinese: 要是你正打算买购物袋，宽提手值得摸一摸。我这个装了苹果也不勒手。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Clive keeps the bag beside his leg, with both handles resting securely in his hand.
beats.chinese: Clive仍把袋子提在腿边，两根提手稳稳握在手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Clive, by the way. Lovely thick canvas, too. Worth spending a bit extra.
beats.chinese: 对了，我叫Clive。这厚帆布也真不错。多花一点也值得。

choices.english: What makes that one worth it?
choices.chinese: 这个袋子好在哪里？

choices.english: No thanks. I'm not looking for a shopping bag.
choices.chinese: 不用了，谢谢。我没打算买购物袋。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Clive lifts the handles just enough to show their stitched edges, keeping the bag close to his body.
beats.chinese: Clive稍稍提起提手，露出缝边，袋子仍紧贴着身体。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Wide handles. No thin edge digging into your fingers. I fit curtain tracks part-time, and my hands get quite enough punishment there.
beats.chinese: 提手宽，没有细细的边勒进手指。我还在兼职装窗帘轨道，干活时手已经够受罪了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rubs the doubled fabric between finger and thumb, warming to the subject.
beats.chinese: 他用拇指和食指捻了捻双层布料，越说越起劲。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd pay double for a handle like that. Spread over a few years, you'd hardly notice the extra. And the stitching—well, I could go on. You're welcome to feel it if you like.
beats.chinese: 为了这样的提手，我愿意多花一倍。摊到几年里，那点差价几乎感觉不到。还有这针脚——哎，我能一直说下去。你要是愿意，可以摸摸。

choices.english: May I feel the handle?
choices.chinese: 我能摸摸提手吗？

choices.english: That's more than I'd want to spend on a shopping bag.
choices.chinese: 我不想在购物袋上花那么多钱。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Clive lowers the handle immediately. His smile stays easy.
beats.chinese: Clive立刻放下提手，脸上仍是轻松的笑容。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I'll keep my bag opinions to myself.
beats.chinese: 好啊。袋子这方面的见解，我就自己留着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks into the open bag and spots his paper-wrapped sandwiches beneath the apples.
beats.chinese: 他往敞开的袋子里一看，发现纸包的三明治压在苹果下面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, lovely. I've put the apples on my sandwiches. All that fuss about the bag, and I've flattened my lunch.
beats.chinese: 哦，这下好了。我把苹果放在三明治上了。光顾着讲究袋子，午饭倒给压扁了。

choices.english: I'll give you some room to sort that out.
choices.chinese: 我让开一点，你整理吧。

choices.english: I'll leave you to it. Have a good day.
choices.chinese: 那不打扰你了。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Clive supports the bag's weight and holds one handle within reach. You feel the thick, soft canvas without taking the bag.
beats.chinese: Clive自己承住袋子的重量，把一根提手递到你手边。你没有接过袋子，只摸了摸厚实柔软的帆布。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There, that rounded edge. That's the bit I like. Some of them feel like carrying your shopping by a shoelace.
beats.chinese: 就是这儿，这道圆润的边。我喜欢的就是它。有些袋子提起来，简直像用鞋带拎东西。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Once you release the handle, he gathers both handles into one hand and turns along the clear aisle.
beats.chinese: 你松开提手后，他把两根提手拢进一只手，转向畅通的通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, these apples need to get home. Enjoy your look round.
beats.chinese: 好了，该把这些苹果带回家了。你慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Clive stops rubbing the fabric and lowers the bag.
beats.chinese: Clive不再捻那块布，把袋子放低。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair point. A plain cotton bag carries apples perfectly well. I get carried away with handles and seams.
beats.chinese: 说得对。普通棉布袋装苹果也完全够用。我一说起提手和缝线就容易来劲。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rolls the handles together once, settles his grip and steps back to leave the aisle open.
beats.chinese: 他把提手拢着卷了一下，握稳袋子，往后退开，留出通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave your shopping decisions alone. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 你买东西怎么选，我就不掺和了。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You give him more room. Clive keeps the bag suspended in one hand and carefully draws out the sandwich parcel with the other.
beats.chinese: 你往旁边让开一点。Clive一手提着袋子，另一手小心地抽出三明治纸包。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. Nothing's escaped the paper. That's something.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。好在没什么从纸包里漏出来。还算不错。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He places the parcel on top of the apples and folds the bag's opening loosely over it.
beats.chinese: 他把纸包放到苹果上面，再把袋口松松地折拢。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Lunch on top, heavy things underneath. I'll get this lot home now. Enjoy the market.
beats.chinese: 好了。午饭在上，重东西在下。我这就把这些带回家。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Clive takes his hand away from the bag's opening and lets the sandwiches stay where they are.
beats.chinese: Clive把手从袋口移开，三明治还是留在原处。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. I'll eat the evidence when I get home.
beats.chinese: 你也是。我回家就把证据吃掉。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives you a brief wave, secures the bag against his hip and starts along the aisle between the tents.
beats.chinese: 他朝你轻轻挥了下手，把袋子稳稳贴在胯侧，沿着帐篷间的通道走开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A slightly thinner sandwich won't spoil my afternoon. Cheerio.
beats.chinese: 三明治薄一点，还不至于毁了我的下午。再见啦。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another market day at Union Square, Clive stands at the edge of the aisle between the tents, clear of the moving crowd, holding an open coffee flask. He recognises you and smiles.
beats.chinese: 又一个开市日，Clive站在联合广场市集帐篷间的通道边，不挡来往人流，手里握着已经打开的保温杯。他认出你，笑了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again! Brought this coffee from home. It's cooled down nicely. Just the temperature I like.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了！这咖啡是从家里带来的。现在已经不烫了，正是我喜欢的温度。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes a small sip and opens his mouth to say more about the coffee. Then he looks back into the flask, still wanting another sip, and stops with a satisfied smile.
beats.chinese: 他喝了一小口，张了张嘴，本来还想继续推荐这咖啡。随后他低头看看杯里，自己还没喝够，便带着满意的笑容收住了话头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This is worth sipping slowly. I'll stand here and enjoy it for a bit. Enjoy your look round.
beats.chinese: 这口值得慢点喝。我先站这儿享受一会儿，你慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Steeplechase Pier at Coney Island, Harvey Lindqvist sits on a bench with a notebook. He came to sketch an imaginary island and rest his knees. As you come near, he lifts his canvas bag off the seat.
beats.chinese: 在康尼岛的 Steeplechase Pier 栈桥上，Harvey Lindqvist 正拿着笔记本坐在长椅上。他来画一座虚构的岛，也让膝盖歇歇。你走近时，他把帆布包从座位上拿开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Seat's free if you want it. My bag's been getting more rest than I have. I'm Harvey.
beats.chinese: 想坐就坐，这儿空着。我的包歇得比我还够。我叫 Harvey。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the bag between his shoes and holds down a curling notebook page with his palm.
beats.chinese: 他把包放在两脚之间，用手掌压住被风掀起的本子页面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My knees called off the rest of my walk. How's your day treating you?
beats.chinese: 我的膝盖宣布，今天剩下的路不走了。你今天过得怎么样？

choices.english: I'll sit, thanks. My only complaint is this wind.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，那我坐会儿。我唯一想抱怨的就是这风。

choices.english: Thanks, I'll stay standing. No complaints to trade.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，我站着就好。没什么烦心事可聊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Harvey shifts his notebook onto his own knee as you sit. He looks toward the water, then back at the page lifting under his hand.
beats.chinese: 你坐下时，Harvey 把笔记本挪到自己膝上。他看看海面，又看看手底下被风吹起的纸页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, it gets right in your ears. Though my client left a cushion outside all winter and blamed my stitching for the mold. I think I've got you there.
beats.chinese: 是啊，直往耳朵里灌。不过我的客户把靠垫在外头放了一冬天，长了霉还怪我的针脚。这一局我可比你惨。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pins the page with two fingers. A penciled coastline shows beneath his hand.
beats.chinese: 他用两根手指钉住纸页，手底下露出一段铅笔画的海岸线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Forty years sewing boat canvas, and apparently I also control the weather.
beats.chinese: 缝了四十来年船用帆布，原来我还得管天气。

choices.english: I'm not entering a contest. I'll leave you to your drawing.
choices.chinese: 我可没打算比赛谁更惨。你接着画吧，我走了。

choices.english: You win on cushions. What's on that page?
choices.chinese: 靠垫这件事算你赢。那页画的是什么？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Harvey leaves the cleared seat alone. His pencil pauses above the notebook as he looks up at you.
beats.chinese: Harvey 没再招呼你坐下。他的铅笔停在本子上方，抬头看着你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nothing at all? A late bus would count. I'm fairly generous about what qualifies.
beats.chinese: 一点儿都没有？公交晚点也算。我这儿的标准挺宽松。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns a page, revealing crossed-out dialogue, then turns back to his drawing.
beats.chinese: 他翻过一页，露出几行划掉的对白，随后又翻回画稿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I brought an island to draw and a radio play to fix. Naturally, I've started collecting somebody else's troubles instead.
beats.chinese: 我带着本子来画岛，还想改改广播剧。结果倒好，又开始打听别人的烦心事了。

choices.english: Really, I'd rather just look at the water.
choices.chinese: 真的，我只想看看海。

choices.english: A radio play? Give me one line.
choices.chinese: 广播剧？来一句听听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Harvey's pencil stops. He moves his elbow back onto his side of the bench as you rise.
beats.chinese: Harvey 的铅笔停住了。你起身时，他把胳膊肘收回自己那一侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. You mentioned the wind and I dragged a moldy cushion into it.
beats.chinese: 也是。你说的是风，我硬扯进来一个发霉的靠垫。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives you a brief nod as you step away along the pier, then lowers his pencil to the coastline.
beats.chinese: 你沿栈桥走开时，他朝你点了点头，随后落笔继续画海岸线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care. I'll keep the rest of the upholstery complaints to myself.
beats.chinese: 慢走。剩下那些软垫套的牢骚，我自己留着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Harvey angles the notebook so you can see without moving closer. The island has three harbors and a narrow strip of hills.
beats.chinese: Harvey 把本子转了个角度，你不用凑近就能看清。纸上的岛有三个港湾，还有狭长的一带山丘。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: An island. Made it up. I keep putting the towns too close together, then there's nowhere left for anybody to get lost.
beats.chinese: 一座岛，编的。我老把城镇画得太近，结果连个能让人迷路的地方都没剩下。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He adds one small inlet, closes the notebook, and puts it in his bag. He stands carefully, leaving the bench to you.
beats.chinese: 他添了一处小海湾，合上本子，装进包里。他小心地站起来，把长椅留给你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's enough geography for me. Enjoy the seat. My knees have approved a short walk.
beats.chinese: 今天的地理就画到这儿。你慢慢坐。我的膝盖批准再走一小段。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Harvey lowers the notebook to his lap and looks toward the sea rather than waiting for another answer.
beats.chinese: Harvey 把本子放低到腿上，转眼望向海面，没有再等你解释。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. No further questions from the complaints department.
beats.chinese: 好，牢骚受理处不再追问。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shifts his bag fully beneath the bench, then returns to drawing. His pencil begins adding short marks along the island's shore.
beats.chinese: 他把包完全挪进长椅底下，重新画起来，沿着岛岸添上一道道短线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave you to the water. I've got six miles of imaginary beach to finish.
beats.chinese: 你看海吧。我还有六英里想象出来的沙滩没画完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Harvey turns back to the dialogue page. He straightens on the bench and raises his voice just enough for you to hear.
beats.chinese: Harvey 翻回写着对白的那一页。他在长椅上坐直，稍稍提高声音，刚好让你听见。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Captain, the island's gone.
beats.chinese: 船长，岛不见了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers his chin for the captain's voice, then closes the notebook with a small finishing nod.
beats.chinese: 他压低下巴，准备换成船长的嗓音，又合上本子，轻轻点头作为收场。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Turn the map over. That's the captain's entire contribution. My two friends make me play him. Thanks for the audience. I'll let you get back to the view.
beats.chinese: 把地图翻过来。这就是船长的全部贡献。我那两个朋友非让我演他。谢谢捧场，你接着看风景吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Steeplechase Pier, you see Harvey on a bench with several handwritten pages. He recognizes you and lifts a hand, keeping the loose sheets pinned beneath his notebook.
beats.chinese: 在 Steeplechase Pier ，你看见 Harvey 坐在长椅上，拿着几页手稿。他认出你，抬手打招呼，同时用本子压住散页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I've managed to name both villains Frank. Very efficient, until they have a scene together.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我居然把两个反派都起名叫弗兰克。倒是省事，直到他俩要演对手戏。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He crosses out a name and writes another above it, shielding the paper with his forearm.
beats.chinese: 他划掉一个名字，在上面写了个新的，用小臂挡住纸页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One's Leonard now. Same crooked boat dealer, different stationery. Good to see you.
beats.chinese: 现在有一个叫伦纳德了。还是那个黑心船商，换套信纸而已。见到你挺好。

causality.presenceReason: Harvey 在玩家到来前已来栈桥画虚构岛屿，顺便歇膝盖，包中也带着待改的广播剧。
causality.placeAttitude: 他愿意来海边消磨一阵，喜欢画海岸，却会抱怨风和自己的膝盖。
causality.stayingConstraint: 膝盖需要短暂休息，让他暂留长椅。没有必须等候玩家或完成工作的安排。
causality.currentGoal: 休息时添几笔地图，有余力再改广播剧对白。
causality.currentState: 今天有闲聊兴致，待人热乎，却忍不住搜集并比较别人的烦心事。
causality.contactTrigger: 玩家走近长椅，他主动拿走占座的包，自报名字并询问近况。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Terrence Boyle has come to Steeplechase Pier to read some food manga before heading home. He sits on a bench, his bag at his feet, and looks up from the page toward the sea.
beats.chinese: Terrence Boyle 来到康尼岛的 Steeplechase Pier，打算回家前读会儿美食漫画。他坐在长椅上，包放在脚边，目光从书页移向海面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: How long are they going to argue about this soup?
beats.chinese: 这锅汤还要吵多久？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He says it under his breath, then notices you nearby. He lifts the open manga slightly to show what he means.
beats.chinese: 他低声嘀咕完，才注意到附近的你，便稍稍举起摊开的漫画，解释自己在说什么。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: In the manga. They've been arguing about soup for pages. I'm Terrence, by the way.
beats.chinese: 我是说漫画里。他们已经为汤吵了好几页了。对了，我叫 Terrence。

choices.english: What manga are you reading?
choices.chinese: 你在看什么漫画？

choices.english: I'm just here to look at the water.
choices.chinese: 我只是来看看海。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Terrence tilts the manga cover toward you, keeping a finger between the pages.
beats.chinese: Terrence 把漫画封面朝你倾了倾，一根手指还夹在书页间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Food manga. This guy takes three pages to slice an onion. Somehow I'm completely invested.
beats.chinese: 美食漫画。这家伙切个洋葱用了三页。我居然看得特别投入。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shifts the manga, revealing a small closed sketchbook underneath it.
beats.chinese: 他挪了挪漫画，露出下面一本合着的小素描本。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I coordinate pet food sample shipments. Been talking about a manga-style sample box for months. The fun version has a cat chef. The practical version needs somewhere to put the shipping label.
beats.chinese: 我负责宠物食品试吃装的发货协调。漫画风包装盒这事，我念叨好几个月了。有趣的版本里有只猫厨师。实际能用的版本，还得留地方贴运单。

choices.english: Did that box ever get made?
choices.chinese: 那个盒子后来做出来了吗？

choices.english: Is that a sketchbook? Could I have a look?
choices.chinese: 那是素描本吗？能看看吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You look toward the water near the bench. Terrence rests a hand across the open pages.
beats.chinese: 你在长椅附近望向海面。Terrence 把一只手搭在摊开的书页上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I've read this page three times. The water keeps winning.
beats.chinese: 也好。这一页我已经读三遍了，还是海更吸引我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances down at the open manga and laughs through his nose.
beats.chinese: 他低头瞥了眼摊开的漫画，轻轻哼笑了一声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Two chefs arguing about soup for twelve pages. At this point I'd serve it cold and let them complain about something new.
beats.chinese: 两个厨师为了汤吵了十二页。换我就直接凉着端上去，让他们换个话题抱怨。

choices.english: Now I want to hear what was wrong with the soup.
choices.chinese: 这下我倒想听听，那汤到底有什么问题。

choices.english: I'll keep walking. Enjoy the soup argument.
choices.chinese: 我继续走走。你慢慢看他们吵汤吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Terrence's answer comes quickly. Then he lowers the manga onto his knees.
beats.chinese: Terrence 答得很快，随后把漫画放低，搁在膝头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Dana built it. We work together. I helped pack the first shipment. She got that little cat apron right.
beats.chinese: Dana 做出来了。我们是同事。第一批货我帮着装的。那只猫的小围裙，她做得真不错。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens a phone note headed 'Box idea,' scrolls past an unfinished list, then locks the screen. His smile fades a little as he picks the manga up again.
beats.chinese: 他打开手机里标题为“盒子点子”的笔记，划过一份没写完的清单，又锁上屏幕。重新拿起漫画时，他脸上的笑意淡了些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mine's mostly bullet points. Hers actually shipped. Good work. Anyway, I'd better find out whether this onion survives.
beats.chinese: 我这儿基本还是几条提纲。她那个已经发出去了。做得真好。好了，我得接着看看这颗洋葱能不能活下来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Terrence rests a palm on the closed sketchbook. His voice stays easy.
beats.chinese: Terrence 把一只手掌搭在合着的素描本上，语气仍然轻松。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah, I keep that one to myself. Mostly hands. Coworkers holding scanners, pulling tape, that sort of thing.
beats.chinese: 啊，那本我留着自己看。主要画手。同事拿扫描器、扯胶带之类的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the manga in his bag, opens the sketchbook toward himself, and positions his free hand on his knee. He begins drawing its curled fingers.
beats.chinese: 他把漫画收进包里，将素描本朝自己打开，另一只手放在膝头，开始画微微蜷起的手指。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This one's available without a warehouse shift. Enjoy the view. I'm going to catch that thumb before I move it.
beats.chinese: 这只手不用去仓库上班也能画到。你慢慢看海，我趁拇指还没挪窝，赶紧画两笔。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Terrence lifts one finger from the page, suddenly ready to present the case.
beats.chinese: Terrence 从书页上抬起一根手指，立刻摆出了要讲清来龙去脉的架势。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One says it needs salt. The other says adding salt would insult his teacher. The customer has said nothing. Poor guy's probably eaten the napkin.
beats.chinese: 一个说得加盐，另一个说加盐就是侮辱他的师父。客人一句话都没说。可怜的人，估计已经把餐巾吃了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the page, reads the next panel, and lets out a short laugh. Then he closes the manga around his bookmark and looks out over the sea.
beats.chinese: 他翻过一页，看了下一格，短促地笑了一声。随后把书签夹好，合上漫画，望向海面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He ordered tea. Sensible man. Right, that's enough soup for me. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 他点了茶。明白人。好了，今天的汤看到这儿吧。祝你散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the wooden deck. Terrence raises his hand briefly from the book.
beats.chinese: 你沿着木栈面继续往前走。Terrence 暂时把手从书上抬起，挥了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Enjoy the water.
beats.chinese: 谢了。慢慢看海。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers his hand to the open manga and finds his place on the page.
beats.chinese: 他把手放回摊开的漫画上，找到刚才读到的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Twelve pages. This had better be very good soup.
beats.chinese: 十二页啊。这汤最好真有那么好喝。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Steeplechase Pier, Terrence Boyle closes a food manga on his knees and recognises you from the bench.
beats.chinese: 在康尼岛Steeplechase栈桥，Terrence Boyle坐在长凳上，合上膝头的美食漫画，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello. Read the whole thing waiting for the chef to win. His grandmother won. She entered at the last minute.
beats.chinese: 噢，又见面了。我一直等着那个厨师赢，整本都读完了。结果他奶奶赢了，最后一刻才报名。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He laughs, turns the book over to look at the cake on the back cover, then tucks it under his arm.
beats.chinese: 他笑起来，翻过书看看封底的蛋糕，才把书夹到腋下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good ending. Terrible book to read before lunch. I want that cake now. See you around.
beats.chinese: 结尾不错。午饭前读它真是失策。我现在想吃那个蛋糕。回头见。
