beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Steeplechase Pier at Coney Island, Harold Wexler sits with his jacket and a folded theater program on his lap. After watching the evening light on the shorefront rides for a while, he turns toward you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在康尼岛的障碍赛码头，哈罗德·韦克斯勒坐在长椅上，外套和折好的剧场节目册都放在自己腿上。他看了一会儿岸上游乐设施映着的暮光，转向近处的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I was only going to read a couple of pages. Now the light's more interesting than the program.
beats.chinese: 刚才还只想翻两页，这会儿光倒比节目册好看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances back toward the rides, keeping the jacket and program on his lap.
beats.chinese: 他又朝游乐设施望了一眼，外套和节目册仍放在自己腿上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Harold, by the way. I stopped here on a whim to take a look.
beats.chinese: 对了，我叫哈罗德。我就是临时起意，停下来看看。

choices.english: I'll sit at the other end for a bit and watch the light.
choices.chinese: 我在长椅另一头坐一会儿，看看这光。

choices.english: I'll stand here. Are you waiting for someone?
choices.chinese: 我站这儿就好。你在等人吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: With you seated at the other end, Harold starts to slide farther along the bench.
beats.chinese: 你在长椅另一端坐下后，哈罗德开始往旁边挪。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Let me move over. No, we've got plenty of room.
beats.chinese: 我再挪挪。不用，地方够宽敞。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He settles back into precisely his original spot and plants his shoes beside the same seam in the boards.
beats.chinese: 他又坐回原来的位置，两只鞋重新停在木板上同一条接缝旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Look at that light on the rides. At a theater, I'd have paid for this seat.
beats.chinese: 瞧游乐设施上的光。这要是在剧院，这个位子可得花钱。

choices.english: Do you watch the lighting at the theater too?
choices.chinese: 你在剧院也会留意灯光吗？

choices.english: I'll take a look from the railing. Thanks for the seat.
choices.chinese: 我去栏杆边看看。谢谢你让座。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Harold keeps his jacket and program on his lap. He turns slightly toward you without getting up.
beats.chinese: 哈罗德仍把外套和节目册放在腿上。他没有起身，只是稍稍转向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No, just me. I hadn't planned this stop, but the light looked good.
beats.chinese: 没有，就我一个。本来没打算在这儿停，不过这光看着真不错。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He straightens the folded program on top of his jacket.
beats.chinese: 他把外套上折好的节目册摆正。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I keep a little cash for detours. Today's detour is free, and I brought my own reading. Big spender.
beats.chinese: 我留了点钱，专门花在临时起意的事上。今天这趟不用花钱，读物也是自带的。真够阔气。

choices.english: What are you reading?
choices.chinese: 你在看什么？

choices.english: I'll leave you to it. Enjoy the view.
choices.chinese: 那就不打扰了。好好欣赏风景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Harold turns toward you, lifting the program just enough to reveal its worn fold.
beats.chinese: 哈罗德转向你，稍稍举起节目册，露出已经磨旧的折痕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Constantly. Everyone's watching the lead. I'm wondering who picked that green.
beats.chinese: 老看。大家都盯着主角，我在琢磨是谁选了那个绿色。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers the program and looks back toward the shore, a small grin lingering.
beats.chinese: 他放下节目册，重新望向岸上，嘴边还带着一点笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Saw a stage turn deep blue before the curtain rose once. Empty chairs, one bright doorway. That stayed with me longer than the first scene. Anyway, enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 有次开幕前，整个舞台变成深蓝色。空椅子，一扇亮着的门。那个画面比第一场戏留得还久。好了，你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You leave the bench and move to the railing. Harold keeps his jacket on his lap.
beats.chinese: 你离开长椅，走到栏杆边。哈罗德仍把外套放在腿上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure. I'll hold down this end.
beats.chinese: 好。我继续守着这一头。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the program, finds a page with his thumb, and settles back against the bench.
beats.chinese: 他打开节目册，用拇指翻到一页，重新靠在椅背上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a good evening.
beats.chinese: 祝你今晚愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Harold unfolds the program on his lap, keeping its pages out of the breeze.
beats.chinese: 哈罗德在腿上展开节目册，拢着书页，不让风吹乱。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A program from a musical. Couldn't hum you a thing from it. Terrific lighting, though.
beats.chinese: 一本音乐剧的节目册。里面的歌，我一首都哼不出来。不过灯光真棒。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes it, slips it into his jacket pocket, and puts the jacket on. Then he gets up and takes an open spot at the railing.
beats.chinese: 他合上节目册，塞进口袋，穿好外套。随后他站起身，走到栏杆边一处空着的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enough reading. I've come all this way and barely looked at the sea. Enjoy your evening.
beats.chinese: 先不看了。来都来了，海还没看上几眼呢。祝你今晚愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Harold gives you a small nod and shifts the jacket so the program can lie flat.
beats.chinese: 哈罗德向你轻轻点头，挪了挪外套，好把节目册摊平。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Good evening to you.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。也祝你今晚愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the program and runs one finger down the page until he finds his place.
beats.chinese: 他打开节目册，手指沿着书页往下移，找到了刚才读到的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah, there. Lighting credits. That's my page.
beats.chinese: 啊，在这儿。灯光制作名单。这页归我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Steeplechase Pier, you see Harold sitting on a bench, watching the light toward shore. An open theater program rests on his lap. He recognizes you and smiles.
beats.chinese: 在障碍赛码头，你看见哈罗德坐在长椅上，望着岸上的光线。一本打开的剧场节目册放在他腿上。他认出你，笑了笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I was only going to stop for a minute. Think I'll sit a little longer.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。原本只打算停一下。现在想再坐一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes the program and leaves it on his lap, turning his attention back to the view.
beats.chinese: 他合上节目册，仍放在腿上，注意力又回到眼前的景色。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Today's schedule has changed. Nothing else lined up for now. You do your thing. I'll watch a little longer.
beats.chinese: 今天的日程改了。暂时没有下一项。你随意，我再看一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Washington Square Park, Marisol Ferrante sits on the dry fountain's steps with a paperback after a neighborhood walk. Skateboarders move inside the basin. Keeping the book angled inward, Marisol finishes the last page and looks up at you nearby.
beats.chinese: 华盛顿广场上，Marisol Ferrante在街区散步后，坐在干涸喷泉的台阶上看一本平装书。有人在盆地里滑板。Marisol始终把书朝着自己，看完最后一页后，抬头看向近处的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Quick reading-habit question. Do you ever read the ending first? I've just finished it. I won't say what happens.
beats.chinese: 只问个读书习惯。你会先看结尾吗？我刚看完，内容不会说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol rests the book on their knees, keeping a thumb on the final page and the pages facing inward.
beats.chinese: Marisol把书放在膝上，用拇指压着最后一页，书页仍然朝着自己。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Marisol. I always start here. Saves three hundred pages of worrying.
beats.chinese: 我叫Marisol。我总是从这里开始看。省得提心吊胆地读上三百页。

choices.english: How do you enjoy a story when you already know the ending?
choices.chinese: 已经知道结尾了，怎么还能享受故事呢？

choices.english: I don't read endings first. I don't want any spoilers.
choices.chinese: 我不会先看结尾。我不想被剧透。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol keeps a thumb on the final page, leaving the book turned away from you.
beats.chinese: Marisol的拇指仍压着最后一页，书页也依然背着你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I notice more. Little clues, odd things people say. Like when the sister—nope, not saying it.
beats.chinese: 我能注意到更多东西。小线索，人物说的怪话。比如那个姐姐——不，不说了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They stop mid-gesture, then place their free hand flat on their knee.
beats.chinese: 手势做到一半，Marisol停了下来，把空着的那只手平放在膝上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I forget people want the worrying part. Do you actually enjoy that?
beats.chinese: 我总忘了，有人就是想要那种悬着心的感觉。你真的喜欢吗？

choices.english: I like finding things out as I go. I'll leave you to your ending and keep walking.
choices.chinese: 我喜欢边读边发现。你慢慢看结尾，我继续走走。

choices.english: Maybe I'll try your way sometime. Go on, start yours.
choices.chinese: 也许哪天我会试试你的读法。你接着看吧，从头开始。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol closes the paperback around one finger, keeping its pages out of view.
beats.chinese: Marisol用一根手指夹住页码，合上平装书，不让书页露出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Absolutely. I schedule events at a Brooklyn bookstore. Other people's endings stay private.
beats.chinese: 当然。我在布鲁克林一家书店安排活动。别人的结尾，我会保密。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They slide a paper bookmark into place and turn the front cover outward.
beats.chinese: Marisol夹好一张纸书签，把封面朝外转过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The cover's safe. There's a summary on the back, so I'll keep that to myself too.
beats.chinese: 封面很安全。封底有内容简介，那个我也不朝着你。

choices.english: I'd like to see the cover, though. Just the title, no summary.
choices.chinese: 不过我想看看封面。只看书名，不听简介。

choices.english: Enjoy your book. I'll keep walking.
choices.chinese: 祝你读得开心。我继续走走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the fountain, Marisol lowers the book and gives you a small wave.
beats.chinese: 你沿着喷泉继续走。Marisol放低书，朝你轻轻挥了挥手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I keep forgetting that part can be fun for someone else.
beats.chinese: 明白了。我老是忘记，对别人来说那部分也可能很好玩。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn back two pages, keeping the book angled inward.
beats.chinese: Marisol往前翻了两页，书仍然朝着自己。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy your walk. I'm going to read those last two pages again.
beats.chinese: 散步愉快。我再读一遍最后这两页。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol lifts the book slightly, then pauses before opening it.
beats.chinese: Marisol把书稍微举高，翻开前又停了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Try it with something you don't mind experimenting on. A mystery reader once got very cross with me.
beats.chinese: 拿一本你愿意试验的书试试吧。有个爱看推理的朋友曾经为这事气坏了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn to chapter one, smooth the page, and settle the book on their knees.
beats.chinese: Marisol翻到第一章，把书页抚平，将书放稳在膝上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Now I can read the whole thing. Enjoy the square.
beats.chinese: 好了。现在可以从头读完了。祝你在广场逛得开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol holds the front cover steady. The title reads The Missing Tuesday.
beats.chinese: Marisol稳稳举着封面。书名是《消失的星期二》。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The Missing Tuesday. I bought it for the title. I've nearly lost a Tuesday in the events calendar myself.
beats.chinese: 《消失的星期二》。我冲着书名买的。我自己排活动日历时，也差点把一个星期二弄没了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They lower the book into the tote at their feet, stretch their fingers, and turn toward the skateboarders in the basin.
beats.chinese: Marisol把书收进脚边的布袋，舒展了一下手指，转头看向盆地里的滑板者。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's enough pages for a minute. I'm going to watch the boards. Enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 先歇会儿，不看字了。我看看滑板。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue on your way. Marisol keeps the book closed long enough to wave goodbye.
beats.chinese: 你继续往前走。Marisol先没翻开书，抬手向你道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Have a good walk.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They open the book at the bookmark and shift it closer to their lap, out of passing sightlines.
beats.chinese: Marisol翻到书签夹着的位置，把书往腿上收了收，避开路人的视线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Nobody else needs to read this page with me.
beats.chinese: 这样就好。不用让别人陪我一起看这一页。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Washington Square Park, Marisol is on the dry fountain's steps, closing a small handwritten calendar. Skateboarders move inside the basin. Marisol spots you and raises a hand in greeting.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到华盛顿广场时，Marisol正坐在干涸喷泉的台阶上，合起一本小小的手写日历。盆地里有人滑板。Marisol看见你，抬手打了个招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I'm done checking schedules for today. Time to read the middle of my novel.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天不再检查安排了。接下来该读小说中间那一段了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol puts the calendar away and takes out a novel with a bookmark already in place, opening it at the marked page.
beats.chinese: Marisol收好日历，拿出一本已经夹好书签的小说，翻到书签所在的那一页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I already know the ending. Now I get to see how they get there. Good to see you.
beats.chinese: 结尾已经知道了，现在轮到看看他们怎么走过去。见到你真好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Washington Square Park, Frank Delgado sits on the fountain steps after his shift proofreading movie captions. He is waiting for his longtime friend Eddie, with his coat folded on his lap. People linger on the steps, and skateboarders keep rolling across the dry basin. You are nearby.
beats.chinese: 华盛顿广场的喷泉台阶上，Frank Delgado 刚结束电影字幕校对的班次，正在等老朋友埃迪，叠好的外套放在腿上。有人在台阶上停留，滑板的人不断滑过无水的盆地。你就在附近。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Been coming here long?
beats.chinese: 常来这里吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Frank turns from the skateboarders to look at you. His coat stays folded on his lap.
beats.chinese: Frank 将目光从滑板的人身上移开，看向你。外套仍叠放在他腿上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm waiting for an old friend.
beats.chinese: 我在等一个老朋友。

choices.english: It's my first visit. Who are you waiting for?
choices.chinese: 我是第一次来。你在等谁？

choices.english: I'd rather just watch the skating, thanks.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，我想只看看滑板。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Frank folds one sleeve over the other on his lap. His answer comes slowly, while his eyes move across the people on the steps.
beats.chinese: Frank 将腿上外套的两只袖子叠好。他慢慢回答，目光扫过台阶上的人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eddie. We've known each other thirty years. We meet here after my matinee caption shift.
beats.chinese: 埃迪。认识三十年了。我做完日场字幕的工作，就在这里和他碰面。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His phone lights up. He reads the message, then puts it away without opening anything else.
beats.chinese: 他的手机亮了。他读完消息，没再打开别的内容，就收起手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He's running a little late. Same as Tuesday.
beats.chinese: 他要晚一点。跟星期二一样。

choices.english: You work on movie captions?
choices.chinese: 你做电影字幕方面的工作？

choices.english: Would you like some company while you wait?
choices.chinese: 等人的时候，要不要一起聊聊？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Frank gives a small nod and turns slightly so you both have a clear view of the basin.
beats.chinese: Frank 轻轻点头，稍微侧过身，让你们都能看清盆地。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I'm just waiting for my friend Eddie.
beats.chinese: 当然。我只是在等朋友埃迪。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tucks the loose coat sleeve under the rest of the coat. A skateboard rolls across the dry basin below.
beats.chinese: 他把垂下的袖子塞进叠好的外套下面。下方，一块滑板滚过干燥的盆地。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy the skating.
beats.chinese: 慢慢看吧。

choices.english: Stay nearby and watch without starting a conversation.
choices.chinese: 留在附近看滑板，不再开口聊天。

choices.english: Give him a nod and move to another clear part of the steps.
choices.chinese: 向他点点头，移到台阶上另一处空着的地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Frank turns back to answer you. He keeps his coat neatly contained on his lap.
beats.chinese: Frank 转头回答你，腿上的外套仍旧叠得整整齐齐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I proofread the accessibility captions. Words, timing, missing sounds. A door slamming matters in some films.
beats.chinese: 我校对无障碍字幕。文字、时间点，还有漏掉的声音说明。有些电影里，摔门声很重要。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A man approaching along the steps raises a hand. Frank lifts his own hand in reply and turns his knees toward him.
beats.chinese: 一个沿台阶走近的男人抬手示意。Frank 也举手回应，把膝盖转向了他。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's Eddie. I'll leave work there for the afternoon. Good talking to you.
beats.chinese: 埃迪来了。今天下午就不聊工作了。很高兴和你聊了几句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Frank pauses with his hand resting on the folded coat. His reply becomes more formal.
beats.chinese: Frank 的手停在叠好的外套上，顿了一下，回答变得客气而正式。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. I'd prefer to wait on my own.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我还是想自己等。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He draws the coat closer and turns toward the people coming along the steps. The space beside him remains open.
beats.chinese: 他把外套往怀里收了收，转向沿台阶走来的人。身旁的位置依然空着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Please use the step if you like. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 想坐的话，这里可以坐。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You watch the skateboarders. A man arrives carrying a small paper bag, and Frank immediately raises his hand.
beats.chinese: 你看着滑板的人。一个男人提着小纸袋走来，Frank 立刻举起手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eddie. There you are.
beats.chinese: 埃迪。你来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Eddie offers the bag. Frank's expression softens as he takes a biscuit, then turns fully toward his friend.
beats.chinese: 埃迪递过纸袋。Frank 拿出一块饼干，神情放松下来，完全转向了老朋友。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You remembered the plain ones. Good. The others leave sugar all over my coat.
beats.chinese: 你记得拿原味的。好。别的那几种会把我的外套弄得全是糖。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You nod and move to a different open stretch of the fountain steps. Frank returns your nod without trying to continue the conversation.
beats.chinese: 你点点头，移到喷泉台阶上另一处空地。Frank 也点头回应，没有继续攀谈。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you settle farther along, Frank catches a slipping sleeve and gathers his coat. He spots someone among the people on the steps and raises a hand.
beats.chinese: 你在稍远处停下时，Frank 接住滑落的袖子，将外套拢好。他在台阶上的人群中看见了谁，抬手示意。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eddie. Over here.
beats.chinese: 埃迪。在这边。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Washington Square Park, you see Frank sitting on the fountain steps, waiting for someone. He recognizes you and gives you a nod.
beats.chinese: 后来再次来到华盛顿广场，你看见 Frank 坐在喷泉台阶上等人。他认出了你，向你点点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Eddie isn't here yet. I'm waiting for him.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。埃迪还没到，我等他。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Frank turns his attention back to the people coming and going on the steps. He lets the greeting end there.
beats.chinese: Frank 把目光转回台阶上来往的人，没有继续延长话题。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You don't need to wait with me. Enjoy watching the skating.
beats.chinese: 你不用陪着等。慢慢看滑板吧。

causality.presenceReason: Frank 做完日场无障碍字幕校对，按约到华盛顿广场的喷泉台阶等认识三十年的朋友埃迪。
causality.placeAttitude: 他把这里当作与老朋友固定碰面的地点，对陌生人保持礼貌，但不急着扩大交往，也不寻求带路或搭伴。
causality.stayingConstraint: 他与埃迪约在这里见面。交谈分支中，埃迪发消息说会迟到，Frank 继续留在约定地点等候。
causality.currentGoal: 等埃迪到场，开始自己的休息时间。
causality.currentState: 下班后精力平稳，外套从一开始就叠放在腿上。他的注意力主要放在等人上，愿意简短交谈，不愿接受陌生人的陪等邀请。
causality.contactTrigger: Frank 等人时看着无水盆地里持续的滑板活动，直接向附近的玩家询问是否常来，随后说明自己在等老朋友。接触不再由外套占位或腾出台阶触发。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留先问来访资历的习惯、短句语气、字幕校对工作及对老相识的依赖。面对陪聊邀请，他措辞转为正式并直接婉拒。再次见面时，他仍以点头和简短招呼维持礼貌距离，不因见过一次便升级亲密。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家可说明初访并问他在等谁，也可表示只想看滑板。aa 中他简短说明字幕工作，随后迎接埃迪并结束交谈。ab 中他更正式地婉拒陪伴，同时保留玩家使用台阶的自由。ba 中玩家不再聊天，看到他对埃迪明显放松并接过饼干。bb 中玩家移到另一处空着的台阶，双方点头结束接触，Frank 随后看见埃迪并招手。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程使用喷泉台阶与无水盆地，盆地内的滑板活动始终作为背景。外套起初就在 Frank 腿上，后续整理袖子与收拢外套的动作仍然成立。人物不进入滑行区域，不占用通道，不新增设施。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Frank Delgado。本次重逢位于华盛顿广场，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Washington Square, Beatriz Ocampo is taking a snack break on the fountain steps after trying a newly opened bakery. People linger nearby, and skateboarders ride inside the dry basin. Her paper bag rests securely on her lap as she checks the pastry against the receipt.
beats.chinese: 在华盛顿广场，Beatriz Ocampo刚去过一家新开的面包店，正坐在喷泉台阶上吃点心。附近有人停留，无水的盆地里有人滑板。纸袋稳稳放在她腿上，她对照着小票看了看点心。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Plain, not this one. Oh, I'm checking my pastry. I wasn't talking about you. I'm Beatriz.
beats.chinese: 原味，不是这个。哦，我在核对点心，不是在说你。我叫Beatriz。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps the bag on her lap and looks from the receipt to the pastry again.
beats.chinese: 她让袋子稳稳留在腿上，又看了看小票和点心。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, wrong one. They're in their first week, though. Everybody's learning where things go.
beats.chinese: 哦，拿错了。不过他们才开业第一周，大家还在熟悉东西都放在哪儿。

choices.english: I'd still be annoyed if I got the wrong order.
choices.chinese: 要是拿错了我的餐点，我还是会不高兴。

choices.english: Is it at least something you like?
choices.chinese: 至少是你喜欢吃的吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beatriz folds the receipt once, ready with an answer.
beats.chinese: Beatriz把小票对折了一下，立刻准备接话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They had quite a line, and the person serving looked new—oh, you only said you'd be annoyed. I added the whole defense.
beats.chinese: 当时排队的人挺多，拿餐的那个人看着也像新来的——哦，你只是说你会不高兴。我倒把整套辩护都补上了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sets the receipt on top of the bag and leaves the pastry wrapped.
beats.chinese: 她把小票放在袋子上，没有拆开点心的包装。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I ordered plain. This one's full of raisins. I can be patient and still ask for the right thing.
beats.chinese: 我点的是原味，这个全是葡萄干。我可以有耐心，也可以要求拿到自己点的东西。

choices.english: Exactly. I'd want what I ordered. I'll let you finish your break.
choices.chinese: 对，我也会想拿到自己点的东西。不打扰你休息了。

choices.english: I'd probably give them another try too. I'm going to watch the skating.
choices.chinese: 我大概也会再给他们一次机会。我去看看滑板。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beatriz turns the wrapped pastry over. Several raisins show through a gap in the paper.
beats.chinese: Beatriz把包着的点心翻过来。包装纸的缝隙里露出几颗葡萄干。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Raisins. I like them well enough. I just wanted plain today.
beats.chinese: 葡萄干。我倒也不讨厌，只是今天想吃原味。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She starts opening the wrapper, pauses, and folds one corner back into place.
beats.chinese: 她开始拆包装，停了停，又把一个纸角折了回去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I keep trying new places. Apparently I also keep giving myself a speech before eating a snack.
beats.chinese: 我总爱试新店。看来我还总爱在吃点心之前，先给自己讲上一通。

choices.english: You could save it for later. I'll leave you to your break.
choices.chinese: 可以留着晚点吃。不打扰你休息了。

choices.english: What makes you try so many new places?
choices.chinese: 你为什么这么喜欢试新店？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beatriz slips the receipt into the bag beside the untouched pastry.
beats.chinese: Beatriz把小票放进袋子，塞在还没动过的点心旁边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. I'll take it back after my break and ask for the plain one.
beats.chinese: 嗯。休息完我就拿回去，换成原味的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the bag shut and settles it securely against her hip, leaving the step beside her clear.
beats.chinese: 她折好袋口，把袋子稳稳放在身侧，空出了旁边的台阶。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks for the chat. Enjoy the square.
beats.chinese: 谢谢你陪我聊了几句。祝你在广场逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You move a little farther along the steps to watch the skateboarders. Beatriz unwraps one end of the pastry.
beats.chinese: 你沿台阶挪开一点，去看盆地里的滑板者。Beatriz拆开了点心一端的包装。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They'll get another visit from me. I'll point at the plain one next time.
beats.chinese: 我还会再去的。下回我直接指着原味的点。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes a bite, catches a loose crumb in the paper, and turns toward the basin.
beats.chinese: 她咬了一口，用包装纸接住掉下的碎屑，转头望向盆地。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy. I'm staying here with my very unexpected raisins.
beats.chinese: 慢慢看。我就在这儿，吃这些意料之外的葡萄干。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beatriz closes the wrapper without taking a bite.
beats.chinese: Beatriz没有吃，把包装重新包好了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I will. I'm allowed to stop negotiating with a pastry.
beats.chinese: 那就留着吧。我也该停止跟一块点心讨价还价了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tucks the pastry into the bag and keeps it on her lap. Her hands rest on the folded top.
beats.chinese: 她把点心收进纸袋，放在腿上，双手搭在折好的袋口上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beatriz smooths the wrapper around the pastry before putting it away.
beats.chinese: Beatriz把点心外面的包装纸抚平，收回袋子里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I make shadow puppets for a small theater in Brooklyn. I've sat through enough shaky opening nights to want new places to get a second week.
beats.chinese: 我在布鲁克林一家小剧院做皮影人偶。磕磕绊绊的首演看得多了，就总希望新店能撑到第二周。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the bag closed, stands, and gathers it against her side without entering anyone's path.
beats.chinese: 她折好袋口，站起身，把袋子拢在身侧，没有挡住别人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sometimes I get carried away with the excuses. Anyway, that's my break finished. Nice talking with you.
beats.chinese: 有时候我替人找理由会找过头。好了，我也休息够了。很高兴跟你聊天。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Washington Square, you see Beatriz on the fountain steps looking through film choices in a small notebook on her knee. Skateboarders are riding in the dry basin. She recognizes you and raises a hand in greeting.
beats.chinese: 在华盛顿广场，你看见Beatriz坐在喷泉台阶上，翻看膝头小笔记本里的候选电影。无水的盆地里有人滑板。她认出了你，抬手打了个招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. I'm picking a Tagalog film for the weekend. Today I feel like watching one I already know.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。我在挑周末要看的他加禄语电影。今天想重看一部熟悉的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts a check mark beside one title, then closes the notebook.
beats.chinese: 她在一个片名旁打了个钩，然后合上本子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No new ones this time. I just want to watch one I like again. It's good to see you.
beats.chinese: 这次不找新的了。我就是想再看一遍喜欢的。见到你真好。

causality.presenceReason: 她先去尝试一家新开的面包店，随后独自到华盛顿广场喷泉台阶上吃点心、歇脚。
causality.placeAttitude: 把广场当作普通休息地点，也愿意看看无水盆地里的滑板活动。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须久留的义务，只打算完成一次短暂休息，纸袋始终收在身边。
causality.currentGoal: 坐一会儿并吃掉刚买的点心，发现拿错口味后决定如何处理。
causality.currentState: 友善健谈，休息时较放松，但一提新店就容易急着替对方解释。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Tiong Bahru Market's upstairs open-air dining area, Tan Kim Seng has settled at a table for lunch. As you pass beside it, he looks up from his untouched chicken rice. The next chair is empty, and his shopping bag rests between his feet.
beats.chinese: 在中峇鲁熟食中心楼上的开敞用餐区，Tan Kim Seng刚坐下来吃午饭。你从桌旁经过时，他从没动过的鸡饭前抬起头。旁边的椅子空着，购物袋放在他的两脚之间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Lunch is already here, and I'm still thinking about the laksa I didn't buy. I've prepped meals for two hundred people, then I go and do this with my own lunch.
beats.chinese: 午饭已经买好了，我还在想没买的叻沙。两百个人的饭都备过，轮到自己的午饭就这样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He laughs at himself and gestures toward the empty chair.
beats.chinese: 他自己笑起来，朝旁边的空椅子示意。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Kim Seng. Sit if you like. I've already ordered, so you won't have to wait through that performance.
beats.chinese: 我叫Kim Seng。想坐就坐。我已经点好了，你不用看我那场点餐大戏。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll sit for a little while.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，我坐一小会儿。

choices.english: Thanks, but I'm just passing.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，不过我只是路过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You take the empty chair. Kim Seng moves his plate a little closer to himself, keeping your side of the table open.
beats.chinese: 你在空椅子上坐下。Kim Seng把盘子往自己这边挪了挪，给你留出桌面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Chicken rice. A good choice. Although I remembered the laksa about three seconds after ordering.
beats.chinese: 鸡饭，选得不错。不过点完才三秒，我就想起叻沙了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He picks up his spoon, pauses over the rice, then laughs at himself.
beats.chinese: 他拿起勺子，停在米饭上方，又自己笑了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My wife says I choose trains to photograph faster than I choose lunch. She's right, lah.
beats.chinese: 我太太说，我挑火车拍照都比挑午饭快。她说得对啦。

choices.english: Tell me a little about your train photos, then I'll head on.
choices.chinese: 跟我聊两句你的火车照片吧，然后我就走。

choices.english: I'll just sit quietly for a minute, then head on. Enjoy your food.
choices.chinese: 我就安静坐一分钟，然后就走。你慢慢吃。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You remain beside the table. Kim Seng leaves the empty chair clear and draws his feet and bag farther under his own seat.
beats.chinese: 你没有入座。Kim Seng让那张椅子空着，又把脚和袋子往自己的座位下面收了收。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No problem. Enjoy your walk around.
beats.chinese: 没问题，慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns back to his chicken rice and lifts his spoon, but stops before taking any.
beats.chinese: 他转回去看着鸡饭，举起勺子，却迟迟没舀下去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Aiyah, now I'm thinking about noodles. This rice hasn't even had a chance yet.
beats.chinese: 哎呀，现在又想吃面了。这盘饭连表现的机会都还没有。

choices.english: Give it one bite before you replace it.
choices.chinese: 先吃一口，再想着换掉它吧。

choices.english: Enjoy your lunch. I'll keep going.
choices.chinese: 午饭吃好，我继续走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kim Seng lowers his spoon and turns toward you for the brief chat.
beats.chinese: Kim Seng放低勺子，转过身来，跟你聊上几句。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Old railway carriages, mostly. I spent decades prepping meals on trains around Malaysia and Singapore. These days I like getting the whole carriage in the picture.
beats.chinese: 主要拍老火车车厢。我在马来西亚和新加坡一带的列车上备餐，做了几十年。现在拍照，我喜欢把整节车厢都拍进去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He finally takes a mouthful of rice. As you get up to leave, he swallows and raises his free hand.
beats.chinese: 他终于吃了一口饭。你起身离开时，他咽下饭，抬起空着的那只手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I still do the prep part-time. Feeding two hundred people, easy. Choosing for myself takes longer. Ha! Take care, ah.
beats.chinese: 我现在还兼职做备餐。喂饱两百个人，容易。给自己选吃的，反而更久。哈！慢走啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kim Seng turns back to his plate, leaving you to your quiet minute.
beats.chinese: Kim Seng转回去面对自己的盘子，让你安静坐一会儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. Better eat this while it's warm.
beats.chinese: 当然。趁热吃才好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He eats several mouthfuls without restarting the conversation. When your minute is up and you rise, he moves his bag fully beneath his chair.
beats.chinese: 他接连吃了几口，没有再挑起话题。一分钟后你起身，他把袋子完全收进椅子底下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care. Thanks for the company.
beats.chinese: 慢走。谢谢你坐一会儿作伴。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kim Seng looks from you to his untouched lunch, then gives a short laugh.
beats.chinese: Kim Seng看看你，又看看没动过的午饭，笑了一声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One bite, can. You're asking less than my wife. She says finish the plate.
beats.chinese: 一口，可以。你要求比我太太少。她说，要吃完整盘。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes a spoonful of rice with a piece of chicken, chews, and nods. He settles closer to the table, ready to continue eating.
beats.chinese: 他舀起一勺饭，配上一块鸡肉，嚼了嚼，点点头。他往桌前坐近一点，准备继续吃。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Wah, the ginger's good. The noodles will have to manage without me. Enjoy your day, ah.
beats.chinese: 哇，姜蓉不错。那碗面只好少我这个食客了。今天过得愉快啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the same dining-area passage. Kim Seng stays at his table.
beats.chinese: 你沿着用餐区同一条通道继续走。Kim Seng仍坐在桌边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. Bye, ah.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。再见啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives a small wave and turns his attention back to the plate. His spoon hovers over the rice before shifting toward the chicken.
beats.chinese: 他轻轻挥了挥手，把注意力转回盘子。勺子在米饭上停了一下，又转向鸡肉。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Chicken first, then.
beats.chinese: 那就先吃鸡肉吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Tiong Bahru Market's upstairs dining area, you spot Kim Seng at a table with his lunch. He recognises you. A bag of market vegetables rests securely beside his feet.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到中峇鲁熟食中心楼上的用餐区，你看见Kim Seng坐在桌边吃午饭。他认出了你，一袋从市场买来的蔬菜稳稳地放在脚边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again! Good to see you. I chose my vegetables quickly today. Just one dish for dinner.
beats.chinese: 又见面了！见到你真好。今天买菜很干脆，晚饭只做一道菜。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances at the vegetables in the open bag, smiles, and takes another spoonful of his lunch.
beats.chinese: 他看了一眼敞口袋里的蔬菜，笑了笑，又舀起一口午饭。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No changing my mind today, lah. I'll cook these when I get home. Enjoy your visit, ah.
beats.chinese: 今天不改主意了啦，回家就做这个。慢慢逛啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Tiong Bahru Market's upstairs dining area, Farah Zulkifli is having rice and fried tofu after a cleaning shift at a small dairy plant. She notices you beside her table, where her bag occupies a chair.
beats.chinese: 在中峇鲁熟食中心楼上的用餐区，Farah Zulkifli 刚结束小型乳品厂的设备清洁班次，正在吃米饭和炸豆腐。她注意到桌旁的你，自己的包正占着一把椅子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can sit here if you like. My bag doesn't need its own chair.
beats.chinese: 想坐的话可以坐这里。我的包不用独占一把椅子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the bag on her lap. Beside her meal are two little sauce dishes and an empty blue side plate.
beats.chinese: 她把包放到腿上。饭菜旁摆着两个小酱碟，还有一个空的蓝色小盘。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Farah, by the way. That seat's free.
beats.chinese: 对了，我叫 Farah。这个位子没人坐。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll sit here.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，那我坐这里。

choices.english: Thanks, but I'm not sitting down. Are those little plates yours?
choices.chinese: 谢谢，不过我不坐。那些小碟子是你自己的吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You take the cleared chair. Farah moves the empty blue plate between you, keeping her meal on her own side.
beats.chinese: 你坐上腾出来的椅子。Farah 把空蓝盘移到两人之间，自己的饭菜仍留在自己这边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Want a piece of tofu? I've got plenty. This little plate's clean.
beats.chinese: 要不要来块豆腐？我这儿挺多的。这个小盘是干净的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She reaches for a clean spoon, then stops to shift the chilli dish farther from the peanut sauce. She checks the gap once more.
beats.chinese: 她伸手拿起一把干净勺子，又停下来，把辣椒碟移得离花生酱更远些。她还低头确认了一遍间距。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Peanut sauce in this dish. Chilli in that one. Separate spoons too. Aiyah, the tofu's getting a longer introduction than you did.
beats.chinese: 花生酱放这个碟，辣椒放那个碟。勺子也分开。哎呀，豆腐的出场介绍都比你的长了。

choices.english: Yes, please. I'll try a piece on that spare plate.
choices.chinese: 好呀，谢谢。我用那个空盘尝一块。

choices.english: No food, thanks. I'd just like to sit.
choices.chinese: 不用吃的，谢谢。我只是想坐一下。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Farah stays seated and turns the empty blue plate so its painted edge is visible. The two sauce dishes remain beside her meal.
beats.chinese: Farah 仍坐着，把空蓝盘转了个方向，让盘边的花纹露出来。两个酱碟依旧放在饭菜旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mine, yes. I collect small plates. Then I bring them out for lunch, so I can claim they're useful.
beats.chinese: 对，我自己的。我收集小盘子，再带出来吃午饭，这样就能说它们有实际用途了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts the blue plate by its edge. A folded cloth for wrapping it sits inside her open bag.
beats.chinese: 她捏着盘沿举起蓝盘。敞开的包里放着一块折好的布，是用来包盘子的。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My siblings count them whenever they visit. Very hardworking people when it's my cupboard.
beats.chinese: 我兄弟姐妹每次来都要数一遍。只要是查我的橱柜，他们就特别勤快。

choices.english: Could I look at the empty one? I'll give it straight back.
choices.chinese: 能让我看看那个空盘吗？我马上还你。

choices.english: I'll leave you to your lunch. Enjoy it!
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你吃午饭了。慢慢吃！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Farah puts a piece of tofu on the blue plate with the clean spoon and slides it towards you. Both sauces stay in their separate dishes.
beats.chinese: Farah 用干净勺子往蓝盘里放了一块豆腐，推到你面前。两种酱仍各自放在自己的碟子里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There you go. Sauce if you want. Once it's on your plate, you can do whatever you like with it.
beats.chinese: 给你。想蘸酱就蘸。到了你的盘子里，怎么吃都由你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You try the tofu. Farah serves herself a piece, dips it in peanut sauce, and settles back over her rice.
beats.chinese: 你尝了豆腐。Farah 也给自己夹了一块，蘸上花生酱，重新吃起米饭。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good, still crisp. All right, lunch first. I talk too much when I'm hungry.
beats.chinese: 不错，还脆着。好了，先吃饭。我一饿就话多。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Farah draws the spare plate back to her side, leaving the space in front of you clear.
beats.chinese: Farah 把备用小盘收回自己这边，让你面前的桌面保持空着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Can, of course. No need to eat just because I'm eating.
beats.chinese: 当然可以。不用因为我在吃，你就也得吃。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes one earbud from her bag, puts it in, and returns to her rice. Her other ear remains uncovered.
beats.chinese: 她从包里拿出一只耳机戴上，继续吃饭，另一只耳朵仍空着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm putting my music back on. Enjoy the seat.
beats.chinese: 我接着听会儿歌。你坐着歇吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Farah passes you the empty plate, keeping her fingers around its rim. Its blue pattern continues onto the underside.
beats.chinese: Farah 捏着盘沿，把空盘递给你。蓝色花纹一直延伸到盘底。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here. The pattern goes underneath too. Completely wasted on the table, so naturally I wanted it.
beats.chinese: 给。花纹连盘底都有。摆在桌上完全看不见，所以我当然就想要了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You look it over and hand it back. Farah wraps it in the cloth, puts it in her bag, and picks up her spoon.
beats.chinese: 你看了看，把盘子还给她。Farah 用布包好，放进包里，再拿起勺子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Better put it away before I decide I need a matching one. Enjoy your day, ah.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。赶紧收起来，免得我又觉得该买个配套的。祝你今天愉快啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Farah lowers the plate and gives you a small wave from her chair.
beats.chinese: Farah 放下盘子，坐在椅子上朝你轻轻挥了挥手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks, you too. Glad I moved the bag anyway.
beats.chinese: 谢谢，你也是。反正把包挪开总没错。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You leave the table. Farah keeps the spare chair clear and takes another bite of lunch.
beats.chinese: 你离开餐桌。Farah 没再往空椅子上放东西，继续吃午饭。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye, ah!
beats.chinese: 拜拜啊！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Tiong Bahru Market's upstairs dining area, Farah looks up from her phone at a table and recognises you. A family group chat is filling her screen.
beats.chinese: 在中峇鲁熟食中心楼上的用餐区，坐在餐桌旁的 Farah 从手机上抬起头，认出了你。屏幕上满是家庭群聊的新消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eh, hello! My siblings are organising dinner. Twelve messages, and all we've agreed on is that we're hungry.
beats.chinese: 诶，你好！我兄弟姐妹在商量晚饭。发了十二条消息，唯一达成的共识就是大家都饿了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Another message arrives. Farah laughs, types a short reply, and places the phone face down beside her.
beats.chinese: 又来了一条消息。Farah 笑了，打了个简短回复，把手机翻扣在身旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've suggested a time. Let them argue about the food for a bit. Nice to see you, ah.
beats.chinese: 我提了个时间。吃什么就让他们再争一会儿吧。见到你真好啊。

causality.placeAttitude: 她喜欢在熟食中心吃饭，也愿意与人同桌，但对自己碟中的酱料分隔很坚持。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Tiong Bahru Market's upstairs open-air dining area, Jolene Seah is finishing the kopi and chwee kueh she came here for. Her bag is by her feet, and the other chair at her table is empty. She takes a sip and glances your way.
beats.chinese: 中峇鲁熟食中心楼上的开敞用餐区里，Jolene Seah正享用专程来吃的水粿和咖啡，已经快吃完了。她的包放在脚边，同桌的另一把椅子空着。她喝了一口咖啡，朝附近的你看了一眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Strong today. Good.
beats.chinese: 今天这杯够浓。好喝。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sets her cup down, then looks back at you.
beats.chinese: 她放下杯子，又看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: For me, anyway. No promise you'll like it. This seat's free if you want it. I'm Jolene.
beats.chinese: 反正我喜欢。不保证你也喜欢。想坐的话，这个位子没人。我叫Jolene。

choices.english: I'll sit, thanks. What would you recommend here?
choices.chinese: 谢谢，那我坐了。这里你推荐吃什么？

choices.english: No seat for me, thanks. You sound very careful about that coffee.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，我不坐。你说起这杯咖啡，好像很谨慎。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You take the empty chair. Jolene glances at the remaining piece of chwee kueh on her plate, then back at you.
beats.chinese: 你坐到空椅子上。Jolene看了看盘里剩下的那块水粿，又看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I like the chwee kueh. Soft cake, plenty of salty topping. Whether I'd recommend it to you, though...
beats.chinese: 我喜欢水粿。粿软，咸菜脯给得也足。不过，要说推不推荐你吃嘛……

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She picks up her spoon, pauses, and puts it down again.
beats.chinese: 她拿起勺子，停了停，又放下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You want a reference only, can. I don't know how salty you like your food.
beats.chinese: 你只是想参考一下，那可以。我不知道你平时喜欢吃多咸。

choices.english: Just a reference, not a promise. Tell me what you like about it.
choices.chinese: 只是参考，不用保证。说说你喜欢它什么吧。

choices.english: No recommendation needed, then. I'll just use the seat.
choices.chinese: 那就不用推荐了，我坐一会儿就好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The chair stays empty. Jolene sets her cup down a little more firmly than before.
beats.chinese: 椅子仍然空着。Jolene放下杯子的动作比刚才重了一点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Careful? I know I like it. I just don't know what you like.
beats.chinese: 谨慎？我很清楚自己喜欢。我只是不知道你喜欢什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks at the little coffee left in her cup and gives a brief, embarrassed smile.
beats.chinese: 她看了看杯底剩下的一点咖啡，短暂地笑了笑，有些不好意思。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Okay, that was a lot of explanation for one cup. I came for strong kopi. I got strong kopi.
beats.chinese: 好吧，一杯咖啡让我解释了这么多。我就是来喝浓咖啡的，也确实喝到了。

choices.english: Fair enough. I'll leave you to your coffee. Move on from the table.
choices.chinese: 明白，那不打扰你喝咖啡了。离开桌边。

choices.english: No food advice needed. What do you do when you're not here?
choices.chinese: 不用给我吃喝建议。你平时做什么工作？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jolene picks up her spoon again and cuts into the last piece of chwee kueh.
beats.chinese: Jolene重新拿起勺子，把最后一块水粿切开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Then yes, I'd pick this. The topping has a proper bite, and the cake is soft without turning to mush. Some places give you a sad little pinch of topping. This one doesn't.
beats.chinese: 那我推荐这个。菜脯嚼起来有口感，粿软，又不会烂成一团。有些地方只给可怜巴巴的一小撮菜脯，这份没有那么小气。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She scoops up the remaining topping and starts on her last bite, ending the exchange while you remain seated.
beats.chinese: 她把剩下的菜脯拢进勺子，开始吃最后一口。交谈告一段落，你仍坐在桌旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And I'm eating every bit of this. That's how much I like it.
beats.chinese: 而且这点菜脯我一点也不留。我就是这么喜欢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jolene nods and shifts her tray closer to herself, leaving the table space in front of your chair clear.
beats.chinese: Jolene点点头，把托盘往自己这边挪了挪，空出你面前的桌面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure. You don't have to order anything to sit with me.
beats.chinese: 可以，跟我同桌不用非得点东西。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She returns to her food without watching you for another question.
beats.chinese: 她继续吃东西，没有盯着你等下一个问题。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll finish this while it's warm. Make yourself comfortable.
beats.chinese: 我趁热把这个吃完。你随意。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You move away from the table. Jolene stays seated with her cup in hand.
beats.chinese: 你离开桌边。Jolene仍坐着，手里拿着杯子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 好，祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She raises her free hand in a small goodbye, then drinks the last of her kopi.
beats.chinese: 她抬起空着的那只手，轻轻挥别，随后喝完最后一点咖啡。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Time I finished this anyway.
beats.chinese: 我也该把这杯喝完了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jolene finishes her kopi before answering. Her tone becomes brisk and matter-of-fact.
beats.chinese: Jolene喝完咖啡才回答，语气变得干脆、平实。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I calibrate weighing scales at a fish market. A vendor disputes fifty grams, I show the printout. Some days they argue with the paper too.
beats.chinese: 我在鱼市场校准秤。摊主对五十克的误差有意见，我就拿打印记录给他们看。有时他们连那张纸也要争。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She places her cup on the tray, stands, and picks up both the tray and her bag, ready to clear her table.
beats.chinese: 她把杯子放回托盘，站起身，拿好托盘和包，准备收拾离桌。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Anyway, lunch is finished. I'll get these cleared. Take care, ah.
beats.chinese: 好了，午饭吃完了。我把这些收走。再见啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Tiong Bahru Market's upstairs dining area, you spot Jolene at a table. She is reading something on her phone. She looks up and recognises you.
beats.chinese: 在中峇鲁熟食中心楼上的用餐区，你看到Jolene坐在一张餐桌旁看手机。她抬头认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eh, hello again. This food vlogger put watery porridge at number one. I was there a few days ago.
beats.chinese: 诶，又见面了。这个美食博主把稀得很的粥排第一。我前几天才吃过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She scrolls back to check the name, then locks the phone and puts it beside her cup.
beats.chinese: 她往回滑，核对了一下名字，随后锁上手机，放在杯子旁边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, same place. I want porridge that stays on the spoon. He can keep his number one.
beats.chinese: 没看错，就是那家。我喜欢能挂在勺子上的粥。他继续把它排第一好了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Tiong Bahru Market's upstairs dining area, Grace Lim is having lunch before her evening theatre duty shift. Her friends Siti and Mei are debating a film ending at her table.
beats.chinese: 在中峇鲁熟食中心楼上的用餐区，Grace Lim正趁剧院晚班前吃午饭。同桌的朋友Siti和Mei正在争论一部电影的结尾。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Can I borrow you for a second? They both liked the first half. That's something they can agree on, right?
beats.chinese: 借你一句话——她们都喜欢前半部，总算有一点能同意吧？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Siti tells Grace they are only discussing the film, and Mei nods. Grace gestures towards the empty chair beside her, then turns back to her friends.
beats.chinese: Siti告诉Grace，她们只是在讨论电影，Mei也点了点头。Grace示意了一下身旁一直空着的椅子，又转向朋友们。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Grace, by the way. You can sit here if you like. Siti, Mei, can we at least agree the first half was good?
beats.chinese: 对了，我叫Grace。想坐的话，这里可以坐。Siti，Mei，那我们至少能同意前半部拍得不错吧？

choices.english: Thanks. I'll sit for a bit.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，我坐一会儿。

choices.english: No thanks, I'm only passing.
choices.chinese: 不用了，谢谢，我只是路过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You take the empty chair. Siti tells Grace that nobody is upset. Mei nods, then resumes explaining why the ending annoyed her.
beats.chinese: 你坐上空椅子。Siti告诉Grace，根本没人不高兴。Mei点点头，接着解释那个结尾为什么让她恼火。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Okay, okay. I heard the volume and appointed myself chairperson.
beats.chinese: 好啦，好啦。我一听声音大，就自己当上会议主席了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Grace laughs and raises both hands. One hand starts another small gesture towards her friends before she places it beside her bowl.
beats.chinese: Grace笑着举起双手。一只手又忍不住朝朋友那边比画了一下，她随即把它放回碗边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I manage the front of house at a theatre. Nobody here has actually made a complaint, but I've already started handling one.
beats.chinese: 我在剧院管前厅。这里明明没人投诉，我已经开始处理投诉了。

choices.english: Let them finish their debate. What did you think of the ending?
choices.chinese: 让她们继续争论吧。你觉得那个结尾怎么样？

choices.english: I'd just like to sit quietly, thanks.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，我只想安静坐一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Grace leaves the chair empty. Siti tells her they are enjoying the disagreement, while Mei taps the table once to underline her point about the film.
beats.chinese: Grace让椅子继续空着。Siti告诉她，她们争得挺开心。Mei轻敲一下桌面，强调自己对电影的看法。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No problem. It's there if anyone needs it.
beats.chinese: 没问题。谁需要都可以坐。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Grace glances between her friends. She opens her mouth, pauses, then turns back towards you without getting up.
beats.chinese: Grace看了看两位朋友。她张开嘴，顿了一下，又转头看向你，没有起身。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They say they're enjoying this. I was about to propose a time limit.
beats.chinese: 她们说这样争很开心。我刚才还准备提议，每个人限时发言。

choices.english: They sound fine without a referee. Enjoy lunch. (Continue along the aisle.)
choices.chinese: 听起来她们不需要裁判。慢慢吃。（沿通道继续走。）

choices.english: I'll leave you to lunch. Bye. (Continue along the aisle.)
choices.chinese: 那不打扰你吃午饭了。再见。（沿通道继续走。）

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Grace turns fully towards you for her answer. Beside her, Siti folds her arms while Mei waits with an expectant grin.
beats.chinese: Grace转过身来回答你。旁边的Siti抱起双臂，Mei则带着期待的笑容等她开口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mei's right. The ending was rushed. There, I've made things worse already.
beats.chinese: Mei说得对，结尾太仓促了。好了，我一开口，局面更乱了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Siti immediately challenges her opinion. Grace starts to lift a hand, catches herself, and takes a spoonful of lunch instead. She turns back to her friends as their debate continues.
beats.chinese: Siti立刻反驳。Grace刚要抬手，又收住，改为舀了一口午饭。她转回朋友那边，让争论继续。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy the seat. I'd better eat before they get to the sequel.
beats.chinese: 你慢慢坐。我得赶在她们说到续集之前吃完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Grace nods at your request and shifts her bowl closer to herself, leaving your part of the table clear.
beats.chinese: Grace听完点点头，把碗往自己面前挪了挪，让你这边的桌面空着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I'll leave you to it.
beats.chinese: 当然，你安心坐。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns away from your chair and takes another mouthful. Mei resumes her account of the final scene, and Grace keeps her hands around her spoon and bowl.
beats.chinese: 她转离你这边，又吃了一口。Mei继续讲最后一场戏，Grace的双手则老实拿着勺子、扶着碗。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Carry on, Mei. I've missed half your argument by interrupting it.
beats.chinese: Mei，你继续。我一直打岔，你的理由都漏听一半了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the same aisle, Grace gives a short laugh and raises both hands towards her friends.
beats.chinese: 你沿着原来的通道继续走。Grace短促地笑了一声，朝朋友们举起双手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. Enjoy your day!
beats.chinese: 说得也是。祝你今天愉快！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Grace tucks her hands under her thighs for a moment. Siti resumes speaking without waiting for her permission, and Grace stays facing the table.
beats.chinese: Grace把双手压在大腿下面片刻。Siti没等她许可就继续说了起来，Grace也转回桌前，不再招呼你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Go on, Siti. I'm listening.
beats.chinese: Siti，你接着说。我听着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the dining-area aisle. Grace gives you a quick wave from her chair.
beats.chinese: 你沿着用餐区通道继续走。Grace坐在椅子上，朝你挥了挥手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye! Enjoy the rest of your day.
beats.chinese: 再见！祝你接下来一天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Grace turns back to her friends and holds up two fingers. Mei continues talking rather than accepting the proposed arrangement.
beats.chinese: Grace转回朋友那边，竖起两根手指。Mei没有接受她的安排，仍然接着往下说。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Two minutes each, that's all I'm suggesting. Okay, Mei, finish that sentence first.
beats.chinese: 我只是建议每个人说两分钟。好好好，Mei，你先把这句说完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Tiong Bahru Market, you spot Grace at a table in the upstairs dining area. She recognises you as she unfolds a sheet covered in small red marks beside her lunch.
beats.chinese: 在中峇鲁熟食中心，你在楼上用餐区的一张桌旁看见Grace。她正把一张满是红色小记号的纸摊在午饭旁，抬头认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello! Good to see you. My cousin has returned my paper puzzle.
beats.chinese: 哎，你好！见到你真好。我表亲把我出的纸上谜题退回来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Grace traces a red circle around a printed number, shakes her head with a smile, then folds the sheet and puts it in her bag.
beats.chinese: Grace沿着一个数字外面的红圈划了划，笑着摇摇头，然后把纸折好收进包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Three unclear clues, and apparently I can't number a page properly. Lunch first. Corrections later.
beats.chinese: 三条线索不清楚，看来连编号我都没编对。先吃饭，待会儿再改。

causality.presenceReason: Grace晚间要去剧院值班，事先已约Siti和Mei在中峇鲁熟食中心吃午饭。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the public walkway along Koon Seng Road in Joo Chiat, Tan Cheng Huat pauses to look at a blue facade. A folded recipe sheet is in his hand.
beats.chinese: 在如切Koon Seng Road的公共通道上，Tan Cheng Huat停下来看一面蓝色外墙，手里拿着折好的食谱。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Third gingerbread already. It can cool without me watching. This blue's a better use of my eyes.
beats.chinese: 姜饼都第三炉了。不用盯着它也会放凉。我的眼睛先看看这面蓝墙。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He notices you nearby and folds the recipe smaller, leaving the walkway clear.
beats.chinese: 他注意到附近的你，把食谱又折小一点，没有挡住通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Tan Cheng Huat. Old household recipe. I've come out for a little walk before I try a slice.
beats.chinese: 我叫Tan Cheng Huat。照着旧家政书做的。尝之前先出来走一小圈。

choices.english: Old recipes are always healthier. I read that somewhere.
choices.chinese: 老食谱总是更健康。我在哪儿读到过。

choices.english: That blue caught my eye too. I'm just looking at the houses.
choices.chinese: 那面蓝墙也吸引了我。我就是来看看这些房子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tan glances down at the folded recipe, smiling slightly.
beats.chinese: Tan 低头看了看折好的食谱，微微笑着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This one has plenty of sugar. Where you read that one?
beats.chinese: 这一份可放了不少糖。你是在哪里读到的？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His thumb stops halfway along the fold. He turns fully toward you instead of continuing his walk.
beats.chinese: 他的拇指压到折痕一半就停了下来。他没有继续走，而是转过身面对你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A recipe book, or an article? Did they mean healthier ingredients, or smaller portions?
beats.chinese: 食谱书，还是文章？说的是食材更健康，还是每份吃得更少？

choices.english: Only a headline. I'll take back 'always.'
choices.chinese: 只是个标题。我收回“总是”这个说法。

choices.english: I'd rather leave it there.
choices.chinese: 我不太想继续讨论这个了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tan puts the recipe in his pocket and turns his attention to the coloured facades, staying on the public walkway.
beats.chinese: Tan 把食谱放进口袋，转头看向彩色立面，始终站在公共通道上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That blue caught my eye. I grew up around Joo Chiat, but I can come out for a walk and get distracted here.
beats.chinese: 那片蓝色把我看住了。我是在如切一带长大的，出来散个步，走到这里还是会分神。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He smooths his loose shirt and looks back at the blue section.
beats.chinese: 他抚平宽松衬衫上的褶皱，又看了看那片蓝色。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I made hats for an opera house for thirty-odd years. Once spent half an afternoon finding a blue feather that looked right under stage lights.
beats.chinese: 我以前给一家歌剧院做帽子，做了三十多年。有一回，光是找一根在舞台灯下颜色合适的蓝羽毛，就花了半个下午。

choices.english: Do you miss making the hats?
choices.chinese: 你会想念做帽子的日子吗？

choices.english: I'll keep looking at the houses. Enjoy your walk.
choices.chinese: 我继续看看这些房子。祝你散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tan nods and finally presses the fold flat.
beats.chinese: Tan 点点头，终于把那道折痕压平了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A headline, ah. All right, I won't make you produce the whole newspaper.
beats.chinese: 原来是个标题啊。好啦，不叫你把整份报纸都找出来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shifts his attention back to the recipe and traces a printed line with his finger.
beats.chinese: 他把注意力转回食谱，手指沿着其中一行字划过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mine says 'a quick oven.' That's the bit I'm puzzling over. Thanks for the chat. I'll finish reading this.
beats.chinese: 我这份写着“快火烤箱”。我正琢磨这个呢。谢谢你聊这几句，我把它看完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tan's hand pauses on the recipe. He gives a small, immediate nod.
beats.chinese: Tan 放在食谱上的手停了停，随即轻轻点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I asked you three things in one breath.
beats.chinese: 当然可以。我这一口气问了你三件事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pockets the paper and resumes his walk along the public passage, without another question.
beats.chinese: 他把纸放进口袋，沿公共通道继续散步，没有再追问。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy your afternoon. I'd better get back before I start worrying about the gingerbread.
beats.chinese: 祝你下午愉快。我也该回去了，省得又惦记起那盘姜饼。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tan keeps his gaze on the blue facade for a moment before answering.
beats.chinese: Tan 看着蓝色立面，过了一小会儿才回答。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The steam, yes. And a wire frame finally sitting straight. The deadlines can stay gone.
beats.chinese: 会想念蒸汽的味道。还有铁丝帽架终于调正的那一下。赶工期限就免了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rubs his thumb against his forefinger, then lets his hand fall and returns his attention to the houses.
beats.chinese: 他用拇指搓了搓食指，随后垂下手，把目光重新投向那些房屋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The workshop got smaller, so I retired. These days my gingerbread gets most of the attention. Good talking to you. I'll have another look here.
beats.chinese: 后来工坊缩编，我就退休了。现在大半心思都花在姜饼上。很高兴聊这几句，我再在这里看看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tan smiles and steps into the direction he was already walking, keeping clear of the residential entrances.
beats.chinese: Tan 笑了笑，朝原本散步的方向迈步，没有靠近住宅入口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. Plenty of colour to keep your eyes busy.
beats.chinese: 你也慢慢看。这些颜色，够眼睛忙一阵了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks that the folded recipe is secure in his pocket and continues along the public walkway.
beats.chinese: 他确认折好的食谱在口袋里放稳了，继续沿公共通道往前走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Paper safely away. Goodbye!
beats.chinese: 纸收好了。再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Koon Seng Road, Tan Cheng Huat recognises you while holding a worn deck of cards in its box.
beats.chinese: 在Koon Seng Road，Tan Cheng Huat手拿装着旧牌的牌盒，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eh, hello again. Learned one new move with these. Same old cards. Tonight my nephew gets to be suspicious.
beats.chinese: 哎，又见面了。用这副牌学了个新手法。还是旧牌。今晚轮到我外甥猜疑了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He presses the card box flap shut, pleased with it, and puts it in his pocket before turning back towards the coloured houses.
beats.chinese: 他把牌盒盖压好，颇为满意，装进口袋才转回身看彩色房屋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No extra equipment. Very economical, provided I don't drop them all. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 不用添道具。很省钱，只要别全掉地上。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Koon Seng Road in Joo Chiat, Desmond Koh stands to one side of the public passage, clear of passing pedestrians. During his walk, he has taken two differently framed photos of the colourful residential facades.
beats.chinese: 在如切的坤成路，Desmond Koh 站在公共通道一侧，不妨碍行人经过。散步途中，他已经拍了两张构图不同的彩色住宅立面照片。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Would you have a look at just two photos? I'm trying to get the feel of the whole row. No need to take a photo for me.
beats.chinese: 愿不愿意帮我只看两张照片？我想拍出这一整排房子的感觉。不用替我拍照。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps his phone in his own hand and swipes between the two images, smiling at the wider view.
beats.chinese: 他把手机拿在自己手里，在两张照片之间切换，看到取景更宽的那张时笑了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I like this wider one. Two steps sideways and I got a whole different picture! If you're just passing, no worries.
beats.chinese: 我喜欢这张拍得更宽的。往旁边挪两步，拍出来就完全不同了！你要是只是路过，也没关系。

choices.english: Thanks, but I'm just passing through.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，不过我只是路过。

choices.english: Sure. What are you trying to capture?
choices.chinese: 可以啊。你想拍出什么感觉？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Desmond stays to the side with both feet planted, keeping your route open.
beats.chinese: Desmond 在一旁站定，给你留出通行的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I'll let you get on.
beats.chinese: 当然，不耽误你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks down and swipes between two photographs on his phone. His smile widens.
beats.chinese: 他低头在手机上的两张照片之间来回滑动，笑容越来越大。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Same houses, two steps sideways. I'm ridiculously pleased with the difference.
beats.chinese: 还是这些房子，只是往旁边挪了两步。我居然高兴成这样。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll keep going.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，那我继续走了。

choices.english: Actually, could I see those two photos?
choices.chinese: 对了，能让我看看那两张照片吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Desmond turns toward the facades, staying to one side of the public passage.
beats.chinese: Desmond 转身面向那些住宅立面，仍站在公共通道一侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm trying to fit more of the row in. Come, come see. Every time I move, I like a different bit.
beats.chinese: 我想把这一排多拍进去一点。来，看看。我每挪一下，就又喜欢上另一部分。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He starts to extend his phone, then pauses and holds it where you can choose whether to look.
beats.chinese: 他刚要把手机递近，又停住了，只举在你可以自行决定要不要看的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I lay out the newspaper's puzzle page. You'd think I'd be able to fit a few houses into a rectangle.
beats.chinese: 我在报社排字谜游戏版。按说总该有办法把几栋房子装进一个长方形里吧。

choices.english: Go ahead and take it. I'll step aside.
choices.chinese: 你拍吧，我往旁边让一让。

choices.english: I'd rather look at the houses than a screen.
choices.chinese: 比起屏幕，我更想直接看看房子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Desmond lowers his phone completely and leaves the passage clear for you to continue.
beats.chinese: Desmond 把手机完全放下，留出通道让你继续前行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No problem. I've already got one I like.
beats.chinese: 没问题。我已经拍到一张自己喜欢的了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives a small wave, then turns toward the houses from his spot at the side.
beats.chinese: 他轻轻挥了挥手，然后站在一旁转身看向房屋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a good day!
beats.chinese: 祝你今天愉快！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Desmond angles his phone toward you while remaining at the side of the public passage.
beats.chinese: Desmond 仍站在公共通道一侧，把手机屏幕转向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This one cuts off the end house. This one gets it in. There, that's the entire achievement.
beats.chinese: 这张把最边上那栋切掉了。这张拍进去了。喏，全部成就就是这个。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shows each image once, chuckles, and puts the phone away.
beats.chinese: 他把两张照片各展示了一次，笑了笑，随后收起手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: At home I'd turn the sofa round for a different view. Much easier to move myself here. Anyway, I'll let you carry on.
beats.chinese: 在家我会把沙发转个方向，换个视野。在这里还是挪自己容易多了。好啦，不耽误你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: With the space you offered, Desmond lifts his phone while staying to one side of the public passage.
beats.chinese: 有了你让出的空间，Desmond 举起手机，仍站在公共通道一侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. One more from here, then I'll put it away.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。从这里再拍一张，我就收起来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes one photograph, checks that the row fits, and pockets his phone. He turns to continue his own walk along the public passage.
beats.chinese: 他拍了一张，确认这一排房屋都在画面里，便把手机放进口袋，转身沿公共通道继续自己的散步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Got it! That's enough versions for one walk. Thanks for the room.
beats.chinese: 拍到了！一次散步拍这么多版本，够了。谢谢你让地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Desmond glances from his small screen to the colourful facades.
beats.chinese: Desmond 看了看小小的屏幕，又抬头看向色彩鲜艳的住宅立面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I've barely looked up since I got here.
beats.chinese: 也是。我到这里以后，几乎都没怎么抬头看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pockets the phone and turns to study the colours on one house, leaving space beside him and bringing the conversation to a close.
beats.chinese: 他收起手机，转身仔细看其中一栋房子的配色，身旁依然留着空位，也就此结束了交谈。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All these colours, and I'll probably go home and move the same old sofa again. Anyway, enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 这里这么多颜色，我回家以后大概还是只会挪那张旧沙发。好啦，你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a later walk along Koon Seng Road, Desmond recognises you. He is standing to one side of the public passage, reading a message on his phone.
beats.chinese: 在坤成路散步时，Desmond 认出了你。他正站在公共通道一侧，看手机上的消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again! My flatmate's sent me a photo of our bookshelf. Apparently it's exactly where he wants it.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了！我室友发来一张我们家书架的照片。看来他觉得现在这个位置正合适。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Desmond types a short reply, grins, and slips the phone into his pocket.
beats.chinese: Desmond 简短地回复了一句，咧嘴笑笑，把手机放进口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've said I'll leave it there. I only moved it on Sunday. Have a good day!
beats.chinese: 我答应不挪了。我星期天才刚挪过呢。祝你今天愉快！

causality.presenceReason: Desmond 到如切坤成路散步，被彩色住宅立面吸引，已用自己的手机拍下两张不同构图的照片。
causality.placeAttitude: 他真心喜欢住宅立面的颜色与构图变化，尤其喜欢现有照片中取景较宽的一张，会为挪动两步带来的差别高兴。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须留下的事务，只因想反复调整构图而暂时停留。他从一开始就站在不妨碍行人的公共通道一侧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the public walkway along Koon Seng Road in Joo Chiat, Grace Tan waits for her friend Mei. They have arranged to look at the colourful houses. Grace holds a clear box of individually wrapped pineapple tarts.
beats.chinese: 在如切 Koon Seng Road 的公共通道上，Grace Tan 正等着朋友 Mei。她们约好来看看彩色房屋。Grace 手里拿着一盒透明包装的凤梨酥，每块都有独立包装。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Would you like a pineapple tart? Nobody's had one yet.
beats.chinese: 要不要来块凤梨酥？还没人吃过呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She loosens the ribbon and raises the lid towards you. A small card tucked beneath the ribbon reads, 'Photo first, please! — Mei'.
beats.chinese: 她松开丝带，朝你这边掀起盒盖。丝带下面夹着一张小卡片，上面写着“请先拍照！——Mei”。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We bought these for our tea later. Mei wants a picture of the whole box. One missing won't spoil the picture, surely.
beats.chinese: 这是我们一起买的，留着待会儿喝茶吃。Mei 想拍一整盒。少一块，总不至于拍不了吧。

choices.english: I'd like one, if Mei is happy to share.
choices.chinese: 如果 Mei 也愿意分给别人，我想尝一块。

choices.english: No, thanks. I'll leave the box as it is.
choices.chinese: 不用了，谢谢。还是让这一盒保持原样吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Grace stops with her fingers above a wrapped tart. She glances at Mei's card.
beats.chinese: Grace 的手指停在一块独立包装的凤梨酥上方。她看了一眼 Mei 的卡片。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah. I haven't asked her. Better keep the lid down for now.
beats.chinese: 啊，我还没问她。那还是先盖上吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes the box and sends a short message on her phone. The loosened ribbon hangs over her wrist.
beats.chinese: 她合上盒盖，用手机发了一条简短消息。松开的丝带垂在她手腕上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry. I offered before thinking. I do that with the first slice of cake too. The knife's out before anyone gets a photo.
beats.chinese: 不好意思，没想清楚就先请你吃了。分蛋糕时我也这样。别人还没拍照，我的刀就拿出来了。

choices.english: No problem. What brought you to this street?
choices.chinese: 没关系。你怎么想到来这条街？

choices.english: No problem. I'll leave you to meet Mei. Goodbye.
choices.chinese: 没关系，不打扰你等 Mei 了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Grace draws the box back without pressing you. She closes the lid, then pulls the ribbon free.
beats.chinese: Grace 把盒子收回来，没有继续劝。她盖好盒盖，随后把丝带抽了出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. These wrappers make enough crumbs in my bag anyway.
beats.chinese: 好。这些包装放在包里，本来就够掉碎屑的了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the ribbon into a small square. Mei's card remains visible through the clear lid.
beats.chinese: 她把丝带折成一个小方块。隔着透明盒盖，仍能看见 Mei 的卡片。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll keep the box full for her picture. The bow can go. It takes up half the lid.
beats.chinese: 我会把整盒留着给她拍照。蝴蝶结就免了吧，占了半个盒盖。

choices.english: She might want the bow in the picture too.
choices.chinese: 她可能也想把蝴蝶结拍进去。

choices.english: Enjoy your afternoon with Mei. Goodbye.
choices.chinese: 祝你和 Mei 下午玩得开心。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Grace turns slightly towards the colourful façades, keeping the closed box level in her hands.
beats.chinese: Grace 微微转向那些彩色立面，双手把合上的盒子端平。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The colours. I match pulp colours at the Jurong paper mill. Over thirty years, and I spend my day off looking at more colours.
beats.chinese: 来看颜色。我在裕廊的造纸厂做纸浆配色。干了三十多年，休息日还跑出来看颜色。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She laughs at herself, then slips her phone into her bag and looks along the public walkway for Mei.
beats.chinese: 她自嘲地笑了一声，随后把手机放进包里，沿着公共通道张望，寻找 Mei。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: At least these don't need checking on a running machine. Anyway, I'd better watch for Mei. Nice talking to you.
beats.chinese: 至少这些不用上正在运转的机器检验。好了，我得留意 Mei 来了没有。跟你聊得挺开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Grace brings the box close to her body, leaving the public walkway clear.
beats.chinese: Grace 把盒子收近身前，让公共通道保持畅通。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye. Sorry about offering something I couldn't hand over yet.
beats.chinese: 再见啊。还不能给你，就先开口请你吃，不好意思。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She places the ribbon and Mei's card together on top of the closed lid, then puts her phone away.
beats.chinese: 她把丝带和 Mei 的卡片一起放在合好的盒盖上，然后收起手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll keep this lot together until she gets here. Enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 等她到了再动这一盒。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Grace looks from the folded ribbon to the card inside the box.
beats.chinese: Grace 看看折好的丝带，又看看盒子里的卡片。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The bow too? I think it's a fuss. But yes, she paid for half.
beats.chinese: 蝴蝶结也要？我觉得挺折腾。不过也是，她出了一半的钱。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: With a short laugh, she loops the ribbon around the box again. The new bow has one noticeably longer end.
beats.chinese: 她短促地笑了一声，把丝带重新绕回盒子上。新系的蝴蝶结，一边明显比另一边长。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. She can straighten that herself. I'd better keep an eye out for her. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 好了。系得歪不歪，让她自己调整吧。我得留意她来了没有。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Grace nods and tucks the loose ribbon into her own bag. The box stays closed.
beats.chinese: Grace 点点头，把松开的丝带收进自己的包里。盒子仍然盖着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. We'll manage our tea without an opening ceremony.
beats.chinese: 你也是。我们喝个茶，总不至于还得办场开幕式。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives a brief chuckle and turns her attention back to the street. As she waits, she hums a few off-key notes of an old song.
beats.chinese: 她轻笑一下，把注意力转回街上。等人的时候，她低声哼了几句老歌，有些跑调。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, that came out wrong. Better leave the singing till I'm downstairs at home. Bye now.
beats.chinese: 哎，这句唱跑了。还是等回家下楼时再唱吧。再见啦。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another day along Koon Seng Road, Grace is quietly humming an old song at the edge of the public walkway. She recognises you and stops to say hello.
beats.chinese: 另一天，在 Koon Seng Road 的公共通道边，Grace 正轻声哼着一首老歌。她认出你，停下哼唱，开口招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I'm not rushing to meet anyone today. I'll look at the colours and finish humming this song. It's one of my favourites.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天不赶着跟谁会合。我想边看颜色，边把这首歌哼完。我很喜欢这首。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks towards the colourful house fronts and lightly taps her fingers against her palm to the tune in her head. She stays on the public walkway, clear of the private doorsteps and passing pedestrians.
beats.chinese: 她望向彩色住宅立面，随着脑中的旋律，用手指轻轻拍着掌心。她始终留在公共通道上，避开住户的私人门阶，也不挡行人的路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A slow walk like this is plenty for me today. Good to see you. Enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 今天就这样慢慢走，很够了。见到你真好。祝你下午愉快。

causality.currentState: 今天心情轻快、愿意搭话，但急着分享，低估了 Mei 对完整包装和拍照的重视。
