beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the public path along Koon Seng Road in Joo Chiat, Celeste Tan stands clear of passing pedestrians. She keeps her phone lowered and speaks to you nearby.
beats.chinese: 如切 Koon Seng Road 的公共通道上，Celeste Tan 站在不妨碍行人通行的位置。她放低手机，向近旁的你开口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm going to photograph the roofs and sky up there. No people. You can keep walking. I'll wait until the picture's clear.
beats.chinese: 我准备拍上面的屋顶和天空，不拍人。你照常走就好，我会等画面空下来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She glances up at the roofline, leaving her phone down and the public path clear.
beats.chinese: 她抬眼看了看屋顶的轮廓，手机仍放低着，公共通道也保持畅通。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Celeste. My siblings get a photo from me most days. Today they're getting Joo Chiat.
beats.chinese: 我叫 Celeste。我大多数日子都会给兄妹发张照片。今天给他们看看如切。

choices.english: What do they usually send back?
choices.chinese: 他们一般会发什么给你？

choices.english: Thanks for letting me know. I'll keep going.
choices.chinese: 谢谢你告诉我。我继续走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Celeste turns her phone towards herself and opens the family photo thread.
beats.chinese: Celeste 把手机转向自己，点开家人的照片聊天记录。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Breakfast from Vancouver. Plants from Melbourne. I send my fish quite often. Two planted tanks at home.
beats.chinese: 温哥华那边发早餐，墨尔本那边发植物。我常发家里的鱼。我有两个种了水草的鱼缸。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She opens one tank photo, then another. The camera stays closed while she enlarges a small patch of plants.
beats.chinese: 她点开一张鱼缸照，又打开另一张。相机还没重新打开，她已经放大了一小片水草。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Tetras and gouramis. This gourami claims the left corner, so I moved the plants. Then the other one started guarding the right. Now, the feeding arrangement—
beats.chinese: 灯鱼和丝足鲈。这条丝足鲈占着左边角落，我就挪了水草。结果另一条开始守右边。至于喂食怎么安排——

choices.english: Short version, please. Which photo are you sending today?
choices.chinese: 简短版就好。你今天到底要发哪张照片？

choices.english: I'd rather hear a little about your market stall.
choices.chinese: 我更想听你简单说说自己的市集摊位。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Celeste stays clear of the passing pedestrians. Her phone remains lowered as you prepare to continue.
beats.chinese: 你准备继续走，Celeste 仍站在不妨碍行人通行的位置，手机保持放低。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure. I'll keep the phone down.
beats.chinese: 好，我先不举手机。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the screen towards her leg and looks up at the roofline instead.
beats.chinese: 她把屏幕转向腿侧，抬头看向屋顶的轮廓。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll wait until you're clear of the picture. No hurry.
beats.chinese: 等你走出画面我再拍。不用赶。

choices.english: Thank her and continue along the public path.
choices.chinese: 道谢，沿公共通道继续走。

choices.english: I'll pause beside you, out of the frame. You can take it now.
choices.chinese: 我在你旁边停一下，不进镜头。你现在可以拍了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Celeste's thumb stops on the enlarged fish photo. She closes it without opening another.
beats.chinese: Celeste 的拇指停在放大的鱼照上。她关掉照片，没有再点开下一张。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. You asked about my siblings and got the tank report. Sky photo today.
beats.chinese: 对哦。你问的是我兄妹，结果听了一段鱼缸汇报。今天发天空照。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes one photo above the house fronts, sends it, and puts her phone away.
beats.chinese: 她朝店屋上方拍了一张，发出去，随后收起手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Done. I'll keep the feeding arrangements to myself. Enjoy Joo Chiat.
beats.chinese: 好了。喂食安排就留给我自己研究吧。祝你在如切逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Celeste closes the fish photos and slips the phone into her pocket, leaving the sky picture untaken.
beats.chinese: Celeste 关掉鱼照，把手机放进口袋，暂时不拍天空了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hand-knotted cord jewellery. Eight years now. The stall beside mine had a queue on Sunday. I counted, lah.
beats.chinese: 卖手工绳结首饰，做了八年了。星期天旁边那摊排起了队。我还数了人数呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives a small, rueful smile and turns to continue along the public path.
beats.chinese: 她有点无奈地笑了笑，转身准备沿公共通道继续走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mine was quieter. Annoying, but I covered my costs. That's the short stall report. Take care.
beats.chinese: 我的摊冷清些。是有点烦，不过成本挣回来了。摊位的简报就这些。再见啦。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You thank her and continue along the public path. Celeste stays where she is, leaving the way clear.
beats.chinese: 你向她道谢，沿公共通道继续走。Celeste 留在原处，没有占住通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. Bye.
beats.chinese: 谢谢，再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Once you are out of the frame, she raises her phone and takes a single picture of the roofs and sky.
beats.chinese: 等你走出画面，她才举起手机，拍了一张屋顶和天空。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, that'll do.
beats.chinese: 嗯，这张可以。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You pause beside Celeste, outside the frame. She checks her angle without moving farther across the public path.
beats.chinese: 你在 Celeste 身旁停下，避开镜头。她确认了一下角度，没有再往通道中央挪。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Just a little higher. I want more sky.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。再抬高一点，我想多拍些天空。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tilts her wrist, takes the picture and sends it. Then she lowers the phone and steps away from her shooting position.
beats.chinese: 她转动手腕，拍照发出，随后放下手机，离开刚才取景的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sent. One is enough, or I'll spend another ten minutes choosing. Thanks for waiting. Bye.
beats.chinese: 发了。一张就够，不然我又要挑十分钟。谢谢你等我，再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another outing along Koon Seng Road, Celeste recognises you from the public path. She is carrying a takeaway bag home, held steadily at her side.
beats.chinese: 在 Koon Seng Road ，Celeste 在公共通道上认出了你。她正提着打包的食物回家，袋子稳稳地垂在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. Found a good hawker stall. Worth the trip, actually. I bought lunch and dinner together.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。找到一家不错的小贩摊，还真值得专程去一趟。我把午饭和晚饭一起买了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks down at the food, then turns to continue along the public path with the bag still closed.
beats.chinese: 她低头看了一眼食物，袋子仍好好收着，随后转身沿公共通道继续走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could eat the dinner packet right now, actually. I'll take it straight home. Good to see you. Bye.
beats.chinese: 其实我现在就想把晚饭那包也吃掉。还是直接带回家吧。很高兴又见到你，再见。

causality.presenceReason: Celeste 在玩家出现前已站在 Koon Seng Road 公共通道上不妨碍行人的位置，准备拍屋顶和天空，发进与海外兄妹共享的日常照片聊天。
causality.placeAttitude: 她把如切当作当天可以分享的街景，愿意稍作停留，没有被设定为建筑爱好者或当地导览。
causality.stayingConstraint: 拍照只是短暂停留，没有必须留下的义务。她始终保持公共通道畅通，不进入住宅门阶或院落，并愿意等画面无人时再拍。
causality.currentGoal: 拍下一张满意的街景照片发给兄妹，然后继续自己的行程。
causality.currentState: 今天不赶时间，愿意简短聊天，但提到鱼缸就容易展开过头。她主动说明取景安排，不要求玩家停步或参与。
causality.contactTrigger: 她在拍摄前主动告知近旁玩家，自己只拍上方屋顶和天空，不拍人，玩家可以照常走，她会放低手机等画面空下来。接触不由挡路、退让或道歉触发。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留绳结首饰摊主身份、养鱼兴趣、海外手足照片往来、直接温和的说话方式，以及容易讲多和比较摊位生意的缺点。保留新加坡国籍、勿洛组屋成长经历及原有居住背景。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家询问兄妹回图时，她打开家庭照片聊天并越讲越细。aa 接受简短要求，停止鱼缸长谈并发出照片。ab 应玩家选择改谈摊位，坦承数过邻摊排队人数，暂缓拍照后离开。玩家选择继续走时，她保持手机放低。ba 尊重玩家离开，待其走出画面才拍照。bb 接受玩家自愿在画面外短暂停留，拍照发送后主动结束等待。
causality.spatialContinuity: 所有动作限于 Koon Seng Road 住宅店屋前的公共通道。初遇只使用随身手机，重逢携带稳妥的外带食物袋，不进入门阶或院落，不新增设施，不阻碍行人。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Celeste Tan。本次重逢位于如切彩色店屋街，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

reviewEvidence: 结构校验、模型复核与正式编辑批准分别记录；本条保持草稿状态。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Swan Lake in Singapore Botanic Gardens, ripples spread across the water, breaking up the reflections of the lakeside trees. Nearby, Lim Boon Chye closes a sketchbook with an old envelope still tucked between its pages.
beats.chinese: 在新加坡植物园天鹅湖畔，湖面泛起涟漪，岸边树木的倒影随之散开。近旁的 Lim Boon Chye 合上速写本，一只旧信封仍夹在书页间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The tree hasn't moved. The one in the water keeps changing.
beats.chinese: 树没动，水里的倒一直在改。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances toward you, then back at the shifting reflection, keeping the closed book in one hand.
beats.chinese: 他朝你看了一眼，又望向不断变化的倒影，一只手仍拿着合上的本子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Came out for a walk. Ended up comparing my bonsai sketch with the trees here again.
beats.chinese: 本来出来走走，结果又拿家里盆景的速写跟这里的树作比较了。

choices.english: Were you drawing the trees?
choices.chinese: 你刚才在画这些树吗？

choices.english: Yes, the reflection keeps changing.
choices.chinese: 是啊，倒影一直在变。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Boon Chye opens the notebook. The drawing shows a small tree in a shallow pot, with several faint versions of the same branch.
beats.chinese: Boon Chye 翻开本子。纸上画着浅盆里的一棵小树，同一根枝条旁留着好几道淡淡的修改痕迹。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My little bonsai at home. I came to look at the trees here. Then I started changing this again.
beats.chinese: 画的是家里的小盆景。我本来是来看这里的树，结果又改起这张画了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rubs out a short line with the pencil's eraser, redraws it, then tilts the page toward himself.
beats.chinese: 他用铅笔尾端的橡皮擦掉一小段线，重新画上，又把纸页朝自己倾了倾。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That branch has moved three times. The real one is at home, minding its own business.
beats.chinese: 这根枝条已经挪了三次。真的那根还在家里，好好待着呢。

choices.english: I'll just look at the trees for a moment.
choices.chinese: 我就在这里看一会儿树。

choices.english: Have you always drawn?
choices.chinese: 你一直都画画吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Boon Chye watches the ripples a moment longer, then looks down at his notebook. The old envelope sticks out between the pages, its corners soft from use.
beats.chinese: Boon Chye 又看了一会儿涟漪，随后低头看向本子。旧信封从书页间露出来，四角已经磨软了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That envelope is older than the notebook.
beats.chinese: 那个信封比这本笔记本还老。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He notices one corner sticking out and opens the notebook to straighten the envelope.
beats.chinese: 他发现信封露出一个角，便翻开本子把它摆正。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've been clearing a drawer at home. Somehow this came out for a walk with me.
beats.chinese: 最近在清理家里的一个抽屉。不知怎么，这个倒跟我出来散步了。

choices.english: I'll let you get on. Enjoy your walk.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰了。散步愉快。

choices.english: What made you keep that one?
choices.chinese: 你为什么留下这个呢？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you turn your attention to the trees, Boon Chye lowers the notebook and looks up from his drawing.
beats.chinese: 你把目光转向树木，Boon Chye 也放低本子，从画上抬起头来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Go ahead. I've been looking at the paper more than the trees.
beats.chinese: 慢慢看。我盯着纸的时间，比看树还多。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He secures the pencil inside the notebook, puts it away, and resumes his walk along the lake, leaving you the space where he stood.
beats.chinese: 他把铅笔夹牢，收起本子，继续沿湖散步，把原先站着的位置留给你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll get a little walking done now. Enjoy the lake.
beats.chinese: 我这就去走走。慢慢欣赏湖景啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Boon Chye holds the notebook against his palm. His thumb rests beside the repeatedly erased branch.
beats.chinese: Boon Chye 用手掌托着本子，拇指停在那根反复擦改的枝条旁边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Only little sketches. I maintained gym floors for thirty-odd years. Retired now. Drawing is something I can do badly at home.
beats.chinese: 就画些小速写。我做了三十多年的体育馆地板养护，现在退休了。画画嘛，在家画得差一点也没关系。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He starts to close the book, pauses, and opens it again. The eraser returns to the same branch.
beats.chinese: 他刚要合上本子，停了一下，又翻开了。橡皮重新落在同一根枝条上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hmm. That bit is bothering me. I'll leave you to enjoy the lake while I rub another hole in this page.
beats.chinese: 嗯，这一小段看着还是别扭。你慢慢看湖，我再擦下去，这页纸都要破了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you take your leave, Boon Chye stops adjusting the envelope and closes the notebook.
beats.chinese: 你向他告辞，Boon Chye 不再调整信封，合上了本子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. You too.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。你也玩得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the notebook away and shifts clear of your route. His attention returns to the lake.
beats.chinese: 他收起本子，往旁边挪开，不挡你的去路，随后重新望向湖面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care, ah.
beats.chinese: 慢走啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Boon Chye takes the envelope out again and turns its blank back toward himself.
beats.chinese: Boon Chye 又取出信封，把空白的背面转向自己。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Clean on the back. I thought I'd write something on it. Been thinking that for quite a while.
beats.chinese: 背面还是干净的。我想着可以写点东西。这个念头，想了挺久了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes out his pencil and writes 'check small pot' on the envelope. After inspecting the words, he slips it into his pocket and closes the notebook.
beats.chinese: 他拿出铅笔，在信封上写下“检查小花盆”。看了看那几个字，他把信封放进口袋，合上本子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Though I've got plenty of paper at home, lah. Anyway, I'll let you enjoy the lake.
beats.chinese: 好了。不过家里的纸也够多了。好啦，不耽误你看湖了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Swan Lake, you see Boon Chye standing beside the lakeside walking area. He recognises you and lifts a hand.
beats.chinese: 在天鹅湖，你看见 Boon Chye 站在湖岸步行区域一旁。他认出了你，抬手打招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. Short walk for me today. Played land curling yesterday, and my legs know it.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。我今天少走一点。昨天玩了陆地冰壶，今天腿有点酸。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes a few easy steps, then pauses to look across the water without drawing you along.
beats.chinese: 他慢慢走了几步，又停下来看向湖面，没有招呼你跟着走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We argued over one shot for ten minutes. Could have played three more by then.
beats.chinese: 我们为一球争了十分钟。有那个时间，本来还能多打三球。

causality.presenceReason: 他原本来天鹅湖散步，也想看看岸边树形，途中拿出家中盆景的速写作比较。
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢在此慢慢走、看树，今天却容易被自己的速写分神。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须久留的任务，只因查看和修改画稿而暂时停步。
causality.currentGoal: 暂时合上速写本看看湖中树影，再决定继续走路还是修改速写。
causality.currentState: 精神松弛，愿意就眼前景象简短搭话，对自己的线条却反复调整。旧信封一直夹在本子里，没有掉落，也不需要玩家帮忙。
causality.contactTrigger: 湖面涟漪使岸边树木的倒影散开。他合上仍夹着旧信封的速写本，向近旁玩家随口说树没动，水里的倒一直在改，再说明自己本来出来散步，却又拿盆景速写作比较。玩家可问画稿，也可只简短回应倒影，不需要捡物或让位。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留退休地板养护工的经历、盆景和陆地冰壶兴趣，以及随和、干幽默、舍不得丢旧物和放不下自己作品的习惯。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家问画稿时，他翻开本子展示盆景速写，随后aa中收起本子继续散步，玩家留下看树，ab中简述旧职业后留在原地擦改。玩家只回应倒影时，他低头注意到本子里的旧信封，谈起清理抽屉，随后ba中双方直接告别，他让开去路独自看湖，bb中他承认留信封的理由薄弱，实际用英文写下检查小花盆的提醒后收入口袋并结束交谈。
causality.spatialContinuity: 所有动作均在植物园天鹅湖可步行的湖岸区域完成，只使用湖面、岸边树木及其倒影，以及自带的本子、铅笔和信封，不增设设施，不要求玩家处理近身事故或提供帮助。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Lim Boon Chye。本次重逢位于植物园天鹅湖畔，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

reviewEvidence: 结构校验、模型复核与正式编辑批准分别记录；本条保持草稿状态。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Swan Lake in Singapore Botanic Gardens, Vijay Anandan stands beside the walkable lakeshore, recording a message on his phone. He came for a morning walk. His booming voice carries to where you are.
beats.chinese: 在新加坡植物园天鹅湖可步行的湖岸边，Vijay Anandan正拿着手机录语音。他是来晨间散步的，洪亮的声音传到了你这边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The morning walk is officially open! Oh, sorry. Message for my sister. I'm Vijay Anandan.
beats.chinese: 晨间散步正式开始！哦，抱歉。我在给妹妹录语音。我叫Vijay Anandan。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stops the recording without sending it and glances from the screen to the lake.
beats.chinese: 他停止录音，没有发送，目光从屏幕移到湖面上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I said I'd let her know when I arrived. I've spent longer announcing the walk than walking.
beats.chinese: 我说过到了就告诉她。结果宣布散步花的时间，比散步还长。

choices.english: Surely an opening like that deserves a second announcement.
choices.chinese: 这么隆重的开场，怎么也得再宣布一遍吧。

choices.english: I'll leave you to your message.
choices.chinese: 那我就不打扰你录语音了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Vijay straightens immediately. His thumb hovers over the record button.
beats.chinese: Vijay立刻挺直身子，拇指悬在录音键上方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Attention, please! The inaugural walk has suffered a minor delay.
beats.chinese: 各位请注意！本次散步的首发仪式稍有延误。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He records the sentence, listens to the first few words, then deletes it with a small grin.
beats.chinese: 他录下这句话，听了开头几个字，又笑着删掉了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nearly thirty years selling tickets at a monastery history visitor centre. I could make ticket number eight sound important. This message is getting ridiculous, though.
beats.chinese: 我在一家修道院历史游客中心卖了将近三十年的票。八号票都能让我念得郑重其事。不过，这条语音确实越来越离谱了。

choices.english: Let's just walk a few steps along the lake. No grand opening needed.
choices.chinese: 我们就沿湖走几步吧，不用什么开场仪式。

choices.english: You can lead the walk, then. You choose the route.
choices.chinese: 那就由你带着走吧，路线你来选。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Vijay lowers his voice to an ordinary speaking level and holds the phone closer.
beats.chinese: Vijay把音量降到平常说话的程度，将手机拿近了些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Very kind. This production has already run over.
beats.chinese: 多谢体谅。这场演出已经超时了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He records a short arrival message and sends it. Then he lowers the phone.
beats.chinese: 他简短地录了一句报平安的话，发了出去，随后放下手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. She's got it. Now I can actually start walking.
beats.chinese: 好了，她收到消息了。这下总算可以真的散步了。

choices.english: I'll stay here and look at the lake for a moment. Go ahead.
choices.chinese: 我在这里看一会儿湖，你先走吧。

choices.english: Enjoy your walk. I'm heading on.
choices.chinese: 祝你散步愉快，我继续走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Vijay records a quick message saying he has arrived, sends it, and puts his phone away. You walk a few steps together along the lakeshore.
beats.chinese: Vijay简短地录了一句自己已经到了，发送后收起手机。你们沿着湖岸一起走了几步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: At last, actual walking. Much less preparation involved.
beats.chinese: 总算真的走起来了。这事需要的准备可少多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: After those few steps, he slows and turns toward the water, ending the brief shared walk.
beats.chinese: 走过这几步后，他放慢脚步，转向湖面，结束了这段短短的同行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll have a look here. Enjoy the rest of your morning.
beats.chinese: 我在这里看看。祝你接下来这一上午过得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Vijay's raised hand drops before he points anywhere. He gives you a friendly shake of the head.
beats.chinese: Vijay抬起的手还没指向任何地方就放了下来。他友好地摇摇头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, no leading for me. I make the announcements. I haven't even chosen my own route.
beats.chinese: 哦，带路可别找我。我只负责宣布，连自己的路线都还没选呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns back to his phone, records a plain arrival message, and sends it. He stays where he is rather than setting off as a leader.
beats.chinese: 他重新看向手机，平平常常地录了一句自己到了，发了出去。他留在原地，没有领路出发。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll sort myself out here. Have a good walk.
beats.chinese: 我在这里慢慢决定。祝你散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You remain facing the lake. Vijay pockets his phone and turns along the shoreline.
beats.chinese: 你留在原地面向湖面。Vijay把手机放进口袋，转身沿着湖岸走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, I'll get moving before I think of a closing speech.
beats.chinese: 好，我得赶紧走，免得又想出一段闭幕词。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives you a small wave and walks on alone, leaving your view of the water clear.
beats.chinese: 他向你轻轻挥手，独自往前走去，没有挡住你看湖的视线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Goodbye! Enjoy the lake.
beats.chinese: 再见！慢慢看湖吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the lakeshore, Vijay stays to one side and carefully settles his phone into his pocket.
beats.chinese: 你沿着湖岸继续走，Vijay留在一旁，仔细把手机放稳在口袋里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. Off you go, no ceremony required.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。你慢走，不用举行什么仪式。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives a brief nod, then turns toward the lake instead of following.
beats.chinese: 他简短地点头致意，随后转向湖面，没有跟上来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll give the lake another minute. Goodbye!
beats.chinese: 我再看一分钟湖。再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Swan Lake in the Singapore Botanic Gardens, Vijay Anandan recognises you while looking at a photograph on his phone.
beats.chinese: 在新加坡植物园天鹅湖畔，Vijay Anandan看手机照片时认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. My sister found her ticket from our first film outing. I've kept mine too. Same torn corner, opposite side.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我妹妹找到我们头一次一起看电影的票根。我那张也还留着。都缺了角，缺在两边。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He enlarges the faded date, smiles and sends her a short reply.
beats.chinese: 他放大褪色的日期，笑了笑，给妹妹回了条消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She remembers the film. I remember us missing the bus afterwards. Both worth keeping. See you around.
beats.chinese: 她记得电影。我记得看完没赶上公交。都值得留着。回头见。

causality.presenceReason: Vijay先到天鹅湖晨间散步，并答应抵达后给妹妹发语音。
causality.placeAttitude: 把湖岸当作普通散步地点，也忍不住给出发加一段隆重播报。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须久留的安排，只是尚未完成自己答应发送的抵达消息。
causality.currentGoal: 发出语音，然后真正开始走路。
causality.currentState: 今天精神不错、愿意搭话，但为了开场措辞反复录音，耽误了实际行动。
causality.contactTrigger: 他的洪亮语音传到近旁玩家所在处，他主动转向玩家解释并介绍自己。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留退休售票员、播报腔、表演兴致与拖延决定的毛病。初遇语音播报及选择责任仍在。重逢改为与姐姐各自保留同次电影票根，具体呈现既有票根兴趣与手足关系。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa接受不作安排的短暂同行，走几步后停下看湖。ab拒绝领路，留在原地自行安排。ba独自开始散步，玩家留下看湖。bb玩家继续前行，他暂留湖边，结束交谈。
causality.spatialContinuity: 初遇和重逢全部发生在天鹅湖可步行的湖岸区域，只使用湖面、岸线及随身手机，不添加公共设施。重逢结束时他沿湖继续散步，不转入新场景。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Vijay Anandan。本次重逢位于植物园天鹅湖畔，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Swan Lake in Singapore Botanic Gardens, Ryan Teo has paused at one side of the walkable lakeshore to check his location on his phone. He notices you nearby and looks up.
beats.chinese: 在新加坡植物园的天鹅湖畔，Ryan Teo停在可步行湖岸的一侧，用手机核对自己的位置。他注意到附近的你，抬起头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Excuse me, is this Swan Lake? I'm trying to match where I am to the map.
beats.chinese: 请问这里就是天鹅湖吗？我想先把地图上的位置对准。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps the phone in his own hand. His eyes flick back to the map before he looks at you again.
beats.chinese: 他仍把手机拿在自己手里。目光又扫了一眼地图，才重新看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Ryan. It's fine if you're not sure.
beats.chinese: 我叫Ryan。你不确定也没关系。

choices.english: Yes, this is Swan Lake. Planning a walk?
choices.chinese: 对，这里就是天鹅湖。在规划散步路线吗？

choices.english: I'm not sure.
choices.chinese: 我不太确定。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ryan stays where he is. He brings the phone up again, comparing the map with the shoreline.
beats.chinese: Ryan留在原处，又举起手机，对照着地图和岸线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. Just checking how to get back the way I came.
beats.chinese: 对。就是确认一下怎么沿原路回去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He studies the screen for another moment. Then he lowers it and faces you properly.
beats.chinese: 他又盯着屏幕看了一会儿，随后放低手机，这才转过身正对着你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry. You asked about the walk. Yes, I wanted a change from pools. I spend enough time at those during the week.
beats.chinese: 抱歉，你问的是散步。对，我想换个地方，不去泳池了。平时一周里已经待得够多了。

choices.english: Do you work at a pool?
choices.chinese: 你在泳池工作吗？

choices.english: Enjoy your walk. I'm heading on.
choices.chinese: 祝你散步愉快。我继续往前走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ryan nods and looks back at the map, staying at the side of the walkable shore.
beats.chinese: Ryan点点头，重新看向地图，仍站在可步行湖岸的一侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No worries. I'll check.
beats.chinese: 没关系。我自己查一下。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He studies the screen for a moment, then glances up at you again without offering you the phone.
beats.chinese: 他看了一会儿屏幕，又抬眼看向你，没有把手机递过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just need a minute to work out where I am.
beats.chinese: 我得花点时间弄清自己在哪儿。

choices.english: I'll leave you to it. I'd like to enjoy the view on my own.
choices.chinese: 那你慢慢看。我想自己看看湖景。

choices.english: Is the map giving you trouble?
choices.chinese: 地图不好看明白吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ryan puts his phone in his pocket. His attention stays on you this time.
beats.chinese: Ryan把手机放进口袋。这回，他的注意力一直在你这边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I collect water samples at public pools. Then I go back on weekends to swim. Very adventurous of me.
beats.chinese: 我在公共泳池采集水样。周末还会回泳池游泳。我这生活真够有冒险精神的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives a small smile, checks that the way is clear, and starts walking along the lakeshore.
beats.chinese: 他微微一笑，确认前面没有挡着别人，便沿湖岸走起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, I've got my route now. Enjoy the lake.
beats.chinese: 好了，路线弄清楚了。慢慢看湖吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ryan looks up fully as you turn to continue along the lakeshore.
beats.chinese: 你转身准备沿湖岸继续走，Ryan这才把视线完全从手机上移开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. I'll stay here a moment.
beats.chinese: 你也是。我在这里再待一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shifts out of your way and gives a brief wave as you pass. Once you are clear, he opens the map again.
beats.chinese: 他侧身让开，在你经过时简短地挥了挥手。等你走过去，他才重新打开地图。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye, then.
beats.chinese: 那，再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ryan nods without trying to keep the conversation going.
beats.chinese: Ryan点点头，没有试着把话题继续下去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure. Enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 好，慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He moves a little farther along the shore and turns toward his phone. Away from your view, he traces a short section of the map with one finger.
beats.chinese: 他沿岸又走远了一点，转身看手机。在不挡你视线的地方，他用手指划过地图上的一小段路线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah. That's where I turned.
beats.chinese: 啊，我是在这里转弯的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ryan looks at the phone, then back at the shoreline. He gives a small shake of his head.
beats.chinese: Ryan看看手机，又看看岸线，轻轻摇了摇头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The map's fine. I like knowing my way back before I go farther. Takes me a minute.
beats.chinese: 地图没问题。我喜欢先弄清回去的路，再继续往前走。得花点时间。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks one final stretch on the screen, locks the phone, and puts it away. He remains to the side, turning to look across the lake.
beats.chinese: 他最后核对了一段路线，锁屏收起手机。他仍留在一旁，转头望向湖面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Now I can actually look at the lake. I'll leave you to it.
beats.chinese: 好了。现在总算能看看湖了。我不打扰你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Swan Lake, Ryan is standing to one side of the walkable lakeshore, absorbed in a paperback. When he notices you, he keeps a finger between the pages to hold his place.
beats.chinese: 在天鹅湖畔，Ryan站在可步行湖岸的一侧，正投入地读着一本平装书。注意到你时，他把一根手指留在书页间，记住读到的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. I'd like to finish this bit today. I might not be very chatty.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。我今天想把这一段读完，可能不太会聊天。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He draws the pages slightly together and looks up to give you his full attention for a moment, then opens the book again at his finger.
beats.chinese: 他稍稍合拢书页，抬起头，认真地向你致意片刻，随后重新翻开手指夹着的那一页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy your walk. I'll get back to my book.
beats.chinese: 祝你散步愉快。我接着看书了。

causality.presenceReason: Ryan主动来天鹅湖散步，想换个不同于泳池的环境，在用户出现前已停在湖岸一侧查看手机地图。

causality.currentGoal: 先确认眼前是否为天鹅湖，把当前位置与地图对准，再弄清如何沿原路返回。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kelvin Loh is beside Swan Lake at the Singapore Botanic Gardens, waiting for his friend Wei Ming. Water drips from the bag he has just lifted off his shoulder.
beats.chinese: 新加坡植物园天鹅湖畔，Kelvin Loh正在等朋友Wei Ming。他刚把包从肩上取下，水就从包底滴了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mind the drips, ah. My bottle's leaked. I'm Kelvin.
beats.chinese: 小心水滴啊。我的水瓶漏了。我叫Kelvin。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pulls out a water bottle and tries to unzip the wet bag while keeping the bottle upright.
beats.chinese: 他掏出水瓶，一边保持瓶身直立，一边试着拉开湿包的拉链。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Wei Ming picked the lake for our walk. I've brought a little extra lake with me.
beats.chinese: Wei Ming选了湖边散步。我还自己多带了一点湖水来。

choices.english: I can hold the bottle while you sort out the bag.
choices.chinese: 你整理包吧，我可以帮你拿着水瓶。

choices.english: I'll give you some room.
choices.chinese: 我给你腾点地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kelvin hesitates, then holds the bottle out to you, carefully keeping it upright.
beats.chinese: Kelvin迟疑了一下，随后把水瓶朝你递来，仍小心地让瓶口朝上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Just the bottle. I'll handle the wet stuff.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。拿一下水瓶就好，湿的东西我来收拾。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes a small cloth from the bag and wipes inside. Before closing the bag, he tucks it under his arm and reaches for the bottle.
beats.chinese: 他从包里拿出一块小布，擦了擦包内。包还没拉好，他就把它夹到腋下，伸手来接水瓶。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Okay, I'll take it now. You've got better things to do than hold my drinking water.
beats.chinese: 好了，我拿回来吧。总不能让你一直替我拿喝的水。

choices.english: The bag's still open. I can hold this until you're done.
choices.chinese: 包还开着呢。你收拾好之前，我可以继续拿着。

choices.english: Okay. Here you go.
choices.chinese: 好，给你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you give him room, Kelvin lowers the bag onto a dry patch beside his feet and checks the bottle cap.
beats.chinese: 你让开一些，Kelvin把包放到脚边一处干燥的地面上，检查瓶盖。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks, ah. Wei Ming chose the lake. My choice would have involved a telescope.
beats.chinese: 谢谢啊。Wei Ming选了湖边。换我选，多半就得带上望远镜。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He unscrews the crooked cap, puts it on straight and tightens it. He tips the bottle slightly over his open bag to check it.
beats.chinese: 他拧下歪着的瓶盖，对正后重新拧紧，再把瓶子放在敞开的包上方，稍微倾斜着检查。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We take turns choosing. Otherwise we'd spend the whole walk saying, 'Anything, you decide.'
beats.chinese: 我们轮流选。不然整趟散步都在说，随便啦，你决定。

choices.english: I'd like to hear about the telescope.
choices.chinese: 我想听听那架望远镜。

choices.english: I'll leave you to wait for your friend. Enjoy the walk.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你等朋友了。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kelvin glances at the open bag, then lets his reaching hand fall.
beats.chinese: Kelvin看了眼还敞着的包，把伸出的手放了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Another few seconds, then. This bag needs two hands and I've been trying to use one.
beats.chinese: 也是。那就再麻烦几秒。这包得用两只手，我偏要用一只。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: With both hands free, he dries the bag, fixes the cap and takes the bottle back. He packs it upright and closes the zip.
beats.chinese: 腾出双手后，他擦干包内，拧好瓶盖，再接回水瓶。他把瓶子竖着放好，拉上拉链。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorted. Thanks for holding it. I'll wait here for Wei Ming. Enjoy the lake, ah.
beats.chinese: 搞定。谢谢你帮忙拿着。我在这儿等Wei Ming。好好逛逛湖边啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kelvin takes the bottle back and immediately traps the open bag against his side with his elbow.
beats.chinese: Kelvin接回水瓶，立刻用手肘把敞开的包夹在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks, ah. At work I handle crates of spices. One bottle should be within my abilities.
beats.chinese: 谢谢啊。我上班经手的可是一箱箱香料。一个水瓶，应该还应付得来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tightens the cap and packs the bottle away. A wet patch spreads on his shirt where the bag rests, but he pulls the zip shut and gives you a farewell nod.
beats.chinese: 他拧紧瓶盖，把水瓶放回包里。包贴着的衬衫洇湿了一块，他还是拉好拉链，点头向你道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. All packed. Thanks for stopping. Enjoy the rest of your visit.
beats.chinese: 好了，收好了。谢谢你停下来。祝你接下来逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The cap stays dry. Kelvin wipes the bottle with a small cloth from his bag, looking pleased at the change of subject.
beats.chinese: 瓶盖没有再漏水。Kelvin从包里拿出小布擦瓶身，话题一转，他显得轻快起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's a refractor. Assembled it myself. Finding Saturn is easier than finding a tiny screw you've dropped.
beats.chinese: 是架折射望远镜，我自己组装的。找土星，比找掉在地上的小螺丝容易。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the bottle away, closes the bag and turns to look along the walkable lakeshore for his friend.
beats.chinese: 他把水瓶收好，拉上包，转头沿着可步行的湖岸寻找朋友的身影。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Usually I take it to Punggol when the sky's clear. Anyway, I'd better watch for Wei Ming. Nice talking to you.
beats.chinese: 天气晴的时候，我通常带它去榜鹅。好了，我得留意Wei Ming来了没有。跟你聊天很开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kelvin looks up from the bottle and gives you a quick smile.
beats.chinese: Kelvin从水瓶上抬起视线，朝你笑了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. Thanks for making room.
beats.chinese: 你也逛得愉快。谢谢你刚才让开地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He raises one hand in farewell, then crouches beside his bag to finish drying it. The space beside him is clear again.
beats.chinese: 他抬手道别，随后蹲在包旁继续擦拭。他身边的位置又空了出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll be here a little longer. Take care, ah.
beats.chinese: 我还会在这儿待一会儿。慢走啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Swan Lake at the Singapore Botanic Gardens, Kelvin is looking at the sky above the trees. He notices you and smiles in recognition.
beats.chinese: 在新加坡植物园天鹅湖，Kelvin正抬头看树木上方的天空。他注意到你，认出来后笑了笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eh, hello again. I came out for a walk and now I'm checking clouds.
beats.chinese: 哎，又见面了。我出来散步，结果又开始看云了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He follows a gap in the clouds with his eyes, then lowers his head and shifts aside to leave room along the shore.
beats.chinese: 他的目光追着云间的一块空隙，随后低下头，往旁边挪了挪，留出湖岸通行的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm hoping for a clear evening. No telescope with me, so naturally the sky might cooperate. Enjoy your visit, ah.
beats.chinese: 就盼晚上晴一点。今天没带望远镜，天空倒可能肯配合了。好好逛啊。

causality.currentState: 语气温暖，漏水令他手忙脚乱，接受短暂帮助后又急着把东西拿回。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the lower waterfront promenade near the Helix Bridge, Wanjiku Mwangi stands near the railing. She came for a walk after testing used consoles. Her own handheld is muted, and she is near the end of a game when she briefly looks up at you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在滨海湾螺旋桥北端的下层临水步道上，Wanjiku Mwangi站在栏杆附近。测试完一批二手游戏机后，她来这里散步。她自己的掌机一直静音，游戏已经玩到末段，她短暂抬头，看向近旁的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've only got one life left. Want to watch how it ends, or take over and have a go?
beats.chinese: 我只剩最后一条命了。想看它怎么结束，还是接手试一下？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pauses the game with her thumb and tilts the screen slightly toward you, keeping the handheld in her own hands.
beats.chinese: 她用拇指暂停游戏，把屏幕稍稍转向你，掌机仍拿在自己手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Wanjiku. You can kite the guard—wait, I've started in the middle. I should explain the game first.
beats.chinese: 我叫Wanjiku。你可以给守卫放风筝——等等，我又从半截开始讲了。我该先把游戏说清楚。

choices.english: What are you playing?
choices.chinese: 你在玩什么？

choices.english: I'm just enjoying the water.
choices.chinese: 我只是来看看水景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wanjiku turns the screen slightly toward you without handing it over. A small figure waits inside a maze.
beats.chinese: Wanjiku把屏幕稍稍转向你，没有直接把掌机塞过来。一个小人停在迷宫里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A maze game. Get the key, reach the exit. Easy. Well, easy to describe.
beats.chinese: 迷宫游戏。拿到钥匙，走到出口。很简单。嗯，说起来很简单。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps the game paused and holds the handheld between you, keeping her fingers around its edges.
beats.chinese: 她让游戏继续暂停，把掌机拿在你们之间，手指仍握着边缘。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Want to take over? Or you can watch me lose. That's a fairly reliable service.
beats.chinese: 想接手试试吗？也可以看我输。这个节目还挺稳定的。

choices.english: I'll try one round, then head on. Take the handheld and play.
choices.chinese: 我试一局，然后就继续走。接过掌机玩一局。

choices.english: I'll watch one round before I go.
choices.chinese: 我看你玩一局，然后就走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wanjiku lowers the handheld and leaves the view across the railing clear.
beats.chinese: Wanjiku放低掌机，没有挡住栏杆外的水景。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I've spent all day testing used consoles. Enough little screens for one day.
beats.chinese: 当然。我今天一直在测试二手游戏机。一天看这么多小屏幕，也够了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She switches the handheld off and puts it inside her shoulder bag.
beats.chinese: 她关掉掌机，把它放进肩包。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came out for a walk and brought another one with me. Excellent planning, Wanjiku.
beats.chinese: 明明出来散步，还随身带了一块屏幕。Wanjiku，你安排得可真好。

choices.english: You mentioned testing consoles. Is that your usual work?
choices.chinese: 你刚才说在测试游戏机。那是你平时的工作吗？

choices.english: Enjoy your walk. I'll carry on with mine.
choices.chinese: 散步愉快。我继续往前走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: During your round, a guard moves two squares and catches the little figure. Wanjiku opens her mouth, then winces.
beats.chinese: 你这一局里，守卫移动了两格，抓住了小人。Wanjiku张了张嘴，随即露出懊恼的表情。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The guard gets two steps. Which I have chosen to mention after it caught you. Ah. My fault.
beats.chinese: 守卫一次能走两步。而我偏偏等它抓到你才说。啊，是我的问题。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes the handheld back at the end of the round, taps the rules screen, then switches it off instead of starting again.
beats.chinese: 这一局结束后，她收回掌机，点开规则页面看了一眼，随后关机，没有再开一局。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You said one round, so I won't trap you in a replay. Sorry about the missing rule. Enjoy your walk!
beats.chinese: 你说了只玩一局，我就不拉着你重玩了。抱歉漏讲了规则。散步愉快！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wanjiku plays with the screen tilted so you can watch. Her little figure collects the key, then runs straight into a guard.
beats.chinese: Wanjiku把屏幕斜向你，方便你看。她操纵的小人拿到钥匙，随后径直撞上了守卫。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And that's the exit—no, that's the guard. Very different reception.
beats.chinese: 那边就是出口——不对，那是守卫。接待方式可差远了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She laughs, closes the game and tucks the handheld into her bag. She pulls the zip fully shut.
beats.chinese: 她笑着退出游戏，把掌机收进包里，将拉链彻底拉好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One round, as advertised. My family usually takes the controller off me about here. Bye!
beats.chinese: 说好一局，就是一局。我家里人通常到这时候就把手柄拿走了。再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wanjiku settles the bag against her side. The handheld stays inside as she answers.
beats.chinese: Wanjiku把包挪到身侧。回答时，她没有再拿出掌机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. I refurbish second-hand consoles in Nairobi. I'm here temporarily, helping another refurbisher test a batch.
beats.chinese: 对。我在内罗毕翻修二手游戏机。这次只是暂时来新加坡，帮另一位翻修师测试一批机器。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She rubs the thumb she was using on the controls, then lets her hand drop.
beats.chinese: 她揉了揉刚才按键用的拇指，随后放下手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Getting them working is my part. Winning games belongs to somebody else. Anyway, I'm getting on with this walk. Enjoy yours!
beats.chinese: 让机器正常运作是我的活儿。赢游戏就交给别人吧。好了，我继续散步去了。你也逛得愉快！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the promenade, Wanjiku gives a small wave from beside the railing.
beats.chinese: 你继续沿步道往前走，Wanjiku在栏杆旁轻轻挥手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too! Enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 你也是！慢慢欣赏水景吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She adjusts her bag strap and turns toward the water, leaving the handheld packed away.
beats.chinese: 她调整肩包带，转身看向水面，没有再拿出掌机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye!
beats.chinese: 再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the lower waterfront walkway near the Helix Bridge, Wanjiku Mwangi smiles at a message on her phone before recognising you near the railing.
beats.chinese: 在滨海湾螺旋桥北端的下层滨水步道，Wanjiku Mwangi看着手机消息笑了，随后在栏杆旁认出你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Family in Nairobi. Sunday porridge. They sent me a picture of the empty pot, which is useful if I wanted to know what I missed.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。内罗毕家里周日煮了粥。给我发了张空锅照，倒是清清楚楚让我知道错过了什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sends a laughing reply asking them to take the photograph earlier next time, then puts her phone away.
beats.chinese: 她笑着回复，让他们下次早点拍，再收起手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Apparently they remembered after the second helping. I'll call them later. Good seeing you.
beats.chinese: 说是添第二碗以后才想起来拍。晚点再给他们打电话。很高兴见到你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Marina Bay's lower waterfront promenade near the Helix Bridge, Aubrey Wint has paused beside the railing, leaving the walking route clear. They came for an after-work walk and some people-watching, but a friend's message has held their attention.
beats.chinese: 在滨海湾螺旋桥北端的下层临水步道上，Aubrey Wint停在栏杆旁，给通行留足了空间。原本是下班后出来散步、看看来往行人，一条朋友的消息却让他们看了好一会儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Excuse me. If a friend said you could come by any evening, would you take that literally and pick a day?
beats.chinese: 打扰一下。如果朋友说哪天晚上都可以过去，你会按字面理解，直接挑一天吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aubrey lowers their phone and looks toward you.
beats.chinese: Aubrey放低手机，看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The message says, 'Drop in any evening. We'll find a minute.' I'm considering Tuesday.
beats.chinese: 消息上说，‘哪天晚上过来都行。我们总能抽出点时间。’我正在考虑周二。

choices.english: I'd probably take that literally too.
choices.chinese: 我大概也会按字面理解。

choices.english: I'm not sure. I'll leave you to decide.
choices.chinese: 我也说不准，还是由你决定吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aubrey brings the phone closer to their glasses without holding it out for you to inspect.
beats.chinese: Aubrey把手机凑近眼镜，没有把屏幕递过来让你看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's how I read it. They haven't named a particular day.
beats.chinese: 我也是这么理解的。对方没指定哪天。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their thumb hovers over the reply box. They check a date on the screen, then return to the message.
beats.chinese: 他们的拇指悬在回复框上方，查看了一下屏幕上的日期，又回到消息页面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Tuesday is free for me. I'll say Tuesday, then.
beats.chinese: 我周二有空。那我就说周二去。

choices.english: I'd check whether Tuesday suits them first.
choices.chinese: 我会先问问对方周二方不方便。

choices.english: I'll leave you to your message. Goodbye.
choices.chinese: 那不打扰你回消息了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aubrey nods, remaining beside the railing and clear of the walking route.
beats.chinese: Aubrey点点头，仍站在栏杆旁，没有占住通行的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I haven't replied yet.
beats.chinese: 也是。我还没回复。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They lower the phone to their side and look at the people passing along the promenade.
beats.chinese: 他们把手机垂在身侧，看向步道上经过的行人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came to watch people. I've mostly watched this screen.
beats.chinese: 我是出来看人的，结果大部分时间都在看这块屏幕。

choices.english: How much people-watching have you managed?
choices.chinese: 那你到现在看了多少人？

choices.english: I'll just look at the water for a while.
choices.chinese: 我就在这儿看一会儿水。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aubrey stops typing and reads the invitation once more.
beats.chinese: Aubrey停下打字，又读了一遍邀请。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They did say any evening. But yes, Tuesday hasn't actually been agreed.
beats.chinese: 对方确实说了哪天晚上都行。不过也是，周二还没真正定下来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They type a short question about Tuesday, send it, and put the phone in their pocket. They turn toward the water.
beats.chinese: 他们打了一句询问周二是否方便的话，发送后把手机收进口袋，转身面向水面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sent. I'll leave that with them. Enjoy your evening.
beats.chinese: 发了。让对方自己看看再回吧。祝你今晚愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aubrey's attention has already returned to the reply box.
beats.chinese: Aubrey的注意力已经回到了回复框上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Tuesday evening, then. That gives them a few days.
beats.chinese: 那就周二晚上。这样也提前留了几天。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They send a message announcing the visit, then glance up as your goodbye registers. Their thumb stops above the screen.
beats.chinese: 他们发消息告知自己会去，随后才反应过来你在道别，抬起头，拇指停在屏幕上方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, goodbye. Sorry, I was reading.
beats.chinese: 哦，再见。抱歉，刚才顾着看消息了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aubrey looks along the promenade as though checking their count.
beats.chinese: Aubrey朝步道望了望，像是在核对人数。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Three. One came past twice, so I may be counting generously.
beats.chinese: 三个。有一个经过了两次，所以这个数字可能算得宽松了点。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They pocket the phone and begin walking along the same lower promenade, leaving the message unanswered.
beats.chinese: 他们收起手机，暂时没有回复消息，沿着这条下层步道继续散步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd better get a little walking done too. Good evening.
beats.chinese: 我也该正经走上几步了。祝你今晚愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aubrey stays beside the railing, leaving plenty of space between you.
beats.chinese: Aubrey留在栏杆旁，与你保持着足够的距离。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. There's plenty to look at.
beats.chinese: 当然。这里有不少可看的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They give a small nod, turn slightly away, and raise their phone again without moving closer to you.
beats.chinese: 他们轻轻点头，略微转开身，又拿起手机，没有向你靠近。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good evening to you.
beats.chinese: 祝你今晚愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the lower waterfront promenade near the Helix Bridge, Aubrey Wint has stopped to read a message. They recognise you and lift a hand.
beats.chinese: 在滨海湾螺旋桥北端的下层滨水步道，Aubrey Wint停下看消息。认出你后，他们抬了抬手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. My neighbour in Kingston is looking after my herbs while I'm here. Says the basil has taken over the step.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我在这边时，金斯敦的邻居帮忙照顾香草。说罗勒已经占领台阶了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They open the attached photograph and laugh at the leaves filling the small pot.
beats.chinese: 他们打开附图，看着小盆里挤满的叶子笑起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I asked her to use some. She says she has. I'll ask for a picture of the dinner as evidence. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 我请她随便用。她说已经用了。得让她发张晚饭照片作证。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the lower waterfront walkway near the Helix Bridge, Kumaravel Suppiah has stopped during his day-off walk to take a photo for his album. He stays beside the railing as he raises his phone for a selfie, straightening his back and pressing his lips together.
beats.chinese: 滨海湾螺旋桥北端的下层临水步道上，Kumaravel Suppiah趁休息日来散步，停下来给相册拍张照片。他一直站在栏杆旁，举起手机自拍，背一下挺直，嘴唇也抿紧了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Could you call out 'Now' for me? I'll press it myself. Without someone telling me, even my selfies look like work-pass photos.
beats.chinese: 能不能替我喊一声“拍了”？我自己按。没人提醒，我连自拍都站得像在拍工作证照片。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers his phone and his shoulders immediately relax. Still beside the railing and clear of the passing space, he turns towards you with a laugh.
beats.chinese: 他放下手机，肩膀立刻松了下来。他仍站在栏杆旁，没有占着通行的地方，笑着转向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Kumaravel, by the way. Just need a little warning, lah. No worries if you'd rather carry on.
beats.chinese: 对了，我叫Kumaravel。就是想有人提前提醒一下啦。你想继续走也没关系。

choices.english: Does that happen every time you take a photo?
choices.chinese: 你每次拍照都会这样吗？

choices.english: You just want me to say 'Now'?
choices.chinese: 只要我喊一声“拍了”就行？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kumaravel laughs, then turns his phone screen towards himself. With the camera lowered, his face is much less solemn.
beats.chinese: Kumaravel笑起来，把手机屏幕转回自己这边。镜头放低后，他的表情没那么严肃了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Every team photo. Everyone lifts the trophy, I stand like the manager has called me in.
beats.chinese: 每次球队合影都这样。别人举奖杯，我站得像被经理叫去谈话。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He starts laughing before he finishes. He raises the phone again, immediately squares his shoulders, then lowers it with a small shake of his head.
beats.chinese: 话还没说完，他自己先笑了。他再次举起手机，肩膀立刻端正起来，随后又摇摇头，把手机放下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Some colleagues try to catch me laughing. I tell them first, lah. No secret pictures. A serious one is fine with me.
beats.chinese: 有些同事专挑我笑的时候偷拍。我就跟他们说，先打个招呼啦，别偷偷拍。严肃一点的照片，我也喜欢。

choices.english: Offer to take one on his phone, wait for his cue, take a single photo, and hand the phone back.
choices.chinese: 提出用他的手机拍一张，等他示意后拍摄，再把手机还给他。

choices.english: Ask which team photos he means, then say goodbye after his answer.
choices.chinese: 问他指的是哪些球队合影，听完后道别。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kumaravel gives you a friendly nod and turns slightly towards the water. He keeps his elbows close so there is room to pass.
beats.chinese: Kumaravel友善地点点头，稍稍转向水面。他收着胳膊，留出通行的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, just that. I'll hold the phone and press it. You don't need to take anything.
beats.chinese: 对，就这样。手机我拿着，也由我来按。你不用接任何东西。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He raises his phone towards himself again. His shoulders square up and his face becomes serious, though his thumb waits beside the shutter button.
beats.chinese: 他再次举起手机对着自己。肩膀端正起来，表情也严肃了，拇指却还停在快门键旁，等着提醒。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One second, lah. Right, ready. Then I'll put the date in before this becomes another picture labelled 'sometime'.
beats.chinese: 等一秒啦。好了，准备好了。拍完就记上日期，免得又多一张只能标成“某一天”的照片。

choices.english: I'll leave you to it. Enjoy your walk.
choices.chinese: 我就不参与了。散步愉快。

choices.english: Give him the cue, then ask whether he labels his photos straight away.
choices.chinese: 喊一声提醒他拍照，然后问他是不是拍完就给照片做标注。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kumaravel hands you his phone with the camera open. He stands beside the railing, smooths his yellow shirt and plants both feet firmly.
beats.chinese: Kumaravel把打开相机的手机交给你。他站在栏杆旁，抚平黄色衬衫，两脚稳稳站好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One second, lah. Shirt first. Right, ready now. Just one.
beats.chinese: 等一秒啦。先弄好衬衫。好了，现在可以了。拍一张就行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You take one photo and return the phone. He examines his formal pose, lets out a laugh and saves the picture before putting the phone away.
beats.chinese: 你拍了一张，把手机还给他。他看着照片里端正的站姿，笑出声来，保存照片后收起手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ha! Exactly the face I expected. Keeping that one. Thanks for waiting. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 哈！果然还是这个表情。这张留着。谢谢你等我准备好。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kumaravel locks his phone and slips it into his pocket. He turns back towards you rather than setting up another picture.
beats.chinese: Kumaravel锁上手机，放进口袋，没有继续摆姿势，而是转身朝向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Local basketball teams. I fix scoreboards in indoor sports halls. Twenty-plus years, and I always stay to hear who won.
beats.chinese: 本地篮球队。我在室内体育馆修记分牌。干了二十多年，还是总想留下来听听谁赢了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He chuckles and rubs his chin. After your goodbye, he returns the farewell and turns to look across the water, leaving his phone in his pocket.
beats.chinese: 他笑着摸了摸下巴。你道别后，他也回应了一声，转身望向水面，没再掏手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sometimes I stay longer than the players. All right, take care. I'll leave the picture for another day.
beats.chinese: 有时候我比球员待得还久。好，慢走。照片改天再拍吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You decline and give him a brief wave as you continue along the walkway. Kumaravel lowers his phone to return the wave.
beats.chinese: 你婉拒了，简单挥挥手，沿步道继续走。Kumaravel放低手机，也向你挥了挥手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye! Enjoy the walk.
beats.chinese: 再见！散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes the selfie himself, enters the date and pockets his phone. Then he sets off along the walkway in the other direction.
beats.chinese: 他自己拍好自拍，输完日期，收起手机，随后沿着步道向另一边走去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good, that's saved.
beats.chinese: 好了，存好了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You give him the cue and he presses the shutter himself. He lowers the phone, relaxes his shoulders and starts entering a label. When you ask whether he always does that straight away, he pauses and looks up.
beats.chinese: 你喊了一声，他自己按下快门。他放低手机，肩膀松了下来，开始输入标注。你问他是不是每次拍完都马上标注，他停下来，抬起头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Date and place, straight away. At home I sort them into albums. Otherwise I spend Sunday asking myself which Sunday it was.
beats.chinese: 日期、地点，马上记好。回家再整理进相册。不然整个星期天都得琢磨，那到底是哪个星期天拍的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He laughs, finishes the short label and locks the screen. With the picture filed, he gives you a small farewell nod.
beats.chinese: 他笑了笑，补完简短的标注，锁上屏幕。照片整理好了，他轻轻点头，向你道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There, Marina Bay and the date. That's enough typing for a walk. Nice talking to you.
beats.chinese: 好了，滨海湾，加上日期。出来散步，字就打到这里。很高兴跟你聊聊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a later outing along the lower waterfront walkway near the Helix Bridge, Kumaravel Suppiah is browsing old photos on his phone beside the railing. He pauses on a photo of himself standing very stiffly, then looks up, recognises you and smiles.
beats.chinese: 后来一次，在滨海湾螺旋桥北端的下层临水步道上，Kumaravel Suppiah正站在栏杆旁，用手机翻看旧照片。他停在一张自己站得十分僵直的照片上，随后抬头认出你，笑了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eh, hello again! I was going to delete this one. I'm standing so stiffly. Doesn't look very good, lah. Still, that's very much me.
beats.chinese: 哎，又见面了！这张我原本想删的，站得太僵了。拍得不怎么好看啦。不过，还真像我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He adds the photo to an album for pictures he wants to keep, smiling with satisfaction. Still holding the phone himself, he looks back up at you.
beats.chinese: 他把这张照片加入专门存放想保留的照片的相册，满意地笑了笑。手机仍拿在他自己手里，他又抬头看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Every photo doesn't have to look natural, lah. As long as I recognise myself from that day, I'm happy. Good seeing you again. Take care!
beats.chinese: 不是每张都要拍得自然啦，认得出那天的自己就好。又见到你真好。保重啊！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Marina Bay's lower waterfront promenade near the Helix Bridge, Chua Ah Koon is waiting for his friend Seng before a walk. He keeps a folded umbrella upright against his side as he reads a message on his phone.
beats.chinese: 滨海湾螺旋桥北端的下层临水步道上，Chua Ah Koon正等朋友Seng一起散步。他把折伞竖着贴在身侧，读着手机上的消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A shop repaired it? I replaced this catch myself.
beats.chinese: 店里修的？这个卡扣明明是我换的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His voice is low but clear. Realizing you have heard him, he lowers his phone and turns toward you with a small smile. The umbrella stays close to his side.
beats.chinese: 他的声音不大，却很清楚。意识到你听见了，他放低手机，转向你，微微一笑。伞仍贴在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Waiting for Seng to collect his umbrella. No charge for fixing it, lah. Just want him to get the name right.
beats.chinese: 等Seng来拿他的伞。修理不收钱啦。就是得让他说对是谁修的。

choices.english: Do you often fix things for him?
choices.chinese: 你经常替他修东西吗？

choices.english: Is Seng your walking partner?
choices.chinese: Seng是跟你一起散步的朋友吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ah Koon keeps the folded umbrella upright against his side.
beats.chinese: Ah Koon仍把折伞竖着贴在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Him, neighbours, whoever brings something over. Used to inspect camping gear at a rental shop near Bukit Merah. Retired already.
beats.chinese: 他啊，邻居啊，谁拿东西过来都修。以前在红山附近一家租赁店检查露营装备，已经退休了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pockets his phone, then takes out a small notebook and checks an entry.
beats.chinese: 他收起手机，取出一本小记事本，查看其中一条记录。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Monday morning, my kitchen table. I even replaced the catch.
beats.chinese: 星期一早上，在我家厨房桌上修的。卡扣都是我换的。

choices.english: A quick message would clear that up.
choices.chinese: 发条消息就能说清楚了。

choices.english: At least the umbrella works now.
choices.chinese: 至少现在伞能用了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ah Koon checks along the promenade for Seng, keeping the umbrella close to his side.
beats.chinese: Ah Koon沿着步道张望，找着Seng，伞一直收在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Old army friend. We walk sometimes. Tuesdays we play badminton. He usually beats me.
beats.chinese: 老战友了。有时一起走走。星期二打羽毛球，他通常赢我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He presses his lips together, then raises one finger.
beats.chinese: 他抿了抿嘴，又竖起一根手指。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Usually. I still win points. He likes to tell the score very quickly.
beats.chinese: 通常而已。我也有得分的。他报比分的时候倒是讲得特别快。

choices.english: You sound very sure about your points.
choices.chinese: 自己得了哪些分，你好像记得很清楚。

choices.english: Enjoy your walk together. I'll keep going.
choices.chinese: 祝你们散步愉快。我继续往前走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ah Koon opens the message and types slowly with one thumb.
beats.chinese: Ah Koon点开消息，用一根拇指慢慢打字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah Koon replaced the catch. Monday morning. There, short enough.
beats.chinese: Ah Koon换的卡扣。星期一早上。好了，够简短。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sends it, puts his phone and notebook away, and gives you a small nod.
beats.chinese: 他发出消息，收起手机和记事本，朝你轻轻点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No charge for the repair. Just get the name right, lah. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 修理不收钱。把是谁修的说对就行啦。慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ah Koon holds his notebook open with his thumb. His voice becomes slower and more precise.
beats.chinese: Ah Koon用拇指压着摊开的记事本，说话慢了下来，字字清楚。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It works because I replaced the catch. Seng can give me credit for that too. Only takes a few words.
beats.chinese: 能用了，是因为我换了卡扣。Seng也可以说清楚这是我修的。又没几个字。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He adds a short note, pockets the book, and shifts a few steps along the railing to continue waiting.
beats.chinese: 他补记了几个字，把本子放回口袋，沿栏杆挪开几步，继续等人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll tell him myself when he gets here. Anyway, don't let me keep you.
beats.chinese: 等他到了，我自己跟他说。好了，不耽误你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ah Koon's mouth opens into a grin. He holds up two fingers.
beats.chinese: Ah Koon咧嘴笑了，举起两根手指。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Two clean serves he couldn't return on Tuesday. Lost the game, yes. Those two points were mine.
beats.chinese: 星期二有两个发球，他干干净净地没接到。比赛是输了，没错。那两分可是我的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers his hand and turns back toward the stretch of promenade he has been watching.
beats.chinese: 他放下手，重新望向刚才一直留意的那段步道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enough badminton talk. My shoulder gets tired just remembering. Have a good walk, ah.
beats.chinese: 羽毛球就讲到这里。光回想，肩膀都累了。慢慢逛啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ah Koon nods as you continue along the promenade.
beats.chinese: 你继续沿步道往前走，Ah Koon向你点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. Take care, ah.
beats.chinese: 你也逛得愉快。慢走啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns toward the water, keeping the folded umbrella upright against his side.
beats.chinese: 他转向水面，仍把折伞竖着贴在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll wait here for Seng. He knows where to find me.
beats.chinese: 我就在这里等Seng。他知道来哪里找我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the lower waterfront promenade near the Helix Bridge, Chua Ah Koon recognises you while checking a message beside the railing.
beats.chinese: 在滨海湾螺旋桥北端的下层滨水步道，Chua Ah Koon站在栏杆旁看消息时认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eh, hello again. Seng asked me to lunch. Says nothing needs fixing. I checked.
beats.chinese: 哎，又见面了。Seng约我吃午饭。说没东西要修。我特意问过了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He reads the reply and chuckles, then slips his phone into his pocket.
beats.chinese: 他看完回复笑起来，把手机放进口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He says just come hungry. That part I can manage. Good seeing you.
beats.chinese: 他说空着肚子来就行。这个我办得到。很高兴见到你。

causality.presenceReason: 他已约好在这里把修好的伞还给老战友Seng，再一起散步，因此在玩家出现前就在等人。
causality.placeAttitude: 把临水步道当作普通的会合与散步地点，注意力主要在朋友和手中的伞上。
causality.stayingConstraint: 会合地点已经约定，Seng尚未到，他暂时留在这一段步道等候。
causality.currentGoal: 归还修好的伞，随后与Seng散步。读到修理被归功于店铺的消息后，也想把修理者是谁说清楚。
causality.currentState: 原本心情平常，看到署名错误才认真计较。他意识到附近的玩家听见后，仍温和解释，愿意简短交谈，也能随玩家选择转谈老朋友和羽毛球。
causality.contactTrigger: 折伞始终竖着贴在身侧。他读到Seng把修理归功于店铺的消息，低声却清楚地指出卡扣是自己换的。发现玩家听见后，他主动解释正在等朋友领伞，维修免费，但修理不能算错人。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留免费替人修东西、敏感署名、随身记录、羽毛球逐分计账与退休装备检查员职业。重逢与朋友相约普通午饭，无需再以一次准确感谢重复初遇。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa接受简短澄清的建议，发消息纠正后结束交谈。ab面对淡化贡献的回应，明确坚持署名，指出Seng可以说清楚卡扣是他修的，记下一笔并挪开等候。ba具体列出自己赢的两分，笑着收住话题。bb尊重玩家离开，告别后留在原处等Seng，不再提衣袖或物件险些碰人的事故。
causality.spatialContinuity: 初遇与重逢都在滨海湾螺旋桥北端下层滨水步道。初遇的伞保持竖直贴身，其他自带物是手机与本子。重逢仅读手机消息后收机，无需进入其他街区或新增设施。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Chua Ah Koon。本次重逢位于滨海湾步道，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Bondi's rocky shore, Tegan Marsh stands safely beside the route along the coast, looking across the bay. She has a folded jacket under her arm and a bag at her side.
beats.chinese: 在邦迪岩岸，Tegan Marsh站在沿岸路径旁的安全位置，望着海湾。她臂下夹着折好的外套，包收在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd like to move a little this way to see the whole bay. I'll leave this bit of the path clear for you.
beats.chinese: 我想往这边挪一点，看全海湾。这段路我给你留着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She shifts a little along the safe edge of the route, keeping her bag and jacket close to her side, then turns towards you.
beats.chinese: 她沿路径的安全边缘挪了一点，把包和外套收在身侧，然后转向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Tegan. Came out for a good look at the bay.
beats.chinese: 我叫Tegan，特意过来好好看看海湾。

choices.english: No rush. I've stopped for the view too.
choices.chinese: 不着急，我也停下来看看风景。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll keep going.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，我继续往前走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tegan turns slightly towards you, keeping her bag and jacket close to her side. The bay remains open in front of you both.
beats.chinese: Tegan稍稍转向你，把包和外套都收在身侧。你们面前是开阔的海湾。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's the whole curve I like. I could spend ages looking across that.
beats.chinese: 我喜欢的是海湾整个弧形的轮廓。这样望过去，我能看好久。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She follows the shoreline with her eyes, then flexes the fingers of her free hand.
beats.chinese: 她的目光沿着海岸线移过去，又活动了一下空着那只手的手指。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I make tiny plants for architectural models. After a week of little leaves, I wanted a bigger view.
beats.chinese: 我给建筑模型做微型植物。做了一星期的小叶子，就想看看开阔一点的景色。

choices.english: I'll take in the whole bay for a moment.
choices.chinese: 那我也看看整个海湾。

choices.english: I'll leave you to your big view. Enjoy it!
choices.chinese: 那就不打扰你看大风景了。慢慢欣赏！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tegan stays to one side as you continue along the route.
beats.chinese: 你继续沿路前行，Tegan留在一侧，没有挡路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No worries. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 没事，散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She reaches into her bag, checks one pocket, then another. Her sunglasses are resting on top of her head.
beats.chinese: 她伸手翻包，摸了一个口袋，又摸另一个。她的太阳镜就架在头顶上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now, where did those glasses go?
beats.chinese: 咦，眼镜放哪儿去了？

choices.english: They're on your head.
choices.chinese: 在你头顶上。

choices.english: Give a small wave and keep walking.
choices.chinese: 轻轻挥手，继续往前走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You pause to take in the bay. Tegan looks from one end of its curve to the other, her jacket held securely under her arm.
beats.chinese: 你停下来看看海湾。Tegan的目光从弧形海岸的一端移向另一端，外套稳稳地夹在臂下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's a good size for an afternoon off. I like a big old fig tree for the same reason.
beats.chinese: 休息的下午，就适合看这么大的景物。我喜欢高大的老榕树，也是这个原因。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A wave breaks against the nearer rocks, covering the end of her sentence. She laughs and turns her attention back to the water.
beats.chinese: 一阵浪拍在近处岩石上，盖住了她最后几个字。她笑了笑，把注意力转回海面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Can't compete with that. I'll let you have a look without me talking over it.
beats.chinese: 可说不过这声音。我就不在旁边叨叨了，你好好看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You say goodbye. Tegan shifts the folded jacket into a firmer hold and turns towards you.
beats.chinese: 你向她道别。Tegan把折起的外套抱稳，转过脸来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. Hope you get a good stretch of coast.
beats.chinese: 谢啦，祝你接下来这段海岸走得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives you a brief wave, then faces the bay again, with all her belongings clear of the route.
beats.chinese: 她朝你简短地挥了挥手，重新面向海湾，随身物品都收在通行路线之外。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll be here a bit longer, I reckon.
beats.chinese: 我估计还会在这儿多看一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tegan stops searching her bag and touches the top of her head.
beats.chinese: Tegan停下翻包的动作，伸手摸了摸头顶。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, brilliant. Carried them all this way and lost them on myself.
beats.chinese: 哦，真行。一路带过来，结果丢在自己身上了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pulls the sunglasses down over her eyes and closes her bag, laughing at herself.
beats.chinese: 她把太阳镜拉下来戴好，合上包，自己先笑了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks for that. I was about to unpack the whole bag. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 谢谢啊，我差点要把整包东西都掏出来。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You give a small wave and continue along the coast. Tegan returns the wave without trying to stop you.
beats.chinese: 你轻轻挥手，继续沿海岸前行。Tegan也挥手回应，没有叫住你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: See you.
beats.chinese: 回见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes the bag and pushes a loose strand of hair back. Her fingers catch the sunglasses on her head.
beats.chinese: 她合上包，伸手把一缕散发拨回去，手指碰到了头顶的太阳镜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah. There you are.
beats.chinese: 啊，原来在这儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another outing at Bondi's rocky shore, Tegan is standing clear of the coastal route, watching waves strike the rocks. She recognises you and smiles.
beats.chinese: 在邦迪岩岸，Tegan正站在沿岸路径之外，看海浪拍打岩石。她认出了你，笑了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello! Good to see you. I was about to head back, then the waves got interesting.
beats.chinese: 哦，你好！很高兴见到你。我本来准备回去了，结果这几道浪又挺好看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns towards the route, then looks back as another wave breaks against the rocks. She stays out of the way.
beats.chinese: 她转向路径，另一道浪拍上岩石时，又回头看了一眼，脚下仍留在不挡路的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One more. That's what I said three waves ago.
beats.chinese: 再看一道。三道浪之前，我说的也是这句。

causality.presenceReason: Tegan做了一周建筑模型微型植物，特意来邦迪岩岸看开阔海湾。

causality.currentState: 今天轻松健谈，注意力主要在远处海湾，容易忽略身边的小物件。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the shore path at Bondi, Declan Vos has paused during a coastal walk to straighten his shoulder bag's strap. He keeps it in front of him, smoothing the front with his thumb.
beats.chinese: 邦迪岸边的步道上，Declan Vos 散步走到这里，正停下来理顺挎包背带。他始终把背带收在身前，用拇指压平正面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi, could you check if there's still a fold at the back of this strap? No worries if you'd rather not. I'm Declan.
beats.chinese: 嗨，能替我看一眼这条背带背面还有没有一折？不方便也没事。我叫 Declan。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns slightly so you can see the back of the strap, keeping the bag against his side and the passing space clear.
beats.chinese: 他稍稍转身，让你能看见背带背面，包仍贴在身侧，也没有占住通行的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got the front flat. Can't quite see the back from here.
beats.chinese: 正面已经压平了。背面我这个角度看不太清。

choices.english: Sure, I'll have a look.
choices.chinese: 可以，我看一眼。

choices.english: No worries. I'm going to look at the bay.
choices.chinese: 没事。我想看看海湾。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You look at the back of the strap. One edge is still folded under. Declan follows your glance, holding the bag close to his side.
beats.chinese: 你看了看背带背面，一侧边缘还折在里面。Declan 顺着你的目光看过去，包仍收在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I repair car seat fabric. Used an offcut for this strap. It's soft enough, but the folded edge keeps turning under.
beats.chinese: 我是修汽车座椅面料的，用了块边角料做这条背带。软是够软，可折边老往里卷。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the edge out, releases it, then immediately catches it again. He starts another explanation before noticing his own hands.
beats.chinese: 他把边缘翻出来，刚松手，又立刻捏住。他接着解释，随后才留意到自己一直没停下的双手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It makes a little ridge against your shoulder. Like a sock seam. Listen to me. You asked about a strap and got the whole repair report.
beats.chinese: 它会在肩膀上硌出一道小棱，像袜子的接缝。瞧我这话多的，你就问了条背带，我把维修报告都讲出来了。

choices.english: I'll leave you to sort it out. Enjoy your walk.
choices.chinese: 那你慢慢弄。散步愉快。

choices.english: Leave it for now. Let's look at the waves.
choices.chinese: 先别管它了。看看海浪吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You turn toward the bay. Declan keeps the strap close to himself and turns it over to check the back.
beats.chinese: 你转向海湾。Declan 把背带收在身前，自己翻过来查看背面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah, go on. Plenty to look at.
beats.chinese: 好啊，你看。这里可有得看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes a water bottle from his bag and unscrews the lid, keeping both the bag and his elbows close.
beats.chinese: 他从包里拿出水瓶，拧开瓶盖，包和胳膊都收在身边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Came out for a decent walk. So far I've mostly stood here fiddling.
beats.chinese: 本来是出来好好走走的，结果到现在大半时间都站在这里瞎摆弄。

choices.english: Enjoy your walk. I'll stay here.
choices.chinese: 散步愉快。我在这儿待一会儿。

choices.english: I'm heading on. Take your time.
choices.chinese: 我继续往前走了。你慢慢来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You leave Declan to his bag. He gives the twisted edge one more look, then folds the loose end beneath the strap.
beats.chinese: 你准备离开，让 Declan 自己处理挎包。他又看了一眼拧着的边缘，把松垂的一端折进背带下面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. It'll get me home like that.
beats.chinese: 谢了。这样撑到家没问题。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He settles the bag against his hip and drops his hands. As you move on, he stays beside the path to check that the folded end holds.
beats.chinese: 他把包挪到胯侧，放下双手。你继续走时，他留在步道边，看看折进去的带尾会不会再松出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And that's enough of the strap report. Have a good one.
beats.chinese: 背带报告就到这儿了。祝你玩得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You turn toward the waves together. Declan lets the imperfect fold go and slides the bag behind his hip.
beats.chinese: 你们一起转向海浪。Declan 松开那道没理平的折痕，把包挪到胯后。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah, fair call. I can fiddle with that at home.
beats.chinese: 也是，听你的。回家再摆弄就行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A wave spreads white water across the nearby rocks. He watches it drain away, then takes a step along the path with his hands free.
beats.chinese: 一道浪把白色水沫铺上近处的岩面。他看着水退下去，随后沿步道迈出一步，双手终于空了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nearly missed that one. Right, I'll get some walking done. Enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 差点错过这一道浪。好了，我也该走走了。你好好看风景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You stay facing the bay while Declan takes a drink and puts his bottle away.
beats.chinese: 你留在原地面向海湾，Declan 喝了口水，把瓶子放回包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. Reckon I'll actually use my legs now.
beats.chinese: 谢了。这回总该让腿动起来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He settles the bag securely, checks the passing space and resumes his walk along the shore path.
beats.chinese: 他背稳挎包，看清身边通行的位置，继续沿岸边步道散步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: See you around. Enjoy the bay.
beats.chinese: 回头见。好好看看海湾吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the path. Declan remains to one side with his open water bottle.
beats.chinese: 你沿步道继续向前。Declan 拿着打开的水瓶，留在一旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Will do. I've finally remembered I brought water.
beats.chinese: 好。我可算想起自己还带了水。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lifts the bottle in a small farewell and takes a drink. His other hand rests on the bag without adjusting it.
beats.chinese: 他稍稍举起水瓶道别，喝了一口。另一只手搭在包上，没有再调整背带。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Catch you around. Have a good walk.
beats.chinese: 有缘再见。走得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Bondi's shore path, you see Declan drinking water beside the path, clear of passing walkers. He recognises you and lowers his bottle.
beats.chinese: 在邦迪岸边步道，你看见 Declan 在步道旁喝水，没有挡住过路的人。他认出了你，放下水瓶。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hey. Good to see you. I've had enough of a walk today. Just about ready to head back.
beats.chinese: 哦，嗨。见到你真好。今天已经走够了，正准备回去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the bottle away in his bag and stays beside the path a little longer, looking across the bay.
beats.chinese: 他把水瓶收进包里，仍在步道旁站了一会儿，望着海湾。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That was a good walk. Happy to leave it there for today. See you around.
beats.chinese: 今天走得挺舒服，到这儿就够了。回头见。

causality.presenceReason: Declan 原本就在邦迪沿岸散步，玩家到来前已停下整理自己挎包的背带。
causality.placeAttitude: 他喜欢沿海散步，却因对贴身物件触感的在意，暂时把注意力从海景移到背带上。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须久留的任务，只想把背带收妥再继续走，并始终让出通行空间。
causality.currentGoal: 背带正面已经压平，他想确认自己看不清的背面是否仍有折痕，处理妥当后继续原定的散步。
causality.currentState: 心情放松，手上有些停不下来。他为确认背带背面的折痕向近处玩家提出有限请求，允许玩家不参与，并非主动寻找听众。
causality.contactTrigger: 背带始终收在 Declan 身前。他看不清背面的折痕，请近处玩家帮忙看一眼，并明确表示不方便也没事。他不递包、不要求触摸，也没有物件侵入玩家空间或道歉事故。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留汽车座椅面料修补职业、对柔软度和接缝的敏感、热情过度解释及尊重别人兴趣边界的习惯。玩家愿意查看后，他才兴致上来解释背带的材料和触感。重逢保留他喜欢沿海散步的一面，让他在走够之后自然满足，无须每次都整理物件或解释手艺。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家答应查看时，看见背带背面的一侧边缘仍折在里面，Declan 随之解释材料与触感，并察觉自己讲多了。玩家选择看海湾时，他接受并自行查看背带，随后拿水喝。aa 中玩家告别，他收住长篇说明，留下处理带尾。ab 中玩家邀他看浪，他放下调整，观看后继续散步。ba 中玩家留下，他喝水后先走。bb 中玩家先走，他留在一旁喝水，不再摆弄背带。重逢时他在喝水间认出玩家，说明今天已走够、准备回去，收好水后再看一会儿海湾，温和道别。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程位于照片所示邦迪岩岸旁的往来步道，背带与挎包始终由 Declan 收在身前或身侧，不占通行空间。海湾、岩面与海浪用于观察，不进入湿滑岩面，不新增设施。重逢也只在同一岸边路径旁喝水、站立看海，并保持通行空间。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Declan Vos。本次重逢位于邦迪海岸，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

reviewEvidence: 结构校验、模型复核与正式编辑批准分别记录；本条保持草稿状态。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Bondi's rocky shore, Jules Ngata stands clear of the walking route, eating a biscuit and looking across the bay. As you come alongside, a wave breaks over the nearby rocks, well away from where you both stand.
beats.chinese: 邦迪岩岸边，Jules Ngata站在不挡路的位置，吃着饼干，望着海湾。你来到他旁边时，一道浪拍上近处的岩面，离你们站的位置还很远。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I thought the last one was the biggest. Spoke too soon. I'm Jules, by the way.
beats.chinese: 我还以为刚才那道最大。说早了。对了，我叫Jules。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds his biscuit packet shut and puts it securely in his pocket, keeping the biscuit in his other hand. Another wave breaks, and he glances toward it.
beats.chinese: 他把饼干袋口折好，稳稳收进口袋，另一只手仍拿着饼干。又一道浪拍下来，他朝那边看了一眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That one sounded bigger, anyway. I've stopped eating just to listen. Biscuit's getting neglected.
beats.chinese: 反正那一下听着更大。我光顾着听，连饼干都不吃了。把它冷落了。

choices.english: Do sounds like that interest you?
choices.chinese: 你对这样的声音很感兴趣吗？

choices.english: No worries. I was just going to...
choices.chinese: 没关系。我正打算……

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jules looks toward the rocks again, briefly giving the waves more attention than his biscuit.
beats.chinese: Jules又朝岩面看去，一时顾着听浪，把饼干晾在了一边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Dangerously interesting. I've got a box of odd rattles and squeaky things at home. Very little of it belongs in a kitchen.
beats.chinese: 有意思得有点危险。我家有一盒各种会咔啦响、吱吱叫的怪东西。里面没几样适合放在厨房。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He reaches toward the pocket holding the packet, then catches himself and brings his empty hand back down.
beats.chinese: 他伸手去摸装着包装袋的口袋，随即意识到自己的动作，又把空着的手放了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nearly got the packet out again. Once I start wondering what something sounds like, my hands get ahead of me.
beats.chinese: 差点又把袋子拿出来了。一琢磨什么东西能发出什么声音，我的手就先动起来了。

choices.english: What's the strangest thing in that box?
choices.chinese: 那盒子里最奇怪的东西是什么？

choices.english: Sounds like you're working even on a walk.
choices.chinese: 听着像是散步时也在工作。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jules answers before you can finish. He draws his biscuit close to his chest.
beats.chinese: 你还没说完，Jules就接了话，同时把拿着饼干的手收到了胸前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Keep walking? Yep, I'll shift.
beats.chinese: 接着走？好，我让一下。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes a small step farther from the walking route, then stops and looks back at you.
beats.chinese: 他又往远离通行路线的方向挪了一小步，随后停住，回头看你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hang on. I finished your sentence for you. Sorry. What were you actually going to say?
beats.chinese: 等等。我替你把话说完了。抱歉。你原本想说什么？

choices.english: I meant stop here and look at the bay. You're not in the way.
choices.chinese: 我是想停在这里看看海湾。你没挡路。

choices.english: Yes, I'm carrying on along the path. Thanks.
choices.chinese: 对，我要沿着这条路继续走。谢谢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jules holds his biscuit halfway to his mouth while considering the contents of his collection.
beats.chinese: Jules把饼干举到嘴边，停在半途，想了想自己的收藏。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A loose plastic eye from an old toy. It rattles. Horrible thing to find when you're looking for a bottle opener.
beats.chinese: 旧玩具上掉下来的一只塑料眼睛，摇起来会响。找开瓶器时翻到那玩意儿，可真够吓人的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He laughs, finishes the biscuit and lowers his hand. He stays beside the route, turning back toward the bay.
beats.chinese: 他笑了，吃完饼干，把手放下来。他留在路旁，重新转向海湾。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That one's staying in the box. Anyway, I'll let you enjoy the view. Nice talking to you.
beats.chinese: 那东西还是老实待在盒子里吧。好了，不耽误你看风景。聊得挺开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jules lowers the biscuit and gives a small shake of his head.
beats.chinese: Jules放低饼干，轻轻摇了摇头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, no recording today. I make sound effects for radio drama. Work stays at the studio. I'm just eating a biscuit.
beats.chinese: 哦，今天不录音。我是给广播剧做音效的。工作留在录音室里。我这会儿就是吃块饼干。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He eats the last bite and turns along the walking route, away from the water's edge.
beats.chinese: 他吃完最后一口，转身沿着通行路线走去，与水边保持着距离。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, back to the walking part. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 好了，接下来该散步了。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Jules stops moving aside. There is already room beside the route for both of you to stand without obstructing anyone.
beats.chinese: Jules不再往旁边挪了。路旁原本就有空间让你们各自站着，不妨碍别人通行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah, looking. Got it. You can finish your own sentences from here.
beats.chinese: 啊，看海。明白了。接下来你的话都由你自己说完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives an apologetic grin, turns slightly away to leave you space and finally takes a bite of his biscuit.
beats.chinese: 他带着歉意笑了笑，稍稍侧过身给你留出空间，终于咬了一口饼干。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy the bay. I'll get back to this before I forget why I'm holding it.
beats.chinese: 慢慢看海吧。我得继续吃了，免得忘了自己拿着它是干什么的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The route ahead remains clear. Jules stays out of it as you continue along the shore.
beats.chinese: 前方的路是通畅的。你沿着岸边继续走，Jules留在不挡路的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Thanks for saying it yourself.
beats.chinese: 好。谢谢你自己把话说完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lifts the biscuit in a brief farewell, then turns back toward the bay rather than following.
beats.chinese: 他举了举饼干，简短地道别，随后转回去看海湾，没有跟上来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy your walk. I've got a bit of lunch to finish. Well, one biscuit.
beats.chinese: 散步愉快。我还有点午饭要解决。好吧，就是一块饼干。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Bondi's rocky shore, Jules Ngata stands beside the safe walking route, clear of passing people. His phone shows the booking page for his next beginner surfing lesson. He recognises you and raises his free hand.
beats.chinese: 邦迪岩岸边，Jules Ngata站在安全通行路径旁，不妨碍来往的人。他的手机停在下一次初级冲浪课的报名页面上。他认出你，抬起空着的那只手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. Been hovering over this booking for a while. The longer I wait, the more ways I find to embarrass myself. Haven't even got in the water yet.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。我对着这报名页面犹豫好一阵了。等得越久，越能想出自己会怎么丢脸。这还没下水呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks down, completes the booking himself and checks the confirmation. Then he pockets his phone and looks up with a quick grin.
beats.chinese: 他低下头，自行完成报名，查看了确认信息。随后他把手机收进口袋，抬起头咧嘴一笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Booked. Just a walk today. I'll save getting scared about the next lesson for when I'm actually there.
beats.chinese: 报好了。今天先散步，不提前把下一堂课吓完。

causality.presenceReason: Jules原本独自来邦迪岸边散步，在玩家出现前已停在路旁吃随身带的饼干。
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢在这里散步看海，今天属于休息时间，没有采音或工作任务。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有硬性等待任务，只想先吃完饼干再走，始终给岸边往来路线留出空间。
causality.currentGoal: 吃完短暂休息时拿出的饼干，然后继续散步。
causality.currentState: 今天轻松、愿意搭话，听浪时暂时忘了吃饼干，接话也比听完对方更快。
causality.contactTrigger: 玩家来到旁边时，一道浪拍上近处岩面。Jules脱口评论自己刚才误以为上一道浪最大，随后向玩家介绍自己。双方始终站在远离浪打岩面的安全位置，包装袋正常折好收进口袋，不以噪声或致歉触发接触。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留广播剧拟音师职业、奇怪发声物收藏、快嘴自嘲和抢先行动的习惯。声音兴趣可由海浪话题自然展开，职业仅在玩家提到工作后说明。抢接玩家未完的话显露急躁，不把休闲变成工作任务。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa聊到收藏中的塑料眼睛，吃完后留在原处看海并结束交谈。ab回应玩家关于工作的猜测，说明职业及休息时不工作的边界，随后继续散步。ba接受玩家纠正，留出空间吃饼干，不再接话。bb让玩家继续通行，自己留在岸边道别。
