beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: In the covered aisles of Queen Victoria Market, Billie Hartnett is checking a package against handwritten pillow measurements beside a household-goods stall. She came to replace some ill-fitting pillowcases. With her tote held close to her side, she looks up toward you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在维多利亚女王市场的棚内，Billie Hartnett 正站在日用品摊旁，对照手写的枕头尺寸核对一件商品的包装。她来替换几只不合尺寸的枕套。她把布袋收在身侧，抬头看向站在附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've measured the pillows this time. Finally, I don't have to guess what 'standard' means.
beats.chinese: 这次我量过枕头了，终于不用猜“标准”是什么意思。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her tote stays close to her side as she glances at the paper with a pleased little smile.
beats.chinese: 她的布袋始终收在身侧。她看了看纸条，露出一点得意的笑容。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Billie, by the way. I trusted the word 'standard' far too much on my previous attempt.
beats.chinese: 对了，我叫 Billie。上回买的时候，我实在太相信“标准尺寸”这几个字了。

choices.english: What happened with the standard ones?
choices.chinese: 那些标准尺寸的枕套怎么了？

choices.english: Are you nearly finished shopping?
choices.chinese: 你快买完了吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Billie turns toward you, keeping herself and her bag beside the stall and clear of the central aisle.
beats.chinese: Billie 转向你，自己和袋子都留在摊位旁，没有占着中央通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Too short. I checked the receipt, then the label, then finally the actual pillows. A very thorough investigation in the wrong order.
beats.chinese: 太短了。我先查收据，再查标签，最后才量枕头。调查得很仔细，顺序完全反了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She unfolds the paper once, then again. Two measurements occupy one corner of a much larger page.
beats.chinese: 她把纸展开一折，又展开一折。整张大纸上，两组尺寸只占了一个角。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Length, width, and a reminder on the back. I've somehow made buying pillowcases require two sides of paper.
beats.chinese: 长、宽，背面还有一条提醒。我居然把买枕套这件事写满了纸的正反两面。

choices.english: What's important enough to go on the back?
choices.chinese: 什么提醒这么重要，还得写到背面？

choices.english: I'll skip the full report, but good luck. Bye, Billie.
choices.chinese: 完整报告我就不听了，不过祝你顺利。再见，Billie。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Billie looks from her paper to the household goods, then back to the paper.
beats.chinese: Billie 从纸条看到摊上的日用品，又低头看回纸条。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I haven't bought anything yet. I only need pillowcases, but I've already looked at tea towels twice.
beats.chinese: 还什么都没买呢。我只需要枕套，可是已经看了两遍擦碗布了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the page into a smaller rectangle, leaving the measurements visible.
beats.chinese: 她把纸折成小小的长方形，只露出尺寸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One thing on the list. I thought that would make this quicker.
beats.chinese: 清单上就一样东西。我原以为这样会快一点。

choices.english: I'll let you concentrate. Bye, Billie. Continue along the aisle.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你专心挑了。再见，Billie。沿通道继续走。

choices.english: Could you find a pair that size for me too?
choices.chinese: 你能顺便也帮我找一对这个尺寸的吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Billie turns the page over. Three heavily underlined words sit in the middle.
beats.chinese: Billie 把纸翻过来。纸中央写着三个画了重重下划线的词。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Check packet quantity. I also managed to buy one pillowcase for two pillows. That was a separate discovery.
beats.chinese: 核对包装数量。我还成功地给两个枕头只买了一个枕套。那是另一次发现。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She laughs at the large sheet, folds it down to pocket size, and turns her attention to the packaged household goods.
beats.chinese: 她看着那张大纸笑了，把它折到能放进口袋的大小，然后把注意力转向摊上带包装的日用品。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, you've now heard the entire case history. I'll check the packets. Nice talking to you.
beats.chinese: 好了，全部案情你都听完了。我去核对包装。很高兴和你聊聊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Billie stops with one corner of the page lifted, then gives a quick, amused nod.
beats.chinese: Billie 正掀起纸的一角，听完便停住了，带着笑意点点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. That was becoming a surprisingly long answer about pillowcases.
beats.chinese: 当然可以。一个关于枕套的回答，居然被我说了这么长。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the paper without showing the reverse and resumes checking the goods beside her.
beats.chinese: 她没有再展示背面的内容，把纸折好，继续查看身旁的商品。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Hope you enjoy the market. Bye!
beats.chinese: 谢谢。祝你逛得愉快。再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the central aisle, Billie stays beside the household-goods stall.
beats.chinese: 你沿中央通道继续走，Billie 留在日用品摊旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Bye!
beats.chinese: 谢谢。再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives a brief wave, lowers her hand, and checks her measurements against a package label.
beats.chinese: 她简短地挥挥手，放下手后，拿纸上的尺寸核对一件商品的包装标签。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Pillowcases. Yes. That's what I came for.
beats.chinese: 枕套。对。我就是来买这个的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Billie pauses with the folded measurements in her hand. Her smile remains, but she shakes her head.
beats.chinese: Billie 拿着折好的尺寸纸条停了一下。她仍然笑着，但摇了摇头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll stick to my own shopping today, sorry.
beats.chinese: 不好意思，今天我就只买自己的东西了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips the measurements into her tote's outer pocket and turns back toward the goods, keeping the bag close.
beats.chinese: 她把尺寸纸条塞进布袋外侧的口袋，转身继续看商品，袋子始终收在身边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hope you find what you need. I'll get on with mine.
beats.chinese: 希望你能找到需要的东西。我接着挑我的了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: In the covered aisles of Queen Victoria Market, you see Billie beside a household-goods stall, holding a shopping record she has finished checking. She looks up and recognises you.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到维多利亚女王市场棚内，你看见 Billie 站在日用品摊旁，拿着已经核对好的购物记录。她抬头认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello! I've got everything I came for today, and I'm still within my budget.
beats.chinese: 啊，你好！今天要买的都买齐了，而且还在我的预算里。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the record and puts it in her tote without reading out the individual amounts. She looks pleased and gives you a smile.
beats.chinese: 她把记录折好放进布袋，没有逐项报出金额。她一脸满足，朝你笑了笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll spare you the calculations this time. I'll let you get on with looking around.
beats.chinese: 具体怎么算的我先不展开，你也逛你的。

causality.presenceReason: Billie 在玩家出现前已到 棚内日用品摊，带着枕头尺寸，准备购买枕套来替换先前不合尺寸的枕套。
causality.placeAttitude: 她把采购当作值得认真完成的小事，也会被其他日用品吸引。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须久留的外部约束，她尚未核对完尺寸与包装数量，自愿继续挑选。
causality.currentGoal: 买到尺寸合适、数量正确的枕套，避免重复之前的失误。
causality.currentState: 今天心情轻快，对事先量尺寸颇为得意，忍不住向附近的人分享，也容易把简单回答说得过长。
causality.contactTrigger: 她在 棚内日用品摊旁对照尺寸核对包装，主动向附近的玩家宣布自己这次量过枕头，终于不用猜标准尺寸的含义。略不合时宜但真诚的小成就分享本身促成交流，没有擦碰或其他身体侵入，布袋始终收在身侧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the upper gallery overlooking the State Library of Victoria's La Trobe Reading Room, Robin Castellano is practising the room's name in a small notebook. They came for a quiet look at the room. You are nearby on the same gallery.
beats.chinese: 在维多利亚州立图书馆俯瞰拉筹伯阅览室的上层书廊，Robin Castellano正拿着小本子，练写阅览室的名字。他们原本是来安静看看这间阅览室的。你就在同层书廊的附近。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Excuse me. Could I check something?
beats.chinese: 打扰一下。能确认件事吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin keeps the notebook close against their chest, clear of the view and the passage. They lower their voice without stepping closer.
beats.chinese: Robin始终把本子收在胸前，没有挡住视线或通道。他们没有走近，只是压低了声音。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: La Trobe. There's a space in the middle, isn't there?
beats.chinese: La Trobe，中间留空格，对吧？

choices.english: Yes, there's a space. What are you writing it for?
choices.chinese: 对，中间有空格。你写这个是做什么用的？

choices.english: Yes, there's a space.
choices.chinese: 对，中间有空格。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Keeping the notebook close, Robin tilts it just enough to show two handwritten words, La Trobe.
beats.chinese: Robin仍把本子收在身前，只稍稍倾斜，露出手写的两个词，La Trobe。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Practising a heading. I check rail timetables part-time. Hard to leave the spacing alone.
beats.chinese: 练个标题。我兼职检查铁路时刻表的可读性。总忍不住盯着间距看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their finger hovers over the gap between the words, then moves to the capital T.
beats.chinese: 他们的手指停在两个词的空隙上方，接着移向大写字母T。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Too much space there. And that T needs a shorter top. Then the whole line—
beats.chinese: 这里空得太多。那个T上面一横也得短一点。这样整行就——

choices.english: I only meant what the notebook was for.
choices.chinese: 我只是想知道这个本子是做什么用的。

choices.english: I'd leave it uneven. I like it that way.
choices.chinese: 我会留着这种不齐整的样子。我挺喜欢的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin gives a small nod and looks down at the words in the notebook.
beats.chinese: Robin轻轻点头，低头看了看本子上的字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I'm trying out the spacing.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我在试字距。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They shut the notebook and hold it at their side, then turn towards the reading room below.
beats.chinese: 他们合上本子，垂手拿在身侧，随后转向下方的阅览室。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll have a look at the room now.
beats.chinese: 我现在看看阅览室。

choices.english: I'll look from here. I'd prefer no chat, thanks.
choices.chinese: 我就在这里看看。想安静待着，谢谢。

choices.english: I'm just passing. You can keep that spot. Continue along the gallery.
choices.chinese: 我只是路过。你留在这里就好。沿书廊继续走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin's finger stops above the page. They lower the notebook.
beats.chinese: Robin的手指停在纸页上方，随后放低本子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. A lettering notebook. That was the short answer.
beats.chinese: 对。练手写字的本子。简短回答就该是这个。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin closes it, puts it in their coat pocket and turns towards the reading room below.
beats.chinese: Robin合上本子，装进外套口袋，转身看向下方的阅览室。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came up for a look. Better get round to it. Enjoy your visit.
beats.chinese: 我本来是上来参观的。也该看看了。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin looks at the heading again. Their raised eyebrow stays raised.
beats.chinese: Robin又看了一眼标题，挑起的眉毛没有放下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I don't like it. I'll do mine again.
beats.chinese: 我不喜欢。我这个得重写。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn to a fresh page and begin a new heading, keeping the notebook close.
beats.chinese: 他们翻到空白页，重新写起标题，仍把本子收在身前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Anyway, thanks for saying what you thought. Enjoy the room.
beats.chinese: 不过，谢谢你说实话。慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You stay to look down into the reading room. Robin gives a brief nod.
beats.chinese: 你留在原处，俯瞰阅览室。Robin简短地点点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Certainly.
beats.chinese: 当然。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin slips the notebook into their pocket. As they turn towards the room, their pen starts to slide after it. They catch it against their coat.
beats.chinese: Robin把本子放进口袋。转身看向阅览室时，钢笔也跟着往下滑，他们把笔按在外套上接住。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nearly lost that.
beats.chinese: 差点掉了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the same gallery. Robin keeps the notebook tucked against their side while you pass.
beats.chinese: 你沿着同一层书廊继续走。你经过时，Robin把本子收在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. Thanks.
beats.chinese: 好。谢谢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Once you are clear, Robin opens the notebook again, keeping it close in front of them.
beats.chinese: 等你走过，Robin再次打开本子，仍把它收在身前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a good visit.
beats.chinese: 祝你参观愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the upper gallery overlooking the La Trobe Reading Room, you see Robin Castellano looking down into the room. They recognise you and give a small nod.
beats.chinese: 在俯瞰拉筹伯阅览室的上层书廊，你看见Robin Castellano正望着下方。他们认出了你，轻轻点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I've got a song stuck in my head.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。有首歌在我脑子里转个不停。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin taps two fingers against their folded arm, notices the movement and stops.
beats.chinese: Robin用两根手指敲着交叠的手臂，察觉这个动作后停了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Family song swap. My niece chose six minutes of drums. I preferred the silence before it.
beats.chinese: 家里每周交换歌曲。侄女选了六分钟的鼓声。我更喜欢播放前那段安静。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the upper gallery overlooking the State Library of Victoria's La Trobe Reading Room, Walter Bishop studies the arrangement of the desks below. He holds his open sketchbook low and speaks quietly to you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在维州图书馆俯瞰拉筹伯阅览室的上层书廊，沃尔特·毕晓普正观察下方书桌的排列。他把摊开的草图本放得很低，向附近的你低声开口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd like to use those arrangements, without making the film look like a floor plan.
beats.chinese: 我想把这些排列画进去，又不想把短片画成平面图。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks down at his page, keeping the sketchbook low against his blue work vest.
beats.chinese: 他低头看看纸页，草图本始终低低地贴在蓝色工装背心前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm making a little stop-motion film with pegboard figures. These patterns might work in it.
beats.chinese: 我在用洞洞板上的图形做一部定格动画短片。这些图案也许用得上。

choices.english: Are you making an animation?
choices.chinese: 你在做动画吗？

choices.english: I'd just like to look quietly.
choices.chinese: 我只想安静地看看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Walter turns the notebook toward himself. A page of geometric sketches sits beside a list of names and numbers.
beats.chinese: 沃尔特把笔记本转向自己。一页几何草图旁边，列着一些名字和数字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Stop-motion. Pegboard figures. I used to inspect ferry cables, so having things stay where I put them is quite a pleasure.
beats.chinese: 定格动画，用洞洞板上的图形来拍。我以前检查渡船缆索，所以东西能老实待在我放的位置上，还挺让人高兴。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He adds a small mark beside a name, checks the total, then finds a finished drawing.
beats.chinese: 他在一个名字旁添了一小笔，核对总数，然后翻到一张画好的图。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Two Thursday dinners. That's an hour holding my lamp. Right, there's one finished frame here, if you'd like a look.
beats.chinese: 吃了两顿周四晚饭，得给我扶一小时灯。好了，这儿有一帧画完的，你想看可以看看。

choices.english: Yes, I'd like to see the drawing.
choices.chinese: 好，我想看看那张图。

choices.english: I'll skip the drawing. Do they agree to those lamp shifts?
choices.chinese: 图就不看了。他们同意来扶灯吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Walter gives a small nod, keeping the notebook low against his body.
beats.chinese: 沃尔特点点头，仍把笔记本低低地收在身前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course.
beats.chinese: 当然。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks a sequence of tiny drawings, counts them with his pencil, and crosses out a number.
beats.chinese: 他查看一串小图，用铅笔逐个点数，划掉了一个数字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Six frames, not eight. Counted the same two twice. That's mine.
beats.chinese: 六帧，不是八帧。同样的两帧数了两遍，是我算错了。

choices.english: I'll leave you to it.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你了。

choices.english: Six frames of what?
choices.chinese: 什么东西的六帧？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Walter holds the notebook low between you. The drawing shows blue peg shapes arranged around an open centre.
beats.chinese: 沃尔特把笔记本放低，展示在你们之间。画上的蓝色插钉图形围着一块空白中心排列。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's the frame. The room gave me the arrangement. The blue was settled before I got here.
beats.chinese: 就是这一帧。布局是看这间阅览室想到的。蓝色嘛，来之前就定好了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He leaves the page visible for a few moments, then turns it back and makes a small note beneath the drawing.
beats.chinese: 他把那页展示了片刻，随后转回去，在图下记了一小条。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll finish these notes before I lose the measurements. Enjoy the room.
beats.chinese: 我得趁还记得尺寸，把这些记完。你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Walter stops with his fingers on the corner of the drawing. He keeps the notebook facing himself.
beats.chinese: 沃尔特的手指停在画页一角，笔记本依然朝着自己。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They eat the casserole. I put the lamp time against the dinners. Seems a fair account to me.
beats.chinese: 他们吃了炖羊肉，我就把扶灯的时间记在饭账上。我觉得这账很公平。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks the marked total once more, closes the notebook, and puts his pencil away.
beats.chinese: 他又核对了一遍标出的总数，合上笔记本，把铅笔收好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I wouldn't charge you for looking at a drawing, though. Anyway, that's enough notes for this visit. Good day.
beats.chinese: 不过，看一张图我可不会跟你记账。好了，这趟记得够多了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Walter gives a small nod and folds the notebook shut around his pencil.
beats.chinese: 沃尔特点点头，把铅笔夹进笔记本里，合上本子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. I've got the number down now.
beats.chinese: 好，数字已经记好了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns his attention back to the arrangement of desks below, with the notebook held at his side.
beats.chinese: 他重新望向下方书桌的排列，把笔记本垂放在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy your visit.
beats.chinese: 祝你参观愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Walter holds his pencil upright beside the notebook, well below anyone's view of the room.
beats.chinese: 沃尔特把铅笔竖在笔记本旁边，高度远低于大家观看阅览室的视线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A peg turning in a little animation. Six pictures for this bit.
beats.chinese: 小动画里一根插钉在转动。这一段要拍六张。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rotates the pencil in three small steps, then lays it along the notebook's spine.
beats.chinese: 他把铅笔分三小步转动了一下，然后沿着笔记本书脊放好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Like that, a little each time. The peg needs six positions. I only need to count them properly. I'll get back to it.
beats.chinese: 就这样，每次动一点。插钉要摆六个位置，我只要把数点对就行了。我接着记了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the upper gallery above the La Trobe Reading Room, Walter Bishop closes his animation sketchbook and recognises you.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到拉筹伯阅览室上层的同一片书廊，沃尔特·毕晓普合上动画草图本，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I've only settled one thing today. The blue in this design stays.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天只确定了一件事，这个构图里的蓝色不改。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tucks the sketchbook under his arm and looks back out over the reading room.
beats.chinese: 他把草图本收在臂下，重新望向阅览室。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The rest can wait till tomorrow. That one's settled.
beats.chinese: 别的可以明天再想，这个定了。

causality.presenceReason: 沃尔特来到维州图书馆拉筹伯阅览室的上层书廊，观察下方书桌的几何排列，为洞洞板定格动画记草图。
causality.placeAttitude: 他对室内排列有具体的创作兴趣，想借用构图，又不想让短片看起来像平面图。他愿意安静观看，不承担导览职责，也不要求陌生人评审作品。
causality.stayingConstraint: 双方始终留在照片所示的同层上层书廊，交流压低声音。沃尔特始终把草图本放低，不遮挡视线，也不主动举到用户眼前展示。
causality.currentGoal: 初遇时观察书桌布局，记下动画构图与帧数，完成这次观察笔记。重逢时已决定保留构图中的蓝色，暂时停下草图工作。
causality.currentState: 初遇时专注于创作，愿意向附近的人分享一句具体感想，但不索取评价。用户想安静观看时，他直接接受。他偶有计数疏忽，发现操作错误就直接认账。重逢时平静而坚持已作出的配色决定。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Oscar Brightwell is on the upper gallery overlooking the State Library Victoria's La Trobe Reading Room, taking a look after his laundromat maintenance shift. His phone is on silent. He reads a message from a friend asking to bring his flatmate to dinner, then looks towards you nearby.
beats.chinese: Oscar Brightwell 下了自助洗衣店的维修班，来到维州图书馆俯瞰 La Trobe 阅览室的上层书廊看看。他的手机一直调着静音。他看完朋友询问能否带室友来吃饭的消息，随后看向附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just been promoted to cooking for three. Haven't accepted the promotion.
beats.chinese: 刚刚升任三人晚饭的厨师。我还没接受这个晋升。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers his phone, staying where he is. He keeps his voice low.
beats.chinese: 他放低手机，仍站在原处。他继续压低声音说话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A mate wants to bring his flatmate to dinner. I only want one guest.
beats.chinese: 朋友想带室友来吃饭。我只想招待一个人。

choices.english: Dinner sounds complicated.
choices.chinese: 听起来这顿晚饭挺复杂。

choices.english: No worries. I'd just like to look at the room.
choices.chinese: 没关系。我就想看看阅览室。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Oscar glances at the message again, staying out of your way.
beats.chinese: Oscar 又看了一眼消息，仍站在不挡着你的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One mate's coming over. Now he wants to bring his flatmate. I've got a two-seat table.
beats.chinese: 一个朋友要来吃饭，现在又想带上他室友。我家餐桌就两个座位。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He types a short reply with both thumbs, then locks the screen.
beats.chinese: 他用两只拇指打了一条简短的回复，随后锁上屏幕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Told him just him tonight. We can do another night if that doesn't suit.
beats.chinese: 跟他说了，今晚只能他一个人来。不方便的话就改天。

choices.english: Couldn't you just cook a bit more?
choices.chinese: 不能多做一点吗？

choices.english: Fair enough. The frying pan probably needs the other seat.
choices.chinese: 也对。另一个座位大概还得留给煎锅。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Oscar pockets the phone without finishing his reply. He shifts farther to one side of the gallery.
beats.chinese: Oscar 没回完消息就把手机收进口袋，又往书廊一侧挪了挪。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No worries. I'll give you some room.
beats.chinese: 没问题，我给你让点地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks down into the reading room, then checks where he is standing.
beats.chinese: 他朝下方的阅览室看去，又确认了一下自己站的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm staying here a minute. Say if I'm in your way.
beats.chinese: 我还会在这儿看一会儿。挡着你就说。

choices.english: One step to your left would help, thanks.
choices.chinese: 往你左边挪一步就好了，谢谢。

choices.english: You're fine there. I'll move a little farther along. Enjoy the view.
choices.chinese: 你站那儿没问题。我往前走一点。慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Oscar's eyebrows lift. His answer comes out a little sharper than before.
beats.chinese: Oscar 挑了挑眉，回答时的语气比刚才硬了一点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can cook more. I don't want two guests.
beats.chinese: 多做点饭没问题。我就是不想同时招待两个人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He presses his lips together briefly, then puts the phone away and turns back towards the reading room.
beats.chinese: 他短暂地抿了抿嘴，把手机收好，转身重新望向阅览室。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That came out sharp. Anyway, dinner's sorted. I'll let you get on.
beats.chinese: 刚才语气有点冲。总之，晚饭安排好了。不打扰你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Oscar gives a brief laugh, quiet enough for the gallery.
beats.chinese: Oscar 短促地笑了一声，音量依然适合安静的书廊。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Pan's good company. Doesn't ask to bring anyone.
beats.chinese: 煎锅挺好相处的，也不问能不能再带个人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His phone lights up. He reads the reply, taps a quick response, then moves a few paces along the same gallery.
beats.chinese: 手机屏幕亮了。他看完回复，简短地回了一条，随后沿着同一层书廊走开几步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, he's coming on his own. Better have a proper look before I go and buy the onions. Enjoy yours.
beats.chinese: 好了，他自己来。我得趁去买洋葱前好好看看了。你也慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Oscar takes one step to his left and checks that he has left your view clear.
beats.chinese: Oscar 往自己的左边挪了一步，确认不再挡住你的视线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yep. Easy enough.
beats.chinese: 行，小事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He leaves his phone in his pocket and faces the reading room.
beats.chinese: 他把手机留在口袋里，面向阅览室。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That reply can wait. Came in to have a look.
beats.chinese: 那条消息可以等会儿再回。我本来就是进来看看的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you move farther along the gallery, Oscar stays where he is and gives you a small nod.
beats.chinese: 你沿书廊往前走了一点，Oscar 留在原处，朝你轻轻点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. Enjoy yours too.
beats.chinese: 谢了，你也慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes out his phone and opens his shopping list. The conversation ends as he adds one item.
beats.chinese: 他拿出手机，打开购物清单。随着他补上一样东西，这段交谈也结束了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Onions. Knew there was something.
beats.chinese: 洋葱。就知道漏了点什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the upper gallery overlooking the La Trobe Reading Room, Oscar is quietly looking down into the room. He recognises you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在俯瞰 La Trobe 阅览室的上层书廊，Oscar 正安静地看着下方的阅览室。他认出了附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. No rush to get dinner on after work today.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。今天下班后不用赶着做晚饭。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He leaves his phone in his pocket and looks down again, following the arrangement of the desks below.
beats.chinese: 他把手机留在口袋里，重新低头看向下方，目光沿着书桌的排列移动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just feel like staying here a bit today.
beats.chinese: 今天就想在这儿待一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Baldwin Street in Kensington Market, Beatriz Lunn is waiting to return a borrowed stockpot to a friend. Wearing a violet jacket, she sets the pot securely beside her leg and holds a bag of groceries.
beats.chinese: 在肯辛顿街区的 Baldwin Street，Beatriz Lunn 正等朋友来取回借给她的大汤锅。她穿着紫色外套，把锅稳稳放在腿侧，手里提着一袋食材。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Excuse me, do you have the time? I'm waiting for a friend to collect this pot.
beats.chinese: 打扰一下，现在几点了？我在等朋友来取这口锅。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She glances at her closed shopping bag, keeping the pot close to her leg and clear of passing people.
beats.chinese: 她看了一眼收好口的购物袋，让锅贴着腿侧放着，不妨碍行人经过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My phone's right at the bottom. I've just packed everything, and I'd rather not unpack it all again.
beats.chinese: 手机压在最底下。我刚把东西收好，不太想再全翻出来。

choices.english: Tell her the time.
choices.chinese: 告诉她现在的时间。

choices.english: “Sorry, I don't have the time.”
choices.chinese: “抱歉，我也不知道现在几点。”

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beatriz nods when you tell her the time.
beats.chinese: 你告诉她时间，Beatriz 点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. That saves me unpacking everything.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。这下不用把东西全翻出来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the bag's top twice. The empty pot rests against her ankle.
beats.chinese: 她将袋口折了两道。空锅靠在她脚踝旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eight people ate from this pot yesterday. Now it goes back before I start treating it as furniture.
beats.chinese: 昨天八个人吃的饭都是这口锅做的。现在得还回去，免得我开始拿它当家具用。

choices.english: “Wouldn't owning a big pot be easier?”
choices.chinese: “自己有一口大锅，不是更方便吗？”

choices.english: “Hope your friend gets here soon. I'll be on my way.”
choices.chinese: “希望你朋友快到了。我先走了。”

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beatriz nods and leaves the shopping bag closed.
beats.chinese: Beatriz 点点头，没有打开购物袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No worries. I'll check when I've got a hand free.
beats.chinese: 没关系。等腾出手来我再看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pulls the stockpot closer so its handle no longer sticks out.
beats.chinese: 她把大汤锅拉近，让锅柄不再伸出去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm returning this to a friend. Fed eight yesterday, and somehow the empty pot is harder to carry.
beats.chinese: 我在等朋友来拿回这口锅。昨天喂饱了八个人，今天空着反倒更难拿。

choices.english: “What did you cook for eight?”
choices.chinese: “你给八个人做了什么？”

choices.english: “I'll let you wait for your friend. Take care.”
choices.chinese: “那你等朋友吧。再见。”

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beatriz looks down at the pot, then shakes her head immediately.
beats.chinese: Beatriz 低头看了一眼锅，立刻摇头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. Where would it go? Sorry, that came out sharp. My kitchen's small, and I like having an empty cupboard.
beats.chinese: 不。放哪儿呢？抱歉，说得太冲了。我厨房小，而且我喜欢留一个空柜子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her friend arrives along Baldwin Street. Beatriz lifts the pot, waits for a firm grip, and lets go.
beats.chinese: 她的朋友沿着 Baldwin Street 走来。Beatriz 提起锅，等对方拿稳才松手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Back with its owner. Thanks for telling me the time. Enjoy your day.
beats.chinese: 好了，物归原主。谢谢你告诉我时间。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beatriz lifts the folded bag by both handles, leaving the pot safely beside her.
beats.chinese: Beatriz 握住购物袋的两只提手，把袋子提起来，锅稳稳留在她身旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Have a good day.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along Baldwin Street, she opens the top of the bag and checks her groceries.
beats.chinese: 你继续沿 Baldwin Street 前行，她则打开袋口，检查买好的食材。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Tomatoes, chickpeas, garlic. All here.
beats.chinese: 番茄、鹰嘴豆、蒜。都齐了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beatriz's expression brightens. She holds the bag upright between her shoes.
beats.chinese: Beatriz 的神情一下明亮起来。她把袋子竖在两只鞋之间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Chickpeas, tomatoes, a lot of garlic. Bread to wipe the bowls. I forgot to put the bread out until everyone had finished.
beats.chinese: 鹰嘴豆、番茄，还有好多蒜。面包用来蘸碗底，结果大家都吃完了，我才想起没把面包端出来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She laughs, then takes out her phone and opens her friend's contact.
beats.chinese: 她自己先笑了，随后拿出手机，找到朋友的联系方式。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They ate it anyway. I'd better call about this pot. Nice talking to you.
beats.chinese: 不过面包最后还是吃光了。我得打电话问问这锅什么时候交接。跟你聊天很开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beatriz nods and takes hold of both bag handles.
beats.chinese: Beatriz 点点头，握住购物袋的两只提手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Take care.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She ties the handles together and turns the pot handle inward, leaving the space beside her clear.
beats.chinese: 她把袋子的提手系在一起，又将锅柄转向自己，留出身旁的通行空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That should do it.
beats.chinese: 这就妥了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Baldwin Street in Kensington Market, you see Beatriz Lunn carrying a bag of groceries she has already bought. She recognizes you and smiles.
beats.chinese: 在肯辛顿街区的 Baldwin Street，你看见 Beatriz Lunn 提着一袋已经买好的食材。她认出你，笑了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I'm only cooking for myself tonight, but I still feel like making a big pot.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今晚只给自己做饭，不过我还是想煮一大锅。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She glances into the bag and folds the top closed without adding anything else. Then she turns to continue her shopping along Baldwin Street.
beats.chinese: 她往袋里看了一眼，没再添东西，把袋口折好，随后转身准备沿 Baldwin Street 继续采买。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll eat the extra tomorrow. I can have a good dinner without having anyone over tonight. Good to see you. I've still got a few things to get.
beats.chinese: 多出来的明天吃。今晚不招待人，也能好好吃饭。见到你真好。我还得接着买几样东西。

causality.presenceReason: Beatriz 在肯辛顿街区的 Baldwin Street 等朋友取回昨天聚餐借用的大锅，手里提着已经买好的食材。

causality.stayingConstraint: 她需要留在约定的街道范围等朋友取锅。锅稳放在腿侧，食材已经收好，手机却压在购物袋深处，查看时间需要重新翻动袋中物品。
causality.currentGoal: 先确认时间，继续等朋友取回借锅，避免为了找手机把刚收好的食材全翻出来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Baldwin Street in Kensington Market, Gordon Ellery pauses during a walk to look along the storefronts. Holding a plain notebook, he speaks to you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在肯辛顿街区的 Baldwin Street，Gordon Ellery 散步时停下来看沿街店面。他拿着一本朴素的笔记本，随口对附近的你说话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I nearly said this street hasn't changed at all. I've only looked at a few shops. That's not enough to go on.
beats.chinese: 我差点说这条街一点没变。才看了几家店，这结论不算数。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the notebook and writes down the claim he nearly made, then looks along the storefronts again.
beats.chinese: 他翻开笔记本，把刚才差点说出口的判断记下来，随后又望向沿街店面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It does look familiar, though.
beats.chinese: 不过，看着确实很熟悉。

choices.english: Familiar isn't the same as unchanged.
choices.chinese: 熟悉不等于没变。

choices.english: Fair enough.
choices.chinese: 这么说也有道理。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Gordon lowers the notebook and looks back along Baldwin Street.
beats.chinese: Gordon 放低笔记本，又沿着 Baldwin Street 望了望。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One new shop doesn't make it a different street.
beats.chinese: 多一家新店，也不至于就成了另一条街。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rests his pen against the open page, then looks back at you.
beats.chinese: 他把笔抵在摊开的纸页上，随后又看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: What would count as enough change?
beats.chinese: 要变到什么程度才算数？

choices.english: I questioned 'unchanged.' I didn't say it was a different street.
choices.chinese: 我质疑的是“一点没变”。我没说它成了另一条街。

choices.english: I'd rather not debate how much the street has changed.
choices.chinese: 我不太想争论这条街到底变了多少。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Gordon gives a small nod and glances down at the sentence in his notebook.
beats.chinese: Gordon 轻轻点了点头，低头看了看笔记本里的那句话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A few familiar storefronts. That's what I've actually seen.
beats.chinese: 几家熟悉的店面。我实际看到的也就这些。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the page open with his thumb, his pen hovering over the words he has just written.
beats.chinese: 他用拇指压住纸页，笔尖停在刚写下的那句话上方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've written 'the street.' That covers rather more than I've looked at.
beats.chinese: 我写的是“这条街”。这范围可比我看过的大了不少。

choices.english: What do you actually enjoy looking at here?
choices.chinese: 那你在这里真正喜欢看什么？

choices.english: I'll leave you to it. Have a good walk.
choices.chinese: 你慢慢写。祝你散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Gordon lowers his pen. For a moment, he says nothing.
beats.chinese: Gordon 放低了拿笔的手，一时没有说话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. You said exactly that. I added the rest.
beats.chinese: 对。你说的就是这个。后面那些是我加上去的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A small smile appears. He crosses out his claim, closes the notebook firmly, and keeps it in his hand.
beats.chinese: 他露出一点笑意，把那句判断划掉，将笔记本合好，留在手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I was ready to argue about the entire street. Thanks for being precise. Enjoy your day.
beats.chinese: 我都准备争论整条街的变化了。谢谢你说得这么准确。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Gordon takes his pen off the page and turns his shoulders to clear the way.
beats.chinese: Gordon 把笔从纸页上移开，侧过身让开了路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I made that into an argument very quickly.
beats.chinese: 可以理解。我这也太快就跟人争论起来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes the notebook and holds it at his side without asking another question.
beats.chinese: 他合上笔记本，拿在身侧，没有再追问。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave it there. Have a good day.
beats.chinese: 那就说到这儿。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Gordon lowers the notebook and looks into a shop window along Baldwin Street.
beats.chinese: Gordon放低笔记本，望向Baldwin Street的一扇店窗。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The cups. Blue pattern near the rim. I have a weakness for things I haven't got room for.
beats.chinese: 杯子。口沿那圈蓝纹。我总喜欢家里放不下的东西。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes the notebook without finishing the sentence and starts towards the window.
beats.chinese: 他没把那句话写完就合上本子，朝店窗走去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll have a closer look. You enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 我去近处看看。你散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Gordon lifts his pen from the notebook as you say goodbye.
beats.chinese: 听见你道别，Gordon 把笔从笔记本上抬起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. You too.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。你也是。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He crosses out the claim, closes the cover, and turns back toward the storefronts with the notebook in hand.
beats.chinese: 他划掉那句判断，合上封面，拿着笔记本转回沿街店面的方向。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's enough checking for now. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 先检查到这里吧。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another outing along Baldwin Street in Kensington Market, Gordon Ellery recognizes you as he finishes wrapping a bunch of mint in damp paper.
beats.chinese: 在肯辛顿街区的 Baldwin Street ，Gordon Ellery 正用湿纸包好一束薄荷，这时认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Mint from my balcony, for a friend.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。这是我阳台上种的薄荷，带给朋友的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gathers the damp paper snugly around the stems, then notices the mint scent on his hands. His expression relaxes.
beats.chinese: 他把茎部周围的湿纸收拢，随后闻到手上的薄荷味，神情放松下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I promised her fresh mint. Better get there before the stems give up. Good to see you.
beats.chinese: 答应给她新鲜薄荷的。得趁茎还挺着赶紧送去。很高兴见到你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Baldwin Street in Toronto's Kensington Market, Aud Thibodeau is looking along the storefronts. She has brought a canvas bag of beeswax goods for a delivery and keeps it close against her leg. She turns toward you without moving into your path.
beats.chinese: 在多伦多肯辛顿街区的 Baldwin Street，Aud Thibodeau 正沿着店面张望。她带着一袋待送的蜂蜡制品，把帆布袋贴着腿提好。她转向你，没有挡住你的去路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Excuse me. This is Baldwin Street, right?
beats.chinese: 打扰一下，这里是 Baldwin Street，对吧？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aud keeps the bag at her side and leaves room for you to pass.
beats.chinese: Aud 仍将袋子贴身提在一侧，留着供你通行的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just checking before I go any farther.
beats.chinese: 我想先确认一下，再往前走。

choices.english: Yes, it is. Are you looking for somewhere?
choices.chinese: 对，是这里。你在找什么地方吗？

choices.english: Yes, but I can't stop. I need to keep going.
choices.chinese: 对，不过我不能停下来，得继续走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aud keeps her bag close, with room for people to pass. Her eyes move along the storefronts again.
beats.chinese: Aud 贴身提着袋子，留出了供人通行的空间。她又沿着店面看了一遍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I've got a delivery. I remember the street name, but the shop front doesn't look how I remember it. I make candles, food wraps, wood polish. I've brought orders here often enough.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我来送货。街名我记得，可店面跟我印象里的对不上。我做蜡烛、食物保鲜布，还有木蜡油。来这儿送过不少次货了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A folded delivery slip sticks out of the bag's outer pocket. Aud glances past it toward the buildings.
beats.chinese: 一张折好的送货单露在袋子外侧的口袋上。Aud 的目光越过它，仍看着那些店面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I used to look for the painted front. It was along here. I'm fairly sure it was along here.
beats.chinese: 我以前就认那块刷过漆的门脸。就在这一段。我相当确定是在这一段。

choices.english: Would the address on that slip help?
choices.chinese: 那张单子上的地址能帮上忙吗？

choices.english: I'll leave you to look. Goodbye.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你找了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aud takes a small step aside and holds the canvas bag close against her leg.
beats.chinese: Aud 往旁边挪了一小步，把帆布袋贴着腿提好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. Thanks for confirming.
beats.chinese: 当然。谢谢你帮我确认。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She glances along the storefronts again, keeping the way clear.
beats.chinese: 她又沿着店面望了一眼，仍让开通行的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I remembered the street name. The shop front I had in mind... Anyway, don't let me keep you.
beats.chinese: 街名我记得。只是我印象里的那家店面……算了，不耽误你了。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll go past.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，我过去了。

choices.english: Before I go, what are you delivering?
choices.chinese: 走之前问一句，你在送什么？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aud looks down at the delivery slip, then pulls it free with her other hand.
beats.chinese: Aud 低头看了看送货单，用另一只手将它抽了出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. Though I walked all this way quite certain I wouldn't need it.
beats.chinese: 能。可我一路走过来，还笃定自己根本用不着它。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She reads the address and refolds the slip with that part facing outward. Her attention shifts from the remembered paint to the written address.
beats.chinese: 她读了地址，重新折好单子，让地址露在外面。她不再只想着记忆里的漆色，开始对照纸上的地址。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. I'll use this. I do remember that doorway, though. Thanks for stopping.
beats.chinese: 好吧，我照着这个找。不过那个门口，我确实记得。谢谢你停下来聊两句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aud gives you a small wave without taking the slip from her bag.
beats.chinese: Aud 轻轻向你挥了挥手，没有取出袋子里的送货单。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye, then. It was definitely along this stretch.
beats.chinese: 那，再见。肯定就在这一段。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She walks a few paces along the same storefronts, keeping the bag close. She slows again to examine another shop front, ending the conversation.
beats.chinese: 她贴身提着袋子，沿着同一排店面走了几步，又放慢脚步打量另一家门脸，交谈就此结束。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll have another look. Take care.
beats.chinese: 我再找找。慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You pass through the space Aud has cleared. She keeps the bag still beside her.
beats.chinese: 你从 Aud 让出的空当走过。她将袋子稳稳地提在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You're welcome.
beats.chinese: 不客气。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Once you are past, Aud turns back toward the storefronts without calling after you.
beats.chinese: 等你走过去后，Aud 转回身看向店面，没有再叫住你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye.
beats.chinese: 再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aud lifts the canvas bag a little, keeping the parcels inside it.
beats.chinese: Aud稍稍提起帆布袋，里面的包裹没有拿出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Beeswax wraps. My workshop makes candles and wood polish too. Deliveries are my excuse for a good long walk.
beats.chinese: 蜂蜡保鲜布。我作坊里还做蜡烛和木蜡油。送货正好让我多走走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the written address again, then turns towards the next storefront.
beats.chinese: 她又核对了一次写下的地址，转向下一家店面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Longer than intended today. Still, I'll get there. Take care.
beats.chinese: 今天比打算的走得还远。不过总能到。你慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Baldwin Street in Kensington Market, you see Aud Thibodeau standing out of the pedestrian flow. She recognizes you as you come near.
beats.chinese: 在肯辛顿街区的 Baldwin Street ，你看见 Aud Thibodeau 站在不挡行人的地方。你走近时，她认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. No deliveries today. For once, I don't have to think about how far I've still got to go.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。今天没有货要送。总算不用一直想着还得走多远了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aud shifts her gaze from the storefronts to the full stretch of street. She stays where she is, looking a little longer.
beats.chinese: Aud 把目光从店面移向整段街道。她没有动身，仍站在原处多看了一会儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd like to take it slowly today. If you're in a hurry, go on ahead.
beats.chinese: 今天想慢一点。你赶时间就先走。

causality.presenceReason: Aud 在用户到场前已带着蜂蜡制品来到 Baldwin Street 送货，正站在店面外凭旧印象寻找收货店铺。
causality.placeAttitude: 她喜欢步行送货，也熟悉这片街区，但过分相信自己记得的门脸。重逢当天没有送货任务，她愿意从容停看街道，享受不必计算剩余路程的步行时间。
causality.stayingConstraint: 初遇时货物尚未送达，她需要先确认店铺位置。用户没有陪同、停留或帮忙寻找的义务。重逢时没有送货约束，她因自己想多看一会儿而停留。
causality.currentGoal: 初遇时确认自己身处 Baldwin Street，并找到此次订单的收货店铺。重逢时只是慢慢看街，不急着动身。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Baldwin Street in Toronto's Kensington Market, Emile Fontenot is taking his neighborhood walk. He has taken off his purple overshirt in the warmer air and draped it over his forearm.
beats.chinese: 在多伦多肯辛顿街区的 Baldwin Street，Emile Fontenot 正在附近散步。天气暖起来了，他脱下紫色外衫，搭在前臂上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I needed two shirts a little while ago. Now this green one finally gets to show itself. I'm Emile.
beats.chinese: 刚才还得穿两件，现在终于能让这件绿的露面了。我叫 Emile。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He points to his lime-green shirt with a smile, staying clear of passing pedestrians.
beats.chinese: 他笑着指了指自己的青柠绿上衣，站在不妨碍行人经过的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It was cool when I set out. Now I've got a whole extra shirt to carry.
beats.chinese: 出门时还有点凉。现在倒好，得多抱着一整件衣服。

choices.english: That's a bright purple. I usually go for something simple.
choices.chinese: 这紫色真鲜艳。我一般会选简单一点的。

choices.english: Hello, Emile. I'm just passing through.
choices.chinese: 你好，Emile。我只是路过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Emile smooths the purple fabric with his palm. Your mention of simple clothes seems to encourage him.
beats.chinese: Emile 用手掌抚平紫色布料。你说喜欢简单的衣服，他反倒来了兴致。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Simple's easy. Plain orange shirt, no pattern. I'd put that beside purple any day.
beats.chinese: 简单好办。纯橙色上衣，不带花纹。配紫色，我哪天都愿意穿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds up a corner of the overshirt against his green top, already absorbed in the combination.
beats.chinese: 他提起外衫的一角，贴着自己的绿色上衣，已经琢磨起了配色。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Or this green. Though I suspect you've noticed I give very little advice involving less color.
beats.chinese: 或者这种绿。不过你大概也看出来了，我出的主意，很少是让颜色再素一点。

choices.english: I meant gray or navy. That's what I'd pick. Goodbye, Emile.
choices.chinese: 我指的是灰色或者藏蓝色。我会选那种。再见，Emile。

choices.english: I like your purple. Was color part of your work? Then I'll let you get back to your walk.
choices.chinese: 我喜欢你这件紫色。你以前的工作和颜色有关吗？问完就不耽误你散步了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Emile draws the whole shirt closer to his side, leaving plenty of room for you to pass.
beats.chinese: Emile 把整件外衫收拢到身侧，给你留出足够的通行空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. You go right ahead.
beats.chinese: 当然，你尽管走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds it over his forearm. One cuff immediately slips down, and he catches it with two fingers.
beats.chinese: 他把外衫搭在前臂上。一只袖口立刻滑了下来，他用两根手指捏住。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It behaved better when it had my arms in it.
beats.chinese: 我的胳膊还穿在里面时，它倒老实多了。

choices.english: You could put it back on and roll up the sleeves.
choices.chinese: 你可以再穿上，把袖子卷起来。

choices.english: Good luck with it. I'll keep going.
choices.chinese: 祝你搞定它。我继续走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At gray or navy, Emile lowers the purple corner. His smile turns rueful.
beats.chinese: 听到灰色和藏蓝色，Emile 放下了那一角紫布，露出有点自嘲的笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah, there it is. You said simple, and I went straight to orange.
beats.chinese: 啊，这下明白了。你说简单，我却一头奔着橙色去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds both sleeves inside the shirt and stays clear as you continue along Baldwin Street.
beats.chinese: 他把两只袖子都折进衣服里，留在一旁，让你继续沿 Baldwin Street 前行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Gray wouldn't be my pick, but you've already made yours. Goodbye now.
beats.chinese: 我自己不会选灰色，不过你已经选好了。再见啦。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Emile settles the folded overshirt over one arm and gives you his full attention for the brief answer.
beats.chinese: Emile 把折好的外衫搭在一条胳膊上，认真地回答了这个简短的问题。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Forty years dyeing and repairing leather sofas in New Orleans. Plenty of brown, plenty of beige. I enjoyed getting a red one.
beats.chinese: 我在新奥尔良给皮沙发染色、修补，干了四十年。棕的多，米色的也多。碰上红色的，我就高兴。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pats his green shirt, then turns to resume his own walk without drawing you along.
beats.chinese: 他拍了拍自己的绿色上衣，随后转身继续散步，没有招呼你同行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm retired now. I buy the bright shirts for myself. Good talking with you.
beats.chinese: 现在退休了。鲜艳的衬衫，我就买给自己穿。跟你聊得很愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Emile looks from the dangling cuff to the open front of the shirt.
beats.chinese: Emile 看看垂下的袖口，又看看敞着的衣襟。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Well, that would leave both hands free. I got so busy folding it, I forgot I could wear it open.
beats.chinese: 可不是，那样两只手都空出来了。我光顾着折，都忘了还能敞着穿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Staying out of the passing foot traffic, he puts the shirt on and rolls each sleeve below his elbow.
beats.chinese: 他站在不妨碍行人的位置，重新穿上外衫，把两边袖子都卷到肘部以下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Purple and green get another block together. Thank you kindly. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 紫色和绿色又能一起走一段了。多谢你。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the street. Emile keeps the loose cuff firmly in his hand.
beats.chinese: 你继续沿街走去。Emile 把那只松垂的袖口牢牢攥在手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. I'll keep this end under control.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我会管好这一头的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives a small wave with his free hand, then starts walking in the other direction with the shirt bundled against his side.
beats.chinese: 他用空着的手轻轻挥别，把外衫拢在身侧，朝另一个方向走去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care now.
beats.chinese: 慢走啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Baldwin Street in Kensington Market, Emile recognizes you during his walk. He is holding a small purple and lime-green card holder he made from leather scraps.
beats.chinese: 在肯辛顿街区的 Baldwin Street，散步中的 Emile 认出了你。他手里拿着一个紫色配青柠绿的小卡套，是他用皮边料做的。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Well, hello again! Purple and lime green look good on more than shirts. I'm mighty pleased with how this little thing turned out.
beats.chinese: 哎，又见面了！紫色配青柠绿，除了做衬衫，做别的也好看。这个小东西做出来，我可满意了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slips the card holder into his pocket and smooths his overshirt, smiling as he leaves room for people to pass.
beats.chinese: 他把卡套收进口袋，抚平外衫，脸上带着笑，也给来往行人留出了空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm going to walk a little farther. Good seeing you. You take care now!
beats.chinese: 我还想再走一段。见到你真高兴。回头见，多保重啊！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the Toronto Islands lakeside boardwalk, Sacha Okafor has stopped to hear a podcast facing Lake Ontario. Her bag and its strap are tucked close to her feet, clear of the walking space. She pauses the episode to pack her water bottle, takes one side of her headphones off, and hears the water. She sets the bottle down firmly beside her bag before speaking to you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在多伦多群岛湖岸的木栈道上，Sacha Okafor 正面向安大略湖，停下来听播客。她的包和包带都收在脚边，没有占用通行区域。她暂停节目，准备收好水瓶，摘下一侧耳机，听见了水声。她先把水瓶稳稳放在包旁，再向附近的你开口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now that I've paused this, I can hear the water. It's been there the whole time.
beats.chinese: 节目停了，才发现这里的水声一直没停。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns toward you with her hands empty, leaving the bottle beside her bag.
beats.chinese: 她空着双手转向你，水瓶仍放在包旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I hadn't noticed it with my headphones on.
beats.chinese: 戴着耳机的时候，我一直没注意到。

choices.english: What are you listening to?
choices.chinese: 你在听什么？

choices.english: I'm just looking at the lake.
choices.chinese: 我只是看看湖。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sacha reaches for her bottle, then puts it down again before answering. Her hand stays empty.
beats.chinese: Sacha 伸手拿起水瓶，又在回答前把它放了回去。她让手空着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A podcast about a shipwreck. I'm halfway through.
beats.chinese: 一个讲沉船的播客。我听了一半。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns fully toward you, leaving the bottle and bag at her feet.
beats.chinese: 她完全转向你，把水瓶和包留在脚边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I inspect life jackets for a fishing supply company. I meant to listen to something unrelated to boats. I chose badly.
beats.chinese: 我在一家渔具用品公司检查救生衣。本来想听点跟船无关的东西。没选好。

choices.english: What have they found out so far?
choices.chinese: 他们目前查出了什么？

choices.english: I'll leave you to your episode. Enjoy it.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你听节目了。慢慢听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sacha caps her bottle and puts it in her bag while you look toward the open lake.
beats.chinese: 你望向开阔的湖面，Sacha 拧好瓶盖，把水瓶装进包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave you to the lake, then.
beats.chinese: 那我就不打扰你看湖了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts the bag onto her shoulder, then pauses with one hand on the strap.
beats.chinese: 她把包背到肩上，随后停下来，一只手握着包带。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry, I'm guessing. Did you want quiet, or were you just looking?
beats.chinese: 抱歉，我又在猜了。你是想安静待着，还是只是看看？

choices.english: Some quiet, please. Enjoy your walk.
choices.chinese: 我想安静一会儿。祝你散步愉快。

choices.english: Just looking. I can look at the lake and listen to you.
choices.chinese: 只是看看。我可以一边看湖，一边听你说话。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sacha looks toward the lake for a moment, recalling where she paused the episode.
beats.chinese: Sacha 朝湖面看了一会儿，回想节目暂停在了哪里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They found the ship's bell. The name on it was different from the one in their records.
beats.chinese: 他们找到了船钟。上面的名字跟记录里的不一样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She packs the bottle, puts on her headphones, and keeps her bag close to her feet.
beats.chinese: 她收好水瓶，戴上耳机，把包放在紧靠脚边的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's where they stopped. I'm going to hear the explanation now. Enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 他们就讲到这里。我现在要听后面的解释了。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sacha leaves her headphones off while she says goodbye.
beats.chinese: 道别时，Sacha 没有戴回耳机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. I do want to finish it.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我确实想把它听完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the boardwalk. Sacha picks up her bottle and finishes packing before touching the podcast controls.
beats.chinese: 你沿木栈道继续前行。Sacha 拿起水瓶，先把东西收好，再去操作播客播放键。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care.
beats.chinese: 慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sacha nods and settles the bag securely on her shoulder.
beats.chinese: Sacha 点点头，把肩上的包背稳。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. Thanks for saying.
beats.chinese: 当然。谢谢你直接告诉我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns along the boardwalk and begins walking, keeping her headphones off as she goes.
beats.chinese: 她转向木栈道延伸的方向，开始往前走，没有戴上耳机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy the view. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 慢慢看风景。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sacha stays where she is. Her grip loosens on the bag strap.
beats.chinese: Sacha 留在原地，握着包带的手放松下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. I read that wrong.
beats.chinese: 明白了。是我会错意了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes out the bottle again, sets her bag down clear of the walking space, and unscrews the cap.
beats.chinese: 她又取出水瓶，把包放在不影响通行的地方，再拧开瓶盖。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I only meant to leave you to the view. I'm staying for some water before I listen again. Enjoy the lake.
beats.chinese: 我刚才只是想让你安心看风景。我打算留在这里喝点水，再接着听。慢慢看湖吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the Toronto Islands lakeside boardwalk, Sacha stands facing Lake Ontario with her headphones on. She recognizes you and raises a hand, then pauses her audio.
beats.chinese: 在多伦多群岛湖岸木栈道，Sacha 正戴着耳机面向安大略湖。她认出你，抬手打了个招呼，随后暂停音频。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Give me a second to take these off.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。等我一下，我把耳机摘下来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She rests the headphones around her neck and folds her arms loosely. Her bag sits close to her shoes, outside the walking space.
beats.chinese: 她把耳机挂在脖子上，松松地抱起双臂。包紧靠鞋边，没有占着通行区域。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got six minutes left in this episode. I wanted to say hello before I finish it. Good to see you.
beats.chinese: 这集还剩六分钟。我想先跟你打个招呼，再把它听完。见到你真好。

causality.presenceReason: Sacha 在玩家出现前已专程停在湖岸，面向安大略湖听一集播客，暂停只是为了收水瓶。
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢面向开阔湖面专心听节目，没有把湖岸当成工作场所。摘下一侧耳机后才注意到现场一直存在的水声。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须留下的外部义务，只想完成手头收拾或听完节目，不能同时专心聊天。
causality.currentGoal: 收好水瓶，再决定继续听节目还是沿栈道走走。
causality.currentState: 独自休息，态度温和，注意力原本在节目和收拾东西上，愿意向附近的人分享刚察觉的水声，也愿意短聊。
causality.contactTrigger: 她暂停播客、摘下一侧耳机后听见真实水声，先把水瓶放稳，再向附近的玩家说节目停了才发现水声一直没停。接触源于分享现场声音，不涉及物品占道、致歉、求助或提供知识。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留救生衣检查员职业、一次只做一件事的习惯、开口及回答前先放稳物品的动作，以及误读注意力后直接确认的方式。她接受玩家能够同时看湖和听话，没有要求玩家采用自己的注意力习惯。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家询问节目时，她先放下水瓶再回答。aa 中分享节目细节后留在原地继续听。ab 中玩家离开，她先完成收拾。玩家表示只看湖时，她起初理解为想安静，随后直接确认。ba 中确认玩家想安静后自行离开。bb 中接受玩家能同时看湖和听话，澄清误会后留下喝水。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程只用面向安大略湖的木栈道，随身包、水瓶与耳机都有休息用途。包和包带从开场起就收在脚边，所有物品始终避开通行区域，不新增设施或转移到其他场景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the Toronto Islands lakeside boardwalk, Marisol Duarte has stopped for a homemade lunch on her day off. She holds an open jar of pickled beans in one hand and reads her phone with the other. The lid is wrapped in a napkin inside her lunch bag.
beats.chinese: 在多伦多群岛湖岸木栈道，Marisol Duarte休息日停下来吃自带午饭。她一手拿着打开的腌豆角罐，一手看手机。罐盖已用餐巾包好，放在午饭袋里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Friday. That's when it'll be a week.
beats.chinese: 星期五才算一周。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks up and notices you nearby, then slips the phone into her pocket. The jar stays in her other hand.
beats.chinese: 她抬头注意到附近的你，把手机放进口袋，另一只手仍拿着罐子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry, that wasn't for you. My sister wants her rack installed. I'm Marisol.
beats.chinese: 不好意思，不是在跟你定时间。我妹妹催我装架子。我叫Marisol。

choices.english: “Beans? What kind?”
choices.chinese: “豆角？什么做法的？”

choices.english: You give her a little space. “No problem.”
choices.chinese: 你稍微让开一点。“没事。”

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol tilts the jar slightly. Garlic cloves sit among the beans.
beats.chinese: Marisol轻轻倾了倾罐子。豆角间能看到蒜瓣。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Pickled green beans. Plenty of alho. Garlic. My mother never saw the point of one lonely clove.
beats.chinese: 腌四季豆。放了不少alho，就是蒜。我母亲觉得只放孤零零的一瓣根本没意思。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps the jar upright and takes out her phone to read the message again. Her thumb pauses over the screen.
beats.chinese: 她扶正罐子，拿出手机又看了一眼消息，拇指停在屏幕上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My sister wants her laundry rack installed today. She's had my mock-up two days. She gets five more.
beats.chinese: 我妹妹想今天就把洗衣间的架子装上。样架她才用了两天，还得再用五天。

choices.english: “Even if she says she's ready?”
choices.chinese: “就算她说已经可以了，也不行？”

choices.english: “I'll leave you to your message. Enjoy your lunch.”
choices.chinese: “那你回消息吧。午饭吃好。”

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol glances at the open jar in her hand.
beats.chinese: Marisol看看手里的开口罐子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Just talking to myself.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我就是自言自语。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the lid is secure in its napkin inside her lunch bag and lifts out her fork.
beats.chinese: 她确认午饭袋里包着罐盖的餐巾收好了，拿出叉子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've packed enough lunch for two breaks. No need to rush.
beats.chinese: 午饭带得够分两次吃。可以慢慢来。

choices.english: “Enjoy it. I'll move on.”
choices.chinese: “慢慢吃，我先走了。”

choices.english: “Is this a break from work?”
choices.chinese: “这是工作间隙出来休息吗？”

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol glances back at the message, holding the open jar upright in her other hand.
beats.chinese: Marisol又看看消息，另一只手把开着的罐子端稳。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Two days. She hasn't even put the heavy towels on it yet. I know she wants the finished one.
beats.chinese: 才两天。她连厚毛巾都还没往上放。我知道她想赶紧用上成品。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pockets the phone, retrieves the lid and closes the jar. With lunch packed into her bag, she takes out the phone again and sends her sister a short reply.
beats.chinese: 她先收起手机，取出罐盖，把罐子旋紧。午饭装回袋里后，她再拿出手机，给妹妹发了条简短回复。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Friday, I've told her. She'll send me an annoyed face. Thanks for the chat. I'll get back to my lunch.
beats.chinese: 跟她说了，周五。她准会发个生气的表情。谢谢你聊这几句，我继续吃午饭了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol slips the phone away without replying. She takes a fork from her lunch bag.
beats.chinese: Marisol没有回复，把手机收了起来，从午餐袋里拿出叉子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. She can have an answer after I've eaten.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。等我吃完再回她。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts a bean from the jar and turns toward the open lake, leaving the boardwalk clear.
beats.chinese: 她从罐里叉起一根豆角，转向开阔的湖面，给栈道留出通行空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: These came out sharp. Good thing I brought bread. Enjoy your day.
beats.chinese: 这回腌得挺酸。还好带了面包。祝你今天玩得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the boardwalk. Marisol puts her fork back in the lunch bag, checks the wrapped lid is secure and lifts the jar.
beats.chinese: 你继续沿木栈道往前走。Marisol把叉子放回午饭袋，确认包好的罐盖收稳，再提起罐子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. Thanks for making room.
beats.chinese: 你也一样。谢谢你让开位置。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes her bag in her free hand and starts walking slowly in the other direction, keeping the jar level.
beats.chinese: 她用空着的手拎起袋子，朝相反方向慢慢走去，小心端平罐子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. No swinging this arm.
beats.chinese: 好了。这只胳膊可不能甩。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marisol shakes her head and settles the lunch bag against her hip.
beats.chinese: Marisol摇摇头，把午餐袋往胯边拢了拢。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Day off. I install handrails on city trails and park walkways. No tools with me today.
beats.chinese: 今天休息。我给市里的步道和公园走道安装扶手。今天没带工具。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the fork away, then takes out a piece of bread and folds its wrapper down with her thumb. Her attention returns to lunch.
beats.chinese: 她收起叉子，取出一块面包，用拇指折下包装纸，把注意力转回午饭。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came over for the lake. I'll get back to that now. Take care.
beats.chinese: 我是来看湖的。这会儿接着看。回头见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the Toronto Islands lakeside boardwalk, Marisol Duarte recognises you while closing a message from her sister.
beats.chinese: 在多伦多群岛湖岸木栈道，Marisol Duarte关掉妹妹发来的消息时认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Made a trial laundry rack for my sister. She finally put the heavy towels on it. Wants it lower now.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我给妹妹做了个晾衣架样架。她总算挂了重毛巾。现在想把高度调低。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She taps the requested height into her phone, then pockets it and looks out across the lake.
beats.chinese: 她把对方要的高度记进手机，再收起来看湖。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good thing I hadn't drilled the wall. I'll measure it with her tomorrow. Today, lake. Enjoy yours.
beats.chinese: 幸好还没往墙上钻孔。明天和她一起量。今天先看湖。你也慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the Toronto Islands lakeshore boardwalk, Casey Moreau is waiting for a radio-station coworker who suggested a walk. With Lake Ontario ahead and the shore wall and shrubs alongside, Casey looks up from their phone as you come into view.
beats.chinese: 多伦多群岛湖岸的木栈道上，Casey Moreau正在等一位电台同事，对方曾提议一起散步。前方是安大略湖，两侧是岸墙与树丛。你进入视线时，Casey从手机前抬起头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi! Are you a friend of Amara's? I'm Casey Moreau.
beats.chinese: 嗨！你是Amara的朋友吗？我是Casey Moreau。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Casey lowers their phone and shifts aside, keeping the boardwalk clear.
beats.chinese: Casey放低手机，往旁边让了让，保持栈道通畅。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm expecting a walk. Possibly several people. The details are slightly thin.
beats.chinese: 我在等人一起散步。可能还不止一个人。具体安排嘛，稍微有点少。

choices.english: I don't know Amara, but I can chat for a moment. What was the plan?
choices.chinese: 我不认识Amara，不过可以聊一会儿。原本怎么安排的？

choices.english: No, I'm just passing through. Hope you find your group.
choices.chinese: 不是，我只是路过。希望你顺利找到同伴。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Casey turns their phone inward rather than showing you the private conversation.
beats.chinese: Casey把手机屏幕转向自己，没有把私人聊天直接展示给你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She said, 'You should come for a walk sometime.' I sent 'Sunday?' and she liked it. So I moved my neighbours' pickle tasting.
beats.chinese: 她说，“改天可以一起散个步。”我发了句“周日？”她点了赞。所以我把邻居们的腌菜盲品会改期了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They open the conversation again, scan it, then nod with renewed confidence.
beats.chinese: Casey又打开聊天，扫了一遍，随后更加笃定地点点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A day and a thumbs-up. That seems fairly booked. Four jars of pickles are much easier to reschedule than a person.
beats.chinese: 有日期，还有一个赞。应该算约好了吧。四罐腌菜改期，总比一个人改期容易。

choices.english: You could ask whether she's actually coming. I'll leave you to check.
choices.chinese: 你可以问问她到底来不来。我就不打扰你确认了。

choices.english: I'd rather hear about the pickle tasting before I go.
choices.chinese: 走之前，我倒更想听听腌菜盲品会的事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Casey leaves you plenty of room and slips the phone into their jacket pocket.
beats.chinese: Casey给你留出充足的通行空间，把手机放进外套口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Sorry for recruiting you into a group that may contain exactly one person.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。不好意思，差点把你拉进一个可能只有一人的团体。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The phone vibrates. Casey takes it out, reads, and taps one finger against their forehead.
beats.chinese: 手机振动起来。Casey取出手机，读完消息，用一根手指点了点额头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah. She's at home. Apparently 'sometime' wasn't today. I had a whole departure time worked out.
beats.chinese: 啊。她在家。原来“改天”不是今天。我连几点出门都安排好了。

choices.english: Enjoy the lake, then. Goodbye.
choices.chinese: 那就欣赏一下湖景吧。再见。

choices.english: I'm stopping here to look at the lake. No need to move for me.
choices.chinese: 我要在这里看看湖。你不用特意给我让地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Casey types a direct question. A reply arrives before they can put the phone away.
beats.chinese: Casey直接发消息询问。还没来得及收起手机，回复就到了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She's at home. Right. I supplied the date, the place, and apparently her attendance.
beats.chinese: 她在家。行吧。日期是我定的，地点是我定的，看来连她会出席也是我定的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Casey sends a brief reply, pockets the phone, and turns toward the lake as your conversation ends.
beats.chinese: Casey简短地回了消息，收起手机。交谈结束，Casey转身面向湖面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I still think the thumbs-up was a reasonable clue. Anyway, thanks for the chat. Bye.
beats.chinese: 我还是觉得那个赞挺像那么回事的。总之，谢谢你陪我聊。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Casey switches from the message thread to a photograph of a handwritten tasting ledger.
beats.chinese: Casey从聊天页面切换到一张照片，照片里是手写的盲品记录。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Four jars, no labels. The neighbours vote. Garlic beat dill by two votes, and one person wrote 'too wet' about a pickle.
beats.chinese: 四罐，不贴标签。邻居们投票。蒜味比莳萝味多两票，还有个人给腌黄瓜写了条评价，叫“太湿了”。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A message appears over the photograph. Casey reads it, locks the phone, and turns along the boardwalk.
beats.chinese: 照片上方弹出一条消息。Casey读完，锁上手机，转身朝栈道延伸的方向站好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Amara isn't coming. I'll take my walk anyway. And I'm keeping 'too wet' in the official record. Bye!
beats.chinese: Amara不来了。那我自己散步。“太湿了”也会保留在正式记录里。再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the boardwalk. Casey stays to one side, no longer scanning the people passing.
beats.chinese: 你继续沿木栈道前行。Casey留在一侧，不再逐个打量经过的人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye! At least I can stop looking expectantly at everyone's face.
beats.chinese: 再见！至少我不用再满怀期待地盯着每个人的脸了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Casey silences the phone and puts it away, then faces the open water.
beats.chinese: Casey将手机调成静音并收好，随后面向开阔的湖水。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll stay a little. I came all this way.
beats.chinese: 我再待一会儿。来都来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You stop facing the lake, leaving room for others to pass. Casey remains nearby and reads the message once more.
beats.chinese: 你停下来面向湖水，留出供其他人通行的空间。Casey仍在附近，又看了一遍那条消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I moved a perfectly definite plan for this. People had already voted on a tasting date.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我为了这个，把另一个明明确确的安排挪了。大家连盲品会的日期都投票选好了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Casey types a short reply, pockets the phone, and starts walking along the boardwalk, leaving your view clear.
beats.chinese: Casey简短地回复后收起手机，沿木栈道走开，没有挡住你看湖的视线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm going to walk off some of that early arrival. Enjoy the view. Bye.
beats.chinese: 我去走走，消耗一下这份早到的劲头。慢慢看湖吧。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the Toronto Islands lakeshore boardwalk, Casey Moreau checks two jars tucked into their lunch bag. They recognise you and look up.
beats.chinese: 在多伦多群岛湖岸木栈道，Casey Moreau检查午饭袋里的两个罐子，抬头认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Lent my neighbour two pickle jars. Got them back full of her own batch. That's an excellent way to get your jars back.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。借给邻居两个腌菜瓶，她装了自己做的一批送回来。要瓶子能有这种结果，真不错。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They check that both lids are secure and close the bag, pleased.
beats.chinese: 他们确认两个盖子都旋紧了，高高兴兴地合上袋子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mustard seeds this time, apparently. Looking forward to lunch. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 听说这次放了芥末籽。开始期待午饭了。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the Toronto Islands lakeshore boardwalk, Sasha Okafor-Ryan has arrived early to meet a friend and used the spare time for a walk. Standing to one side, with the open lake ahead and trees and a shore wall alongside the boards, she looks along the boardwalk and speaks quietly to you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在多伦多群岛湖岸木栈道上，Sasha Okafor-Ryan 提前到了与朋友约好的地方，利用空余时间走了一段。她站在栈道一侧，前方是开阔湖面，栈道两侧有树丛和岸墙。她望着沿湖延伸的木板，轻声对附近的你开口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can keep the lake in view all along this way. I'm Sasha.
beats.chinese: 沿这边走，倒是一直能看着湖。我叫 Sasha。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks her watch, then looks along a stretch of boardwalk she has not walked yet.
beats.chinese: 她看了一眼手表，又望向还没走过的那段栈道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm meeting a friend right here. Eight minutes early, so I thought I'd walk a little further.
beats.chinese: 我和朋友约在这里见。早到了八分钟，就想再往前走一点。

choices.english: Wouldn't it be easier to wait here?
choices.chinese: 在这里等不是更省事吗？

choices.english: Go ahead. Enjoy your walk.
choices.chinese: 你去吧。慢慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sasha looks back at the place where she has been waiting. One foot remains pointed along the boardwalk.
beats.chinese: Sasha 回头看了看自己刚才等候的位置，一只脚仍朝着栈道前方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's the obvious option. I've already seen this bit.
beats.chinese: 那是最现成的办法。这一段我已经看过了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She presses her lips together briefly, then turns her attention back to you.
beats.chinese: 她短暂地抿了一下嘴，重新看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry. You made a perfectly sensible suggestion. I leave early so I can do this.
beats.chinese: 抱歉，你的建议很合理。我就是为了能这样多走走，才特意早出门。

choices.english: I only meant it would make meeting your friend easier.
choices.chinese: 我只是说，这样跟朋友碰头更方便。

choices.english: Then enjoy the extra stretch. I'm staying here.
choices.chinese: 那就再去走一段吧。我留在这里。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sasha takes a couple of steps along the boardwalk. She keeps to one side, leaving the centre clear.
beats.chinese: Sasha 沿栈道走了两步。她靠着一侧，把中间留出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I haven't been along this bit yet.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。这一段我还没走过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She glances at her watch once more, then lowers her wrist.
beats.chinese: 她又看了一次手表，随后放下手腕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Only a short walk, though. My friend shouldn't have to come looking for me.
beats.chinese: 不过只能走一小段。总不能让朋友到了还得找我。

choices.english: I'll walk a short way beside you.
choices.chinese: 我和你一起走一小段。

choices.english: Enjoy your walk. I'm staying here.
choices.chinese: 慢慢走。我留在这里。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sasha brings her other foot back and settles at the tree side of the boardwalk, clear of the passing space.
beats.chinese: Sasha 收回朝前的那只脚，站到栈道靠树的一侧，不占通行的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair point. This is the spot we agreed on.
beats.chinese: 有道理。我们确实约好了在这里见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sends a brief message on her phone, puts it away, and takes a drink from the water bottle she brought for her walk.
beats.chinese: 她用手机发了一条简短的消息，收好手机，又拿出散步带的水瓶喝了一口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. She knows I'm here. I'll leave the rest of the walk for another day. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 好了，她知道我到了。剩下那段改天再走。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sasha gives you a small wave and sets off alone along the unexplored stretch of boardwalk.
beats.chinese: Sasha 朝你轻轻挥手，独自走向还没走过的那段栈道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just a couple of minutes out. I've allowed for coming back.
beats.chinese: 往前走两分钟就回。我把回来的时间也算进去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A few minutes later, she returns to the meeting spot. She checks her watch and gives you a brief nod without restarting the conversation.
beats.chinese: 几分钟后，她回到约定的位置，看了看表，朝你点了一下头，没有重新攀谈。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Back with time to spare. Take care.
beats.chinese: 回来了，还有余量。回见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You walk beside Sasha for a short stretch, leaving room for others on the boardwalk. She does not hurry to fill the gaps in conversation.
beats.chinese: 你和 Sasha 并肩走了一小段，也给栈道上的其他人留出空间。谈话有了空当，她并不急着接上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I do this with streets too. Same errand, different street. It takes a little planning.
beats.chinese: 走街道时我也这样。同一件事，换条街去。得稍微安排一下时间。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At her next watch check, she stops and turns back toward the meeting spot, lifting one hand in farewell.
beats.chinese: 再次看表时，她停下脚步，转向约定碰头的方向，抬手道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's my limit. I'm heading back to meet my friend. Enjoy the lake.
beats.chinese: 只能走到这里了。我得回去见朋友。慢慢看湖吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sasha turns toward you briefly before continuing alone. You remain where you chose to stay.
beats.chinese: Sasha 继续独自往前走之前，短暂地转身看向你。你留在自己选择的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes three steps, notices her water bottle sitting crooked in her bag, and stops to secure it before walking on.
beats.chinese: 她走了三步，发现包里的水瓶歪了，便停下来把它放稳，再继续走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nearly lost my water. Right, off I go.
beats.chinese: 差点把水瓶掉了。好，这就走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the Toronto Islands lakeshore boardwalk, Sasha recognises you and raises a hand in greeting.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到多伦多群岛湖岸木栈道时，Sasha 认出了你，抬手打了个招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm not meeting anyone today, and I still haven't decided how far to walk.
beats.chinese: 今天不赶着见谁，我反而还没决定走多远。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She glances along the boards stretching beside the lake without checking her watch. After a moment, she starts walking on alone.
beats.chinese: 她看了一眼沿湖延伸的木板，没有查表。停了片刻后，她独自继续往前走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll walk until I feel like turning back. Good to see you.
beats.chinese: 先走到想回头的时候。见到你真好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Inside St. Lawrence Market, bell-shaped decorations hang above the food counters. Devon Marchetti-Lowe stands on the customer side, studying a paper schedule with a grocery bag held at their side. They glance up at you nearby.
beats.chinese: 圣劳伦斯市场内，食品柜台上方挂着钟形挂饰。Devon Marchetti-Lowe站在顾客一侧，手边提着购物袋，低头研究一张纸质时间表。Devon抬眼看向附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If I give hardware browsing a finish time, does it still count as relaxing?
beats.chinese: 逛五金店也要规定结束时间，还算休息吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon looks back at the neatly timed entries for groceries, hardware browsing, and a pegboard project. They pause over the last two.
beats.chinese: Devon又看向纸上排得整整齐齐的时间，买食材、逛五金店、做洞洞板作品，每项都有安排。目光停在了最后两项上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Dinner's already in the bag. I've scheduled the pegboard time after the hardware shop too. Apparently my afternoon needs paperwork.
beats.chinese: 晚饭食材已经买好了。逛完五金店，连做洞洞板的时间也排死了。看来我的下午还得配套文书工作。

choices.english: That sounds like work. What's the pegboard project?
choices.chinese: 听着像上班。你在做什么洞洞板作品？

choices.english: Maybe. Is the whole afternoon on that schedule?
choices.chinese: 也许算吧。整个下午都排在那张表上了吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon glances from the schedule to you, keeping the grocery bag at their side.
beats.chinese: Devon把目光从时间表移到你身上，购物袋仍提在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A skyline. Well, actually—half a skyline. I've been very thorough about leaving it unfinished.
beats.chinese: 一幅天际线。嗯，其实——半幅天际线。在让它一直没做完这件事上，我倒是很认真。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They start folding the list, then stop at the words 'pegboard skyline' and press a thumb against that entry.
beats.chinese: Devon开始折清单，看到“洞洞板天际线”几个字时停下来，用拇指按住了那一项。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've scheduled a pegboard skyline for the rest of the afternoon. Very restful of me.
beats.chinese: 我把下午剩下的时间都排给洞洞板天际线了。可真会休息。

choices.english: A pegboard skyline? Have you got a picture?
choices.chinese: 洞洞板天际线？你有照片吗？

choices.english: I'd like to look on my own now. Have a good afternoon.
choices.chinese: 我想自己看看了。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon holds the paper below the display glass and looks down its neatly timed entries.
beats.chinese: Devon把纸放低到展示柜玻璃下方，低头看着那些时间排得整整齐齐的事项。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Pretty much, unfortunately. I mix and sterilize mushroom substrate bags for work. Apparently my shopping needs a production schedule too.
beats.chinese: 很遗憾，差不多都排上了。我上班负责混合蘑菇培养料，给料袋灭菌。看来买东西也得有生产排程。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They run a finger from the grocery entry to hardware browsing, then to the skyline project. Their smile tightens slightly at the final entry.
beats.chinese: Devon的手指从买食材划到逛五金店，再划到天际线作品。看到最后一项时，笑容略微僵了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hardware browsing next, then my half-finished skyline. I've given myself a whole extra shift.
beats.chinese: 接着逛五金店，再做那幅完成了一半的天际线。我给自己又排了整整一个班。

choices.english: You could leave those for another weekend.
choices.chinese: 那两项也可以留到别的周末。

choices.english: I'll let you get on with your plan. Have a good afternoon.
choices.chinese: 那我不耽误你的安排了。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon pockets the list and takes out their phone. They open a photo and hold it where you can see without either of you leaning over the food counter.
beats.chinese: Devon把清单塞进口袋，拿出手机，打开一张照片，举到你能看清的位置，两个人都不用往食品柜台上探身。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here. It's meant to be Toronto. At the moment, several buildings are taking the day off.
beats.chinese: 这张。原本要做的是多伦多。目前有几栋楼正在休假。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The photo shows an unfinished geometric skyline made with pegs. After giving you a moment to look, Devon pockets the phone and turns back toward the display.
beats.chinese: 照片里是用插钉拼出的几何风格天际线，还没完成。Devon留了片刻让你看，随后收起手机，重新转向展示柜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's my entire exhibition. I'll let you look at the actual food now. Enjoy your visit.
beats.chinese: 我的展览到此结束。现在不耽误你看真正的食品了。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon folds the list fully and keeps the grocery bag close to their side.
beats.chinese: Devon把清单彻底折好，将购物袋收在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I'll leave you to it.
beats.chinese: 当然。那就不打扰你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They move a little farther along the customer side of the counter and turn their attention to another part of the display, ending the conversation.
beats.chinese: Devon沿着柜台的顾客侧又挪开一点，转而看展示柜的另一部分，结束了交谈。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon looks at the two hobby entries again, then takes a pencil from their pocket.
beats.chinese: Devon又看了一遍那两项爱好安排，接着从口袋里拿出一支铅笔。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could. Well, actually—I set a two-weekends-a-month limit for that thing. I'd already forgotten.
beats.chinese: 是可以。嗯，其实——我给那东西定过规矩，每个月只用两个周末。我已经给忘了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They cross out the hardware trip and skyline session, fold the paper, and put the pencil away. Then they turn to examine the food at an unhurried pace.
beats.chinese: Devon划掉逛五金店和做天际线这两项，折起纸，收好铅笔，转过身慢慢看柜台里的食品。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Those can wait. I'm having a look here, then taking dinner home. Enjoy the market.
beats.chinese: 那些都可以等等。我在这儿看看，然后带着晚饭回家。祝你逛得开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon glances at the hardware entry once more and folds the list into precise quarters.
beats.chinese: Devon又瞥了一眼逛五金店那一项，把清单整整齐齐地折成四折。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. The hardware shop gets ten minutes. That's what I wrote, anyway.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。五金店分到十分钟。反正纸上是这么写的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tuck the list into the grocery bag, check that the handles are secure, and turn away from the counter to leave.
beats.chinese: Devon把清单塞进购物袋，确认提手拿稳了，便转身离开柜台。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Off to browse hooks like it's an appointment. Have a good one.
beats.chinese: 好了。该像赶预约一样去看挂钩了。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At St. Lawrence Market, you encounter Devon on the customer side of a food counter beneath the bell-shaped decorations. They look from one part of the display to another, then recognize you.
beats.chinese: 后来一次逛圣劳伦斯市场时，你在挂着钟形挂饰的食品柜台前又遇见了Devon。Devon站在顾客一侧，目光在展示柜里来回移动，随后认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello. Good to see you. I came in hungry. That was a tactical error.
beats.chinese: 哦，你好。见到你真好。我饿着肚子进来了。战术失误。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon starts to point at one option, lowers their hand, and gives a small laugh at the abandoned decision.
beats.chinese: Devon刚要抬手指向一样食品，又把手放下，为这个半途作废的决定轻轻笑了一声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Everything keeps making the shortlist. I'd better choose before I find more candidates. Enjoy looking around.
beats.chinese: 每样东西都能入围。我得赶在候选名单变长之前选一个。你慢慢逛。
