beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Inside St. Lawrence Market, bell-shaped decorations hang above the food counters. On the customer side, Rosalind Achterberg waits for Mrs. Okafor to collect her share of a bulk food order. Her full shopping bag rests against her leg, clear of the customer aisle. She looks up at the decorations, then toward you nearby.
beats.chinese: 圣劳伦斯市场内，食品柜台上方挂着钟形挂饰。Rosalind Achterberg站在顾客侧，等奥卡福太太来取合购食品中属于她的那份。装得满满的购物袋贴着她的腿，没有挡住顾客通道。她抬头看看钟形挂饰，又看向站在附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I heard they're filming something here. Have you heard that too?
beats.chinese: 我听说这里要拍片。你也听到这个说法了吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps the bag close to her leg and glances back up at the decorations.
beats.chinese: 她让袋子贴在腿边，又抬眼看看那些钟形挂饰。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's just something I heard. That might explain the decorations.
beats.chinese: 只是听来的。也许这些钟形挂饰就是为那个挂的。

choices.english: No. Where did you hear that?
choices.chinese: 没有。你是听谁说的？

choices.english: No idea. I'm just looking around.
choices.chinese: 不清楚。我就是随便看看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rosalind shifts the bag to her other hand. She answers immediately, as if the source settles the matter.
beats.chinese: Rosalind把袋子换到另一只手上，立刻答了出来，仿佛消息来源本身就足够可靠。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mrs. Okafor's cousin. He does deliveries. He heard it from someone on his round.
beats.chinese: 奥卡福太太的表弟。他送货，是听送货路上的人说的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes out her phone and opens a message thread with a coworker.
beats.chinese: 她拿出手机，打开和一位同事的聊天记录。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I make route signs at a climbing gym. I nearly sent this to our front desk. Someone there always wants to be in a film.
beats.chinese: 我在攀岩馆做线路标牌，刚才差点就把这消息发给前台了。那里总有人想上镜。

choices.english: I'd check before sending it. Those decorations could be part of the usual display.
choices.chinese: 我会先核实再发。那些钟形挂饰也可能是平时就有的陈设。

choices.english: I'll leave the film mystery with you. Enjoy your visit.
choices.chinese: 拍片的谜团就留给你了。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rosalind looks along the customer aisle for Mrs. Okafor, then turns back toward you.
beats.chinese: Rosalind沿着顾客通道望了望，寻找奥卡福太太，随后又转向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm waiting to split this order with my neighbour. She adds things to the list after I've left home.
beats.chinese: 我在等邻居来分这些合购的东西。我都出门了，她还往单子上加。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks a folded shopping list, runs a finger down it, and folds it again without putting it away.
beats.chinese: 她查看折好的购物单，用手指顺着单子划了一遍，又折起来，却没收好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Are you just looking around here, or have you got other stops?
beats.chinese: 你就逛这里，还是还要去别处？

choices.english: Just looking at the bell-shaped decorations for now.
choices.chinese: 眼下就看看这些钟形挂饰。

choices.english: I'd rather keep my plans to myself. Have a good day.
choices.chinese: 我不太想聊自己的安排。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rosalind pauses with her thumb above the message box. She switches to Mrs. Okafor's messages and scrolls upward.
beats.chinese: Rosalind的拇指停在消息输入框上方。她切到奥卡福太太的聊天记录，往上翻了翻。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hang on. It says he saw a camera. That's less than she told me.
beats.chinese: 等等。这里写的是他看见了一台摄影机。可没她跟我说的那么多。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She deletes the unsent message to her coworker and pockets the phone. Her attention returns to the food order.
beats.chinese: 她删掉了那条尚未发给同事的消息，把手机放回口袋，重新查看手里的食品。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave that out of the gym chat. Enjoy the market.
beats.chinese: 这条就不往攀岩馆群里发了。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mrs. Okafor comes alongside Rosalind carrying an empty shopping bag. Rosalind puts her phone away.
beats.chinese: 奥卡福太太提着一个空购物袋来到Rosalind身旁。Rosalind收起手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. Here's my neighbour. We'd better divide this before I forget which bits are hers.
beats.chinese: 你也是。我的邻居来了。我们得赶紧分好，不然我又要忘记哪些是她的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rosalind gives you a parting nod. Mrs. Okafor opens her bag, and Rosalind turns toward her with the first wrapped package.
beats.chinese: Rosalind向你点头道别。奥卡福太太打开袋子，Rosalind拿起第一包食品，转向她。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mrs. Okafor, apparently they're filming here. I was just telling someone. Did your cousin say what it's called?
beats.chinese: 奥卡福太太，听说这里要拍片呢。我刚刚还跟人聊起。你表弟说叫什么名字了吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rosalind follows your glance toward the bell-shaped decorations. She finally slips the shopping list into her pocket.
beats.chinese: Rosalind顺着你的目光望向钟形挂饰，终于把购物单塞进口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They do make a food errand feel a bit more cheerful. I've only been looking at my list.
beats.chinese: 有这些钟形挂饰，买吃的也多了点趣味。我刚才光顾着看单子了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes an earbud case from her bag and holds it ready, ending the conversation without asking where you will go next.
beats.chinese: 她从袋里拿出耳机盒，握在手里准备使用，没有继续追问你接下来去哪里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll get a few minutes of my audio drama while I wait. A missing suitcase this week. Enjoy your look around.
beats.chinese: 我等人的时候听几分钟有声短剧。这周讲的是一个失踪的行李箱。你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rosalind presses the folded list flat between her fingers. Her mouth opens briefly, then closes.
beats.chinese: Rosalind用手指把折好的购物单压平。她张了张嘴，又合上了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. Have a good day.
beats.chinese: 好。也祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns back toward her shopping bag and checks the packages against her list, leaving the exchange there.
beats.chinese: 她转回购物袋前，照着清单核对包装好的食品，没有再把谈话接下去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Two packets for her, one for me.
beats.chinese: 好了。两包给她，一包给我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At St. Lawrence Market, Rosalind Achterberg recognises you on the customer side of a food counter. Her takeaway order is being packed.
beats.chinese: 在圣劳伦斯市场，Rosalind Achterberg站在食品柜台顾客一侧认出你，摊主正打包她的外带餐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Won a game of solitaire while I waited. Had to tell somebody before I started the next one and lost.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。等餐时赢了一局纸牌。得趁下一局输掉之前，先找个人说说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The seller hands her the packed order. She puts the phone away and accepts it with both hands.
beats.chinese: 摊主递来打包好的餐。她收起手机，用双手接过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Lunch and a win. Good start. Enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 饭到手，牌也赢了。开头不错。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bell-shaped decorations hang above the food counters at St. Lawrence Market. Gloria Pemberton is checking a shopping list for the snacks she will serve her friends after their matinee.
beats.chinese: 圣劳伦斯市场的食品柜台上方挂着钟形挂饰。格洛丽亚·彭伯顿正在核对购物清单，准备给一起看午场电影的朋友们买些散场后吃的东西。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheese, crackers, grapes. No changes to the menu today, or I'll still be choosing combinations when the film starts.
beats.chinese: 奶酪、饼干、葡萄。今天不改菜单了，不然我能一直搭配到电影开场。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Standing on the customer side of the counter, clear of the passage, she gives her list a satisfied nod and looks over at you.
beats.chinese: 她站在柜台的顾客一侧，没有挡住通道。她看着清单，满意地点点头，又看向附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. That's decided.
beats.chinese: 好了。就这么定了。

choices.english: That's quite a list.
choices.chinese: 你的清单可真长。

choices.english: I'll just browse on my own, thanks.
choices.chinese: 我自己看看就好，谢谢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Gloria turns the list towards herself, revealing several neatly crossed-out items.
beats.chinese: 格洛丽亚把清单转向自己，上面几项已经整齐地划掉了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheese, crackers, grapes. My friends come round after our fortnightly film, and somehow the snacks require more planning than the outing.
beats.chinese: 奶酪、饼干、葡萄。我们每两周看一次电影，散场后朋友们来我家。不知怎么，准备吃的比安排出门还费心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks an item, then taps the remaining names with one finger.
beats.chinese: 她核对完一项，又用手指点了点剩下几样东西的名字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've settled the menu now. I can spend an entire morning considering a different cracker.
beats.chinese: 菜单已经定下来了。不然，光是考虑换一种饼干，我就能琢磨一上午。

choices.english: You could leave one thing unplanned.
choices.chinese: 也可以留一样，到时候再决定。

choices.english: Do you chat this much during the film too?
choices.chinese: 看电影的时候，你也这么健谈吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Gloria nods and turns her attention back to her list.
beats.chinese: 格洛丽亚点点头，把注意力转回清单。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I'll leave you to it.
beats.chinese: 当然。那就不打扰你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the list smaller, adding one last remark as she looks over the food counter.
beats.chinese: 她把清单折小，目光移向食品柜台，顺口又说了一句。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I used to arrange food for photographs. Retirement hasn't shortened my shopping lists.
beats.chinese: 我以前给食品摄影做摆盘助理。退休了，购物清单倒也没变短。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll have a look on my own.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。我自己看看就好。

choices.english: Was that the job you wanted?
choices.chinese: 那是你自己喜欢做的工作吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Gloria looks down the list again. Her finger pauses at the crackers, then moves on without changing anything.
beats.chinese: 格洛丽亚又看了一遍清单。她的手指在饼干那一项停了停，随后移开，什么也没改。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could. I'm going to be difficult and stick to this, though. I've already decided where everything goes on the board.
beats.chinese: 是可以。不过这回我就固执一点，照这个买吧。拼盘上每样东西放哪里，我都想好了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the list with a small, unapologetic smile and turns her attention back to the food counter.
beats.chinese: 她把清单折好，微微一笑，并没有要改主意的意思，随后重新看向食品柜台。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Very adventurous company, my friends. Very predictable crackers. Enjoy your look round.
beats.chinese: 我的朋友们很有冒险精神，我选的饼干倒是一点惊喜都没有。你慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Gloria immediately shakes her head. Her reply is noticeably shorter than before.
beats.chinese: 格洛丽亚立刻摇头，回答明显比刚才简短。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: During the film? No talking. Even a quick whisper gets a look from me.
beats.chinese: 看电影的时候？不能说话。哪怕只悄悄说一句，我也会瞪过去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her eyebrows relax, and she gives a brief laugh before turning back towards her shopping.
beats.chinese: 她的眉头随即舒展开来，短促地笑了一声，然后转回去继续挑选东西。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The credits roll and I'm everybody's problem again. Anyway, I'd better finish this shopping. Nice talking to you.
beats.chinese: 片尾字幕一出来，大家就又得听我说个没完了。好了，我得接着买东西了。很高兴和你聊了几句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Gloria nods and turns to inspect another part of the counter.
beats.chinese: 格洛丽亚点点头，转而查看柜台的另一部分。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Certainly. Take your time.
beats.chinese: 当然。你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She unfolds her list close to her chest and resumes checking it, leaving you to browse independently.
beats.chinese: 她在胸前展开清单，继续核对，让你独自浏览。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy the rest of your day.
beats.chinese: 祝你今天过得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Gloria turns towards you. She rubs a folded corner of the list between her fingers.
beats.chinese: 格洛丽亚转向你，用手指捻了捻清单折起的一角。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, actually. Thirty-odd years assisting food stylists in Toronto. People sometimes assumed I was waiting to become the photographer.
beats.chinese: 是啊，确实喜欢。我在多伦多做了三十多年的食品造型助理。有些人总以为，我是在等机会当摄影师。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She smiles and tucks the list into her coat pocket, freeing both hands to adjust her shopping bag.
beats.chinese: 她笑了笑，把清单塞进外套口袋，腾出双手整理购物袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I liked my own job. Retirement suits me too, especially the absence of hot lights. Lovely chatting. Back to my errands.
beats.chinese: 我就喜欢自己那份工作。退休也挺适合我，尤其是不用再受那些烫人的灯照着了。聊得很开心，我接着办我的事啦。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At St. Lawrence Market, you spot Gloria on the customer side of a food counter beneath the bell-shaped decorations. She looks up and recognizes you.
beats.chinese: 在圣劳伦斯市场，你看见格洛丽亚站在钟形挂饰下的食品柜台顾客侧。她抬起头，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello! Good to see you. My friends are each bringing something to eat after the film today. I'm only responsible for the grapes.
beats.chinese: 哦，你好！见到你真高兴。今天朋友们各带一样散场后吃的零食，我只负责葡萄。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tucks a small bag of grapes she has bought into her shopping bag, staying clear of the passage.
beats.chinese: 她把已经买好的一小袋葡萄收进购物袋，站的位置没有挡住通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's my part done. I don't have to rush off now. Take your time looking round.
beats.chinese: 我这份办完了，倒可以不赶着走。你慢慢看。

causality.presenceReason: 格洛丽亚来市场采购，为她与朋友们固定的午场电影活动准备散场后在家吃的零食。
causality.placeAttitude: 她把这里当作日常采购地点，乐于顺便聊天，也对已经定好的菜单感到满意。
causality.stayingConstraint: 清单尚未核对完，采购还没结束。她始终留在食品柜台顾客侧，不妨碍通行。
causality.currentGoal: 买齐已经定好的奶酪、饼干和葡萄，不再重新安排拼盘。
causality.currentState: 今天心情轻松、话多，对自己终于定下菜单有一点满足。愿意交谈，也接受玩家独自浏览。
causality.contactTrigger: 她看着自己的清单，主动向附近玩家说出奶酪、饼干和葡萄，并打趣说再改菜单就会一直搭配到电影开场。接触不涉及遮挡视线、让位或物品差错。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留退休食品摄影造型助理经历、固定午场电影、散场后招待朋友的习惯、干幽默，以及电影中禁止交谈的明确边界。她对既定菜单略显固执，对助理工作本身感到满足。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家接清单话题后，aa中她听见建议却仍坚持既定菜单，转回采购。ab中她简短说明观影禁语规则，随后恢复亲切并告别。玩家表示想独自浏览后，她答应不打扰，顺口以旧工作和清单自嘲收尾。ba中她不再延续话题，礼貌结束。只有玩家在bb主动追问工作，她才展开回答，随后继续办事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Trinity Street in Toronto's Distillery District, Gus Marchetti is waiting for his friend Dot after timing a winter walk. White temporary huts stand against the red-brick surroundings. Holding his old stopwatch, he notices you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在多伦多酿酒厂历史街区的 Trinity Street，Gus Marchetti 刚给冬日散步计完时，正在等朋友 Dot。红砖街区间立着白色临时小屋。他手里拿着旧秒表，注意到了附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Two minutes until our meeting time. Enough for a quick chat. I'm Gus.
beats.chinese: 离约好的时间还有两分钟。够聊两句，我是 Gus。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Gus lowers the watch and gives you a small smile, staying clear of the space people are walking through.
beats.chinese: Gus 放低秒表，朝你微微一笑，站在不妨碍行人通行的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If you're busy, that's fine. I'm waiting here for Dot.
beats.chinese: 你要是有事也没关系。我在这儿等 Dot。

choices.english: What's the stopwatch for?
choices.chinese: 秒表是用来做什么的？

choices.english: No thanks. I'll leave you to your wait.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，不聊了。你慢慢等。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Gus lifts the stopwatch slightly and checks it once more.
beats.chinese: Gus 稍稍抬起秒表，又看了一眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just under two minutes until Dot meets me here. She picked the Distillery District. I timed my walk while she had a look around.
beats.chinese: 离 Dot 到这里碰面还有不到两分钟。酿酒厂街区是她选的。她四处看看，我给自己走路计时。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the watch face inward, though his thumb stays against its edge.
beats.chinese: 他把表面转向手心，拇指却仍抵着表边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thirty years managing the floor at a TV shopping channel. I'm retired, apart from the odd cue-sheet job. Apparently the timing department stayed on.
beats.chinese: 我在电视购物频道做了三十年现场调度。现在退休了，偶尔还接点流程提示单的活儿。看来计时部门还没下班。

choices.english: Could you spare thirty seconds? Do you keep all those walking times?
choices.chinese: 能聊三十秒吗？你会把那些步行时间都记下来吗？

choices.english: Put the watch away. We can talk for a while.
choices.chinese: 把秒表收起来吧。我们可以聊一阵。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Gus gives a small nod and lowers his hand.
beats.chinese: Gus 轻轻点头，放下手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Two minutes to myself, then. No problem.
beats.chinese: 那这两分钟就自己待着。没问题。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tucks a glove cuff under his sleeve. The stopwatch hangs securely from its strap.
beats.chinese: 他把一只手套的袖口塞进衣袖里。秒表靠着挂带，稳稳地垂着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I allowed for a short walk before meeting Dot here. Finished a little early.
beats.chinese: 我安排了跟 Dot 在这里碰面前走一小段。结果提前走完了。

choices.english: I'll leave you to it. Take care.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰了。保重。

choices.english: Call it an unscheduled commercial break.
choices.chinese: 就算临时插播广告吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Gus presses the stopwatch and takes a small notebook from his coat. He opens it to a page of walking times.
beats.chinese: Gus 按下秒表，从外套里拿出一本小记事本，翻到记着步行时间的那页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thirty seconds, certainly. I keep a few. My tablet game gets more pages. Rhythm game. My nephew installed it, and now I'm chasing the next difficulty tier.
beats.chinese: 三十秒，当然可以。我会记一些。平板游戏占的页数更多。节奏游戏，我侄子装的，现在我正往下一个难度冲。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He briefly turns to a tightly packed score page, then closes the notebook when the watch reaches thirty seconds.
beats.chinese: 他短暂翻到一页密密麻麻的分数记录，等秒表走到三十秒，便合上本子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And that's thirty. Thanks for the chat. I'll keep an eye out for Dot now. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 三十秒到了。谢谢你陪我聊聊。我这就留意着 Dot。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Gus's thumb stops moving. Instead of pocketing the watch, he turns its face outward again.
beats.chinese: Gus 的拇指停住了。他没有收起秒表，反而又把表面转了出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A while needs a number. I've got a meeting time with Dot, and I'm keeping it.
beats.chinese: 一阵得有个具体数字。我跟 Dot 约了时间，得守着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes out a folded cue sheet, checks the pencilled meeting time, and returns it to his coat.
beats.chinese: 他拿出一张折好的流程提示单，核对上面用铅笔写的碰面时间，又放回外套里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave the chat there. Nice meeting you. Better get this hand back in my pocket.
beats.chinese: 那就聊到这儿。很高兴认识你。我得把这只手放回口袋了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Gus gives a small wave and leaves the conversation there. A little later, Dot comes into view along Trinity Street.
beats.chinese: Gus 轻轻挥手，就此结束交谈。过了一会儿，Dot 出现在 Trinity Street 上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All set. Take care, and enjoy the district.
beats.chinese: 妥了。保重，祝你逛得开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pockets the stopwatch and walks over to Dot, keeping clear of other people using the street.
beats.chinese: 他收起秒表，避让街上的其他人，走到 Dot 身边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There you are, Dot. Ready when you are.
beats.chinese: 你来了，Dot。你准备好了就走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Gus gives a quick, uneven grin and lifts a gloved hand.
beats.chinese: Gus 咧嘴一笑，笑容有些歪，抬起一只戴着手套的手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ten seconds, brought to you by warm gloves. We'd have sold six hundred pairs by now.
beats.chinese: 十秒钟，由保暖手套赞助。换在电视台，这会儿已经卖掉六百双了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He chuckles, pockets the watch, and closes both gloved hands to warm his fingers while he waits for Dot.
beats.chinese: 他笑了两声，收起秒表，戴着手套握了握双手，一边暖手指，一边等 Dot。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That got a laugh out of me. Thanks. I'll let you get on. These fingers need a quiet minute.
beats.chinese: 这话真把我逗笑了。谢谢。不耽误你了。我得让这几根手指安生暖一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a winter day on Trinity Street in the Distillery District, Gus studies a small sheet of sketch paper against a background of red brick and white temporary huts. He looks up and recognizes you.
beats.chinese: 冬日的酿酒厂历史街区里，Gus 站在 Trinity Street 的红砖街景与白色临时小屋前，看着手里的小画纸。他抬起头，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Four minutes left. Hello again. I set aside a little time for sketching today. Wanted to do more than time my walk.
beats.chinese: 还留了四分钟。又见面了。今天特意给速写留了点时间，不想光给散步计时。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Keeping his gloves on, he adds the final line to his sketch with a pencil. He looks it over with a pleased smile, then puts the paper and pencil away.
beats.chinese: 他戴着手套，用铅笔给速写补上最后一条线。他看了看，满意地笑了笑，然后把画纸和铅笔收好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Those few minutes were worth it. Good to see you. I'll carry on with my walk now.
beats.chinese: 这几分钟花得值。见到你真好。我接着散步去了。

causality.presenceReason: Dot 选择来酿酒厂历史街区，Gus 提前完成一段计时步行，在约定地点等她。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Trinity Street in Toronto's Distillery District, Marcus Delaney is studying the white temporary huts among the red-brick buildings. He has come for a winter walk on his day off. He shifts backward, then notices you close behind him and stops.
beats.chinese: 在多伦多酿酒厂历史街区的 Trinity Street，Marcus Delaney 正打量红砖建筑间的白色临时小屋。他趁休息日来冬日散步。他往后挪了一下，发现你就在身后，立刻停住。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, sorry. Nearly backed into you. I'm Marcus.
beats.chinese: 哦，抱歉，差点退到你身上。我叫 Marcus。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns to face you, one hand gripping his backpack strap. His eyes flick back toward the huts.
beats.chinese: 他转身面向你，一只手抓着背包肩带，目光又往小屋那边飘了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Came out for a walk. Got a bit stuck looking at those.
beats.chinese: 本来是出来散步的。看着那几间小屋就有点走不动了。

choices.english: What caught your eye?
choices.chinese: 什么让你看得这么入神？

choices.english: Could you give me a little more room?
choices.chinese: 能稍微离我远一点吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcus turns toward the white huts again, visibly pleased by the question.
beats.chinese: Marcus 又转向白色小屋，显然很高兴你问起这个。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The corners. Whole wall panels, maybe. That bit goes against the other… no, can't tell from here.
beats.chinese: 那些转角。可能是一整块一整块的墙板吧。那部分靠着另一块……不行，这里看不清。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He leans sideways for another view, edging closer to you without noticing.
beats.chinese: 他侧着身子换个角度看，无意间又朝你挨近了一点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I check tools in and out at a vocational training centre. Usually there's someone actually building something to watch.
beats.chinese: 我在职业培训中心管工具借还。平时一般都有人真正在动手做东西，可以在旁边看。

choices.english: I'll look for a moment. A little more space and less commentary, though.
choices.chinese: 我也看一会儿。不过请离远一点，少解说几句。

choices.english: What do you do for fun besides watching people build things?
choices.chinese: 除了看别人做东西，你还喜欢做什么？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcus immediately takes a step away from you, leaving a clear gap.
beats.chinese: Marcus 立刻往远处挪了一步，给你留出明显的空隙。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah, of course. Sorry about that.
beats.chinese: 嗯，当然。刚才不好意思。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pulls his backpack closer against his back and stays where he is.
beats.chinese: 他把背包往背上收紧，停在原处，没有再靠近。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Plenty of street here. Somehow I picked your bit.
beats.chinese: 这条街这么宽，我偏偏挤到你这块儿来了。

choices.english: Thanks. Are you working here?
choices.chinese: 谢谢。你是在这里工作吗？

choices.english: Thanks. I'll carry on.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。那我继续走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcus shifts away at once. You spend a moment looking at the huts together, with a clear gap between you.
beats.chinese: Marcus 马上挪开。你们隔着一段明确的距离，一起看了一会儿小屋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yep. I can do that.
beats.chinese: 行，没问题。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His lips part as he notices something, then close again. After a short look, he pulls his hands into his sleeves and turns back along Trinity Street.
beats.chinese: 他像是又看到了什么，嘴唇刚张开就合上了。看了片刻，他把手缩进袖口，转身沿 Trinity Street 继续走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, my hands are freezing. Take care.
beats.chinese: 好，我的手快冻僵了。回见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcus turns fully away from the huts. He straightens up, ending his sideways lean toward you.
beats.chinese: Marcus 完全转过身，不再盯着小屋，也站直了身子，不再朝你这边侧倾。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Pickup basketball. And flea markets. I keep finding odd hand tools I absolutely don't need.
beats.chinese: 打打野球，逛逛跳蚤市场。老能看见些稀奇的手工具，其实我根本用不上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He laughs and hooks both thumbs under his backpack straps. He gives the huts one final glance, then starts his walk again.
beats.chinese: 他笑了，把两根拇指勾进背包肩带。他最后瞥了一眼小屋，随后重新迈开步子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Anyway, I'd better do the walking part of this walk. Have a good day.
beats.chinese: 好了，既然出来散步，我也该真走几步了。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcus stays at the distance you requested. He shakes his head and loosens his grip on his backpack strap.
beats.chinese: Marcus 保持着你要求的距离，摇了摇头，松开抓紧背包肩带的手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No, day off. I work in a tool library at a vocational training centre. Routers, pipe cutters, all that.
beats.chinese: 没有，今天休息。我在职业培训中心的工具借用处工作。管铣机、切管器之类的东西。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances toward the huts, then deliberately turns his shoulders away from them and toward the open street.
beats.chinese: 他朝小屋看了一眼，随后特意转过肩膀，面向开阔的街道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nobody's building anything here, so I'm mostly staring at walls. I'll get moving. Take care.
beats.chinese: 这里又没人正在搭东西，所以我基本就是在盯着墙看。我接着走了，回见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along Trinity Street. Marcus stays back, leaving you room to pass without brushing his backpack.
beats.chinese: 你沿 Trinity Street 继续走。Marcus 留在远处，让你能从旁边经过，不会碰到他的背包。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure. Have a good one.
beats.chinese: 好，祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Once you have passed, he turns back toward the huts. This time he checks behind himself before changing position.
beats.chinese: 等你走过，他重新转向小屋。这次换位置前，他先回头看了看身后。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll watch where I'm standing.
beats.chinese: 我会留意自己站的位置。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another winter day on Trinity Street in the Distillery District, Marcus is checking a basketball invitation on his phone near the white temporary huts. His hands are cold even inside his gloves. He looks up and recognizes you.
beats.chinese: 又一个冬日，在酿酒厂历史街区的 Trinity Street，Marcus 正站在白色临时小屋附近，用手机查看一条打篮球的邀约。即使戴着手套，他的手还是冷。他抬起头，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. Just sorting out a time for basketball. Want to get a proper walk in first. Don't want to keep anyone waiting, though.
beats.chinese: 嘿。正在确认打篮球的时间。想先好好散会儿步，不过也不能让别人等。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sends a short reply confirming the time and puts his phone away. His eyes pass over the white huts without stopping to study them, and he starts walking along the same stretch of Trinity Street.
beats.chinese: 他简短回复，确认了时间，然后收好手机。他的目光扫过白色小屋，没有停下来研究，随后沿 Trinity Street 原来的这段街面继续走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There, time's set. That's a relief. Should be a good game. See you around.
beats.chinese: 好了，时间说定了。这下轻松了。应该能打场好球。回头见。

causality.presenceReason: Marcus 休息日先来 Trinity Street 冬日散步，被白色临时小屋的拼装方式吸引而停下。
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢看实际搭建留下的结构，对小屋好奇，但不进入、不触碰，也不假装了解其构造。
causality.stayingConstraint: 初遇没有必须留下的任务，冬日寒冷让他随时可能结束驻足。重逢当天另有令人期待的篮球安排，他正在确认时间，希望散步留够时间，也不让约他打球的人等。
causality.currentGoal: 初遇原本想散步，眼下想从公共街道看明白小屋墙体如何连接。重逢时正在回复篮球邀约，把打球时间说定后继续散步。
causality.currentState: 初遇心情轻松、注意力集中在小屋上，愿意聊天，却容易忽略身边距离。重逢时戴着手套仍觉得手冷，注意力主要在确认篮球安排上，对之后打球有所期待。
causality.contactTrigger: 初遇时他为换角度向后挪，发现玩家就在身后，停下并主动道歉、报上姓名。重逢时他查看手机上的篮球邀约，抬头认出玩家后打招呼。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留工具借用处助理身份、对真实制作过程的兴趣、碎片式自言自语，以及看入迷后靠得太近的缺点。被要求留空间或安静时立即照做。重逢以既有的篮球爱好呈现当天安排，他仍会扫一眼小屋，但没有驻足研究，也不邀请或默认玩家参加打球。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 拉开距离并停止解说，共看片刻后因手冷离开。ab 转聊篮球和旧工具，主动结束驻足继续散步。ba 保持距离说明职业，放下观察继续走。bb 不延长对话，让玩家经过，自己留下观察并先检查身后。重逢时他认出玩家并招呼，说明正在协调散步与打球的时间，简短回复确认后收好手机，因安排说定而放松，期待打球并沿原街面继续走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On wintry Trinity Street in Toronto’s Distillery District, Devon Achterberg waits for their friend Leon among the red-brick buildings and temporary white huts. With both gloves on, they hold a small audio recorder that is still switched off.
beats.chinese: 冬日的多伦多酿酒厂历史街区，Devon Achterberg正在Trinity Street的红砖建筑与白色临时小屋间等朋友Leon。他们戴着两只手套，拿着一台尚未启动的小录音机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. I’d like to record ten seconds of street sounds, without recording any conversation. Would you mind if I switched this on?
beats.chinese: 你好。我想录十秒街声，不录谈话。你介意我现在开吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon keeps their thumb away from the recording button and leaves you room to pass.
beats.chinese: Devon的拇指没有碰录音键，也给你留着经过的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It’s still off. If you’d rather I didn’t, I’ll put it away.
beats.chinese: 现在还关着。你要是不愿意，我就收起来。

choices.english: What are you hoping to record?
choices.chinese: 你想录些什么？

choices.english: I’m just passing through. I’d rather not be involved.
choices.chinese: 我只是路过，不想参与。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon keeps the recorder switched off and lowers it slightly.
beats.chinese: Devon让录音机保持关闭，稍稍放低了手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just the street. I usually take recording walks in the Don Valley. Leon picked this spot for our walk today.
beats.chinese: 就是街上的声音。我平时常去顿河谷边走边录。今天散步的地方是Leon选的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They briefly show you the recorder’s dark screen, then lower it.
beats.chinese: 他们短暂地把录音机熄灭的屏幕给你看了一下，又放低手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It’s off while we’re talking. I could catch ten seconds of the street, or leave it in my pocket.
beats.chinese: 我们说话的时候它是关着的。我可以录十秒街声，也可以让它继续待在口袋里。

choices.english: Go ahead. I’ll stand back while you record the street.
choices.chinese: 录吧。你录街声时，我往后站一点。

choices.english: Keep it off. I can chat for a minute.
choices.chinese: 先关着吧。我可以聊一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon puts the recorder into their coat pocket without switching it on.
beats.chinese: Devon没有启动录音机，直接把它放进外套口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I’m waiting for Leon. We’re taking a winter walk before I go home.
beats.chinese: 当然。我在等Leon。回家之前，我们约好在这儿冬日散步。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Despite your mention of passing through, Devon makes a small inviting gesture along the street.
beats.chinese: 虽然你已经说了只是路过，Devon还是朝街上做了个小小的邀请手势。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You could say a quick hello before you go. He repairs old radios at home. Usually has a story about something that finally made a sound.
beats.chinese: 走前可以简单打个招呼。他在家修旧收音机，总有哪台终于响了的新鲜事。

choices.english: All right, a quick hello.
choices.chinese: 好吧，简单打个招呼。

choices.english: No introductions, thanks. Enjoy your walk.
choices.chinese: 不用介绍了，谢谢。祝你散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: With your permission and with you standing back, Devon points the recorder away from you. They capture ten seconds of footsteps and street noise, then stop.
beats.chinese: 得到你的同意，等你往后站开后，Devon把录音机朝向远离你的方向，录了十秒脚步声和街上的杂音，随后停止。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That’ll do. The street doesn’t need a second take.
beats.chinese: 这就行了。这条街不用重录一遍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They save the file, pocket the recorder and give you a small farewell wave. Their attention returns to the people approaching along Trinity Street.
beats.chinese: 他们保存文件，把录音机放回口袋，朝你轻轻挥手道别，随后重新留意沿Trinity Street走来的人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I’d better watch for Leon. Thanks for the chat. Enjoy the rest of your walk.
beats.chinese: 我得留意Leon来了没有。谢谢你陪我聊会儿，接下来逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon puts the recorder away without switching it on and turns their attention fully to you.
beats.chinese: Devon没有开机，直接收起录音机，把注意力转回你身上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Gladly. I digitize old recordings at the municipal archive. Some days I’ve heard quite enough people talking by five.
beats.chinese: 乐意。我在市政档案馆把旧录音录像转成数字文件。有些日子，到了五点，人声已经听得够多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: For a minute, Devon talks about finding an unlabelled tape among their own obsolete-media collection. Then they check the street and give you a friendly nod.
beats.chinese: Devon聊了一小会儿，说起自己收藏的过时影音载体里有盘没贴标签的磁带。随后，他们望了望街上，友好地点头道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I label everything at work. Apparently my collection has negotiated an exemption. I’ll let you get on. Take care.
beats.chinese: 工作时我什么都贴标签。看来我的收藏给自己争取到了豁免。你继续逛吧，回见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Leon arrives carrying a bag over one shoulder. Devon lifts a hand to catch his attention without calling across the street.
beats.chinese: Leon单肩背着包走来。Devon抬手引起他的注意，没有隔着街喊人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Leon, a quick hello. This is someone I just met. Leon repairs old radios and somehow makes a tuning knob sound interesting.
beats.chinese: Leon，来打个招呼。这是我刚认识的人。Leon修旧收音机，连调频旋钮都能讲得挺有意思。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Leon stops and gives you a friendly nod. Devon shifts half a step aside, leaving the introduction there instead of launching another topic.
beats.chinese: Leon停下，友好地向你点头。Devon向旁边挪了半步，让介绍停在这里，没有再抛出新话题。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There, introductions complete. I’ll give you two some room.
beats.chinese: 好了，介绍完毕。我给你们让点地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon lowers their hand and stays where they are, leaving your route along the street clear.
beats.chinese: Devon放下手，留在原处，没有挡住你沿街走的路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. You did say you were passing through. I got one suggestion ahead of myself.
beats.chinese: 当然。你确实说过只是路过。是我多提了一句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They give you a brief, warm wave, then turn their attention back to waiting for Leon.
beats.chinese: 他们简短而友好地挥手道别，随后继续留意Leon的身影。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another winter outing on Trinity Street in the Distillery District, Devon stands among the red-brick buildings with their phone in hand. They look up and recognise you.
beats.chinese: 另一个冬日，Devon又来到酿酒厂历史街区的Trinity Street，手里拿着手机，站在红砖建筑之间。他们抬头认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello. Good to see you. My bowling group has started another group chat. That’s three chats for one lane.
beats.chinese: 哦，你好。见到你真好。我的保龄球队又建了一个群。一个球道，三个群聊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Devon mutes the notifications and slips the phone into their coat pocket.
beats.chinese: Devon关闭消息提醒，把手机放进外套口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. I’m happy to bowl with them. I’m leaving the chat administration to somebody else.
beats.chinese: 好了。一起打球我很乐意，管理群聊就交给别人吧。

causality.presenceReason: Devon已与朋友Leon约在酿酒厂街区冬日散步，在Trinity Street先到等候，手持尚未开机的录音机。
causality.placeAttitude: 愿意尝试朋友选的散步地点，关注街声，不承担导览或教学角色，也不把附近的人默认当作录音参与者。

causality.currentGoal: 先就录音向附近的玩家确认边界，仅在得到许可后录十秒街声，再收好设备等朋友到来。
causality.currentState: 今天有余力一对一闲聊，态度温和，愿意尊重录音方面的拒绝。介绍朋友的冲动仍略快于对方的意愿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the brick pavement by Gastown's Water Street steam clock, Noor Haddad is considering a personal photo. She stands beside the shop window with her phone held down at her side.
beats.chinese: 在煤气镇 Water Street 蒸汽钟旁的砖面人行道上，Noor Haddad 正琢磨着拍张照片留念。她站在店窗旁，拿着手机的手一直垂在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd like a photograph of the whole clock. This angle might include you. Would you mind being in it?
beats.chinese: 想拍张整座钟的照片。从这个角度可能会把你拍进去，你介意吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps the phone at her side and glances up at the clock, waiting for your answer.
beats.chinese: 她把手机垂在身侧，抬眼看看钟，等你回答。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I haven't lifted it yet. You don't need to move or pose.
beats.chinese: 我还没举起手机。你不用挪地方，也不用摆姿势。

choices.english: What caught your eye?
choices.chinese: 是什么吸引了你？

choices.english: Please keep me out of the photo.
choices.chinese: 请别把我拍进去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Noor keeps the phone lowered and looks up at the clock.
beats.chinese: Noor没有举起手机，抬头看向钟。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The clock. I put small interesting things on a list on my kitchen wall. It's getting difficult to see the paint.
beats.chinese: 这座钟。我把有意思的小东西记下来，贴在厨房墙上。墙漆都快看不见了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She makes a small rectangle with her free hand, then drops it when the shape proves useless.
beats.chinese: 她用空着的那只手比了个小方框，发现没什么用，又放下了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I keep fermentation logs at a brewery all week. This list gets to have things that don't need measuring.
beats.chinese: 我整周在酒厂记发酵日志。这张清单可以放点不用量来量去的东西。

choices.english: All those records. You sound like you could sort out anyone's life.
choices.chinese: 记这么多东西，感觉你能把谁的人生都理顺。

choices.english: Go ahead with the clock. Please keep me outside the frame.
choices.chinese: 你拍钟吧。把我避开就好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Noor turns the phone's screen off immediately.
beats.chinese: Noor 立刻关掉了手机屏幕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. You won't be in it.
beats.chinese: 当然，不会把你拍进去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips the phone into her pocket and leaves room beside the window.
beats.chinese: 她把手机放进口袋，让出窗边的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The clock can manage without another photograph for a minute.
beats.chinese: 这座钟暂时少一张照片，也应付得来。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll leave you to it.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，那就不打扰你了。

choices.english: We can talk. I just don't want a photo.
choices.chinese: 聊聊没关系，我只是不想入镜。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Noor's hand stops halfway back to her phone. Her expression goes flat.
beats.chinese: Noor 正要重新拿起手机，手停在半途，脸上的神情淡了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's a large job to give someone you've just met.
beats.chinese: 刚认识就给人安排这么大的差事啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the phone away and turns her attention back to the clock, ending the photo attempt.
beats.chinese: 她收好手机，把注意力转回钟上，不再尝试拍照。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave the picture unfinished. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 这张照片就先不拍了。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Noor waits for a clear frame, then raises her phone with the lens angled away from you.
beats.chinese: Noor等画面让开后举起手机，把镜头转向避开你的角度。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. Roof, face, base. All of it this time.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。顶、钟面、底座。这回全拍进来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes one photograph of the clock, checks its edges and pockets the phone.
beats.chinese: 她拍了一张钟的照片，检查画面边缘，收起手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That'll go on the kitchen wall. I'll find room. Enjoy your day.
beats.chinese: 这张要贴厨房墙上。总能找出地方。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Noor gives a small nod and stays beside the window, her phone safely pocketed.
beats.chinese: Noor 轻轻点头，留在窗边，手机好好地放在口袋里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure. Take care.
beats.chinese: 好，慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns toward the clock and keeps the space beside her clear. The exchange ends without another attempt at a photograph.
beats.chinese: 她转向钟，继续空着身旁的位置。这段交谈结束了，她没有再举起手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll keep the camera down.
beats.chinese: 我不会举起相机的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Noor takes her hand away from the pocket holding her phone.
beats.chinese: Noor 把手从装着手机的口袋旁移开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I'm Noor. I keep fermentation logs at a small brewery.
beats.chinese: 明白。我叫 Noor，在一家小啤酒厂做发酵记录。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She glances at the window, then back at the clock. Her mouth lifts slightly.
beats.chinese: 她看看窗玻璃，又看看钟，嘴角略微扬起。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Temperatures and yeast readings all week. Apparently I spend my time off considering clocks. Anyway, nice talking to you.
beats.chinese: 整周都是温度和酵母读数。到了休息日，又开始琢磨钟。总之，很高兴聊这几句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a later outing by the Water Street steam clock, Noor stands on the brick pavement outside the shop window, listening to an old film score. She pauses the music, looks up, and recognizes you.
beats.chinese: 另一天，在 Water Street 蒸汽钟旁，Noor 站在店窗外的砖面人行道上，听着一部老电影的配乐。她暂停音乐，抬起头，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. I listened to the same short passage twice today, on purpose. Only caught one low note the second time.
beats.chinese: 噢，又见面了。今天我特意把同一小段听了两遍。第二遍才注意到一个低音。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts her earphones away and looks at the indoor tables reflected in the glass. She seems pleased, with no hurry to do anything else.
beats.chinese: 她收起耳机，看看玻璃里室内餐桌的倒影。她看起来心满意足，也不急着做别的事。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No research today. Liking it is enough. Good to see you. Take care.
beats.chinese: 今天不考据。喜欢就够了。见到你真好。回见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Outside a shop window on Water Street, Marlowe Trelawney studies the Gastown Steam Clock with an open notebook held low in front of them. They came to find a shape for a rubber stamp. Still looking at the clock, they fold the notebook halfway shut.
beats.chinese: 在 Water Street 的店窗外，Marlowe Trelawney 把摊开的笔记本放在身前低处，观察煤气镇蒸汽钟。他们来这里，是想找个适合刻橡皮章的形状。他们仍看着钟，把本子合上一半。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's enough. Any more detail and it'll be a quote.
beats.chinese: 够了，再添细节就成报价单了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlowe notices you nearby and glances over. The notebook stays low, turned toward them.
beats.chinese: Marlowe 注意到近旁的你，朝你看了一眼。本子仍低放着，朝向他们自己。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I mean my sketch. I'm Marlowe. I'm off work. I don't want to record every last detail.
beats.chinese: 我说的是自己的草图。我叫 Marlowe。下班了，不想再把每个细节都记全。

choices.english: What's the sketch for?
choices.chinese: 这张草图是做什么用的？

choices.english: Thanks. I'll just look at the clock.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。我看看钟就好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlowe keeps the open notebook at waist height so you can see. A few loose outlines fill the page.
beats.chinese: Marlowe 把摊开的本子保持在腰间，让你看清。纸上画着几个松散的轮廓。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Rubber stamps. I quote landscape stone for work. Twenty-two years of getting sizes right.
beats.chinese: 橡皮章。我做景观石材报价。尺寸得弄准，干了二十二年了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They take the pencil out and add a short line to the clock outline.
beats.chinese: 他们取出铅笔，在钟的轮廓上添了一小笔。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: At home I carve leaves. Eavestroughs, sometimes. This clock might make the cut.
beats.chinese: 在家就刻刻叶子。有时也刻屋檐排水槽。这座钟也许能入选。

choices.english: How do you decide where to make each cut?
choices.chinese: 你怎么决定每一刀该刻在哪里？

choices.english: Could I see the shape you've picked?
choices.chinese: 能看看你选中的形状吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlowe turns their attention back to the notebook held low in front of them.
beats.chinese: Marlowe 把注意力转回放在身前低处的本子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I'll carry on with this.
beats.chinese: 当然。我接着画。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They glance from the page to the dining tables reflected in the glass, then stop their pencil.
beats.chinese: 他们看看纸页，又看看玻璃里映出的餐桌，铅笔停了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've given the clock a dining table. Wrong side of the glass.
beats.chinese: 我给钟添了张餐桌。看串了，画成玻璃里的了。

choices.english: A clock with a dinner reservation. Now I'd like to see that.
choices.chinese: 一座订了位吃晚饭的钟。这下我倒想看看了。

choices.english: I'll leave you to it. Take care.
choices.chinese: 那就不打扰你了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlowe pauses with the pencil above the page, then gives a small shake of the head.
beats.chinese: Marlowe 的铅笔悬在纸上，停了停，随后轻轻摇头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I couldn't give you steps. I cut a bit, look at it, and carry on.
beats.chinese: 要我讲步骤，我讲不出来。就是刻一点，看看，再接着刻。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn the notebook back toward themselves and resume the outline, keeping it below your view of the clock.
beats.chinese: 他们把本子转回自己面前，继续画轮廓，仍旧放得很低，没有挡住你看钟。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's the whole account, I'm afraid. Enjoy the view. I'm going to finish this bit.
beats.chinese: 恐怕就只能说这么多了。你慢慢看，我把这点画完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlowe turns the notebook so you can see a simplified outline of the clock.
beats.chinese: Marlowe 把本子转给你看，上面是简化过的钟的轮廓。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. I've left out most of the bits I'd regret carving.
beats.chinese: 就是这个。那些刻起来会后悔的细节，大多让我省掉了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: After holding it steady for a moment, they close the notebook and tuck it under their arm. They turn along the brick pavement.
beats.chinese: 他们稳稳举了一会儿，随后合上本子，夹到腋下，转身沿着砖面人行道准备离开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That'll do. I've got what I came for. Enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 行了。要找的东西找到了。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlowe gives a short laugh and angles the notebook toward you. Beneath the clock is a lopsided rectangle with three legs.
beats.chinese: Marlowe 短促地笑了一声，把本子斜过来给你看。钟的下面有个歪斜的长方形，长着三条腿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It booked the wobbly table. Poor choice.
beats.chinese: 它订了张晃悠的桌子。眼光不怎么样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They add the missing fourth leg, then put the pencil away and close the notebook.
beats.chinese: 他们补上缺的第四条桌腿，收起铅笔，合上本子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Dinner's safe. Enough drawing for me.
beats.chinese: 好了。这顿饭稳当了。我也画够了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you leave the conversation, Marlowe turns back to the notebook at their waist.
beats.chinese: 你结束交谈准备离开，Marlowe 重新看向腰间的本子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. Take care.
beats.chinese: 你也是。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They erase the table shape and look directly at the clock before setting the pencil to the page again.
beats.chinese: 他们擦去餐桌的形状，直接看了看钟，才重新落笔。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Just the clock.
beats.chinese: 好。这回只画钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the Water Street Steam Clock, Marlowe stands on the brick pavement outside the window, reading their phone. They look up and recognize you.
beats.chinese: 在 Water Street 蒸汽钟旁，Marlowe 正站在店窗外的砖面人行道上看手机。他们抬起头，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Priya's watering my plants. She's sent a complaint about the fig.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。Priya 在替我浇花。她发消息来投诉我的无花果。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlowe reads the next message, presses their lips together briefly, and pockets the phone.
beats.chinese: Marlowe 看完下一条消息，短暂地抿了抿嘴，把手机放回口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It leans. She's turned the pot. Apparently that's the matter settled.
beats.chinese: 它长歪了。她把花盆转了个方向。这事看来算处理完了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Outside a window on Water Street in Gastown, Ren Osei is finishing a Sunday sketch of the steam clock. A magazine scrap is secured under the sketchbook cover. Ren looks up at you.
beats.chinese: 在煤气镇 Water Street 的一扇店窗外，Ren Osei 正画着周日的蒸汽钟速写。一片杂志剪纸稳稳夹在速写本封皮下。Ren 抬头看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Ren. I think the tables reflected in the glass on the left catch your eye before the clock does. That patch of tabletop, specifically.
beats.chinese: 我叫 Ren。我觉得左边玻璃里映出的餐桌比钟更抢眼。具体说，就是桌面那一块。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ren lowers the sketchbook and glances from the reflected tables to the clock.
beats.chinese: Ren 放低速写本，视线从餐桌倒影移向蒸汽钟。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came to draw the clock before my noon cutoff. I'm curious what someone else sees first. What caught your eye?
beats.chinese: 我想趁中午停手前画画这座钟。我想知道别人第一眼会看到什么。你先注意到了什么？

choices.english: Yes, those tables definitely catch your eye first.
choices.chinese: 对，第一眼确实会注意到那些桌子。

choices.english: I notice the clock first. What's the scrap for?
choices.chinese: 我第一眼注意到的是钟。那片剪纸是做什么的？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ren's small smile fades. They lower the sketchbook instead of turning it toward you.
beats.chinese: Ren 脸上那点笑意淡了。他们把速写本放低，没有翻过来给你看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Which part caught your eye?
beats.chinese: 哪一部分吸引了你的注意？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They indicate the reflected tables in the glass with the blunt end of their pencil.
beats.chinese: 他们用铅笔的钝头指了指玻璃里映出的餐桌。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Those table edges are what I keep looking at. You agreed so quickly, I wasn't sure you'd looked.
beats.chinese: 我总是忍不住看那些桌沿。你答应得太快了，我有点拿不准你有没有仔细看。

choices.english: Those tables, yes. I noticed them before the clock.
choices.chinese: 就是那些桌子。我先注意到它们，然后才看到钟。

choices.english: I only meant I heard you. I'll carry on.
choices.chinese: 我只是表示听见你说的话了。我继续走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ren slides the scrap out from under the sketchbook cover and turns it over. It is a small piece of an old magazine page, with part of a printed room on it.
beats.chinese: Ren 从速写本封皮下抽出剪纸，翻过来。那是一小块旧杂志内页，上面印着房间的一角。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's for a collage. I've been using it to hide the clock from my own view.
beats.chinese: 是做拼贴用的。我刚才一直拿它挡住自己视线里的钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ren holds the paper close to one eye, briefly covering the clock from their perspective. Then they lower it and glance at their watch.
beats.chinese: Ren 把纸片举到一只眼睛前，短暂遮住自己视野中的钟，随后放下纸片，瞥了一眼手表。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Even with it covered, I keep looking for the clock. You may have a point.
beats.chinese: 就算挡住了，我的视线还是会去找那座钟。你可能说得有道理。

choices.english: Actually, I've changed my mind. Those reflected tables take up more of the view.
choices.chinese: 其实我改主意了。那些餐桌倒影在视野里占的地方更大。

choices.english: I'll leave you to finish your sketch.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你完成速写了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ren looks at the reflected tables again. Their grip on the sketchbook loosens.
beats.chinese: Ren 又看了看倒影里的餐桌，握着速写本的手松了些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh. You had seen them. I was about to make a whole case for those table edges.
beats.chinese: 哦，你已经看到了。我刚才还准备拿那些桌沿好好论证一番呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their watch reaches noon. Ren closes the book, puts away the pencil, and turns toward the actual clock.
beats.chinese: 手表上的时间到了中午。Ren 合上本子，收起铅笔，转头看向真实的蒸汽钟。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's my Sunday cutoff. I'll just look for a minute. Thanks for stopping.
beats.chinese: 到我周日停手的时间了。我就再看一会儿。谢谢你停下来聊聊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ren draws the pencil back and leaves you room to continue along the pavement.
beats.chinese: Ren 收回铅笔，留出空间让你沿人行道继续走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. You weren't signing up for a discussion about a window.
beats.chinese: 明白。你也没说要参加一场关于窗户的讨论。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue, Ren folds the loose scrap inside the cover and adds one short line to the sketch.
beats.chinese: 你继续前行，Ren 把那片散纸折进封皮里，又在速写上添了一小笔。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ren pauses with the scrap halfway back into the book. They look from you to the clock.
beats.chinese: 剪纸塞回本子一半，Ren 的手停住了。他们看看你，又看看钟。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You've changed your mind? Wait. Taking up more space doesn't mean it catches your eye first.
beats.chinese: 你改主意了？等等，占的地方更大，也不代表第一眼就会注意到它。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They begin lifting the paper for another comparison, then check their watch. Ren presses the paper flat inside the book and closes it.
beats.chinese: 他们刚举起纸片，想再比一次，随即看了看手表。Ren 把纸片压平放进本子，合上封皮。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The clock has a fair case. And it's noon, so this is going away. Enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 那座钟也很有说服力。而且到中午了，该收起来了。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ren checks the unfinished corner of the drawing, then their watch.
beats.chinese: Ren 看了看画上没完成的一角，又看了看手表。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm stopping here, actually. Hobby stuff ends at noon on Sundays.
beats.chinese: 其实我准备停笔了。周日一到中午，我就不碰这些爱好项目了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They secure the pencil and scrap inside the sketchbook, tuck it under one arm, and walk a few steps along the brick pavement.
beats.chinese: 他们把铅笔和剪纸收稳，将速写本夹在臂下，沿砖面走开几步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That corner can wait a week. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 那个角可以再等一周。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ren stands on the brick pavement outside a shop window on Water Street and closes their sketchbook. They recognize you and raise a hand.
beats.chinese: Ren 站在 Water Street 店窗外的砖面上，合好速写本。他们认出你，抬手打了个招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I still think those reflected tables catch your eye first today. I'm not going to ask anyone else to check, though.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天我还是觉得那些餐桌倒影更抢眼。不过，我不打算再拉个人来核对了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ren studies the steam clock for a while, looking closely at its details. The sketchbook stays closed under their arm.
beats.chinese: Ren 认真看了一会儿蒸汽钟，神情投入，仔细打量着钟的细节。速写本一直合着，夹在他们臂下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The clock does look better than my drawing. You don't have to agree with that one. See you.
beats.chinese: 钟倒是比我画的好看。这句不用你同意。回头见。

causality.presenceReason: Ren 周日上午特意来画蒸汽钟，想在自己的中午停手时间前画上一会儿。

causality.currentGoal: 画下眼前的钟，并听听别人第一眼注意到什么，以核对自己关于餐桌倒影抢眼的判断，而非索取对速写的赞美。
causality.currentState: 起初专注且愿意主动交谈，听到迅速赞同时有些扫兴，怀疑对方没有仔细看。遇到具体观察又会投入。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the brick pavement outside a shop window, Gordon Aaltonen is reading while waiting to meet his daughter at Gastown's Water Street steam clock. His tote rests against his side. He laughs at a page and looks up toward you.
beats.chinese: 在店窗外的砖面人行道上，Gordon Aaltonen 正边看书边等女儿，他们约在煤气镇 Water Street 的蒸汽钟见面。他的布袋贴在身侧。他读着其中一页笑了起来，抬头看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My daughter got me into this. Says I talk about noodles more than my divorce now. I'm Gordon.
beats.chinese: 是我女儿带我看这个的。她说我现在聊面条，比聊自己离婚的事还多。我叫 Gordon。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tucks the food manga into the opening of the tote at his side, leaving the cover visible.
beats.chinese: 他把美食漫画塞进身侧的布袋口，封面还露在外面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm meeting her here. Got here early, so I thought I'd finish a chapter.
beats.chinese: 我在这儿等她。我来早了，就想着先看完一章。

choices.english: What's happening in that manga?
choices.chinese: 那本漫画讲到什么了？

choices.english: Let's skip the family details. I'm just here for the clock.
choices.chinese: 家里的事就先不聊了。我只是来看看钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Gordon takes the manga back out, keeping his tote against his leg and the pavement clear.
beats.chinese: Gordon 又把漫画拿出来，把布袋贴在腿边，没有占住通行的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The rival chef wants a rating after every mouthful. The poor man at the table only came in for lunch.
beats.chinese: 那个对手厨师每吃一口都要人打分。桌边那个人只是进来吃顿午饭。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He finds the page, then keeps talking with a finger resting on the corner.
beats.chinese: 他翻到那一页，手指压着书角，嘴上却接着聊起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I graft apple and pear trees around the Fraser Valley. About one in five of mine fails. Told my daughter that before I even told her whether I liked the book.
beats.chinese: 我在菲沙河谷一带嫁接苹果树和梨树，大约五棵里就有一棵失败。还没告诉女儿喜不喜欢这本书，就先跟她说起这个了。

choices.english: Let me see the scene at the table.
choices.chinese: 让我看看桌边那一段。

choices.english: I'll let you finish the chapter. Enjoy it.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你看完这章了。慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Gordon straightens and lowers the tote. His cheerful flow stops abruptly, though he stays beside the window.
beats.chinese: Gordon 站直身体，垂下拎着布袋的手。他兴冲冲的话头突然停了，人仍留在店窗旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Certainly. Thank you for making your preference clear.
beats.chinese: 当然。感谢您明确说明自己的偏好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns toward the steam clock, then gives you a small, rather official nod.
beats.chinese: 他转向蒸汽钟，又朝你郑重地点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Please enjoy your visit to Water Street.
beats.chinese: 祝您在 Water Street 参观愉快。

choices.english: No need to be formal. A joke about the clock is fine.
choices.chinese: 不用这么正式。开个钟的玩笑就没关系。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll look on my own.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。我自己看看就好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Gordon angles the open book towards you without stepping closer. A diner holds a bill while the chef waits with a notepad.
beats.chinese: Gordon把打开的书朝你转了转，没有靠近。画里食客拿着账单，厨师捧着笔记本等在旁边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He thinks the bill's a scorecard. The man wants to pay and get out. Can't say I blame him.
beats.chinese: 他以为账单是评分表。那人只想结账走人。还真怪不了人家。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: After giving you time to see the panel, he closes the book with a finger marking his place and turns back toward the clock.
beats.chinese: 他留了点时间让你看清那格漫画，随后用手指夹住页码合上书，转回去望着钟。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll let him escape in the next panel. Better watch for my daughter. Take care.
beats.chinese: 下一格让他逃出去吧。我得留意女儿来了没有。你慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Gordon lowers his finger to the next panel instead of turning the book toward you.
beats.chinese: Gordon 把手指移到下一格，没有再把书转向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I was about to tell you about pear trees as well. That's quite enough subjects for one pavement.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我刚才都快聊到梨树上了。在一段人行道上聊这么多话题，也够了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He settles the tote securely over his shoulder and resumes reading beside the window.
beats.chinese: 他把布袋稳稳挎到肩上，留在店窗旁继续看书。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Gordon's shoulders drop. He looks up at the clock, then back at you.
beats.chinese: Gordon 的肩膀放松下来。他抬头看了看钟，又看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I finally arrive early, and it's to wait for a clock. My badminton friends must never hear about this.
beats.chinese: 我好不容易早到一回，结果是在等一座钟。这事可千万不能让我那些球友知道。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He chuckles and shifts one step aside, leaving you a clearer view while he keeps his own place near the window.
beats.chinese: 他笑了一声，往旁边让了一步，让你的视线更开阔，自己仍站在店窗附近。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, I'll leave you to the clock. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 好，那我不打扰你看钟了。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Gordon accepts the end of the conversation with a nod. He leaves the space beside you open.
beats.chinese: Gordon 点点头，接受了谈话到此为止，也没有占住你身旁的空处。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I'll leave you to it.
beats.chinese: 当然。那就不打扰了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns back toward the window and takes his manga out, holding it low in front of him.
beats.chinese: 他转回店窗那边，拿出漫画，放低在身前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy the clock.
beats.chinese: 慢慢看钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another outing by the Water Street steam clock, Gordon closes his manga on the brick pavement outside the shop window. He notices you and smiles in recognition.
beats.chinese: 在 Water Street 蒸汽钟旁，Gordon 正站在店窗外的砖面人行道上，合上手里的漫画。他注意到你，认出来后笑了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I'm not meeting anyone today. Just finished a chapter and felt like standing here a little longer.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我今天没约人。刚看完一章，想在这儿多站一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps a finger between the pages, the smile still on his face. He stays beside the window without launching into the plot.
beats.chinese: 他的手指仍夹在书页间，脸上的笑意还没退。他继续站在店窗旁，没有急着讲起整段情节。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good ending. I won't spoil it. Lovely to see you.
beats.chinese: 结尾不错，我先不剧透了。见到你真好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the False Creek seawall, Léa Tremblay has stopped at the edge of the paved path for a late packed lunch. Her shoulder bag is tucked against her side, and her food flask is already open. She looks up at you.
beats.chinese: 在福溪海堤，Léa Tremblay停在铺装步道边，准备吃一顿迟来的自带午餐。她已把肩包收在身侧，保温饭罐也打开了。她抬头看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi! I'm Léa.
beats.chinese: 嗨！我叫Léa。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She smiles and lifts her spoon, speaking quickly as steam rises from the flask.
beats.chinese: 她笑着举起勺子，开口时语速很快，饭罐里正冒着热气。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I need two bites first. Lunch is very late. I do want to chat, though.
beats.chinese: 我得先吃两口，午饭拖得太晚了。不过，我不是不想聊天。

choices.english: That smells good. What is it?
choices.chinese: 闻着真香。是什么？

choices.english: I'd just like to look at the water.
choices.chinese: 我只是想看看水景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Léa lifts a spoonful almost before your question is finished, then holds it just below her mouth.
beats.chinese: 你的问题还没说完，Léa已经舀起一勺，又把勺子停在嘴边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Beef stew. Potatoes, carrots.
beats.chinese: 炖牛肉，有土豆和胡萝卜。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She eats, quickly takes a second spoonful, and lowers her shoulders. When she speaks again, her words come more slowly.
beats.chinese: 她吃了一口，很快又吃了第二口，肩膀随之放松下来。再开口时，她的语速慢了些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Now I can actually hear a whole sentence.
beats.chinese: 好了。现在我能把一句话听完了。

choices.english: How did lunch get so late?
choices.chinese: 午饭怎么拖到这么晚？

choices.english: Enjoy it. I'll keep going.
choices.chinese: 慢慢吃。我继续走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Léa turns slightly so her open flask and bag stay away from your side. The water and the homes across it remain in view.
beats.chinese: Léa稍稍转身，让打开的饭罐和包都避开你这一侧。眼前仍能望见水面和对岸的住宅。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I'll keep my lunch over here.
beats.chinese: 当然。我把午饭放在这边拿着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tucks the loose bag strap under her arm and takes a spoonful, leaving the paved route clear.
beats.chinese: 她把松垂的包带夹在臂下，吃了一勺，没有占住步道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Is this enough room?
beats.chinese: 这样地方够吗？

choices.english: Yes, here's fine. Those homes across the water have quite a view.
choices.chinese: 够了，这里挺好。对岸那些住宅的景色真不错。

choices.english: Could we swap places? I'd like to look from that angle.
choices.chinese: 我们能换个位置吗？我想从你那边的角度看看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Léa rests her spoon inside the flask while she answers.
beats.chinese: Léa把勺子搁在饭罐里，回答你的问题。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I stayed to finish checking a manifest. I'm an apprentice in a container terminal's documentation office. I kept saying, one more line.
beats.chinese: 我留下来核完一份舱单。我在集装箱码头的单证办公室做学徒。当时一直想着，再看一行就好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives a small laugh, checks her watch, then takes another spoonful instead of reaching for her bag.
beats.chinese: 她轻轻笑了一声，看看手表，随后又舀起一勺，没有伸手去拿包。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The paperwork's finished. I'm taking the rest of my lunch break now. Nice talking to you.
beats.chinese: 单据已经弄完了。现在我要把剩下的午休好好用掉。很高兴跟你聊了几句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the paved path. Léa keeps her bag tucked against her side.
beats.chinese: 你沿着铺装步道继续往前走。Léa把包收在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Enjoy your walk!
beats.chinese: 谢谢。散步愉快！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives a brief wave with her spoon, notices what she is waving, and laughs before lowering it back into the flask.
beats.chinese: 她拿着勺子朝你轻轻挥了一下，发现自己挥的是什么，笑着把它放回饭罐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nearly sent a carrot after you. Bye!
beats.chinese: 差点把胡萝卜也甩过去。再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You stay in your spot facing the water. Léa follows your glance toward the homes on the opposite shore.
beats.chinese: 你留在原处，面向水面。Léa顺着你的目光望向对岸的住宅。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They do. I'd spend ages looking out of those windows. Nothing would get cooked.
beats.chinese: 确实。我住那儿肯定会一直望着窗外，饭都做不成。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She smiles, turns back toward her lunch, and adjusts the flask securely in one hand.
beats.chinese: 她笑了笑，把注意力转回午餐，调整了一下姿势，单手拿稳饭罐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave you to the view. I've got potatoes to finish.
beats.chinese: 你慢慢看。我得把土豆吃完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Léa checks the clear space beside you and closes her flask before moving.
beats.chinese: Léa看了看你身旁的空处，先盖好饭罐才挪动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure. Let me put the lid on first.
beats.chinese: 可以。让我先把盖子盖上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You exchange places at the edge of the paved path. She settles a few paces away with her bag against her side and opens the flask again.
beats.chinese: 你们在铺装步道边交换了位置。她在几步外站定，把包贴在身侧，重新打开饭罐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There you go. Enjoy the view!
beats.chinese: 好了。慢慢欣赏！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the False Creek seawall, you see Léa watching the water from the edge of the paved path. She looks over and recognizes you.
beats.chinese: 在福溪海堤，你看见Léa站在铺装步道边看水。她转头看过来，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again! I finished lunch on time today. No rush along here now.
beats.chinese: 啊，又见面了！今天午饭准时吃完了，现在走这段路不用赶。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She leaves her phone in her bag and quietly watches the homes across the water for a moment. Then she turns to continue along the path.
beats.chinese: 她把手机留在包里，安静地看了一会儿对岸的住宅，随后转身准备沿步道继续走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can take my time today. Have a good afternoon!
beats.chinese: 今天可以慢慢走。下午愉快！

causality.presenceReason: 她核完一份舱单后，带着自备炖菜来福溪海堤吃迟到的午餐。玩家出现时，她已在铺装步道边收好肩包并打开饭罐。
causality.placeAttitude: 她喜欢在水边吃饭和短暂停留，把海堤当作日常休息、散步的地方。
causality.stayingConstraint: 午休有限，而且她已经很饿，想趁炖菜热着吃完。她愿意交际，但会直接说明需要先吃两口，不为聊天继续拖延进食。
causality.currentGoal: 先吃自带午餐，让肩包和饭罐不妨碍通行，再按双方意愿聊几句或各自看水。
causality.currentState: 起初因饥饿说话快、急着舀饭，但仍主动友善地打招呼。谈炖菜的分支中，她吃过两口后肩膀放松，语速恢复平常节奏。
causality.contactTrigger: 她在饭罐已经打开、肩包已经收好的情况下主动向玩家问好并介绍自己，随后坦白午饭拖晚了，需要先吃两口，同时说明自己仍愿意聊天。接触不再来自肩包险些碰人。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留她的码头单证学徒身份、炖菜兴趣、随和幽默、主动交际和饿时急躁的特点。她直接表达进食需要，不要求玩家配合自己的节奏，也不评论别人的饮食。保留魁北克家乡、二十岁迁居温哥华及原有家庭与生活经历。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家问食物时，她简短介绍炖菜，先吃两口再继续交流。aa中应玩家追问解释午饭被核舱单拖晚，随后结束交谈继续午休。ab中玩家继续走，她挥勺道别。玩家只想看水时，她礼貌留出空间并询问是否足够。ba中玩家原地看景，她接一句玩笑后转回吃饭。bb中应玩家明确要求盖好饭罐换位，在几步外重新开饭。
causality.spatialContinuity: 初遇和重逢均留在福溪海堤的铺装步道及其边缘，水面、石岸与对岸住宅保持分离。肩包贴身收好，停留和换位不占住通行路线。不新增座椅、柜台或其他设施，重逢只在原地看景后沿同一条步道继续散步。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Léa Tremblay。本次重逢位于福溪海堤，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the paved curve of Vancouver's False Creek seawall, Ingrid Solheim is finishing her early walk. The woman in the yellow coat closes a small harmonica case, notices you approaching, and promptly steps to one side.
beats.chinese: 温哥华福溪海堤的铺装步道弯道上，Ingrid Solheim正准备结束清晨的散步。这位穿黄外套的女士合上小口琴盒，看见你走近，便及时往旁边让了一步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Go ahead. I chose a silly place to put this away.
beats.chinese: 请过。我收东西的地方选得不太好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the case in her hand until its catch faces upward. The path beside her is clear.
beats.chinese: 她把盒子在手里转了转，让搭扣朝上。她身旁的步道已经让开了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It fits in the pocket. It catches on the lining every single time.
beats.chinese: 口袋是装得下的。就是每回都会勾住里衬。

choices.english: Is that a harmonica?
choices.chinese: 那是口琴吗？

choices.english: Thanks. I'll go past.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，那我先过去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ingrid holds the closed case flat on her palm so you can see its shape. She stays to the side of the paved path.
beats.chinese: Ingrid把合上的盒子平放在掌心，让你看清它的形状。她仍站在铺装步道的一侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. I bring it on my walks. A few tunes before there are many people about.
beats.chinese: 是。我散步会带着它。趁人还少，吹上几首。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She presses the catch once more, although it is already shut.
beats.chinese: 搭扣已经合好了，她还是又按了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Practising the same bar twenty times ruins a walk. Well, mine, anyway.
beats.chinese: 同一小节练二十遍，散步就毁了。嗯，至少我的散步是这样。

choices.english: Could I hear a short tune?
choices.chinese: 能听你吹一小段吗？

choices.english: So it's something you keep just for yourself?
choices.chinese: 所以，这是你留给自己的爱好？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You go past Ingrid. She keeps the case close to her coat, leaving the walking space clear.
beats.chinese: 你从Ingrid身旁经过。她把盒子收近外套，没有占用通行的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You're welcome.
beats.chinese: 不客气。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pulls back her cuff and checks her watch before turning toward the way she came.
beats.chinese: 她拉开袖口看了看表，然后转向来时的方向。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Seven exactly. I said I'd turn round at seven.
beats.chinese: 正好七点。我说好了七点往回走。

choices.english: Enjoy the rest of your walk.
choices.chinese: 祝你接下来走得愉快。

choices.english: Would another minute matter?
choices.chinese: 再多一分钟也有关系吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ingrid leaves the catch closed. She meets your eyes rather than pretending she has not heard the request.
beats.chinese: Ingrid没有打开搭扣。她看着你，没有假装没听见这个请求。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No, I've finished for this morning. I don't take requests.
beats.chinese: 不了，今天早上已经吹完了。我不接受点曲。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds her pocket open with two fingers and slides the case inside. Then she steps farther to the side and looks across the water.
beats.chinese: 她用两根手指撑开口袋，把盒子滑进去。随后又往旁边挪了一点，望向水面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nothing wrong with asking. Have a good morning.
beats.chinese: 问问没什么。祝你早上愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ingrid lowers the case. Her thumb rests on its worn corner as she answers.
beats.chinese: Ingrid放低了盒子，回答时拇指搭在磨旧的盒角上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mostly. I catalogue carpet borders at a textile museum two days a week. That's enough careful repetition.
beats.chinese: 大多是。我每周有两天在纺织博物馆给地毯边饰编目。仔仔细细反复做的事，已经够多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips the case into her pocket and starts back along the paved curve, giving you a small nod.
beats.chinese: 她把盒子放进口袋，向你轻轻点头，沿着铺装弯道往回走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I leave the unfinished tunes unfinished. Goodbye, then.
beats.chinese: 曲子没吹完，就让它没吹完吧。那么，再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the seawall. Ingrid turns fully in the opposite direction.
beats.chinese: 你继续沿海堤前行。Ingrid则完全转向了相反的方向。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too.
beats.chinese: 你也是。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She finally works the case past the pocket lining, then sets off at an even pace without calling you back.
beats.chinese: 她终于把盒子顺过口袋里衬，步子平稳地走开，没有再叫住你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. In at last. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 好了。总算放进去了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ingrid pauses before taking her first step back. She looks from her watch to you.
beats.chinese: Ingrid还没迈出回程的第一步，便停了一下。她看看表，又看看你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: To me, yes. Nobody's waiting. I just said seven.
beats.chinese: 对我来说，有关系。没人在等我。只是我说了七点。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She smooths her cuff over the watch. One corner of her mouth lifts, and she begins walking back along the curve.
beats.chinese: 她把袖口抚平，盖住手表。一边嘴角微微扬起，随后沿弯道往回走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've used up the extra minute explaining it. Good morning.
beats.chinese: 解释这件事，倒把多出来的一分钟用掉了。再会。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the False Creek seawall, Ingrid stands to one side of the paved curve, looking across the water. She recognizes you and turns her head toward you.
beats.chinese: 又一个早晨，Ingrid站在福溪海堤铺装弯道的一侧，望着水面。她认出了你，转过头来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. No harmonica today. I wanted a quiet walk when I left home.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天不吹口琴。出门时就想安静走一趟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps both hands in her coat pockets and looks back across the water. For a few moments, she says nothing.
beats.chinese: 她的双手仍留在外套口袋里，目光回到水面。她有一小会儿没有说话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This is fine for today. Enjoy your walk. I'll be on my way.
beats.chinese: 今天这样就很好。祝你走得愉快。我接着走了。

causality.presenceReason: Ingrid按习惯趁人少来福溪海堤散步，途中吹了几首口琴，现正收好准备回程。
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢清晨海堤人少，适合独自走路和短暂吹奏，不把公共空间当作表演场地。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有外部任务要求她留下。她给自己定了七点折返，另会短暂停步收拾口琴。
causality.currentGoal: 收好口琴，按自己定的时间结束这段散步。
causality.currentState: 神态平静，有简短交谈的余裕，但没有演奏给陌生人听的打算。
causality.contactTrigger: 收盒时发现玩家走近，她主动让到步道一侧并说明可以通行。
causality.characterContinuity: 短句、字面回答和轻微干幽默保留。把个人习惯说成定论后略作缓和，以重复按搭扣和坚持七点折返显出固执。

causality.spatialContinuity: 初遇与重逢均仅使用福溪水边弯道的铺装步道和可见水面、对岸住宅。人物留出通行空间，没有增加设施或进入石岸。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Vancouver's False Creek seawall, Walter Kambe stands to one side of the paved path. He came to record water against the stone shore for a friend's cassette. As you draw near, he lowers his handheld recorder and presses stop.
beats.chinese: 在温哥华福溪海堤，Walter Kambe站在铺装步道的一侧。他来录石岸边的水声，准备做进送给朋友的磁带。你走近时，他放低手持录音机，按下停止键。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's off now. I was recording the water. I'm Walter.
beats.chinese: 已经关了。我刚才在录水声。我叫Walter。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the recorder's dark display toward you, then rests it on a neatly folded cloth in his hand.
beats.chinese: 他把录音机已经暗下来的屏幕转向你，随后将机器放在手里叠得整整齐齐的布上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No need to stop. I just didn't want to point a microphone your way without saying anything.
beats.chinese: 你不用停下。我只是不想一句话不说，就把麦克风朝着你。

choices.english: What are you hoping to record?
choices.chinese: 你想录到什么样的声音？

choices.english: Could my voice be on that recording?
choices.chinese: 那段录音里可能有我的声音吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Walter looks toward the water, keeping the recorder lowered.
beats.chinese: Walter望向水面，录音机仍放在低处。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That little wash against the stones. There's a soft scrape at the end. I want a clean stretch for a cassette I'm making.
beats.chinese: 就是水轻轻拍着石头的声音，末尾还有一点细细的摩擦声。我想录一段干净的，做进磁带里。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He notices one corner of the cloth sticking out and folds it level with the others.
beats.chinese: 他发现布的一角伸了出来，便把它折回去，和其他边角对齐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got enough for now. I could put this away and have a little chat, if you'd like.
beats.chinese: 目前录的已经够了。你要是愿意，我可以把它收起来，聊几句。

choices.english: Yes, let's chat. You folded that cloth very neatly.
choices.chinese: 好啊，聊几句。那块布你叠得真整齐。

choices.english: Maybe in a minute.
choices.chinese: 也许等一会儿吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Walter checks the length of the recording without playing it aloud.
beats.chinese: Walter查看录音的时长，没有外放。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Possibly, at the very end. I stopped when you came close, but I can't promise it caught nothing.
beats.chinese: 有可能，在最后一点。我是等你走近才停的，不能保证一点都没录到。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the options for that recording and keeps his thumb away from the buttons.
beats.chinese: 他打开那段录音的选项，拇指停在按键之外。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can delete this take. Or keep it for the water, if that doesn't bother you.
beats.chinese: 我可以删掉这一段。要是你不介意，也可以留下来用里面的水声。

choices.english: Please delete it.
choices.chinese: 请删掉吧。

choices.english: You can keep it. I'll carry on walking.
choices.chinese: 可以留着。我接着往前走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Walter puts the recorder into his bag. He inspects the cloth as though the neat fold has only just come to his attention.
beats.chinese: Walter把录音机装进包里，又看了看那块布，仿佛这时才发现自己叠得有多整齐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nearly forty years pressing and finishing rented tuxedos. I still iron the tea towels. They never come back with gravy down the front.
beats.chinese: 我给出租的礼服做了将近四十年的熨烫和整理。现在连擦碗布也熨。它们倒不会送回来时前面沾满肉汁。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives a small chuckle, folds the cloth once more, and puts it away. Then he turns along the paved curve.
beats.chinese: 他轻轻笑了一声，把布又折了一次，收起来，随后转向弯曲的铺装步道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd better get a little walking in before I stop for another sound. Good talking to you. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 我得先走上一小段，免得又为别的声音停下来。跟你聊得很愉快。慢慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Walter's smile becomes brief. He closes his bag rather than leaving the recorder ready.
beats.chinese: Walter的笑容很快收住了。他合上包，没有把录音机留在随时可用的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. Don't let me hold you up.
beats.chinese: 当然。别让我耽误你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes out a pocket notebook used for sound notes and appointments. Turning to the week's plans, he crosses out several entries, then pockets it and turns away along the path.
beats.chinese: 他掏出一本记声音和约会的随身小本，翻到本周安排，划掉好几项，再把本子塞进口袋，转身沿步道走开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll head home. There's some dubbing I can get on with. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 我回家了。还有些磁带可以翻录。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Walter selects delete and confirms it. The recording disappears from the list.
beats.chinese: Walter选中删除并确认。那段录音从列表中消失了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. That take's gone.
beats.chinese: 好了。那一段删掉了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He switches the recorder off and wraps it in the cloth. He remains at the side of the path, leaving the walking line clear.
beats.chinese: 他关掉录音机，用布包好，仍站在步道一侧，让通行的位置保持畅通。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks for saying so plainly. I'll leave the recording for another day. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 谢谢你直接告诉我。改天再录吧。慢慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the path, Walter closes the recording menu without deleting the file.
beats.chinese: 你沿步道继续前行，Walter退出录音菜单，没有删除文件。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. I'll keep this one. Thank you.
beats.chinese: 好，那这段我就留着了。谢谢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps the recorder lowered while you are within speaking distance. With his free hand, he folds the cloth into a small square.
beats.chinese: 你还在能说话的距离内时，他一直没有举起录音机，空着的那只手把布折成一个小方块。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll wait a bit before I start again. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 我等一会儿再接着录。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a later outing at the False Creek seawall, you see Walter Kambe putting away his recorder at one side of the paved path. He finished recording before you arrived. He recognizes you and lifts a hand.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到福溪海堤时，你看到Walter Kambe正在铺装步道一侧收起录音机。你到来前，他已经结束了录制。他认出你，抬手打了个招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. That little stretch of water I just recorded is for me. I'm keeping it off the tapes I make for friends.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。刚录的那一小段水声，我留给自己，不准备做进送朋友的磁带里。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He wraps the recorder securely in his neatly folded cloth. Still listening to the water against the stone shore, he rests the wrapped machine in his hand, looking at ease.
beats.chinese: 他用叠得整整齐齐的布把录音机稳稳裹好，托在手里，仍听着石岸边的水声，神态自在。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can take my time with my own cassette. Nobody's waiting for it. Good to see you. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 给自己的那盘可以慢慢做，没人等。见到你很高兴。慢慢走。

causality.placeAttitude: 他熟悉并喜欢这里可采集的细小水声，也把沿海堤慢行当作日常消遣。

causality.currentGoal: 录下一段少有人声的水声，回家剪辑并转录到磁带。
causality.currentState: 初遇时温和、专注，愿意短聊，但对含糊的回应格外敏感。重逢时已经录完一小段留给自己的水声，正在收好设备，神态自在，没有触发退缩循环。
causality.contactTrigger: 初遇时玩家走近录音范围，他主动停机并解释麦克风的用途，避免无声地把设备朝向陌生人。重逢时录制在玩家到来前已经结束，他收设备时认出玩家并抬手招呼，不再引出录音隐私确认。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留退休礼服熨烫整理工的身份、近四十年工作习惯、整齐折布的执着、录音与磁带爱好，以及听到含糊回应便过度撤退的缺点。重逢时把一小段录音留给自己，不改变他为朋友制作磁带的长期习惯，也不暗示朋友疏远。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa接受短聊后，他谈起熨烫习惯，收机继续散步。ab听到也许后撤回交谈，还自行划掉数项本周安排并回家翻录。ba应明确要求删除录音并结束当天录制。bb获得保留许可，留下文件，等玩家走远再录。重逢时他主动招呼，说明刚录的水声留给自己，不准备做成送人的磁带。他把机器裹好，仍自在地听着水声，说给自己的那盘可以慢慢做，随后温和道别，不要求玩家收听、评价或参与录音。
