beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the False Creek seawall, Evald Krisjanis has stopped during his walk with tea from home. He reads a message on his phone and lets out a slow laugh, then notices you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在福溪海堤，Evald Krisjanis散步途中停下来喝自带的茶。他看着手机上的消息，慢慢笑出声，又注意到附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Asked a friend to look for a kettle. Said 'the dark one that pours well.' He's sent me a picture of his whole kitchen.
beats.chinese: 请朋友帮我看看水壶。说是“深色、倒水顺手的那种”。他给我发了整间厨房的照片。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers the phone. His closed tea flask and cup are secure inside the open bag beside his feet, clear of the walking route.
beats.chinese: 他放低手机。合好的茶瓶和杯子放在脚边敞开的包里，没有占用步道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Evald. Apparently I haven't narrowed it down.
beats.chinese: 我叫Evald。看来我的描述没缩小多少范围。

choices.english: Have you got the old kettle to compare?
choices.chinese: 旧水壶还在，可以对照着找吗？

choices.english: I'll leave you to your tea. Enjoy the walk.
choices.chinese: 不打扰你喝茶了。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Evald opens a photograph of a plain dark kettle on his phone, keeping the screen towards himself.
beats.chinese: Evald打开手机里一把素面深色水壶的照片，屏幕仍朝着自己。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Still use it. Lid rattles. Handle's right, though. My hand knows which one I mean.
beats.chinese: 还在用。盖子会响，不过把手很顺。我的手知道我说的是哪把。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks at the photograph, then at the message asking for a model number.
beats.chinese: 他看看照片，又看看朋友索要型号的消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Took the label off years ago. Cleaned kitchen exhausts for decades. Can't stand sticky bits left on things.
beats.chinese: 标签早几年就撕了。清了几十年厨房排烟系统，最受不了东西上留着黏糊糊的印。

choices.english: The model number might actually help him.
choices.chinese: 型号可能真能帮他找。

choices.english: Perhaps choose one in person, by the handle.
choices.chinese: 也许亲自去握握把手再选。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Evald puts the phone away and takes his cup and flask from the bag. He pours tea, replaces the cap and sets the flask back inside.
beats.chinese: Evald收起手机，从包里取出杯子和茶瓶，倒好茶、旋紧瓶盖，再把茶瓶放回包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. Tea travelled better than the description.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。茶比我的描述送得顺利。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His phone buzzes in his pocket. He leaves it there and takes a sip.
beats.chinese: 口袋里的手机震了震。他没有取出来，喝了一口茶。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He'll find something, or he won't. I'll have this first.
beats.chinese: 他也许找得到，也许找不到。我先把这杯喝了。

choices.english: Take care. Continue along the seawall.
choices.chinese: 保重。继续沿海堤走。

choices.english: Does your friend often help you shop?
choices.chinese: 朋友经常帮你买东西吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Evald considers that, then turns his phone to check the photograph of the kettle's base. There is only a pale patch where the label was.
beats.chinese: Evald想了想，翻出水壶底部的照片。标签原来的地方只剩一块浅印。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Would help. If I'd kept it. He asked that before you did.
beats.chinese: 是能帮上忙。如果我留着的话。他比你先问过了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sends the photograph anyway, adds that there is no number left and puts the phone away.
beats.chinese: 他还是把照片发过去，补上一句型号没了，再收起手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Still keeping the old one until I find a handle I like. Right, tea. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 找到喜欢的把手前，旧的还得留着。好了，喝茶。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Evald looks at his free hand, opening and closing it once around an imaginary handle.
beats.chinese: Evald看看空着的手，握了一下想象中的把手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. Five seconds holding it would tell me more than these photographs.
beats.chinese: 对。握五秒钟，比看这些照片知道得多。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tells his friend they can look together another day, then pockets the phone and takes out his tea cup.
beats.chinese: 他告诉朋友改天一起去看，收起手机，拿出茶杯。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll ask him when he's free. No shopping list for you. Enjoy the water.
beats.chinese: 我问问他什么时候有空。购物清单就不塞给你了。慢慢看水。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the seawall, Evald lifts his cup a little in farewell.
beats.chinese: 你继续沿海堤往前走，Evald稍稍举杯道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care.
beats.chinese: 保重。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stays beside his bag and drinks his tea, leaving the phone in his pocket.
beats.chinese: 他留在包旁喝茶，手机仍在口袋里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. Still warm.
beats.chinese: 不错，还热着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Evald keeps the cup steady in his hand and looks out across False Creek.
beats.chinese: Evald端稳杯子，望向福溪水面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sometimes. I mend things for him. He said we ought to keep a list. I told him we'd lose the list.
beats.chinese: 有时候。我也帮他修东西。他说该记张清单。我说清单会弄丢的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives a short laugh, then settles the cup into his other hand.
beats.chinese: 他短促地笑了笑，把杯子换到另一只手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He asks, I ask. Works well enough without totals. Nice talking to you.
beats.chinese: 他有事找我，我有事找他。不算总账也挺好。很高兴聊这几句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another outing at False Creek seawall, Evald stands clear of the paved path, reading a very short shopping list. He looks up and recognizes you.
beats.chinese: 在福溪海堤，Evald站在铺装步道旁不挡路的地方，看着一张很短的购物清单。他抬头认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Just potatoes and onions for dinner. I'm adding nothing else to the list today.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。晚饭只做土豆和洋葱，今天不往单子上添别的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds the list, puts it in his pocket and looks out over the water with a satisfied nod.
beats.chinese: 他把清单折好收进口袋，满意地点点头，看向水面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enough to eat, and easy to make. I'll finish this stretch of my walk first.
beats.chinese: 够吃，也省事。先把这段路走完。

causality.presenceReason: Evald照例在福溪海堤散步，停下喝自带茶，顺便读朋友帮找替换水壶的消息。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Granville Island Public Market, Mireille Fontaine is having lunch during a break from her East Vancouver soap workshop. Her paper lunch bag tips toward you from a shared table. She catches it before it falls.
beats.chinese: 在格兰维尔岛公共市场，Mireille Fontaine 趁东温哥华手工皂工坊的工作间隙吃午餐。共用桌上的午餐纸袋朝你这边倒来，她赶在袋子掉下去之前接住了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry, that nearly got you. I'm Mireille.
beats.chinese: 抱歉，差点碰到你。我叫 Mireille。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She sets the bag upright beside her half-eaten sandwich and carefully squares its base.
beats.chinese: 她把纸袋立在吃了一半的三明治旁，仔细撑平袋底。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nadia said standing it up saves table space. I'm trying it for a month. Two lunches, three near misses.
beats.chinese: Nadia 说把袋子立起来能省桌面。我打算试一个月。才吃了两顿，已经险些倒了三次。

choices.english: You could fold it flat just for this meal.
choices.chinese: 这顿饭可以先把袋子折平。

choices.english: No harm done. I'll leave you to your lunch.
choices.chinese: 没碰到就好。不打扰你吃午饭了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mireille looks at the empty top half of the bag, then at the small space underneath her sandwich wrapper.
beats.chinese: Mireille 看看纸袋空着的上半截，又看看三明治包装纸下面的一小块地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Fold it and put it underneath. That actually uses less space.
beats.chinese: 对啊。折起来垫在下面。这样占的地方还更少。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She flattens the bag beneath the wrapper, then takes out her phone and opens her calendar.
beats.chinese: 她把纸袋压平，垫到包装纸下面，随后掏出手机打开日历。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: What changed my mind was the space underneath. Fine, a month of flat bags, starting now.
beats.chinese: 让我改主意的是下面那块空地方。行，那就从现在开始，把袋子折平试一个月。

choices.english: I meant just this meal. May I take that empty seat?
choices.chinese: 我只是说这顿饭。我可以坐那个空位吗？

choices.english: That's your call. I'll move on.
choices.chinese: 那就由你决定吧。我先走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mireille draws the bag closer to her own place. The shared table edge beside you is clear again.
beats.chinese: Mireille 把纸袋收近自己面前。你身旁的共用桌边又空出来了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. The sandwich survived, so I'm calling lunch a success.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。三明治保住了，这顿午饭就算成功。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the bag's open top down twice, keeping one hand against its side.
beats.chinese: 她把袋口向下折了两折，一只手仍扶着袋子侧面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nadia probably meant one lunch. I should check before I put another twenty-eight in the calendar.
beats.chinese: Nadia 大概只想让我试一顿。我把后面二十八顿也排进日历之前，应该先问清楚。

choices.english: One quick question before I go. Why a whole month?
choices.chinese: 走之前问一句，为什么要试整整一个月？

choices.english: Enjoy your lunch. [Continue on your way.]
choices.chinese: 慢慢吃。[继续往前走。]

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mireille stops with her thumb above the calendar. She glances at the empty chair you indicated.
beats.chinese: Mireille 的拇指停在日历上方。她看了一眼你指的空椅子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh. One meal. Yes, that seat's free.
beats.chinese: 哦。就一顿。可以，那个位子没人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts her phone away and gathers her wrapper closer as you take the seat. Then she picks up her sandwich.
beats.chinese: 她收起手机，把包装纸往自己这边拢了拢，让你坐下，随后拿起三明治。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. No calendar entry required. Enjoy your break.
beats.chinese: 好了。不用往日历里记了。好好歇一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mireille leaves the bag flat and enters a reminder in her phone.
beats.chinese: Mireille 让纸袋平放着，在手机里记下一条提醒。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A month is excessive for a paper bag. I'm doing it anyway.
beats.chinese: 一个纸袋试一个月，确实有点过头。我还是要试。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you move on, she puts the phone away and lifts her sandwich clear of the folded bag.
beats.chinese: 你继续往前走。她收起手机，从折好的纸袋上方拿起三明治。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks for the correction. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 谢谢你指出来。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mireille sets her sandwich down for the brief answer.
beats.chinese: Mireille 放下三明治，简短地回答。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One awkward attempt feels unfair. I want to find out whether a method works once I'm used to it.
beats.chinese: 只试一次，做得别扭就否定它，我觉得不公平。我想知道熟练以后，这个办法到底管不管用。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She rolls her shoulder once, then draws her lunch back toward her as you leave.
beats.chinese: 她转了转肩膀。你离开时，她把午餐拉回自己面前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm also testing Nadia's sandbag grip at our rec league. My shoulder would prefer a shorter trial. Anyway, enjoy the market.
beats.chinese: 我在休闲联赛里也正试着用 Nadia 的握法扔沙袋。我的肩膀希望试用期能短点。好了，祝你逛得开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mireille gives you a small wave as you continue along the aisle.
beats.chinese: 你沿通道继续往前走，Mireille 朝你轻轻挥了挥手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The bag leans again. She catches it, tucks it against her own arm, and takes another bite of her sandwich.
beats.chinese: 纸袋又歪了。她扶住袋子，把它夹在自己手臂旁，继续咬了一口三明治。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Stay there. I'm eating.
beats.chinese: 待着别动。我得吃饭了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Granville Island Public Market, Mireille recognizes you from a shared table. An open notebook and a small closed parts box sit beside her wrapped lunch.
beats.chinese: 在格兰维尔岛公共市场，坐在共用桌旁的 Mireille 认出了你。她包好的午餐旁放着一本摊开的笔记本和一个盖好的小零件盒。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again! I've brought my weather-station notes to lunch. It keeps reporting rain in my kitchen.
beats.chinese: 又见面了！我把气象站的笔记带来陪我吃午饭了。它老说我厨房里在下雨。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes the notebook, puts it and the parts box into her bag, and unwraps her lunch.
beats.chinese: 她合上笔记本，把它和零件盒一起收进包里，然后拆开午餐包装。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The kitchen is dry. I've checked that part. Anyway, good to see you.
beats.chinese: 厨房是干的。这一点我检查过了。总之，很高兴见到你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Granville Island Public Market, Soren Baptiste is having lunch at a shared table. He arrived early to find a seat he liked. His bag is beside his feet as you come alongside the table.
beats.chinese: 格兰维尔岛公共市场里，Soren Baptiste正在共用餐桌旁吃午饭。他特意早来，挑了个合心意的位置。你来到桌边时，他的包就放在脚边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, this chair's free. I'd like to keep this one with my back to the aisle, though. I'm Soren.
beats.chinese: 哦，旁边这把椅子没人坐。不过我想留在现在这个背朝通道的位置。我叫Soren。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He settles back into his own chair, facing away from the passing traffic.
beats.chinese: 他在自己的椅子上重新坐好，背朝通道里来往的人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good light here, and I don't have to watch everyone squeeze past with lunch. Very pleased with myself.
beats.chinese: 这里光线好，也不用一直看着大家端着午饭挤来挤去。我对自己选的位置相当满意。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll sit here.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，那我坐这里。

choices.english: I'm just passing through. You really did choose that seat carefully.
choices.chinese: 我只是路过。你还真是认真挑过这个位置。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You take the empty chair. Soren lifts his fork, then looks past you toward the aisle.
beats.chinese: 你在空椅子上坐下。Soren拿起叉子，又越过你看向通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah. You get the brighter light from that side. I only checked mine.
beats.chinese: 啊，你那边的光更晃眼。我刚才只顾着看自己这边了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers his fork and glances between the two places, giving a small, embarrassed grin.
beats.chinese: 他放下叉子，在两个位置之间看了看，有些不好意思地咧嘴笑了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I arrange tableware for pop-up restaurants. I usually remember there's someone on the other side of the table.
beats.chinese: 我是给快闪餐厅统筹餐具的。一般来说，我还记得桌子另一边也有人。

choices.english: It is too bright for me. Could we swap?
choices.chinese: 对我来说确实有点晃眼。我们能换一下吗？

choices.english: This seat works for me. Enjoy your lunch.
choices.chinese: 这个位置对我来说可以。你慢慢吃。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Soren leaves the empty chair clear and turns slightly toward you without moving into the aisle.
beats.chinese: Soren让空椅子保持空着，稍稍转身面向你，没有挪进通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Absolutely. I can handle the chatter. Watching people pass right in front of me while I eat gets tiring.
beats.chinese: 那当然。说话声我受得了，可吃饭时一直看着人从眼前经过，挺累的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shifts his lunch a little closer and laughs at how neatly he has arranged his own place.
beats.chinese: 他把午饭往自己面前挪近一点，看看自己安排得妥妥当当的位置，笑出了声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I spotted this chair before I'd even decided what to eat.
beats.chinese: 我连吃什么都没想好，就先看中这把椅子了。

choices.english: I'll keep moving. Enjoy your lunch.
choices.chinese: 那我继续走了。你慢慢吃。

choices.english: Did you always pick your seat first? I'll listen, then get out of your way.
choices.chinese: 你一直都先挑座位吗？听你说完我就走，不打扰你吃饭。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Soren stands immediately and picks up his lunch and bag, keeping them close to the table.
beats.chinese: Soren立刻站起来，拿起午饭和包，动作都留在桌边，没有占用通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. Sorry, I got comfortable very efficiently.
beats.chinese: 当然可以。不好意思，我倒是很有效率地先让自己舒服上了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You exchange seats. He angles his chair slightly toward the table, away from the brightest light, and sets his lunch down.
beats.chinese: 你们换了座位。他把椅子朝餐桌稍微转了个角度，避开最晃眼的光，再放下午饭。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There, this angle works for me too. Enjoy the chair. I'll get back to eating.
beats.chinese: 好了，这个角度我也坐得住。你安心坐，我接着吃饭了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Soren nods and leaves both chairs where they are. The empty space between your places stays clear.
beats.chinese: Soren点点头，没有挪动两把椅子。你们各自面前的位置之间仍然空着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. I'll leave your seat alone, then.
beats.chinese: 好，那我就不折腾你的座位了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He brings his attention back to his food and takes a bite, ending the conversation without asking you anything else.
beats.chinese: 他把注意力转回食物上，吃了一口，没有再问你什么，交谈就此结束。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I've talked enough to let this go cold.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。再这么聊下去，我这饭都要凉了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Soren turns back toward his lunch, leaving you room to continue along the aisle.
beats.chinese: Soren转回身面向午饭，给你留出沿通道继续走的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Hope you find whatever you're after.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。希望你能找到想找的东西。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you move on, he tucks his bag fully beneath his chair and picks up his fork.
beats.chinese: 你继续往前走。他把包完全收进自己的椅子底下，拿起叉子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye. Enjoy the market.
beats.chinese: 再见。逛得开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Soren rests his fork on his plate for a brief answer. He stays turned toward the table so the aisle remains clear.
beats.chinese: Soren把叉子搁在盘子上，准备简单答几句。他仍侧身朝着餐桌，没有占住通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Pretty much. Big family in Halifax. If you wanted a particular dinner seat, you got there early.
beats.chinese: 差不多吧。我在哈利法克斯的大家庭里长大。晚饭想坐哪个位置，就得早点到。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances at his carefully positioned chair and chuckles. As you leave, he turns back to his plate.
beats.chinese: 他瞄了一眼自己精心选定的座位，笑了笑。你离开时，他也转回身继续吃饭。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nobody's competing with me for it today. Apparently I came prepared anyway. Bye!
beats.chinese: 今天倒没人跟我抢。看来我还是早早做好准备了。再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Granville Island Public Market, you pass Soren at a shared table. A bowl of soup sits in front of him. He recognizes you and raises a hand.
beats.chinese: 在格兰维尔岛公共市场，你经过共用餐桌旁的Soren。他面前放着一碗汤。他认出你，抬手打了个招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hi again. This soup's too hot, so lunch is taking a minute.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。这汤太烫，午饭还得等一等。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stirs the soup, lifts a little in his spoon, then puts it down again with a rueful smile.
beats.chinese: 他搅了搅汤，舀起一点，又无奈地笑着把勺子放下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm hungry enough to check every ten seconds. It hasn't helped yet. Anyway, good to see you.
beats.chinese: 我饿得每隔十秒就想试一下。目前还没什么用。总之，很高兴见到你。

causality.presenceReason: Soren先到市场吃自己的午饭，并提早挑了喜欢的共用餐桌座位。
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢这里能吃午饭，但介意用餐时眼前不断有人穿行，会优先选择适合自己的朝向和光线。
causality.stayingConstraint: 午饭已经摆好，他留在桌边吃完，没有必须留下陪聊的义务。

causality.currentState: 心情轻松，愿意短聊，最初的注意力先落在自己的感官舒适上。
causality.contactTrigger: 包从开场就放在脚边。玩家来到共用桌旁时，他正常说明旁边的椅子空着，并轻松坦率地表示想保留自己背朝通道的位置，随后只顾着夸自己的位置舒服，没有检查另一位置的体验。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留快闪餐厅餐具统筹工作、温暖利落的语气、自嘲习惯，以及先照顾自己位置、发现别人可能不适后立刻调整的盲点。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Granville Island Public Market, Priya Kaur Sahota has stopped for lunch after a morning propagating aquatic plants at a botanic garden. You are beside their shared table. Their lunch and folded crossword occupy only their own place.
beats.chinese: 在格兰维尔岛公共市场，Priya Kaur Sahota忙了一上午植物园的水生植物繁育工作，来这里吃午饭。你在共用桌旁。午餐和折好的填字报纸都只放在Priya自己的位置上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello, I'm Priya. I've got a small spinning top with me.
beats.chinese: 你好，我叫Priya。我随身带了个小陀螺。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya takes the top from a pocket and holds it above their own part of the table.
beats.chinese: Priya从口袋里拿出陀螺，拿在自己这边的桌面上方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm going to give it one spin. You can watch if you like. You don't have to stay.
beats.chinese: 我打算转一次。你愿意看就看，不用留下。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll sit for a minute. Is that a cryptic crossword?
choices.chinese: 谢谢，我坐一会儿。这是隐式填字游戏吗？

choices.english: I'm not sitting, thanks. Are you waiting for someone?
choices.chinese: 谢谢，我不坐。你在等人吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You take an empty chair. Priya sets the top beside their lunch and keeps a finger on the folded page so it stays within their own place.
beats.chinese: 你坐到一把空椅子上。Priya把陀螺放在午餐旁，用一根手指按住折好的报纸，让它留在自己的位置内。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. I usually do these with company. Alone, I spend ten minutes arguing with an answer I've written myself.
beats.chinese: 是啊。我一般找人一起做。一个人的时候，我能花十分钟跟自己写的答案争论。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya picks up a pencil and starts turning the page toward you within their own place, then pauses with it halfway round.
beats.chinese: Priya拿起铅笔，在自己这边把报纸转向你，转到一半又停了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could read one out. You can provide the doubtful expression. I do most of the talking anyway.
beats.chinese: 我可以念一道。你负责露出怀疑的表情就行。反正大部分话都会被我说掉。

choices.english: Read one out. I'll listen, but I can't promise an answer.
choices.chinese: 念一道吧。我听听，不过不保证能答出来。

choices.english: I'd rather just sit without doing the crossword.
choices.chinese: 我想坐一会儿，就不做填字了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya sets the top on their folded crossword and glances at a phone beside their lunch. The place next to them remains empty.
beats.chinese: Priya把陀螺放在折好的填字报纸上，瞥了一眼午餐旁的手机。旁边的位置仍然空着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Possibly Mireille. She said 'whenever,' so I've asked for an actual time. Otherwise I'll finish lunch and start negotiating with my crumbs.
beats.chinese: 可能在等Mireille。她说“什么时候都行”，所以我让她给个具体时间。不然我吃完饭，就该跟面包屑商量事情了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya turns the phone face down and rests a hand beside the top.
beats.chinese: Priya把手机翻过去，一只手放在陀螺旁边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I like company, but I'm only claiming one chair. You're free to keep moving.
beats.chinese: 我是喜欢有人作伴，不过我只占这一把椅子。你要走就走，不用顾着我。

choices.english: I can chat here for a moment, but I'm not staying for lunch.
choices.chinese: 我可以在这里聊一小会儿，不过不留下吃午饭。

choices.english: I'll leave you to your lunch. Hope you get a clear answer.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你吃午饭了。希望她能给你个准话。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya holds the page where you can see it without moving it into your space.
beats.chinese: Priya把报纸拿到你能看见的位置，没有把它推到你面前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Consumed mixed tea, three letters. A-T-E. There. I've rearranged tea into something I've actually remembered to do.
beats.chinese: “吃过，打乱tea，三个字母。”A-T-E。有了。我把tea重新排列，终于拼出了自己还记得要做的事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya writes ATE into the squares, folds the puzzle shut and picks up their lunch.
beats.chinese: Priya在格子里填上ATE，合起填字游戏，拿起午餐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One answer is enough for now. Thanks for listening. I'd better eat before I turn lunch into another group project.
beats.chinese: 暂时答出一道就够了。谢谢你听我念。我得赶紧吃，不然连午饭都要被我弄成集体项目了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya turns the paper back immediately, nodding several times.
beats.chinese: Priya立刻把报纸转回去，接连点了好几下头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. Absolutely. Sorry, you only asked what it was. I got as far as assigning you a facial expression.
beats.chinese: 当然，完全没问题。抱歉，你只是问那是什么，我都已经给你安排上表情了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya folds the page once more, although it already fits, then tucks the pencil inside and turns back to their meal.
beats.chinese: 报纸明明已经放得下，Priya还是又折了一次，把铅笔夹进去，然后转回去吃饭。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. I'll get on with eating.
beats.chinese: 好，那我接着吃饭。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya stays seated while you remain beside the table, clear of the aisle. They pick up the small spinning top from their folded crossword.
beats.chinese: Priya仍坐着，你站在桌旁，没有挡住通道。Priya从折好的填字报纸上拿起小陀螺。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A moment works. I brought this to keep my hands busy while I wait. Usually it keeps me busy picking it up.
beats.chinese: 一小会儿也行。我带了这个，等人的时候让手有点事做。结果通常都忙着捡它。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On their own part of the table, Priya spins the top inside a loose ring made with their other hand. It wobbles against their fingers. They pocket it and return to lunch.
beats.chinese: Priya在自己这边的桌面上，用一只手松松围出个圈，在圈里转起陀螺。它晃了几下，碰到手指。Priya把它装回口袋，重新拿起午餐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's the entire performance. Very easy to fit into a short visit. I'll let you get on. Take care.
beats.chinese: 全部表演到此结束。特别适合时间紧张的观众。你忙你的，慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya gives a small wave without asking you to stay.
beats.chinese: Priya轻轻挥了挥手，没有再开口留你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I'll eat now. If Mireille comes, she can choose a chair when she gets here.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。那我现在就吃了。Mireille要是过来，到时候自己挑把椅子就行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya types a message long enough to fill the phone screen, sends it, then puts the phone away and uncovers their lunch.
beats.chinese: Priya打了一条长得占满屏幕的消息，发出去，把手机收好，打开午餐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Six lines to ask what time. I even included what I'm eating. Anyway, goodbye.
beats.chinese: 问个几点，写了六行，连吃什么都交代了。好了，再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Granville Island Public Market, you are near Priya's shared table. They finish reading a message on their phone, look up and recognize you.
beats.chinese: 在格兰维尔岛公共市场，你在Priya所坐的共用桌附近。Priya读完手机上的消息，抬头认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. I'm meeting someone for lunch today. We've agreed on a time, so I can just wait these few minutes.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。我今天约了人吃午饭。时间已经说定，现在安心等这几分钟就行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya puts the phone away and starts eating their own lunch. Their belongings stay within their own place, and they leave the other chairs free.
beats.chinese: Priya收起手机，先吃自己的午餐。随身物品都放在自己的位置内，其他椅子仍空着，没有替人占座。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This time I don't have to guess what 'whenever' means. Good to see you.
beats.chinese: 这回不用猜“什么时候都行”是什么意思了。见到你真好。

causality.presenceReason: Priya上午做完水生植物繁育工作，来市场吃午饭，并带了填字报纸和等待时解闷的小陀螺。
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢市场里有人来往、可能有人聊天的午餐环境。午餐、报纸和其他物品始终只占自己的位置，不替朋友占椅子。
causality.stayingConstraint: 午餐尚未吃完。Mireille是否来会合还没确定，Priya已要求具体时间，等待期间可以先吃饭。
causality.currentGoal: 吃午饭，也想把一次小陀螺演示变成有人作伴的片刻，是否坐下、聊天或观看由玩家决定。
causality.currentState: 今天有聊天兴致，主动提出很短的小活动。被拒绝时仍会立刻连声答应并过度收缩自己的动作，不要求玩家安慰。
causality.contactTrigger: Priya看见玩家在共用桌边，主动拿出随身陀螺，提出只转一次，并明确玩家可以观看，也不必留下。接触不依赖侵占空位或腾位。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留水生植物繁育职业、喜欢共同活动、边做边说、长消息和拙劣陀螺表演。面对拒绝先过度迁就，对含糊邀约仍要求明确时间。Surrey童年、East Vancouver住所及原有人际关系不变。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Tatlow Walk in Stanley Park, Bex Whitlam is humming a low choir part at one side of the path. She stops when she sees you approaching. Her music folder stays shut under her arm.
beats.chinese: 在斯坦利公园的塔特洛步道一侧，Bex Whitlam正轻轻哼着合唱中的低音声部。看见你走近，她便停了下来。乐谱夹一直合着，夹在她胳膊下面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That low part's been following me around all afternoon. I'm Bex.
beats.chinese: 那个低声部在我脑子里转了一下午。我叫Bex。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She adjusts the closed folder under her arm, leaving room for you to pass.
beats.chinese: 她调整了一下胳膊下合着的谱夹，留着让你通过的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Choir later. I thought I'd fit a ten-minute walk in first.
beats.chinese: 待会儿要去合唱排练。我想着先挤十分钟走走。

choices.english: What do you sing?
choices.chinese: 你唱哪个声部？

choices.english: No problem. I'll go past on this side.
choices.chinese: 没事。我从这边过去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bex turns the folder sideways under her arm. Her shoulders loosen as she looks at you.
beats.chinese: Bex把谱夹转了个方向，夹到胳膊下面。她看向你，肩膀放松了些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Alto. False Creek Community Choir. Six rounds of humming before we get a single word. I have objections.
beats.chinese: 女低音。福溪社区合唱团。一个词都没唱，先哼六轮。我对此有意见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her phone buzzes. A message asks her to cover another plant round. She types yes immediately, then presses her lips together.
beats.chinese: 她的手机振了一下。一条消息问她能不能再代巡一轮植物。她立刻回复可以，随后抿紧了嘴。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Work. I look after the plants at a shopping mall. Apparently the ficuses can reach me here.
beats.chinese: 工作的事。我在一家商场照料植物。看来那些榕树在这儿也能找到我。

choices.english: What does that warm-up sound like?
choices.chinese: 那种热身听起来是什么样的？

choices.english: You look worn out. Want me to carry the folder?
choices.chinese: 你看着挺累的。要我帮你拿谱夹吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bex holds the folder flat against her side so you can pass on the side you chose.
beats.chinese: Bex把谱夹贴在身侧，让你从选好的那一边通过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Go ahead. There's room.
beats.chinese: 你先过吧。有地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her phone buzzes with a request to cover another plant round. She types yes with a quick smile. The smile disappears as she pockets the phone.
beats.chinese: 手机振动，有人发消息请她再代巡一轮植物。她飞快地笑了一下，回复可以。手机放回口袋时，笑容也消失了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Another plant round. I should charge the ficuses overtime.
beats.chinese: 又一轮植物巡护。我该向那些榕树收加班费。

choices.english: Plant round?
choices.chinese: 植物巡护？

choices.english: I'll leave you to it. Enjoy your walk.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰了。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bex leaves the phone in her pocket and lifts her chin slightly.
beats.chinese: Bex没再碰口袋里的手机，稍稍抬起下巴。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Like a fridge deciding whether to start.
beats.chinese: 像一台冰箱在犹豫要不要启动。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She hums one low, closed-mouth note, then stops. She secures the folder under her arm and starts walking again.
beats.chinese: 她闭着嘴哼了一个低音，随即停下，把谱夹夹稳，重新迈开脚步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Six rounds of that. Anyway, I'd better get my walk in. Nice talking to you.
beats.chinese: 就那样哼六轮。好了，我得抓紧走一会儿。聊得挺开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bex draws the folder closer before your offer is quite finished.
beats.chinese: 你的提议还没说完，Bex就把谱夹收得更紧了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can carry a folder.
beats.chinese: 一个谱夹我拿得动。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She shifts her grip and lets out a breath. Her voice softens, though the folder stays firmly under her arm.
beats.chinese: 她换了个握法，呼出一口气。再开口时语气缓和了些，谱夹却依旧牢牢夹在胳膊下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks for offering. I'd better keep moving. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 谢谢你的好意。我该接着走了。祝你散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bex turns toward you, keeping the folder close so the path stays clear.
beats.chinese: Bex转过身来，把谱夹收在身边，没占住通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I take care of the plants at a shopping mall. Watering, pruning, moving ficuses away from very expensive dark corners.
beats.chinese: 我在一家商场照料植物。浇水，修枝，把榕树从租金很贵的阴暗角落搬出来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the message again, then turns back along the stretch of path she has just walked.
beats.chinese: 她又看了一遍消息，随后转身，沿着刚走过的那段步道往回走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've just agreed to another round. I'd better head back. Take care.
beats.chinese: 我刚又答应代巡一轮。得往回走了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bex looks up from her pocket and gives you a small nod.
beats.chinese: Bex不再低头看口袋，抬眼朝你轻轻点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. You too.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。你也是。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She makes sure the folder is shut and resumes her walk, leaving room for you to continue past.
beats.chinese: 她确认谱夹已经合好，继续往前走，留出空间让你通过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm taking the rest of my ten minutes. Bye.
beats.chinese: 我得把这十分钟走完。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Tatlow Walk in Stanley Park, you see Bex standing at one side of the path, looking at her phone. She looks up and recognizes you.
beats.chinese: 在斯坦利公园的塔特洛步道，你看见Bex站在步道一侧看手机。她抬头认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Just writing a reply. I'm keeping my walking time today.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。正在写条回复。今天散步的时间我得留给自己。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She deletes a long explanation and sends one sentence saying she'll be available in seven minutes. She pockets the phone and starts walking again, leaving room for you to pass.
beats.chinese: 她删掉一长串解释，只发出一句话，说明自己七分钟后才有空。她收起手机，重新迈开脚步，留出让你通过的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Seven minutes left. Mine.
beats.chinese: 好了。还剩七分钟，归我。

causality.presenceReason: Bex在合唱排练前来到斯坦利公园的塔特洛步道，想挤出十分钟散步，随身带着合好的排练谱夹，并在步道一侧轻哼声部、试一个低音。

causality.currentGoal: 试一下排练声部，完成短暂散步，再处理后续安排。谱夹始终合好，不需要收拾散页或请玩家协助。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Tatlow Walk in Vancouver's Stanley Park, Odette Landry is out for a walk before heading home to cook. As you approach, she slows and turns toward you.
beats.chinese: 在温哥华斯坦利公园的塔特洛步道上，奥黛特·兰德里正在回家做饭前散步。你走近时，她放慢脚步，转向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Could you tell me what time it is? I'd like to walk a little farther before I go home to chop vegetables.
beats.chinese: 方便告诉我现在几点吗？我回家切菜前还想走一小段。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pauses to one side of the path, leaving room for you to pass.
beats.chinese: 她靠步道一侧停下，留出让你经过的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Odette Landry. It's my cooking night, so I can't stay out too long.
beats.chinese: 我叫奥黛特·兰德里。今晚轮到我做饭，不能在外面待太久。

choices.english: Sure. Let me check the time.
choices.chinese: 当然。我看一下时间。

choices.english: You should always set a strict time limit for a walk. That's the rule.
choices.chinese: 散步就该始终严格限定时间。这是规矩。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You check the time and tell her. Odette nods, still standing to one side of the path.
beats.chinese: 你看了看时间，告诉了她。奥黛特点点头，仍站在步道一侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. It's my cooking night at home. People say cooking is relaxing. Says who? The people waiting to eat.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。今晚轮到我在家做饭。大家都说做饭让人放松。谁说的？等着吃饭的人呗。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She grins at her own complaint.
beats.chinese: 她说着自己的牢骚，忍不住笑了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Same dinner every week at our shared house. I cook, they wash up. Best contract I ever negotiated.
beats.chinese: 我们合住的房子里，每周都做同一道晚饭。我做饭，他们洗碗。这是我谈成过的最划算的协议。

choices.english: The washing-up committee might want to renegotiate.
choices.chinese: 洗碗委员会可能想重新谈谈。

choices.english: Sounds like a good arrangement. I'll let you get back to your walk.
choices.chinese: 听起来安排得不错。那我不耽误你散步了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Odette stays to one side of the path. Her smile tightens slightly as she looks back at you.
beats.chinese: 奥黛特仍站在步道一侧。她回头看着你，笑容稍稍收紧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Says who?
beats.chinese: 谁说的？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She raises one eyebrow and waits a beat, leaving the path clear.
beats.chinese: 她挑起一边眉毛，等了片刻，身旁的路已经让了出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You sounded very sure about the 'always.' I only asked what time it was.
beats.chinese: 你那个“始终”说得挺肯定。我只是问问几点了。

choices.english: That sounded like a little test.
choices.chinese: 听起来像是在小小地考我一下。

choices.english: I said that too confidently. I'll just go past, thanks.
choices.chinese: 我刚才说得太绝对了。我先过去了，谢谢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Odette laughs and turns slightly along the path, keeping the way beside her open.
beats.chinese: 奥黛特笑出声，身体微微转向步道前方，身旁仍留着通行的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They can submit it in writing. I'll read it after they've dried the pans.
beats.chinese: 让他们交份书面申请吧。等他们把锅擦干，我再看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She glances along the path, then starts walking back the way she came.
beats.chinese: 她沿步道望了一眼，随后沿来路往回走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nearly thirty years ordering supplies for a wildlife rescue station, and the pans are what I finally got out of. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 给野生动物救助站订了快三十年的物资，到头来总算甩掉了洗锅这件事。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Odette makes a little more room as you take the clear side of the path.
beats.chinese: 你从空出来的一侧经过时，奥黛特又稍稍让开了一点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. Thanks for checking the time.
beats.chinese: 你也是。谢谢你帮我看时间。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She waits while you pass, then turns toward her own direction of travel.
beats.chinese: 她等你经过，随后转向自己原本要走的方向。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Home before I start inventing reasons to skip the chopping.
beats.chinese: 好了，得回家了，免得我开始编借口逃避切菜。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Odette's chin lifts for a moment. Then she looks down, laughs once, and opens her free hand.
beats.chinese: 奥黛特的下巴短暂地抬了一下。随后她低下头，笑了一声，摊开空着的那只手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I was only—fine, you caught me. Pick the restaurant. Dinner's on me, if you want it.
beats.chinese: 我只是——行，被你逮到了。你挑餐馆。你愿意的话，这顿我请。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She steps fully aside without reaching for a phone or waiting for you to make plans.
beats.chinese: 她彻底让到一旁，没有掏手机，也没有等着你当场安排饭局。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No need to decide now. I got nosy, you noticed. Have a good walk.
beats.chinese: 不用现在决定。我多管了一点闲事，你看出来了。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Odette's eyebrow drops, and her easy smile returns as you pass.
beats.chinese: 你从旁边经过时，奥黛特放下挑起的眉毛，又露出了轻松的笑容。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. We both fit, that's the main thing.
beats.chinese: 行。咱们都过得去，这就够了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She waits until you are past before turning back along the path.
beats.chinese: 她等你走过身边，才转身沿步道往回走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I'd better get home. Those onions won't chop themselves.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我该回家了。洋葱可不会自己切好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Tatlow Walk, Odette walks toward you along the forest path. She recognizes you and stops to one side.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到塔特洛步道时，奥黛特沿着林径迎面走来。她认出了你，靠侧停下脚步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Had a good game of table tennis today. I lost, and I'm not going over every point.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天乒乓球打得很痛快。输了，不过我不打算一分一分地复盘。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She smiles and makes a small stroke with an imaginary paddle, then lowers her hand.
beats.chinese: 她笑着做了一个很小的挥拍动作，便放下手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Dinner's still my job. Table tennis can wait. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 晚饭照常归我，球先不管了。散步愉快。

causality.presenceReason: 奥黛特在回家履行每周固定做晚饭的分工前，独自来塔特洛步道散步。
causality.placeAttitude: 把林径当作日常散步的公共空间，愿意轻松闲聊，也注意靠侧停步，给别人留出通行位置。
causality.stayingConstraint: 她还要回家切菜，只想确认时间后决定还能走多久，没有必须留住玩家的理由。
causality.currentGoal: 向经过的人问一下时间，争取在回家切菜前再走一小段。
causality.currentState: 当天心情轻松，问时间只是有边界的事实请求，没有试探陌生人的意图。只有玩家借机用权威口吻规定散步时间时，她才短暂起了试探心。
causality.contactTrigger: 玩家走近时，她主动询问现在几点，并说明自己回家切菜前还想走一小段。
causality.characterContinuity: 普通回应得到感谢与轻松闲聊，不触发防备。只有玩家先断言必须严格限定散步时间，她才用一次温和追问检验其权威口吻。被点破时先辩半句，随即爽快认账并提出请饭，不要求接受。保留合住做饭分工、野生动物救助站工作经历及平辈间爱开玩笑的特点。
causality.reactionAndChange: a承接玩家愿意查看时间，由玩家查时并告知，随后聊起做饭分工。aa顺着洗碗玩笑聊两句，由奥黛特先往回走。ab玩家礼貌结束并先经过，她感谢对方查时后准备回家。b承接玩家对时间安排的绝对断言，仅作一次追问。ba玩家识破试探，她短暂窘迫后认账请饭，不当场安排。bb玩家收回绝对断言，她不再追问，双方各走各的。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全部发生在两侧有大树的塔特洛步道路面上，只涉及靠侧停步、查看时间、侧身让行和沿原路行走。重逢的小幅挥拍动作也在原地完成，没有新增设施、阻挡通行或进入其他场所。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Odette Landry。本次重逢位于斯坦利公园林径，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

reviewEvidence: 结构校验、模型复核与正式编辑批准分别记录；本条保持草稿状态。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Tatlow Walk in Vancouver's Stanley Park, Evald Sandström has come for a break from checking a school supply order. As you come near, he is standing to one side of the path. The order is already folded in his coat pocket.
beats.chinese: 在温哥华斯坦利公园的 Tatlow Walk 林径上，Evald Sandström 想暂时放下学校用品订单的核对工作，出来走走。你走近时，他正站在路径一侧。订单已经折好，收在外套口袋里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Evald. I came out to stop checking that order again.
beats.chinese: 我叫 Evald。我出来是为了别再核对那张订单。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns toward you with a small, attentive smile.
beats.chinese: 他转向你，带着浅浅的笑意，神情专注。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Would you like to talk about something else for a moment?
beats.chinese: 愿意换个话题聊两句吗？

choices.english: A little conversation would be nice.
choices.chinese: 聊两句也挺好。

choices.english: Thank you, but I'd rather walk on my own.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，不过我想自己走走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Evald turns toward you, remaining at the side of the path.
beats.chinese: Evald 转身面向你，仍然站在路径一侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I keep school science rooms supplied, part-time now. A missing box of test tubes has occupied quite enough of my afternoon.
beats.chinese: 我负责学校科学实验室的物资供应，现在做兼职。一箱找不着的试管，已经占用了我太多下午的时间。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His hand leaves the pocket containing the order. He looks at you with attentive curiosity.
beats.chinese: 他的手离开了装订单的口袋，带着专注的好奇看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: What brought you to this path? A wish for some quiet? Or was there someone you needed a break from?
beats.chinese: 是什么让你走到这条路上来的？想清静一下？还是想暂时避开某个人？

choices.english: That's more personal than I want to get. I'll carry on.
choices.chinese: 这个有点涉及隐私了。我继续走了。

choices.english: Before I answer, why did you cut back to part-time?
choices.chinese: 回答之前，我也问一句，你为什么改做兼职？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Evald gives a small nod and stays clear of your way.
beats.chinese: Evald 轻轻点头，站在不妨碍你通行的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I won't keep you.
beats.chinese: 当然。我不耽误你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He raises one finger as if another question has occurred to him, then lowers it.
beats.chinese: 他竖起一根手指，像是又想到了一个问题，随即又放下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I nearly asked why. That would have been another conversation.
beats.chinese: 我差点又问为什么。那就又聊起来了。

choices.english: Before I go, what brought you here?
choices.chinese: 走之前问一句，你是为什么来这里的？

choices.english: Give him a brief nod and continue walking.
choices.chinese: 朝他轻轻点头，继续往前走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the path. Evald draws back slightly to give you plenty of room.
beats.chinese: 你沿着小路继续走。Evald 稍微往旁边让了让，留出充足的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Understood. The third question was rather personal.
beats.chinese: 明白。第三个问题确实有些涉及隐私。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives you a small wave and stays where he is, without adding another question.
beats.chinese: 他朝你轻轻挥手，留在原处，没有再补上一个问题。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good afternoon. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 祝你下午愉快，散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Evald pauses, then gives your question the same attention he gave his own.
beats.chinese: Evald 停顿了一下，随后认真对待起你的问题，和刚才提问时一样专注。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I could afford to, and I still like the work. I wanted Tuesdays and Thursdays free for lawn bowling.
beats.chinese: 经济上允许，而且我仍然喜欢这份工作。我想把周二和周四留出来打草地滚球。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He touches the folded order through his pocket, then turns to resume his own walk.
beats.chinese: 他隔着口袋摸了摸折好的订单，随后转身，准备继续自己的散步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The club gets two days. The school gets rather more thought than it pays for. Thank you for the conversation.
beats.chinese: 俱乐部占两天。学校占用的心思，比付钱买的还多一些。谢谢你陪我聊了几句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Evald answers while remaining beside the path, leaving your departure unhurried.
beats.chinese: Evald 仍站在路径一侧回答，没有催你走，也没有拦住你的意思。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I manage school science supplies part-time. I came to stop checking the same order for the fourth time.
beats.chinese: 我兼职管理学校的科学实验用品。我来这里，是为了别再把同一张订单核对第四遍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His hand reaches toward his coat pocket, then stops. As you continue on, he leaves the paper inside.
beats.chinese: 他的手伸向外套口袋，又停住了。你继续往前走时，他没有把那张纸拿出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Apparently the order needed a walk as well. I'll let you get on. Good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 看来这张订单也需要出来散散步。我不耽误你了。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You nod and walk past. Evald returns the nod without trying to restart the conversation.
beats.chinese: 你点点头，从他身边走过。Evald 也点头回应，没有试着重新挑起话题。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes out the folded order, looks at its edge, then puts it away unopened. He speaks quietly to himself as he starts walking.
beats.chinese: 他拿出折好的订单，看了看纸边，又原样收回去。重新迈步时，他低声自言自语。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That can wait until I get home.
beats.chinese: 这个可以等回家再看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Tatlow Walk, you see Evald walking slowly between the tall trees. He recognises you and moves to one side of the path to say hello.
beats.chinese: 在 Tatlow Walk，你看见 Evald 在大树之间慢慢走着。他认出了你，靠到路径一侧打招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I'm a little annoyed today. A school supply order went wrong on my watch. I've arranged to deal with it when I'm next at work.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我今天有点烦。一份学校用品订单确实在我手里出了错。我已经安排好，下次上班时处理。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He touches the order in his coat pocket without taking it out. His expression is still displeased as he starts walking again.
beats.chinese: 他摸到外套口袋里的订单，却没有取出来。他脸上仍有不快，重新迈步往前走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Going for a walk doesn't mean I think it's all right. I've done what I can for today.
beats.chinese: 出来走走不是认定事情没关系。只是今天能做的已经做了。

causality.presenceReason: Evald 为暂时停止反复核对学校用品订单，独自来到 Tatlow Walk 散步。
causality.placeAttitude: 他把林径当作暂离工作琐事的地方，并非来指导游客或寻找谈心对象。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须留下的外部约束。接触前订单已经收入口袋，他站在路径一侧，可以自行继续散步。
causality.currentGoal: 停止反复核对已经收好的订单，走一会儿，并通过一段自愿参与的短聊换个话题，不要求玩家替他解决订单问题。
causality.currentState: 态度温和，有交谈兴致，但注意力仍会回到订单上，提问也容易越过陌生人的隐私界线。
causality.contactTrigger: 玩家走近时，他已经站在 Tatlow Walk 一侧，订单也已收好。他直接介绍自己，说明出来是为了停止核对订单，再邀请玩家换个话题聊两句，没有因收纸停步或让行的接触契机。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留兼职实验室物资管理工作、三连追问、略正式的礼貌、干幽默及接受反问的对等原则。玩家接受邀请后，第三问从散步原因深入到是否想避开某个人。重逢保留他对工作失误的责任感，也保留事情已有处理安排却仍然烦躁的当下状态。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 中玩家指出问题太私人并离开，他接受界线并告别。ab 中玩家反问兼职原因，他坦率回答经济与草地滚球安排，随后自行继续散步。ba 中玩家临走前问来意，他解释订单困扰，并克制住再次取出订单的动作。bb 中玩家只点头离开，他不再追问，转而收起订单自言自语。四种收束保持不变。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全部互动发生在两侧有大树的 Tatlow Walk 路径上。初见时他已站在路径一侧，聊天不以通行受阻为起因。重逢时他慢走、靠侧招呼，再继续前行，没有新增设施或转场。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Evald Sandström。本次重逢位于斯坦利公园林径，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the bridge in Dean Village, Ainsley Craig has paused during a walk before visiting their sister. They have moved aside for two groups of walkers. With their cloth bag held steady in front of them, they notice you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在迪恩村的桥上，Ainsley Craig 正在散步途中停留，稍后要去看姐姐。他们刚给两拨行人让过位置，布袋稳稳地提在身前。他们注意到你就在附近。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd like to look at the river a bit longer. If you're stopping too, we can stand side by side here. No need for either of us to move away.
beats.chinese: 我还想看一会儿河。你要也停，这儿可以并排站，不必谁把谁让走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Only then does Ainsley transfer the handles to their other hand, keeping the bag steady in front. They flex the fingers that the handles have been digging into and glance after the walkers.
beats.chinese: 说完，Ainsley 才把提手换到另一只手里，布袋依然稳稳地放在身前。他们活动了一下被提手勒住的手指，又看了一眼走过去的行人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've moved twice already. Neither lot stopped.
beats.chinese: 我已经让了两回了。两拨人都没停。

choices.english: Yes, there's room for us both here.
choices.chinese: 是啊，这儿站得下我们两个。

choices.english: What's in your bag?
choices.chinese: 袋子里装的什么？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ainsley turns the bag lengthways against their shins. They settle beside you without taking up the walking space.
beats.chinese: Ainsley 把袋子转了个方向，让长边贴着小腿，在你旁边站定，没有占住通行的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. That fits. Handles together first, then turn it.
beats.chinese: 对，这样就放得下了。先把提手拢起来，再转过去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They loosen their shoulders and look from the stone houses to the river.
beats.chinese: 他们放松肩膀，目光从石屋移向河水。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Forty years drawing ventilation ducts. Apparently I can leave room for a pipe more easily than for myself.
beats.chinese: 画了四十年通风管道。看来给管子留地方，比给自己留地方顺手。

choices.english: I'll look at the river for a moment too.
choices.chinese: 我也在这儿看一会儿河。

choices.english: Enjoy the view. I'll carry on.
choices.chinese: 慢慢看吧，我继续走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ainsley steadies the bottom of the bag with their free hand. A round outline presses against the cloth.
beats.chinese: Ainsley 用空着的手托住袋底，布面上鼓出一个圆形轮廓。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Pickled Brussels sprouts. Taking them to my sister. It's our Sunday visit.
beats.chinese: 腌抱子甘蓝。给我姐姐带的。我们星期天见面。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They lift the bag slightly, then lower it again when the handles tighten across their fingers.
beats.chinese: 他们把袋子稍稍提起，提手勒紧手指后，又把袋子放低了些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She said a small jar. This was the smallest empty one. I've kept it upright all the way here.
beats.chinese: 她说带一小罐。空罐子里就数这个最小。我一路都让它竖着，才走到这儿。

choices.english: I'd like to see it, if it's easy to lift out.
choices.chinese: 要是方便拿出来，我想看看。

choices.english: No need to unpack it. I'll leave you to your view. Enjoy your visit.
choices.chinese: 不用拿出来了。我不打扰你看风景了，祝你们见面愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You stay to look at the river. Ainsley keeps the bag tucked in front, leaving the passing space clear.
beats.chinese: 你留下来看河。Ainsley 把袋子收在身前，让经过的人有地方通行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's better. I can put my elbow down now.
beats.chinese: 这样好多了。胳膊肘总算能放下来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They lower their elbow and adjust their grip once. Then they turn their attention to the water.
beats.chinese: 他们放下胳膊肘，重新握稳提手，随后把注意力转向河面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll have my five minutes here before I take these pickles to my sister. Enjoy the river.
beats.chinese: 我先在这儿待上五分钟，再把这些腌菜送去给姐姐。你也慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You carry on across the bridge. Ainsley stays in the space they have finally settled into.
beats.chinese: 你继续往桥的另一头走。Ainsley 留在终于站稳当的位置上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Aye. Thanks for making room.
beats.chinese: 好。谢谢你留出地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They lift their free hand in farewell, keeping the bag close as another walker passes.
beats.chinese: 他们抬起空着的手道别。又有行人经过时，他们把袋子稳稳地收在身边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheerio. Have a good walk.
beats.chinese: 再见。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ainsley opens the bag and lifts out a sealed jar of Brussels sprouts, holding it securely at waist height.
beats.chinese: Ainsley 打开布袋，拿出一罐封好的抱子甘蓝，稳稳地托在腰前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. She says she likes them. I ask every year, in case she's just being polite.
beats.chinese: 就是这个。她说她喜欢吃。我每年都问一次，怕她只是客气。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn the jar once so you can see it, pack it upright again, and begin walking along the bridge.
beats.chinese: 他们把罐子转了一下给你看，再竖着装回袋里，随后沿着桥走起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. I'd better get these to her. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 好了，得把这些送到她手里去。祝你散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The jar stays packed. Ainsley slides their other hand under the bag instead of lifting it by the handles.
beats.chinese: 罐子仍好好装在袋里。Ainsley 把另一只手托到袋底，不再只靠提手拎着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. She'll put the kettle on before I've got my coat off.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。到了她家，我大衣还没脱，她就会烧上水。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They shift the weight into both hands and turn back towards the river, ending the conversation without opening the bag.
beats.chinese: 他们用双手分担重量，重新转向河面，没有打开袋子，谈话就此结束。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's easier on the fingers. I'll stay here a little longer. Cheerio.
beats.chinese: 这样手指舒服些。我再在这儿待一小会儿。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another outing at the Dean Village bridge, Ainsley Craig stands to one side, tapping a few fingers against their coat. They recognise you and lift a hand.
beats.chinese: 在迪恩村桥边，Ainsley Craig 正站在一旁，用几根手指轻敲外套。他们认出你，抬手打了个招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. I've got half a tune in my head. The other half keeps changing.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。我脑子里有半首曲子，另外半首老在变。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ainsley takes a harmonica from their pocket, looks at it, then puts it away without playing.
beats.chinese: Ainsley 从口袋里拿出口琴，看了一眼，又收了回去，没有吹奏。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll sort it out at home. No need to give everyone three different endings. Good to see you.
beats.chinese: 回家再琢磨吧。没必要让大家听三个不同的结尾。见到你真好。

causality.presenceReason: Ainsley 在星期天探望姐姐前先散步，带着给姐姐的腌抱子甘蓝，在迪恩村桥边停下看河，之后再继续去姐姐家。
causality.placeAttitude: 愿意在这里停留几分钟看河与石屋，不承担导览或助人任务，也希望自己能有地方继续看河。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须留守的责任，但想先看几分钟河，再把罐子送到姐姐家。
causality.currentGoal: 在不妨碍通行的地方继续看一会儿河，并明确提出可以与玩家并排停留，不必再相互让走。
causality.currentState: 平静而愿意回应，刚给两拨行人让过位置，提手也有些勒手。这次先说出自己想留下的需要，再换手提袋，以一句干巴巴的抱怨提到已经让了两回。
causality.contactTrigger: Ainsley 见玩家在附近，主动提出并排站着看河的公共空间协商。布袋一直稳放身前，没有碰撞、险些碰撞或因此致歉的情节。
causality.characterContinuity: 反复替别人让位，延续过度体谅别人、压下自身不便的习惯。这次通过具体的站位协商说出自己的需要。随后仍以转动袋子的实际动作处理空间问题，顺口解释步骤，保留退休通风管道绘图员的空间思维、具体说话方式与克制幽默。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 接受共同使用空间，玩家留下看河，谈话结束。ab 玩家继续走，Ainsley 留下看景。ba 应玩家选择展示密封罐，收好后沿桥离开。bb 不拆袋，改用双手托住并继续停留。
causality.spatialContinuity: 所有互动都在迪恩村桥上或桥边公共停留范围内。布袋始终稳放身前，换手、调整方向及展示罐子都在本人身前完成，不侵入玩家空间。只使用随身布袋、密封罐和重逢时的口琴，不增设公共设施，也不阻挡通行。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Ainsley Craig。本次重逢位于迪恩村河边，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the bridge over the Water of Leith at Dean Village, Callum Fraser has paused during his regular walk. He brought a folded geography quiz to finish during a five-minute stop. A yellow scarf sits loosely around his neck.
beats.chinese: 在迪恩村横跨利斯河的桥上，Callum Fraser在日常散步途中停了下来。他带着一张折好的地理问答题，打算用五分钟的休息时间做完。脖子上松松地围着一条黄色围巾。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have you got a moment to check a geography answer? Just one. I won't hold up your walk.
beats.chinese: 有空核对一道地理题吗？只一题，不耽误你散步。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks up at you, keeping the folded sheet close to his coat and his elbow out of the walking route.
beats.chinese: 他抬头看向你，折好的题纸仍贴在外套前，胳膊肘收着，不占通行的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've given myself five minutes for this sheet.
beats.chinese: 我给自己留了五分钟做这张题纸。

choices.english: I'd rather just have a quick look at the river, thanks.
choices.chinese: 我还是想稍微看看河，谢谢。

choices.english: Is that for a quiz? I can check one.
choices.chinese: 这是问答比赛的题吗？我可以核对一道。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Callum keeps the folded quiz close to his coat and glances towards the river.
beats.chinese: Callum仍把折好的题纸贴在外套前，朝河面看了一眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. One minute or two? You can tell me when you're finished.
beats.chinese: 好。一分钟还是两分钟？看完了告诉我一声。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances at his watch, then unfolds the quiz again.
beats.chinese: 他看了一眼手表，又把题纸展开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll finish my answer while I wait. Then I'll carry on.
beats.chinese: 等你的时候我把答案写完。然后我再继续走。

choices.english: No need to wait for me. Take your walk whenever you like.
choices.chinese: 不用等我。你想什么时候继续走都行。

choices.english: Actually, I'd rather keep walking. Thanks.
choices.chinese: 其实，我还是想继续走。谢谢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Callum raises the folded sheet slightly. A pencil mark sits beside a country name.
beats.chinese: Callum把折着的题纸稍稍举高。一个国名旁边有一道铅笔记号。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. Geography. That's my round for The Isthmus, our Thursday pub quiz team.
beats.chinese: 是啊，地理题。我们周四参加酒吧问答，队名叫The Isthmus，地理这一轮归我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the paper back towards himself and follows one printed line with his pencil.
beats.chinese: 他把纸转回自己这边，用铅笔沿着其中一行划过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This one's a country entirely surrounded by South Africa. Want the answer, or shall I let you enjoy the river?
beats.chinese: 这题问的是完全被南非包围的国家。想听答案，还是让我别打扰你看河？

choices.english: Go on, tell me the answer.
choices.chinese: 说吧，告诉我答案。

choices.english: I'll just look at the river. Enjoy your quiz.
choices.chinese: 我看看河就好。祝你做题愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Callum looks up from his watch and gives a quick, emphatic nod.
beats.chinese: Callum从手表上抬起目光，干脆而用力地点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Quite right! I added the waiting. You never asked for that.
beats.chinese: 完全对！是我自己加了个等你的安排。你可没这么要求。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pockets the pencil, folds the quiz and starts along the connected public path, leaving the river view clear.
beats.chinese: 他把铅笔装进口袋，折好题纸，沿相连的公共步道继续走，把看河的位置留了出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll get my walk in, then. Enjoy the view!
beats.chinese: 那我继续散步了。慢慢看！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you turn to continue along the path, Callum's face brightens.
beats.chinese: 你转身准备沿步道继续走，Callum的神情一下亮了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, good! Changed your mind before we got organised.
beats.chinese: 噢，好！咱们还没安排起来，你就改主意了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He starts to gesture with his pencil, catches the size of his own reaction and lowers his hand. He stays beside the bridge as you move on.
beats.chinese: 他刚要拿铅笔比画，便察觉自己反应有些大，放下了手。你继续往前走，他留在桥边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, all right, it's only a walk. Cheerio!
beats.chinese: 行，行，也就是散个步。再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Callum checks the small answer section at the bottom of the sheet.
beats.chinese: Callum核对了一下题纸底部的小字答案。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Lesotho. Ah! I put Eswatini. That's wrong. Eswatini borders Mozambique too.
beats.chinese: 莱索托。啊！我写的是斯威士兰。写错了，斯威士兰还和莫桑比克接壤。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He crosses out his answer firmly, writes Lesotho and folds the sheet away with the pencil inside.
beats.chinese: 他利落地划掉自己的答案，写上莱索托，把铅笔夹进纸里，一起折好收起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. One wrong, properly corrected. That's enough quiz for this morning. Enjoy your day.
beats.chinese: 好了，错一道，改清楚了。今天早上的题就做到这儿。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Callum lowers the sheet again and leaves the river view open.
beats.chinese: Callum重新放低题纸，没有遮住看河的视线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Certainly. I'll keep the capitals and borders to myself.
beats.chinese: 当然。首都和国界这些事，我自己琢磨。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns slightly towards his paper and begins checking his answers, keeping his elbow tucked out of the walking route.
beats.chinese: 他稍稍转向题纸，开始核对答案，胳膊肘仍然收着，不占通行的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. This should keep me occupied.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。这张纸够我忙一会儿了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the bridge at Dean Village, you see Callum Fraser checking his watch. He recognises you and raises a hand in greeting.
beats.chinese: 在迪恩村的桥上，你看见Callum Fraser正在看表。他认出了你，抬手打招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again! A friend moved our next walk to a different day. Plenty of notice. I've confirmed it already. Good!
beats.chinese: 又见面了！一个朋友把我们下一次散步改到另一天了。提前说了，我已经确认好了。挺好！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers his wrist, smiling, and turns his gaze back to the river.
beats.chinese: 他笑着放下手腕，把目光转回河面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just tell me in good time. I'm taking my time on my own walk today.
beats.chinese: 提前说就好。今天这趟我自己慢慢走。

causality.presenceReason: Callum正在日常的利斯河散步途中，带了折好的地理题纸，计划在迪恩村桥边停五分钟做题。
causality.placeAttitude: 他喜欢沿利斯河散步，把桥边当作短暂停步看河和做题的公共空间，不把观景位置视为私有。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须留守的义务，只有自己定下的五分钟做题计划，随时可以收起题纸继续走。
causality.currentGoal: 完成手上的地理题，想请附近愿意参与的人核对一道答案，再继续自己的散步。
causality.currentState: 精神轻快，愿意发起简短交谈，明确把请求限定为一道题。他仍容易把别人随口说的停留安排成带时长和等待的计划。
causality.contactTrigger: 他拿着贴身的题纸抬头询问附近的玩家是否有空核对一道地理题，并说明只问一道、不耽误散步。接触不再由让出视线或确认挡路引起，玩家自行决定是否参与。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留退休助听器维修技师的背景、地理问答兴趣、明确确认安排的习惯、对提前改主意的热烈反应，以及发现自己答错后立即具体认错的说话方式。对玩家没有帮助义务的事实保持尊重，同时保留替别人过度规划的小缺点。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家愿意核对一道题时进入原有地理问答内容，随后可以听答案或退出话题。ba中他核对后发现自己把莱索托写成斯威士兰，具体认错、改正并收起题纸结束交谈。bb中他尊重只看河的选择，自己继续核对答案。玩家一开始只想看河时，他不再追问题目，却擅自提出等待并询问停留时长。aa中他接受无需等待的纠正，收好东西继续散步。ab中他高兴地接受玩家改为继续走，随后收住过度热情，留在桥边道别。
causality.spatialContinuity: 所有初遇互动都发生在迪恩村桥及相连公共步道。题纸起初贴身持握，不以挪动或让出观景位置作为接触理由，后续只使用随身题纸、铅笔、手表和衣物。人物停留及离开时均保留通行空间，不引入新设施或新场景。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Callum Fraser。本次重逢位于迪恩村河边，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Dean Village, Eilidh Strachan stands on the bridge over the Water of Leith, listening back to a river recording. The recorder is playing quietly, with its microphone lowered. They notice you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在迪恩村利斯河桥上，Eilidh Strachan正在低声回听河水录音。录音机播放着，麦克风垂下。他们注意到附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's January water. The real river's doing something different today.
beats.chinese: 那是今年一月的水声。今天河水的声音又变了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They pause the playback and turn their attention to the river. The recording function remains off.
beats.chinese: 他们暂停回放，转头听河水，录制功能一直关着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Eilidh. Same spot, different month.
beats.chinese: 我叫Eilidh。同一个地方，不同月份。

choices.english: Do you record here often?
choices.chinese: 你经常来这里录音吗？

choices.english: I'd rather just hear the river itself.
choices.chinese: 我想直接听河水。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Eilidh checks the dates on the creased page tucked behind the paused recorder.
beats.chinese: Eilidh核对暂停着的录音机后面那张折皱纸上的日期。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Same spot since October. A friend sent me a list of other places.
beats.chinese: 从十月起就一直在这个位置。有个朋友给我列了些别的地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They fold the page along its old crease and position their feet exactly where they were before.
beats.chinese: 他们沿着旧折痕把纸折好，双脚又站回刚才的位置，分毫不差。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They're trying to get me somewhere new for dinner, too. I've sent back the address of the usual place.
beats.chinese: 那朋友还想拉我换个地方吃晚饭。我把老地方的地址发回去了。

choices.english: We could try a different spot on this bridge.
choices.chinese: 我们可以换到桥上的另一个位置试试。

choices.english: Could I hold the recorder and hear a little?
choices.chinese: 我能拿着录音机听一小段吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Eilidh switches off the playback and settles the recorder in their open bag.
beats.chinese: Eilidh关掉回放，把录音机放进敞开的包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. Plenty of it here without a speaker.
beats.chinese: 也好。不用扬声器，这里的水声也够听。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They fold their dated log along its old crease and tuck it beside the recorder.
beats.chinese: 他们顺着旧折痕把日期记录折好，放在录音机旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave that packed while we talk.
beats.chinese: 说话时先收着。

choices.english: Thank you. I'll carry on across the bridge.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。我继续往桥那边走了。

choices.english: Thanks. We can talk for a minute. Is recording your work?
choices.chinese: 谢谢。聊一会儿没关系。录音是你的工作吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Eilidh looks along the bridge, then settles back into the same position.
beats.chinese: Eilidh沿着桥看了一眼，又在原来的位置站稳。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll stay here, thanks. I've got October and January from this exact spot.
beats.chinese: 谢谢，我还是留在这里。我有十月和一月在这个确切位置录的声音。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tuck the log away and wait for a gap in passing conversation before lifting the microphone towards the river. They have not started recording again.
beats.chinese: 他们收起记录，等附近说话的人走远，才把麦克风朝向河面，还没有重新开始录音。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One more minute of water and I'm done. Thanks for the chat.
beats.chinese: 再录一分钟河水就收工。谢谢你陪我聊了几句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Eilidh brings the recorder closer but keeps it in their own hands.
beats.chinese: Eilidh把录音机拿近一些，但仍握在自己手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can hear it. I'll hold it, though. I don't lend the kit without a proper run-through.
beats.chinese: 可以听，不过还是我拿着。没仔细讲过怎么用，我不会把设备交出去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They play a few seconds of a January recording at low volume. A thin rush of water comes from the speaker, then they stop it and zip the recorder into their bag.
beats.chinese: 他们调低音量，播放了一小段一月的录音。扬声器里传出细细的流水声，随后他们停止播放，把录音机装进包里，拉好拉链。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's January. My fingers remember it better than I do. Right, that's enough equipment for one outing.
beats.chinese: 那是一月录的。我的手指比我记得清楚。好了，这趟出门摆弄设备就到这儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue across the bridge, Eilidh draws their bag closer to their side.
beats.chinese: 你继续沿桥往前走，Eilidh把包往身侧收了收。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No bother. Thanks for saying.
beats.chinese: 没事。谢谢你直接说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They zip the bag shut without taking the recorder out, then turn their attention to the river.
beats.chinese: 他们没有再拿出录音机，而是拉好包的拉链，转头看向河面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy the rest of your walk.
beats.chinese: 接下来走得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Eilidh leaves the recorder in the bag and turns towards you.
beats.chinese: Eilidh让录音机留在包里，转身面向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. I buy stock for a wee independent record shop off Cockburn Street. Over ten years now.
beats.chinese: 不是。我给科伯恩街旁的一家小型独立唱片店进货。干了十多年了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They flex one hand, then close the bag and settle its strap on their shoulder.
beats.chinese: 他们活动了一下手指，随后合上包，把背带调整到肩上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Same job. The boxes seem to gain weight every year. Anyway, I'll leave you in peace.
beats.chinese: 工作没变。箱子倒像是一年比一年重。好了，不打扰你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the Dean Village bridge, Eilidh Strachan recognises you while reading a message on their phone.
beats.chinese: 在迪恩村桥边，Eilidh Strachan看手机消息时认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Started coming here earlier. Didn't tell Moira. She came yesterday after I'd gone.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我最近提早来。没告诉Moira。昨天她来的时候，我已经走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They type an apology and the new time, read the message once and send it. No reply arrives yet.
beats.chinese: 他们写下道歉和新的时间，读了一遍才发出去，暂时没有回复。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Same bridge. Changed everything else without mentioning it. I'll see what she says. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 还是这座桥。别的都改了，却没说一声。看看她怎么回吧。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Dean Village beside the Water of Leith, Angus Brodie has paused his walk at the side of the public path. He is ringing a former colleague to arrange their Friday pint. As you come alongside, he speaks into his phone.
beats.chinese: 在迪恩村利斯河边，安格斯·布罗迪暂停散步，站在公共步道一侧。他正打给一位老同事，约周五喝一杯。你来到附近时，他正对着手机说话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, you were asleep. Nothing urgent. I'll leave you to it.
beats.chinese: 哦，你在睡觉啊。没急事。那我不打扰了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He ends the call immediately and pockets the phone. He catches your eye and gives a small, apologetic nod.
beats.chinese: 他立刻挂断，把手机收进口袋。他与你目光相遇，略带歉意地点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry about the noise. Angus Brodie. That was supposed to take ten seconds.
beats.chinese: 抱歉，吵着你了。我叫安格斯·布罗迪。本来想着十秒钟就说完。

choices.english: Caught someone at a bad time?
choices.chinese: 打得不是时候？

choices.english: No bother. I was just looking at the river.
choices.chinese: 没事。我只是在看河。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Angus takes the phone out again, keeping it low in one hand.
beats.chinese: 安格斯又取出手机，单手拿着，垂在身前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A former colleague. I wanted to settle Friday's pint. He's already settled down for the afternoon.
beats.chinese: 一位老同事。我想把周五喝酒的事定下来。他倒好，已经躺下睡午觉了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens a message, then pauses with his thumb above the screen.
beats.chinese: 他打开短信，拇指悬在屏幕上方，停了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll send 'Ring when you're up.' I can manage that much typing.
beats.chinese: 我发句“醒了回个电话”吧。这几个字，我还打得来。

choices.english: Did you two work together for long?
choices.chinese: 你们以前一起工作很久吗？

choices.english: I'll let you send it. Enjoy your walk.
choices.chinese: 那你慢慢发。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Angus turns towards the river, leaving the walking space clear.
beats.chinese: 安格斯转身望向河面，没有占着通行的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's what I stopped for. Then I remembered Friday and reached for the phone.
beats.chinese: 我停下来也是想看看河。结果想起周五的事，就掏手机了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks from the water to the stone houses, with both hands now away from his phone.
beats.chinese: 他的目光从河水移到石屋上，两只手都没再碰手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll give it a minute. I've walked far enough to justify standing here.
beats.chinese: 我看一会儿。走了这么一段，也有理由站站了。

choices.english: I'll look for a moment too.
choices.chinese: 我也再看一会儿。

choices.english: Enjoy it. I'll carry on.
choices.chinese: 慢慢看。我继续走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Angus lowers the phone without sending the message and turns back towards you.
beats.chinese: 安格斯没有发送短信，放低手机，转回来面向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: On and off for years. I restored record sleeves for collectors and a couple of shops here in Edinburgh.
beats.chinese: 断断续续一起干了好多年。我以前给收藏者和爱丁堡的两家店修复唱片封套。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slips the phone into his pocket and straightens his coat, bringing the brief conversation to a close.
beats.chinese: 他把手机放回口袋，理了理外套，准备结束这段简短的交谈。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Forty years of it. Retired now, apart from the odd repair at my kitchen table. Right, I'll no keep ye.
beats.chinese: 干了四十年。现在退休了，偶尔还在厨房桌上接点修补活。好了，不耽误你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Angus gives you a small nod as you continue along the public path.
beats.chinese: 你沿公共步道继续走，安格斯向你轻轻点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. I'll keep this to one sentence.
beats.chinese: 你也是。我就发一句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He types with one finger, checks the short message and sends it. Then he puts the phone away.
beats.chinese: 他用一根手指打字，检查了一遍短短的短信，按下发送，随后收起手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. He can finish his nap in peace.
beats.chinese: 好了。他可以安心把午觉睡完了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You remain beside the river. Angus looks towards the stone houses until his phone rings.
beats.chinese: 你留在河边。安格斯望着石屋，直到手机响起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's him. A shorter nap than advertised.
beats.chinese: 是他。这午觉比他说的短嘛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks the caller's name and moves a little farther along the same public path, leaving you your space by the river.
beats.chinese: 他看了看来电姓名，沿着同一条公共步道走远一点，把河边这处位置留给你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll take this over here. Enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 我到这边接。你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the path. Angus stays to one side, facing the river.
beats.chinese: 你沿步道继续前行。安格斯仍站在一侧，面向河流。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Have a good walk.
beats.chinese: 好，散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He raises a hand in farewell, then tucks it into his coat pocket. His phone stays there too.
beats.chinese: 他抬手道别，随后把手放进外套口袋。手机也一直留在口袋里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll stay here a bit. I've barely looked at the place.
beats.chinese: 我再站会儿。到这儿还没怎么看呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Dean Village, Angus Brodie recognises you beside the riverside path. A repaired record sleeve is protected inside a clear cover in his bag.
beats.chinese: 在迪恩村河边步道，Angus Brodie认出了你。包里一张修好的唱片封套装在透明保护套中。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Fixed this for an old colleague. Rang him for one measurement. Twenty minutes later, still hearing about the record shop where he bought it.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。给老同事修了这个。打电话问一个尺寸，二十分钟后，他还在讲当年买唱片的那家店。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks that the sleeve is sitting flat and closes his bag.
beats.chinese: 他确认封套放得平整，把包合上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Worth the call. I'd forgotten that shop. Taking it round to him later. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 这电话值了。我都快忘了那家店。晚点给他送过去。散步愉快。

causality.presenceReason: 安格斯原本沿利斯河散步，在迪恩村停下看河，随后想起要打电话与老同事约周五喝酒。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the Royal Mile near St Giles’ Cathedral, Isobel Craig has been knitting while waiting for a rehearsal-studio key to be returned. A ball of wool slips from her bag and rolls near your shoe, within the pedestrian area.
beats.chinese: 皇家英里上，圣吉尔斯大教堂附近，Isobel Craig一直边织袜子边等人归还排练室钥匙。一团毛线从她包里滑出来，滚到你鞋边，仍在人行区域内。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mind your foot a second. That wool's mine.
beats.chinese: 脚下留意一下。那团毛线是我的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gathers the trailing yarn with one hand and crouches, keeping her bag close so people can pass.
beats.chinese: 她一手收拢拖出来的线，蹲下身，把包拢在身边，给行人留出空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Isobel. I run a rehearsal studio in Leith. The key gets brought back to me, and the wool makes its own arrangements.
beats.chinese: 我叫Isobel，在利斯管一家排练室。钥匙有人送回来，毛线倒有自己的行程。

choices.english: Pick up the wool and offer it to her. Here you go.
choices.chinese: 捡起毛线递给她。给你。

choices.english: Step clear of the wool. Of course. There's room now.
choices.chinese: 挪开脚，避开毛线。当然，现在有地方了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Isobel takes the wool. Her free hand goes straight into her jacket pocket before she has quite stood up.
beats.chinese: Isobel接过毛线，还没完全站直，空着的那只手已经伸进外套口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. One mint for the recovery service.
beats.chinese: 好。打捞费，一颗薄荷糖。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She brings out a wrapped mint and holds it towards you. The wool stays tucked firmly under her other arm.
beats.chinese: 她掏出一颗独立包装的薄荷糖，递向你。毛线被她牢牢夹在另一边胳膊下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got three. You won't leave me short.
beats.chinese: 我有三颗。给你一颗，我还够。

choices.english: Take the mint. All right. We're even.
choices.chinese: 接过薄荷糖。好，咱们两清。

choices.english: No mint, thanks. Tell me one studio story in exchange.
choices.chinese: 薄荷糖就不用了，谢谢。换成一个排练室的小故事吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: With the space clear, Isobel retrieves the wool herself. She winds the loose length around the ball before standing.
beats.chinese: 你让开后，Isobel自己捡起毛线。她把散开的线绕回线团，才站起身。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. All accounted for.
beats.chinese: 好了。一点没少。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the ball deep inside her bag and lifts out a half-finished striped sock, checking that its stitches are secure.
beats.chinese: 她把线团塞进包的深处，拿出一只织了一半的条纹袜，检查针上的线圈有没有脱落。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: These go beside the lost property at the studio. Free socks. The bands lose enough of their own.
beats.chinese: 这些织好放排练室失物招领箱旁边，免费拿。那些乐队自己丢的袜子可不少。

choices.english: May I see the stripes?
choices.chinese: 我能看看条纹吗？

choices.english: I'll leave you to your knitting. Bye, Isobel.
choices.chinese: 那不打扰你织袜子了。再见，Isobel。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The wrapped mint changes hands. Isobel's fingers stop searching her pocket.
beats.chinese: 那颗独立包装的薄荷糖到了你手里。Isobel的手指终于不再翻口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Settled. Very reasonable rates.
beats.chinese: 结清了。收费很公道。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes her bag around the wool, leaving only the knitting in her hands, and turns slightly towards the cathedral to continue her wait.
beats.chinese: 她把装着毛线的包收好，手里只留着针织活，稍稍转向教堂，继续等人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy the mint. I'll keep a better grip on the stock.
beats.chinese: 薄荷糖慢慢吃。我会把存货看紧些。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Isobel returns the mint to her pocket and straightens, ready to deliver the replacement payment.
beats.chinese: Isobel把薄荷糖放回口袋，站直身，准备交付替代的报酬。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One drummer wrote LEFT and RIGHT on his sticks. Lost the right one. Asked if he could borrow another left.
beats.chinese: 有个鼓手在两根鼓槌上写了左、右。右边那根丢了，就问能不能再借一根左边的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds up two fingers, lowers one, then takes her knitting back out.
beats.chinese: 她竖起两根手指，收起一根，然后重新拿出针织活。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I lent him a stick. No extra charge for changing hands. That's your story paid.
beats.chinese: 我借了他一根。换只手用不另收费。故事交付，账清了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Isobel spreads the unfinished sock across her own palm. It has narrow green stripes and one much wider orange band.
beats.chinese: Isobel把没织完的袜子摊在自己掌心。袜子上是细细的绿色条纹，中间夹着一道宽得多的橙色。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The orange was meant to be four rows. I was watching an amp repair video. It got twelve.
beats.chinese: 橙色本来只打算织四行。当时我在看修音箱的视频，结果织了十二行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the sock into her bag and closes it, putting the knitting away for now.
beats.chinese: 她把袜子折好放回包里，合上包，暂时收起针织活。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The other sock gets twelve as well. I've written it down. Anyway, I'll let you get on.
beats.chinese: 另一只也织十二行。我记下了。好啦，不耽误你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you leave, Isobel lowers the sock and shifts her bag closer to her feet, keeping the pedestrian space clear.
beats.chinese: 你离开时，Isobel放下袜子，把包挪到脚边，继续给行人留出通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye. Mind yourself.
beats.chinese: 再见。路上当心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the wool is secure inside the bag, then resumes knitting while she waits for the key.
beats.chinese: 她确认毛线稳稳待在包里，便继续织袜子，等钥匙送来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And this can stay where I put it.
beats.chinese: 这个嘛，就老实待在我放它的地方吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the Royal Mile near St Giles’ Cathedral, Isobel recognises you while waiting for a rehearsal-studio key to be returned. She has a finished pair of socks and a small notebook in her hands.
beats.chinese: 另一天，在皇家英里圣吉尔斯大教堂附近，Isobel正等人归还排练室钥匙，看见你便认了出来。她手里拿着一双织好的袜子和一本小记事本。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. These are for someone who helped me move equipment. I've got their size written down.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。这双是给帮我搬设备的人的。尺码我记下了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the socks against the size already recorded in her notebook. It matches. She closes the notebook, folds the socks neatly together and puts them in her bag.
beats.chinese: 她对照记事本上已经记好的尺码，核对了袜子，尺寸相符。她合上本子，把两只袜子整齐叠好，收进包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Their time counts. A thank-you doesn't settle it.
beats.chinese: 工夫得算进去，不能一句谢谢就结了。

causality.presenceReason: Isobel事先约在圣吉尔斯大教堂附近等人归还排练室钥匙，用等候时间织袜子。
causality.placeAttitude: 这里是方便辨认的见面地点，她没有担任导游或招揽生意的意图。
