beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the Royal Mile near St Giles' Cathedral, Dougal Menzies is waiting for his sister with a tote of stuffed baked potatoes for her to taste. The bag rests neatly beside his shoes. He studies a small ingredient list and speaks under his breath.
beats.chinese: 皇家英里靠近圣吉尔斯大教堂的人行道上，Dougal Menzies正等妹妹来尝他做的夹馅烤土豆。手提袋稳稳地收在鞋边。他看着一张小小的配料单，低声嘀咕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've put in more mustard than I meant to.
beats.chinese: 芥末放得比我打算的多。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tucks the list beneath the food container's elastic band, then looks up towards you.
beats.chinese: 他把配料单夹回食盒外的橡皮筋下面，随后抬头看向附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They're for my sister to taste. She's meeting me here for a walk. She'll have plenty to say today.
beats.chinese: 带给我妹妹试味的。她约在这里跟我碰头，一起散步。今天她有得说了。

choices.english: Potato tasting sounds serious.
choices.chinese: 听起来，试吃土豆还是件正经事。

choices.english: That's quite a bag for some potatoes.
choices.chinese: 装几个土豆，这袋子可真够大的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dougal glances down at the closed food container inside his tote. A small ingredient list is tucked under its elastic band.
beats.chinese: Dougal低头看看袋里盖好的食盒。盒子外的橡皮筋下面夹着一张小小的配料单。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Aye, she takes notes. I engrave trophies part-time, and I've had less detailed instructions for those.
beats.chinese: 是啊，她还记笔记呢。我兼职给奖杯刻字，接到的要求都没她这么详细。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He presses the paper securely beneath the band with one precise fingertip.
beats.chinese: 他用一根手指准确地把纸条往橡皮筋下面压牢。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If she approves, these go on the dinner menu. Eight people round my table, provided nobody needs to move their elbows.
beats.chinese: 她要是点头，这道菜就能上聚餐菜单了。我那张桌子能围坐八个人，前提是谁也别动胳膊肘。

choices.english: Is the table too small, then?
choices.chinese: 这么说，桌子太小了？

choices.english: I'll leave the verdict to her. Enjoy your walk.
choices.chinese: 那就留给她来评判吧。祝你们散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dougal glances down at the tote resting neatly beside his shoes.
beats.chinese: Dougal低头看了一眼整齐放在鞋边的手提袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Aye. I do misjudge how much room things need.
beats.chinese: 是啊。我确实老是估不准东西要占多少地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds his hands apart, considers the distance, then widens it considerably.
beats.chinese: 他把双手分开，比画了一下，又把间距拉大了不少。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bought a round dining table for my wee flat. Lovely for dinner. Getting past it with the washing is another matter.
beats.chinese: 给我的小公寓买了张圆餐桌。吃饭是真好。抱着洗好的衣服从旁边过，那就是另一回事了。

choices.english: Wouldn't a smaller table make things easier?
choices.chinese: 换张小一点的桌子，不就方便了吗？

choices.english: I'll carry on. Enjoy the potato tasting.
choices.chinese: 我继续走了。祝试吃顺利。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dougal gives a quiet laugh and lowers his hands to the tote handles.
beats.chinese: Dougal轻轻笑了起来，双手落回袋子的提手上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The table's enormous. It's the flat that's wee. I measured the table properly, then imagined all my friends round it and bought it anyway.
beats.chinese: 桌子大得很，是公寓太小。我好好量过尺寸，可一想到朋友们围坐在旁边，还是买了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He spots his sister farther along the same pavement and lifts one hand in greeting, keeping the tote at his side.
beats.chinese: 他看见妹妹出现在同一条人行道的前方，便抬手招呼，袋子仍拎在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's my sister. She'll tell you the table's ridiculous. She always stays for another potato, though. Nice talking to you.
beats.chinese: 我妹妹来了。她准会说那张桌子太离谱。不过每回她都会留下来再吃一个土豆。跟你聊得很愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dougal nods at your farewell and draws the ingredient list halfway out from beneath the elastic.
beats.chinese: 听你道别，Dougal点点头，把配料单从橡皮筋下抽出一半。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. I'd better check I've written down the mustard. She'll notice before I've got the lid off.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我最好看看有没有把芥末写上去。恐怕盖子还没打开，她就察觉到了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the pavement. Dougal stays where he is, reading the list through his round glasses.
beats.chinese: 你沿人行道继续走。Dougal留在原处，透过圆眼镜查看纸条。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheerio. Enjoy the rest of your day.
beats.chinese: 再见。祝你接下来过得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dougal briefly brings his hands closer together, then shakes his head with a small smile.
beats.chinese: Dougal短暂地把双手收近，又带着一点笑意摇摇头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It would. I nearly sold it once. Then everyone stayed half the evening after dinner, and I took the advert down.
beats.chinese: 是会方便。我有一次差点卖掉它。结果那次饭后，大家又坐了半个晚上，我就把出售广告撤了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He picks up the tote and settles its handles in one hand, then turns his attention back along the street.
beats.chinese: 他拎起袋子，把提手在一只手里握稳，随后转头望向街道前方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll keep sidling past it. No sense pretending I don't know what I've done. Anyway, good talking to you.
beats.chinese: 我就继续侧着身子挤过去吧。总不能装作不知道是自己买的。总之，跟你聊得很愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dougal raises a hand in farewell without trying to prolong the conversation.
beats.chinese: Dougal抬手道别，没有设法把谈话继续下去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. With luck she'll approve it before it gets cold.
beats.chinese: 谢啦。运气好的话，她会在土豆凉掉之前点头。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you carry on along the pavement, he crouches beside the tote and checks that the food container is upright.
beats.chinese: 你沿人行道继续走时，他在袋子旁蹲下，检查食盒有没有放正。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care now.
beats.chinese: 慢走啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another outing along the Royal Mile near St Giles' Cathedral, you see Dougal standing clear of passing pedestrians. He lowers his phone when he recognises you.
beats.chinese: 在皇家英里，在圣吉尔斯大教堂附近，你看见Dougal站在不妨碍行人的位置。他认出你，放低了手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. I'm early for meeting my sister. Thought I'd fit in an old stop-motion short.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。我来早了，正等妹妹。想着趁这会儿看一部老定格动画短片。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pauses the film and pockets the phone, then checks the street for his sister.
beats.chinese: 他暂停影片，把手机放进口袋，又沿街望了望妹妹来了没有。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A little wooden man has spent three minutes trying to put his hat on. I've had mornings like that. Good to see you.
beats.chinese: 一个小木头人花了三分钟，还没把帽子戴好。有些早晨我也差不多。见到你真好。

causality.presenceReason: Dougal事先约好在圣吉尔斯大教堂附近与妹妹碰头散步，并带来夹馅烤土豆请她试吃。

causality.stayingConstraint: 他需要留在约定位置等妹妹，没有紧急任务，也不要求玩家陪等。
causality.currentGoal: 等妹妹到达，让她尝新配方，再一起散步。
causality.currentState: 今天心情轻松，正在查看配料单，知道芥末比原本打算的多，也预料妹妹会有意见。他愿意顺口搭话，但不要求陌生人评价或试吃。
causality.contactTrigger: 袋子从一开始就稳稳收在鞋边。他查看配料单时低声说芥末放多了，随后向附近的玩家解释是带给妹妹试味的，今天妹妹有得说了。接触由实际配方和家庭试吃自然引出，不再以物品让位或致歉启动。
causality.characterContinuity: 他期待妹妹试吃并坦然承认配方偏差，保留好客与自嘲。精确整理配料单呼应雕刻工作的细致，买大餐桌后仍拒绝换小的行为保留误判空间和温和固执。职业、爱丁堡生活背景、家庭关系和兴趣均不改变。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家选择谈试吃时，a延续妹妹认真评味的话题，再引出聚餐餐桌。aa澄清桌大屋小，妹妹出现使谈话结束。ab接受告别，回头核对配料单。玩家选择评论袋子大时，b由物品所占空间转到买大餐桌的经历。ba承认换小桌会方便，却明确保留原桌，随后结束聊天。bb不挽留玩家，蹲下检查食盒。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the Royal Mile, Callum Beattie stands clear of passing pedestrians with a small sketchbook. He has come to borrow building shapes for a fictional map. He looks between two sections of roof, then turns to you.
beats.chinese: 皇家英里街上，Callum Beattie 拿着一本小速写本，站在不妨碍行人的位置。他来这里找些建筑轮廓，用在虚构地图里。他来回看了看两段屋顶，然后转向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: From here, do those two roof sections join up, or is one building behind the other? I'm only borrowing the shape.
beats.chinese: 从这儿看，那两段屋顶是连着的，还是前后两栋？我只借个形状。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He draws a short, careful line. The page contains a coastline rather than a street.
beats.chinese: 他仔细画了一小段线。纸上是一条海岸线，并不是街道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Callum. I'm borrowing a few shapes from these buildings for an island. None of the places on this map exist.
beats.chinese: 我叫 Callum。我在借用这些建筑的几个形状，画一座岛。这张地图上的地方全都不存在。

choices.english: Can I see the map?
choices.chinese: 我能看看地图吗？

choices.english: I'll stick to looking at the real buildings.
choices.chinese: 我还是看看真正的建筑吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Callum angles the sketchbook toward you without moving into the flow of pedestrians. Several narrow strips of land run along one side of the page.
beats.chinese: Callum 把速写本转向你，没有挪进行人的通道。纸的一侧画着几条狭长的陆地。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here's the north coast. Then this bit folds behind the grey ridge, and the harbour sits round here.
beats.chinese: 这是北边的海岸。然后这一块绕到灰色山脊后面，港口就在这附近。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His finger leaves the page and traces a harbour in empty air, well beyond the edge of the book.
beats.chinese: 他的手指离开纸面，在本子边缘之外的半空里描出一个港口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The ridge is three layers of paper in my head. I haven't actually drawn it yet.
beats.chinese: 我脑子里的山脊是三层纸叠起来的。其实还没画上去。

choices.english: I've lost the coast. Show me where it starts.
choices.chinese: 我跟不上这条海岸线了。指给我看看从哪里开始吧。

choices.english: I'd rather just look for a moment, without the explanation.
choices.chinese: 我想自己看一会儿，先不用讲解。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Callum turns the book back toward himself. He glances from its crooked coastline to the buildings along the Royal Mile.
beats.chinese: Callum 把本子转回自己面前，目光在弯曲的海岸线和皇家英里沿街的建筑之间来回移动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I'm leaving most of the street out. Too orderly for this island.
beats.chinese: 行啊。我也没打算把整条街画进去。对这座岛来说，太整齐了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He points toward a visible building edge, keeping his elbow close as someone passes.
beats.chinese: 他指向一处看得见的建筑边缘。有人经过时，他把胳膊肘收在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That edge, though. See the narrow strip of shadow? That's what made me stop.
beats.chinese: 不过那条边挺好。看见那道窄窄的影子了吗？我就是为了它停下来的。

choices.english: Which edge do you mean?
choices.chinese: 你说的是哪条边？

choices.english: I'll leave you to your drawing. Enjoy it.
choices.chinese: 那就不打扰你画画了。慢慢画。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Callum brightens and brings his finger firmly back onto the paper.
beats.chinese: Callum 来了精神，把手指稳稳地落回纸面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, here. Start at this little hook. Follow the pencil line down to the split. Everything beyond my thumb is still missing.
beats.chinese: 对，从这里看。从这个小钩开始，顺着铅笔线往下，到分岔这里。我拇指外面的部分都还没画。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He follows the visible line slowly, then marks the missing section with a small cross. He turns the book back and resumes drawing.
beats.chinese: 他慢慢沿着已有的线条指了一遍，又在缺失的部分画了个小叉。随后他转回本子，继续画起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Now I've got somewhere to put it. Enjoy the rest of your walk.
beats.chinese: 好了。这下我知道该把它画在哪儿了。接下来逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Callum stops mid-gesture and lowers his free hand. He keeps the sketchbook angled toward you.
beats.chinese: Callum 的手势停在一半，空着的那只手放了下来。本子仍朝着你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. I'll keep my finger out of it too.
beats.chinese: 好。我的手指也不来掺和了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the page steady for a few moments, then closes the book and slips it into his shoulder bag.
beats.chinese: 他稳稳拿着本子停了一会儿，然后合上，放进肩包。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's enough coastline for one stop. Enjoy the street.
beats.chinese: 这一站画这些海岸线够了。慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Callum lowers the sketchbook and points again, this time keeping his finger aligned with the actual building.
beats.chinese: Callum 放低速写本，再次指过去。这一次，他的手指始终对着真正的建筑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just there, where the light face meets the dark one. That thin grey line between them.
beats.chinese: 就在那里，亮的那一面和暗的那一面接上的地方。中间那道细细的灰线。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the sketchbook away and drops his pointing hand. His attention settles on the building itself.
beats.chinese: 他收起速写本，放下指着建筑的手，目光落在建筑本身。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I look at stamps all week for auction photographs. I'm giving my eyes something bigger for a minute. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 我整周都盯着邮票拍拍卖图录。现在让眼睛看点大东西。逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Callum lowers his hand immediately and settles the sketchbook against his palm.
beats.chinese: Callum 立刻放下手，把速写本稳稳托在掌心。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. I've got one awkward corner left.
beats.chinese: 谢啦。还剩一个难画的拐角。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shifts farther clear of the passing pedestrians and bends over the page. His pencil begins tracing the corner.
beats.chinese: 他往更不妨碍行人的位置挪了挪，低头看着纸面，开始用铅笔描那个拐角。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a good walk.
beats.chinese: 逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the Royal Mile, Callum Beattie recognises you while opening a small box he carries in both hands, clear of passing pedestrians.
beats.chinese: 在皇家英里，Callum Beattie站在行人通道一侧，双手打开一个小盒子时认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Three layers of paper ridge. Finished it at home. Wanted to see the shadows in daylight.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。三层纸做的山脊，在家里做完的。想看看日光下的影子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tilts his own box towards the light without extending it to you, then closes the lid around the model.
beats.chinese: 他把自己手里的盒子向光倾了倾，没有往你面前递，随后盖好模型。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The middle one's nearly vanished. I'll look again from another angle at home. Enjoy the street.
beats.chinese: 中间那层快隐没了。回家再换个角度看。你慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Edinburgh's Royal Mile, Callum Wren has paused during a walk to tuck a partly wrapped second-hand mug into his crowded bag. He stands in the pedestrian area, with St Giles' Cathedral along the street. Before packing the mug away, he briefly lifts it towards you.
beats.chinese: 在爱丁堡皇家英里的人行区域，散步中的卡勒姆·雷恩停下来，想把一只还没完全包好的二手杯子塞进鼓鼓的包里。沿街能看见圣吉尔斯大教堂。收起杯子前，他朝你短暂地举了举。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just found this. The duck's a funny shape, but the handle fits my hand nicely.
beats.chinese: 刚淘到的。鸭子画得挺怪，杯把倒真顺手。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He draws the bag close to his legs, leaving the walking space clear, and tries to fit the mug inside. Its handle catches on the bag's opening.
beats.chinese: 他把包拢到腿边，留出通行的空间，试着把杯子放进去。杯把勾住了包口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bought one mug. Apparently it needs the whole bag to itself.
beats.chinese: 就买了一个杯子。看来它得独占整个包。

choices.english: What sort of mug did you find?
choices.chinese: 你淘到了什么样的杯子？

choices.english: I'll give you a bit of room.
choices.chinese: 我给你腾点地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Callum turns the wrapped mug so its handle no longer catches on the bag.
beats.chinese: 卡勒姆转了转包着纸的杯子，让杯把不再勾住包口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Brown, with a very small duck on it. Almost missed the duck. That's what sold it.
beats.chinese: 棕色的，上面有只特别小的鸭子。差点没看见。我就是冲着它买的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pushes a fistful of old receipts deeper into the bag. One springs back out, and he catches it against his chest.
beats.chinese: 他把一把旧收据往包里压。其中一张又弹了出来，被他按在胸前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm an apprentice window dresser at a charity shop in Leith. I can arrange a whole window. Can't pack a bag.
beats.chinese: 我在利斯一家慈善商店当橱窗陈列学徒。整个橱窗我都摆得好。一个包倒是装不好。

choices.english: I'd like to see the duck, if it's easy.
choices.chinese: 方便的话，我想看看那只鸭子。

choices.english: No need to unwrap it. Do you collect mugs?
choices.chinese: 不用拆开了。你收集杯子吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: With the extra space, Callum pulls his scarf out of the bag and folds it against the side. He keeps his belongings in his hands.
beats.chinese: 有了多出来的一点空间，卡勒姆从包里抽出围巾，抵在包侧叠起来。他的东西始终拿在手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. I put everything in loose, then act surprised when it comes out loose.
beats.chinese: 谢了。我把东西一股脑塞进去，掉出来的时候还挺惊讶。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He finds a gap beside the wrapped mug and pushes the scarf into it. The bag will only close halfway.
beats.chinese: 他在包好的杯子旁找到了空隙，把围巾塞进去。包却只能合上一半。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nearly fits. Just more in here than I remembered.
beats.chinese: 差一点就装下了。就是装得比我记得的多。

choices.english: I'll carry on, then. Enjoy your walk.
choices.chinese: 那我继续走了。散步愉快。

choices.english: I'm fine here. You go ahead.
choices.chinese: 我在这儿没关系。你先走吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Callum loosens just the top fold of paper and holds the mug where you can see it without taking it.
beats.chinese: 卡勒姆只松开包装纸最上面的一折，举起杯子，让你不用接过去也能看清。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Beside the handle. They've given it enormous feet and hardly any head.
beats.chinese: 在这儿，杯把旁边。脚画得老大，脑袋却几乎没有。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the mug once, chuckles, then wraps it again. This time he carries it separately and settles the bag on his shoulder to continue his walk.
beats.chinese: 他转了一下杯子，笑了笑，又把它包好。这回他把杯子单独拿着，挎好包，继续散步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Aye, worth carrying home. Enjoy the rest of your day.
beats.chinese: 嗯，值得拎回家。祝你今天过得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Callum leaves the wrapping in place and tucks its loose edge around the handle.
beats.chinese: 卡勒姆没有拆包装，只把松开的纸边掖到了杯把周围。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Odd bits of pottery, mostly. This one's getting used, though. I'm not clearing a shelf for a duck.
beats.chinese: 主要收些古怪的陶器。不过这个我会拿来用。我可不为了一只鸭子专门腾个架子。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives up trying to close the overfilled bag and holds its opening together with one hand. You continue along the pedestrian area, leaving him to finish packing.
beats.chinese: 他不再试着合上塞满的包，改用一只手攥住包口。你沿人行区域继续走，让他自己收拾剩下的东西。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've already got mugs stacked inside mugs. Anyway, I'll let you get on. Cheers.
beats.chinese: 我家已经杯子套着杯子了。好了，不耽误你走了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the Royal Mile. Callum stays where he is in the pedestrian area, holding the bag against his hip.
beats.chinese: 你沿皇家英里继续走。卡勒姆留在人行区域原处，把包抵在胯旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. Thanks for the room.
beats.chinese: 你也是。谢谢你腾地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes the scarf out again and loops it around his neck. With that space freed, he finally closes the bag.
beats.chinese: 他又拿出围巾，绕在脖子上。空出这点地方后，他终于把包合上了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There we go. Had a neck available the whole time.
beats.chinese: 这就行了。脖子一直空着呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Callum checks that the scarf is tucked in, then supports the partly open bag underneath with his forearm.
beats.chinese: 卡勒姆确认围巾已经塞好，又用前臂托住没能完全合上的包底。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Aye, that'll do. I'm only out for a wander.
beats.chinese: 嗯，这样就行。我本来就只是出来逛逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He moves past you with the bag held close, keeping to the pedestrian area. He gives a brief nod as he goes.
beats.chinese: 他把包抱在身前，从你身旁经过，始终走在人行区域内。离开时，他轻轻点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy yourself. I'll try to keep the rest of my belongings with me.
beats.chinese: 逛得愉快。我尽量让剩下的家当都跟紧我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another outing on the Royal Mile, Callum Wren is standing in the pedestrian area, eating a small snack he brought with him. He recognises you and waves, then swallows his mouthful.
beats.chinese: 在皇家英里，卡勒姆·雷恩正站在人行区域，吃着自带的小点心。他认出你，先挥了挥手，然后咽下嘴里的食物。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. Out for a walk today. No hurry.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。今天出来散散步，不赶时间。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks along the buildings lining the street. Still taking in the view, he eats another small bite and swallows before speaking again.
beats.chinese: 他看了看沿街的建筑，一边欣赏街景，一边又吃了一小口，咽下后才接着说话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Those buildings look really tidy from here. Lovely to look at. I don't hold my room to that standard, mind.
beats.chinese: 那些建筑从这里看真齐整。看看挺好，不过我房间就不照这个标准来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Calton Hill’s viewpoint path in front of the Dugald Stewart Monument, Isla Menzies stands with a small notebook. After a shift operating a rink’s ice resurfacer and refrigeration plant, she came up for the city view. A radio-play idea has interrupted her break.
beats.chinese: 在卡尔顿山杜格尔德·斯图尔特纪念亭前的观景步道上，Isla Menzies拿着一本小笔记本。她刚结束冰场整冰车和制冷设备的操作班次，上来看看城市，却被一个广播剧点子打断了休息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Captain, the fridge has swallowed the moon.
beats.chinese: 船长，冰箱把月亮吞了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lowers the notebook, notices you nearby, and gives a brief, apologetic smile.
beats.chinese: 她放低笔记本，注意到旁边的你，略带歉意地笑了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry. Radio play. I’m Isla. I came up for the view and brought the nonsense with me.
beats.chinese: 抱歉，在试广播剧台词。我叫Isla。本来上来看风景，结果把这些胡思乱想也带来了。

choices.english: A whole moon? That sounds like a very big fridge.
choices.chinese: 一整个月亮？那冰箱可够大的。

choices.english: No worries. I’ll leave you to it.
choices.chinese: 没事，你继续吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Isla opens the notebook again, suddenly animated.
beats.chinese: Isla又翻开笔记本，顿时来了精神。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enormous. Six doors. A choir of angry peas demanding their moon back.
beats.chinese: 巨大无比。六扇门。一群愤怒的豌豆齐声要求归还月亮。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She writes a six, pauses, then firmly crosses it out.
beats.chinese: 她写下一个六，停了停，又用力划掉。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hang on. Six doors means six sound effects, and our podcast has three people. One door.
beats.chinese: 等等。六扇门就是六种音效，我们播客总共才三个人。一扇门。

choices.english: Let the peas tell the story. You won’t need any doors.
choices.chinese: 让豌豆自己讲吧。这样连门都不用了。

choices.english: I’ll leave the moon in your hands.
choices.chinese: 月亮就交给你处理了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Isla closes the notebook without trying to hold your attention.
beats.chinese: Isla合上笔记本，没有试着继续吸引你的注意。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. The moon can manage without me for a bit.
beats.chinese: 好。月亮暂时没有我也能应付。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lowers her hands and turns toward the city below.
beats.chinese: 她放下双手，转向山下的城市。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I’ve had compressor noise in my ears all shift. I was only trying one line.
beats.chinese: 一个班下来，耳朵里全是压缩机的声音。我本来只打算试一句台词。

choices.english: Give her a nod and move farther along the viewpoint path.
choices.chinese: 向她点点头，沿观景步道往前走一段。

choices.english: You don’t have to stop on my account.
choices.chinese: 你不用因为我停下来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Isla’s pen hovers above the crossed-out number.
beats.chinese: Isla的笔停在那个被划掉的数字上方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Peas giving evidence. A tiny vegetable court. Yes. One witness, though. I’m not voicing a whole bag.
beats.chinese: 豌豆出庭作证。一个小小的蔬菜法庭。行。不过只要一个证人。我可不想给整袋豌豆配音。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She writes “one witness,” shuts the notebook, and gives you a small parting wave.
beats.chinese: 她写下“一个证人”，合上笔记本，轻轻挥手道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That’s enough plot for one break. Cheers for joining in.
beats.chinese: 一次休息想出这些情节够了。谢谢你接我的话。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Isla looks down at the page, where the moon now has several notes beside it.
beats.chinese: Isla低头看看纸页，月亮旁边已经添了好几条备注。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Probably wise. I’ve already given it a maintenance schedule.
beats.chinese: 明智。我都已经给它排上保养计划了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pockets the notebook and turns her full attention to the city, ending the conversation with a nod.
beats.chinese: 她把笔记本放进口袋，点头结束谈话，将注意力全部转回城市景色。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, my break from machinery starts here. I’ll let you get on.
beats.chinese: 好了，现在正式开始远离机器的休息时间。不耽误你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You nod and move farther along the same viewpoint path. Isla stays where she is.
beats.chinese: 你点点头，沿着同一条观景步道往前走了一段。Isla留在原处。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care.
beats.chinese: 慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips the notebook into her pocket and looks toward the monument. Her next words are quietly to herself.
beats.chinese: 她把笔记本塞进口袋，望向纪念亭。接下来的一句是轻声自言自语。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Five minutes without inventing anything. Should be possible.
beats.chinese: 五分钟，什么都不编。应该能做到。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Isla lifts the notebook slightly, then leaves it closed for a moment.
beats.chinese: Isla稍稍举起笔记本，又让它合着停了一会儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I’ll keep the rehearsals in my head. Saves doing all the voices out here.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我在脑子里排练就行。省得在这儿把所有角色的声音都演一遍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives you a friendly nod, angles herself away, and opens the notebook to make a few private edits.
beats.chinese: 她友好地点点头，侧过身去，翻开笔记本，自己改了几笔。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a good day. I’ve got a moon to make smaller.
beats.chinese: 祝你今天愉快。我得把月亮的规模缩一缩。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the edge of the viewpoint path in front of the Dugald Stewart Monument on Calton Hill, Isla stands clear of passing walkers, tapping a beat with her toe. She recognises you and smiles in greeting.
beats.chinese: 在卡尔顿山杜格尔德·斯图尔特纪念亭前的观景步道边缘，Isla站在不妨碍行人通行的位置，用脚尖轻点节拍。她认出你，微笑着打招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. No radio play in my head today. It’s a rhythm from my folk dance class. I really like this one.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天脑子里转的不是广播剧，是民间舞课上的一段节奏。我特别喜欢这一段。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stills her toe and taps the beat with two fingers on her closed notebook. Then she turns to head along the same path on her own, adding a few words as she goes.
beats.chinese: 她停下脚尖，用两根手指在合上的笔记本上轻敲那段节拍。随后她转身，独自沿着同一条步道离开，临走时又说了几句。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I’ll save the steps for class. I’m enjoying the rhythm for now.
beats.chinese: 脚步留到上课再跳，这段节奏我先享受着。

causality.currentGoal: 原想休息看景，临时试一句广播剧台词，并决定是否记下点子。
causality.currentState: 下班后想远离机器声，精力仍足以被荒唐设定迅速点燃。
causality.contactTrigger: 她试台词出声后发现玩家就在附近，主动解释并自报姓名，没有要求玩家评价作品。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Calton Hill's viewing path, in front of the Dugald Stewart Monument, Ewan Cathcart is watching the afternoon light over Edinburgh. He brought two printed theatre listings to choose an evening show and holds them folded. His phone gives a short countdown beep. He looks up towards you.
beats.chinese: 在卡尔顿山 Dugald Stewart 纪念亭前的观景步道上，Ewan Cathcart 正看着爱丁堡城上的午后光线。他带了两张打印的剧目介绍，想选一场晚上的演出，纸一直折好拿在手里。手机发出一声短促的倒计时提示，他抬眼看向附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Not a call. I'm Ewan.
beats.chinese: 不是来电。我叫 Ewan。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps the folded sheets in one hand. His phone screen shows a timer with less than a minute left.
beats.chinese: 他一只手拿着折好的纸。手机屏幕上的倒计时已经不到一分钟。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've given myself a minute to choose tonight's show. Haven't chosen yet.
beats.chinese: 我给自己留了一分钟选晚上的戏。还没选。

choices.english: Are those theatre listings?
choices.chinese: 那是剧目介绍吗？

choices.english: I'll just look at the view.
choices.chinese: 我就看看风景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ewan lowers the folded sheets enough to reveal two show titles. He keeps hold of them rather than offering them over.
beats.chinese: Ewan 把折好的纸稍稍放低，露出两个剧名。他仍自己拿着，没有递过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Aye. Cheap seats, if there are any left. This one has a lighting designer I like. The other starts later. I keep choosing between them instead of booking either.
beats.chinese: 是啊，还有便宜票的话。这场有我喜欢的灯光师，另一场开得晚。我一直在两场之间选，一场也没订。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks the timer, then looks back at the same two titles without moving either sheet.
beats.chinese: 他看了眼倒计时，又看向那两个剧名，两张纸的位置一点没变。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Twenty seconds. Plenty, probably.
beats.chinese: 二十秒。应该还很充裕。

choices.english: What are you waiting for?
choices.chinese: 你在等什么呢？

choices.english: I'll leave you to choose. Enjoy the show.
choices.chinese: 那你慢慢选。祝你看得开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ewan glances towards the city, still holding the folded listings.
beats.chinese: Ewan 朝城市望了一眼，手里仍拿着折好的剧目介绍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. Enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 当然。慢慢看风景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the papers in his vest pocket and shifts a little farther from you, leaving the path clear.
beats.chinese: 他把纸放进背心口袋，稍微挪远了一点，没有占住步道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came up for the light, anyway. Managed about ten seconds of looking at it.
beats.chinese: 我本来就是上来看光线的。到现在大概只看了十秒。

choices.english: What caught your eye in the light?
choices.chinese: 这里的光线有什么吸引你的？

choices.english: Thanks. I'll leave you to it.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。那就不打扰了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ewan studies the two titles again. The timer sounds before he answers.
beats.chinese: Ewan 又端详起那两个剧名。他还没回答，倒计时就响了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: For one to feel settled. Usually happens right at the end.
beats.chinese: 等其中一个让我觉得定下来了。一般都是最后一刻才有这个感觉。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He adds five minutes to the timer. Keeping the listings folded with both titles still facing out, he turns his attention back to them.
beats.chinese: 他给倒计时加了五分钟。介绍页仍折着，两个剧名都露在外面，他重新低头看纸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll give it five more. Anyway, I'll let you get on.
beats.chinese: 再给它五分钟吧。嗯，不耽误你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His alarm sounds as the farewell ends. Ewan looks down once, then taps one of the titles with his thumb.
beats.chinese: 道别的话音刚落，他的闹钟就响了。Ewan 低头看了一眼，用拇指点住其中一个剧名。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That one. Right. Hope they've got a seat.
beats.chinese: 就这个。好。希望还有座位。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stops the alarm, puts the chosen folded listing on top of the other and pockets both. With a small nod, he sets off along the same public path.
beats.chinese: 他关掉闹钟，把选中的那张折好的介绍页放到另一张上面，一起收进口袋。他轻轻点头，沿着这条公共步道走开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。慢慢看风景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ewan looks towards the memorial rather than taking the papers out again.
beats.chinese: Ewan 看向纪念亭，没有再把纸拿出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The light along that edge. Makes the shape much clearer. I watch theatre lighting more than I should.
beats.chinese: 那道边缘上的光。轮廓一下就清楚了。我看戏时总是太留意灯光。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His timer sounds. He silences it through his pocket, then settles his gaze on the memorial. He leaves you room to look or move on.
beats.chinese: 倒计时响了。他隔着口袋把声音按掉，目光重新落在纪念亭上，也给你留出了观看或离开的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll stay for this bit. Enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 这会儿我再看看。你也慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ewan gives a small nod. His phone sounds before he has put his hand back in his pocket.
beats.chinese: Ewan 轻轻点头。手还没放回口袋，手机就响了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Aye. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 好。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He dismisses the alarm without opening either listing. Keeping the folded papers pocketed, he turns and walks away along the viewing path.
beats.chinese: 他关掉闹钟，没有打开任何一张介绍页。折好的纸仍放在口袋里，他转身沿观景步道离开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll decide when I'm down. There's time.
beats.chinese: 等下去再选吧。来得及。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the Calton Hill viewing path by the Dugald Stewart Monument, Ewan Cathcart recognises you with a folded music sheet under his arm.
beats.chinese: 在卡尔顿山Dugald Stewart纪念亭旁的观景步道上，Ewan Cathcart腋下夹着折好的乐谱，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Picked my handbell part just before rehearsal finished. They were putting the bells away.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。排练快结束才选好我的手铃声部。他们都在收铃了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks the marked line, pleased with the choice, then folds the page again.
beats.chinese: 他看了看标出的那一行，对选择挺满意，再把乐谱折好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good part. Could have played it today if I'd picked it an hour earlier. Next week, then. Enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 挺好的声部。早选一小时，今天就能弹上了。那就下周吧。慢慢看风景。

causality.currentState: 说话低缓，待人客气，选择尚未落实。对自己的倒计时比对旁人的时间更宽松。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the viewing path in front of the Dugald Stewart Monument on Calton Hill, Rowan Blackwood is looking over the city. They came up after a day organising animation files at a small studio. As you arrive nearby, they turn from the view.
beats.chinese: 卡尔顿山的 Dugald Stewart 纪念亭前，Rowan Blackwood 正站在观景步道上俯瞰城市。在小型动画工作室整理了一天素材后，他们来这里看看风景。你来到附近时，他们从景色前转过身。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Am I in your way? I was just finishing.
beats.chinese: 我挡着你了吗？我正好看完了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan takes a small step aside, leaving the view clear without stepping into anyone's path.
beats.chinese: Rowan 往旁边挪了一小步，让出视野，也没有挡住其他人的去路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Rowan, by the way. That sounded rather like I owned the view.
beats.chinese: 对了，我叫 Rowan。刚才那话说得好像这片风景归我管似的。

choices.english: I'd like a look from there, thanks.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，我想从那儿看看。

choices.english: You're fine. I can see from here.
choices.chinese: 没关系。我从这里就能看见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You take the space Rowan has cleared. They remain a little to one side, looking out over the city with you.
beats.chinese: 你站到 Rowan 让出的地方。他们留在侧边，和你一起望向下方的城市。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Worth coming up for. My view at work is mostly folders inside other folders.
beats.chinese: 值得上来一趟。我上班时看到的基本都是文件夹里面套文件夹。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan gives the city one more glance, then turns their shoulders away from it.
beats.chinese: Rowan 又看了一眼城市，随后转过肩膀，准备离开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, we've had a good look. Let's call it there.
beats.chinese: 好了，我们也看得差不多了。就到这儿吧。

choices.english: I've only just started. I'll stay here. Enjoy your evening.
choices.chinese: 我才刚开始看呢。我留在这里。祝你晚上愉快。

choices.english: I'm ready to move on too. Goodbye. [Leave the viewing spot.]
choices.chinese: 我也准备走了。再见。[离开观景的位置。]

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan stops moving aside. There is room for both of you to see the city without either changing position.
beats.chinese: Rowan 不再往旁边挪。你们各自站着，都能看见下方的城市。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good. I'll have another look, then. Nobody needs me to name a file up here.
beats.chinese: 那好，我就再看一眼。在这里总没人要我给文件起名字。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They adjust their narrow rectangular glasses and look back towards you with a small smile.
beats.chinese: 他们扶了扶窄矩形眼镜，带着一点笑意转头看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I organise animation assets for work. At home I sort films by how well they end. That system annoys people.
beats.chinese: 我工作时整理动画素材。在家就按结尾好不好给电影分类。这套分法挺惹人烦的。

choices.english: Tell me one with a good ending, then I'll be on my way.
choices.chinese: 说一部结尾好的吧，听完我就走。

choices.english: I'll leave you to the view. Goodbye. [Move on along the path.]
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你看风景了。再见。[沿步道走开。]

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan turns back towards you. You remain facing the city, keeping the spot they offered.
beats.chinese: Rowan 转回来看你。你仍面向城市，留在他们刚才让出的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I've just ended your visit about thirty seconds into it.
beats.chinese: 当然。你才来了三十秒，我就替你宣布结束了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They give a brief, sheepish smile and move away along the same public path.
beats.chinese: 他们略带不好意思地笑了笑，沿着同一条公共步道走开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm off. You carry on. Enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 是我要走了。你慢慢看，好好欣赏。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You leave the viewing spot. Rowan moves aside to let you pass rather than falling into step with you.
beats.chinese: 你离开观景的位置。Rowan 侧身让你经过，没有顺势和你结伴走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good timing, then. I do like leaving while I'm enjoying myself.
beats.chinese: 那时间正好。我确实喜欢趁着还开心的时候离开。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan waits until you are clear, then takes their own way along the viewing path.
beats.chinese: Rowan 等你走开后，也自行沿观景步道离去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Lovely view. Brief introduction. Very manageable evening. Bye.
beats.chinese: 风景很好，认识新人的过程很简短。这晚上一点也不费事。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan turns fully towards you, ready with an answer.
beats.chinese: Rowan 完全转向你，已经有了答案。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Paddington 2. Even Hugh Grant gets a song in prison. Very generous ending.
beats.chinese: 《帕丁顿熊2》。连休·格兰特在监狱里都有首歌唱。这个结尾真够大方的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They grin and give a small farewell wave as you move on. Then they turn back for another look over the city.
beats.chinese: 他们咧嘴一笑，在你离开时轻轻挥手道别，随后转回去，再看看下方的城市。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's my recommendation. I'll spare you the full list. Bye!
beats.chinese: 我就推荐这一部。整张片单就不拿来烦你了。再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You move on along the path. Rowan stays where they are, leaving you room to pass.
beats.chinese: 你沿步道走开。Rowan 留在原地，给你留出经过的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. Nice to meet you.
beats.chinese: 好，很高兴认识你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They lift a hand in farewell, then take off their glasses and wipe a smudge with the hem of their top.
beats.chinese: 他们抬手道别，随后摘下眼镜，用衣服下摆擦掉镜片上的污印。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah. That explains the blurry buildings. Bye!
beats.chinese: 啊，难怪那些楼看起来糊糊的。再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the viewing path in front of the Dugald Stewart Monument on Calton Hill, you see Rowan Blackwood again. They are about to leave along the path when they recognise you and smile.
beats.chinese: 在卡尔顿山 Dugald Stewart 纪念亭前的观景步道上，你又见到了 Rowan Blackwood。他们正准备沿步道离开，认出你后便露出了笑容。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. Good to see you. I've really enjoyed the view today. I was just heading off.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。见到你真好。今天看得很尽兴，我正要走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan pauses for another look over the city, looking pleased rather than tired. Then they continue along the path on their own, turning briefly towards you.
beats.chinese: Rowan 停下片刻，再看了一眼下方的城市，神情满足，没有倦意。随后，他们独自继续沿步道走，短暂地转头看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's me done for today. Take your time. Enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 我今天就看到这里了。你慢慢看，好好欣赏。

causality.placeAttitude: 真心喜欢这处景色，把短暂观景当作愉快的下班活动，并非急于逃离社交。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有外部时限，可以自行决定停留多久，但习惯在仍然尽兴时离开。
causality.currentGoal: 看够景色后结束自己的停留，不承担导游或工作讲解任务。
causality.currentState: 心情轻松，愿意和陌生人说几句，已经接近自己打算离开的时刻。
causality.contactTrigger: 用户来到附近，Rowan 担心挡住视线，主动询问并让开一点。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留素材管理员职业、友好干幽默、按结尾整理电影的爱好，以及容易替所有人宣布结束的缺点。重逢时仍然真诚友好，在尽兴时结束自己的停留，不替用户决定何时离开。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the viewpoint path in front of the Dugald Stewart Monument on Calton Hill, Rowan Kessler holds a folded city map. He came up for the view before walking home to Leith. As you come alongside, he looks up from the paper.
beats.chinese: 在卡尔顿山 Dugald Stewart 纪念亭前的观景步道上，Rowan Kessler 手里拿着一张折叠的城市地图。他上来看风景，之后打算步行回利斯。你来到旁边时，他从地图上抬起头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, Leith is this way.
beats.chinese: 好，回利斯是这边。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the map close to his chest and turns towards you. Its title is upside down from where he is reading it.
beats.chinese: 他把地图拿在胸前，转向你。从他阅读的方向看，地图标题是倒着的。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Rowan, by the way. Have I got that the wrong way round? I'm only checking the general direction, not planning the whole route.
beats.chinese: 对了，我叫 Rowan。没认反吧？我只认个大方向，不排整条路。

choices.english: Your map is upside down.
choices.chinese: 你的地图拿倒了。

choices.english: I don't know. I'm just looking at the view.
choices.chinese: 我不清楚。我只是来看看风景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan looks at the map's title, then at the finger he has planted beside it.
beats.chinese: Rowan 看了看地图标题，又看了看自己按在旁边的手指。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah, yes. I've been following the fold. Very definite line, mind you.
beats.chinese: 啊，是啊。我一直顺着折痕看呢。不过，那条线确实挺清楚。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the map around without embarrassment and finds Leith with his fingertip.
beats.chinese: 他毫不尴尬地把地图转过来，用指尖找到了利斯。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I marshal lanes at swimming galas. I can keep eight lanes straight. Two streets seem to be beyond me.
beats.chinese: 我在游泳比赛做泳道检录。八条泳道我能管得清清楚楚，两条街好像就超出我的本事了。

choices.english: Keep the map open for a bit, then.
choices.chinese: 那就先把地图摊着看一会儿吧。

choices.english: Want to plan the whole walk home?
choices.chinese: 要不要把回家的整条路线规划一下？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan holds the map closer to himself and looks out over the city below.
beats.chinese: Rowan 把地图往自己身前收了收，望向山下的城市。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I live in Leith. Doesn't seem to give me any special advantage.
beats.chinese: 没事。我就住在利斯。看来也没因此多什么优势。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He catches a loose corner of the paper under his thumb before it can flap into your space.
beats.chinese: 他用拇指压住地图翘起的一角，免得纸张翻到你这边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My friends check anything I say about directions. They've had practice.
beats.chinese: 朋友们听我指路，都会再核实一下。他们已经练出来了。

choices.english: Enjoy your walk. Goodbye.
choices.chinese: 祝你散步愉快。再见。

choices.english: Have you ever sent someone the wrong way?
choices.chinese: 你以前给别人指错过路吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan opens one more panel of the map, keeping it low so it does not cover the view.
beats.chinese: Rowan 又展开一页地图，拿得低低的，没有挡住风景。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair suggestion. The street names are easier to read this way up.
beats.chinese: 这建议合理。这样拿，街名也容易认多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He follows the printed streets with a finger and stops at his own street. He gives you a small nod, then returns his attention to the map.
beats.chinese: 他用手指沿着印出的街道移动，停在自己住的那条街上。他朝你微微点头，随后继续看地图。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. My street. Thanks for catching that. Enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 找到了，我家那条街。多谢你看出来。慢慢欣赏风景吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan starts folding the map as soon as you mention planning the whole route.
beats.chinese: 你一提规划整条路线，Rowan 就开始折地图。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No, thanks. I don't want every turn settled before I've taken a step.
beats.chinese: 不用了，谢谢。我不想一步还没走，就把每个弯都定好了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the map in his trouser pocket and turns towards the city, leaving you room beside him.
beats.chinese: 他把地图装进裤袋，转身看向城市，给你留出了身旁的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mind you, turning the paper round was worth doing. Thanks for that. I'll have my look at the city now.
beats.chinese: 不过，把地图转过来还是很有必要的。谢谢你了。现在我先看看城里的风景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan lowers the map completely and nods goodbye.
beats.chinese: Rowan 把地图完全放低，点头道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And you enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 你也好好看风景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He moves a few paces along the same level path, clear of people passing, and opens the map again.
beats.chinese: 他沿同一层的步道走开几步，避开来往行人，重新展开地图。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheerio.
beats.chinese: 再见啦。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan raises his eyebrows and stops trying to fold the map.
beats.chinese: Rowan 扬起眉毛，暂时不折地图了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A visiting cousin wanted Portobello. I sent him to Stockbridge. Gave him lovely clear directions, too.
beats.chinese: 有个来做客的表亲想去波托贝洛，我把他指去了斯托克布里奇。路线还给他说得清清楚楚。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He finishes folding the paper into a small rectangle and slips it into his trouser pocket, smiling at the memory.
beats.chinese: 他把地图折成一个小长方形，塞进裤袋，想起这件事便笑了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Wrong end of town. No hesitation at all. Anyway, I'll leave you to your view. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 完全是城里的另一个方向。当时一点也没犹豫。好了，不打扰你看风景了。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the Calton Hill viewpoint path near the Dugald Stewart Monument, Rowan Kessler recognises you and lifts a hand.
beats.chinese: 在卡尔顿山Dugald Stewart纪念亭附近的观景步道上，Rowan Kessler认出你，抬手打招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Been watching a swimming gala. Off duty, so I could actually stay for the last heat.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。刚去看游泳比赛。没值班，倒能一直看到最后一组。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He smiles at the memory and shifts his bag comfortably onto his shoulder.
beats.chinese: 他想起来笑了笑，把包往肩上挪舒服一些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Whole row cheering the last swimmer home. Best bit of the afternoon. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 一整排人都在给最后那位游泳者加油。下午最棒的一段。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Trinity College's Parliament Square, Bridie Fahey-Kinsella has paused during a walk before heading home to Rathmines. She is doing a crossword beside the public stone-paved path, holding the folded newspaper firmly in one hand. She looks up at you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在圣三一学院的 Parliament Square 庭院，Bridie Fahey-Kinsella 正在回拉思敏斯家之前散步。她停在公共石铺通道旁做填字题，一只手稳稳拿着折好的报纸。她抬头看向附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Excuse me. Have you got the time?
beats.chinese: 打扰一下。请问现在几点了？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bridie keeps hold of the newspaper and slips her pencil between its pages. With her free hand, she gathers her jade scarf against her coat.
beats.chinese: Bridie 仍拿稳报纸，把铅笔夹进纸页之间。她用空着的手将翡翠绿色围巾拢到外套前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Lost track doing this. Just deciding whether to try another clue or head home.
beats.chinese: 做着做着就忘了看时间。正琢磨着再做一道，还是回家。

choices.english: Tell her the time and ask how the crossword is going.
choices.chinese: 告诉她时间，再问问填字题做得怎么样。

choices.english: Just tell her the time.
choices.chinese: 只告诉她时间。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: After your answer, Bridie glances down at the crossword, keeping a firm grip on the newspaper.
beats.chinese: 听完你的回答，Bridie 低头看了看填字题，手里仍稳稳拿着报纸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Still time for one more, then. Very little luck so far. I keep tea-blending records at a Dublin tea merchant. Twenty-odd years of neat columns. This page is a disgrace.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。那还够再磨一道。目前没做出几道。我在都柏林一家茶商那里管拼配记录。二十多年，表格都整整齐齐。这页可真不像样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She unfolds the crossword, then taps one pencilled answer with her fingernail.
beats.chinese: 她展开填字题，用指甲点了点一个铅笔写的答案。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've put the same word in twice. Very efficient. Almost certainly wrong.
beats.chinese: 同一个词填了两遍。效率真高。十有八九错了。

choices.english: Do you choose the teas too?
choices.chinese: 茶也是由你来挑选的吗？

choices.english: I'll leave work alone. Seen any good television dramas?
choices.chinese: 那就不聊工作了。最近看过什么好看的电视剧吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: After you tell her the time, Bridie takes one last look at the crossword in her hands.
beats.chinese: 你告诉她时间后，Bridie 最后看了一眼手里的填字题。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I'd best head home, then.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。那我还是该回家了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the crossword outward and puts her pencil into her coat pocket.
beats.chinese: 她把填字题朝外折好，将铅笔放进外套口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's enough staring at it for one afternoon. I've barely filled anything in.
beats.chinese: 一个下午盯它这么久，够了。其实也没填上几个字。

choices.english: Enjoy the rest of your walk. Continue along the public path.
choices.chinese: 祝你接下来散步愉快。沿公共通道继续走。

choices.english: If you're finished, could I have the crossword?
choices.chinese: 如果你不做了，可以把填字题给我吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bridie presses the newspaper shut. Her answer comes before you can say anything else.
beats.chinese: Bridie 把报纸压合起来，没等你再说什么就开了口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm not recommending tea on my walk. I get quite enough of that.
beats.chinese: 散步的时候我不推荐茶。这种事平时已经够多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tucks the paper under her arm, then pauses with her mouth pressed tight. Her shoulders drop slightly.
beats.chinese: 她把报纸夹到腋下，抿着嘴停了停，肩膀稍稍放松。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You asked about the job. Sorry, I jumped ahead. Records are my bit. Anyway, I'll be getting home. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 你问的是工作。抱歉，我想岔了。记录才是我负责的部分。好了，我该回家了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bridie lowers the newspaper. Her brisk delivery becomes noticeably more animated.
beats.chinese: Bridie 放低报纸。她原本利落的语气明显活泼起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Last night's had a woman hide a will in a biscuit tin. I'd have found it before the opening credits. I always check for biscuits.
beats.chinese: 昨晚那集，有个女人把遗嘱藏进饼干盒。换我，片头字幕没放完就找到了。我总得看看有没有饼干。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives a short laugh and unfolds the crossword again, remaining beside the path with room for people to pass.
beats.chinese: 她短促地笑了一声，重新展开填字题，仍站在通道旁，给行人留出空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. One more clue before I go home and shout at the next episode. Enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 好了。再做一道就回家，对着下一集继续嚷嚷。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the public path, Bridie stays beside it with her folded newspaper.
beats.chinese: 你沿公共通道继续走，Bridie 拿着折好的报纸，仍站在通道旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. Thanks for telling me the time.
beats.chinese: 你也是。谢谢你告诉我时间。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the newspaper firmly under her arm and smooths her scarf flat so neither catches the breeze.
beats.chinese: 她把报纸牢牢夹在腋下，又将围巾抚平，免得再被风吹起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Home, then. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 好了。那就回家了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Bridie opens the newspaper to check that the whole crossword is on the folded section.
beats.chinese: Bridie 展开报纸，确认折出来的那部分包含完整的填字题。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Certainly. The pencil stays with me. It's done nothing wrong.
beats.chinese: 当然可以。铅笔我留下。它又没犯错。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She hands you the newspaper with the crossword facing upward, then secures her scarf and turns along the paving.
beats.chinese: 她把填字题朝上递给你，随后拢好围巾，转身沿石铺道路走去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Rub out anything I've written if it gets in your way. None of it has my full confidence. Cheerio.
beats.chinese: 我写的答案要是碍事，尽管擦掉。没一个是我十拿九稳的。再见啦。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Trinity College's Parliament Square, Bridie stands beside the public path, reading her phone. She recognises you and lifts a hand.
beats.chinese: 在圣三一学院 Parliament Square 庭院，Bridie 正站在公共通道旁看手机。她认出了你，抬手招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Just reading the recap of last night's drama. I missed the episode.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。正在看昨晚那部电视剧的剧情梗概。那集我没看上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her eyes stop on one sentence. She locks the screen before reading further, slips the phone into her coat pocket and resumes her walk along the paving with a small, expectant smile.
beats.chinese: 她的目光停在一句关键内容上。她不再往下读，主动锁屏，把手机放进外套口袋，带着一点期待的笑意，继续沿石铺道路散步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enough. Any more and I'm spoiling it for myself. I'll watch it later. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 够了，再看就算我自己剧透自己。晚点再看那集。散步愉快。

causality.presenceReason: Bridie 回拉思敏斯家前在圣三一学院 Parliament Square 庭院散步，停在公共石铺通道旁做随身报纸上的填字题。

causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须久留的事务。她做题时没留意时间，问清后自行决定再做一道或回家，不借问时间催促玩家。
causality.currentGoal: 先问清现在几点，再决定继续做题还是结束停留。
causality.currentState: 正在休息，语速利落，愿意短聊，但对工作话题容易过度警觉。报纸一直由她拿稳，没有掉落或侵入玩家脚边。
causality.contactTrigger: 她做填字题忘了留意时间，向附近玩家礼貌询问现在几点，并说明自己正在决定继续做题还是回家。玩家选择只报时，或报时后主动询问填字题。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留茶商拼配记录员职业、严谨习惯、休息边界、抢先误判的缺点，以及电视剧和干幽默兴趣。她会因普通职业提问先竖起防备，也能意识到误判并简短道歉。重逢中她自主停止阅读剧情梗概，保留稍后看剧的期待。
causality.reactionAndChange: a中玩家报时并询问填字题，她决定还有时间再做一道，谈到自己的记录工作和填错的答案。aa中她把职业提问误判为求推荐，简短道歉后离开。ab中她兴致勃勃聊剧情，再留下做题并结束交谈。b中玩家只报时，她道谢并决定回家，将铅笔收进口袋。ba中玩家继续走，她礼貌告别并收好物品。bb中她应请求交出报纸，留下自己的铅笔后离开。重逢时她主动招呼，读到关键剧情便自行锁屏，带着期待继续散步，不要求玩家看过该剧或参与讨论。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: In Trinity College's Parliament Square, Aoife Kavanagh pauses beside the public stone path to look at the bell tower. They have come through on their way home with vegetables. As you arrive nearby, they shift their shopping bag closer to their feet.
beats.chinese: 在圣三一学院的Parliament Square庭院，Aoife Kavanagh停在公共石铺道路旁看钟楼。他们买了蔬菜，回家途中经过这里。你来到附近时，他们把购物袋往脚边挪了挪。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came through for a look at the bell tower. The carrots needed an outing.
beats.chinese: 我绕过来看看钟楼。胡萝卜也需要出来逛逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aoife leaves the space beside them clear and gathers the bag handles into one hand.
beats.chinese: Aoife让出身旁的空位，把袋子的提手拢到一只手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Aoife. I was just heading home, so there's room here if you want a look.
beats.chinese: 我叫Aoife。我正要回家，你要是想看看，这里有地方。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll stop a moment. Are the carrots heading home now?
choices.chinese: 谢谢。我停一会儿。胡萝卜现在要回家了吗？

choices.english: Thanks. Don't let me keep you. Goodbye.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。那不耽误你了，再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aoife rests the bag against their leg, staying at the edge of the path.
beats.chinese: Aoife把袋子靠在腿边，仍站在道路边缘。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Home for roasting. My housemate has picked a silent comedy for tonight. We usually spend half the film arguing about the title cards.
beats.chinese: 回家进烤箱。室友选好了今晚看的默片喜剧。我们通常有半部电影的时间都在争论字幕卡。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They lift the bag as if ready to leave, then lower it again as another thought occurs to them.
beats.chinese: 他们提起袋子，像是准备走了，却又想起什么，把袋子放低。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Actually, here's one. If a title card explains why someone falls over before they fall, has it spoiled the joke?
beats.chinese: 对了，有个问题。如果人还没摔倒，字幕卡就先解释了摔倒的原因，是不是把笑点说破了？

choices.english: Yes. Let me see the fall first.
choices.chinese: 是啊。先让我看见那个人摔倒再说。

choices.english: I'll leave that argument to you two. I need to go now.
choices.chinese: 这个问题留给你们俩争吧。我现在得走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aoife turns towards the path home and gives a small farewell wave.
beats.chinese: Aoife转向回家的方向，轻轻挥手道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye now. Oh, hold on, before you go. One tiny question.
beats.chinese: 再见啦。哦，等一下，走之前问个小问题。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their raised hand becomes a counting gesture, though they have only one question.
beats.chinese: 他们挥到一半的手变成了掰手指数数的姿势，尽管只打算问一个问题。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Would you watch a silent comedy if the final five minutes were missing? I said yes at breakfast, and I've been adding conditions ever since.
beats.chinese: 一部默片喜剧要是缺了最后五分钟，你还会看吗？我早餐时说会，后来就一直在往上加条件。

choices.english: Yes, but I'd be annoyed. That's my answer. Goodbye!
choices.chinese: 会，但我会很恼火。我的答案就这些。再见！

choices.english: I haven't got time for a question. Goodbye!
choices.chinese: 我没时间回答问题了。再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aoife nods and keeps the bag raised this time.
beats.chinese: Aoife点点头，这回一直提着袋子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Exactly. Show me the fall. I can usually work out what the floor contributed.
beats.chinese: 没错，先让我看他摔下去。地板在其中起了什么作用，我通常自己看得出来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They glance down at the vegetables, give you a cheerful nod, and start home along the public path.
beats.chinese: 他们低头看看蔬菜，愉快地向你点点头，沿着公共通道往家走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, these need cooking. Enjoy the square. Bye!
beats.chinese: 好了，这些菜还得做呢。你好好逛，再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aoife immediately gathers the loose bag handle and turns slightly aside as you leave.
beats.chinese: Aoife立刻收好松开的袋子提手，在你离开时微微侧身。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. Off you go.
beats.chinese: 当然，你快去吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They give a brief wave without adding another question, then look back up at the bell tower.
beats.chinese: 他们简短地挥挥手，没有再加一个问题，随后抬头望向钟楼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Lovely talking to you. Bye now.
beats.chinese: 聊得很开心。再见啦。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aoife's mouth opens for a follow-up, then closes as they register your goodbye.
beats.chinese: Aoife张口想追问，听清你的道别后，又把话收了回去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes and annoyed. Fair enough. I'll leave your answer intact.
beats.chinese: 会看，但会恼火。很合理。我就不往你的答案里添东西了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They give a quick nod and walk on with the shopping bag, ending the conversation before another question escapes.
beats.chinese: 他们利落地点点头，提着购物袋走开，没让下一个问题再溜出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye! Home for me too.
beats.chinese: 再见！我也该回家了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aoife lowers their counting hand at once.
beats.chinese: Aoife立刻放下了那只正要掰手指的手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. That wasn't going to be a tiny question anyway.
beats.chinese: 当然。那个问题说起来也小不了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue on, they stay beside the path to straighten the twisted bag handles. They make no attempt to call you back.
beats.chinese: 你继续前行，他们留在路边，理顺拧在一起的袋子提手，没有再叫住你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye now. Have a good day.
beats.chinese: 再见啦。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Trinity College's Parliament Square, you see Aoife beside the public path, checking their phone with the bell tower in view. They recognise you and smile.
beats.chinese: 在圣三一学院的Parliament Square庭院，你看到Aoife站在能看见钟楼的公共道路旁看手机。他们认出你，笑了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. I'm meeting my housemate here, and I've arrived ten minutes early.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。我约了室友在这里碰面，居然早到了十分钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aoife checks the time once more, then puts the phone in their pocket and remains clear of the passing foot traffic.
beats.chinese: Aoife又确认了一遍时间，随后把手机放进口袋，仍站在不妨碍行人的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've checked twice. A rare enough event without getting the time wrong.
beats.chinese: 我已经确认两遍了。难得早到一次，可不能是看错了时间。

causality.presenceReason: Aoife买完晚餐用的蔬菜，回家途中特意经过庭院看一眼钟楼，在玩家抵达前已停留。
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢顺路看看钟楼，把这里当作日常步行中的短暂停留处，并非工作场所。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须留在庭院的任务，手中的蔬菜尚待回家烹饪，因此本来已经准备离开。
causality.currentGoal: 看完钟楼便带菜回家，晚上与长期室友一起看默片喜剧。
causality.currentState: 今天心情轻松，愿意闲聊，临别时容易想起一个实际上不短的问题。
causality.contactTrigger: 玩家来到附近，Aoife主动把购物袋挪近脚边，留出身旁空间，并用胡萝卜出门散步的玩笑搭话。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the edge of a public path in Trinity College's Parliament Square, Dara Kinsella stands with an imaginary railway map tucked inside a notebook. On their phone, a friend's message about a spare theatre ticket is waiting for a reply.
beats.chinese: 在圣三一学院 Parliament Square 庭院的公共通道边侧，Dara Kinsella 站定，虚构铁路图夹在笔记本里。手机上，朋友关于一张多余剧票的消息还等着回复。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Quick question. If someone says 'I might go', would you take that as a reason to hold a ticket for them?
beats.chinese: 问一句。有人说“我可能去”，你会觉得应该替那人留着票吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dara glances down at the message again, keeping the notebook tucked against their side.
beats.chinese: Dara 又低头看了一眼消息，笔记本仍夹在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I said I might go. Apparently they need something a bit more useful than that.
beats.chinese: 我说我可能去。看来他们需要一个比这更管用的答复。

choices.english: If someone else wants the ticket, they need a yes or a no.
choices.chinese: 要是还有别人想要那张票，他们就得知道你到底去不去。

choices.english: An evening without a fixed plan can be nice.
choices.chinese: 晚上不把计划定死，也挺好的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dara opens the message fully. Their unfinished railway map rests against the back of the phone.
beats.chinese: Dara 点开完整消息。那张没画完的铁路图垫在手机背后。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair. I chase costume purchase approvals on film jobs. At work, I'd be sending a second email by now.
beats.chinese: 有道理。我在剧组做服装采购审批的跟进。要是在工作中，我这会儿都该发第二封催办邮件了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They start typing, stop, then delete the short reply.
beats.chinese: 他们开始打字，停下来，又删掉了那条简短的回复。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's someone else who'll take it. And I've just typed 'probably'. Useless. Let me try again.
beats.chinese: 还有别人愿意要。我刚才居然又打了个“大概”。没用。重来。

choices.english: If you want to go, send a definite yes.
choices.chinese: 想去的话，就明确回复去。

choices.english: If you'd rather stay here, let the other person have it.
choices.chinese: 要是更想待在这里，就把票让给另一个人吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dara's expression brightens. They tuck the phone behind the open notebook.
beats.chinese: Dara 的神情轻快起来，把手机塞到摊开的笔记本后面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Exactly. Turn up, see what's available. If it's full, try somewhere else. Easy enough.
beats.chinese: 就是。到了再看有什么。满了就换个地方。挺简单。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They lift the notebook slightly. Beneath a small drawing of the bell tower, two railway lines end without station names.
beats.chinese: 他们稍稍抬起笔记本。小小的钟楼图下面，两条铁路线到了尽头，还没写站名。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came here to put that tower on a made-up railway map. Haven't even given it a station yet.
beats.chinese: 我来这里，就是想把那座钟楼画进虚构的铁路图。连车站都还没给它安排上。

choices.english: Trying somewhere else can cost another fare. I'll leave you to decide.
choices.chinese: 换个地方可能还得多花一趟车钱。你慢慢决定吧。

choices.english: Give the tower a station, then. That part you can decide now.
choices.chinese: 那就给钟楼加个车站吧。这件事现在就能定。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dara reads the ticket message once more, then types without stopping.
beats.chinese: Dara 又看了一遍关于剧票的消息，随后一口气打完回复。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I do want to see it. Right. 'Yes, I'll take it. Where are we meeting?' Sent.
beats.chinese: 我是想看的。好。“去，票给我吧。我们在哪里碰面？”发了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They close the notebook, pocket the phone and start along the paved path, leaving you clear space.
beats.chinese: 他们合上笔记本，把手机放进口袋，沿石铺道路往前走，给你留出充足的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm off, then. The railway can survive without its final station. Bye!
beats.chinese: 那我走了。铁路少一个终点站也不会垮。再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dara looks from the message to the unfinished drawing and lets out a small breath.
beats.chinese: Dara 看看消息，又看看没完成的画，轻轻呼了口气。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Actually, I want to finish this. I'll tell them to give the ticket to the other person.
beats.chinese: 其实我想把这张画画完。我跟他们说，把票给另一个人吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They send the reply, put the phone away and turn the notebook back towards themself.
beats.chinese: 他们发出回复，收起手机，把笔记本转回自己面前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Done. They've got an answer, and I've got a pencil. Enjoy the square.
beats.chinese: 好了。他们有答复了，我也有铅笔可忙。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dara lowers the notebook. Their quick agreement stops before it becomes another suggestion.
beats.chinese: Dara 放低笔记本，原本顺口要接上的话停住了，没有再提一个新方案。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah. Yes. I was thinking I could walk. That doesn't cover everybody, does it.
beats.chinese: 啊，对。我只想着自己可以走过去。别人可不一定都行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They close the notebook and bring the unanswered message back onto the screen, turning aside to read it.
beats.chinese: 他们合上笔记本，重新打开那条没回复的消息，侧过身认真看起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll sort my own evening out. Thanks for saying. Bye.
beats.chinese: 我自己把今晚的事想清楚吧。谢谢你提醒。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dara takes out a pencil and draws a small station beside the bell tower.
beats.chinese: Dara 拿出铅笔，在钟楼旁边画了一座小车站。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bell Central. Two platforms, no trains. Very cheap to operate.
beats.chinese: 钟楼中央站。两个站台，一辆车都没有。运营成本很低。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They briefly angle the page towards you, then turn it back and begin adding the station name. The phone remains tucked behind it.
beats.chinese: 他们把纸页朝你倾斜了一下，随后转回去，开始写站名。手机依旧夹在后面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. One decision made. I'll finish the lettering here. Enjoy your evening!
beats.chinese: 好了，总算定下一件事。我在这儿把字写完。晚上愉快！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Trinity College's Parliament Square, Dara has their imaginary railway map open at the edge of the public path. They look up and recognise you.
beats.chinese: 在圣三一学院的 Parliament Square 庭院，Dara 在公共通道边侧摊着虚构铁路图。他们抬起头，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again! Only drew a little bit today, but it joins up two lines that weren't connected.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了！今天只画了一小段，不过刚好把原来不相接的两条线连上了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dara traces the short stretch with their pen, then closes the notebook with a pleased nod and starts along the paved path.
beats.chinese: Dara 用笔沿着那一小段线路比画了一下，满意地点点头，合上本子，沿石铺道路继续往前走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's enough for today. I can still change the rest. See you!
beats.chinese: 今天先停在这里，剩下的还可以改。回头见！

causality.presenceReason: Dara 在玩家出现前就来庭院画虚构铁路图，准备把眼前的钟楼加入其中。
causality.placeAttitude: 把庭院当作可以临时停下来画画的地方，并无带人参观的意图。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须留在庭院的安排，但朋友的多余剧票需要明确答复，另有人愿意接手。
causality.currentGoal: 原本想画完地图，收到消息后又要决定是否接受剧票，先就自己已经发出的“可能去”询问一句有限的措辞判断。
causality.currentState: 下班后的心态轻快、愿意主动搭话，却习惯拖延休闲承诺，已经用含糊答复让朋友等候。询问只针对这句话是否意味着要留票，不要求玩家替其安排晚上。
causality.contactTrigger: Dara 已在公共通道边侧站稳，地图夹在笔记本里，手机上留着待回复的剧票消息。他们主动问附近的玩家，收到“我可能去”是否会替对方留票，随后坦白这正是自己发出的答复。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留剧组服装采购与报销文员学徒身份、工作上重视确认、休闲时爱留余地、虚构地图爱好，以及轻快具体的玩笑。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 明确接受剧票并收好东西离开交谈。ab 明确让票，留在原处画图。ba 被提醒交通成本后停止泛泛推荐，感谢提醒，收起画本独自处理消息。bb 先给虚构车站命名，以玩笑结束交谈，剧票仍未答复。
causality.spatialContinuity: 初遇在庭院公共通道边侧发起，不靠突然转身、险些碰撞或挡路制造接触。全程使用可见钟楼与石铺道路，人物只在边侧停留或沿道路前行，道具均为随身手机、笔记本和笔。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Dara Kinsella。本次重逢位于圣三一学院庭院，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: In Trinity College's Parliament Square, Sorcha Ní Riain has paused during a walk to redraw their hallway plan. They stand beside the public stone path with a notebook and a drawing. As you pass, they look up.
beats.chinese: 在圣三一学院的 Parliament Square 庭院，Sorcha Ní Riain 散步途中停下来，重新画自家的走廊平面图。Sorcha 拿着笔记本和图纸站在公共石铺通道旁，在你经过时抬起头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Can I borrow a hallway opinion? Two stools or one bench?
beats.chinese: 借你一个走廊意见，两张凳子，还是一张长凳？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sorcha holds the sheet against the notebook, keeping the path clear. The drawing shows a narrow rectangle, two small squares and several crossed-out measurements. Their expression stays completely level.
beats.chinese: Sorcha 将图纸抵在笔记本上拿着，让通道保持畅通。图上画着一个狭长矩形、两个小方块，还有几处被划掉的尺寸。Sorcha 面不改色。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The stools have asked to speak separately. I'm Sorcha.
beats.chinese: 凳子要求分别陈述。我叫 Sorcha。

choices.english: They'll need separate plans. You've put both their locations on this one.
choices.chinese: 那得分别给它们画图。你把它们的位置都标在这一张上了。

choices.english: Is it actually a floor plan? I can't tell if you're joking.
choices.chinese: 这真是平面图吗？我听不出你是不是在开玩笑。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sorcha looks down at the two squares, then turns the sheet over as if concealing evidence.
beats.chinese: Sorcha 低头看了看那两个小方块，随后把纸翻过去，像是在藏证据。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A serious security failure. I manage kit for a rugby team. Usually I only reveal where the socks are.
beats.chinese: 严重的保密失误。我给一支橄榄球队管装备。平时我只泄露袜子的位置。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn it back and write a small number eleven in the corner. Their expression stays completely level.
beats.chinese: Sorcha 又把纸翻回来，在角落写下一个小小的数字十一，脸上依然毫无波澜。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eleven redraws. Four metres of hallway. The furniture hasn't moved once.
beats.chinese: 重画了十一遍。走廊长四米。家具一次都没挪过。

choices.english: Write 'STOOLS ON STRIKE' at the top. That explains the lack of movement.
choices.chinese: 在顶上写“凳子罢工”。这样就能解释为什么一直没动了。

choices.english: I'll leave the stools to negotiate. Enjoy your walk.
choices.chinese: 那就让凳子自己谈判吧。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sorcha holds the sheet upright. The two squares are labelled with the word 'stool'.
beats.chinese: Sorcha 把纸竖起来。两个小方块旁边都标着“凳子”。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A real hallway. Four metres. The stools haven't approved the drawings.
beats.chinese: 真走廊。四米长。凳子还没批准图纸。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sorcha opens their mouth for another remark, then stops. They lower the sheet and tuck its bottom edge into the notebook.
beats.chinese: Sorcha 张嘴还想说一句，随后停住了。Sorcha 放低纸张，把纸的下沿夹进笔记本里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry. Yes, it's a floor plan for my flat. Two stools and a mug shelf. I keep redrawing it.
beats.chinese: 抱歉。对，是我公寓的平面图。两张凳子，一个放杯子的架子。我一直在重画。

choices.english: Thanks for explaining. I'll leave you to it. Bye.
choices.chinese: 谢谢你解释。那不打扰了，再见。

choices.english: How many times have you redrawn it?
choices.chinese: 你重画过多少遍了？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sorcha uncaps their pen and prints STOOLS ON STRIKE across the top of the drawing.
beats.chinese: Sorcha 拔下笔帽，在图纸顶端工工整整地写上“凳子罢工”。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That'll look convincing when my next guest asks why nothing's changed.
beats.chinese: 下一个客人问怎么什么都没变时，这看起来就很有说服力了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They secure the sheet inside the notebook, put it in their bag and resume their walk along the public stone path.
beats.chinese: Sorcha 把纸夹牢，将笔记本收进包里，沿公共石铺通道继续散步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. No more drawings this afternoon. Enjoy the square.
beats.chinese: 好了。今天下午不画了。祝你在庭院逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sorcha gives a small nod and lays the drawing flat against the notebook cover.
beats.chinese: Sorcha 轻轻点头，把图纸平铺在笔记本封面上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I'll keep the negotiations off the path.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我会避开通道进行谈判。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the public path, Sorcha stays to one side and crosses out a measurement, then writes exactly the same number beneath it.
beats.chinese: 你沿公共通道继续走。Sorcha 留在一旁，划掉一个尺寸，又在下面写了个一模一样的数字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Goodbye. Another productive revision.
beats.chinese: 再见。又是一次卓有成效的修改。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sorcha closes the notebook without adding another remark about the drawing.
beats.chinese: Sorcha 合上笔记本，没有再拿图纸打趣。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. Sorry I kept the joke going.
beats.chinese: 当然。抱歉，刚才还在接着开玩笑。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue on your way. Sorcha puts the notebook away and stays beside the path, looking up at the bell tower.
beats.chinese: 你继续走自己的路。Sorcha 收起笔记本，留在通道旁，抬头看向钟楼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye. Enjoy your visit.
beats.chinese: 再见。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sorcha checks the small numbers on the corners of the pages.
beats.chinese: Sorcha 翻看纸页角落的小数字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eleven. A teammate leaves fake measurements under my door now. I've taped the best one to the wall.
beats.chinese: 十一遍。现在有个队友会往我门缝下塞假尺寸。我把最好的一张贴在了墙上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They put the loose drawing inside the notebook and close it firmly. With the notebook held at their side, they turn their attention to the bell tower.
beats.chinese: Sorcha 把散页放进笔记本，利落地合上，将本子垂拿在身侧，转而望向钟楼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nothing's being renovated. I just like drawing the plans. Anyway, I'll let you get on. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 没在装修。我就是喜欢画这些图。好了，不耽误你了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Parliament Square, you see Sorcha standing beside the public stone path, quietly looking up at the bell tower. They turn their head and recognise you.
beats.chinese: 在 Parliament Square 庭院，你看见 Sorcha 站在公共石铺通道旁，安静地抬头看着钟楼。Sorcha 转过头，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I'm not feeling very talkative today. Just out for a walk.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天不太想说话，只是出来走走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sorcha pauses briefly, their expression plain and relaxed. Then they turn along the public stone path and resume walking.
beats.chinese: Sorcha 短暂停顿，神情平常而放松。随后，Sorcha 转向公共石铺通道，继续散步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy your walk. Good to see you again.
beats.chinese: 祝你散步愉快。很高兴又见到你。

causality.presenceReason: Sorcha 原本就在庭院散步，途中停在公共通道旁重画随身带着的走廊图。
causality.placeAttitude: 把庭院当作普通散步地点，没有工作任务，也没有带陌生人参观的意图。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须等候的人或事务，可以继续画图，也可以随时恢复散步。玩家无需停步或接过物品。
causality.currentGoal: 短暂停步修改走廊图，顺口征询两张凳子或一张长凳的图面意见，随后继续散步，并没有实际装修安排。
causality.currentState: 初遇时工作之外精神放松，愿意主动抛出冷面玩笑，但容易把笑话多说一句。重逢时只是社交精力较低，想独自散步，不借沉默制造玩笑或暗示重大变故。
causality.contactTrigger: Sorcha 始终自己拿着图纸，在玩家经过时主动询问走廊图上选两张凳子还是一张长凳，随即一本正经地说凳子要求分别陈述。接触不再依赖散页掉落，也不要求玩家帮忙。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留职业橄榄球队装备管理员的身份、精确习惯、冷面恶作剧、走廊反复制图，以及面对明确询问仍先接笑话的毛病。主动征询走廊意见符合原有习惯，重逢当天不想多说话不改变其长期性格。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家可以用分别画图的保密玩笑接话，进入 a。也可以要求确认是否真是平面图，进入 b。aa 接受玩家反向玩笑，写下标题并收包离开。ab 接受告别，留在一旁继续无实质进展的修改。ba 停止玩笑并道歉，收起本子看钟楼。bb 直接回答重画次数和队友的小恶作剧，结束制图与谈话。
causality.spatialContinuity: 初遇及重逢全部发生在 Parliament Square 可见钟楼、草坪边界与石铺道路的范围内，仅使用公共通道旁的空间及自带纸笔和包，不占道、不进入草坪或新增设施。图纸始终由 Sorcha 持有，收束中的离开仅沿原有公共石铺通道继续散步。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Sorcha Ní Riain。本次重逢位于圣三一学院庭院，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Dublin's Grand Canal path, Cian Doyle stands clear of passing walkers with his phone to his ear. After an afternoon calibrating vintage-camera light meters, he has come out to listen to a recording. As you come within earshot, he speaks.
beats.chinese: 都柏林的大运河步道上，Cian Doyle站在不妨碍行人的位置，把手机贴在耳边。整个下午都在校准老式相机测光表的他，出来听一段录音。你走到能听见他说话的地方时，他开了口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just open the envelope. Oh, sorry. That was for the recording. I'm Cian.
beats.chinese: 快把信封拆开吧。哦，抱歉。我是在对录音说话。我叫Cian。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pauses the audio and lowers his phone. His thumb stays beside the play button.
beats.chinese: 他暂停录音，放下手机。拇指还停在播放键旁边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A friend and I make little radio plays. I came down here to hear his recording away from my workbench. He's taking a full minute over one envelope.
beats.chinese: 我和一个朋友一起做短广播剧。我来这里听他录的这一段，换个地方，离开工作台。他拆一个信封居然要花整整一分钟。

choices.english: What's in the envelope? Now I'm curious.
choices.chinese: 信封里是什么？现在我也好奇了。

choices.english: I'll leave you to hear the rest.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你听下去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cian checks the remaining time on the recording. The canal water moves beyond him, on the same side of the path.
beats.chinese: Cian看了看录音还剩多少时间。他身后的运河水缓缓流动，你们仍在同一侧的步道上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I don't know yet. He wrote this one. Mine usually involve somebody refusing to answer a perfectly reasonable question.
beats.chinese: 我还不知道。这一篇是他写的。我写的那些，通常会有人拒绝回答一个完全合理的问题。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tilts the screen towards himself and checks it again, although the audio is paused.
beats.chinese: 他把屏幕转向自己，又看了一次，尽管录音还暂停着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Twenty seconds left. I can give you the answer once he finally gets the paper out.
beats.chinese: 还剩二十秒。等他终于把那张纸拿出来，我就能告诉你答案了。

choices.english: I'll wait for the ending.
choices.chinese: 我等着听结局。

choices.english: Maybe it says... [Pause and smile.] I'll let you wonder. Goodbye, Cian.
choices.chinese: 也许上面写着……【停顿，微笑】你慢慢猜吧。再见，Cian。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cian lowers the phone fully instead of immediately restarting it. He gives a small, slightly embarrassed smile.
beats.chinese: Cian把手机完全放低，没有立刻继续播放。他笑了一下，略显不好意思。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. I do enjoy a slow reveal when I'm the one writing it.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。如果是我自己写的，我倒很喜欢慢慢揭晓答案。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances at the paused recording, then back at you, one eyebrow raised.
beats.chinese: 他看了一眼暂停的录音，又抬眼看你，扬起一边眉毛。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Apparently everyone else ought to get straight to the point.
beats.chinese: 可轮到别人写，我似乎就觉得他们该直奔主题了。

choices.english: [Nod goodbye and continue along the path.]
choices.chinese: 【点头告别，沿步道继续走。】

choices.english: You sound much less patient as the audience.
choices.chinese: 你当听众的时候，好像就没那么有耐心了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cian listens to the final twenty seconds with the phone against his ear. His expression tightens, then he lets out a short laugh.
beats.chinese: Cian把手机贴回耳边，听完最后二十秒。他先是皱了皱脸，接着短促地笑了一声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A receipt for a second envelope. That's what was in it.
beats.chinese: 买第二个信封的收据。里面装的就是这个。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pockets the phone and turns along the path, keeping to the same bank.
beats.chinese: 他把手机收进口袋，转身沿着同一侧河岸的步道走去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He made me wait for stationery. I'm going to be annoyed about that for several minutes. Good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 他让我等了半天，就为了个文具笑话。这事够我气上好几分钟了。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cian's thumb stops above the play button. He looks directly at you for a moment.
beats.chinese: Cian的拇指停在播放键上方。他直直地看了你一会儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Are you stopping there on purpose? Yes, of course you are.
beats.chinese: 你是故意停在这儿的吗？嗯，当然是。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He presses his lips together, then gives a brief wave and returns the phone to his ear.
beats.chinese: 他抿了抿嘴，随后简短地挥手告别，把手机重新贴回耳边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's two unfinished envelopes now. Goodbye. I'll deal with this one.
beats.chinese: 这下有两个信封都没下文了。再见。我先把这一个听完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the path, Cian raises his free hand in farewell.
beats.chinese: 你沿步道继续走，Cian抬起空着的那只手，向你告别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good afternoon. Thanks for bearing with the interruption.
beats.chinese: 祝你下午愉快。谢谢你没介意我刚才突然出声。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He restarts the recording. A few seconds later, he lowers the volume and moves a little farther from the passing walkers.
beats.chinese: 他重新播放录音。几秒后，他调低音量，又往远离过路行人的方向挪了一点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Get on with it.
beats.chinese: 好了，快往下说吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cian opens his mouth, then looks down at the phone without answering immediately.
beats.chinese: Cian张了张嘴，随后低头看向手机，没有马上回答。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Actually, you're right. I wrote a longer pause on Sunday. I even put 'hold this' in the script.
beats.chinese: 其实，你说得对。我星期天还写了一段更长的停顿，甚至在剧本里标了“这里多停一会儿”。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens a note, adds the date and types a short sentence. Then he locks the phone and gives you a parting nod.
beats.chinese: 他打开一则备忘录，添上日期，输入一句短话。随后他锁上手机，点头向你告别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I keep a record when I change my mind. I'm keeping the pause, though. He's allowed to complain too. Good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 每次改变看法，我都会记下来。不过，那段停顿我还是要留着。他也可以抱怨。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another outing beside Dublin's Grand Canal, Cian stands at the edge of the path on your side of the canal, holding a camera and watching the trees reflected in the water. He looks up and recognises you.
beats.chinese: 在都柏林大运河边，Cian站在与你同侧的步道边，手里拿着相机，看着水中的树影。他抬起头，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I preferred the water when it was still a moment ago. Actually, I've changed my mind. The reflections look better broken up by the ripples.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。刚才我更喜欢水面平静时的样子。其实，我改主意了。波纹把树影打散以后，反而更好看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He watches the reflections a moment longer, then raises the camera and takes one photograph. He lowers it and gives you a parting nod.
beats.chinese: 他又看了片刻倒影，随后举起相机拍了一张。他放下相机，点头向你告别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll keep this one. Good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 这次留这一张。祝你下午愉快。

causality.presenceReason: Cian做了一下午老式相机测光表校准，先于玩家来到运河步道，想离开工作台听朋友录制的广播剧。
causality.placeAttitude: 把运河岸当作工作之外散步、听录音和观察画面的普通去处，不承担向导角色。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须留住玩家的事务，只想听完剩余录音，并始终避开通行位置。
causality.currentGoal: 听清朋友写的广播剧里，信封究竟装着什么。
causality.currentState: 对路人礼貌，注意力却被录音悬念牵住，急于知道答案。
causality.contactTrigger: 玩家进入可听范围时，他对录音催促拆信封，随即主动澄清并自我介绍。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留精密校准职业、广播剧合作、对他人拖延悬念的不耐烦，以及记录改变看法的习惯。礼貌不等于掩饰真实反应。重逢通过他对平静水面与波纹树影的偏好变化，表现坦然承认改判，不把观察写成糊涂失误。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa玩家等到结局，他转述信封笑话后离开。ab玩家故意留悬念并告别，他明显着急但礼貌结束，独自续听。ba玩家离开，他挥别后恢复录音。bb玩家指出双重标准，他承认并记下，却保留自己剧本里的长停顿，随后告别。重逢时，他主动说出自己对树影画面的新判断，观察后拍下一张，平静决定保留并告别。
causality.spatialContinuity: 初遇与重逢均发生在照片支持的同侧运河岸步道及水边视域内，不跨岸，不添加座椅、桥头或设施。重逢只使用随身相机与水中树影，不添加倒影文字，也不要求玩家停留等待。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Cian Doyle。本次重逢位于大运河岸，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。
