beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beside Dublin's Grand Canal path, Deirdre O'Connell holds a cloud identification card and watches a thin patch of cloud through the trees. As the wind stretches it out, she turns towards you.
beats.chinese: 在都柏林大运河步道旁，Deirdre O'Connell手里握着云朵识别卡，望着树间的一片薄云。风把那片云拉长，她忍不住转向附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That cloud looked like one on this card a moment ago. Now it's changed its mind.
beats.chinese: 那片云刚才还像卡上的一种呢。转眼它就改主意了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Keeping to the side of the path, she points towards the cloud, then turns the card towards herself to check it again. She laughs.
beats.chinese: 她站在步道一侧，指了指天上的云，再把卡片转向自己核对了一遍，笑了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I brought it along for my walk. Want a quick look? There are only about three on here I can recognise.
beats.chinese: 我散步时带来看的。想瞧一眼吗？这上头我大概只认得三种。

choices.english: Just a quick look. What caught your eye?
choices.chinese: 就看一眼。你刚才看到什么了？

choices.english: No thanks. Are you out for a break?
choices.chinese: 不用了，谢谢。你是出来歇歇的吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Deirdre angles the card so you can see its small cloud pictures without either of you standing in the middle of the path.
beats.chinese: Deirdre把卡片转向你，让你能看清上面的小幅云图，两个人都不用站到步道中央。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That thin patch through the trees. I've narrowed it down to four pictures, which is nearly half the card. Tremendous progress.
beats.chinese: 树间露出来的那一小片。我已经缩小到四幅图了，差不多是这张卡的一半。进展惊人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She laughs and moves her thumb away from a picture she had been covering.
beats.chinese: 她笑起来，把挡住一幅图的拇指挪开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This is week two. The harmonica got six weeks before it went into the kitchen drawer. Six very loud weeks.
beats.chinese: 这是第二周。口琴撑了六周，才被我收进厨房抽屉。那六周可真够吵的。

choices.english: Would you take a class to get better at this?
choices.chinese: 你会去上课，好认得更准一点吗？

choices.english: Six weeks of harmonica sounds loud. I'll leave you to the clouds.
choices.chinese: 吹六周口琴，听着就挺吵。你慢慢看云吧，我先走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Deirdre lowers the card immediately. She stays at the side of the path rather than holding it out again.
beats.chinese: Deirdre立刻放低卡片。她仍站在步道一侧，没有再递过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Day off. I time races at athletics meets. I've spent enough afternoons watching a finish line to enjoy looking up for a change.
beats.chinese: 今天休息。我给田径比赛计时。盯着终点线过了那么多个下午，换成抬头看看还挺高兴的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She presses a curled corner of the card flat with her thumb.
beats.chinese: 她用拇指把卡片卷起的一角压平。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No stopwatch with me. I can stretch a ten-minute walk into half an hour all by myself.
beats.chinese: 没带秒表。我自己就能把十分钟的路走成半小时。

choices.english: Does timing races suit you?
choices.chinese: 给比赛计时这份工作适合你吗？

choices.english: I'll leave you to your day off. Take care.
choices.chinese: 那就不打扰你休息了。慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the mention of a class, Deirdre draws the card back towards herself.
beats.chinese: 一听到上课，Deirdre把卡片收回自己面前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm not signing up for lessons. I only wanted a look at the sky.
beats.chinese: 我可不打算报名上课。我就是想看看天。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She hears her own sharp tone and loosens her grip. Remaining beside the path, she looks between the card and the clouds.
beats.chinese: 她听出自己的语气有点冲，松开了捏紧的手。她留在步道旁，看看卡片，又看看云。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry, that came out fierce. You only asked. I'll manage with this little card. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 抱歉，刚才说得太冲了。你也就是问问。我用这张小卡片就行。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Deirdre laughs as you take your leave along the same canal path.
beats.chinese: 你沿着同一侧运河步道告辞离开，Deirdre笑了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The kitchen drawer hasn't complained once. Best audience I ever had.
beats.chinese: 厨房抽屉一次也没抱怨过。那是我遇到过的最佳听众。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lowers the card to her side and tips her head back, watching the patch of cloud through the trees.
beats.chinese: 她把卡片垂在身侧，仰头望着树间的那片云。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll give this one another minute before it changes shape on me. Bye now.
beats.chinese: 趁它还没变样，我再看一分钟。回头见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Deirdre nods quickly. Her answer comes without the joking hesitation she had over the cloud pictures.
beats.chinese: Deirdre很快点了点头。回答这个问题时，她没有了刚才看云图时那种带着玩笑的犹疑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It does. Over ten years now. There's a stretch where I have to be exact, and I like that. Once the meet's finished, my evening's my own.
beats.chinese: 适合。干了十多年了。有一段时间必须分毫不差，我喜欢这一点。比赛一结束，晚上就归我自己了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips the card into her pocket and turns along the path, keeping to the same bank.
beats.chinese: 她把卡片塞进口袋，转身沿步道继续走，仍留在运河这一岸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, I'd better actually do some walking. Lovely talking to you. Bye!
beats.chinese: 好啦，我也该真的走上几步了。聊得很开心。再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Deirdre gives you a small wave as you end the conversation.
beats.chinese: 你结束话题时，Deirdre朝你轻轻挥了挥手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Enjoy the rest of your day.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。祝你接下来也过得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the card and puts it away, then stays beneath the trees for a moment, looking across the water.
beats.chinese: 她折起卡片收好，在树下又停了一会儿，望向水面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm having a minute here before I move on. Bye now.
beats.chinese: 我在这儿待一小会儿再走。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Dublin's Grand Canal, you see Deirdre O'Connell beside the path with a light jacket half off one arm. She recognises you and smiles.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到都柏林大运河时，你看见Deirdre O'Connell站在步道旁，一件薄外套刚脱下一只袖子。她认出你，笑了笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again! Warm in the sun, chilly under the trees. This jacket's been on and off twice already.
beats.chinese: 噢，又见面了！太阳底下暖和，树荫底下又凉。这件外套已经穿穿脱脱两回了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pulls her other arm free and folds the jacket over her forearm, leaving the path clear.
beats.chinese: 她把另一只胳膊也抽出来，将外套搭在小臂上，没有占住步道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll carry it for a bit. Good to see you. Enjoy your day.
beats.chinese: 先拿着走一会儿吧。见到你真好。祝你今天愉快。

causality.presenceReason: Deirdre休息日来大运河散步，事先带了云朵识别卡，想顺便辨认几种云。
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢这里能边走边抬头看云，不把散步当训练，也不要求自己完成辨认任务。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须久留的安排，可以继续走或短暂停留。全程留在同侧岸边并让出步道。
causality.currentGoal: 试着把树间的一片薄云与卡上的图片对上，满足当前兴趣即可。
causality.currentState: 今天休息，精神轻快，愿意闲聊。一听到上课建议便短暂变得防御。
causality.contactTrigger: 她始终握着识别卡，看见树间的薄云被风拉长，忍不住向附近的玩家分享云形变化。她先指向天空，再把卡转向自己核对，笑着承认只认得约三种，随后邀请玩家快速看一眼。卡片不脱手，也不请求帮助。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留田径赛事计时工作、尝鲜式兴趣、口琴与观云爱好，以及被建议深入学习时容易语气过重的缺点。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa中她生硬拒绝课程后为语气道歉，留在原处自己辨云。ab中她接着口琴玩笑，玩家离开，她继续看天。ba中她简短说明工作为何适合自己，随后继续散步。bb中她接受告辞，收卡留在树下看水。
causality.spatialContinuity: 所有动作发生在大运河同岸步道及其一侧树荫范围内，不跨岸，不添加设施，不妨碍通行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the Grand Canal path in Dublin, Robin Fahey stands to one side with a folder of leaves for printing tucked securely under their arm. They watch a leaf floating on the canal, then turn towards you.
beats.chinese: 在都柏林大运河的同岸步道边，Robin Fahey把装着拓印用叶片的文件夹稳稳夹在腋下。他们看着水面上漂浮的一片叶子，随后转向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm looking for someone to bet with. Ten euro says that leaf turns over before I count to ten.
beats.chinese: 我想找个人赌一把。十欧元，那片叶子会在我数到十之前翻面。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin points out the floating leaf, keeping the folder firmly under their arm and leaving the path clear.
beats.chinese: Robin指了指漂浮的叶子，文件夹仍牢牢夹在腋下，也没有挡住步道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You in?
beats.chinese: 你赌吗？

choices.english: I'll watch, but no money.
choices.chinese: 我可以看看，不过不赌钱。

choices.english: I'll pass on the bet. What's the paper in your folder for?
choices.chinese: 赌就算了。你文件夹里的纸是做什么用的？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin keeps an eye on the floating leaf, with the folder tucked against their side.
beats.chinese: Robin把文件夹夹在身侧，眼睛盯着漂浮的叶子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Not even a euro? Barely worth keeping an account of.
beats.chinese: 一欧元也不赌？这点钱都不值得记一笔。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin reaches towards a pocket, then withdraws an empty hand. Their lips press together briefly.
beats.chinese: Robin伸手摸向口袋，又空着手收回来，嘴唇短暂地抿了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. No money. I still say it'll turn.
beats.chinese: 好吧，不赌钱。我还是觉得它会翻。

choices.english: Go on, then. Count.
choices.chinese: 那就数吧。

choices.english: I'll carry on instead. Enjoy your walk.
choices.chinese: 我还是继续走吧。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin glances once more at the canal, then turns the folder so its contents cannot slide out.
beats.chinese: Robin又看了一眼运河，随后调整文件夹的方向，免得里面的东西滑出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Leaf prints. I press the leaves between sheets before I ink them.
beats.chinese: 做叶片拓印用的。上墨之前，我先把叶子夹在纸里压平。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin opens the folder a little. A dry leaf lies between two sheets, its uneven edge visible.
beats.chinese: Robin把文件夹打开一点。一片干叶子夹在两张纸之间，露出参差的边缘。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thirty-odd years restoring buses. One small commission each winter now. Leaves take up considerably less room.
beats.chinese: 修复老巴士干了三十多年。现在每年冬天只接一份小委托。叶子占的地方可小多了。

choices.english: May I have a look at that leaf?
choices.chinese: 我可以看看那片叶子吗？

choices.english: I'll let you get back to collecting. Goodbye.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你收集叶子了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin faces the canal from the path, leaving room for people to pass behind them.
beats.chinese: Robin站在步道上面向运河，身后留着供人通行的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One, two, three, four...
beats.chinese: 一、二、三、四……

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin counts on to ten. The leaf lifts at one edge, then settles flat again. Robin closes the folder and turns back towards the fallen leaves.
beats.chinese: Robin继续数到十。叶子的一边翘起，随后又平平地落回水面。Robin合上文件夹，转身看向地上的落叶。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ten. Hasn't turned. Fair enough. You've saved ten euro and I've lost an argument with myself. Back to collecting.
beats.chinese: 十。没翻。行吧。你省了十欧元，我跟自己争了一回，还输了。我继续捡叶子去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin's eyebrows rise as you take your leave. The folder stays firmly tucked under their arm.
beats.chinese: 你告辞时，Robin扬了扬眉毛，文件夹依然牢牢夹在腋下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. No wager.
beats.chinese: 好吧。这赌打不成了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin looks down at the folder for a moment, then shifts farther from the middle of the path. They return their attention to the water.
beats.chinese: Robin低头看了片刻文件夹，随后往步道边挪了挪，再次望向水面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy yours too. Mind how you go.
beats.chinese: 你也散步愉快。慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin holds the open folder where you can see the leaf clearly without stepping closer to the water.
beats.chinese: Robin举起打开的文件夹，让你不用靠近水边就能看清那片叶子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a look. I'll keep hold of it. It's dry enough to crumble.
beats.chinese: 看吧。我拿着就好。它已经干得一碰就可能碎了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin tilts the folder to show the branching veins, then carefully covers the leaf and fastens the folder.
beats.chinese: Robin倾斜文件夹，露出分叉的叶脉，随后小心盖上纸，把文件夹扣好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've plenty at home already. Apparently that hasn't stopped me. Right, this one's coming home too. Good day to you.
beats.chinese: 家里已经有不少了。显然还是拦不住我。好了，这片也带回家。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin closes the folder as you say goodbye. Two fallen leaves lie a little farther along the same path.
beats.chinese: 你道别时，Robin合上文件夹。同一条步道稍远一点的地方落着两片叶子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One more, then I'm off myself.
beats.chinese: 再捡一片，我也该走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin moves towards the leaves, crouches clear of passing feet and picks up one. The other stays on the ground.
beats.chinese: Robin走向那两片叶子，避开行人的脚步蹲下，只捡起其中一片，另一片仍留在地上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. One. A surprisingly difficult number to stick to. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 好了。一片。要守住这个数，居然还挺难。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beside the path on the bank of Dublin's Grand Canal, Robin Fahey finishes reading something on their phone. They look up, recognise you and raise a hand.
beats.chinese: 在都柏林大运河的同岸步道边，Robin Fahey看完手机上的消息。他们抬起头，认出你，便抬手打了个招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. A friend has just admitted today's crossword took them longer than it took me. I've won this round.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。一位朋友刚刚承认，今天的填字游戏，自己做得比我慢。这一回我赢了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Robin slips the phone into a pocket. They press their lips together, but a pleased smile keeps escaping.
beats.chinese: Robin把手机收进口袋。他们抿了抿嘴，却还是忍不住露出得意的笑容。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll probably remind them a few more times tonight. Only tonight, mind. Tomorrow they'll get another chance. Good seeing you. Bye.
beats.chinese: 今晚我大概还会多提醒那位朋友几遍。说好了，只得意今晚。明天再给对方一次机会。见到你真好。再见。

causality.presenceReason: Robin在玩家出现之前已沿大运河收集落叶，准备带回家压平后做叶片拓印。
causality.placeAttitude: 这里是其熟悉的都柏林日常步行与采叶地点，兴趣具体，不承担接待或指导陌生人的角色。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须留下的外部义务，采叶尚未结束，水面上的叶子又吸引其暂时停留，玩家随时可以离开。
causality.currentGoal: 收集少量适合拓印的落叶并妥善夹好，同时想为水面叶子能否在数到十之前翻面找一个下注对象。
causality.currentState: 文件夹已夹稳，注意力在叶片上，有闲心主动搭话。被拒绝赌钱时短暂不快，但最终接受界限。
causality.contactTrigger: Robin站在同岸步道边，看见水面漂浮的叶子，直接向附近的玩家提出十欧元赌约，并询问是否参与，不预设玩家接受。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留退休老巴士修复师及每冬一份小委托的职业状态，以随口押注、讨价还价和输后认账表现其好赌与轻微难缠，叶片拓印仍是其既有兴趣。重逢以朋友承认填字速度较慢的消息，表现其借小较量维系交情、赢后会得意一晚的既有特点，不向玩家追讨赌债或发起新赌约。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa无金钱地数数，预测落空后认输并继续采叶。ab玩家离开，Robin短暂闷闷不乐后独自看水。ba展示夹好的干叶但自己持有，收好后道别。bb接受告辞，沿同侧步道只捡一片叶子后准备离开。重逢时Robin看完朋友的消息后认出玩家，主动分享这次赢了的小事，收起手机仍掩不住得意，承认今晚可能反复提起，并笑着限定只得意今晚，随后道别。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the shaded path beside Dublin's Grand Canal, Aoife Brennan has stopped in her roller skates at the side of the path. Holding an open folder, she looks towards you nearby.
beats.chinese: 都柏林大运河岸边的树荫步道上，Aoife Brennan穿着轮滑鞋，已经停在步道侧边。她拿着摊开的文件夹，看向附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll stay over here. I won't skate forward. I'm Aoife Brennan.
beats.chinese: 我会先停在这边，不往前滑。我叫Aoife Brennan。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes the folder but keeps it in her hands. Before the covers meet, you glimpse several versions of the same handwritten letter.
beats.chinese: 她合拢文件夹，却仍握在手里。封面合上前，你瞥见了同一个手写字母的几种写法。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A morning off from looking after studio backdrops. I came for a skate, but I keep finding one more thing to change in this letter.
beats.chinese: 今天上午不用去照相馆管背景布。本来是来滑轮滑的，可这个字母总还有一处让我想再改改。

choices.english: Are you making an alphabet?
choices.chinese: 你在做一套字母吗？

choices.english: Do you skate here often?
choices.chinese: 你常来这里滑轮滑吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aoife presses the edges of the closed folder together with both hands before answering.
beats.chinese: Aoife双手把已合上的文件夹边缘压紧，才开口回答。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My own alphabet. Three months so far. The practice pages stay inside.
beats.chinese: 自己做的一套字母。到现在做了三个月。练习页就留在里面。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the closed cover, then loosens her grip. A small cream card sits in its outer pocket.
beats.chinese: 她确认封面已经合好，才松开手。外侧口袋里放着一张奶油色的小卡片。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's a finished dinner place card here. I use it as a bookmark. You're welcome to see that.
beats.chinese: 这里有张已经写好的晚餐座位卡，我拿它当书签。那张可以给你看。

choices.english: I'd like to see the finished card.
choices.chinese: 我想看看那张写好的卡片。

choices.english: No need to take it out. I'll carry on. Enjoy your morning.
choices.chinese: 不用拿出来了。我继续走了，祝你早上愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aoife lowers the folder and looks along the path on this bank. She keeps her skates still while a passer-by goes past.
beats.chinese: Aoife放低文件夹，望了望同侧岸边的步道。一名路人经过时，她稳稳站着，没有滑动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sunday mornings, before it gets busy. Three years, and one foot still wants the other one nearby.
beats.chinese: 星期天早上来，趁人还不多。滑了三年，单脚滑的时候，另一只脚还是总想赶紧落地。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slides the folder halfway into her bag, then pauses and slips her thumb between its pages.
beats.chinese: 她把文件夹往包里塞了一半，却又停下来，把拇指插进纸页之间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I keep saying I'll put this away after one more correction. I've said it four times this morning.
beats.chinese: 我一直说，再改一处就收起来。今天早上已经说了四遍。

choices.english: I'll give you room to set off. Enjoy your skate.
choices.chinese: 我让开些，你慢慢滑。祝你滑得愉快。

choices.english: I'll leave you with your letter, then. Goodbye, Aoife.
choices.chinese: 那就不打扰你琢磨字母了。再见，Aoife。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aoife takes out the cream card without reopening the folder. She holds it by its corners so the lettering is visible.
beats.chinese: Aoife没有重新打开文件夹，只抽出那张奶油色卡片，捏着两角，把字露出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Maeve. She sat beside the radiator. I had three friends round just to use these.
beats.chinese: Maeve。她当时坐在暖气片旁边。我特意请了三个朋友来吃饭，就是为了用上这些卡片。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds it steady for a moment, looking pleased, then returns it to its pocket and packs the folder away.
beats.chinese: 她稳稳举了一会儿，神情很满意，然后把卡片插回口袋，收好文件夹。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They all took theirs home. I made an extra copy of Maeve's to keep. Anyway, I'll let you get on. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 她们都把自己的带回家了。我另做了一张Maeve的，留着作样。好了，不耽误你了，再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aoife leaves the card in its pocket and shifts her bag closer to her side.
beats.chinese: Aoife没有拿出卡片，只把肩包往身侧拢了拢。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. Have a good walk.
beats.chinese: 好。祝你散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the path, she opens the folder towards herself again. Her finger stops at the same letter, and her skates remain planted.
beats.chinese: 你沿步道继续走，她又把文件夹朝自己打开。手指停在刚才那个字母上，脚下的轮滑鞋依然没动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Goodbye. I'm staying here a little longer.
beats.chinese: 再见。我还要在这儿待一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: With the space you have left clear, Aoife pushes the folder fully into her bag and fastens the flap.
beats.chinese: 你让出了空间，Aoife便把文件夹完全塞进包里，扣好包盖。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Both feet down for the first bit.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。开头这一段，还是两只脚都落地吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She waits for a clear stretch, then rolls away slowly along the same bank, keeping both skates close to the ground.
beats.chinese: 她等前方一段路空下来，才沿同侧岸边慢慢滑走，两只轮滑鞋都没有抬高。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, I'm off. Enjoy the canal.
beats.chinese: 好，我走了。慢慢逛运河吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Aoife draws the folder out again, holding it close enough that its pages face only her.
beats.chinese: Aoife又抽出文件夹，拿得离自己很近，纸页只朝着她。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Goodbye. Yes, the letter's getting another five minutes.
beats.chinese: 再见。对，这个字母还得再占五分钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue on. She stays at the side of the path, turns back one page, then another, without taking out a pen.
beats.chinese: 你继续往前走。她留在步道边，往前翻了一页，又翻了一页，却没有拿出笔。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Possibly ten.
beats.chinese: 也可能十分钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beside Dublin's Grand Canal, Aoife Brennan recognises you while fastening her skate bag. She is standing at the edge of the path.
beats.chinese: 在都柏林大运河边，Aoife Brennan站在步道一侧扣好轮滑包时认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. A friend and I are skating farther next Sunday. She's agreed to my pace. I asked twice.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。下周日和朋友多滑一段。她答应按我的速度来。我问了两遍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tightens the skate bag strap and smiles towards the open stretch of path, then turns back to you.
beats.chinese: 她拉紧轮滑包带，朝开阔的步道笑了笑，又转回来看你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Before it gets busy. Then breakfast, which I've had rather less trouble planning. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 趁人还不多。然后吃早饭，这个倒没费多少心思就定了。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At George's Street Arcade, Ruairi Mac Cormaic is waiting while a friend browses the shops. He has brought his Saturday paper. Standing beside the central aisle beneath the glass roof, he folds a section he has finished reading separately from the rest and looks towards you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在乔治街拱廊市场，Ruairi Mac Cormaic正等着逛店的朋友。他带来了周六的报纸。他站在玻璃顶下的中央过道旁，把已经读完的一份副刊单独折好，看向附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've finished this section.
beats.chinese: 这份副刊我看完了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps the folded section beside the rest of his paper, clear of passing shoppers, without reaching it towards you.
beats.chinese: 他把折好的副刊和其余报纸一起拿在身前，没有伸向你，也没有占到顾客来往的动线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can have it if you fancy a read. No bother if you don't.
beats.chinese: 你想看的话可以拿去。不想看也没关系。

choices.english: Thanks, I'll take it. What are you reading?
choices.chinese: 谢谢，那我拿着了。你正在看什么？

choices.english: No thanks. I'll just look at the shops.
choices.chinese: 不用了，谢谢。我就看看这边的店。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ruairi passes you the folded section, then turns the rest of the paper towards himself and finds the paragraph he was reading.
beats.chinese: Ruairi把折好的副刊递给你，然后把其余报纸转向自己，找到了刚才读的那一段。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A fellow's written a whole piece about repairing his kettle. I've one in bits at home myself.
beats.chinese: 有个人写了一整篇，说自己修水壶的事。我家里也有一个拆散了的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His eyes move down the next paragraph. Several seconds pass before he looks up halfway.
beats.chinese: 他的目光又顺着下一段读了下去。过了几秒，他才略微抬起头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Give me a second. I want to see whether he got it working.
beats.chinese: 等我一下。我想看看他到底修好了没有。

choices.english: I'll leave you to the kettle story, then. Bye.
choices.chinese: 那你接着看修水壶的故事吧。再见。

choices.english: I meant to have a quick chat, actually.
choices.chinese: 其实我是想随便聊两句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ruairi keeps the paper narrow as you turn your attention towards the shops.
beats.chinese: 你把注意力转向两侧的店铺，Ruairi仍把报纸折得窄窄的。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Grand. Enjoy your look round.
beats.chinese: 好。慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances along both sides of the aisle, then checks the folded page again.
beats.chinese: 他朝过道两边望了望，又低头看了一眼折好的报纸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I said I'd look round with my friend. Haven't got very far, have I.
beats.chinese: 我还说要陪朋友逛逛呢。结果我自己根本没挪几步。

choices.english: Enjoy your paper. Bye.
choices.chinese: 慢慢看报吧。再见。

choices.english: Would you rather be looking round with them?
choices.chinese: 你是不是更想跟朋友一起逛？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you say goodbye and continue along the aisle, Ruairi lifts his eyes fully from the page.
beats.chinese: 你道别后沿着过道继续走，Ruairi这才把目光完全从报纸上移开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Sorry, I got buried in that.
beats.chinese: 好。抱歉，刚才看进去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds the paper shut and holds it under his arm, well clear of passing shoppers.
beats.chinese: 他把报纸合起来夹在腋下，仍与来往顾客留着距离。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mind yourself. Enjoy the rest of your day.
beats.chinese: 慢走。祝你今天过得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ruairi lowers the paper at once and looks directly at you.
beats.chinese: Ruairi立刻放下报纸，正眼看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah, right. Sorry. I've a radio in pieces too. I keep starting another thing before I've finished the first.
beats.chinese: 啊，明白了。抱歉。我还有一台收音机拆着没装好呢。总是手头这件还没弄完，又开始弄下一件。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes the paper. His friend comes into view between passing shoppers and raises a hand. Ruairi returns the wave without opening the paper again.
beats.chinese: 他合上报纸。朋友从来往顾客间露出身影，朝他抬了抬手。Ruairi挥手回应，没有再打开报纸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's my friend. Glad you said something. Take care now.
beats.chinese: 我朋友来了。幸好你直接说了。那就再见了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You say goodbye and turn towards the shops. Ruairi gives a small nod.
beats.chinese: 你道别后转向店铺。Ruairi轻轻点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Enjoy your look round.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the folded page over against his chest, keeping his elbows tucked in as other customers pass.
beats.chinese: 他把折起的报纸贴近胸前翻了一面，收着手肘，让其他顾客从旁边经过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now, where was I.
beats.chinese: 好了，刚才看到哪儿了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Ruairi looks away from the print and along the central aisle.
beats.chinese: Ruairi把目光从印字上移开，朝中央过道望去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I would, for a bit. I just opened this without thinking.
beats.chinese: 是想一起逛一会儿。我刚才顺手就把报纸打开了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He spots his friend farther along the same aisle, folds the paper under his arm and walks towards them through a gap in the passing shoppers.
beats.chinese: 他看见朋友就在同一条过道的前方，便把报纸折好夹在腋下，趁来往顾客间有空隙时走了过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll catch up with them. Enjoy your wander.
beats.chinese: 我去跟上。你慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At George's Street Arcade, Ruairi Mac Cormaic recognises you beside the central aisle, a folded newspaper under his arm.
beats.chinese: 在乔治街拱廊市场，Ruairi Mac Cormaic腋下夹着折好的报纸，在中央过道一侧认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Got my kettle working this morning. The radio's still in bits. One success is enough before lunch.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今早把水壶修好了。收音机还散着。午饭前能成一件就够了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks towards the shops for the friend he is meeting, keeping his newspaper closed.
beats.chinese: 他看看店铺方向，留意约好的朋友，报纸没有打开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Meeting a friend for lunch. He'll ask about the radio first. He always does. Enjoy your look round.
beats.chinese: 约了朋友吃饭。他准先问收音机。每次都是。你慢慢逛。

causality.presenceReason: Ruairi已经和朋友约好在市场一起逛，朋友先看店，他带着周六报纸在中央过道旁等候。
causality.placeAttitude: 愿意陪朋友逛市场，也很容易顺手投入阅读，并非讨厌这里或急着离开。
causality.stayingConstraint: 朋友仍在同一拱廊内逛店，他暂时留在过道旁等候，没有工作任务或强制停留要求。
causality.currentGoal: 等候朋友时继续看报，并把自己已经读完的副刊提供给附近愿意阅读的人。
causality.currentState: 今天放松、注意力偏向报纸，愿意做一次实际而不强求回应的分享。他提出副刊可以拿走，不接着推介内容，也不立即低头阅读，而是留给玩家回应的机会。
causality.contactTrigger: 他把已经读完的一份副刊单独折好，主动向附近的玩家表示想看可以拿去，不拿也没关系。副刊没有伸向玩家或通行动线，只有玩家明确接受后才递出。接触来自具体的分享，不再是向陌生人说明自己的阅读安排。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留慢节奏的都柏林口吻、实际的礼貌、修家电兴趣，以及默认别人也接受停顿的习惯。玩家接受副刊并问起他正在读什么后，他仍容易顺势读下去，被直接提醒想聊天时不辩解。拒绝副刊也会得到自然、礼貌的回应。
causality.reactionAndChange: a中玩家接受副刊并问起他正在读什么，他递出副刊，谈到修水壶的文章，随后又读入神。aa中玩家告辞，他意识到自己看得入神，合报并礼貌道别。ab中玩家说明想聊天，他立即放下报纸回应，随后与到来的朋友会合。b中玩家不接副刊，转而看店，他礼貌回应。ba中双方礼貌结束，玩家看店，他继续读报。bb中他承认自己顺手看报，主动走向同一过道内的朋友。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程只使用玻璃采光、中央过道及两侧店铺。Ruairi在过道旁阅读，报纸与单独折好的副刊都不占用通行动线，也不直接塞给玩家。a中玩家接受后才发生递交。报纸、眼镜和擦镜布均为随身物品，未增加座椅、柜台或其他设施。bb中只沿同一过道走向朋友。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Ruairi Mac Cormaic。本次重逢位于乔治街拱廊市场，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Under the glass roof of George's Street Arcade, Peadar Ó Loinsigh stops beside the shops. He came in to look around before heading home. A film score is stuck in his head, and he turns towards you nearby.
beats.chinese: 乔治街拱廊市场的玻璃顶下，Peadar Ó Loinsigh在店铺一侧停稳。他回家前进来随便逛逛。一段电影配乐在他脑中盘旋，他转向站在附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got a film score stuck in my head. Better on its own, do you think?
beats.chinese: 我脑子里一直转着一段电影配乐。拆出来单听，是不是反而更好？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He moves a little closer to the shops, leaving the central aisle clear, and gives a small grin.
beats.chinese: 他朝两侧店铺挪近一点，让出中央过道，微微咧嘴一笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd say so. Saves the pictures getting in the way.
beats.chinese: 我看是。省得画面碍事。

choices.english: A score needs its film. Otherwise it's just music.
choices.chinese: 配乐得有电影才行，不然就只是音乐了。

choices.english: What film is it from?
choices.chinese: 这是哪部电影里的？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Peadar turns towards you, looking considerably more alert. He stays beside the shops rather than stepping back into the aisle.
beats.chinese: Peadar转向你，神情明显精神了些。他仍站在店铺这一侧，没有退回过道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah, I'd say the opposite. It's from The Third Man. That tune manages perfectly well with your eyes shut.
beats.chinese: 啊，我倒想反过来说。这是《第三人》里的曲子。闭着眼睛听，它也完全撑得住。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He taps the rhythm against his cardigan, then interrupts his own tapping with a raised finger.
beats.chinese: 他隔着开衫打着拍子，随后竖起一根手指，把自己的节奏打断了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mind you, the picture does half the work. What would you miss most without it?
beats.chinese: 不过话说回来，画面确实出了半份力。没有画面，你觉得最缺的是什么？

choices.english: You've just argued both sides. You can hardly disagree with me now.
choices.chinese: 两边的道理都让你说了。你这下总不能再反对我了吧。

choices.english: I'll stop there. Enjoy the rest of your walk.
choices.chinese: 我就说到这儿吧。祝你接下来逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Peadar briefly purses his lips as though checking the tune before naming it.
beats.chinese: Peadar短暂地抿起嘴，像是在说出片名前先确认一下旋律。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The Third Man. That's a zither on the recording. Rather better than I'd sound humming through my moustache.
beats.chinese: 《第三人》。录音里弹的是齐特琴，总比我隔着胡子哼出来强多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He smooths his moustache with one finger, looking pleased with his comparison.
beats.chinese: 他用一根手指捋了捋胡子，对自己这个比较颇为满意。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I watch old films with the sound low, listening for the score. Then I complain I can't hear it. Very efficient.
beats.chinese: 我看老电影时把声音调低，专门听配乐。然后又嫌听不清。效率高得很。

choices.english: Let's hear a little more of the tune, then.
choices.chinese: 那就再哼一小段吧。

choices.english: Did you work in music?
choices.chinese: 你以前从事音乐工作吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Peadar opens his mouth to object, then laughs before a word comes out.
beats.chinese: Peadar张嘴就想反驳，却还没说出一个字就笑了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah, you've caught me. Changed sides without even moving my feet.
beats.chinese: 啊，让你逮着了。脚都没挪，就换了阵营。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers his hand and gives you a small nod of concession.
beats.chinese: 他放下手，朝你轻轻点头认了输。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll give you that one. I was about to demand evidence for something I'd just agreed with. Good day to you.
beats.chinese: 这回算你说得对。我刚才都准备让你拿证据了，明明自己才赞同过。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Peadar's raised finger drops. He makes no attempt to restart the argument.
beats.chinese: Peadar竖着的手指放了下来，没有试着把争论重新挑起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I've taken two positions already. That's plenty for one passing conversation.
beats.chinese: 行啊。我已经站过两个立场了。萍水相逢聊几句，也够了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns towards a shopfront, keeping himself clear of passing customers.
beats.chinese: 他转身看向一家店面，站在不妨碍顾客经过的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy your look round.
beats.chinese: 你慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Peadar straightens his cardigan as though preparing for a very small concert.
beats.chinese: Peadar拉了拉开衫，像是要准备一场规模极小的音乐会。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A short performance. The moustache has a limited range.
beats.chinese: 只演一小段。这副胡子的音域有限。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He hums a few quiet bars, loses a note, and stops with a tiny bow.
beats.chinese: 他轻声哼了几个小节，跑了一个音，便停下来，略略欠身。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's quite enough damage to a good tune. I'll leave you to your day.
beats.chinese: 好曲子糟蹋到这儿也够了。不耽误你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Peadar shakes his head immediately, with no sign of taking offence.
beats.chinese: Peadar立刻摇了摇头，丝毫没有介意的样子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Skate bearings. Forty-odd years servicing them. First a rink in Phibsborough, then speed skaters posting me their wheels.
beats.chinese: 轮滑轴承。修了四十多年。先在菲布斯伯勒的一家轮滑场，后来速滑选手把轮子寄给我修。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He waits for a passing customer to clear the space, then turns along the central aisle.
beats.chinese: 他等一位顾客经过、让出空当，才转身沿着中央过道往前走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Retired now. The films get more of my attention. Anyway, I'll let you get on. Good day.
beats.chinese: 现在退休了，花在电影上的心思更多了。好了，不耽误你。祝你愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At George's Street Arcade, Peadar Ó Loinsigh stands beside the shops, watching customers pass along the central aisle. He recognises you and nods.
beats.chinese: 在乔治街拱廊市场，Peadar Ó Loinsigh正站在店铺一侧，看着顾客沿中央过道来来往往。他认出了你，点头致意。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I'm just having a look round today. I'm not planning to buy anything.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我今天只是随便逛逛，没打算买东西。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He says it quite seriously, then looks at the shops on either side. A small, pleased grin appears as he continues browsing from the edge of the aisle.
beats.chinese: 他说得很认真，随后望向两侧的小店。他嘴角露出一点自得的笑意，沿着过道边继续浏览。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mind you, not planning to buy anything and not allowing myself to buy anything are two different things.
beats.chinese: 不过，没打算买东西，和不许自己买东西，还是两回事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Under the glass roof of George's Street Arcade, Fionnuala Masterson is browsing the small shops after skating. Their skates are in a bulky cloth bag. As you come level, they notice the bag sticking into the central passage.
beats.chinese: 在乔治街拱廊市场的玻璃顶棚下，Fionnuala Masterson滑完轮滑，正逛两侧的小店。轮滑鞋装在一个鼓鼓的布袋里。你来到旁边时，Fionnuala发现袋子伸进了中央过道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry. The bag's taking up more room than I am.
beats.chinese: 抱歉。袋子占的地方比我还大。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They draw the bag against their leg and tuck a long fabric loop under its handle, leaving room to pass.
beats.chinese: Fionnuala把袋子收拢到腿边，将一条长布环塞进提手下，给过道让出空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Fionnuala. These used to be my curtains. I remembered to shorten everything except that loop.
beats.chinese: 我叫Fionnuala。这袋子以前是我家的窗帘。该裁短的都记住了，偏偏漏了这条布环。

choices.english: You made a skate bag out of curtains?
choices.chinese: 你把窗帘改成了轮滑鞋袋？

choices.english: Could you keep it tucked in while I pass?
choices.chinese: 我过去的时候，能请你把它收好吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Fionnuala turns the bag slightly, keeping it close to their legs. A faded stripe runs across one side.
beats.chinese: Fionnuala稍稍转动袋子，仍把它贴在腿边。一侧横着一道褪色的条纹。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. I moved to a smaller flat. Too much curtain, nowhere for the skates. That seemed easy enough.
beats.chinese: 对。我搬进了小一点的公寓。窗帘多了，轮滑鞋又没地方放。当时觉得这事挺容易。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They follow the handle stitching with a finger, then turn it over to reveal another row of stitches.
beats.chinese: Fionnuala用手指沿着提手上的缝线划过，又把提手翻过来，露出另一排线迹。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I alter railway uniforms for work. You'd think I'd have counted the layers before starting. My machine had a difficult evening.
beats.chinese: 我的工作是修改铁路制服。按说动手前总该数数有几层布。那天晚上，我的缝纫机可不好过。

choices.english: At least making it yourself must have saved money.
choices.chinese: 不过自己做，至少应该省了钱吧。

choices.english: I'd rather keep old curtains as curtains.
choices.chinese: 我的话，还是想让旧窗帘继续当窗帘。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Fionnuala immediately gathers both handles into one hand. The loose loop begins to slide out again.
beats.chinese: Fionnuala立刻用一只手拢住两个提手。那条松松的布环又开始往外滑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. You've got room.
beats.chinese: 当然。现在能过去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They catch the loop with their thumb and hold the whole bag close, without reaching across your path.
beats.chinese: Fionnuala用拇指勾住布环，把整个袋子收紧，没有伸手挡住你的路线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll hold it like this. Sorting it properly can wait.
beats.chinese: 我这样拿着就行。等会儿再好好弄。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll carry on.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，那我先走了。

choices.english: I'll wait while you secure it, then go past.
choices.chinese: 我等你把它固定好再过去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Fionnuala lets out a short laugh and folds the loose loop flat against the handle.
beats.chinese: Fionnuala短促地笑了一声，把松布环折平，贴住提手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No, this one cost more. Stronger needles, extra webbing, then another evening because I'd guessed the size.
beats.chinese: 没有，这个反而更贵。买了更结实的针、额外的织带，尺寸又是估的，结果还多花了一个晚上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They grip the folded loop securely and turn their attention back to the nearest shop, keeping the bag out of the passage.
beats.chinese: Fionnuala攥牢折好的布环，将注意力转回最近的小店，袋子始终收在过道之外。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I wanted this particular bag. That's the expensive part. Anyway, I'll let you get on.
beats.chinese: 我就是想要这样的袋子。这才是费钱的地方。好了，不耽误你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Fionnuala lifts one finger, already forming a suggestion.
beats.chinese: Fionnuala竖起一根手指，一个建议已经到了嘴边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cushion covers would use less of the—ah, you've just said curtains.
beats.chinese: 做靠垫套的话，用的布会少一……啊，你刚说了，想留着当窗帘。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They lower their hand and settle the bag against their leg, ending the little demonstration.
beats.chinese: Fionnuala放下手，把袋子靠回腿边，结束了这番小小的展示。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yours can stay hanging. I only cut up my own. Enjoy your browse.
beats.chinese: 你的就继续挂着。我只剪自己的。慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You pass through the space Fionnuala has cleared. They keep the bag firmly against their leg.
beats.chinese: 你从Fionnuala让出的空当走过。Fionnuala把袋子牢牢收在腿边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There you go.
beats.chinese: 可以了，请过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Once you are past, they turn towards the shops, holding the troublesome loop inside their fist.
beats.chinese: 等你走过后，Fionnuala转向两侧的小店，把那条碍事的布环攥在手心里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy the arcade.
beats.chinese: 逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You wait while Fionnuala stays to the side of the central passage. They look from the long loop to the two handles.
beats.chinese: 你等在一旁，Fionnuala仍靠着中央过道的一侧，看看长布环，又看看两个提手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One tuck should do it.
beats.chinese: 塞一下应该就行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The loop slips free. Fionnuala presses their lips together, threads it through both handles and pulls it snug. You pass once it is secure.
beats.chinese: 布环又滑了出来。Fionnuala抿了抿嘴，把它穿过两个提手，再拉紧。固定好后，你从旁边走过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Two tucks, apparently. Thanks for waiting. Off you go.
beats.chinese: 看来得塞两下。谢谢你等着。好了，请过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At George's Street Arcade, you see Fionnuala beside the small shops under the glass roof. They recognise you. A small paper parcel rests in their hand.
beats.chinese: 在乔治街拱廊市场，你看见Fionnuala站在玻璃顶棚下的小店旁。Fionnuala认出了你，手里托着一个小纸包。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I'm meeting a friend here. I've brought the chillies.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我在这里等一个朋友，给对方带了些辣椒。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They fold down a corner of the parcel to cover a chilli poking out, then shift aside for a passing customer.
beats.chinese: Fionnuala折下纸包的一角，盖住一根探出来的辣椒，又侧身让一位顾客走过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They'll cook me something in exchange. Something I can eat without needing a little lie-down.
beats.chinese: 朋友会做点吃的作为交换。得是我吃完不用躺下缓一缓的那种。

causality.presenceReason: Fionnuala滑完轮滑后已来到市场逛店，自己的布袋里装着轮滑鞋。
causality.placeAttitude: 把市场当作随意浏览小店的地方，没有购物任务，也不要求玩家陪逛。
causality.stayingConstraint: 仍想继续看店，暂时停在过道一侧。装着轮滑鞋的袋子必须随身拿稳，不能占住通行空间。
causality.currentGoal: 收好伸进过道的袋子和松布环，再继续浏览。
causality.currentState: 心情轻快，愿意聊自己的改造作品，但对这次改造所需的时间和费用估计不足。
causality.contactTrigger: 玩家来到旁边时，Fionnuala发现自己的袋子侵占了通行空间，主动道歉并收拢袋子。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留铁路制服修改裁缝身份、旧窗帘改轮滑鞋袋的经历、具体利落的表达及干幽默。先提改造建议的习惯通过脱口而出的靠垫套建议显现，尊重物主决定的底线随即保留。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa纠正省钱推断，承认额外成本后转回看店。ab抢先建议后收住，接受玩家保留窗帘的想法并结束展示。ba持续拿稳袋子，让玩家直接离开。bb接受玩家自愿等待，首次固定失败后重新穿紧布环，玩家再通过。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全部发生在玻璃顶棚下、两侧小店之间的中央过道。人物靠边拿稳自带物品，不新增设施，不堵路，不转移到别处。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Under the glass roof of George's Street Arcade, Saoirse Byrne waits beside the central aisle. Her bag holds six poetry magazines for an arranged handover with Niall and rests beside her shoes. She has her own reading copy in one hand and her phone in the other.
beats.chinese: 乔治街拱廊市场的玻璃顶下，Saoirse Byrne等在中央过道一侧。袋子放在自己脚边，装着约好交给Niall的六本诗刊。她一手拿着自己的阅读本，一手拿手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: His sister says a neighbour will collect these. I've asked Niall to confirm. It's his order.
beats.chinese: 他姐姐说会让邻居来拿。我请Niall自己确认一下。这是他的订单。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks up from the message, keeping the delivery bag clear of passing shoppers.
beats.chinese: 她看完消息抬起头，交付袋收在身边，没有挡着过路顾客。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Saoirse. Brought something to read. Waiting for a yes before I give the parcel to someone else.
beats.chinese: 我叫Saoirse。带了本刊物来读。他说一声可以，我才能把包裹交给别人。

choices.english: What magazines are they?
choices.chinese: 都是些什么杂志？

choices.english: Could his sister confirm it for him?
choices.chinese: 他姐姐不能替他确认吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Saoirse pockets her phone, then lifts the delivery bag by its handles. Its contents face her rather than passing shoppers.
beats.chinese: Saoirse收起手机，提起交付袋，袋口朝向自己，没有向过路顾客敞开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Six copies of a little poetry magazine. I select small magazines and carry them round Dublin. This creased one's my own.
beats.chinese: 六本小型诗歌杂志。我做独立小刊物的选刊和跑送，送遍都柏林。这本起了折痕的是我自己的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns a few pages in the worn copy she is holding and finds a folded corner.
beats.chinese: 她把手里那本翻旧的杂志翻了几页，找到折角的那页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd marked a poem for the wait. Might get through it before Niall replies.
beats.chinese: 特意给等候留了一首诗。也许Niall回消息之前能读完。

choices.english: Could I read one page, then give it back?
choices.chinese: 我可以读一页，然后还给你吗？

choices.english: I'll let you get to your reading. Take care.
choices.chinese: 那我不耽误你读了。保重。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Saoirse holds her phone above the delivery bag, rereading the message.
beats.chinese: Saoirse把手机拿在交付袋上方，又看了一遍消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She can tell me what she expects. Niall needs to tell me who gets his copies.
beats.chinese: 她能告诉我她觉得怎么安排。可这几本交给谁，得Niall自己说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks that her question to Niall has gone through, then puts the phone away. The delivery bag stays beside her feet.
beats.chinese: 她确认发给Niall的问题已经送达，收起手机，交付袋仍在脚边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm here as arranged. No reason to make another arrangement around him.
beats.chinese: 我按原约定到了。没必要绕过他另做约定。

choices.english: She could pass your question on to him.
choices.chinese: 可以请她替你把问题转告他。

choices.english: I'll leave you to your handover. Take care.
choices.chinese: 那不耽误你交接了。保重。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Saoirse keeps the delivery bag close and offers you her worn copy.
beats.chinese: Saoirse把送货袋收在身边，将自己那本翻旧的杂志递给你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here you are. That page is a whole poem. They've left it plenty of room.
beats.chinese: 给你。那一页就一首诗，给它留了挺多空白。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You read the page and return the magazine. She opens it at her folded corner again, keeping clear of the shoppers.
beats.chinese: 你读完一页，把杂志还给她。她重新翻到折角处，站在不妨碍顾客通行的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Lovely, thank you. I'll get a page in myself now. Enjoy your wander.
beats.chinese: 好，谢谢。现在我自己也读上一页。慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Saoirse lowers the bag to the floor beside her shoes, outside the flow of shoppers.
beats.chinese: Saoirse把袋子放到鞋边的地上，避开来往的人流。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I've carried this copy about for three days without finishing it.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。这本我随身带了三天，还没读完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She smooths the folded corner with her thumb and settles her attention on the page, leaving the way past her clear.
beats.chinese: 她用拇指抚平折角，把注意力放回书页上，身旁留着通行的空隙。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, the poem about the kitchen. Take care now.
beats.chinese: 好了，读这首写厨房的。保重啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Saoirse shakes her head once and opens her reading copy.
beats.chinese: Saoirse摇了一下头，打开自己的阅读本。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've sent it to him. A message through her, through the neighbour, then back to me—that'll take longer than my walk.
beats.chinese: 我已经发给他了。经她、再经邻居、最后传回我这里，怕是比我走来还久。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: No reply has arrived. She finds the marked poem and stays beside her bag.
beats.chinese: 还没有回复。她翻到标好的诗，仍留在袋子旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm slow enough on my own. I'll read this while I wait. Enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 我自己已经够慢了。等的时候先读这首。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you say goodbye, Niall's reply arrives. Saoirse reads it, then looks along the aisle.
beats.chinese: 你告别时，Niall的回复到了。Saoirse读完，朝过道望去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He's coming himself after all. Two minutes. Good, that settles it.
beats.chinese: 他还是自己来。两分钟。好，这就定下了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes her reading copy, lifts the delivery bag and checks the name on its paper wrapping.
beats.chinese: 她合上阅读本，提起交付袋，核对纸包装上的名字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll have these ready. Take care.
beats.chinese: 我先把这些备好。保重。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At George's Street Arcade, you see Saoirse Byrne beside the central aisle, reading an old journal she has brought with her. She notices you and looks up.
beats.chinese: 在乔治街拱廊市场，你看见Saoirse Byrne站在中央过道边，翻看自己带来的一本旧期刊。她注意到你，抬起头来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. No deliveries to wait for today. I want to finish this article before I have a look round.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天没有交付要等。我想先读完这篇文章，再逛一逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps a finger beside the paragraph she is reading and meets your eyes for a moment, standing clear of the passing shoppers.
beats.chinese: 她把一根手指留在正读的段落旁，短暂地与你对视，站的位置没有妨碍来往的顾客。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll just finish this paragraph. Good to see you.
beats.chinese: 我先把这段读完。见到你真好。

causality.presenceReason: Saoirse按约到乔治街拱廊交付Niall订的六本诗刊，对方姐姐临时说让邻居代取，她等待Niall直接确认。

causality.currentState: 亲切而固执，坚持直接约定，知道自己慢，仍不愿加转述链。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Mount Eden, Arthur Pemberton stands in the marked viewing area outside the crater, his bag over his shoulder. He came to look across Auckland, but has been reading a book he carried up. He closes it and turns towards you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在伊甸山，Arthur Pemberton站在火山口外缘标示的观景区域，肩上背着包。他本来是来看奥克兰远景的，却一直在读随身带来的书。他合上书，转向附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Before I came up, I told myself I'd look at the view for ten minutes first. Opened the book and never did. Right. Officially starting now.
beats.chinese: 上来前跟自己说好了，先看十分钟风景。书一打开，就没执行。好了。现在正式开始。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks across the city, keeping a finger between the pages. A moment later, he glances down at the cover.
beats.chinese: 他望向城市，一根手指仍夹在书页间。过了一会儿，他又低头瞥了眼封面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Arthur, by the way. It's a book about beekeeping. I've reached the bit about moving beehives. Quite a lot to think about, apparently—the straps alone...
beats.chinese: 对了，我叫Arthur。这是本养蜂的书。我读到搬蜂箱那部分了。原来要操心的事还真不少，光是绑带就……

choices.english: What's interesting about the book?
choices.chinese: 这本书有什么有趣的地方？

choices.english: I'd just like to look at the skyline from here.
choices.chinese: 我只想从这里看看城市远景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Arthur turns the cover towards you without handing the book over. A folded handwritten list sticks out near the back.
beats.chinese: Arthur把封面转向你，没有把书递过来。靠后的书页里露出一张折起来的手写清单。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Found it on a bottom shelf, beside something about drains. You should read it. There's a chapter on moving beehives that—oh, it gets very particular.
beats.chinese: 在最底下那层书架找到的，旁边是本讲排水管的书。你该读读。有一章讲搬蜂箱，那个细致劲儿——哦，真是什么都讲究。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He finds the chapter, then laughs before he has finished scanning the page.
beats.chinese: 他翻到那一章，还没看完那一页，自己先笑了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I drive a mobile library van around Auckland. Apparently that qualifies me to worry about loading bees. I haven't even asked whether you like bees.
beats.chinese: 我在奥克兰开流动图书馆的车。看来这就够资格让我操心怎么装运蜜蜂了。我甚至还没问你喜不喜欢蜜蜂。

choices.english: Give me the short version of the beehive chapter.
choices.chinese: 简单说说搬蜂箱那章吧。

choices.english: Bees aren't really my thing. I'll carry on along the marked path.
choices.chinese: 我对蜜蜂实在没什么兴趣。我继续沿着标示的步道走走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Arthur nods, keeping the closed book in his hands and his finger between the pages.
beats.chinese: Arthur点点头，手里仍拿着合上的书，手指夹在书页间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I'll keep the bees to myself.
beats.chinese: 当然。蜜蜂的事我就留着自己琢磨吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the book and takes out a folded list. His eyes move from the first item to the skyline, then back to the open page.
beats.chinese: 他翻开书，抽出一张折好的清单，视线从第一项移到城市远景上，又落回翻开的书页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ten minutes looking, then a chapter. That was the arrangement. I've started with the chapter and lost track of the ten minutes.
beats.chinese: 先看十分钟风景，再读一章。原本是这么安排的。我先读了那一章，十分钟早就不知道去哪了。

choices.english: I'll look from here. Enjoy your book.
choices.chinese: 我就在这里看。你慢慢读吧。

choices.english: I'll look from the other side. Enjoy the view.
choices.chinese: 我去另一边看。你也慢慢看风景吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Arthur holds the book against his chest rather than reading the whole page aloud.
beats.chinese: Arthur把书靠在胸前，没有整页念出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You move them when the bees are home, secure the hive, and keep enough air getting through. Rather more to organise than a box of crime novels.
beats.chinese: 要等蜜蜂都回巢再搬，把蜂箱固定好，还得保证通风。比搬一箱犯罪小说要操心多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He starts to turn another page, catches himself, and closes the book. His attention returns to the skyline.
beats.chinese: 他刚想再翻一页，便停住手，把书合上，重新望向城市远景。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That was the short version. I nearly gave you the equipment list as well. Thanks for listening. I'll let you have the view now.
beats.chinese: 简短版就这些。我差点连设备清单都讲给你听。谢谢你听我说。现在不打扰你看风景了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the marked crater-rim path. Arthur keeps his book close and stays in the viewing area.
beats.chinese: 你继续沿着火山口外缘标示的步道前行。Arthur把书收在身前，留在观景区域里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I do tend to recommend whatever's currently in my hand.
beats.chinese: 完全理解。我总爱推荐自己手里正拿着的那一本。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives a small wave, then reopens the chapter with an unmistakably pleased expression.
beats.chinese: 他轻轻挥了下手，又翻开那一章，脸上的兴致一点也藏不住。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy your walk. I'm going to finish this bit about the straps.
beats.chinese: 慢慢逛。我得把讲绑带的这一段读完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You look out across the city. Arthur stays nearby, with his bag on his shoulder.
beats.chinese: 你望向城市远景。Arthur留在附近，包仍背在肩上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I'll leave you to it.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。那就不打扰你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tucks the list into the back of the book and opens his chapter again, holding the pages close so they do not flap.
beats.chinese: 他把清单塞回书后，重新翻开那一章，收拢书页，免得纸张翻动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One more page for me. Possibly two. I wouldn't trust my estimate.
beats.chinese: 我再看一页。也可能两页。我的估计不太可信。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You choose the view from the other side of the viewing area. Arthur stays where he is, keeping his bag on his shoulder.
beats.chinese: 你选择从观景区域的另一侧看风景。Arthur留在原地，包依旧背在肩上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I might actually put this away.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我还真该把这本书收起来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds the list once more, puts it inside the closed book, and stows both in his bag. He looks out across Auckland.
beats.chinese: 他把清单又折了一下，夹进合上的书里，一起收进包中，然后望向奥克兰远景。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. The city gets its ten minutes. Enjoy the view over there.
beats.chinese: 好了。该给这座城市十分钟了。你在那边慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Mount Eden, Arthur stands in the marked viewing area with a closed book in his hands. He recognises you and smiles.
beats.chinese: 在伊甸山，Arthur站在标示的观景区域，手里拿着一本合上的书。他认出你，笑了笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. I'm not going to recommend this one today.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。今天我不准备推荐这本。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the book at the marked page and scans a few lines. Then he closes it, puts it in his bag, and looks across the city.
beats.chinese: 他把书翻到夹着书签的那一页，扫了几行，随后合上书，收进包里，望向城市远景。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm not enjoying it much myself. Still want to know what happens next, though. That's how it keeps me reading. I'll look at the city for a bit, then decide whether to carry on.
beats.chinese: 我自己也读得没什么滋味。不过，还是想知道后面会怎样。就这么一直读下去了。我先看一会儿城市，再决定要不要接着读。

causality.presenceReason: Arthur原本就上伊甸山看奥克兰远景，随身带的养蜂书使他在玩家到达前便读了起来。
causality.placeAttitude: 他喜欢这里的城市远景，但眼下对书中搬运蜂箱的细节更着迷，看景计划因此被自己搁置。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须久留的任务。他自行安排看景和阅读，全程停留在火山口外缘标示步道与观景区域，不占用通行空间。
causality.currentGoal: 原计划先看十分钟风景再读一章，现在合上书，打算正式开始看景，却又忍不住提起蜂箱运输。
causality.currentState: 心情轻松，注意力容易被书吸走，愿意主动短聊，也接受对方只想看景，不需要玩家陪聊或替他安排。
causality.contactTrigger: Arthur在标示观景区域合上养蜂书，主动向附近的玩家说起自己没有执行先看十分钟风景的计划，随后忍不住提到蜂箱运输。接触不再依赖包占位置、致歉或让位。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留流动图书馆司机身份、奥克兰生活背景、清单习惯、冷幽默与偏离计划的乐趣。他仍会没问兴趣就推荐自己正在读的书，被拒绝也不介意。重逢时坦言一本书读得没滋味，不勉强推荐，也没有因此失去想知道后续的好奇心。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家选聊书后，a继续介绍养蜂书并暴露推荐不看对象的习惯。aa按玩家要求简述蜂箱运输，克制继续展开的冲动并结束交谈。ab接受玩家对蜜蜂没兴趣，玩家沿标示步道继续走，他留下读书。玩家选择只看景后，b接受这个边界。ba回应玩家让他继续读书的选择，停止展开话题，自行阅读。bb承接玩家去观景区域另一侧看景的选择，Arthur留在原地，自行收书，真正开始看景。两条结局都不再依赖让位。
causality.spatialContinuity: 所有互动只在火山口外缘标示步道和观景区域内进行，遵循场所用途，不进入火山口，不增设设施，不阻挡通行。包一直随身携带，书与清单均为自带物品。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Arthur Pemberton。本次重逢位于伊甸山观景步道，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Mount Eden's marked crater-rim viewing area, Indira Sparrow is taking a break from sorting watch parts. A coin slips from their fingers and stops near your shoe, within the viewing area.
beats.chinese: 在伊甸山火山口外缘标示的观景区域，Indira Sparrow 正趁着休息，暂时远离整理手表零件的工作。一枚硬币从他们指间滑落，停在你鞋边，仍在观景区域内。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's my coin by your shoe. Could I reach past you? I'm Indira.
beats.chinese: 你鞋边那枚硬币是我的。我能从你旁边伸手捡一下吗？我叫 Indira。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Indira points to the coin and waits, keeping out of your space.
beats.chinese: Indira 指了指硬币，留在原地等着，没有挤进你身边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came up for the view. Apparently I brought a very small escape artist.
beats.chinese: 我是上来看风景的。看来还带了一位特别小的逃脱大师。

choices.english: Step aside. Go ahead. Can you actually do a trick with it?
choices.chinese: 往旁边让开。捡吧。你真能用它变魔术吗？

choices.english: Step aside. Go ahead. I'd rather just look at the view.
choices.chinese: 往旁边让开。捡吧。我只想看看风景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Indira retrieves the coin and straightens up, leaving room for people to pass.
beats.chinese: Indira 捡起硬币，直起身，给其他人留出通行的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Absolutely. You don't need to lend me anything. I've got enough to keep track of.
beats.chinese: 当然。你什么都不用借给我。我需要记住去向的东西已经够多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They open a small prop pouch. Beside a second coin is a notebook. They touch each item, then check the first coin again.
beats.chinese: 他们打开随身的小道具袋。另一枚硬币旁边放着一本小册子。他们逐一碰了碰里面的东西，又检查了一次手里的硬币。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Coin, spare coin, notebook. Right. Now I'm ready.
beats.chinese: 硬币、备用硬币、小册子。好，这下准备好了。

choices.english: Let's see the trick.
choices.chinese: 来，表演一下吧。

choices.english: Actually, what's the notebook for?
choices.chinese: 对了，那本小册子是做什么用的？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Indira picks up the coin and moves to one side within the marked viewing area.
beats.chinese: Indira 捡起硬币，在标示的观景区域内往旁边挪开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I sort tiny watch parts all day. You'd think I could keep hold of one big coin.
beats.chinese: 当然。我整天都在整理小小的手表零件。按说一枚这么大的硬币，总该拿得住吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They put the coin in a zipped pocket, close it, then run a finger over the zip a second time.
beats.chinese: 他们把硬币放进有拉链的口袋，拉好，又用手指沿着拉链摸了一遍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. All yours. The view, I mean.
beats.chinese: 好了，归你了。我是说，风景。

choices.english: Watch parts? Is that your job?
choices.chinese: 手表零件？那是你的工作吗？

choices.english: Thanks. I'll stay here and look.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。我就在这里看看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Indira closes the pouch and holds the coin up. Their quick patter begins as it passes between their hands.
beats.chinese: Indira 合上道具袋，举起硬币。硬币在双手间移动，他们也开始利落地说起表演台词。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One coin, no sleeves involved. The sleeves demanded too much money.
beats.chinese: 一枚硬币，袖子完全不参与。袖子的出场费太高了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The coin vanishes, then appears behind their own ear. They bow briefly, put it beside the spare and count both twice before closing the pouch.
beats.chinese: 硬币消失了，随后又从他们自己的耳后出现。他们简短地鞠了一躬，把硬币放回备用硬币旁边，数了两遍才合上袋子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And that's the whole show. Thanks for watching. I'll let you get back to Auckland.
beats.chinese: 表演到此结束。谢谢观看。接下来就不耽误你看奥克兰了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Indira puts both coins away and takes out the notebook instead. A thumb holds most of its pages shut.
beats.chinese: Indira 收好两枚硬币，转而拿出小册子，拇指压着大部分书页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Things I've lent out. Mara, case knife, three weeks. I did ask yesterday. Very casually.
beats.chinese: 记借出去的东西。Mara，开表刀，三周。我昨天确实问过了。问得特别随意。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They half-turn another page, stop and close the notebook firmly. It goes back into the pouch without any names being added.
beats.chinese: 他们翻起下一页的一半，又停住，利落地合上册子。册子放回袋里，没有添上任何名字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, that's enough public accounting. Enjoy the view. I'm putting this away before I check another entry.
beats.chinese: 好了，公开查账就到这里。慢慢看风景吧。我得赶紧收起来，免得又查下一条。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Indira turns back toward you, keeping their hands away from the zipped pocket.
beats.chinese: Indira 转回身看向你，双手离开了拉好拉链的口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: First-year watchmaking apprentice. Mostly sorting parts by size and finish. Sorting confetti with feelings, I call it.
beats.chinese: 我是制表学徒，第一年。主要按尺寸和表面处理给零件分类。我管这叫给有情绪的纸屑分类。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They glance across the city, then turn along the marked path to leave the viewing area.
beats.chinese: 他们朝城市望了一眼，随后转向标示的步道，准备离开观景区域。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Anyway, I've had my break. Better get going before I start sorting the contents of my pockets. Enjoy it up here.
beats.chinese: 好了，休息够了。得赶紧走，免得开始给口袋里的东西分类。你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Indira stays to one side, leaving your sightline clear.
beats.chinese: Indira 留在一旁，没有挡住你的视线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No problem. Sorry about the coin interruption.
beats.chinese: 没问题。抱歉，刚才那枚硬币打扰你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tuck both hands into their hoodie pocket and turn toward another part of the skyline. The conversation ends without a demonstration.
beats.chinese: 他们把双手插进连帽衫口袋，转头望向城市远景的另一边。交谈就此结束，没有魔术表演。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll keep the rest of my change to myself. Enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 剩下的零钱我会管好的。慢慢看风景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Mount Eden, you see Indira in the marked viewing area, looking at an open notebook with a phone in their other hand. They look up and recognize you.
beats.chinese: 后来一次到伊甸山时，你看见 Indira 站在标示的观景区域，正看着摊开的借物册，另一只手拿着手机。他们抬起头，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. I was just about to ask where something I lent out is being kept. Again. Very casually, obviously.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。我正想问问，借出去的一件东西现在放在哪儿。再问一次。当然，得问得特别随意。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their thumb pauses above the phone screen. They check the location already written beside the entry, then close the notebook, put it and the phone away, and turn toward the city.
beats.chinese: 他们的拇指停在手机屏幕上方。他们核对了一下条目旁已经记下的位置，随后合上借物册，把册子和手机收好，转身望向城市。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's already in the book. I don't need to ask again today. Right. These next few minutes are for the view.
beats.chinese: 册子里已经记着了。今天不用再问一次。好，接下来这几分钟留给风景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: After a morning checking equipment at an indoor climbing gym, Beryl Hutchinson has come to Mount Eden with her housemate. They are in the marked crater-rim viewing area. Her housemate is studying the skyline. Beryl stands clear of the path and speaks to you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在室内攀岩馆检查了一上午器材后，贝丽尔·哈钦森陪室友来到伊甸山。她们待在火山口外缘标示的观景区域，室友正仔细看着城市远景。贝丽尔站在不挡步道的位置，向附近的你开口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She wants to look a bit longer. I said I'd stay with her. I won't hurry her.
beats.chinese: 她还想多看一会儿。我答应陪着，不催她。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beryl stays where she is and glances towards her housemate, a little farther along the viewing area.
beats.chinese: 贝丽尔仍站在原处，朝观景区域稍远处的室友看了一眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've finished looking. She's being very thorough.
beats.chinese: 我已经看够了。她看得很仔细。

choices.english: It's a wonderful view. I can see why she's taking her time.
choices.chinese: 景色真好。我能理解她为什么要慢慢看。

choices.english: I'll leave you to it, then.
choices.chinese: 那我就不打扰你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beryl looks across the crater towards the city again. Her expression barely changes.
beats.chinese: 贝丽尔又越过火山口望向城市，表情几乎没变。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's a city from higher up. Five minutes does me.
beats.chinese: 就是从高处看城市。看五分钟我就够了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She notices her housemate turning towards another part of the skyline and settles her bag strap more securely on her shoulder.
beats.chinese: 她注意到室友转向另一侧的城市远景，便把肩上的包带往稳妥处提了提。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She's enjoying it, though. I said I'd wait.
beats.chinese: 不过她看得挺开心。我说了会等她。

choices.english: I'll have a look for myself, then.
choices.chinese: 那我自己看看。

choices.english: What made you come along?
choices.chinese: 那你怎么会陪她来？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beryl gives a small nod. She stays in her place within the viewing area, clear of the path.
beats.chinese: 贝丽尔轻轻点头，仍站在观景区域内不挡步道的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. Enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 好。慢慢看风景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She glances towards her housemate, who is still looking out over the city, then rests a hand on her bag strap.
beats.chinese: 她朝仍在远眺城市的室友看了一眼，把一只手搭在包带上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll be here a while yet. She's found something else to look at.
beats.chinese: 我还得待一会儿。她又找到别的地方看了。

choices.english: Have you been up here long?
choices.chinese: 你们上来很久了吗？

choices.english: All right. I'll carry on. Enjoy your afternoon.
choices.chinese: 好，那我继续走了。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beryl turns sideways so that her shoulder no longer cuts across your view of the city.
beats.chinese: 贝丽尔侧过身，不再让自己的肩膀挡着你看城市。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Go ahead. I'll keep my opinion over here.
beats.chinese: 看吧。我把我的意见留在这边。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She moves a little farther along the marked viewing area and takes a water bottle from her bag, turning her attention away from the conversation.
beats.chinese: 她沿着标示的观景区域稍稍挪远，从包里取出水瓶，把注意力从交谈中移开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You've got a clear view there.
beats.chinese: 你站那儿看，不挡视线。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beryl watches her housemate for a moment before answering. She makes no move to call her back.
beats.chinese: 贝丽尔看了室友片刻才回答，没有招呼她回来的意思。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She sat through my swim yesterday. Forty slow widths. Her turn to choose.
beats.chinese: 昨天我游泳，她一直坐着等。慢慢游了四十趟短边。这回轮到她选。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her housemate turns and lifts a hand. Beryl returns the gesture and walks over to her, staying within the viewing area.
beats.chinese: 室友转过身，抬手示意。贝丽尔也抬了抬手，留在观景区域内朝她走去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah. Ready now. Enjoy your look.
beats.chinese: 啊。她看好了。你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beryl checks her watch with a quick turn of her wrist.
beats.chinese: 贝丽尔转了下手腕，迅速看了一眼表。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eighteen minutes. We came after my shift at the climbing gym. Equipment checks.
beats.chinese: 十八分钟。我在攀岩馆下班后过来的。做器材检查。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lowers her wrist and turns towards the crater, letting the conversation end rather than adding another question.
beats.chinese: 她放下手腕，转向火山口，没有再问什么，让谈话就此结束。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm giving the watch a rest now. Enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 现在让手表歇会儿。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beryl gives you a nod as you turn to continue along the marked path.
beats.chinese: 你转身准备沿标示步道继续走，贝丽尔向你点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too.
beats.chinese: 你也是。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the path, she faces her housemate again and adjusts the bag resting against her hip.
beats.chinese: 你沿步道继续走，她重新面向室友，调整了一下贴在胯边的包。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave her to it.
beats.chinese: 就让她慢慢看吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Mount Eden, you see Beryl standing in the marked crater-rim viewing area, clear of the path. She recognises you and gives a small nod.
beats.chinese: 后来再次来到伊甸山，你看见贝丽尔站在火山口外缘标示的观景区域，没有挡着步道。她认出了你，轻轻点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. A bit tired after work today. I'll stop here a minute before I carry on.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天下班后有点累。在这儿歇一会儿再走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks quietly across the crater towards the city without adding anything. After a short rest, she starts along the marked path and turns her head towards you.
beats.chinese: 她安静地越过火山口望向城市，没有再说什么。歇了一小会儿，她沿标示步道迈步离开，转头看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's enough of a rest. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 歇够了。散步愉快。

causality.presenceReason: 贝丽尔在攀岩馆结束上午的器材检查后，陪室友上伊甸山看城市远景。
causality.placeAttitude: 她看五分钟便觉得足够，对远景兴趣有限，但不妨碍室友慢慢欣赏。
causality.stayingConstraint: 她答应陪室友看完，因此没有独自离开，也没有催促。
causality.currentGoal: 在标示观景区域等室友结束这次停留。
causality.currentState: 工作后耐心有限、话不多，但保持礼貌，也愿意简短回应。重逢时的疲倦只是当天工作后的状态。
causality.contactTrigger: 她始终站在观景区域内不挡步道的位置，向附近玩家平直地说室友还想多看一会儿，自己答应陪着、不催她，再补充自己已经看够。没有碰撞、空间侵入或需要玩家处理的意外。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留她精确、直白、忠于约定的性格，通过十八分钟和四十趟短边体现说话习惯，通过冷淡评价风景显露扫兴的缺点。她不假装享受等待，也不要求玩家陪她。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家赞美景色后，a保留她直白而扫兴的回应。aa中她收起意见、挪开喝水，让玩家自行观景。ab中她说明陪伴的具体缘由，随后应室友示意过去。玩家表示不打扰时，b礼貌回应，不要求玩家留下。玩家仍可追问等了多久，进入ba，或告辞进入bb。ba中她准确报时并简述工作，随后不再看表，结束交谈。bb中她回应祝福，继续留在原处等室友，不再提及碰撞或道歉。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程位于火山口外缘标示步道与观景区域。初遇时她站定且不挡路，后续仅在区域内小幅移动。重逢时在观景区域休息，再沿标示步道离开，不进入火山口，不新增设施或跨越限制。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Beryl Hutchinson。本次重逢位于伊甸山观景步道，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Mount Eden's marked crater-rim viewing area, Wren Tualagi-Fahey turns toward you nearby. He is taking a short walk after a repair visit and hasn't kept track of the time.
beats.chinese: 在伊甸山火山口外缘标示的观景区域，Wren Tualagi-Fahey 转向附近的你。他做完一次上门维修，来散一小会儿步，一直没留意时间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Could you tell me the time? I'm not meeting anyone. Just wondering how long I've been walking.
beats.chinese: 方便告诉我现在几点吗？我没赶约会，只想知道这趟走了多久。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives you a brief smile, then glances toward the crater.
beats.chinese: 他朝你简短地笑了笑，随后望向火山口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Wren, by the way. I'll have a look at the crater, then head home.
beats.chinese: 对了，我叫 Wren。我再看看火山口就回家。

choices.english: Sure. Just out for a short walk, then?
choices.chinese: 可以。那就是出来走一小会儿？

choices.english: I'm not sure of the time. I'll take a look at the city.
choices.chinese: 我不太清楚现在几点。我看看城市那边。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You tell Wren the time. He stays where he is, with room for others to pass. He loosens his shoulders.
beats.chinese: 你告诉 Wren 现在的时间。他留在原处，给其他人留着通行的空间，活动了一下肩膀。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Yes. I fix smart door locks part-time. Finished a job and fancied a bit of air.
beats.chinese: 谢了。是啊。我兼职修智能门锁。刚做完一单，想出来透透气。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances across the crater.
beats.chinese: 他朝火山口那边望了望。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Home after this. I live on my own, so there's nobody asking what's for dinner.
beats.chinese: 看完就回家。我一个人住，没人追着问晚饭吃什么。

choices.english: No dinner negotiations. That sounds handy.
choices.chinese: 不用商量晚饭吃什么，倒挺省事。

choices.english: Wouldn't a dog make home less lonely?
choices.chinese: 养只狗，家里会不会没那么孤单？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You turn toward the city. Beside you, Wren takes one more look at it.
beats.chinese: 你转向城市那边。Wren 在你旁边，又朝城市望了一眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No worries. I came up for the view. Spent the first few minutes looking at my shoes.
beats.chinese: 没事。我是来看风景的。结果头几分钟一直在看自己的鞋。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lifts one foot just enough to inspect the loose lace, then plants it firmly again.
beats.chinese: 他稍稍抬起一只脚，看了看松开的鞋带，又稳稳地放下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That'll need tying before I go. The city can wait a second.
beats.chinese: 走之前得把它系好。城市可以等我一下。

choices.english: The buildings look very close together from here.
choices.chinese: 从这里看，那些楼挤得真近。

choices.english: I'll leave you to it. Enjoy your walk.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你了。祝你散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wren gives a short laugh and takes a water bottle from his pocket.
beats.chinese: Wren 短促地笑了一声，从口袋里拿出水瓶。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ha. Toast has never asked me to cook something else.
beats.chinese: 哈。吐司可从没要求我换道菜。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He unscrews the cap and raises the bottle slightly in farewell, settling into his water break.
beats.chinese: 他拧开瓶盖，略微举起水瓶，算是道别，接着开始喝水休息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, a drink for me. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 好了，我喝口水。祝你散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wren's smile disappears. His answer comes quickly.
beats.chinese: Wren 收起笑容，回答得很快。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm not lonely. And I'm not taking a dog home.
beats.chinese: 我不孤单。而且我不打算带只狗回家。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pauses, then turns toward the marked path, leaving your view clear.
beats.chinese: 他顿了顿，转向标示的步道，没有挡住你的视线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I like visiting them, with the owner's okay. That's plenty for me. Anyway, enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 主人同意的话，我喜欢逗逗它们。这样就够了。好了，你慢慢看风景。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wren bends to tie his lace, then straightens and looks toward the skyline you mentioned.
beats.chinese: Wren 弯腰系好鞋带，直起身，朝你说的城市天际线望去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They do. Down there, I always seem to need the building three streets further on.
beats.chinese: 是挺挤。在下面的时候，我要去的楼却总像是还隔着三条街。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks the knot with a small tug of his foot, then turns to look into the crater.
beats.chinese: 他轻轻动了动脚，确认鞋带系牢，随后转身看向火山口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's my city-gazing done. I'll have a look this way. Cheers.
beats.chinese: 城市我看够了。我看看这边。回见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wren nods and bends to deal with the loose lace.
beats.chinese: Wren 点点头，弯腰处理松开的鞋带。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. Got my look in already.
beats.chinese: 谢了。我已经看过一阵了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He ties the lace, checks it, and starts along the marked path without drawing you away from the view.
beats.chinese: 他系好鞋带，检查了一下，便沿着标示的步道离开，没有再分散你看风景的注意力。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All sorted. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 弄好了。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Mount Eden's marked viewing area, Wren is looking at his phone. He recognises you and raises a hand in greeting.
beats.chinese: 在伊甸山标示的观景区域，Wren 正看着手机。他认出了你，爽快地抬手打招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again! My neighbour's just sent a close-up of their cat. Ha. I'm saying hello back.
beats.chinese: 又见面了！邻居刚发来一张家里猫的近照。哈。我正回一句问候。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He smiles as he sends the message, then puts his phone away and stays where he is, leaving room for others to pass.
beats.chinese: 他笑着发完消息，把手机收好，仍留在原处，给其他人留着通行的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nice to see the cat, even on a screen. No repair jobs today. I'll take my time on this walk.
beats.chinese: 隔着屏幕看一眼也挺高兴。今天没维修，我还想慢慢走。

causality.presenceReason: Wren 完成一次上门维修后，先来伊甸山短暂散步、看景，再回家。
causality.placeAttitude: 他喜欢在这里短暂停留，看城市和火山口，也会在没有维修安排时特意放慢散步的节奏，独自享受这段时间。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须等候的人或事务，也没有要赶的约会，只打算短暂停留。始终留在标示步道和观景区域，不进入火山口。
causality.currentGoal: 维修结束后透气，问清当前时间以了解自己走了多久，再看看火山口便回家。
causality.currentState: 心情平常，愿意为一个具体问题主动搭话并简短介绍自己，但不寻求长时间陪伴。谈到独居被理解为孤独时，会立刻变得生硬。
causality.contactTrigger: 他散步时没留意时间，于是在标示观景区域向附近玩家询问现在几点，并说明自己没有要赶的约会，只想知道走了多久。玩家可以告诉他时间并追问散步安排，也可以表示不清楚、转而看城市。他不要求玩家查手机。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留西奥克兰成长及现居奥克兰的经历、兼职智能门锁售后维修、喜欢短接触和独居、干脆幽默、尊重宠物主人许可及拒绝养宠物的边界。主动问时间不代表需要陪伴，独居也没有被改写成待解决的问题。重逢时简短回复邻居发来的猫照片，延续他喜欢动物又不要求持续陪伴的相处方式。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家答应告知时间并询问是否只出来短走后，a 先落实报时，再由 Wren 致谢并说明维修后的散步及回家安排。aa 因玩家理解独居便利而开玩笑，以喝水结束交谈。ab 被孤独假设触动，直接划清养狗边界后离开。玩家表示不清楚时间、选择看城市后，b 接受对方不知道，顺着视线再看一眼，注意到鞋带需要系好。ba 接住城市观察，系好鞋带后转看火山口并道别。bb 接受玩家结束交谈的意愿，系好鞋带便沿步道离开。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全部互动发生在火山口外缘标示的步道与观景区域，只使用城市远景、火山口和随身物品。玩家看城市无需 Wren 让位，人物不进入火山口，不增加设施，也不阻挡通行。重逢时只在原处查看并回复手机消息，没有实际接触动物或转移场景。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Wren Tualagi-Fahey。本次重逢位于伊甸山观景步道，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At North Wharf in Wynyard Quarter, Tane Ropata has been waiting ten minutes for a mate and their planned waterfront walk. They raise a hand toward you, then hesitate.
beats.chinese: 在温亚德码头街区的 North Wharf 岸边，Tane Ropata 已经等了朋友十分钟，两人原本约好沿水边散步。他们朝你抬起手，随即迟疑了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There you are. Oh, sorry. Thought you were my mate.
beats.chinese: 你可来了。哦，不好意思。认成我朋友了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their phone vibrates. Tane reads the screen and lets out a short breath, staying clear of people using the public walkway.
beats.chinese: 手机振了一下。Tane 看了看屏幕，短短地呼出一口气，站在不妨碍公共步道通行的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Another queue update. Brilliant. I'm Tane, anyway.
beats.chinese: 又来汇报排队进度了。真行。对了，我叫 Tane。

choices.english: Your mate sounds very committed to that queue.
choices.chinese: 看来你朋友是铁了心要排这个队。

choices.english: No worries. Waiting here seems better than being in the queue.
choices.chinese: 没事。在这里等，总比在队里排着好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tane lowers the phone. Their voice settles back into an even pace.
beats.chinese: Tane 放低手机，语速又恢复了平稳。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Usually I'd agree. They won their first table-tennis match on Thursday. I've been allowing a bit of extra nonsense.
beats.chinese: 平时我也这么想。他们星期四第一次赢了乒乓球比赛。我就多容忍他们胡闹一点。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tuck the phone into a pocket. As they recall the score, their speech speeds up.
beats.chinese: 他们把手机塞进口袋。说起比分时，语速快了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Eleven–nine, from eight–three down. Kept getting the serve back. They keep calling it luck, which is getting annoying.
beats.chinese: 十一比九，八比三落后追上来的。发球一直都接回去了。他们非说是运气，听得我都有点烦了。

choices.english: Coming back from eight–three takes more than luck.
choices.chinese: 从八比三追上来，可不只是运气。

choices.english: What do you do when you're not waiting for your mate?
choices.chinese: 不等朋友的时候，你是做什么的？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tane glances along the shore, then back at the phone.
beats.chinese: Tane 沿着岸边望了一眼，又看向手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah. I'd complain the whole time in there. Held a mate's place for forty minutes once, though. That was different.
beats.chinese: 是啊。真排进去，我能从头抱怨到尾。不过有一次我替朋友占了四十分钟的位置。那是另一回事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They read a new message and briefly hold up two fingers.
beats.chinese: 他们读了一条新消息，短暂地竖起两根手指。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Two minutes, apparently. That's their third two minutes.
beats.chinese: 据说还有两分钟。这已经是第三个两分钟了。

choices.english: Good luck with those two minutes. Bye. Continue along the walkway.
choices.chinese: 祝你顺利等完这两分钟。再见。沿步道继续走。

choices.english: I'll look at the water over here. No need to keep talking.
choices.chinese: 我在这边看看水景就好，不用一直陪我聊天。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tane nods immediately, looking more animated than they did while checking the messages.
beats.chinese: Tane 立刻点头，神情比刚才查看消息时生动多了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Exactly. They used to miss every short serve. Practised those for weeks, then got four back in that last game.
beats.chinese: 就是。他们以前每个短球都接不到。练了好几个星期，最后那局接回去了四个。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Someone farther along the walkway waves. Tane waves back and turns toward their approaching mate.
beats.chinese: 步道前方有人挥手。Tane 挥手回应，转向正走近的朋友。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There they are. I'm making them tell the score properly this time. Good talking to you.
beats.chinese: 来了。这次得让他们好好把比分讲清楚。跟你聊得挺好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tane answers without hesitation, their voice returning to its earlier level.
beats.chinese: Tane 没有迟疑便回答了，声音恢复了先前的平稳。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Apprentice accordion bellows repairer. Two years in. Finished a gasket today. It fitted.
beats.chinese: 修手风琴风箱的学徒。干了两年。今天做完一个密封垫。装得上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They brush a small fleck from their sleeve, then check their phone again.
beats.chinese: 他们掸掉袖子上的一小点碎屑，又看了一眼手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Still wreck the odd one. Anyway, I'll let you get on. Nice meeting you.
beats.chinese: 偶尔还是会做坏一个。总之，不耽误你了。很高兴认识你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the walkway, Tane steps back enough to leave a clear gap.
beats.chinese: 你沿步道继续往前走，Tane 往后让了让，留出通行的空当。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. Sorry about the mistaken wave.
beats.chinese: 谢了。刚才认错人，抱歉啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They give a small farewell wave, then turn back toward the direction their mate is expected from.
beats.chinese: 他们轻轻挥手道别，随后转身望向朋友预计会来的方向。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a good walk.
beats.chinese: 散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You turn toward the water. Tane puts the phone down by their side and leaves you space.
beats.chinese: 你转向水面。Tane 把拿着手机的手垂到身侧，给你留出空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All good. I'll stop giving you queue reports.
beats.chinese: 好啊。我也不继续给你播报排队进度了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The phone rings. Tane gives you a brief nod and shifts farther aside before answering.
beats.chinese: 手机响了。Tane 朝你点点头，又往旁边让了些才接起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah, I'm here. By the water. You've walked past me.
beats.chinese: 对，我在这儿。水边。你走过头了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At North Wharf in Wynyard Quarter, Tane Ropata recognises you with a small braided loop in their hand.
beats.chinese: 在温亚德码头区North Wharf，Tane Ropata手里拿着一小段编绳，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. For my mate's table-tennis bag. He keeps losing it among the black ones.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。给朋友的乒乓球拍袋做的。他老是在一堆黑袋子里找不着自己的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They check the knot once, then put the loop in their pocket, smiling.
beats.chinese: 他们检查一下绳结，笑着把编绳放进口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bright enough now. Mine's still got a bit of old string on it. Anyway, I'll give him this Thursday. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 这回够亮了。我自己的还系着一截旧线。总之，周四给他。散步愉快。

causality.presenceReason: Tane 下班后已到 North Wharf 等朋友，准备按约沿水边散步，玩家出现前已等了十分钟。
causality.placeAttitude: 愿意在岸边散步，对地点没有不满，烦躁针对朋友迟到和接连发来的排队消息。
causality.stayingConstraint: 与朋友约在此处会合，因此暂时留在公共步道旁等候，不阻碍通行。
causality.currentGoal: 等朋友到场，再开始两人原定的散步。
causality.currentState: 当天有些等得不耐烦，但对认错的陌生人礼貌，谈到朋友的小胜利时明显起劲。
causality.contactTrigger: Tane 把玩家误认成朋友，抬手招呼后立刻发现认错并道歉。
