beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Sea Point Promenade, Thandi Mbeki stands inside the railing with a narrow strip of kite fabric and a notebook. She came to check the wind before sewing at home. She keeps the strip in front of her, watching its edge curl down above her palm.
beats.chinese: 海角区海滨长廊上，Thandi Mbeki站在栏杆内侧，拿着一小条风筝布和一本笔记本。她想在回家缝制前试试风。布条始终收在她身前，她看着掌心上方的布边不断向下卷。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I was watching this bit of fabric. I'm not waiting for anyone. I wanted to see if it curls like that here too.
beats.chinese: 我刚才一直盯着这截布，不是在等谁。想确认它在这里是不是也这样卷。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She finishes the brief check and gathers most of the strip into her fist, leaving a short end free.
beats.chinese: 她结束了这次简短的测试，把大部分布条拢进掌心，只留下一小截。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Thandi. It's for a kite I'm making. The notebook makes this look more official than it is.
beats.chinese: 我叫Thandi。这是给我正在做的风筝用的。拿着笔记本，显得比实际正式多了。

choices.english: What are you checking with the fabric?
choices.chinese: 你用这块布测试什么？

choices.english: What do you put in the notebook?
choices.chinese: 你在笔记本里记些什么？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Thandi holds the short end above her fist. It flickers in the sea breeze while she watches its edge.
beats.chinese: Thandi让一小截布露在拳头上方。布边在海风里颤动，她盯着它看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The edge keeps folding under. It did it on my balcony too. I thought the wall might be changing the wind.
beats.chinese: 这条边总往下面卷。在我家阳台上也这样。我原以为是墙改变了风向。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She opens her notebook with her thumb and traces three closely written lines. Her explanation gathers speed.
beats.chinese: 她用拇指翻开笔记本，沿着写得密密麻麻的三行字划过去，越说越快。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I tried it along the weave, then across it. Same length each time. Then I changed which end I held. That gave me another four entries.
beats.chinese: 我先顺着纹路试，再横着试。每次长度一样。后来又换了一头拿。这样又多记了四条。

choices.english: Could you just show me what you mean?
choices.chinese: 能直接让我看看你说的现象吗？

choices.english: That's enough fabric detail for me. I'll leave you to it.
choices.chinese: 布料细节我听到这里就够了。你继续，我先走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Thandi folds the fabric into her palm before turning a page. The notebook has short entries rather than drawings.
beats.chinese: Thandi先把布条折进掌心，再翻过一页。笔记本上是一条条短记录，没有图画。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Wind today. Usually things people do on site. I install glass greenhouses.
beats.chinese: 今天记风。平时记工地上人们做的事。我做玻璃温室安装。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks an entry, then turns the notebook back toward herself rather than holding it out to read.
beats.chinese: 她核对了一条记录，随后把本子转回自己面前，没有递出来让人看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One installer puts every loose screw in his left pocket. Even when the box is beside his right hand. I've written that down three times.
beats.chinese: 有个安装工把每颗散螺丝都放进左口袋。盒子就在他右手边，他也这样。我已经记过三次了。

choices.english: So is he a good installer?
choices.chinese: 所以，他是个好安装工吗？

choices.english: I'd rather not end up in the notebook myself.
choices.chinese: 我不太想被记进这本笔记里。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Thandi closes the notebook and holds the strip where you can see it without stepping into anyone's path.
beats.chinese: Thandi合上笔记本，把布条举到你能看清的位置，没有挡住行人的路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. The middle pulls straight. That little edge rolls underneath.
beats.chinese: 看。中间拉直了，那一小条边却卷到下面去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The edge curls again. She nods once, folds the strip and puts it with the notebook in her bag.
beats.chinese: 布边又卷了一次。她点点头，把布条折好，和笔记本一起装进包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You got the short version. I should have started there. That's my check done. Nice meeting you.
beats.chinese: 你看到简短版了。我刚才就该从这里开始。检查完了。很高兴认识你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Thandi stops with her finger halfway down the page. She closes the notebook, freeing the space beside her for you to leave.
beats.chinese: Thandi的手指停在半页处。她合上本子，让出身旁的空间，方便你离开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I hadn't even reached the stitching.
beats.chinese: 行。我还没讲到缝线呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you move on, she turns back toward the sea and lets a short length of fabric lift above her hand.
beats.chinese: 你继续往前走。她转回海面，放出一小截布，让它在手上方扬起。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks for saying so. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 谢谢你直接说。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Thandi looks down at the entry again, as though the answer might need an exact date.
beats.chinese: Thandi又低头查看那条记录，仿佛回答这个问题需要一个准确日期。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He checks the corners before he fixes a panel. He also leaves his gloves wherever he takes them off.
beats.chinese: 他固定玻璃板之前会检查四个角。手套脱在哪里，就留在哪里。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She finds a second entry, briefly touches it, then shuts the book. The question has received two more observations.
beats.chinese: 她找到另一条记录，轻轻点了一下，随后合上本子。你的问题换来了另外两条观察。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's what I've seen. I'll leave the verdict there. I'd better finish checking this fabric. Good talking to you.
beats.chinese: 我看到的就是这些。结论就先搁着吧。我得把这块布试完了。很高兴和你聊聊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Thandi closes the notebook immediately. She keeps it closed while she speaks.
beats.chinese: Thandi立刻合上笔记本，说话时也没有再打开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. I won't write about you.
beats.chinese: 好。我不会记你的事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the notebook and fabric away, then turns toward Lion's Head beyond the promenade, leaving the conversation there.
beats.chinese: 她收起笔记本和布条，转身望向长廊远处的狮头山，就此结束了谈话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got enough pages to sort out already. Enjoy the sea.
beats.chinese: 我已经有够多的记录要整理了。好好看看海吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Sea Point Promenade, Thandi Mbeki recognises you while waiting on the pedestrian side of the railing. Her dance partner is approaching along the path.
beats.chinese: 在海角区海滨长廊，Thandi Mbeki在栏杆内侧的步行区域等人时认出了你。她的舞伴正沿步道走来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. A walk before class. We've given ourselves ten minutes. The wind's coming across—oh, there she is.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。上课前先走走，留了十分钟。风从这边——噢，她来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her partner points along the promenade. Thandi waves back, turns towards her and falls into step.
beats.chinese: 舞伴指指长廊前方。Thandi挥手回应，转过去和她一起走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll tell her on the way. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 路上再跟她说。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Naledi Mokoena has been watching the waves at Sea Point Promenade for several minutes. She stands on the pedestrian side of the railing, with one elbow taking up the rail space beside you.
beats.chinese: Naledi Mokoena 已经在海角区海滨长廊看了几分钟海浪。她站在人行通道这一侧，一只手肘占着你身旁的一段栏杆。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's room here, if you want a look. I'm Naledi.
beats.chinese: 想看看海的话，这里有位置。我叫 Naledi。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She draws her elbow back and shifts a little sideways. A folded crossword protrudes from her coat pocket.
beats.chinese: 她收回手肘，往旁边挪了挪。外套口袋里露着一张折好的填字游戏。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I brought that for later. The water's keeping me here.
beats.chinese: 那个是留着晚点做的。现在还想看会儿海。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll take a look.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，那我看看。

choices.english: Thanks, but I'm only passing. No need to move.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，不过我只是路过。你不用挪。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You take the space beside her. Below the railing, a wave drains away from a dark patch on one of the shore rocks.
beats.chinese: 你站到她旁边的空位上。栏杆下方，一道海浪正从岸边岩石的一块深色表面退去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That bit keeps disappearing. Then there it is again.
beats.chinese: 那一块老是被淹住。接着又露出来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Naledi watches until the rock is clear, then unfolds her arms and turns slightly along the promenade.
beats.chinese: Naledi 等岩石完全露出来，才松开交叠的双臂，稍稍转向长廊延伸的方向。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I fancy a few steps along here now.
beats.chinese: 我这会儿想沿着这里走几步。

choices.english: Shall we walk a few steps together?
choices.chinese: 要不要一起走几步？

choices.english: I'll stay here. Enjoy your walk.
choices.chinese: 我留在这里。你慢慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Naledi settles back beside the railing, leaving the space next to her clear.
beats.chinese: Naledi 重新站定在栏杆旁，身边的位置仍然空着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. I won't hold you up.
beats.chinese: 好。不耽误你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pushes the folded crossword deeper into her pocket and turns towards the water.
beats.chinese: 她把折好的填字游戏往口袋里塞深一些，转脸望向海面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've nowhere else I need to be just now.
beats.chinese: 反正我这会儿也不急着去别处。

choices.english: I thought you wanted to be alone. I'd stay for one wave, if you like.
choices.chinese: 我以为你想独处。你愿意的话，我可以留着一起看一道浪。

choices.english: Enjoy the sea, then. Goodbye.
choices.chinese: 那你慢慢看海。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Naledi takes the first step almost before you finish the invitation. She leaves enough space for you to walk beside her.
beats.chinese: 你的邀请几乎还没说完，Naledi 就先迈出了一步，也留出了并肩走的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. A few steps.
beats.chinese: 好。走几步。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You walk a short distance together within the same stretch of promenade. Naledi stops at the railing again, facing the sea.
beats.chinese: 你们在这一段长廊上并肩走了一小段。Naledi 又在栏杆边停下，面向海面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This will do for me. Thanks for the company. Enjoy the rest of your walk.
beats.chinese: 我就走到这儿。谢谢你陪这一段。接下来慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Naledi nods and checks the pedestrian space beside her before moving.
beats.chinese: Naledi 点点头，先看了看身旁的人行通道，准备迈步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. I'll stretch my legs.
beats.chinese: 好。我活动活动腿脚。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She walks a few paces along the railing, then briefly turns her head back towards you.
beats.chinese: 她沿栏杆走出几步，又短暂地回头看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Goodbye. You can keep an eye on that rock.
beats.chinese: 再见。那块石头就留给你看着了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Naledi turns back to you. Her arms remain folded for a moment longer.
beats.chinese: Naledi 转回来看你，双臂又交叠着停了一会儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I didn't ask to be alone. One wave, then.
beats.chinese: 我可没说要独处。那就看一道浪。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She makes room, and you stand beside her. The next wave spreads over a low rock, covering its dark top. Naledi leans forward to watch it drain.
beats.chinese: 她让出位置，你站到她身边。下一道浪漫过一块低矮的岩石，盖住深色的石面。Naledi 微微前倾，看着海水退去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Right over the top. Enjoy your walk, now.
beats.chinese: 瞧，整个淹过去了。好了，祝你散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Naledi gives you a small nod without moving from her place at the railing.
beats.chinese: Naledi 轻轻向你点头，没有离开栏杆边的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Goodbye. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 再见。祝你散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The breeze lifts one side of her collar. She folds it down, secures it beneath her chin and turns back to the waves.
beats.chinese: 海风掀起她一边的衣领。她将衣领折好，拢在下巴下方，重新望向海浪。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll have a few more minutes here.
beats.chinese: 我还要在这儿待几分钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Sea Point Promenade, you see Naledi stop on the pedestrian side of the railing. She recognizes you and raises a hand.
beats.chinese: 在海角区海滨长廊，你看见 Naledi 在栏杆内侧的人行通道上停下脚步。她认出了你，抬手打了个招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I've walked as far as I wanted.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我想走的这一段，已经走完了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She settles into place beside the railing, her arms loose at her sides. She looks out at the water as her breathing slows.
beats.chinese: 她在栏杆旁安稳站定，双臂自然垂在身侧。她望着海面，任呼吸慢慢平缓下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's enough walking for today. I don't feel like going back yet.
beats.chinese: 今天走够了。还不想回去。

causality.presenceReason: 她在玩家出现前已停下来观察海浪，口袋里的填字游戏准备晚些时候再做。
causality.placeAttitude: 她喜欢海滨的风和水面，愿意自己驻足，也不排斥短暂作伴。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有赶时间的安排，也没有必须留守的责任，是否继续看海或走几步由她自己决定。
causality.currentGoal: 看岸边岩石被浪覆盖和重新露出，随后可能沿同一段长廊活动一下。
causality.currentState: 今天话少、注意力在海面上，但愿意主动腾出位置，也会接受具体邀请。
causality.contactTrigger: 她的手肘占着玩家身旁一段栏杆，因此主动收回手肘、介绍自己并让出观景位置。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留少言、先行动、回答简短干脆的特点。被直接邀请时立刻迈步，被推断想独处时略显生硬地纠正，没有承担组织者或导师角色。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 接受邀请并先迈步，短暂同行后自己停下告别。ab 接受玩家留下的决定，独自沿栏杆走开。ba 纠正独处假设，与玩家看完一道浪后结束交谈。bb 接受路过者的告别，整理衣领后继续看海。
causality.spatialContinuity: 所有行动都在人行通道、栏杆内侧及同一段长廊完成。岩石只从栏杆内观看，没有下到岸边，也没有新增设施。重逢同样停留在栏杆内侧，她走完自己想走的一段后原地看海。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Naledi Mokoena。本次重逢位于海角区海滨长廊，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Sea Point Promenade, Pieter van Wyk has stopped beside the railing for sea air after his shift at a Philippi flower farm. He holds his folded jacket against his chest. His phone buzzes, and he takes it out to read a friend's plans for two Saturdays in a row.
beats.chinese: 海角区海滨长廊上，Pieter van Wyk结束在菲利皮一家花场的工作后，停在栏杆旁吹海风。他把叠好的外套抱在胸前。手机振了一下，他拿出来，看见朋友把连续两个周六的聚会都安排上了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Saying yes once doesn't mean I'm in every time.
beats.chinese: 答应一次，可不等于以后都算我一个。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks up from the phone toward you, tired from work but with a small smile.
beats.chinese: 他从手机前抬起头看向你，带着下班后的疲惫，脸上却有一点笑意。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My friend's braai plans. He's put me down for two Saturdays. I'm Pieter, by the way.
beats.chinese: 我说的是朋友的烤肉聚会安排。他把我两个周六都算上了。对了，我叫Pieter。

choices.english: Are you here for a break?
choices.chinese: 你是来歇一会儿吗？

choices.english: I'll let you get back to your break.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你休息了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Pieter settles the folded jacket over his forearm.
beats.chinese: Pieter把叠好的外套搭在小臂上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. I work the shade cloth at the flower farm. Enough rolling screens up and down for one day.
beats.chinese: 是啊。我在花场管遮阳网。今天卷上放下的活儿已经干够了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances at the message again. His eyebrows rise, and he gives a short laugh.
beats.chinese: 他又瞥了一眼消息，扬起眉毛，短促地笑了一声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My friend's put me down for two more Saturday braais. I've been to the last three.
beats.chinese: 朋友又把我算进接下来两个周六的烤肉聚会了。前面三次我可都去了。

choices.english: Three Saturdays? You must like his cooking.
choices.chinese: 连去三个周六？你一定很喜欢他的手艺。

choices.english: I'll let you get back to your break.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你休息了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Pieter gives you a friendly nod, staying beside the railing.
beats.chinese: Pieter友善地点点头，仍站在栏杆旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I'll just answer this.
beats.chinese: 谢了。我回一下这条消息。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He settles the folded jacket under his arm and looks at the message again. One eyebrow lifts as he reads.
beats.chinese: 他把叠好的外套夹稳，又看了看消息。读着消息，他挑起一边眉毛。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Two Saturdays. He's getting ambitious.
beats.chinese: 两个周六。他这安排越排越远了。

choices.english: I'll leave you to it. Bye.
choices.chinese: 那你忙，再见。

choices.english: You don't look keen on that message.
choices.chinese: 你看起来不太喜欢这条消息。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Pieter smiles at the mention of the food, then shakes his head at the phone.
beats.chinese: 提起吃的，Pieter笑了，随后又冲着手机摇摇头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: His chops are good. I'm still skipping this Saturday.
beats.chinese: 他的烤肉排是不错。这周六我还是不去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He types a reply declining this Saturday and asking his friend to keep inviting him. With a rather pleased grin, he pockets the phone and starts along the promenade.
beats.chinese: 他打字谢绝了这周六的聚会，也让朋友以后继续邀请自己。他颇为得意地一笑，收起手机，沿着长廊迈开步子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Home for me. Enjoy your stop.
beats.chinese: 好了，我回家了。你慢慢待会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Pieter lowers the phone without answering the message.
beats.chinese: Pieter放下手机，没有回复消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. That can wait ten minutes.
beats.chinese: 谢了。这事等十分钟也行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the phone inside the folded jacket and rests his free forearm on the railing, turning toward the water and the rocks below.
beats.chinese: 他把手机放回叠好的外套里，空着的那只小臂搭上栏杆，转身望向海水和下方的岸边岩石。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy the rest of your day.
beats.chinese: 祝你今天接下来过得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Pieter looks up from the screen as you say goodbye.
beats.chinese: 听见你道别，Pieter从屏幕前抬起头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. Nice meeting you.
beats.chinese: 再见。很高兴认识你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives a small wave and stays by the railing, the folded jacket held under his arm.
beats.chinese: 他轻轻挥手，把叠好的外套夹在臂下，留在栏杆旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy the rest of your day.
beats.chinese: 祝你今天接下来过得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Pieter lowers the phone and looks toward you.
beats.chinese: Pieter放低手机，看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This Saturday suits me. He's counted me in for the one after as well. That's a bit quick.
beats.chinese: 这周六我倒是愿意去。他连下一个周六也把我算进去了。这就排得有点快了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He types an acceptance for this Saturday and asks to be consulted about the next one. He sends it with a firm tap, smiles to himself and puts the phone away.
beats.chinese: 他打字答应了这周六的邀请，又让朋友下次先问过他。他用力点下发送，自己笑了一下，收起手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One braai agreed. That's enough arranging for me. Enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 答应一场烤肉聚会。安排到这里就够了。你慢慢看海。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Sea Point Promenade, Pieter is resting on the pedestrian side of the railing when he recognises you. His phone screen shows a message from a friend.
beats.chinese: 海角区海滨长廊上，Pieter仍在栏杆内侧的人行通道歇脚，这时认出了你。他的手机屏幕上停着朋友发来的消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I said I'd help with a braai. Just checking what he needs me to bring.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我答应帮一次烤肉聚会的忙。正在核对他需要我带什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He carefully types a short message asking which item his friend needs him to bring. His shoulders still look tired. After sending it, he looks up at you.
beats.chinese: 他认真输入一条短消息，只问朋友究竟需要他带哪样东西。他的肩膀仍显得疲惫。发送后，他抬头看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I said I'd help with this one, so I'll do it properly. Now I'm waiting for him to tell me what to bring.
beats.chinese: 答应帮忙的这次，我会办好。现在等他把要带的东西说清楚。

causality.presenceReason: Pieter在菲利皮花场下班后，自行来到海角区海滨长廊吹海风，准备短暂停留再回家。
causality.placeAttitude: 他愿意在海边歇一会儿，这次没有工作任务，也没有组织活动。下班后的疲劳不妨碍他友善地与附近的人闲聊。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须久留的义务。他只打算短暂停留，朋友的聚会消息也无需立即处理，可以回复或暂时放下。
causality.currentGoal: 初见时在栏杆旁休息，并自行决定是否接受朋友连续两个周六的烤肉聚会安排。重逢时，他已经答应帮一次烤肉聚会的忙，正在核对需要携带的具体物品。
causality.currentState: 初见时身体劳累，社交意愿尚可。看到朋友默认自己连续出席时略感不满，表达直接，仍保持随和。明确回复后，他会流露一点自得。重逢时疲劳仍在，他认真确认自己已答应的事项，没有得意地宣布自由。
causality.contactTrigger: 外套起初已叠好抱在胸前。手机振动后，他看见朋友把连续两个周六都算上自己，向附近的玩家直白感叹答应一次不代表以后都参加，随后说明是在说朋友的聚会安排，并介绍自己。接触不依赖衣物失控、占用玩家空间或误会后的道歉。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留Durbanville成长经历、Philippi花场遮阳网操作员身份、北郊朋友圈及原有兴趣。他喜欢烤肉聚会，也愿意履行亲口答应的事，但拒绝被默认成为每次出席的固定成员。初见保留其短句、直白表达、边界与略带得意的缺点。重逢呈现他对一次明确承诺的认真履行，不把守住选择权写成逃避责任。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家询问是否来休息时，a中他说明工作疲劳，继续谈朋友的安排。aa中他谢绝本周邀请，要求以后继续邀请，随后离开。ab中他暂缓回复，留在栏杆边看海并结束交谈。玩家礼貌表示不打扰时，b中他致谢并准备回复消息。ba中他友善接受道别，留在栏杆旁。bb中他解释自己愿意参加本周聚会，但不接受下一周被默认算上，随后发送回复并收起手机。重逢时他主动问候，说明自己正在核对已答应帮忙的聚会所需物品，只发送一条询问具体物品的短消息，随后抬头说明会办好这次承诺，等待朋友明确回复。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程使用海角区海滨长廊的栏杆内侧及人行通道。人物不因衣物问题让位，不进入岸边岩石区域，不阻挡通行，也不增加任何设施。aa只保留沿长廊开始离开的原有收尾，不转入新场景。重逢时他仍在栏杆内侧歇脚，查看和回复随身手机上的消息，没有转场。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Greenmarket Square, Mavis Dlamini stands beside a craft stall, clear of the walking route. They cross out a word in an open notebook, then look up at you.
beats.chinese: 在绿市广场，Mavis Dlamini站在工艺摊旁，没有挡住步行通路。他们划掉打开的笔记本上的一个词，随后抬头看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Would you mind listening to one sentence?
beats.chinese: 方便听我念一句吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mavis keeps the notebook close to their body, with a finger resting beside the sentence. They wait for your answer.
beats.chinese: Mavis把笔记本拿在身前，一根手指停在那句话旁边，等你回答。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You don't need to decide anything for me. I just want to hear how it sounds out loud.
beats.chinese: 不用替我拿主意。我只想听听它说出来是什么样。

choices.english: Sure. Go ahead.
choices.chinese: 可以，你念吧。

choices.english: No thanks. I'm just looking at the crafts.
choices.chinese: 不用了，谢谢。我就是看看工艺品。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mavis looks down at the notebook. They pause, then read the sentence aloud.
beats.chinese: Mavis低头看着笔记本，停了一下，随后把那句话念了出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've decided to stop attending the community map group's meetings. Best wishes.
beats.chinese: 我决定不再参加社区绘图小组的例会。祝好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They cross out two words near the bottom of the page.
beats.chinese: 他们划掉了页面靠下的两个词。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I only came to look at colours. I helped start that group. Now I've spent ten minutes deciding whether 'best wishes' sounds too final.
beats.chinese: 我本来只是来看颜色的。当初我也参与发起了那个小组。现在却花了十分钟，琢磨写“祝好”会不会太像告别。

choices.english: What made you start the map?
choices.chinese: 你们当初为什么开始画地图？

choices.english: I'll leave you to finish your note. Bye.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你写了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mavis closes the notebook and puts it in their bag. They leave enough room beside the stall for other customers.
beats.chinese: Mavis合上笔记本，收进包里，在摊位旁给其他顾客留出足够的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I'm here for the colours. I painted belt edges for forty-odd years. Brown got quite enough of me.
beats.chinese: 当然。我是来看颜色的。我给皮带涂边涂了四十多年。棕色见我已经见得够多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They glance towards the crafts, then check that the notebook is fully inside the bag.
beats.chinese: 他们朝工艺品看了一眼，又确认笔记本已经完全放进包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Salt River workshop. I'm retired now, apart from the odd private commission.
beats.chinese: 以前在盐河区的一间作坊干。现在退休了，偶尔接点私人委托。

choices.english: Do you miss the workshop?
choices.chinese: 你会想念那间作坊吗？

choices.english: I'll leave you to the colours, then. Bye.
choices.chinese: 那就不打扰你看颜色了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mavis stops looking at the unfinished message and turns the notebook over in their hands.
beats.chinese: Mavis不再盯着那段没写完的留言，把笔记本在手里翻了个面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A lane was missing from a printed map. We knew people who used it every day. So we started checking the small routes.
beats.chinese: 一张印出来的地图漏了一条小巷。我们认识的人每天都走那里。于是我们开始核对那些小路。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They put the notebook away and move a few paces along the stalls, keeping clear of passing customers.
beats.chinese: 他们收好笔记本，沿着摊位走开几步，避让经过的顾客。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I liked that part. The meetings got longer. Right, I'm going to do the looking I came for. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 那部分我很喜欢。后来会议越来越长。好了，我要看看原本想看的东西了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mavis nods and turns slightly towards the stall, keeping the notebook close to their body.
beats.chinese: Mavis点点头，稍稍转向摊位，把笔记本拿在身前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. I can spend another five minutes removing three words.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我还可以再花五分钟，删掉三个词。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They write one short sentence, then hold the pencil above the blank closing. The walking route stays clear.
beats.chinese: 他们写下一句短话，又把铅笔悬在空着的落款上方，没有占用步行通路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll manage this bit. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 这点我自己来就行。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mavis rests a hand over the closed bag. They take a moment to answer.
beats.chinese: Mavis把手搭在合好的包上，想了一会儿才回答。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Some of the people. The smell, less often. A small order now and then gives me enough of the work.
beats.chinese: 会想念其中一些人。那股气味就没那么想了。偶尔接个小单，已经够我过手瘾。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They adjust their scarf and turn their attention back to the crafts, without opening the bag.
beats.chinese: 他们理了理围巾，把注意力转回工艺品上，没有打开包。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's enough workshop talk for my day off. Enjoy your look round.
beats.chinese: 休息日里，作坊的事就聊到这里吧。慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mavis gives a small nod, leaving the space beside them open.
beats.chinese: Mavis轻轻点头，身旁的位置依然空着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. Enjoy your look round.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their hand goes towards the notebook in their bag, then stops. They turn back to the stall with both hands free.
beats.chinese: 他们伸手想拿包里的笔记本，又停住了，空着双手转回摊位前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The note can wait until I'm home. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 留言可以回家再写。再见。

reunion.titleZh: 在答案这一页多待一会儿

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Greenmarket Square, Mavis stands beside a craft stall, clear of the walking route. They are reading an answer explanation in a geography quiz on their phone when they look up and recognise you.
beats.chinese: 在绿市广场，Mavis站在工艺摊旁，没有挡住步行通路。他们正在手机上看地理问答的答案说明，抬头时认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. No rush to the next question today. The distances in this explanation are more interesting than the question.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天不赶下一题了。这一题后面讲的距离，比题目有意思。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Mavis keeps the phone in hand and reads the explanation to the end, occasionally glancing at the colours on the stall. They leave the quiz on their own screen without asking you to answer anything.
beats.chinese: Mavis仍拿着手机，认真读完说明，偶尔抬眼看看摊上的颜色。他们自己看着屏幕，没有请你答题。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got the points already. I'd quite like to stay on this page a little longer.
beats.chinese: 分数已经拿到了，我倒想在这一页多待一会儿。

causality.presenceReason: Mavis原本来绿市广场看工艺品的颜色，却随身带着笔记本，开始起草不再参加社区绘图小组例会的留言。
causality.placeAttitude: 把逛摊当作退休后的私人消遣，无须购买，也不在现场揽活。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须留下的安排。从一开始就站在工艺摊旁，不挡步行通路，也为其他顾客留出空间。
causality.currentGoal: 想看工艺品，却忍不住反复修改退出留言。只想征求一次有限的倾听，听听一句话念出来的效果，不请玩家替自己决定去留。
causality.currentState: 语速从容，愿意主动提出具体而有限的请求，对退出决定的表达仍会来回推敲。能够礼貌接受玩家拒绝倾听，不需要陌生人劝解。重逢时被地理问答答案说明中的距离细节吸引，已经得到分数，仍愿意留在这一页细读，心情满足而有兴味。
causality.contactTrigger: 初遇时，Mavis在笔记本上划掉一个词后，主动问玩家是否方便听一句，并说明不用替自己拿主意。玩家同意后才念出退出例会的简短留言，随后承认本来只是来看颜色。重逢时，Mavis从手机上的地理问答答案说明中抬头认出玩家，问候后随口分享自己对说明中距离细节的兴趣，不要求玩家答题。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留盐河区皮带涂边技师经历、偶接私单、干冷幽默和反复推敲退出决定的缺点。退出决定不交由玩家裁决，未邀请玩家修改文字。谈及作坊后会礼貌结束工作话题。重逢保留地理问答兴趣、关注地方细节的习惯和从容语气，不再以按错答案、自嘲或退出游戏推进。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家同意倾听后，Mavis念出留言，仍继续删改措辞。aa谈到绘图起因后收本，沿摊位走开。ab接受告别，留下继续修改未完成的留言。玩家拒绝倾听后，Mavis礼貌收起本子，简谈看颜色与过去的工作。ba简答对作坊的想念，明确结束工作话题并转回看工艺品。bb互相告别，Mavis忍住拿本子的动作，把留言留到回家。重逢时，Mavis问候后继续拿着手机读完说明，偶尔看看摊上的颜色，最后表示已经拿到分数，仍想在这一页多待一会儿。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程使用广场工艺摊旁与步行通路，初始接触不涉及占道或让路补救。仅出现随身笔记本、铅笔、包和重逢时的手机，没有新增设施。重逢时Mavis留在摊旁、不挡通路，手机始终拿在手中。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Mavis Dlamini。本次重逢位于绿市广场，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Greenmarket Square, Sizwe Mahlangu stands clear of a craft stall's customers. He came with his cousin, who is browsing the stalls. While he waits, he listens to a teammate's voice message with his phone held to his ear.
beats.chinese: 在绿市广场，Sizwe Mahlangu站在工艺摊顾客通行范围之外。他和表亲一起来，对方正在逛摊位。他等着，举着手机贴在耳边听队友的语音消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He gave THREE penalties?
beats.chinese: 他判了三个点球？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His voice carries across the walkway. He lowers the phone, notices you nearby, and gives an apologetic smile.
beats.chinese: 他的声音传过步行通路。他放下手机，注意到附近的你，歉意地笑了笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry, that was for my phone. Football message. I'm Sizwe.
beats.chinese: 抱歉，我是在对着手机说话。足球的消息。我叫Sizwe。

choices.english: That sounded serious. What happened?
choices.chinese: 听起来挺严重。怎么了？

choices.english: Could you keep it a little quieter, please?
choices.chinese: 能请你稍微小声一点吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sizwe pauses the message and turns toward you, keeping his position outside the flow of customers.
beats.chinese: Sizwe暂停语音，转向你，仍站在不妨碍顾客通行的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My teammate's match report. Apparently the referee ruined his entire weekend.
beats.chinese: 我队友的赛后报告。听他的意思，裁判把他整个周末都毁了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He raises three fingers, briefly grinning, then lowers his hand.
beats.chinese: 他举起三根手指，咧嘴笑了一下，又把手放下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I didn't see the game, so I'm keeping my verdict to myself. He'll want one anyway.
beats.chinese: 我没看那场比赛，所以先不下结论。不过他肯定还是想让我表态。

choices.english: Three penalties could be fair. Maybe the players were careless.
choices.chinese: 三个点球也可能判得对。也许是球员踢得太冒失了。

choices.english: What do you do when you're not following football?
choices.chinese: 不关注足球的时候，你都做些什么？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sizwe immediately leans back a little and lowers his voice almost to a whisper.
beats.chinese: Sizwe立刻微微往后靠，把声音压得几乎成了耳语。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, sorry. I got carried away.
beats.chinese: 当然，抱歉。我一激动就这样了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stops the recording and slips the phone into his pocket.
beats.chinese: 他关掉语音，把手机放进口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've gone a bit too quiet now. I'll save the rest of that message for later.
beats.chinese: 这下好像又太轻了。剩下的消息我待会儿再听。

choices.english: A normal speaking voice is fine. You sounded excited.
choices.chinese: 正常说话的音量就行。听得出你挺激动的。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll leave you to it.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。那就不打扰你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sizwe nods eagerly at your suggestion that the penalties might have been fair.
beats.chinese: 听你说那些点球也许判得没错，Sizwe连连点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Could be! Three penalties and suddenly nobody remembers where they put their feet!
beats.chinese: 有可能！三个点球下来，谁都不记得自己的脚往哪儿放了！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His voice rises again. He catches himself, gives a small apologetic wave, and lifts the phone back to his ear.
beats.chinese: 他的声音又扬了起来。他自己反应过来，歉意地摆摆手，把手机重新贴到耳边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There I go again. I'll hear the evidence before I join the shouting. Enjoy the square.
beats.chinese: 瞧，我又来了。先听听证据，再加入他们的争论。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sizwe pockets his phone and rubs his fingertips together as he answers.
beats.chinese: Sizwe把手机收进口袋，回答时搓了搓指尖。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I work at a custom sports-guard workshop. Padding and mouthguard fittings. Nervous kids are usually fine once you let them take their time.
beats.chinese: 我在一家定制运动护具作坊工作，做衬垫，也帮人试戴牙套。紧张的小孩通常只要能慢慢来，就没事了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His phone vibrates. He checks a message from his cousin and turns slightly toward the craft stalls.
beats.chinese: 手机振动了一下。他看了眼表亲发来的消息，稍稍转向工艺摊位。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Outside work, I fiddle with bicycles. Much less polite than the kids when something won't fit. My cousin's ready, so I'd better go. Cheers.
beats.chinese: 下了班我就摆弄自行车。零件装不上的时候，我可没那些孩子客气。表亲准备走了，我也该过去了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sizwe straightens and tries a more ordinary speaking volume.
beats.chinese: Sizwe站直了些，试着恢复正常的说话音量。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Football does that to me. I can make a scoreless draw sound like an emergency.
beats.chinese: 一说足球我就这样。一场零比零的平局，我也能说得像出了紧急事故。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He laughs briefly, then folds his arms loosely and turns his attention back toward the stalls where his cousin is browsing.
beats.chinese: 他短促地笑了一声，松松地抱起双臂，把注意力转回表亲正在逛的摊位方向。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll spare you the full broadcast. Have a good look around.
beats.chinese: 就不给你来一场全程转播了。你慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sizwe gives you a brief nod and makes no attempt to keep the conversation going.
beats.chinese: Sizwe向你轻轻点头，没有继续攀谈。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. Take care.
beats.chinese: 当然。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As customers approach the craft stall, he takes a small step farther from its edge, leaving the passage open for you and them.
beats.chinese: 有顾客走近工艺摊，他又往旁边挪了一小步，给你和其他人留出通路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry about the sudden football commentary.
beats.chinese: 刚才突然来那么一段足球解说，不好意思。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Greenmarket Square, Sizwe Mahlangu recognises you beside the craft stalls and calls out happily. Another shopper briefly looks round at his voice.
beats.chinese: 在绿市广场，Sizwe Mahlangu在工艺摊旁认出你，高高兴兴地喊了声招呼。另一位顾客听到他的声音，回头看了一眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again! Got the bicycle quiet at last. Rode all the way here without that clicking.
beats.chinese: 又见面了！自行车终于不响了。一路骑过来，没再咔嗒咔嗒。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He grins, unaware of the glance, and pats the bicycle clips tucked into his pocket.
beats.chinese: 他咧嘴笑着，没留意那一眼，拍了拍口袋里的骑行裤脚夹。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Lovely ride. Now I've come for a look round. Enjoy yours!
beats.chinese: 骑得真舒服。现在来逛逛。你也逛得开心！

causality.presenceReason: Sizwe陪表亲来绿市广场，表亲逛工艺摊时，他站在通道之外等候并听队友语音。
causality.placeAttitude: 他自在地把广场当作陪人逛摊的日常去处，没有充当向导的打算。
causality.stayingConstraint: 他在等表亲结束浏览，因此暂时留在摊位附近，同时给顾客让路。
causality.currentGoal: 等表亲并听完队友对一场足球赛的抱怨，不急着对没看过的比赛表态。
causality.currentState: 当下被足球消息带得兴奋，音量失控，但愿意接受提醒。
causality.contactTrigger: 他听语音时大声惊叹，发现玩家就在附近后主动致歉并自我介绍。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留运动护具作坊、足球、修车、热情直率和音量失准。初遇被提醒会骤然变轻。重逢因车修好了高兴，大声招呼引起一眼却未察觉，不把缺点写成已自动治好。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa欢迎不同看法，音量再升高后收住，继续听消息。ab谈工作和修车，收到表亲消息后告别。ba自嘲音量后继续等人。bb接受玩家离开并让路。重逢高兴谈自行车消除异响，仍大声招呼而没留意其他顾客回头，保留音量缺点。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Greenmarket Square, Eunice Fourie stands beside a craft stall with her knitting bag at her side. She came to choose a friend's present, then offered to watch the goods while the seller fetched a box.
beats.chinese: 在绿市广场，Eunice Fourie提着编织袋站在工艺摊旁。她本来是来给朋友挑礼物，却主动答应在摊主去拿盒子时照看一下东西。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If you're looking for the seller, she's fetching packaging. I'm a customer too.
beats.chinese: 如果你在找摊主，她去拿包装了。我也是顾客。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She spots the seller farther along the stalls, now answering another shopper, and looks at the time.
beats.chinese: 她看见摊主在前面的摊位间又跟另一位顾客说起话，便看看时间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Two minutes, I said. I should have kept the offer to myself.
beats.chinese: 我说，就帮两分钟。刚才真该把话留在心里。

choices.english: Do you work here?
choices.chinese: 你在这里工作吗？

choices.english: I'll just look while she gets back.
choices.chinese: 那我先看看，等她回来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Eunice shakes her head, still keeping an eye on the seller.
beats.chinese: Eunice摇摇头，目光仍留意着摊主。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. I replace golf-club grips. A little work this afternoon. This was meant to be present shopping.
beats.chinese: 不，我做高尔夫球杆握把更换。下午还有一点活。本来是来买礼物的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She shifts her knitting bag to her other hand. The gifts on the stall remain untouched.
beats.chinese: 她把编织袋换到另一只手，摊上的礼物一样也没动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She needed a box. I offered two minutes before she asked anyone. Now I haven't chosen a thing.
beats.chinese: 她需要个盒子。还没问别人，我就先答应帮两分钟。结果自己一样都没挑。

choices.english: Could you choose your present while you wait?
choices.chinese: 等的时候，能先挑自己的礼物吗？

choices.english: What kind of present are you looking for?
choices.chinese: 你在找什么样的礼物？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Eunice gives you room to browse from the public passage. She stays beside the stall.
beats.chinese: Eunice给你留出从公共通道看货的位置，自己仍守在摊旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. She'll deal with the prices. I'm only standing here.
beats.chinese: 当然。价钱等她回来问。我只是站在这里。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The seller lifts a finger to signal one more moment. Eunice returns a small nod, her mouth tightening.
beats.chinese: 摊主举起一根手指，示意再等一会儿。Eunice轻轻点头，嘴角绷紧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I have rather successfully delayed my own shopping.
beats.chinese: 我倒是很成功地耽误了自己的购物。

choices.english: Who asked you to watch the stall?
choices.chinese: 谁请你看摊的？

choices.english: I'll leave you to it. Take care.
choices.chinese: 那不打扰了。保重。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Eunice looks at a small carved bird, then back at the seller, who is still speaking to the other shopper.
beats.chinese: Eunice看看一只雕刻小鸟，又望向还在和另一位顾客说话的摊主。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I keep looking up every time someone comes near the goods. Haven't even asked the bird's price yet.
beats.chinese: 每有人靠近货品，我就抬头看。连那只鸟的价钱都还没问。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The seller returns with the box and thanks her. Eunice acknowledges the handover, then turns back to the bird.
beats.chinese: 摊主拿着盒子回来道谢。Eunice确认交接完，才转回去看小鸟。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Now, how much is that bird? I'll let you look.
beats.chinese: 好了。现在，那只鸟多少钱？你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Eunice points to the carved bird without lifting it from the display.
beats.chinese: Eunice指指雕刻小鸟，没有从陈列上拿起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Something for a friend's shelf. I've knitted the socks already. A bird would fit in the parcel with them.
beats.chinese: 给朋友架子上摆的小东西。袜子已经织好了。小鸟可以和袜子一起装进包裹。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The seller returns and sets the packaging beside her own goods. Eunice lets her know the stall is back in her care before asking about the bird.
beats.chinese: 摊主回来，把包装放在自己的货品旁。Eunice说明已经交还照看，才问起小鸟。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd like a closer look at that one, please. Enjoy the rest of your visit.
beats.chinese: 麻烦让我近看看那只。你慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Eunice pauses, then answers without softening the fact.
beats.chinese: Eunice停了一下，直截了当地回答。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nobody. I saw her looking for a box and offered. Very efficient of me.
beats.chinese: 没人。看她在找盒子，我就主动说了。我可真会办事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the time again, then stays where she promised to wait. The seller is still a few stalls away.
beats.chinese: 她又看一眼时间，仍留在答应守着的位置。摊主还在隔着几个摊位的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll finish what I agreed to. Then I'll do what I came for. Take care.
beats.chinese: 答应的先做完。然后再办自己来的事。保重。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you say goodbye, Eunice gives a small nod and settles her bag against her leg.
beats.chinese: 你告别时，Eunice轻轻点头，把袋子靠在腿边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care. I shall still be here for a moment.
beats.chinese: 保重。我还得在这里待一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks towards the seller, lifts her hand to be seen and waits for a wave back. She does not take on the next shopper's question about a price.
beats.chinese: 她朝摊主举手示意，等对方挥手回应。下一位顾客来问价格时，她没有再把事揽下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The seller will tell you when she gets back. I'm waiting for her too.
beats.chinese: 摊主回来会告诉你的。我也在等她。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Greenmarket Square, Eunice stands beside a craft stall, folding her shopping list. She recognises you and gives a small nod.
beats.chinese: 在绿市广场，尤妮斯正站在工艺摊旁，折起购物清单。她认出了你，轻轻点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good day. Nice to see you again. I have bought everything on my list.
beats.chinese: 你好。很高兴又见到你。今天清单上要买的东西都买齐了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She glances towards the neighbouring stalls, then finishes folding the list and puts it in her pocket without opening it again.
beats.chinese: 她看了一眼相邻的摊棚，随后把清单折好，收进口袋，没有再展开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That is this task finished, then. I have golf-club grips to replace this afternoon.
beats.chinese: 这一件事到这里就算结束。下午还有球杆握把要换。

causality.presenceReason: Eunice到绿市广场为朋友挑礼物，看到摊主找包装盒，未经请求主动答应临时看摊。
causality.placeAttitude: 她愿意逛工艺摊，本想完成自己的礼物采购，当前却因自己提出的帮助留在摊边。
causality.stayingConstraint: 她已答应照看到摊主回来，下午还有更换球杆握把的工作，因此对等待渐生怨气。
causality.currentGoal: 等摊主回来完成交接，再挑朋友的礼物，不代卖、不回答价格。

causality.contactTrigger: 她向附近玩家说明摊主去拿包装，自己同样是顾客。不预设玩家要买或帮她看摊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Greenmarket Square, Sipho Dlamini is examining a new shopping bag brought from home beside a craft stall. His folded errand list is tucked inside. He keeps clear of the walking route as he looks up at you.
beats.chinese: 在绿市广场，Sipho Dlamini正在工艺摊旁研究从家里带来的新购物袋，折好的办事清单放在袋内。他没有占着步行通道，抬头看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Do you think a pocket inside the bag is handy?
beats.chinese: 这种口袋放在袋子里面，你觉得算方便吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the bag so its inner pocket is visible, keeping it in his own hands and close to his body.
beats.chinese: 他翻开袋口，让里面的口袋露出来，袋子始终拿在自己手中，收在身前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Sipho. I like the cloth. The pocket placement, though...
beats.chinese: 我叫Sipho。布料我很喜欢，口袋的位置嘛……

choices.english: It could be handy. What did the pockets do wrong?
choices.chinese: 可能挺方便的。那些口袋犯什么错了？

choices.english: I'm not sure. I'll give you some room.
choices.chinese: 我也说不好。我给你让点地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sipho takes his folded list out of the bag and stays beside the stall, leaving the walking route clear. He holds the bag open and peers into its smallest pocket.
beats.chinese: Sipho从袋里取出折好的清单，留在摊旁，没有占着通道。他撑开袋子，往最小的口袋里看。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This pocket belongs on the other side. Forty years buying bookbinding cloth, and I welcomed every new weave. Apparently a pocket is a much more serious matter.
beats.chinese: 这个口袋就该缝在另一边。我采购了四十年的装订布，每种新织法都欢迎。看来口袋的位置可要严肃得多。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He laughs, then turns the bag around. His hand immediately reaches towards the side where he expects the pocket to be.
beats.chinese: 他笑了，又把袋子转了个方向。手却立刻伸向自己习惯中该有口袋的那一边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. My hand has already lodged another complaint.
beats.chinese: 瞧，我这只手又提意见了。

choices.english: So new cloth gets a welcome, but a new pocket needs permission?
choices.chinese: 所以新布料可以直接受欢迎，新口袋还得先获批准？

choices.english: You could try keeping the list in the larger pocket.
choices.chinese: 你可以试着把清单放进大一点的口袋。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: With the space you give him, Sipho opens the bag wider and takes out his folded list to inspect the pocket underneath. He stays clear of the passing foot traffic.
beats.chinese: 你让出地方后，Sipho把袋口撑得更开，取出折好的清单，查看下面的口袋。他始终避开来往的人流。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. I'll have another look.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我再看看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds the paper once more, then looks from the craft stall to the inside of his own bag.
beats.chinese: 他把纸又折了一下，目光从工艺摊移到自己的袋子里面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came to look at handmade things. Somehow I've ended up inspecting my own bag.
beats.chinese: 我是来看手工制品的。不知怎么，倒检查起自己的袋子来了。

choices.english: A very exclusive stall. Only one bag.
choices.chinese: 真是家独特的摊位。只展出一个袋子。

choices.english: I'll leave you to it. Goodbye.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sipho holds up one finger as if about to object, then laughs and lowers it.
beats.chinese: Sipho竖起一根手指，像要反驳，随后笑着把手放下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Written permission. Two copies, both signed by me.
beats.chinese: 还得是书面批准。一式两份，都由我签字。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pushes the list fully into the unfamiliar pocket and pats it twice. Then he turns his attention back to the craft stall.
beats.chinese: 他把清单完全塞进那个不熟悉的口袋，拍了两下，随后转回去看工艺摊。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It can have a trial. You've caught me being unreasonable quite early in the acquaintance. Enjoy the square.
beats.chinese: 先让它试用一下吧。才刚认识，就让你逮到我不讲理了。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sipho starts answering before your suggestion is finished. His fingers close around the list.
beats.chinese: 你的建议还没说完，Sipho就开口了，手指也攥住了清单。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, yes, I've got it. I'll just—
beats.chinese: 好，好，我知道了。我就——

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stops, opens his hand and gives a small apologetic nod. He keeps the paper in his hand rather than trying either pocket.
beats.chinese: 他停下来，松开手，略带歉意地点了点头。他没有试哪个口袋，而是把纸拿在手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry, you hadn't finished. I'll carry it for now. Thank you for the suggestion. Enjoy your visit.
beats.chinese: 抱歉，你还没说完呢。我暂时拿着吧。谢谢你的建议，祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sipho spreads the bag between his hands as though displaying its entire range.
beats.chinese: Sipho用双手撑开袋子，仿佛正在展示摊位的全部款式。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And one very difficult customer. He keeps asking for last year's pockets.
beats.chinese: 还有一位特别难伺候的顾客。他非要去年的口袋不可。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He chuckles, folds the bag under his arm and keeps the list in his hand. He turns towards the open walking route.
beats.chinese: 他笑着把袋子折好夹在腋下，清单仍拿在手里，转向畅通的步行通路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, this stall is closing before he complains again. Enjoy yourself.
beats.chinese: 好了，趁他还没继续投诉，这家摊位先收摊了。祝你逛得开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sipho lowers the bag and gives you room to pass. He makes no attempt to prolong the conversation.
beats.chinese: Sipho放下袋子，给你留出经过的空间，没有继续拉住话头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. Thank you for making room.
beats.chinese: 好的。谢谢你刚才让开地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He secures the folded list deep inside the bag and stays beside the stall, out of the walking route.
beats.chinese: 他把折好的清单放稳在袋子深处，留在摊旁，没有占用通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Goodbye. Have a pleasant day.
beats.chinese: 再见。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Greenmarket Square, Sipho recognises you beside a craft stall. Two customers are looking closely at the goods, and he waits behind them without crowding.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到绿市广场时，Sipho在工艺摊旁认出了你。两位顾客正在仔细看商品，他在后面等着，没有往前挤。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I'm trying to see that stall without breathing down anyone's neck.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我想看看那个摊，又不想紧贴在人家背后。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: When one customer moves on, he shifts into the open space beside the stall, keeping the walking route clear.
beats.chinese: 一位顾客离开后，他移到摊旁空出来的位置，仍给步行通道留着空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There we are. No elbows required. Good to see you.
beats.chinese: 这就好了，也不用拿胳膊肘开路。见到你真好。

causality.presenceReason: Sipho带着家中的新购物袋到绿市广场逛工艺摊，享受观察手工作品的乐趣，袋内另放着之后办事用的清单。
causality.placeAttitude: 他乐于闲逛和接触新材料，对广场没有工作义务，也不把摊位当成自己的课堂。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须久留的任务。研究袋子和交谈时都在摊旁为顾客与行人留出通道，袋子与清单由他自己保管。
causality.currentGoal: 弄清新购物袋内侧口袋是否顺手，决定如何放置清单，然后继续自己的行程。
causality.currentState: 心情轻松，有主动搭话的兴致，喜欢新袋子的布料，却因口袋位置不合习惯而有些别扭。他只向陌生人征询一个有限的使用意见。
causality.contactTrigger: 他在摊旁研究自己的新购物袋，主动问玩家内侧口袋是否方便，翻开袋口供对方看清，不递出袋子、不挡通道，也没有物品掉落或要求玩家帮忙。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留退休装订布采购员身份、欢迎新材料却固守旧习惯的矛盾、热情自嘲的口吻，以及自认懂了便抢话的缺点。不改变其开普敦与Woodstock的成长和居住经历。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家愿意谈口袋时，他取出清单并解释自己的不满。aa中接受调侃并试用陌生口袋，回头看摊。ab中抢先打断建议，随后道歉，仍选择手拿清单。玩家表示说不好并让出空间时，他自行继续查看。ba中接住玩家的摊位笑话，折袋准备走动。bb中礼貌结束交流，留在原处收好清单。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程限于绿市广场遮阳工艺摊旁与可见步行通路，不增加座椅、柜台或其他设施，不占用人流空间。清单始终在他自己的袋中或手中，没有落地，也不由玩家接取。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Outside Afflecks on Church Street, Wilf Hartley stands beside the red-brick frontage, clear of the entrance. He holds a paper bag of old dance magazines close against his red utility vest as he finishes reading a message from his sister.
beats.chinese: 在 Church Street 的 Afflecks 红砖外墙旁，Wilf Hartley 站在不挡入口的位置。他把一纸袋旧舞蹈杂志贴着红色工装背心拿好，刚看完妹妹发来的消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm a bit annoyed now.
beats.chinese: 我现在有点生气。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers his phone, notices you nearby and addresses you, keeping the bag against his vest.
beats.chinese: 他放低手机，注意到附近的你，便朝你开口，纸袋仍贴身拿着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Not with you. Waiting for my sister. She said she'd take a few. I've brought twelve.
beats.chinese: 不是冲你。在等我妹妹。她说拿几本。我带了十二本。

choices.english: Are those all dance magazines?
choices.chinese: 那些全是舞蹈杂志吗？

choices.english: All right. I'll stand here, out of the entrance.
choices.chinese: 好。我就在这儿站一会儿，不挡入口。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wilf tips the open bag towards you without taking anything out. Several covers show dancers and close views of shoes.
beats.chinese: Wilf 把敞开的袋口稍稍朝向你，没有往外拿东西。几本封面上印着舞者和鞋子的特写。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Every one. I repair dance shoes off Swan Street. These come home with me, then I start cutting bits out.
beats.chinese: 全是。我在 Swan Street 旁边修舞鞋。这些被我带回家，然后我就开始剪里面的图片。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He draws one magazine halfway out. A strip of paper marks a spread near the middle.
beats.chinese: 他把一本杂志抽出一半。中间附近夹着一条纸，标着其中一个跨页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Faces and shoes, mostly. My sister wants something left to read. She's made that quite clear.
beats.chinese: 主要剪脸和鞋。我妹妹希望剩下的还能读。她已经说得很清楚了。

choices.english: Could I see the page you've marked?
choices.chinese: 我能看看你标出来的那页吗？

choices.english: I'll leave you to it. I'm too tired for much today.
choices.chinese: 不打扰你了。我今天太累，没力气做太多事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wilf settles the bag against his own leg, keeping the space beside you clear. He glances towards the Afflecks entrance.
beats.chinese: Wilf 把袋子贴着自己的腿放好，空出你身旁的位置。他朝 Afflecks 入口看了一眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Plenty of room. She's inside. Told me to bring a few magazines, then went in before I got here.
beats.chinese: 地方够。她在里面。叫我带几本杂志来，结果我还没到，她就先进去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He adjusts the paper handles, then looks down at the weight pulling on them.
beats.chinese: 他调整了一下纸提手，低头看着被杂志分量绷紧的提手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm annoyed with her. It'll pass. Twelve was my decision.
beats.chinese: 我正生她的气。过会儿就好了。带十二本是我自己决定的。

choices.english: Couldn't you take them home? I'll stay here a moment.
choices.chinese: 不能把它们带回家吗？我会在这儿待一会儿。

choices.english: I'll give you some room. Goodbye.
choices.chinese: 我给你腾点地方。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wilf opens the magazine to the marked spread and holds it between you. One photograph shows a dancer's raised heel.
beats.chinese: Wilf 把杂志翻到标记的跨页，举在你们之间。一张照片里，舞者正抬起脚跟。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That heel there. I've repaired shoes like that for nearly forty years. Still look at the feet before the face.
beats.chinese: 就是那个鞋跟。这样的鞋，我修了快四十年。看照片还是先看脚，再看脸。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: After holding the spread steady for a few seconds, he closes it and slides it back into the bag.
beats.chinese: 他稳稳举着杂志让你看了几秒，然后合上，放回袋中。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That page can stay whole. She'll want the article on the back. Cheers.
beats.chinese: 那页可以留完整。她会想读背面的文章。谢啦。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the mention of being tired, Wilf pushes the magazine back into the bag and turns fully towards you.
beats.chinese: 听到你说累，Wilf 把杂志塞回袋子，整个身子转向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm arranging a dance evening at a local hall. Twenty minutes would do. Keep your own shoes on, watch if you like.
beats.chinese: 我正在附近一个礼堂筹办舞会。去二十分钟也行。穿自己的鞋，想看就看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He draws breath to add something, then closes his mouth and turns the bag back against his vest. He makes no move to detain you.
beats.chinese: 他吸了口气，还想补充，随后又闭上嘴，把袋子转回背心前。他没有做出任何挽留你的动作。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You said you were going. I heard you. Bye, then.
beats.chinese: 你说了要走。我听见了。那就再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wilf looks towards the entrance again. He lowers the bag to the ground against his shoe, away from the doorway.
beats.chinese: Wilf 又看了一眼入口。他把袋子放到地上，靠着自己的鞋，位置远离门口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Then she'd come out looking for me. We agreed outside Afflecks. I'll stay where I said.
beats.chinese: 那她出来就找不到我了。我们说好在 Afflecks 外面见。我就在说好的地方等。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He flexes the fingers that held the handles, then turns his attention back to the entrance, bringing the conversation to a close.
beats.chinese: 他活动了一下刚才攥着提手的手指，随后重新望向入口，结束了交谈。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hand's happier down here, anyway. Take care.
beats.chinese: 反正放下来，手也舒服些。保重。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you make room, Wilf draws the bag closer to his feet. He gives you a brief nod.
beats.chinese: 你往旁边让开，Wilf 也把袋子收得更靠近脚边。他向你简短地点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Mind yourself.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes a short, partly braided heel cord from his vest pocket. With the bag held against his leg, he crosses two strands between his fingers.
beats.chinese: 他从背心口袋里掏出一小段编到一半的鞋跟系绳，用腿抵住袋子，把两股绳在手指间交叉。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got three inches of this to finish. That'll keep my hands occupied.
beats.chinese: 这个还剩三英寸没编完。够让我的手忙一会儿了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Outside Afflecks on Church Street, Wilf Hartley recognises you beside the red-brick frontage. He has a small roll of dance-hall posters under his arm.
beats.chinese: 在Church Street的Afflecks红砖外墙旁，Wilf Hartley腋下夹着一小卷舞会海报，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Four people came last night. I'm cross about the other twelve. Anyway, the four danced for two hours.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。昨晚来了四个人。另十二个让我有点生气。总之，来的四个跳了两个小时。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rolls the posters a little tighter and looks along the street for his sister.
beats.chinese: 他把海报卷紧一点，沿街望望姐姐有没有来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One asked when we're doing it again. Good sign. I'll sort a date after I've stopped being cross. Take care.
beats.chinese: 一个还问下次什么时候办。这就不错。等我气消了再定日子。保重。

causality.presenceReason: Wilf 带着十二本旧舞蹈杂志来到 Afflecks 外，按约等妹妹出来接收。
causality.placeAttitude: 这里是明确的碰面地点。他因妹妹先进入楼内而对等待有些不满，对地点本身没有敌意。
causality.stayingConstraint: 双方约在楼外，他不愿擅自离开，让妹妹出来找不到人。
causality.currentGoal: 等妹妹接走部分杂志，同时保留自己想剪贴的图片。
causality.currentState: 他提着杂志，刚看完妹妹的消息，有些生气，直接说出情绪。袋子始终贴身拿好，他仍愿意向附近的人礼貌澄清并交谈。
causality.contactTrigger: Wilf 在红砖外墙旁看完妹妹的消息，平声说自己现在有点生气，注意到附近的玩家后主动说明不是冲玩家，继而解释自己正在等妹妹，以及她说拿几本、自己却带了十二本的情况。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留曼彻斯特舞鞋修理工、旧杂志剪贴、手编鞋绳、直报情绪的说话习惯，以及一听到疲倦就安排别人出门跳舞的毛病。他承认带十二本是自己的决定，也接受玩家离开的选择。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家询问杂志时，Wilf 介绍修舞鞋和剪贴的日常。aa 展开图片供短暂观看，再收起道别。ab 听到疲倦便擅自推荐舞会，但接受玩家已表明离开的决定。玩家选择在旁停留时，Wilf 解释等待与不满。ba 不采纳回家的建议，把袋子放下后继续等人并结束交谈。bb 接受告别，转而编完随身鞋绳。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Outside Afflecks on Church Street, Kit Draper waits beside the red-brick frontage, clear of the entrance. He came to return a borrowed timing light to his friend Dev. As you arrive, Kit raises a hand, then lowers it.
beats.chinese: Church Street 的 Afflecks 门外，Kit Draper 站在红砖外墙旁，没有挡住入口。他来把借用的计时灯还给朋友 Dev。你刚到，Kit 就抬起手，又放了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry. Thought you were Dev. He's also got a head. Easy mistake.
beats.chinese: 抱歉。把你当成 Dev 了。他也长着个脑袋。很容易认错。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lifts the small bag at his feet by its handles. A light with red tape around its base shows through the open top.
beats.chinese: 他拎起脚边的小袋子。袋口敞着，能看见一盏底座缠着红胶带的灯。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He's meeting me here for this. Apparently I'm early. I usually am.
beats.chinese: 他跟我约在这儿拿这个。看来是我到早了。我一般都早到。

choices.english: Have you been waiting long?
choices.chinese: 你等很久了吗？

choices.english: What's the light for?
choices.chinese: 这盏灯是做什么用的？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kit checks his phone. There are no new messages. He puts it away without typing.
beats.chinese: Kit 看了看手机。没有新消息。他一个字也没打，就收了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Twenty minutes. He said around four. I've been quite generous with around.
beats.chinese: 二十分钟。他说四点左右。我给这个“左右”留得挺宽。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He transfers the bag to his other hand and looks along Church Street.
beats.chinese: 他把袋子换到另一只手，朝 Church Street 望了望。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I kept the afternoon free. He mentioned getting some food as well. That bit hasn't come up again.
beats.chinese: 我把下午空出来了。他还提过一起吃点东西。后来就没再提。

choices.english: You could send him a quick reminder.
choices.chinese: 你可以发条消息提醒他。

choices.english: I'll leave you to look out for him.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你等他了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kit tilts the bag just enough to show the light, keeping its cable tucked inside.
beats.chinese: Kit 把袋子稍稍倾斜，让你看清那盏灯，电线仍收在袋子里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Open-mic night. I run the list, time the acts, set the room. This tells people their five minutes are up.
beats.chinese: 开放麦用的。我管报名名单、计时、布置场地。这灯告诉台上的人，五分钟到了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His phone vibrates. A message asks him to cover tonight's shift. He types a short reply, then dismisses a dance-class reminder.
beats.chinese: 他的手机振动了。有人发消息，请他今晚代班。他简短回复，然后划掉了一条舞蹈课提醒。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's tonight covered. Six dance classes since September. Excellent attendance, if you leave out most Thursdays.
beats.chinese: 今晚有人顶班了。九月以来上了六次舞蹈课。出勤率很好，只要不算大多数星期四。

choices.english: Couldn't you keep the class and say no?
choices.chinese: 不能拒绝代班，照常去上课吗？

choices.english: I'll leave you to it. Hope Dev turns up soon.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰了。希望 Dev 快点到。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kit takes his phone out again. His thumb hovers over Dev's name, then he locks the screen.
beats.chinese: Kit 又掏出手机。拇指停在 Dev 的名字上方，随后锁了屏。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Could do. He knows where I am.
beats.chinese: 是可以。他知道我在哪儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pockets the phone and moves a little farther along the brick frontage, giving the entrance more room. He turns back towards the street.
beats.chinese: 他收起手机，沿砖墙挪开一点，给入口多留出些空间，重新望向街上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll give him ten more minutes. I've said that twice now. Anyway, take care.
beats.chinese: 再等他十分钟。这话我已经说过两遍了。那，慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kit nods goodbye, then spots someone approaching along Church Street. This time he waits until the man waves first.
beats.chinese: Kit 点头道别，接着看见有人沿 Church Street 走来。这回他等对方先挥了手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's him. Confirmed by an actual wave.
beats.chinese: 是他。这回有挥手确认了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dev stops beside the frontage. Kit hands him the bag and releases the handles once Dev has a firm grip.
beats.chinese: Dev 在外墙旁停下。Kit 把袋子递过去，等 Dev 拿稳才松开提手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here you go, Dev. Cable's tucked underneath. Cheers, both.
beats.chinese: 给你，Dev。电线收在下面了。谢了，两位。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kit glances at the reply he has just sent. He doesn't reopen the message box.
beats.chinese: Kit 看了一眼刚发出的回复，没有重新打开输入框。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Before I replied, yes. I've said yes now.
beats.chinese: 回复之前可以。现在已经答应了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He steps aside along the frontage and calls the host, keeping the entrance clear. He gives you a small farewell nod before lifting the phone to his ear.
beats.chinese: 他沿外墙往旁边挪了挪，避开入口，拨通主持人的电话。把手机举到耳边前，他向你轻轻点头道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. It's Kit. I'm covering tonight. I'll handle the list and the room.
beats.chinese: 喂，我是 Kit。今晚我代班。名单和场地我来弄。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kit slips his phone away and closes the bag around the light.
beats.chinese: Kit 收好手机，把装灯的袋口合拢。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. Enjoy the rest of your day.
beats.chinese: 谢了。祝你今天过得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes a folded sheet of graph paper and a pencil from his jacket. Holding the paper against the closed bag, he studies a small box-kite drawing.
beats.chinese: 他从外套里拿出一张折好的方格纸和一支铅笔，把纸垫在合拢的袋子上，研究一幅小小的箱形风筝草图。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've got this to look at. No deadline on it. Keeping it that way.
beats.chinese: 我还有这个可以看看。没有截止日期。就让它一直没有吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Afflecks, you see Kit outside the Church Street entrance, clear of the doorway. He locks his phone, then recognises you.
beats.chinese: 在 Afflecks ，你看见 Kit 站在 Church Street 的入口外侧，没有挡住门口。他锁上手机屏幕，随后认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello. I've just agreed to cover a shift. Can't make folk dance today.
beats.chinese: 哦，你好。刚答应了一次代班。今天的民间舞课去不成了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the phone in his pocket and lets his hand drop to his side.
beats.chinese: 他把手机放进口袋，手垂回身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's a bit of a shame. I said yes, so I'll go.
beats.chinese: 有一点可惜。答应的还是得去。

causality.presenceReason: Kit 已答应在 Afflecks 门外把借来的开放麦计时灯还给 Dev，因此提前到场等候。
causality.placeAttitude: 这里是约定的交接点，他熟悉本地生活，但本次没有购物或带人游览的打算。
causality.stayingConstraint: Dev 尚未到场，灯也还没交出去。Kit 不愿轻易撤回已经答应的事。
causality.currentGoal: 把计时灯当面归还，并等 Dev 是否兑现顺便吃东西的提议。
causality.currentState: 今天略显无聊，待人客气，能用平淡的自嘲接话，同时持续留意街上。
causality.contactTrigger: Kit 把刚到的玩家错认成 Dev，挥手后主动道歉，接触不依赖玩家先提问或帮忙。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留开放麦助理工作、守诺而挤占自己时间的缺点、不给忘事朋友发提醒的习惯，以及民间舞课和慢慢研究祖父风筝草图的兴趣。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Outside Afflecks on Church Street, Rowan Ashby is checking a camera screen. They came to photograph the red-brick frontage and are standing clear of the entrance.
beats.chinese: 在 Church Street 的 Afflecks 门外，Rowan Ashby 正查看相机屏幕。他们特意来拍红砖外立面，站的位置没有挡住入口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Excuse me. I'm photographing the building. Would you mind being at the edge of the picture? I can wait.
beats.chinese: 打扰一下。我在拍这栋建筑。您介意出现在照片边缘吗？我可以等一等。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan lowers the camera completely, leaving the decision open.
beats.chinese: Rowan 把相机完全放下，等你决定。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Rowan Ashby, by the way. There is no hurry.
beats.chinese: 对了，我叫 Rowan Ashby。不着急。

choices.english: I'll move out of the frame. What caught your eye?
choices.chinese: 我让开镜头吧。什么吸引了你的注意？

choices.english: Please wait. I'd rather not be in a photograph.
choices.chinese: 请等一等。我不太想入镜。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Once you have moved clear, Rowan angles the camera towards the red-brick frontage and checks the screen again.
beats.chinese: 你让开后，Rowan 将相机朝向红砖外立面，又检查了一次屏幕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The brickwork. I thought I had the whole front in. No, I've cut off the top. Oh, please excuse me.
beats.chinese: 是这些砖墙。我以为整个正面都拍进去了。没有，顶上截掉了。噢，请稍等一下。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their phone rings. Rowan lowers the camera and answers. Their expression barely changes as they listen.
beats.chinese: 手机响了。Rowan 放下相机接听，听电话时表情几乎没有变化。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I understand you'd like another chance, Ellis. We settled that. I won't go over it again. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 我明白你想再有一次机会，Ellis。那件事已经说定了。我不会再谈一遍。再见。

choices.english: Would you hear them out another day?
choices.chinese: 换一天，你会愿意听对方说完吗？

choices.english: I'll leave you to your photograph.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你拍照了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan keeps the camera pointed down. They do not take a photograph.
beats.chinese: Rowan 让镜头朝下，没有拍照。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Certainly. I haven't taken anything.
beats.chinese: 当然。我还一张都没拍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They put the lens cap on and let the camera rest against its strap.
beats.chinese: 他们盖上镜头盖，让相机垂在背带上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That can wait. I have been staring at brickwork long enough.
beats.chinese: 照片可以等。我盯着砖墙看的时间也够长了。

choices.english: What do you usually photograph?
choices.chinese: 你平时通常拍什么？

choices.english: Thank you. I'll leave you to it.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。那我不打扰了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan ends the call and puts the phone away before answering you.
beats.chinese: Rowan 挂断电话，收起手机后才回答你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. They have asked before. I gave them my answer then.
beats.chinese: 不会。对方以前问过。我当时就给了答复。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They start to lift the camera, reconsider, and put it into their bag instead. Then they give you a small nod.
beats.chinese: 他们刚要举起相机，又改了主意，把它收进包里，随后向你轻轻点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you for making room earlier. I'll leave the photograph for another day. Good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 谢谢你刚才让开位置。照片改天再拍吧。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan ends the call and returns the phone to their pocket without checking the screen.
beats.chinese: Rowan 挂断电话，没有再看屏幕，直接将手机放回口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. And thank you for moving.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。也谢谢你刚才让开。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn the camera upright, check that the top of the building is in frame, and take one photograph.
beats.chinese: 他们把相机竖过来，确认建筑顶部已经入镜，拍下一张照片。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, that fits. I'll let you get on. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 嗯，这样就拍全了。不耽误你了，再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan leaves the lens cap on and turns towards you.
beats.chinese: Rowan 没有取下镜头盖，转身面向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Graffiti, usually. I photograph pieces around Manchester before someone paints over them. Some disappear between weekends.
beats.chinese: 通常拍涂鸦。我会在曼彻斯特各处拍下来，免得被人刷掉。有些隔一个周末就没了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They settle the camera into their bag, keeping its strap clear of the zip.
beats.chinese: 他们把相机放进包里，将背带拨开，避免夹进拉链。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I cut festival costume patterns near Ancoats. Photography gets me outside the workshop. Anyway, I won't keep you. Good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 我在 Ancoats 附近做节庆服装纸样。拍照能让我走出工作室。好了，不耽误你。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan gives a brief nod. The camera stays capped.
beats.chinese: Rowan 简短地点点头，相机镜头盖仍然盖着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You're welcome. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 不客气。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They turn the camera screen towards themselves and begin reviewing earlier photographs, leaving the entrance clear.
beats.chinese: 他们将相机屏幕转向自己，开始翻看之前的照片，仍然没有挡住入口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've plenty to sort through here anyway.
beats.chinese: 反正这里还有不少照片要整理。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Afflecks, you see Rowan waiting for their flatmate beside the outside wall on Church Street. Their hands are empty, and they recognise you.
beats.chinese: 在 Afflecks ，你看到 Rowan 在 Church Street 的外墙旁等室友。他们双手空着，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I'm just here with my flatmate today. There isn't anything I want to look at myself.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我今天只是陪室友来，自己没有什么想逛的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Rowan glances towards the entrance, then stays where they are, clear of the doorway.
beats.chinese: Rowan 朝入口看了一眼，仍安稳地留在原处，没有挡住门口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can come along without having anything to buy. It's good to see you.
beats.chinese: 没有要买的，也可以陪人来一趟。见到您很高兴。

causality.presenceReason: Rowan 在玩家出现前已专程来到 Afflecks 外，为红砖外立面取景。
causality.placeAttitude: 对建筑表面有拍摄兴趣，愿意反复检查构图，不把入口当私人摄影场地。
causality.stayingConstraint: 拍摄尚未完成，但没有必须留下的硬性约束，可以等待或改天再拍。
causality.currentGoal: 在不让不愿入镜的人被拍进去的前提下，取得一张构图完整的外立面照片。
causality.currentState: 正专注检查画面，交谈意愿有限但态度礼貌。接到要求重新谈旧事的电话后，立即维持原决定。
causality.contactTrigger: 玩家处于预期画面边缘，Rowan 主动放下相机，询问是否介意入镜，并明确可以等待。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留节庆服装纸样师身份、摄影兴趣、正式礼貌的措辞、对可核查事实的修正，以及不重开已定人际事项的缺点。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa 中玩家建议改日倾听，Rowan 明确拒绝并收机结束。ab 中玩家告辞，Rowan 调整构图完成拍摄。ba 中玩家询问摄影，Rowan 收起相机简短聊兴趣与工作后道别。bb 中玩家结束交流，Rowan 保持镜头盖关闭，转而查看旧照片。
causality.spatialContinuity: 所有节点均停留在 Church Street 的 Afflecks 红砖外立面与入口外，不进入楼内，不添加公共设施，也不占用入口。重逢时 Rowan 在外墙旁等室友，看一眼入口后仍留在原处。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Rowan Ashby。本次重逢位于阿弗莱克斯商店街口，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the street corner outside Afflecks on Church Street, Colette Marsh stands beside the red-brick frontage, clear of the entrance. She arranged to meet her sister here for a browse. Looking at the wall, she speaks to you nearby.
beats.chinese: Church Street 上的 Afflecks 街口，Colette Marsh 站在红砖外墙旁，没有挡住入口。她约了姐姐在这里碰面逛逛。她看着墙面，向附近的你开了口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've done fiddly work all morning. Today I just want to look at something I don't have to measure. This wall will do.
beats.chinese: 做了一上午细活，今天只想看点不用量尺寸的东西。这面墙就挺好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks along the brickwork, then briefly towards the people approaching the entrance.
beats.chinese: 她沿着砖墙看了看，又短暂地望向朝入口走来的人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm just waiting for my sister. We're having a browse when she gets here.
beats.chinese: 我只是在等姐姐。她到了，我们就一起逛逛。

choices.english: I'm just looking at the building.
choices.chinese: 我也只是看看这栋楼。

choices.english: So the wall gets a day off from being measured too.
choices.chinese: 那这面墙今天也放假，不用被量尺寸了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Colette looks up at the red-brick frontage, then back towards the entrance.
beats.chinese: Colette 抬头看了看红砖外墙，又把目光转回入口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Plenty to look at from here.
beats.chinese: 嗯。站在这里就有不少可看的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She eases the bag strap off a crease in her collar and settles it again.
beats.chinese: 她把压住衣领的包带提起来，再重新放好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've been winding bows at the workshop all morning. I fancy looking at something I don't have to measure.
beats.chinese: 我在乐器工坊缠了一上午琴弓。现在想看看不用量尺寸的东西。

choices.english: What are you hoping to find?
choices.chinese: 你想淘点什么？

choices.english: I'll leave you to wait, then. Have a good afternoon.
choices.chinese: 那就不打扰你等人了。下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Colette looks from you to the brickwork. Her expression stays practical.
beats.chinese: Colette 看看你，再看看砖墙，神情依然一本正经。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nobody's asked me to measure it.
beats.chinese: 也没人叫我量这面墙。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns back towards the entrance, then lifts one finger as the remark catches up with her.
beats.chinese: 她转头看向入口，随后像是终于接上了那句话，抬起一根手指。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh. A day off for the wall. Hang on, give me a second.
beats.chinese: 哦。给墙放一天假。等一下，给我一秒。

choices.english: Take your time.
choices.chinese: 慢慢来。

choices.english: I'll leave you to your wait. Enjoy the afternoon.
choices.chinese: 不打扰你等人了。下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Colette gives her bag a small, doubtful look.
beats.chinese: Colette 看了看自己的包，神情有点迟疑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Something small. I collect old tools. I can spend ten minutes inspecting a plane after announcing I'm having a day off.
beats.chinese: 小东西吧。我收旧工具。嘴上说着今天休息，转头就能检查一把刨子检查十分钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her sister reaches the street corner and raises a hand. Colette lifts hers in reply and turns towards her.
beats.chinese: 她姐姐走到街口，抬手示意。Colette 也举了举手，转身朝向姐姐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There she is. She'll keep me away from anything rusty. Enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 她来了。她会把我从那些生锈的东西旁边拉开的。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Colette gives a brief nod, accepting the end of the conversation.
beats.chinese: Colette 简短地点点头，顺势结束了交谈。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. You too.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。你也是。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes out her phone, checks a message and puts it away. Her attention returns to the people approaching the entrance.
beats.chinese: 她拿出手机看了一条消息，又收起来，重新留意朝入口走来的人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah, she's nearly here. Good.
beats.chinese: 啊，她快到了。好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Colette keeps her finger raised for another beat. Then she lets out a sudden, loud laugh.
beats.chinese: Colette 的手指又举了片刻，接着突然大声笑了出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ha! The wall gets the day off as well. It's been standing here working all morning.
beats.chinese: 哈！墙也放假了。它可在这儿站着干了一上午的活。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lowers her hand and shakes her head, smiling. Then she turns her shoulders back towards the entrance.
beats.chinese: 她放下手，笑着摇了摇头，随后重新侧身朝向入口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Took a moment. Worth it. Right, I'll get back to waiting. Enjoy your look round.
beats.chinese: 花了点时间。值得。好，我接着等人了。你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Colette drops her raised finger as you leave her to wait.
beats.chinese: 你结束交谈，留她继续等人。Colette 放下了举着的手指。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 好。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She faces the entrance again. A short laugh escapes her, but she does not call you back.
beats.chinese: 她重新面向入口，忽然笑了一声，不过没有叫你回来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A day off for the wall. Oh, I've got it now.
beats.chinese: 给墙放一天假。哦，这下懂了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another outing, Colette pauses a radio comedy programme on her phone outside Afflecks on Church Street. She looks up and recognises you.
beats.chinese: 另一天，Colette 在 Church Street 的 Afflecks 外暂停了手机里的电台喜剧节目。她抬起头，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Wait—I've just got that earlier line.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。等一下，我刚明白前面那句了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She suddenly laughs out loud, still looking pleased as she puts her phone away.
beats.chinese: 她突然笑出声来，把手机收好时，脸上仍带着愉快的笑意。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That was worth the extra moment. Good to see you.
beats.chinese: 这一下值得多等一会儿。见到你真好。

causality.presenceReason: Colette 已与姐姐约好在 Afflecks 外碰面逛逛，在玩家出现前就在 Church Street 街口的红砖外墙旁等候。
causality.placeAttitude: 她把这里当作下工后随意逛逛的去处，眼下愿意看看不需要自己量尺寸的建筑，也知道自己容易被旧工具吸引。
causality.stayingConstraint: 约定地点就在楼外，她留在入口可见且不挡通行的位置等姐姐，不随玩家转移场景，也不要求玩家帮忙解决等待。
causality.currentGoal: 等姐姐到场后一起逛逛，让注意力暂时离开做了一上午的精细工作。
causality.currentState: 刚做完一上午细活，说话干脆，有意随便看看，也愿意主动向附近的人简短分享眼前所想。理解玩笑仍需要额外时间。
causality.contactTrigger: 她已经站在不挡入口的红砖外墙旁，看着墙面，主动向附近的玩家说自己今天只想看不用量尺寸的东西，随后说明正在等姐姐。接触不再由让路、站位协商或排队误会引发。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留琴弓缠绕工、旧工具兴趣、直截了当的说话方式、迟到的真笑和不肯装笑的习惯。玩家拿墙也能放假打趣时，她先按字面理解，再明确要一点时间，领会后才笑。重逢继续使用她喜爱的电台喜剧，保留迟来理解带来的真实愉悦。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家说自己也在看楼时，a 顺着眼前建筑回应，再谈起工坊工作。aa 保留聊淘旧工具的毛病、姐姐到场后结束交谈的收束。ab 保留礼貌接受告辞、查看消息继续等人的收束。玩家拿墙不用量尺寸也算放假打趣时，b 先认真回应没人叫她量墙，再逐渐领会。ba 在玩家愿意等候后大笑，补上墙站了一上午也该放假的笑点，再结束聊天。bb 接受玩家离开，独自领会玩笑，不把玩家叫回。重逢内容不变，她暂停电台喜剧，认出玩家后说刚听懂前面的笑话，笑出声后收好手机并问候。
causality.spatialContinuity: 初遇全程使用 Church Street 街口、Afflecks 红砖外立面及入口外的公共空间。Colette 从开场就不挡入口，没有收包让路或调整双方站位的情节。随身包与手机均由本人携带，姐姐在 aa 到达街口，不进入未交代的室内空间。重逢同样停留在 Afflecks 外，仅使用她随身携带的手机。
