beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: After flying her homemade kite at Heaton Park, Priya Nandra is taking a walk beside the Rochdale Canal in Castlefield. Near the railway bridge, she pauses to inspect an orange corner of the folded kite showing at the top of her shoulder bag.
beats.chinese: 在希顿公园放过自制风筝后，Priya Nandra来到卡斯尔菲尔德的罗奇代尔运河边散步。铁路桥附近，她停下脚步，查看单肩包口露出的橙色风筝折角。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's a kite, not a flag. It actually flew today.
beats.chinese: 这是风筝，不是旗子。今天还真飞起来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She glances towards you and tilts the bag slightly so you can see the folded corner, keeping the path clear. Her small, uneven smile widens.
beats.chinese: 她看向附近的你，稍稍倾斜包身，让你能看见那个折角，同时留出通行空间。她嘴角那一点不对称的笑意扩大了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Priya. Very pleased with that orange bit.
beats.chinese: 我叫Priya。那块橙色的，我特别满意。

choices.english: I did think it was a flag. Can I have a look?
choices.chinese: 我刚才确实以为是旗子。能看看吗？

choices.english: Enjoy your walk. I'll leave you to it.
choices.chinese: 散步愉快。那我不打扰你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya turns the folded bundle slightly. An uneven green edge shows beside the orange fabric.
beats.chinese: Priya把折好的那一团稍稍转过来，橙色布料旁露出一条不齐整的绿色边缘。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Kite. A very wonky one. The orange side's longer because I felt like it.
beats.chinese: 是风筝。特别歪的那种。橙色那边长一些，因为我乐意。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the green edge inward without trying to make it line up.
beats.chinese: 她把绿色边缘折进去，并不费心把两边对齐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I letter price signs for a farmers' market all week. Those have to be tidy. This gets to be a mess.
beats.chinese: 我平时给农夫市集写价签。那些得整整齐齐。这个就可以乱来。

choices.english: Would you ever sell your kites?
choices.chinese: 你会考虑卖自己做的风筝吗？

choices.english: I like the uneven bits. Did it actually fly?
choices.chinese: 我喜欢那些不对称的地方。它真飞起来了吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya nods and checks the zip beside the folded orange corner. She stays on the same side of the canal, clear of the passing space.
beats.chinese: Priya点点头，检查橙色折角旁的拉链。她仍在运河同一侧，给行人留着通行空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. Just checking the zip. It all has to stay in there.
beats.chinese: 谢啦。我就检查一下拉链。得让它好好待在包里。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She begins tucking the folded corner below the zip, keeping the bundle close to her.
beats.chinese: 她开始把折角往拉链下方收，始终把折好的风筝拢在身前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It flew at Heaton Park earlier. It's staying in the bag here.
beats.chinese: 刚才在希顿公园放过了。在这儿它就待在包里。

choices.english: Give her a friendly nod and continue along the path.
choices.chinese: 友好地点点头，沿着路径继续走。

choices.english: I can wait a moment. I'd like to see the colours.
choices.chinese: 我可以等一会儿。挺想看看它的配色。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya's smile tightens before you finish the question. She pulls the zip, catches a fold of fabric, and stops.
beats.chinese: 你的问题还没说完，Priya的笑容就收紧了。她一拉拉链，夹住了一折布料，又停下手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. I don't take orders for them.
beats.chinese: 不卖。我不接风筝订单。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She frees the fabric and closes the bag more carefully. Then she looks up, her expression easing.
beats.chinese: 她把布料解出来，仔细些拉好包，随后抬起头，神色缓和下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry, that came out sharp. Friends keep suggesting a shop. I'm keeping this for myself. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 抱歉，刚才语气冲了点。朋友老劝我开店。我想把这个爱好留给自己。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya laughs and tucks the last orange fold inside. A short length of kite line remains wrapped around her fingers.
beats.chinese: Priya笑起来，把最后一折橙色布料塞进去。她手指上还绕着一小段风筝线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It flew. Went sideways for a bit, then behaved. The wind deserves most of the credit.
beats.chinese: 飞起来了。先横着跑了一阵，后来才老实。主要得归功于风。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes out the line winder and begins winding the loose length onto it, her attention returning to the task.
beats.chinese: 她拿出绕线板，开始收起散线，注意力重新回到手里的事上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The orange side looked ridiculous up there. Very pleased with that. I'll finish this off. Nice talking to you.
beats.chinese: 橙色那边在天上看着特别滑稽。我很满意。我把这点线收完。聊得挺开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You nod and continue along the canal path. Priya keeps the bag close while you pass.
beats.chinese: 你点点头，沿运河路径继续走。你经过时，Priya把包拢在身前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Behind you, she gets the final fold into the bag and closes the zip. She gives the bag a satisfied pat.
beats.chinese: 在你身后，她终于把最后一折塞进包，拉好拉链，满意地拍了拍包。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. All accounted for.
beats.chinese: 好了。总算都在里面了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Priya pauses with her hand on the zip. She keeps the bundle close rather than opening it across the path.
beats.chinese: Priya的手停在拉链上。她把那团风筝抱在身前，没有在路径上铺开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Only a corner. I'm not spreading it across the path.
beats.chinese: 只能看个角。我可不在路上把它摊开。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts a compact fold, showing pink, orange and green panels, then tucks it away and closes the bag.
beats.chinese: 她提起折成一小块的风筝，露出粉色、橙色和绿色的拼接布面，随后又收进去，拉好包。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It clashes with itself. Saves time choosing an outfit. Right, packed. Enjoy the canal.
beats.chinese: 它自己就能跟自己撞色。省得费心搭衣服了。好，收妥了。慢慢逛运河吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another outing beside the Castlefield canal, Priya pauses near the railway bridge before going to buy groceries. She is looking at the water when she recognises you.
beats.chinese: 在卡斯尔菲尔德运河边，Priya在去买日用品之前，停在铁路桥附近。她正看着水面，转头认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. Haven't done the shopping yet. I've decided to finish my ten-minute walk first.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。东西还没买呢。我决定先把这十分钟的散步走完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts her phone away and turns her attention back to the water.
beats.chinese: 她收起手机，把注意力重新放回水面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Shopping can wait. Nothing I need to get done just now.
beats.chinese: 东西待会儿买。这会儿什么也不用办。

causality.presenceReason: Priya在希顿公园放完自制风筝后，带着折好的风筝到卡斯尔菲尔德运河边散步。
causality.placeAttitude: 她把运河岸边当作享受闲暇的公共空间，不在这里展开或放飞风筝，也不把休闲变成工作。
causality.stayingConstraint: 她在铁路桥旁短暂停步，查看包口露出的橙色折角并检查拉链，没有必须留下的任务，双方都可以自然结束交谈。
causality.currentGoal: 享受放飞成功后的轻快心情和自己的散步，把折好的风筝收妥，不承接订单或推销作品。
causality.currentState: 她今天心情轻松，主动分享风筝飞起来的小得意，愿意闲聊。涉及售卖时，她仍会过快进入防御状态，随后意识到语气过冲并简短道歉。
causality.contactTrigger: 风筝已经折好，没有滑落或侵入玩家空间。她查看包口的橙色折角时，主动向附近玩家说明这是风筝而非旗子，并轻快地分享今天成功放飞的事。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留曼彻斯特与Levenshulme成长背景、市集价签制作职业、直接利落而爱说笑的表达、刻意不规整的风筝爱好，以及拒绝把爱好商业化的边界。她在工作中讲究整齐，在休闲中允许作品歪斜难看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Beside the Rochdale Canal in Castlefield, Terence Maddox has paused a walk between customer visits. His bag of garden-watering samples rests against his hip. From the public towpath, he looks up at the ironwork on the railway bridge, then turns towards you.
beats.chinese: 在卡斯尔菲尔德的罗奇代尔运河边，Terence Maddox趁拜访客户的间隙散步。他把花园浇灌设备样品袋拢在胯侧，站在公共纤道上，抬头看看铁路桥上的铁栏，随后转向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just that section up there. What stands out more to you, the horizontal rails or the upright bars?
beats.chinese: 就看上面那一段。你觉得更显眼的是横杆，还是竖杆？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He points towards the bridge, keeping close to the warehouse wall so the towpath stays clear. His phone remains in his pocket.
beats.chinese: 他指向桥上的铁栏，站在仓库墙边，给纤道留出通行空间。手机仍在他的口袋里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's for my sister Denise. She wants a handrail. I've looked at so many designs I can't tell what stands out any more.
beats.chinese: 是替我姐姐Denise看的。她想装个扶手。我看过的样式太多，现在都拿不准该注意哪儿了。

choices.english: What's interesting about that ironwork?
choices.chinese: 那些铁栏有什么特别的吗？

choices.english: I'm not sure. I'll leave that to you.
choices.chinese: 我也拿不准。还是你自己看吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Terence takes his phone from his pocket, keeping it low. Above the canal, the bridge ironwork stands out against the sky.
beats.chinese: Terence从口袋里拿出手机，仍放得很低。运河上方，桥上的铁栏映在天空前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She wants it for her back step. I sell garden watering kits. Somehow I've acquired a metalwork department.
beats.chinese: 她想给后门台阶装个扶手。我是卖花园浇灌设备的。不知怎么，还兼上金工部了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens an unfinished sketch on his phone. Below it are several messages about different rail designs. He starts adding another relative to the conversation, then stops.
beats.chinese: 他在手机上打开一张没画完的草图。下面有几条讨论不同扶手方案的信息。他正要把另一个亲戚加进聊天，又停住了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Brackets are bought. That took ten minutes. We've had four drawings and we haven't drilled a hole.
beats.chinese: 支架已经买好了，十分钟就定了。图纸倒是出了四版，一个孔都还没钻。

choices.english: I'll leave you to sort out the photo.
choices.chinese: 那我就不打扰你拍照了。

choices.english: I could finish that little sketch for you.
choices.chinese: 我可以帮你把那张小草图补完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Terence nods immediately. He takes out his phone and checks a view of the bridge from beside the warehouse wall.
beats.chinese: Terence立刻点头。他拿出手机，站在仓库墙旁，查看朝向桥的取景。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I'll take a picture for her.
beats.chinese: 行。那我拍张照片给她看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks the edges of the screen, then lowers the phone again rather than taking the picture while you are beside him.
beats.chinese: 他检查了一下画面边缘，又放下手机，没有趁你在旁边时直接拍摄。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've been collecting far too many possibilities.
beats.chinese: 我收集的备选样式已经多过头了。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll carry on along the path.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。那我沿着路继续走了。

choices.english: I'm happy to chat while you take it. Why that ironwork?
choices.chinese: 你拍的时候可以聊两句。为什么看中那些铁栏？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Terence returns to the camera, then pauses with his thumb above the screen.
beats.chinese: Terence切回相机，拇指却停在屏幕上方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. One picture, then I'll send it to Denise.
beats.chinese: 谢了。拍一张，就发给Denise。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He zooms in on the bridge ironwork and takes a photograph. In the family chat, he attaches it and begins typing two different questions about the design. His attention settles on the message.
beats.chinese: 他在手机上放大桥上铁栏的画面，拍了一张，附到家庭群里，又开始输入两个关于样式的不同问题。他的注意力转到了信息上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And my brother, apparently. Right then. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 看来还得发给我弟弟。行了，祝你散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Terence's smile fades. He draws the phone closer to his chest without handing it over.
beats.chinese: Terence的笑意淡了。他把手机收近胸前，没有递过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. That's mine to finish.
beats.chinese: 不用。那张图我自己画完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He locks the screen and puts the phone away. After a pause, he adjusts his sample bag and turns along the same canalside path.
beats.chinese: 他锁屏，把手机收进口袋。停了一会儿，他调整好样品袋，转身沿着同一条运河边路径准备离开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The missing line can wait. Right then, enjoy the rest of your day.
beats.chinese: 缺的那条线先放着吧。行了，祝你今天过得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Terence keeps his phone down as you continue along the path.
beats.chinese: 你沿着路径继续走，Terence仍把手机放低。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. I'll get the bridge once you're past.
beats.chinese: 谢了。等你走过去，我再拍桥。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Once you have passed, he raises the phone for a wider view of the bridge ironwork against the sky. He remains on the towpath beside the warehouse wall.
beats.chinese: 等你走过去，他才举起手机，把桥上的铁栏和后方的天空一起拍进去。他始终站在仓库墙旁的纤道上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Nobody in it. Take care.
beats.chinese: 好了，一个人都没拍进去。慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Terence checks that the frame contains only bridge ironwork and sky before answering.
beats.chinese: Terence先确认画面里只有桥上的铁栏和天空，才开口回答。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Those straight uprights. Easy to show her. She asked for something simple, then I asked the family what simple meant.
beats.chinese: 那些笔直的竖杆，拍给她看很方便。她说要简单一点，结果我又跑去问全家，简单到底是什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He zooms in, takes the photograph and sends it directly to Denise. He starts opening the family chat, hesitates, then puts the phone in his pocket.
beats.chinese: 他放大画面，拍下照片，直接发给Denise。他刚要点开家庭群，犹豫了一下，把手机收进口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She can have a look before everyone else gets a vote. Right then. I'll leave you to your day.
beats.chinese: 先让她看看，其他人晚点再发表意见。行了，不耽误你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another outing beside the Castlefield canal, Terence stands by the brick warehouse wall with a small food tub. He recognises you and raises his free hand.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到卡斯尔菲尔德运河边，Terence拿着一个小饭盒站在砖仓库墙旁。他认出了你，抬起空着的那只手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Lunch is putting up a fight.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。午饭正跟我较劲呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He presses a fork against a pickled runner bean. It slips back into the tub. He closes the lid and tucks the fork under its retaining clip.
beats.chinese: 他用叉子压住一根腌荷包豆，豆子又滑回了饭盒里。他盖好盖子，把叉子卡进盒盖上的固定夹。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Home-grown. Pickled them myself. The shallots worked. These need another month, apparently.
beats.chinese: 自家种的，也是自己腌的。小洋葱腌成了。这些看来还得再等一个月。

stories.titleZh: 运河边让出的一点空间

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Castlefield beside the Rochdale Canal, Frankie Osei has stopped at the brick wall during a walk after work. They put their water bottle away and glance at the space between you and the brick wall, keeping their feet where they are.
beats.chinese: 在卡斯尔菲尔德的罗奇代尔运河边，Frankie Osei 下班散步途中停在砖墙旁。他们收起水瓶，看了一眼你与砖墙之间的空间，仍稳稳站在原处。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd like to stand here quietly for a few minutes. Can we leave each other a bit of room?
beats.chinese: 我想在这儿安静站几分钟。我们各留一点地方，可以吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Frankie holds their shoulder bag close to their side. There is room beside the brick wall, with the path still clear.
beats.chinese: Frankie 把肩包拢在身侧。砖墙旁有地方站，路径也仍然畅通。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's room for us both without blocking the path.
beats.chinese: 这里够我们两个人站，也不会挡着路。

choices.english: Of course. Are you out for a walk?
choices.chinese: 当然。你在散步吗？

choices.english: That works. I'd like to stand here a moment too, if there's room.
choices.chinese: 可以。如果站得下，我也想在这里停一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Frankie looks along the canal before answering. The pause lasts long enough to make the simple question feel briefly unanswered.
beats.chinese: Frankie 先沿着运河望了一眼。那一下停顿有点久，简单的问题像是暂时没了下文。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Aye. I sort power and cabling for market stalls. Finished work and fancied a bit of a walk.
beats.chinese: 是啊。我负责集市摊位的供电和布线。忙完了，想走一小段。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They settle the bag strap on their shoulder and turn towards you.
beats.chinese: 他们调整好肩上的包带，转过身来面向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry, went a bit blank there. I was deciding whether I've got another stretch in me.
beats.chinese: 抱歉，刚才走神了。我在想自己还有没有精神再走一段。

choices.english: Would you like company for a short stretch? If you do, I'll walk with you.
choices.chinese: 想找个人一起走一小段吗？想的话，我陪你走。

choices.english: I'll leave you to your walk. I'm staying by the water.
choices.chinese: 那你慢慢走。我就在水边待一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Frankie shifts farther along the brick wall without leaving the photographed stretch of canal. There is space between you, and the path remains open.
beats.chinese: Frankie 沿砖墙又挪开一点，仍在这一段运河边。你们之间留出了距离，路径也保持畅通。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I don't need all of it.
beats.chinese: 当然。我一个人用不了这么大地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They rest one hand on their bag strap and look down at the water.
beats.chinese: 他们一只手搭着包带，低头看向水面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd only stopped for a drink. Got distracted watching the water.
beats.chinese: 本来只是停下来喝口水。看着水面就忘了动。

choices.english: I'll carry on after all. Enjoy your break. [Continue along the path.]
choices.chinese: 我还是接着走吧。好好歇会儿。[沿路径继续走。]

choices.english: A quick chat would be nice, if you're up for it. I'll stay here either way.
choices.chinese: 你要是有兴致，聊两句也不错。不聊也没关系，我就在这儿待会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Frankie looks towards the nearest bridge pillar, then pauses with one hand around the bag strap.
beats.chinese: Frankie 朝最近的桥柱望去，一手握着包带，停下来想了想。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hang on, let me actually think. Yeah. Just as far as that pillar.
beats.chinese: 等一下，让我认真想想。行。就走到那根桥柱。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You walk together along the same bank, keeping room for other people. Beside the pillar, Frankie stops and takes out their water bottle.
beats.chinese: 你们沿着同一侧岸边一起走，给其他人留出通行空间。到了桥柱旁，Frankie 停下，取出水瓶。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, this is my stop. Good to have a bit of company. Take care.
beats.chinese: 好，我就到这儿。有个人一起走挺好。回见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Frankie nods and turns to face along the path. They check that the bag is zipped before moving.
beats.chinese: Frankie 点点头，转向路径前方，出发前检查了一下包的拉链。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I'll give my legs another couple of minutes.
beats.chinese: 好。那我再走个几分钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You remain by the water. Frankie walks on alone along the same bank, raising a hand briefly as they go.
beats.chinese: 你留在水边。Frankie 独自沿同一侧岸边继续走，离开时抬手挥了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy your stop. Mind how you go.
beats.chinese: 慢慢歇着。路上当心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the path, Frankie stays beside the brick wall and turns enough to see you off.
beats.chinese: 你沿路径继续走。Frankie 留在砖墙旁，稍稍转过身向你道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 谢了。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They give a small wave, then take their bottle out again, keeping it and the bag beside their body.
beats.chinese: 他们轻轻挥手，又拿出水瓶，把瓶子和包都收在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll stay here a bit longer. Take care.
beats.chinese: 我再在这儿待一会儿。回见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Frankie glances towards you. Their mouth opens, then they pause, looking down at the bag strap in their hand.
beats.chinese: Frankie 朝你看过来，张了张嘴，又停住，低头看着手里的包带。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No, I'm keeping this bit of the day to myself.
beats.chinese: 不了，这会儿我想自己待着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They give you a small, friendly nod, then turn back towards the canal. You stay in your own space by the brick wall.
beats.chinese: 他们友善地朝你轻轻点头，随后转回去看运河。你留在砖墙旁自己的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You're fine there, though. No need to move.
beats.chinese: 不过你站那儿没关系。不用挪。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Castlefield, Frankie stands beside the brick warehouse wall on the same bank of the canal as you. They finish a drink of water, lower the bottle and recognise you.
beats.chinese: 在卡斯尔菲尔德，Frankie站在与你同岸的砖仓库墙边。他们喝完水，放下水瓶，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Frankie looks towards the visible bridge pillar and pauses for a moment. Then they put their water bottle away, staying beside the brick wall.
beats.chinese: Frankie 看向视线内的桥柱，停顿片刻。随后，他们收好水瓶，仍站在砖墙旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm stopping here today. That little stretch was enough. Hope you're having a decent day.
beats.chinese: 今天就走到这里，不往前了。这一小段够了。希望你今天过得不错。

causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须等人的安排，只愿按当天体力决定继续走多远，并始终给路径留出空间。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Castlefield's Rochdale Canal, Drew Fairhurst has paused beside the brick wall for biscuits during a walk. As he opens a paper box, its broad lid swings towards the space beside you.
beats.chinese: 在卡斯尔菲尔德的罗奇代尔运河边，Drew Fairhurst 散步途中停在砖墙旁吃饼干。他打开一个纸盒，宽宽的盒盖朝你身旁的空处翻过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry. That lid came a bit close.
beats.chinese: 抱歉，盒盖差点碰到你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Drew draws the box back and folds the lid against his wrist. The scuffed box has a radio dial drawn on its front.
beats.chinese: Drew 收回盒子，把盒盖折向自己的手腕。盒角已经磨旧，正面画着一个收音机调谐盘。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's a radio-shaped biscuit box. Reception's rubbish.
beats.chinese: 这是个收音机形状的饼干盒。收音差得很。

choices.english: A paper radio? Does it really hold biscuits?
choices.chinese: 纸做的收音机？里面真装着饼干？

choices.english: Thanks. I'll just get past.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，我过去一下就好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Drew turns the open box so you can see the biscuits inside. He stays beside the brick wall, leaving the path clear.
beats.chinese: Drew 转过打开的盒子，让你看见里面的饼干。他仍站在砖墙旁，没有占住通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Real biscuits. I make paper prototypes for packaging and display firms. This one's off duty.
beats.chinese: 真饼干。我给包装和展示公司做纸质模型样品。这个已经下班了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He holds the box out, then nudges it closer before you've agreed to take it. One thumb keeps the loose lid in place.
beats.chinese: 他把盒子递出来，还没等你答应，又往你这边送了送。一只拇指压着松动的盒盖。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Go on, base in your palm. Unless you'd rather not.
beats.chinese: 来，手掌托住底。你要是不想拿，也没事。

choices.english: All right. I'll hold it by the base for a moment, then hand it back.
choices.chinese: 好，我托着底拿一下，再还给你。

choices.english: No thanks. I'd rather leave it with you.
choices.chinese: 不了，谢谢。还是你拿着吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Drew brings the box close to his chest and makes more room beside him.
beats.chinese: Drew 把盒子收在胸前，又往旁边让开一点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. Plenty of room now.
beats.chinese: 当然，现在够宽了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes the lid, catches the edge of his own sleeve, and immediately opens it again. He frees the fabric with a small tug.
beats.chinese: 他合上盒盖，却夹住了自己的袖边，只好马上重新打开。他轻轻一拽，把布料抽出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Caught my sleeve. That's the second thing I've tried to pack in there.
beats.chinese: 夹着袖子了。这已经是我往里面装的第二样东西了。

choices.english: Give him a quick wave and continue along the path.
choices.chinese: 向他简单挥挥手，继续沿着岸边走。

choices.english: Pause out of the way. I've shut my coat in a door before.
choices.chinese: 在不挡路的地方停一下。我以前也被门夹过外套。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The box rests on your palm for a moment. Its base is firm, though the corners have softened from use.
beats.chinese: 盒子在你掌心里停留片刻。底部很结实，边角却已经用得有些发软。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There you go. That pale patch is where I keep picking it up with buttery fingers.
beats.chinese: 就是这样。那块发白的地方，是我老用沾着黄油的手拿出来的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Once the box is back in his hands, Drew takes a biscuit and secures the lid under his thumb. He turns back towards the water to finish his snack.
beats.chinese: 盒子回到 Drew 手里后，他拿出一块饼干，用拇指压好盒盖，转向水面继续吃点心。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, I'd better eat these before I wear through the box. Nice meeting you.
beats.chinese: 好了，得赶在盒子被我磨穿之前把这些吃完。很高兴认识你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Drew stops extending the box and draws it back to his chest.
beats.chinese: Drew 不再往前递盒子，把它收回胸前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. Got ahead of myself there.
beats.chinese: 行，没问题。刚才是我太急了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He eats one biscuit, closes the box carefully around his sleeve, then tucks it under his arm. With the path clear, he resumes his walk along the same bank.
beats.chinese: 他吃掉一块饼干，避开袖子仔细合上盒盖，然后把盒子夹在臂下。等路上空出位置，他继续沿同一侧河岸散步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll keep hold of my own radio, then. Cheers.
beats.chinese: 那我就自己抱着这台收音机了。回见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the path, Drew returns the wave with the hand that isn't holding the box.
beats.chinese: 你继续沿岸边走，Drew 用没拿盒子的那只手朝你挥了挥。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Cheers. You're clear.
beats.chinese: 回见，路让开了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stays by the brick wall, pulls both cuffs back from his hands, and opens the box again.
beats.chinese: 他留在砖墙旁，把两边袖口都往上拉了拉，重新打开盒子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Just the biscuits this time.
beats.chinese: 好了，这回只管饼干。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Drew stops checking his cuff and grins. There is room for people to pass between the conversation and the rest of the path.
beats.chinese: Drew 不再低头检查袖口，咧嘴笑了。两人待的位置不挡路，其他人可以正常通过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I once stapled my sleeve to a carton. Took me a second to work out why it followed me.
beats.chinese: 我有回把袖子订在纸箱上了。还愣了一下，才明白箱子怎么跟着我走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rolls that cuff back once, closes the box, and secures it under his arm. He turns along the bank, ready to resume his walk.
beats.chinese: 他把那边袖口卷起一折，合好盒子，夹稳在臂下，然后转向岸边路径，准备继续散步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Nothing attached. I'll get moving before I manage anything else. Take care.
beats.chinese: 好了，没连着别的东西。趁我还没弄出下一桩，赶紧走了。保重。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another outing at Castlefield's Rochdale Canal, Drew Fairhurst pauses beside the brick wall, clear of the path. He takes a small folded piece of paper from his pocket, then recognises you.
beats.chinese: 在卡斯尔菲尔德的罗奇代尔运河，Drew Fairhurst 在砖墙旁停步，留出通行空间。他从衣袋里取出一小块折过的纸，随后认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. Been wondering whether to play football this weekend. Yeah, I'll go.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。刚还在想周末要不要去踢球。嗯，去吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances at the plans jotted on the paper, folds it up, and slips it back into his pocket. He turns along the bank, ready to continue his walk.
beats.chinese: 他看了一眼纸上随手记下的安排，把纸折好收回衣袋，转向岸边路径，准备继续散步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Been sitting folding paper all week. Time my legs did some work this weekend.
beats.chinese: 整周都坐着折纸，周末该让腿干点活。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: In Manchester Central Library's Wolfson Reading Room, Albert Grimshaw has settled at a table with his Guardian crossword. Beside you, an empty chair is tucked neatly under the table.
beats.chinese: 在曼彻斯特中央图书馆的沃尔夫森阅览室，阿尔伯特·格里姆肖已经坐在桌边，摊开了《卫报》的填字游戏。你旁边，一把空椅子整齐地收在桌下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The word 'bank' on its own. Do you think of money first, or a river?
beats.chinese: 单看 bank 这个词，你先想到银行，还是河岸？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts down his pen and looks up at you beside the table, keeping his voice low.
beats.chinese: 他放下笔，抬头看向站在桌旁的你，声音压得很低。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just your first thought. I'm not asking you to solve the clue.
beats.chinese: 说第一反应就行。我不是请你把整道题解出来。

choices.english: A bank for money.
choices.chinese: 存钱的银行。

choices.english: Would it be all right if I sat here for a little while?
choices.chinese: 不知道方不方便让我在这里坐一会儿？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Albert nods at your answer, keeping his voice low.
beats.chinese: 阿尔伯特听了你的回答，点点头，仍然压低着声音。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I thought of a river first. Thank you.
beats.chinese: 我先想到的是河岸。谢谢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He picks up his pen, then notices that his newspaper extends across two places. He folds it in half.
beats.chinese: 他拿起笔，又发现自己的报纸铺了两个座位那么宽，便把它对折起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A crossword doesn't need two chairs.
beats.chinese: 做个填字游戏，用不着两把椅子。

choices.english: Thanks. [Continue past the table.]
choices.chinese: 谢谢。[从桌旁继续走过。]

choices.english: Any luck with it? [Pause for his answer, then continue past the table.]
choices.chinese: 填得顺利吗？[停下来听他回答，然后继续从桌旁走过。]

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Albert glances at the empty chair, then back at you.
beats.chinese: 阿尔伯特看了一眼空椅子，又看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. That's a lot of words for one chair.
beats.chinese: 可以。为一把椅子，说了不少字啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds his newspaper and moves his pen away from the empty place, leaving that part of the table clear.
beats.chinese: 他把报纸折起来，将笔移开，给空座位前的桌面腾出地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's free. I'll keep my paper on this side.
beats.chinese: 没人坐。我把报纸放在这边就行。

choices.english: I'll take the seat. No editing, please. [Sit down.]
choices.chinese: 那我就坐了。我的话就不劳你删改了。[坐下。]

choices.english: On second thought, I'll carry on. [Leave the chair empty and move on.]
choices.chinese: 想了想，我还是继续走吧。[留下空椅子，继续走。]

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue past the table. The empty chair remains tucked underneath it.
beats.chinese: 你从桌旁继续走过。空椅子仍收在桌下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You're welcome.
beats.chinese: 不客气。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers his eyes to the crossword and writes a single letter.
beats.chinese: 他低头看填字游戏，填进一个字母。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. One at a time.
beats.chinese: 好了。一个一个来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Albert keeps his voice low during your brief pause beside the table.
beats.chinese: 你在桌旁短暂停留时，阿尔伯特仍然压低着声音。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Four answers in ink. One of them may be optimism.
beats.chinese: 用墨水填了四个答案。其中一个可能只是乐观。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He taps one doubtful answer with the end of his pen. As you continue past, he turns the paper towards himself again.
beats.chinese: 他用笔尾点了点一个拿不准的答案。你继续往前走时，他把报纸重新转向自己。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave that one alone for a bit. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 那个先搁一会儿吧。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You sit in the cleared place. Albert pauses with his pen just above the paper.
beats.chinese: 你在腾出的座位上坐下。阿尔伯特的笔停在报纸上方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough.
beats.chinese: 有道理。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the crossword towards himself and draws its folded edge back from your part of the table.
beats.chinese: 他把填字游戏转向自己，又将报纸折起的边缘从你这边收回去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Seven down can have my attention instead.
beats.chinese: 我还是去琢磨竖七吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You move on without taking the chair. Albert leaves the cleared place empty.
beats.chinese: 你没有坐下，继续往前走。阿尔伯特让腾出的座位空着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 好的。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps his newspaper folded rather than spreading it out again, then finds his place in the clues.
beats.chinese: 他没有重新铺开报纸，而是保持对折，接着找到刚才读到的题目。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now, where was I? Twelve across.
beats.chinese: 刚才看到哪儿了？横十二。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: In Manchester Central Library's Wolfson Reading Room, Albert Grimshaw recognises you at the end of a table. A small shared notebook lies open before him.
beats.chinese: 在曼彻斯特中央图书馆Wolfson阅览室，Albert Grimshaw在桌边认出你，面前摊着一本与朋友共用的小本子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Four lines of a limerick. The fifth's been absent a fortnight.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。一首打油诗写了四行。第五行缺席两周了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He caps his pen and leaves the space beneath the four lines empty. His voice stays low.
beats.chinese: 他盖好笔帽，四行下面留着空白，说话声音仍很轻。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It can turn up when it likes. Nobody's waiting to print it. Enjoy your reading.
beats.chinese: 它想什么时候来就什么时候来。又没人等着印。看书愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: In Manchester Central Library's Wolfson Reading Room, Patricia Wroe is trying a novel her nephew lent her before their planned cinema trip. Her bag is tucked beneath her own chair. As you draw level with her table, she smiles at the opening pages.
beats.chinese: 在曼彻斯特中央图书馆的沃尔夫森阅览室，帕特里夏·罗正在试读侄子借给她的小说，之后他们约好去看电影。她的包收在自己的椅子下面。你走到她的桌旁时，她看着开头几页，露出了笑意。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll have to take something back. This book's better than its cover.
beats.chinese: 我得收回一句话。这本书比封面好看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks up at you and keeps her voice low, with one finger resting on the page.
beats.chinese: 她抬头看向你，声音压得很低，一根手指仍搭在书页上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd already decided it was dreadful before I'd even opened it.
beats.chinese: 我连书都没翻开，就已经认定它糟透了。

choices.english: I'll stop for a moment.
choices.chinese: 我停一小会儿。

choices.english: I'm just passing. Enjoy your book.
choices.chinese: 我只是经过。你好好看书。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You pause beside the table, clear of the walking space. Patricia moves her novel onto her side of the table, revealing a bright cover crowded with smiling faces.
beats.chinese: 你在桌旁停下，没有占住通道。帕特里夏把小说挪回自己这边，露出一张颜色鲜亮、挤满笑脸的封面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Six pages in, and I'm enjoying it. My nephew'll be pleased with himself at the pictures later.
beats.chinese: 才读六页，我就看进去了。待会儿看电影时，我侄子可有得意的了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She glances at the cover again and gives a small, rueful grin.
beats.chinese: 她又看一眼封面，有点自嘲地咧嘴笑了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I hadn't even opened it when I said that. Rather efficient of me.
beats.chinese: 我说那话的时候，连书都没翻开。我这效率可真高。

choices.english: I'll sit here quietly. Enjoy the book.
choices.chinese: 我在这里安静坐会儿。你好好看书。

choices.english: Actually, I'll keep moving. Enjoy it.
choices.chinese: 我还是继续走吧。祝你看得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Patricia keeps her voice low. Her novel lies open beneath one hand.
beats.chinese: 帕特里夏仍压低着声音。摊开的小说压在她的一只手下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right you are. I've come in to give this a fair try before I see my nephew. Apparently I called it rubbish.
beats.chinese: 好，没问题。我来这里是想在见侄子之前，认真试读一下这本书。据说我还骂它是垃圾来着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the cover, then opens it at her marked page.
beats.chinese: 她看了看封面，又翻回夹着书签的那一页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I remember saying it looked cheerful. He remembers the rest of the sentence.
beats.chinese: 我只记得说过它看着挺喜庆。他倒把后半句也记住了。

choices.english: Enjoy your reading. I'll leave you to it and carry on.
choices.chinese: 你好好看书，我不打扰了，继续往前走。

choices.english: I'll stop for a moment. What's changed your mind?
choices.chinese: 我停一小会儿。是什么让你改了主意？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You sit at the table. Patricia draws the book a little closer without spreading anything into your space.
beats.chinese: 你在桌边坐下。帕特里夏把书拉近一点，没有往你这边摊放东西。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I want to finish this chapter before he gets the satisfaction of hearing me admit it.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我想先看完这一章，再让他得意洋洋地听我认错。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She finds her place with one finger, then turns a page. Her attention settles on the book.
beats.chinese: 她用一根手指找到刚才读到的地方，随后翻了一页，专心读起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave this bit of the table clear for you.
beats.chinese: 桌子这边我给你留着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You turn to continue through the reading room. Patricia draws her novel closer.
beats.chinese: 你转身，准备继续穿过阅览室。帕特里夏把小说拉近了一点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. No need to stay on account of my book report.
beats.chinese: 当然。不用为了听我的读书汇报特意留下。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She opens the book at her bookmark and lays the bookmark beneath it.
beats.chinese: 她翻到夹着书签的那一页，把书签抽出来压在书下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Off you go. I'll try to reach page ten before announcing another verdict.
beats.chinese: 你走吧。我争取读到第十页，再发表下一轮高见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue past the table. Patricia brings her book upright.
beats.chinese: 你继续从桌旁走过。帕特里夏把书竖了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. I've only got a few pages to catch up on.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我就再补读几页。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips the bookmark out and lays it beneath the book. Her eyes return to the page as you pass.
beats.chinese: 她抽出书签，压到书下面。你经过时，她的目光已经回到了书页上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy your visit.
beats.chinese: 祝你在这里逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You pause beside the table, clear of the walking space. Patricia rests a finger between the pages so she can close the book.
beats.chinese: 你在桌旁停了片刻，没有占住通道。帕特里夏用一根手指夹住书页，把书合上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The sister's just lied about enjoying a family holiday. Now she's been invited on another one. I want to see how she gets out of it.
beats.chinese: 书里那个姐姐刚撒谎说，跟家人度假很开心。结果人家又约了她一次。我想看看她怎么脱身。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks down at the cheerful cover, gives a tiny shake of her head, and opens the book again.
beats.chinese: 她低头看看那张喜庆的封面，轻轻摇头，又把书翻开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I thought it'd be all lovely family dinners. I got that wrong. Anyway, I'll let you get on.
beats.chinese: 我以为通篇都是一家人开开心心吃饭呢。是我想错了。好了，不耽误你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Manchester Central Library's Wolfson Reading Room, Patricia is sitting at a table. She closes her pocket diary and recognises you.
beats.chinese: 在曼彻斯特中央图书馆的沃尔夫森阅览室，帕特里夏正坐在桌边。她合上袖珍日程本，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. I've just kept an evening free for the fish and the telly at home. No going out.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。我刚给家里的鱼和电视留出了一晚，不安排出门。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the diary into her bag beneath her chair and looks up with an easy smile.
beats.chinese: 她把日程本收进椅子下面的包里，抬起头，笑得很轻松。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Haven't picked a programme yet. The evening's settled, though.
beats.chinese: 节目还没挑。晚上倒是定了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: In Manchester Central Library's Wolfson Reading Room, Patricia Wren is reading a printed essay before meeting her friend Maureen. Her bag is beneath her own chair, and the next chair is empty. As you reach that end of the table, she puts down her pen and speaks quietly.
beats.chinese: 在曼彻斯特中央图书馆的沃尔夫森阅览室，Patricia Wren正读着一篇打印的随笔，准备之后见朋友Maureen。她的包放在自己的椅子下面，旁边的椅子空着。你来到桌子这一端时，她放下笔，轻声开口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Could I borrow an opinion? If you like an essay, is finding reasons to disagree with it careful reading, or making work for yourself?
beats.chinese: 借你一句判断。喜欢一篇文章，还要找理由反对它，是认真读，还是给自己找事？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps the pages in front of her and waits for your answer.
beats.chinese: 她把纸页留在自己面前，等你回答。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You needn't sit down. I'm only after a sentence.
beats.chinese: 不必坐，我只借一句。

choices.english: Sit down. Finding reasons to disagree sounds like work.
choices.chinese: 坐下。找理由反对，听着就像给自己找活干。

choices.english: I'll stay standing. Is this for something?
choices.chinese: 我站着就好。你找反对理由是有什么用吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You take the empty chair. Patricia leaves her bag beneath her own chair, keeping the space around the table clear.
beats.chinese: 你坐上空椅子。Patricia的包仍放在自己的椅子下面，桌子周围的通行空间保持畅通。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: So I'm turning a pleasure into a job. Fair point. Maureen and I each argue against an essay we liked. Whoever loses buys the tea.
beats.chinese: 也就是说，我把一件乐事变成了活儿。有道理。Maureen和我各自反驳自己喜欢的文章，谁输了谁请喝茶。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She raises one finger as a tally, smiling.
beats.chinese: 她笑着竖起一根手指计分。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One point to you. I'll keep count. I do it at badminton too, whether anyone asks or not.
beats.chinese: 你得一分。我来记分。打羽毛球时我也这样，不管有没有人请我记。

choices.english: Then Maureen should pay you for your hard work.
choices.chinese: 那Maureen该付你辛苦费。

choices.english: No more rounds for me. I'd like to sit quietly.
choices.chinese: 我就不继续辩了。我想安静坐会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The chair stays empty. Patricia rests a hand on the printed pages.
beats.chinese: 椅子仍然空着。Patricia将一只手搭在打印纸上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I came to read this before I see Maureen. I've liked every word, which makes things awkward.
beats.chinese: 好啊。我来这里，是想在见Maureen之前把这篇读完。每一句我都喜欢，这下可难办了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the top page back, keeping the papers within her own place at the table.
beats.chinese: 她翻回第一页，纸张始终放在自己面前，没有占到别人的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We each argue against the essay we liked. Whoever loses buys the tea. I agreed to that far too readily.
beats.chinese: 我们各自反驳自己喜欢的文章，谁输了谁请喝茶。我当初答应得太痛快了。

choices.english: One quick round, then I'll carry on looking around. What's the essay claiming?
choices.chinese: 那就来一小回合，然后我继续逛。文章主张什么？

choices.english: I'll carry on looking around. Enjoy your reading.
choices.chinese: 我继续四处看看。祝你读得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Patricia glances at the essay, then back at you. Her smile widens, but her voice stays low.
beats.chinese: Patricia看了看随笔，又看向你。她笑得更开了，声音仍然很轻。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She'd say I chose to do it. Annoyingly, she'd have a point.
beats.chinese: 她会说，这是我自愿的。气人的是，她还真有道理。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She nudges the bag fully beneath her chair and turns her essay squarely in front of her.
beats.chinese: 她把包完全挪到自己的椅子下面，再将随笔摆正。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can have the victory. I've got a much less reasonable argument to prepare here.
beats.chinese: 这局归你赢。我这儿还得准备一套更不讲理的反驳。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Patricia draws breath and raises her finger again. You remain in the chair you chose.
beats.chinese: Patricia吸了口气，又竖起手指。你仍坐在刚才选的椅子上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Though I could make a case for—
beats.chinese: 不过我倒可以替它辩——

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stops, lowers her hand and turns back to her pages, leaving your side of the table alone.
beats.chinese: 她停下来，放下手，转回去读自己的文章，不再打扰你这一侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You did say no more rounds. Sorry. I'll let you sit.
beats.chinese: 你已经说了不继续。抱歉。你安静坐着吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Patricia finds the opening paragraph while you remain beside the table for your brief round.
beats.chinese: 你在桌旁稍作停留，进行约好的短短一轮。Patricia找到了开头那一段。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It says a good host agrees with their guests. If I did that, Maureen would have to argue with herself all evening.
beats.chinese: 它说，好主人会赞同客人的意见。我要真照做，Maureen整晚就只能自己跟自己争了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She underlines the sentence. As you turn to continue looking around, she brings the page closer and begins writing in the margin.
beats.chinese: 她在那句话下面画了线。你转身继续参观时，她把纸拉近，开始在页边写字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That'll do for my opening objection. Enjoy your look round.
beats.chinese: 开场的反对意见就用这个了。你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You move on through the clear space around the tables. Patricia gives you a small nod.
beats.chinese: 你沿着桌子之间畅通的空间继续走。Patricia朝你轻轻点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. It's only a few pages. I've made rather a meal of it.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。其实就这么几页，被我折腾了好半天。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gathers the loose pages into order and returns to the paragraph she was reading.
beats.chinese: 她将散开的纸页理好，重新读起刚才那一段。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. End of the page before I start disagreeing again.
beats.chinese: 好了。先读完这一页，再接着挑毛病。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the Wolfson Reading Room, Patricia Wren is reading a short essay at a table. She looks up and recognises you.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到沃尔夫森阅览室时，Patricia Wren正在桌边读一篇短随笔。她抬起头，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello. I've just read a paragraph I'd very much like to argue with.
beats.chinese: 哦，你好。我刚读到一段话，特别想反驳几句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Keeping her voice low, she writes a line in her own notes, then sets down her pen and returns her attention to the essay.
beats.chinese: 她始终压低着声音，在自己的笔记上写下一行，随后搁下笔，将注意力转回随笔。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll let it win on paper for ten minutes. I'll finish reading it first.
beats.chinese: 先让它在纸上赢十分钟。我读完再说。

causality.presenceReason: Patricia来曼彻斯特中央图书馆的Wolfson阅览室读完一篇打印随笔，为之后与Maureen的例行反方辩论做准备。
causality.placeAttitude: 她愿意在这里阅读，交谈时压低声音，纸页和随身物品不占用他人座位或通行空间。
causality.stayingConstraint: 随笔尚未读完，她准备留在桌前完成阅读和简短笔记，不需要玩家留下陪她。
causality.currentGoal: 为自己喜欢的文章找到反对理由，以准备与Maureen之间输家请喝茶的辩论。
causality.currentState: 她今天有闲心发出一句话即可回答的小邀请，愿意接住玩笑，也允许玩家站着回应或结束交谈。迟半拍才收住的缺点只在玩家明确要求安静的ab路径中显现。
causality.contactTrigger: 包从一开始就放在她自己的椅下，旁椅空着。玩家来到桌端附近时，她暂时放下笔，低声询问喜欢文章却寻找反对理由究竟算认真阅读还是自找事情，并说明不必坐下，只借一句判断。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留她以争辩表示亲近、认真复述对方观点、随手计分、提及羽毛球以及迟半拍才停止争辩的特点。保留Maureen、茶钱赌约和反驳自己喜欢的随笔的既有习惯，不改变职业、背景、居住历史或关系边界。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Jackson Square, Camille Broussard has paused beside the public path, with the Jackson statue and St. Louis Cathedral beyond her. She came for a short walk before taking a newly filled archive binder home. She holds a label firmly beside the binder's spine.
beats.chinese: 在杰克逊广场，Camille Broussard停在公共步道一侧，身后可见杰克逊雕像和圣路易斯主教座堂。她带着刚装满的档案夹，打算回家前散一小会儿步。她稳稳捏着一张标签，放在档案夹书脊旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Last label. Then I'm off duty.
beats.chinese: 最后一张，贴完就下班。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She glances up from the binder and notices you nearby. Keeping the label in her hand, she shifts closer to the side of the path to leave room for people to pass.
beats.chinese: 她从档案夹上抬起目光，注意到附近的你。她仍拿稳标签，往步道一侧挪了挪，留出让行人通过的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm not rushing you. I have to say it out loud before I'll stop.
beats.chinese: 不是催你。我得把话说出来，才肯停手。

choices.english: “What are you filing?”
choices.chinese: “你在整理什么档案？”

choices.english: “All right. I'll let you finish.”
choices.chinese: “明白。那不打扰你收尾了。”

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Camille tilts the binder slightly toward you, keeping the label between her fingers. The binder's clear cover holds an old handwritten shift grid.
beats.chinese: Camille把档案夹稍稍朝你倾斜，手指仍捏着标签。档案夹的透明封面里放着一张旧的手写排班表。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Old film-festival schedules. I schedule the volunteers here in New Orleans. Nine seasons of paper.
beats.chinese: 电影节以前的排班表。我在新奥尔良给电影节志愿者排班。攒了九季的纸。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the binder so she can reach its spine and holds the label against it.
beats.chinese: 她把档案夹转过来，露出书脊，将标签比在上面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This one's full. It needs its year on the spine before it goes on my shelf.
beats.chinese: 这本满了。得先在书脊上贴好年份，才能上我家的书架。

choices.english: “What do you do when you're off duty?”
choices.chinese: “那你不工作的时候做什么？”

choices.english: “I'll leave you to finish. Goodbye.”
choices.chinese: “那不打扰你收尾了。再见。”

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Camille gives you a small nod and turns her attention back to the label, holding it by the corners.
beats.chinese: Camille朝你轻轻点头，把注意力转回标签上，捏着它的两个角。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. Last label. Then nine years of festival shift grids are filed.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。最后一张标签了。贴完，九年的电影节排班表就全归档了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She presses one end onto the binder's spine, stops, and lifts it again. It was barely crooked.
beats.chinese: 她把标签的一端按上档案夹书脊，停住，又揭了起来。它只是歪了那么一点点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nearly. I brought this out for a walk and haven't let it leave my hands.
beats.chinese: 差一点。我带着它出来散步，到现在还没撒过手。

choices.english: “I'd leave it crooked.”
choices.chinese: “我的话，歪一点就算了。”

choices.english: “Is your own calendar that tidy?”
choices.chinese: “你自己的日程表也这么整齐吗？”

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Camille rests the loose label against the binder under her thumb. Her free hand makes a quick sideways blocking motion.
beats.chinese: Camille用拇指把松开的标签压在档案夹上，另一只手迅速向侧面一挡。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Tabletop air hockey. Got a real set for my kitchen table. The table's losing.
beats.chinese: 桌上气垫球。我买了套真的，摆在厨房餐桌上。现在输的是餐桌。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She smiles, applies the label, and slides the binder into her bag. She turns along the public path, keeping clear of passing walkers.
beats.chinese: 她笑了笑，贴好标签，把档案夹装进包里，转身沿公共步道走去，避开经过的行人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Permanent scuff in the felt. Worth it. Enjoy the square.
beats.chinese: 毡面磨出一道印子，消不掉了。值。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Camille gives you a small nod and turns the binder back toward herself.
beats.chinese: Camille朝你轻轻点头，把档案夹转回自己面前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. I'll finish this.
beats.chinese: 好。我把这点收完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stays beside the path as you take your leave. Before pressing the label down, she checks its position against the edge twice.
beats.chinese: 你告辞时，她仍留在步道一侧。按牢标签之前，她对着边缘检查了两遍位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Goodbye. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 再见。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Camille glances up with a small smile, still holding the lifted corner of the label.
beats.chinese: Camille抬眼微微一笑，手里仍捏着标签揭起的一角。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You could. I'd see it every time I reached for the binder.
beats.chinese: 你可以。我每次伸手拿这本档案夹，都会看见它歪着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She straightens the label and smooths it firmly with both thumbs. Then she puts the binder away and gives you a brief farewell nod.
beats.chinese: 她把标签摆正，用两个拇指仔细压平，随后收好档案夹，向你点头道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. You won't have to watch me do that a third time. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 好了。不用让你看我贴第三遍了。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Camille lets out a short laugh and finishes pressing down the label.
beats.chinese: Camille短促地笑了一声，把标签彻底按牢。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mine? October's a mess. I can schedule two hundred volunteers and book myself twice.
beats.chinese: 我的？一到十月就乱套。我能给两百名志愿者排班，轮到自己就能把两件事排在同一时间。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pulls a folded calendar from her bag and taps two entries. With a shrug, she folds it again without changing either and puts it beside the finished binder.
beats.chinese: 她从包里抽出一张折好的日程表，点了点上面的两条记录。她耸耸肩，一条也没改，又折起来，塞到贴好标签的档案夹旁边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Both at two. Yes, that sounds like me. Anyway, enjoy the square. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 都是两点。嗯，是我能干出来的事。总之，祝你逛得愉快。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Jackson Square, Camille stands at the side of the public path, looking at her phone. The statue and cathedral line up behind her. She notices you and raises a hand.
beats.chinese: 在杰克逊广场，Camille正站在公共步道一侧看手机，身后的雕像与主教座堂处在同一条轴线上。她注意到你，抬手打了个招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. Set my swim alarm for seven at night. Very useful.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。我把游泳闹钟设成了晚上七点。可真管用。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She changes the alarm, checks the morning setting once more, and puts the phone away.
beats.chinese: 她改好闹钟，又确认了一遍是早晨，才把手机收起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Morning swim stays on the calendar. Have a good day.
beats.chinese: 好了。晨泳这项不能动。祝你今天愉快。

causality.presenceReason: 她带着刚装满的旧排班档案夹回家，先来杰克逊广场短暂散步，却忍不住处理最后一张年份标签。

causality.currentGoal: 贴好最后一张标签，收起档案夹，开始散步。
causality.currentState: 下班后话不多，注意力在手里的收尾工作上。她用出声宣布结束的方式催自己停手，发现附近有人后简短澄清，态度干脆而有礼。
causality.contactTrigger: 标签始终拿稳。她先对着档案夹说最后一张贴完就下班，随后向附近的玩家澄清自己并非催促对方，只是需要把收尾的话说出来才肯停手，不索取帮助。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Jackson Square, Emile Boudreaux is early to meet a friend he's helping move a cabinet. At the edge of the public path, he has gathered several leaf prints inside an envelope. He looks up as you approach.
beats.chinese: 在杰克逊广场，埃米尔·布德罗提前到了，等一位稍后要他帮忙搬柜子的朋友。他站在公共步道边，已把几张植物拓印拢进信封。你走近时，他抬起头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Excuse me. What time is it? I'm early. Just wondering how early.
beats.chinese: 劳驾，现在几点？我来早了，想知道还早多少。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He keeps the envelope against his blue jacket and slides the papers farther inside. A green leaf outline remains visible above the flap.
beats.chinese: 他把信封抵在蓝色夹克上，继续将纸张往里装。封舌上方还露着一片绿色的叶子轮廓。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Waiting on a friend. I'm helping move a cabinet. Said yes before I even asked how big it was.
beats.chinese: 等个朋友，要帮他搬柜子。连柜子多大都没问，我就答应了。

choices.english: I'll check the time. Did you make those prints?
choices.chinese: 我看一下时间。那些拓印是你做的吗？

choices.english: Sorry, I can't check. I'll give you room to get those packed.
choices.chinese: 抱歉，我没法看时间。我给你留点地方，你好把它们收起来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You check the time and tell him. Emile draws one sheet partway out and holds it by its corners. A flattened leaf has left a green outline and a scattering of darker marks.
beats.chinese: 你看了时间，告诉了他。埃米尔抽出一张纸，捏着两角。压平的叶片留下了绿色轮廓，周围散着深浅不一的印痕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Yes. Leaf under the paper. Hammer on top. I do these at home. The neighbors get a vote on when I stop.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。是我做的。叶子放纸下面，锤子在上面敲。我在家做这个。什么时候收工，邻居们也有发言权。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He separates it from a print bearing a small carved-stamp design, which he puts safely into the envelope. He holds the loose sheet out where you can see it.
beats.chinese: 他把它与另一张带有小印章图案的拓印分开，先将后者妥善装进信封，再把散着的这张举到你能看清的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That one's for an old neighbor. We mail one each month. This one's spare. You're welcome to it.
beats.chinese: 信封里那张是给老邻居的。我们每个月互寄一张。这张多出来了，你想要就拿着。

choices.english: I'll take it. What can I give you in return?
choices.chinese: 那我收下了。我能拿什么回赠你？

choices.english: I'll just look, then hand it back. Thank you.
choices.chinese: 我看看就还给你。谢谢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Emile gathers the papers against his jacket and shifts closer to the lawn's edge, keeping the public path clear.
beats.chinese: 埃米尔把几张纸拢在夹克前，又往绿地边缘靠了靠，留出公共步道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No trouble. Thanks for the room. I've brought one envelope and about six things that won't stay in it.
beats.chinese: 没事。谢谢你让出地方。我带了一个信封，还有大概六样怎么也不肯待在里面的东西。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lines up the bottom edges of the sheets. One corner catches on the envelope flap, and he presses it flat with his thumb.
beats.chinese: 他把几张纸的底边对齐。一个纸角卡在信封封舌上，他用拇指把它压平。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm staying right here till my friend comes. Apparently I needed something to argue with while I waited.
beats.chinese: 我得在这儿等朋友过来。看来等人的时候，我也得找点东西较劲。

choices.english: Is the envelope winning?
choices.chinese: 现在是信封占上风吗？

choices.english: All right. Take care.
choices.chinese: 好，那你慢慢收。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Emile gives you the spare print. At your offer to return the favor, his smile tightens and he immediately shakes his head.
beats.chinese: 埃米尔把多出来的拓印递给你。听见你提出回赠，他的笑容微微一僵，立刻摇头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nothing. I'd only hand it back.
beats.chinese: 什么都不用给。给了我也会退回去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He withdraws both hands and puts them around his remaining papers. He turns back toward the square to watch for his friend, ending the exchange with the print in your hands.
beats.chinese: 他收回双手，拢住剩下的纸张，转向广场等朋友。交谈就这样结束了，拓印留在你手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can owe me this little piece of paper. I'm in no hurry about it.
beats.chinese: 你就欠着我这张小纸片吧。我不急着收。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You take a brief look and return the print, as you said you would. Emile accepts it by the blank edge.
beats.chinese: 你照自己说的，短暂看过后便把拓印还了回去。埃米尔捏住空白边缘接过它。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure. That one's got a torn corner anyway. I caught it with the hammer.
beats.chinese: 行。这张本来也破了一个角，是我敲的时候碰坏的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slips the sheet behind the stamped print and closes the envelope flap over both. With nothing left to show, he lowers the packet and turns his attention back to waiting.
beats.chinese: 他把这张纸塞到盖过印章的拓印后面，用信封封舌压住两张纸。东西看完了，他放下纸包，继续留意等候的方向。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks for looking. I'd better get the rest packed away.
beats.chinese: 谢谢你愿意看看。我得把剩下的收好了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Emile looks at the raised paper corner, then presses it flat with two fingers.
beats.chinese: 埃米尔看看翘起的纸角，伸出两根手指把它压平。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: So far. I should've brought a bigger one.
beats.chinese: 暂时是。我该带个大点的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slides the last sheet inside and tucks the envelope beneath his arm. With the papers secured, he turns to scan the square for his friend.
beats.chinese: 他把最后一张纸推进信封，夹到胳膊下面。纸张终于收稳，他转身望向广场，寻找朋友的身影。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Now I can get back to wondering how big that cabinet is. Should've asked before I said yes.
beats.chinese: 好了。现在可以接着琢磨那个柜子到底多大了。答应之前就该问清楚。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At your goodbye, Emile looks up from the envelope and gives a small nod.
beats.chinese: 听见你道别，埃米尔从信封上抬起头，轻轻点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. You've got a clear path now.
beats.chinese: 你也保重。路上已经不挡着了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gathers the loose sheets under one hand and stays at the path's edge as you continue on. His attention returns to the envelope.
beats.chinese: 他用一只手压住散开的纸张，留在步道边缘。你继续前行，他重新低头整理信封。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bottom edge first. There we go.
beats.chinese: 先放下面这条边。这就对了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Jackson Square, Emile Boudreaux stands at the edge of the public path, with the Jackson statue and St. Louis Cathedral lined up beyond him. A message has just arrived on his phone. He looks up, recognizes you, and raises a hand.
beats.chinese: 在杰克逊广场，埃米尔·布德罗站在公共步道边，身后是处在同一轴线上的杰克逊雕像与圣路易斯主教座堂。他手里的手机刚收到一条消息。他抬头认出你，举手打了个招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey, good to see you. I was going to help a friend move some things. He just said he doesn't need me to come. I even brought my gloves.
beats.chinese: 嘿，很高兴见到你。本来要帮朋友搬东西，他刚说不用去了。我连手套都带了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pushes the gloves sticking out of his bag back inside. He types, "Call me next time you need a hand," sends the reply, and puts his phone away.
beats.chinese: 他把露在包口的手套塞回去，打下“下次需要再叫我”，发给朋友，随后收起手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Having half a day free is good. Just haven't figured out what to do with it yet.
beats.chinese: 空出半天倒是好事。就是还没想好拿它干什么。

causality.presenceReason: 埃米尔提前到杰克逊广场等朋友，稍后要帮对方搬柜子，利用等待时间把随身的植物拓印装进信封。
causality.placeAttitude: 他把广场当作约定碰面的公共地点，注意力主要在等朋友和整理纸张上，没有主动带人游览或教学的打算。
causality.stayingConstraint: 朋友尚未到达，他需要留在约定地点等待，玩家可以继续交谈或自行离开。
causality.currentGoal: 问清当前时间，知道自己早到了多少，同时把拓印收好并等朋友出现。
causality.currentState: 愿意进行简短、具体的交流，手头忙着装纸，对自己连柜子尺寸都没问就答应帮忙略有抱怨。
causality.contactTrigger: 他向经过的玩家礼貌询问时间。玩家可以查看并回答，再询问可见的拓印，也可以表示无法查看，给他留出整理空间。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留动手帮忙、过度答应他人、低调制作植物拓印与刻章、操作时自言自语，以及拒绝回报而让人情悬着的习惯。保留Gentilly成长、洪灾后在Metairie自建住房、Lower Ninth旧邻居关系及保温瓶密封件测试职业，不改写原背景。重逢中，帮忙取消让他稍感轻松，也因突然无事可做而有些失落。他仍回复朋友下次需要可以再叫他，不要求玩家安慰或安排时间。
causality.reactionAndChange: a承接玩家查看时间并询问拓印，他道谢后解释制作方法，再提出可赠送多余的一张。aa中玩家收下并提出回赠，他立即拒绝，留下未结的人情。ab中玩家只看后归还，他接受并收好。b承接玩家无法查看时间并让出空间，他礼貌接受，继续整理信封。ba中双方围绕难装的信封短暂打趣，他收稳纸张后继续等朋友。bb中玩家直接告辞，他礼貌放行并回到整理动作。初遇不再通过吹落或捡回纸张建立接触。重逢改为他刚收到朋友取消帮忙的消息，收好带来的手套并回复下次需要再叫他，最后谈到突然空出的半天，四拍直线结束。
causality.spatialContinuity: 初遇所有动作均在照片支持的公共步道边及绿地边界进行，保留通行空间，不进入草地。重逢仍在杰克逊广场公共步道边完成。拓印、信封、手机、包和为搬运带来的手套均为随身物品，不增设设施，也不转移到搬运现场。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Emile Boudreaux。本次重逢位于杰克逊广场，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Jackson Square, Yvonne Toups-Landry stands near the edge of the public path. She came to photograph the statue and St. Louis Cathedral for her siblings. She lowers her phone when she notices you near the edge of her frame.
beats.chinese: 在杰克逊广场，伊冯娜·图普斯-兰德里站在公共步道边。她来拍雕像和圣路易斯主教座堂，准备发给兄弟姐妹。发现你靠近取景范围边缘时，她放下手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I want a picture without catching anybody by accident. I'm Yvonne.
beats.chinese: 我想拍张照，不想不小心把谁拍进去。我叫伊冯娜。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps the phone pointed down and leaves the middle of the path clear.
beats.chinese: 她让手机镜头朝下，留出步道中间的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If you're staying there, do you mind being in it?
beats.chinese: 你要是在那儿待着，介意入镜吗？

choices.english: Oh, don't worry about me. Whatever's easiest.
choices.chinese: 哦，不用管我。怎么方便怎么来。

choices.english: I'd rather stay out of it. I'll pass behind you.
choices.chinese: 我不太想入镜。我从你身后过去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Yvonne's eyebrows draw together. Her reply comes quickly, before her friendly smile has quite faded.
beats.chinese: 伊冯娜皱起眉头。脸上友好的笑意还没完全退去，她就飞快地接了话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That doesn't tell me whether you want to be in it.
beats.chinese: 这可没说清楚你愿不愿意入镜。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She starts to raise the phone, then stops and holds it against her coat.
beats.chinese: 她刚要举起手机，又停下来，把手机贴在外套上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A yes or a no will do. I can work around either one.
beats.chinese: 愿意或不愿意都行。两种我都有办法拍。

choices.english: Then no, please leave me out. I'd like to keep looking from here.
choices.chinese: 那就不愿意，请别拍到我。我想继续在这里看看。

choices.english: Being in the photo is fine. I just didn't want to rush you.
choices.chinese: 拍到我没关系。我只是不想催你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You pass behind Yvonne. She waits until you are clear of the frame before lifting her phone.
beats.chinese: 你从伊冯娜身后经过。她等你离开取景范围，才举起手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. My sister sent me her view, so she's getting mine.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我姐姐给我发了她那边的风景，我也给她发一张。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes the photograph and checks it, squinting at the screen.
beats.chinese: 她拍下照片，眯着眼检查屏幕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nearly thirty years on the city's night hotline, and I keep forgetting daylight runs out. Retirement hasn't fixed my hours.
beats.chinese: 在市政热线值了将近三十年夜班，我总忘了天还会黑。退休也没把作息调过来。

choices.english: Enjoy your afternoon. I'll keep going.
choices.chinese: 祝你下午愉快。我继续走了。

choices.english: Do you take many pictures around here?
choices.chinese: 你常在这附近拍照吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Yvonne turns her phone upright and narrows the frame to the cathedral, leaving you and the statue out.
beats.chinese: 伊冯娜把手机竖过来，缩小取景范围，只拍主教座堂，把你和雕像都留在画面外。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. Just the cathedral, then. You can stay right there.
beats.chinese: 好，那就只拍主教座堂。你待在那儿就行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes one picture, checks its edges, and puts the phone away.
beats.chinese: 她拍了一张，检查画面边缘，然后收起手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There, you're clear. Enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 好了，没拍到你。慢慢看吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Yvonne looks up from her phone. Her eyebrows relax, though she takes a moment before answering.
beats.chinese: 伊冯娜从手机上抬起眼睛。她松开眉头，过了一会儿才回答。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Well, you weren't rushing me. I've had callers apologize longer than the actual call took.
beats.chinese: 嗯，你可没催我。以前有人打热线，光道歉就比说正事还久。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes the wider photograph with you in the frame, then lowers the phone and steps aside.
beats.chinese: 她拍下较宽的画面，也把你拍了进去，随后放下手机，往旁边让开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That'll do. My sister can complain about the crooked cathedral. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 这张行了。让我姐姐挑教堂拍歪了的毛病去吧。下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the public path. Yvonne turns slightly toward you without stepping into your way.
beats.chinese: 你沿着公共步道继续走。伊冯娜微微转向你，没有挡住你的路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. I've got what I came for.
beats.chinese: 你也是。我要拍的已经拍到了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts a hand in farewell, then looks down to send the photograph.
beats.chinese: 她抬手道别，随后低头发送照片。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now let's see how fast my sister finds something wrong with it.
beats.chinese: 现在看看我姐姐多快能挑出毛病来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Yvonne gives a short laugh and holds the screen closer to check the picture again.
beats.chinese: 伊冯娜短促地笑了一声，把屏幕拿近，又检查了一遍照片。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Only when my sister starts it. She sent a fine view, and I sent her the inside of my coat pocket.
beats.chinese: 只有我姐姐先发来的时候。她发了张漂亮风景，我回了张外套口袋里面的照片。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She selects the new photograph, sends it, and puts her phone away.
beats.chinese: 她选中新照片，发送出去，然后收起手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This one's an improvement. At least there's a building in it. Enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 这张有进步。至少拍到建筑了。下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Jackson Square, Yvonne stands at the edge of the public path, her phone still in her hand. She recognizes you and smiles.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到杰克逊广场时，伊冯娜站在公共步道边，手机还拿在手里。她认出你，笑了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Well now, hello again. My sister just asked to come sit with me tonight. I want the evening to myself.
beats.chinese: 哎呀，又见面了。我姐姐刚问今晚能不能过来坐坐。我今晚想自己待着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She types a short reply saying she isn't taking a last-minute visit tonight and suggesting they pick another time. She sends it, puts her phone away, and looks up with a warm smile.
beats.chinese: 她打了一条简短的回复，明确说今晚不接临时来访，提议另约时间。她发出消息，收起手机，抬头温和地笑了笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: When you want some quiet, you've got to say you want some quiet. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 想安静就得说想安静。下午愉快。

causality.presenceReason: 伊冯娜先收到姐姐的风景照，独自来广场拍雕像和主教座堂，准备回发给家人。
causality.placeAttitude: 她把本地广场当作可以随意来看看、拍张日常照片的地方，没有导览或工作的任务。
causality.stayingConstraint: 她希望趁天光拍完照片，同时不挡公共步道，也不在未询问时把陌生人拍进去。
causality.currentGoal: 取得一张能发给姐姐的清楚照片。
causality.currentState: 她心情轻松，愿意短聊，但对含糊回答反应过快，追问时语气会突然变硬。
causality.contactTrigger: 玩家位于取景边缘，她主动放下手机，询问玩家是否介意入镜。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留退休市政热线夜班接线员身份、晚睡作息、家庭往来和自嘲。她先说自己的要求，把客套当成没回答，得到澄清后也没有立即道歉。重逢保留她不接受临时来访的边界，她直接回复姐姐另约时间，对玩家仍然温和。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa中她接受不入镜要求，舍去雕像改拍教堂，玩家留在原处。ab中她得到许可拍下包含玩家的广角照，再让开结束。ba中玩家继续走，她挥手后发送照片。bb中玩家主动多问一句，她讲出误拍口袋的糗事，发送新照后告别。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程仅使用雕像与主教座堂轴线附近的公共步道。她调整手机方向和取景范围，不进入绿地、不增设设施，也不阻塞通行。重逢时她站在公共步道边回复消息，没有转移场景。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Yvonne Toups-Landry。本次重逢位于杰克逊广场，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Jackson Square, René Delacroix-Toups stands at the edge of the public path with a secondhand travel paperback. They finish a short passage, close the book with the bookmark securely inside, and look toward the Jackson statue and St. Louis Cathedral.
beats.chinese: 在杰克逊广场，勒内·德拉克鲁瓦-图普斯拿着一本二手旅行平装书，站在公共步道边。勒内读完一小段，把书签稳稳夹好，合上书，望向杰克逊雕像和圣路易斯主教座堂。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This page makes it all sound very lively. I rather prefer what's in front of us.
beats.chinese: 这页写得很热闹。我倒比较喜欢眼前这个。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: René glances toward you, holding the closed book at their side and leaving room for passing walkers.
beats.chinese: 勒内朝你看了一眼，把合上的书拿在身侧，给过往行人留出空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm René, by the way.
beats.chinese: 对了，我叫勒内。

choices.english: What are you reading about?
choices.chinese: 你在读什么内容？

choices.english: I'll leave you to your reading.
choices.chinese: 你继续看书吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: René turns the worn paperback over, checking its cover through round glasses.
beats.chinese: 勒内翻过那本旧平装书，透过圆眼镜看了看封面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A man takes the wrong bus and spends a whole chapter blaming the directions.
beats.chinese: 一个人坐错了巴士，用了整整一章来埋怨路线说明。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: René rests the closed book against one palm and turns their attention back to you.
beats.chinese: 勒内把合上的书托在一只手里，重新把注意力转向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I dispatched luggage for long-distance buses here for thirty-one years. Bags went the wrong way too. Filed fewer complaints.
beats.chinese: 我在这里做了三十一年长途巴士行李调度。行李也会走错方向。不过投诉少些。

choices.english: One quick joke before I go. A suitcase takes a holiday alone. Why? It needs some space. I'll let you read now.
choices.chinese: 走之前讲个小笑话。行李箱为什么独自去度假？因为它需要一点空间。你继续看吧。

choices.english: Does knowing the ending spoil a book for you?
choices.chinese: 知道结局会影响你看书的兴致吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: René nods and opens the book, keeping the bookmark firmly under a thumb.
beats.chinese: 勒内点点头，翻开书，用拇指牢牢压住书签。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. I've been on this paragraph for a while.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。这一段，我已经看了好一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Before reading, René glances up at the Jackson statue, then toward St. Louis Cathedral along the square's central axis.
beats.chinese: 继续读之前，勒内抬头看看杰克逊雕像，又望向广场中轴线上的圣路易斯主教座堂。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I keep looking up. The book has competition.
beats.chinese: 我总忍不住抬头。这本书有竞争对手。

choices.english: Give a brief wave and continue along the public path.
choices.chinese: 轻轻挥手，沿公共步道继续走。

choices.english: I'll look at the cathedral for a moment. No need to put your book away.
choices.chinese: 我在这儿看看教堂。你不用收起书。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: René listens through the whole joke without interrupting. A small laugh comes a beat after the punchline.
beats.chinese: 勒内听完了整个笑话，没有打断。包袱说完，隔了一拍，才轻轻笑出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. A suitcase does get rather crowded.
beats.chinese: 有道理。行李箱里面确实挺挤。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the path, René starts to reopen the paperback, then pauses with a finger beneath its cover.
beats.chinese: 你沿步道继续走。勒内正要重新打开书，却把手指停在封面下面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, I have heard that one. One of our drivers told it often. Thank you for telling it. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 哦，这个我听过。以前有个司机常讲。谢谢你讲给我听。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: René considers the question with the book resting loosely between both hands.
beats.chinese: 勒内双手松松地拿着书，想了想你的问题。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. I read this one years ago. I'd forgotten how much the man complains.
beats.chinese: 不会。这本我多年前看过。我都忘了这个人有多爱抱怨。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: René secures the bookmark, tucks the book under one arm, and resumes walking along the public path.
beats.chinese: 勒内放稳书签，把书夹在臂下，沿公共步道重新迈开步子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's enough of him for now. I'll finish my walk. Good talking to you.
beats.chinese: 暂时听他抱怨到这里吧。我接着散步了。很高兴和你聊了几句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: René returns your small wave as you continue along the path.
beats.chinese: 你沿步道继续走，勒内也轻轻挥手回应。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care.
beats.chinese: 慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: René closes the unread page and holds the book at their side, looking back toward the statue while leaving the path clear.
beats.chinese: 勒内合上还没读下去的那一页，把书垂在身侧，又望向雕像，没有挡住步道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. The paragraph can wait.
beats.chinese: 嗯。那一段可以再等等。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You turn your attention toward the cathedral. René makes no attempt to draw you into another exchange.
beats.chinese: 你把目光转向教堂。勒内没有试着继续找话题。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. I'll get on with this.
beats.chinese: 好。我接着看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: René adjusts their round glasses and opens the paperback. The bookmark remains securely tucked between the pages.
beats.chinese: 勒内扶了扶圆眼镜，翻开平装书。书签仍稳稳地夹在书页之间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy the view.
beats.chinese: 慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Jackson Square, you encounter René at the edge of the public path. They finish a phone call, lower the phone, and recognize you.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到杰克逊广场，你碰见勒内站在公共步道边。勒内结束通话，放下手机，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Just got off the phone with an old colleague from the depot. He told me a familiar story again.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。刚跟以前车站的同事通完电话。他把一个熟故事又讲了一遍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: René slips the phone into a pocket and looks across the square. A few seconds pass before they turn back to you.
beats.chinese: 勒内把手机放进口袋，望向广场。过了几秒，才转头看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This time I said at the start that I'd heard it. He told the whole thing anyway. It was good.
beats.chinese: 这回我开头就说听过了。他还是讲完了。挺好。

causality.presenceReason: 勒内散步来到杰克逊广场，在公共步道边读随身带的二手旅行书。
causality.placeAttitude: 勒内愿意在广场停留，读完一小段后看向雕像与教堂，更喜欢眼前的景象，并非专程找陌生人聊天。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须等候的人或事务，可以继续阅读或散步，停留时始终让开通行空间。
causality.currentGoal: 读完一小段后看看广场，再随兴决定继续阅读还是散步。
causality.currentState: 今天不赶时间，注意力会从书页转向周围景象，对短暂交谈友善，但不要求附近的人回应，也不主动延长接触。
causality.contactTrigger: 勒内合上夹好书签的书，面对共同可见的雕像与教堂，向附近玩家简短表达自己更喜欢眼前景象，随后介绍名字。没有物品掉落或求助，玩家可以问书的内容，也可以让勒内继续独处。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the lit sidewalk of Frenchmen Street's 600 block, Emile Landry is taking a break on his walk home. He is drawing a map on a sheet held inside his notebook. When the music from a club pauses, he looks toward you.
beats.chinese: 法国人街600街区亮着街灯的人行道上，埃米尔·兰德里在步行回家的途中停下来歇脚。他把一张纸压在随身笔记本里画地图。俱乐部里传出的音乐暂时停了，他朝你看过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Did that last tune end, or are they just taking a pause?
beats.chinese: 刚才那段结束了，还是只停一下？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rests his pencil point over a harbor on the map, keeping himself and the notebook clear of passing pedestrians.
beats.chinese: 他把笔尖停在地图上的一处港口上，自己和笔记本都避开行人的通行路线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Emile Landry. I want to hear the rest before I head home. This harbor can wait.
beats.chinese: 埃米尔·兰德里。我想听完再回家。这个港口可以等等。

choices.english: What harbor are you drawing?
choices.chinese: 你画的是哪个港口？

choices.english: I could help you work out where the roads go.
choices.chinese: 我可以帮你想想道路怎么走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Emile lifts the map sheet from his notebook and holds it where you can see.
beats.chinese: 埃米尔从笔记本里拿起地图纸，举到你能看清的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Made-up country. Coast first, roads after. I've erased this harbor twice.
beats.chinese: 编出来的国家。先画海岸，再画道路。这个港口已经擦掉重画两次了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He straightens the sheet against his closed notebook. Small islands and a crowded harbor fill the lower corner.
beats.chinese: 他把纸抵在合上的笔记本上理平。纸张下角画满了小岛和密密麻麻的港区。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Kept leaving the warehouses nowhere to unload. Hard on an imaginary shipping company.
beats.chinese: 老是画得仓库没地方卸货。虚构的船运公司也不好过。

choices.english: Can I see the rest of it?
choices.chinese: 能看看其他部分吗？

choices.english: I'll let you get back to drawing. Enjoy the music.
choices.chinese: 不打扰你画画了。好好听音乐吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At your offer, Emile draws the notebook closer to his chest, keeping the map inside it. His answer comes quickly.
beats.chinese: 听见你提出帮忙，埃米尔把笔记本往胸前收了收，地图仍压在里面。他很快接了话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll work out the roads myself. I've got it.
beats.chinese: 道路我自己来想。我能处理。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers the notebook again and looks up. His grip on it loosens.
beats.chinese: 他又放低笔记本，抬头看向你，手也握得松了些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks for offering. I've moved this road three times. Still want to finish it myself.
beats.chinese: 谢谢你愿意帮忙。这条路我已经挪了三次。还是想自己画完。

choices.english: All right. I'll give you room.
choices.chinese: 好。我给你留点地方。

choices.english: You sound like you work with your hands.
choices.chinese: 听起来你是做手上活儿的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Emile angles the sheet toward you, keeping both hands on its edges. Roads run inland from the harbor to three small towns.
beats.chinese: 埃米尔把纸转向你，双手仍握着纸边。几条道路从港口向内陆延伸，连接着三个小镇。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Freight road here. These little lines are ferries. The towns have names. Most of them are terrible.
beats.chinese: 这条是货运道路。这些短线是渡轮航线。镇子都有名字。大部分起得很糟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: After giving you a clear look, he folds the sheet into his notebook and slips the pencil into its spine.
beats.chinese: 让你看清之后，他把纸折好夹进笔记本，再把铅笔插进书脊处。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's the whole country so far. I'm putting it away before I add another customs office. Enjoy your evening.
beats.chinese: 目前整个国家就这些。得收起来了，免得又添一间海关。祝你今晚愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Emile turns the page back toward himself and checks the pencil point.
beats.chinese: 埃米尔把纸转回自己面前，检查了一下铅笔尖。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. One road left to move.
beats.chinese: 谢了。还剩一条路要挪。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sets the sheet against his notebook and erases a short stretch of road. His attention returns to the drawing, ending the conversation.
beats.chinese: 他把纸垫在笔记本上，擦掉一小段道路，注意力重新回到画上，交谈就此结束。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a good night.
beats.chinese: 晚上过得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Emile nods as you give him space. He smooths the sheet once, then again over the same crease.
beats.chinese: 你让出空间，埃米尔点了点头。他把纸抹平了一遍，又沿着同一道折痕抹了一遍。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Appreciate it.
beats.chinese: 谢了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stops working at the crease and puts the paper and pencil away. With a brief nod, he starts along the sidewalk, leaving the conversation behind.
beats.chinese: 他不再折腾那道折痕，收好纸和铅笔，简短地点头告别，沿着人行道走开了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enough drawing for tonight. Night.
beats.chinese: 今晚画够了。晚安。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Emile settles the map sheet inside his notebook. He looks at his pencil-marked fingers before answering.
beats.chinese: 埃米尔把地图纸放好夹进笔记本，回答前先看了一眼沾着铅笔印的手指。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Stage rigging. Rope work for local theaters. Eleven years.
beats.chinese: 舞台吊挂。给本地剧院做绳索活儿。十一年了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rubs the graphite with his thumb, only spreading it. He gives up, pockets the notebook, and turns one ear toward the music.
beats.chinese: 他用拇指蹭了蹭铅笔印，反而蹭开了。他不再擦，把笔记本收进口袋，侧过耳朵听音乐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Rope washes off easier than pencil. I'm off duty, though. Going to listen a minute. Good night.
beats.chinese: 摸绳子倒比画铅笔画容易洗干净。不过我下班了。再听一会儿。晚安。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another evening, at the edge of the lit sidewalk on Frenchmen Street's 600 block, Emile recognizes you. His notebook is still open in his hands.
beats.chinese: 另一个晚上，法国人街600街区亮着街灯的人行道边，埃米尔认出了你。他手里的笔记本仍摊开着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey. Good to see you. That stretch of road looks wrong any way I draw it. Tonight it won't connect.
beats.chinese: 嘿。见到你挺好。那段路怎么画都别扭。今晚先不让它通了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He erases a stretch of line leading inland from the harbor, then pulls the pencil back to check the empty space. He stays clear of passing pedestrians.
beats.chinese: 他擦去港口通向内陆的一段线，把铅笔退开，检查空出来的位置。他始终给过往行人留着通行空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Harbor's still there. No road for now. Better than drawing one I don't want.
beats.chinese: 港口还在。路暂时没有。总比画一条我不想要的强。

causality.presenceReason: 埃米尔下班步行回家，在法国人街600街区停下来听俱乐部内传出的音乐，同时画自己的虚构地图。
causality.placeAttitude: 他愿意在这里短暂停留，听完音乐再走，没有承担接待、导览或协助陌生人的职责。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须留下的任务。想听完音乐是他自己的打算，可以自行收起地图并结束停留。
causality.currentGoal: 初遇时，他想修改地图上的港口与道路，并听完室内传出的音乐再回家。重逢时，他仍在主动修改地图，擦去不满意的道路后继续查看，尚未找到满意的画法。
causality.currentState: 他处于下班后的专注状态，愿意因音乐的停顿向旁人问一句，也能简短聊地图。别人提出参与道路设计时，他会立即收紧姿态，坚持自己完成。重逢时，他能自然招呼熟人，但注意力仍在尚未画满意的地图上。

causality.characterContinuity: 保留本地舞台吊挂职业、虚构地图兴趣、简短直白的说话方式和围绕货运细节的平淡幽默。他把玩家对道路设计的帮助提议视作对自己作品的介入，反应略快、姿态绷紧，随后礼貌致谢，但仍不交出任务。重逢中，他自行擦去不满意的道路，以干巴巴的评论说明当前取舍，继续自己修改，不展示教学，也不邀玩家接手。
