beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the lit sidewalk of Frenchmen Street's 600 block, Odile Prejean stands clear of the walking space. Here for an evening of brass music, she ends a work call, folds her linen schedule, and smiles at you nearby.
beats.chinese: 法国人街600街区亮着路灯的人行道边，奥迪尔·普雷让站在不妨碍通行的位置。她今晚是来听铜管乐的，结束一通工作电话后，她折起布草排班表，朝附近的你笑了笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Evening, dawlin'. Towels can wait till tomorrow. Tonight I'm only in charge of listening to music.
beats.chinese: 晚上好，亲爱的。毛巾的事等明天再说。今晚我只负责听音乐。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She glances at her phone screen again, keeping the folded schedule in her other hand.
beats.chinese: 她又瞥了一眼手机屏幕，另一只手仍拿着折好的排班表。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Odile. Supposed to be off duty, looking for some brass.
beats.chinese: 我叫奥迪尔。本该下班了，出来找点铜管乐听听。

choices.english: Did work follow you here?
choices.chinese: 工作追到这儿来了？

choices.english: Enjoy the music. Good night.
choices.chinese: 好好听音乐。晚安。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Odile stays clear of the walking space. She taps the folded schedule against her palm.
beats.chinese: 奥迪尔站在不妨碍通行的位置，用折好的排班表轻拍掌心。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Marsha needed a towel pickup moved. I coordinate linens for a few guesthouses. One call turned into four.
beats.chinese: 玛莎要改毛巾收取安排。我给几家旅馆协调布草。一通电话，最后打成了四通。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks her phone, closes a scheduling-app reminder, and opens her contacts instead.
beats.chinese: 她看了眼手机，关掉排班应用的提醒，转而打开联系人列表。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Owners want everything in that app. It would save calls, I'll give them that. Marsha wouldn't get to tell me about her awful nephew, though.
beats.chinese: 老板们想把一切都搬进那个应用。电话会少打些，这点我认。可玛莎就没机会跟我念叨她那个糟心侄子了。

choices.english: You could use the app and still call Marsha.
choices.chinese: 你可以用应用，也照样给玛莎打电话。

choices.english: I'll leave you to your evening. Enjoy the music.
choices.chinese: 那就不耽误你过夜生活了。好好听音乐。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Odile tucks her bag close and gives you a quick nod as you say goodbye.
beats.chinese: 听你告别，奥迪尔把包拢到身前，利落地点了点头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You go on ahead, baby. I won't keep you.
beats.chinese: 你先走吧，亲爱的。不耽误你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds the schedule once more. A list headed Sheets and Towels faces outward before she slips it under her arm.
beats.chinese: 她把排班表又折了一次。一份标题为“床单与毛巾”的清单朝外露了一瞬，随后被她夹到腋下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll get these papers put away. Have a good evening, dawlin'.
beats.chinese: 我把这些纸收好。晚上过得愉快，亲爱的。

choices.english: Thanks. Good night. Keep walking.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，晚安。继续往前走。

choices.english: Are those deliveries for the clubs? Just curious before I go.
choices.chinese: 那些是给俱乐部送的货吗？走之前随口问问。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Odile pauses with her thumb over Marsha's contact. She gives a quick nod without opening the app again.
beats.chinese: 奥迪尔的拇指停在玛莎的联系人名字上。她飞快地点了下头，却没有重新打开应用。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You're right. That's what the owners said on Monday, too.
beats.chinese: 你说得对。老板们星期一也是这么说的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She presses Call and lifts the phone to her ear, turning slightly away to end the conversation.
beats.chinese: 她按下拨号，把手机举到耳边，略微转过身，结束了交谈。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll sort the app out tomorrow. Marsha's pickup first. Good talking to you, dawlin'.
beats.chinese: 应用的事我明天再弄。先把玛莎那趟收货安排好。跟你聊得挺好，亲爱的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Odile looks from her contact list toward a club doorway and locks the phone.
beats.chinese: 奥迪尔把目光从联系人列表移向一家俱乐部的门口，锁上了手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you, baby. I've spent enough of this evening discussing towels.
beats.chinese: 谢谢你，亲爱的。今晚花在谈毛巾上的时间已经够多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the phone and schedule into her bag, then heads toward the doorway with a brief wave.
beats.chinese: 她把手机和排班表收进包里，简短地挥挥手，朝门口走去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm going to see who's playing. You have yourself a good night.
beats.chinese: 我去看看谁在演奏。祝你今晚愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the sidewalk. Odile keeps her bag tucked in until you have passed.
beats.chinese: 你沿人行道继续前行。奥迪尔一直把包收在身前，直到你走过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You're welcome, dawlin'.
beats.chinese: 不客气，亲爱的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives a small wave, then turns back to fold the protruding corner of her schedule into her bag.
beats.chinese: 她轻轻挥了一下手，随即转回去，把露在包外的排班表一角折进去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good night now.
beats.chinese: 晚安啦。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Odile shakes her head and taps the folded list under her arm.
beats.chinese: 奥迪尔摇摇头，拍了拍腋下折好的清单。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Guesthouses. Sheets, towels, pickups. I've coordinated their linen runs for years. No club shift for me.
beats.chinese: 是旅馆的。床单、毛巾、收送。我替他们协调布草运输好多年了。我可不在俱乐部值班。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her phone rings. She checks the screen, silences it, and puts both phone and list away.
beats.chinese: 她的手机响了。她看看屏幕，按掉铃声，把手机和清单一起收了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And that can wait till morning. I'm here for music. Take care, baby.
beats.chinese: 这事也可以等到明早。我是来听音乐的。慢走，亲爱的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Frenchmen Street's 600 block, Odile recognizes you at a street-facing club doorway just as she is about to go inside.
beats.chinese: 另一个夜晚，在法国人街600街区一家临街俱乐部的门口，奥迪尔正准备进去，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello, dawlin'! Finally, a night when I'm not taking linen calls.
beats.chinese: 你好呀，亲爱的！今晚终于不接布草工作的电话了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her phone rings. She looks at the caller's name and pauses, then declines the call and sends a short reply saying, “Tomorrow morning.”
beats.chinese: 她的手机响了。她看见来电人的名字，停了一下，随后挂断电话，发了一条简短回复：“明早再说。”

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Music goes first today. Good seeing you, baby.
beats.chinese: 今天先把音乐排在前面。见到你真好，亲爱的。

causality.presenceReason: 奥迪尔原本来法国人街听铜管乐，抵达后仍在处理玛莎提出的毛巾收取调整。她结束一通工作电话后，暂时站在人行道边折起排班表。
causality.placeAttitude: 这里是她喜欢的音乐消遣地点，不是她负责布草工作的场所。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须留下的硬性约束。手机和未完全处理完的工作仍牵住她的注意力，她可以继续联系熟人，也可以收起工作走向俱乐部门口。
causality.currentGoal: 收好排班表，结束工作联系，把晚上的时间留给音乐。
causality.currentState: 心情友善，说话利落，习惯向附近的人热情招呼。她嘴上说工作等明天，注意力却仍在手机上，尚未真正下班。
causality.contactTrigger: 她从一开始就站在不妨碍通行的人行道边。工作电话结束后，她折起排班表，主动向附近的玩家微笑问好，说今晚只负责听音乐。玩家可以询问工作，也可以简短告辞。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留布草协调工作、热情而有时间边界的交往方式、对熟人电话联系的依恋，以及对应用排班的拖延。通过关掉提醒和继续拨电话呈现缺点。保留她在新奥尔良出生、于Bywater长大且始终在本城生活的经历，不改动职业、婚姻往事与熟人关系。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家询问工作后，a中她说明旅馆布草协调工作和对电话联系的留恋。aa中承认建议合理却继续拖延应用设置，转去打工作电话。ab中接受告别，收好工作物品走向俱乐部门口。玩家直接告辞后，b中她礼貌让对方先行，不延长交谈。ba中玩家继续前行，双方简短道别。bb中她回应玩家临走前的提问，澄清旅馆工作与音乐消遣的区别，主动静音来电并结束交谈。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程使用600街区亮灯的人行道及临街俱乐部门口。初遇不包含挡路、碰撞或为玩家腾出通路的意外。纸张、包和手机均为工作带来的随身物品，没有增加公共设施或转移到其他场景。重逢发生在她准备进入的临街俱乐部门口。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Odile Prejean。本次重逢位于法国人街，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the lit sidewalk of Frenchmen Street's 600 block, Remy Toussaint-Bois is listening to music coming from a club. A quarter slips from their fingers and stops beside your shoe.
beats.chinese: 法国人街600街区亮着街灯的人行道上，Remy Toussaint-Bois正听着一家俱乐部里传出的音乐。一枚二十五美分硬币从Remy指间滑落，停在你鞋边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Okay so, that quarter escaped. I'm Remy. I came for the music and brought my own distraction.
beats.chinese: 好吧，这枚硬币逃跑了。我叫Remy。我是来听音乐的，结果自己带了个分心的玩意儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Remy points to the coin and waits rather than reaching across your feet.
beats.chinese: Remy指了指硬币，等在原地，没有直接伸手越过你的脚边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Could you give me a little room to pick it up?
beats.chinese: 能稍微让一点，让我捡一下吗？

choices.english: Step aside. “Go ahead. Was that supposed to be a magic trick?”
choices.chinese: 往旁边让一点。“请吧。刚才是想变魔术吗？”

choices.english: Step aside. “Sure. I'm just passing through.”
choices.chinese: 往旁边让一点。“当然。我只是路过。”

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Remy picks up the quarter and straightens, leaving room for people to pass.
beats.chinese: Remy捡起硬币，直起身，留出供行人通过的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah. Usually the coin disappears before it hits the pavement. Let me try one that stays in my hands.
beats.chinese: 对。一般应该在落地之前就消失的。我换个能把硬币留在手里的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Remy shows the quarter, passes it between their palms, then holds out two closed fists close to their chest.
beats.chinese: Remy亮出硬币，在两掌之间倒了一下，接着将两个拳头并排举在胸前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Which hand? You can skip the guessing if you want.
beats.chinese: 哪只手？不想猜也可以。

choices.english: “Your left. Keep it quiet if I'm right.”
choices.chinese: “你的左手。猜对了也小声点。”

choices.english: “I'll skip the guessing. Where did you learn that?”
choices.chinese: “我就不猜了。你在哪儿学的？”

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Remy retrieves the quarter and steps back from your path.
beats.chinese: Remy捡起硬币，后退一步，让开你的去路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yeah, got it. No sidewalk magic show.
beats.chinese: 好，明白。不在人行道上开魔术专场。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Remy puts the quarter in a pocket and presses the pocket shut with a palm.
beats.chinese: Remy把硬币放进口袋，又用手掌按住袋口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That should keep the rest of the performance under control.
beats.chinese: 这下应该能管住后面的演出了。

choices.english: “Have a good evening.” Continue along the sidewalk.
choices.chinese: “祝你今晚愉快。”沿人行道继续走。

choices.english: “You kept it out of the street. That's a win.”
choices.chinese: “至少没让它滚到街上。这也算成功。”

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Remy opens their left hand. The quarter lies flat against their palm.
beats.chinese: Remy张开左手，硬币平躺在掌心。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: YES! First guess!
beats.chinese: 对啦！一次就猜中了！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Their voice carries down the sidewalk. Remy starts to raise the coin, then lowers it and puts it away.
beats.chinese: 这一声传到了人行道另一头。Remy刚要举起硬币，又放下手，把它收了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That barely counted as a cheer. Okay, okay. I'm stopping. Have a good night.
beats.chinese: 这都算不上正式欢呼。好，好，我停。祝你今晚愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Remy opens both hands without making you guess and puts the quarter away.
beats.chinese: Remy直接摊开双手，没有再让你猜，随后收起硬币。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My uncle. He worked hotel lobbies. He could keep talking while his hands did something completely different.
beats.chinese: 跟我叔叔学的。他以前在酒店大堂工作。他能一边说个不停，手上一边干完全不同的事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Remy tries the empty-handed motion once. Their little finger sticks out awkwardly, and they tuck both hands into their pockets.
beats.chinese: Remy空手比画了一遍，小指却别扭地翘了出来，于是把两只手都插进口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I got the talking part. The fingers need work. Anyway, I'll let you go. Enjoy your evening.
beats.chinese: 说话这部分我学会了。手指还得练。好了，不耽误你了。祝你今晚愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the sidewalk. Remy stays clear of your path.
beats.chinese: 你沿人行道继续走。Remy留在一旁，没有挡住你的路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. Thanks for the room.
beats.chinese: 你也是。谢谢你让地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Remy gives a brief wave, then turns their attention toward the music from the club.
beats.chinese: Remy简短地挥挥手，随后把注意力转回俱乐部里传出的音乐。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The coin's staying put for the next song.
beats.chinese: 下一首歌期间，这硬币哪儿也别想去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Remy takes their hand off the pocket and grins.
beats.chinese: Remy把手从口袋上拿开，咧嘴笑了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You're counting that? Then I've got two. A printer's roller I reconditioned passed inspection today. No second sanding.
beats.chinese: 这也算？那我有两件了。我今天翻修的一根印刷机胶辊通过了检查，没用再磨第二遍。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Remy starts counting on their fingers, then catches sight of the club doorway and drops their hand.
beats.chinese: Remy开始掰着手指数，随后瞥见俱乐部门口，把手放了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I already told the whole shop. Nearly gave you the full version too. I'll leave it at two. Have a good night.
beats.chinese: 我已经跟整个车间说过了。差点也给你从头讲一遍。就说这两件吧。祝你今晚愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Frenchmen Street's 600 block, Remy is on the lit sidewalk, tapping two fingers against their sleeve to music from a club. They recognize you nearby.
beats.chinese: 另一个晚上，在法国人街600街区亮着街灯的人行道上，Remy正随着俱乐部里传出的音乐，用两根手指敲着袖子。Remy认出了附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey, good to see you. I came for one song. That was three songs ago.
beats.chinese: 嘿，又见到你了，真好。我本来只想听一首，结果已经过了三首。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The music stops. Remy's fingers keep tapping for two beats before they notice and smooth their sleeve.
beats.chinese: 音乐停了。Remy的手指又敲了两拍才反应过来，随手抚平了袖子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Okay, a break. Good time for me to head home. Enjoy your evening.
beats.chinese: 好，休息了。我也正好该回家了。祝你今晚愉快。

causality.presenceReason: Remy在玩家出现前就站在法国人街600街区人行道上，听俱乐部传出的音乐，顺手练习硬币手法。
causality.placeAttitude: 喜欢这里能听到音乐的夜间氛围，尚未决定是否进俱乐部，不承担招徕或导览职责。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须留下的义务，当前想听完音乐，交谈也只发生在不妨碍通行的位置。
causality.currentGoal: 先捡回掉在玩家鞋边的硬币，再根据玩家选择继续聊魔术或结束接触。
causality.currentState: 今晚轻松健谈，练习手法却不熟练，受到一点肯定就容易兴奋过头。
causality.contactTrigger: 硬币落在玩家鞋边，Remy先请求留出捡拾空间，不要求玩家代捡或参与表演。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留胶辊翻修职业、口袋魔术、叔叔的影响、抢先庆祝和得到引子后滔滔不绝的习惯。猜中分支中，玩家已经要求小声，Remy仍脱口大声庆祝并先辩解。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa猜中后遭遇过响的欢呼，Remy略带辩解地收场。ab放弃猜测，听到叔叔教手法的来历后告别。ba玩家直接离开，Remy礼貌让路并回去听音乐。bb玩家先点出一个小成功，Remy才连带说出工作上的成功，险些长篇展开后结束。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程停留在照片所示街区有街灯的人行道，俱乐部只提供室内传出的音乐和可见门口，没有增设设施或转场。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the French Market, Josephine Beaumont is waiting beside the clothes along the covered market's public passage. Her visiting friend wanted to browse here. Josephine notices you beside her and shifts away from the display.
beats.chinese: 在法国市场，约瑟芬·博蒙正等在棚廊公共通道旁的衣物摊位边。来访的朋友想逛这里。她注意到旁边的你，便往远离商品的方向挪了挪。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Am I in your way? I've picked a remarkably inconvenient place to wait.
beats.chinese: 我挡着你了吗？我可真会挑地方，站哪儿不好偏站这儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She settles beside the display, leaving room for people to pass, and glances along the stalls.
beats.chinese: 她在陈列区边上站好，给行人留出空间，又朝摊位那边看了一眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My friend wanted the French Market. I voted for a supermarket. My vote did poorly.
beats.chinese: 我朋友想逛法国市场。我投超市一票。我的票没起什么作用。

choices.english: I'd like to look at the clothes. Your friend may have a point.
choices.chinese: 我想看看这些衣服。你朋友的选择也许有道理。

choices.english: I'm just passing through. I'd vote for the supermarket too.
choices.chinese: 我只是路过。我也会投超市一票。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Josephine looks from you to the clothes, with one eyebrow raised.
beats.chinese: 约瑟芬看看你，又看看那些衣服，挑起一边眉毛。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I told her you can buy a shirt anywhere. Apparently that wasn't the ringing endorsement she wanted.
beats.chinese: 我跟她说，哪儿都能买衬衫。显然，这不算她想听到的大力推荐。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds her arms loosely, keeping clear of the merchandise.
beats.chinese: 她松松地抱起双臂，站在碰不到商品的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I prepare feed at the Audubon Aquarium. On a day off, another famous place is a hard sell.
beats.chinese: 我在奥杜邦水族馆配制饲料。休息日还要去著名景点，我就不太情愿了。

choices.english: Your friend doesn't spend every working day around visitors, though.
choices.chinese: 不过，你朋友可不是每个工作日都待在游客堆里。

choices.english: I'll take a look on my own.
choices.chinese: 我自己看看吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Josephine gives you a small, pleased nod, then looks down the line of stalls again.
beats.chinese: 约瑟芬略带满意地点点头，随后又朝一排摊位望去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's two votes. Sadly, my friend is the one visiting.
beats.chinese: 这就两票了。可惜，来做客的是我朋友。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She starts to shrug, then lets her shoulders drop.
beats.chinese: 她刚想耸肩，又把肩膀放了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I tried to cut her browsing short. She reminded me we'd agreed on half her list, half mine. Fair enough.
beats.chinese: 我刚还想让她少逛一会儿。她提醒我，说好了她的清单逛一半，我的逛一半。也对。

choices.english: What makes a supermarket a good outing for you?
choices.chinese: 对你来说，逛超市好在哪里？

choices.english: I'll leave you to your wait. Enjoy the rest of your day.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你等人了。祝你今天玩得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Josephine uncrosses her arms. She looks at the decorative goods beside the clothes instead of searching for her friend.
beats.chinese: 约瑟芬放下双臂，不再寻找朋友，转而看看衣物旁边的装饰物。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair point. She took a trip, and I keep trying to give her my regular Saturday.
beats.chinese: 有道理。人家是来旅行的，我却老想让她照着我平常的周六过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns toward the display without touching anything and gives you a brief smile.
beats.chinese: 她转向陈列的商品，没有伸手碰，又朝你短短一笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll have a look while she's looking. I'm keeping my half of the afternoon, though. Enjoy your browse.
beats.chinese: 她逛着，我也看看。不过下午属于我的那一半，我可得留着。你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Josephine immediately lowers her arms and moves farther along the edge of the public passage.
beats.chinese: 约瑟芬立刻放下双臂，沿着公共通道边缘又挪开了一点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure. You don't need my commentary on every shirt.
beats.chinese: 当然。你也不需要每看一件衬衫都听我点评。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns her attention back toward the other stalls, leaving the clothes unobstructed.
beats.chinese: 她把注意力转回其他摊位的方向，不再挡着衣物陈列区。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll wait over here. Take your time.
beats.chinese: 我在这边等。你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Josephine turns back to you with an easier smile.
beats.chinese: 约瑟芬转回身来，笑容轻松了些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nobody knows me. I can spend ten minutes comparing crackers and nobody asks how my whole family is.
beats.chinese: 没人认识我。我可以花十分钟比较饼干，也没人过来问我全家近况。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her friend comes toward her along the public passage. Josephine lifts a hand in acknowledgment and turns to meet her.
beats.chinese: 她的朋友沿公共通道走来。约瑟芬抬手示意，转身迎向朋友。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My family gets the full report later anyway. There's my friend. Have a good one.
beats.chinese: 反正回头家里还是会问个遍。我朋友来了。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Josephine nods goodbye and takes out her phone to check for a message from her friend.
beats.chinese: 约瑟芬点头道别，拿出手机，看看朋友有没有发消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Enjoy yours too.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。也祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the phone away and turns toward the stalls, staying at the edge of the passage.
beats.chinese: 她收起手机，转向摊位，仍站在通道边缘。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd better watch for her. I picked the meeting place, so I can't complain about that part.
beats.chinese: 我得留神看着她了。碰头的地方是我选的，这一项总不能抱怨。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the French Market, Josephine recognizes you outside the stalls along the covered public passage. She has her phone in hand, waiting for a reply from her friend.
beats.chinese: 另一天，在法国市场，约瑟芬在棚廊公共通道的摊位外侧认出了你。她正拿着手机，等朋友回复。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hi again. My friend wants to look around a bit longer. I've done all the browsing I'm up for.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。我朋友还想多看一会儿。我愿意陪着逛的时间已经用完了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She texts her friend to arrange to meet up later, then puts her phone away, leaving her friend to keep browsing.
beats.chinese: 她给朋友发消息，约好稍后再碰头，随后收起手机，让朋友继续慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We'll each do our own thing. Nobody has to pretend they're having a great time. I'm heading off.
beats.chinese: 各逛各的，谁也不用装得特别开心。我先走了。

causality.presenceReason: 来访朋友想逛法国市场，约瑟芬按双方各安排一半行程的约定陪同，正在衣物摊位旁等朋友。
causality.placeAttitude: 她偏爱无人认识自己的普通超市，对著名景点兴致不高，起初把自己的偏好当成更合理的选择。
causality.stayingConstraint: 她与朋友约在这里碰头，不能因自己觉得无聊便先走。
causality.currentGoal: 等朋友逛完，同时保留下午属于自己安排的那一半时间。
causality.currentState: 休息日精力平稳，有点不耐烦但保持礼貌，愿意简短交谈。
causality.contactTrigger: 她发现玩家就在身旁，意识到自己可能挡住衣物陈列，主动让开并询问是否挡路。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留水族馆饲料配制员职业、偏爱匿名购物的习惯、干幽默，以及轻视朋友观光愿望却能接受反驳和折中安排的特点。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa中接受玩家指出的视角差异，开始自己看商品但保留半天安排。ab中尊重独自浏览的选择，挪远并结束交谈。ba中简述匿名购物的乐趣，朋友到来后结束交谈。bb中礼貌道别，查看消息并专心等朋友。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程使用棚廊边的衣物、装饰物、其他商品与摊位外侧公共通道。人物让出通行空间，不增设设施或进入新场景。重逢发生在棚廊的摊位外侧，仅有查看手机、发消息和收起手机的动作，离开意向通过台词表达。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Josephine Beaumont。本次重逢位于法国市场，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the French Market, Reginald Toussaint stands outside a stall, comparing its decorations with a picture on his phone. He looks from a blue decoration to you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在法国市场，Reginald Toussaint站在摊位外侧，拿手机里的图片对照摊上的装饰物。他看看一件蓝色装饰物，又看向附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Looking only. No buying. You heard me, so now I've got myself a witness. No need to keep watch, though.
beats.chinese: 只看，不买。你听见了，算我给自己留个证人。不过不用盯着我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stays beside the stall and turns his phone slightly toward you. The screen shows a tiny cabinet made from scraps of foam and paneling. He leaves the merchandise untouched.
beats.chinese: 他仍站在摊位旁，把手机稍稍转向你。屏幕上是一个用泡沫边角料和护墙板做的小柜子。他没有碰摊上的商品。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Choosing a color for a cabinet in my little film. Looking only. Very important distinction this month.
beats.chinese: 给我拍的小短片里的柜子挑个颜色。只看，不买。这个月，这个区别非常重要。

choices.english: A film about a cabinet?
choices.chinese: 一部讲柜子的电影？

choices.english: Why only looking?
choices.chinese: 为什么只看不买？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Reginald turns the phone slightly toward you without moving closer.
beats.chinese: Reginald把手机稍稍转向你，没有凑近。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A cabinet door that won't stay shut. I renovate travel trailer interiors for a living, so yes, I hear how that sounds.
beats.chinese: 讲的是一扇怎么也关不上的柜门。我靠翻新旅行拖车内饰吃饭，所以，对，我知道这听着有点好笑。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He taps through several frames. The little door tilts, then drops off its hinge.
beats.chinese: 他点开连续几帧画面。小柜门歪向一边，接着从铰链上掉了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's scrap foam. Humidity gets into it. The hinge never had a fair chance.
beats.chinese: 用的是旧泡沫。湿气一进去就这样。那铰链根本没赶上好条件。

choices.english: I'd like to see the whole film.
choices.chinese: 我想看看完整的短片。

choices.english: Could the hinge be crooked?
choices.chinese: 会不会是铰链装歪了？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Reginald lowers his phone and looks back at the decorations.
beats.chinese: Reginald放低手机，又看向那些装饰物。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No new hobby supplies this month. I've got scrap foam and leftover paneling at my shop in New Orleans East. Plenty to use.
beats.chinese: 这个月不买新的爱好用品。我在新奥尔良东区的工坊里有泡沫边角料，还有剩下的护墙板。够用了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His free hand starts toward a blue ornament. He pulls his hand back into his pocket before touching anything.
beats.chinese: 他空着的那只手伸向一件蓝色装饰物。还没碰到任何东西，他就把手收回来，插进自己的口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Came here for color ideas. Now I'm trying to decide whether glue counts as a hobby supply.
beats.chinese: 本来是来找配色灵感的。现在倒开始琢磨，胶水到底算不算爱好用品。

choices.english: If it's for the film, I'd say it counts.
choices.chinese: 如果是拍短片用的，我觉得就算。

choices.english: I'll let you look. Enjoy the rest of your day.
choices.chinese: 那你慢慢看。祝你今天过得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Reginald holds the screen where you can see it and starts the eleven-second film.
beats.chinese: Reginald把屏幕停在你看得见的位置，播放那部十一秒的短片。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Three evenings to make eleven seconds. Please don't calculate my hourly rate.
beats.chinese: 三个晚上，拍了十一秒。拜托别算我的时薪。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The tiny door shuts, opens, and falls off. When the clip ends, he pockets the phone and turns back toward the blue decorations.
beats.chinese: 小柜门关上，又打开，然后掉了下来。短片放完，他收起手机，重新看向那些蓝色装饰物。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's all I've got so far. Now to find a blue I can mix from paint I already own. Enjoy your day.
beats.chinese: 目前就拍了这些。接下来得找个能用现有颜料调出来的蓝色。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Reginald immediately enlarges the frame with the fallen door.
beats.chinese: Reginald立刻放大了柜门掉落的那一帧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The hinge is square. The foam compresses around the pin, and this camera angle exaggerates the gap.
beats.chinese: 铰链装得很正。是转轴周围的泡沫压下去了，再加上这个拍摄角度，把缝隙显大了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rotates the phone, checks the image again, then closes the clip. His thumb stays pressed against the dark screen.
beats.chinese: 他转了转手机，又检查了一遍画面，随后关掉短片。拇指还按在已经暗下来的屏幕上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll allow that it looks crooked in that frame. I'm keeping the hinge. Anyway, I'll get back to these colors. Take care.
beats.chinese: 我承认，那一帧看着是歪的。铰链我还是要留着。好了，我接着看颜色。回见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Reginald pulls his hand from his pocket and raises one finger.
beats.chinese: Reginald把手从口袋里抽出来，竖起一根手指。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Glue is also a repair material. Plenty of perfectly ordinary repairs require glue.
beats.chinese: 胶水也属于维修材料。很多再普通不过的维修都得用胶水。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers the finger, pockets his phone, and turns away from the decorations toward the clothing along the same canopy.
beats.chinese: 他放下手指，收好手机，转身离开装饰物，朝同一片棚廊下的衣物走去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right, glue counts. I've got half a bottle anyway. I'll look at shirts. The cabinet doesn't need one. Have a good day.
beats.chinese: 好吧，胶水算。反正我还有半瓶。我看衣服去，柜子总不需要穿衣服。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Reginald gives you a quick nod and stays beside the decorations.
beats.chinese: Reginald朝你轻轻点头，留在装饰物旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. Enjoy looking around.
beats.chinese: 你也是。慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens a note on his phone and types a short color description. His other hand stays in his pocket.
beats.chinese: 他打开手机备忘录，输入一句简短的颜色描述。另一只手始终插在口袋里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. A note costs nothing. I can manage that much.
beats.chinese: 好了。记个笔记不花钱。这点我还是做得到的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the French Market, you spot Reginald beside the stalls, quietly singing from a folded sheet of music. He looks up and recognizes you.
beats.chinese: 在法国市场，你看见Reginald站在摊位旁，对着一张折过的乐谱轻声唱歌。他抬起头，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey, good to see you. I've sung those same two bars four times. Came for a look around and brought my homework.
beats.chinese: 嘿，见到你真好。同样的两小节，我已经唱了四遍。本来出来随便看看，结果把作业也带来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He examines three pencil circles on the page, then folds the music with the marked passage inside.
beats.chinese: 他看了看纸上的三个铅笔圈，把标记着的那一段折到了里面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ms. Ferrell circled it three times. She could've saved some pencil. I'll spare you attempt number five. Enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: Ferrell女士给它圈了三遍。她其实可以省点铅笔的。第五遍就不让你听了。祝你下午愉快。

causality.presenceReason: Reginald在玩家出现前已来法国市场，对照摊上装饰物，为自己的柜门定格短片寻找配色。
causality.placeAttitude: 他喜欢看商品的颜色，也容易动购买念头，但本月坚持不买新的爱好用品。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须留到某时的安排。他只在摊位外公共区域浏览，不碰商品，也不妨碍通行。
causality.currentGoal: 找到能用工坊现有颜料调出的蓝色，继续制作短片。
causality.currentState: 今天有闲心搭话，注意力主要放在颜色和手机上。看中蓝色后，他拿自己的禁购规则开玩笑，并明确不需要玩家监督。
causality.contactTrigger: 他始终站在法国市场摊位外侧，拿手机对照装饰物颜色。看中蓝色后，他向附近玩家打趣，说只看不买，请对方算作听见这句话的证人，随后展示手机上的微型柜子，让玩家选择询问短片或禁购规则。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the French Market, Emile Gravois looks over the clothes and decorations beside the covered public aisle. He holds a folded route notebook as he considers this stretch for a day trip with friends.
beats.chinese: 在法国市场，Emile Gravois看了看棚廊公共通道边的衣物和装饰品。他手里拿着折好的路线本，正考虑要不要把这一段排进与朋友的一日游。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Emile. Just looking at this stretch, would you allow ten minutes or half an hour?
beats.chinese: 我叫Emile。只看这一段，你会留十分钟，还是半小时？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances back at the displayed goods. The notebook stays folded in his hand.
beats.chinese: 他又看了一眼陈列的商品，手里的路线本仍折着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm planning a day out. The route's mostly done. Just settling how long to stop here.
beats.chinese: 我在规划一次一日游。路线差不多好了，只差确定在这里停多久。

choices.english: Maybe half an hour. Do you plan these trips often?
choices.chinese: 也许半小时吧。你经常规划这种出游吗？

choices.english: I'd rather browse on my own, thanks.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，不过我想自己逛逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Emile nods at your suggestion of half an hour. He leaves the notebook folded.
beats.chinese: 听到你建议留半小时，Emile点了点头，没有展开本子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Often enough. I cut sail canvas at a marine loft. On a day off, I like a route with very little rushing.
beats.chinese: 算是经常吧。我在一家船用帆布工坊做裁剪。休息时，我喜欢不用赶来赶去的路线。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He smooths a crease in the folded cover with his thumbnail.
beats.chinese: 他用拇指指甲压平折好封面上的一道折痕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This one's ninety percent settled. The return's worked out. Just putting times beside the stops.
beats.chinese: 这条已经定了九成。回程安排好了。只差给几个停留点标上时间。

choices.english: Could I see the route?
choices.chinese: 我能看看这条路线吗？

choices.english: What part do you enjoy planning?
choices.chinese: 你最喜欢规划哪一部分？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Emile turns slightly toward the stall side, leaving the public aisle clear without touching the displayed clothes or decorations.
beats.chinese: Emile稍稍转向摊位一侧，让公共通道保持畅通，没有碰到陈列的衣物和装饰品。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I won't keep you.
beats.chinese: 当然。不耽误你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers the folded notebook to his side and looks back at the goods.
beats.chinese: 他把折好的本子放低到身侧，重新看向商品。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy the market.
beats.chinese: 祝你逛得愉快。

choices.english: Give him a nod and continue along the public aisle.
choices.chinese: 向他点点头，沿公共通道继续走。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll look at these clothes on my own.
choices.chinese: 谢谢。我就在这儿自己看看衣服。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At your request to see the route, Emile draws the folded notebook closer and holds it firmly shut.
beats.chinese: 听到你想看路线，Emile把折好的本子收近，牢牢合住。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Once I've copied it cleanly. The return has two versions. Both worked out, just different roads.
beats.chinese: 等我誊清楚再看吧。回程有两个版本。都安排好了，就是走的路不同。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pockets the notebook and takes out his phone to record a message for his sister.
beats.chinese: 他把本子放进口袋，拿出手机，给姐姐录语音。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll let you browse. Renée, it's Emile. Route's ready. I'm only tidying the notes.
beats.chinese: 不耽误你逛了。Renée，我是Emile。路线好了。我只是在整理笔记。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Emile looks along the goods displayed beside the aisle, still holding the folded notebook.
beats.chinese: Emile仍拿着折好的本子，目光沿着通道边陈列的商品移过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The stretch you drive twice because you liked it. I leave room for that. Lunch gets moved around quite a bit.
beats.chinese: 就是那种因为喜欢，愿意再开一遍的路。我会给它留时间。午饭倒是经常挪来挪去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the notebook facing himself, writes a short note and tucks the pencil into the fold.
beats.chinese: 他让本子朝着自己展开，写下一条短短的备注，把铅笔夹进折页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've put half an hour for this stretch. That's one decision made. Thanks for the chat. Enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 我给这一段留了半小时。总算定下一件事。聊得挺好，祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the public aisle, Emile stays beside the stalls with the notebook shut.
beats.chinese: 你沿公共通道继续走，Emile留在摊位旁，本子仍合着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care.
beats.chinese: 慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slips the notebook into his pocket and turns his attention to the displayed decorations.
beats.chinese: 他把本子塞进口袋，转头看起陈列的装饰品。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Ten minutes or half an hour.
beats.chinese: 嗯。十分钟，还是半小时。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Emile stays beside the decorations, leaving you room to look at the clothes and keeping the aisle clear.
beats.chinese: Emile留在装饰品旁，给你留出看衣服的空间，也没有挡住通道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sure. Enjoy your look around.
beats.chinese: 好。你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the notebook toward himself and rests his pencil beside the market entry without writing anything.
beats.chinese: 他让本子朝着自己展开，把铅笔停在市场那条记录旁，没有写下什么。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mostly settled. Just the timing.
beats.chinese: 差不多定了。只差时间。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the French Market, Emile stands beside the stalls with one earbud in. He recognizes you and removes it.
beats.chinese: 在法国市场，Emile正站在摊位边，戴着一只耳机。他认出了你，把耳机摘下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I've paused this drama three times. Someone keeps opening the wrong door.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。这出广播剧我已经暂停三次了。一直有人开错门。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pauses the audio on his phone and winds the earbud cord loosely around his fingers.
beats.chinese: 他在手机上暂停播放，把耳机线松松地绕在手指上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I came for a look around. Then the missing brother turned up. I'll finish the episode before I move on.
beats.chinese: 本来是来随便逛逛的，结果失踪的弟弟出现了。我听完这一集再接着走。

causality.presenceReason: Emile独自来到法国市场，实地考虑是否把棚廊边这一段摊位纳入给朋友规划的一日游路线。
causality.placeAttitude: 他把市场当作休闲路线中的候选停留点，愿意慢慢看衣物和装饰品，并非来工作或带人游览。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须留下的约束。他只想确定这一站的停留时长，随时可以收起本子。
causality.currentGoal: 确定法国市场这一段应留十分钟还是半小时，同时维持路线已经接近完成、只剩停留时间待定的说法。
causality.currentState: 今天闲缓且客气，愿意主动问一个范围有限的问题。谈到自己的规划进度时语气格外顺滑，直到玩家要求查看路线才收紧本子、回避展示。
causality.contactTrigger: 看过棚廊边的衣物和装饰品后，他拿着始终折好的路线本，询问附近玩家只看这一段会留十分钟还是半小时。不假定玩家已经逛过，也不要求玩家充当导游。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留船用帆布裁剪职业、慢节奏出游爱好、简短温和的说话方式，以及用虚构进度和更细解释回避未完成事实的习惯。他没有因普通询问就坦白真实进度，也不让陌生人查看尚未完成的本子。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家选择参与时先建议半小时，再询问他是否经常规划出游。aa中，玩家要求看路线，他收紧本子，追加两个回程版本的解释，随后给姐姐录制夸大进度的语音。ab中，他谈起喜欢规划的路段，实际记下在市场停半小时这一项决定，然后礼貌结束。玩家选择独自浏览时，他立即停止提问。ba中，玩家沿公共通道离开，他留在原处看装饰品，仍未决定时长。bb中，玩家留在附近独自看衣服，他不再拉玩家交谈，自己打开本子却没有落笔，仍自称只差时间。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全部发生在法国市场棚廊边的摊位外侧和相连公共通道。只使用已有衣物、装饰品陈列及随身路线本、铅笔、手机，不新增设施，不触碰商品，不阻挡通行。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Emile Gravois。本次重逢位于法国市场，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

reviewEvidence: 结构校验、模型复核与正式编辑批准分别记录；本条保持草稿状态。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Outside the Nairobi National Museum, Achieng Opondo is waiting in the courtyard for her daughter before their visit. A breeze lifts a loose sheet from her hand and drops it on the ground in front of you.
beats.chinese: 在内罗毕国家博物馆外，Achieng Opondo正站在庭院里等女儿一起参观。一阵风把她手中的纸吹落，落在你面前的地上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry, that's mine. A suspect list for a radio serial. Nobody in this courtyard is on it.
beats.chinese: 不好意思，那是我的。广播连续剧的嫌疑人名单。院子里的人都不在上面。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She picks up the sheet herself and steps aside, holding the writing towards her.
beats.chinese: 她自己捡起纸，往旁边让了让，把写有字的一面朝向自己。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've picked someone already. My daughter says I should at least let the characters finish introducing themselves.
beats.chinese: 我已经认定一个人了。我女儿说，我至少该让角色们把自我介绍说完。

choices.english: A suspect list? I could hear one theory.
choices.chinese: 嫌疑人名单？我可以听听你的一个推测。

choices.english: No harm done. I'd rather avoid mystery spoilers, though.
choices.chinese: 没关系。不过，我不太想听推理剧的剧透。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Achieng finds a short entry near the top of the sheet. Several names below it have already been crossed out.
beats.chinese: Achieng在纸张上方找到一条简短的记录。下面已经有好几个名字被划掉了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Blue dust on a cuff. I suspect the man repainting the doors.
beats.chinese: 袖口上有蓝色粉末。我怀疑那个给门重新刷漆的人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She smooths a crease with her thumb. Printing on the reverse shows that the sheet was once an invoice.
beats.chinese: 她用拇指抚平一道折痕。背面的印字表明，这张纸原本是一张发票。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I painted carousel horses for over thirty years. You'd think I'd give a painter longer than one episode.
beats.chinese: 我给旋转木马画了三十多年彩绘。按理说，我总该多给同行一集的机会。

choices.english: Could the dust just be washing powder? That's my guess.
choices.chinese: 那些粉末会不会只是洗衣粉？这是我的猜测。

choices.english: I suspect whoever reported the dust. I'll leave you with that and be on my way.
choices.chinese: 我怀疑那个提到粉末的人。留下这个猜测，我就先走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Achieng immediately turns the list away. She starts to speak, then presses her lips together and folds the sheet.
beats.chinese: Achieng立刻把名单转开。她刚要开口，又抿住嘴，把纸折了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Even my guesses give too much away sometimes.
beats.chinese: 明白。有时候，光是我的猜测就透露得太多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She folds it again with the old paint invoice facing out, then looks towards the museum entrance.
beats.chinese: 她又折了一次，把旧油漆发票那面朝外，随后望向博物馆入口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm meeting my daughter here. She got me listening to it. Now she refuses to answer my calls during an episode.
beats.chinese: 我约了女儿在这里碰面。是她带我听这部剧的。现在播出的时候，她都不肯接我的电话。

choices.english: Enjoy seeing her. I'll be on my way.
choices.chinese: 祝你们见面愉快。我先走了。

choices.english: Is that a paint invoice on the outside?
choices.chinese: 外面那一面是油漆发票吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Achieng lowers her finger to the next line of her notes. It contains the words 'laundry room'.
beats.chinese: Achieng的手指移到下一行笔记。上面写着“洗衣房”。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Laundry room. I've written it right here. Washing powder is annoyingly possible.
beats.chinese: 洗衣房。我自己都记在这里了。还真可能是洗衣粉，真扫兴。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: With a theatrical sigh, she folds the list into her bag and turns her attention back towards the entrance.
beats.chinese: 她故意重重叹了口气，把名单折好放进包里，重新看向入口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The painter can have the afternoon off. Thanks for the other explanation. I'll leave the suspects alone while I wait.
beats.chinese: 那位油漆工可以放半天假了。谢谢你的另一种解释。等人的时候，我就先不折腾这些嫌疑人了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Achieng opens her mouth for a quick objection, then stops. She looks once more at the name she has underlined.
beats.chinese: Achieng张嘴就想反驳，随即又停住了。她重新看了一眼自己画了下划线的名字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: But the witness—oh, keep your witness. I'm sticking with the painter.
beats.chinese: 可那个证人——算了，你就怀疑那个证人吧。我还是选油漆工。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She leaves your theory off her written list and gives you a small wave as you move on across the courtyard.
beats.chinese: 她没有把你的推测写进自己的名单。你继续穿过庭院时，她轻轻挥了挥手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Goodbye. That gives me two people to listen for.
beats.chinese: 再见。这下听剧时，我得留意两个人了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Achieng shifts her bag closer to her feet, leaving you a clear way across the courtyard.
beats.chinese: Achieng把包挪到脚边，给你留出穿过庭院的路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Enjoy your day.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you move on, she puts the folded sheet away without reopening it and looks towards the entrance again.
beats.chinese: 你继续往前走。她没再展开那张纸，直接收了起来，又望向入口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And no need to hurry past. I've stopped announcing suspects.
beats.chinese: 也不用急着绕过我。我已经不报嫌疑人的名字了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Achieng glances down at the printed side of the folded sheet, keeping her handwritten notes hidden.
beats.chinese: Achieng低头看了看折好的纸上印着字的一面，仍然没有露出手写笔记。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: An old one. I painted carousel horses for over thirty years. Mostly retired now, apart from the odd restoration.
beats.chinese: 是张旧发票。我给旋转木马画了三十多年彩绘。现在基本退休了，偶尔还接点修复工作。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She notices her daughter in the courtyard and raises a hand. The paper goes into her bag as she takes a few steps to meet her.
beats.chinese: 她看见女儿出现在庭院里，便抬手招呼。她把纸收进包中，朝女儿走了几步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's my daughter. I'd better put this away before she reads my list. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 我女儿来了。得赶紧收好，免得她读到我的名单。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a later outing at the Nairobi National Museum, Achieng recognises you in the courtyard. Before her visit, she is trying to fit a wooden stage crow into a cloth bag. She will take it to a theatre rehearsal afterwards.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到内罗毕国家博物馆时，Achieng在庭院里认出了你。参观前，她正试着把一只舞台用的木乌鸦装进布袋，之后还要带它去剧团排练。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. I gave this crow a larger beak and forgot about the bag.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。我给这只乌鸦加大了嘴，却忘了布袋的尺寸。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the crow sideways, lowers it fully into the bag and brings the handles together.
beats.chinese: 她把乌鸦转向侧面，整个放进袋里，再把两根提手拢到一起。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. It's going to rehearsal after my visit. I'd rather not carry it under my arm all afternoon.
beats.chinese: 好了。参观完还得带它去排练。我可不想整个下午都把它夹在胳膊底下。

causality.presenceReason: 她已约好与女儿在博物馆庭院碰面后一起参观，等候时翻看广播推理剧笔记。
causality.placeAttitude: 把庭院当作明确、方便的会合地点，对参观持日常期待，没有导览或授课意图。
causality.stayingConstraint: 女儿尚未到达，她需要留在约定的入口外庭院等候。
causality.currentGoal: 等到女儿，同时整理自己对广播剧嫌疑人的猜测。
causality.currentState: 兴致不错，注意力容易被线索吸走，忍不住提早宣布理论，但能接受别人不想听。
causality.contactTrigger: 风把她的纸吹到玩家面前，她自行捡起并道歉，解释纸上是虚构案件的嫌疑名单。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留旋转木马彩绘职业、广播推理兴趣、抢先猜凶手的毛病、干幽默，以及尊重他人猜测和避免剧透的边界。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa中玩家提出洗衣粉，她发现笔记里的洗衣房线索并收起名单。ab中她压住反驳，保留双方不同猜测并挥别。ba中她接受玩家离开，停止谈剧继续等候。bb中她简短说明旧发票与职业，随后去迎接女儿，结束交谈。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全部发生在正门外庭院及入口可见范围，只使用随身纸张、包和重逢时携带的木鸟，不增加设施，也不阻挡通行。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Achieng Opondo。本次重逢位于内罗毕国家博物馆庭院，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Outside the Nairobi National Museum, Wanjiru Njoroge is waiting in the courtyard for her daughter. She is rereading her community-paper column before their visit. Holding the paper firmly, she looks up at you nearby.
beats.chinese: 在内罗毕国家博物馆外，Wanjiru Njoroge正在庭院里等女儿，准备一起参观。她重读着自己在社区报纸上的专栏，稳稳拿着报纸，抬头看向附近的你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A quick question. If a community-paper column is called 'How It's Done Around Here,' would you expect rules or people's ways of doing things?
beats.chinese: 问个小问题。社区报的专栏叫《这里的做法》，你会以为写的是规矩，还是人们做事的方法？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She keeps her place on the page with her thumb and waits for a short reply, clear of the entrance.
beats.chinese: 她用拇指按住读到的地方，站在不挡入口的位置，等一个简短回答。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's my column. This isn't an interview, and you don't need to explain your answer.
beats.chinese: 这是我自己的栏目。不是采访，也不用解释答案。

choices.english: People's methods. The rules have enough columns already.
choices.chinese: 人的做事方法。写规矩的专栏已经够多了。

choices.english: I'll leave you to your reading. Enjoy your visit.
choices.chinese: 不打扰你看报了。祝你参观愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wanjiru chuckles and holds the page firmly beneath her thumb.
beats.chinese: Wanjiru轻声笑起来，用拇指牢牢压住那页报纸。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The rules do get plenty of space. I'm waiting for my daughter before we go in.
beats.chinese: 规矩确实占了不少版面。我在等女儿，等她到了再进去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes a small notebook and pencil from her bag and begins writing your sentence.
beats.chinese: 她从包里拿出小笔记本和铅笔，开始记下你刚才那句话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm putting that line in my column. 'How It's Done Around Here.' Usually it's neighbours explaining things. That would make a good opening.
beats.chinese: 这句话我要写进专栏。《这里的做法》。通常写邻居们怎么做事。这句放在开头挺合适。

choices.english: You can use the line, without my name. Enjoy your visit.
choices.chinese: 这句话可以用，别写我的名字。祝你参观愉快。

choices.english: Please don't print that. It was just a joke. I'll leave you to your paper.
choices.chinese: 请别登出来，只是句玩笑。我就不打扰你看报了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wanjiru stays where she is. She folds the newspaper into a smaller rectangle.
beats.chinese: Wanjiru留在原地，把报纸折成一个更小的长方形。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. Enjoy your visit too.
beats.chinese: 好的，也祝你参观愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the folded paper under her arm and looks across the courtyard for her daughter.
beats.chinese: 她把折好的报纸夹在胳膊下，望向庭院，寻找女儿的身影。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That can wait. I came to spend the morning with my daughter, and I've brought my own reading distraction.
beats.chinese: 报纸可以等会儿再看。我是来跟女儿一起过个上午的，结果自己带了份让自己分心的东西。

choices.english: Before I go, what were you reading?
choices.chinese: 走之前问一句，你刚才在看什么？

choices.english: Enjoy your visit. (Give a small wave goodbye.)
choices.chinese: 祝你参观愉快。（轻轻挥手道别。）

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wanjiru finishes the sentence and writes 'no name' beside it.
beats.chinese: Wanjiru记完那句话，在旁边写下“不署名”。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Without your name. Yes. I'll keep the wording too.
beats.chinese: 不写名字，好。原话也保留。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes the notebook, puts her pencil away and secures the newspaper inside her bag.
beats.chinese: 她合上笔记本，收起铅笔，把报纸稳稳放进包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. Enjoy your day. I'll watch for my daughter now.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。祝你今天愉快。我该留意女儿到了没有了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wanjiru stops writing immediately and draws a firm line through the sentence.
beats.chinese: Wanjiru马上停笔，把那句话清楚地划掉。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. Off the record. It stays out.
beats.chinese: 好，不用于发表。不会登出来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes the notebook without adding anything else, then folds the newspaper.
beats.chinese: 她没有再补写什么，合上笔记本，然后把报纸折好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Goodbye, then. Thanks for the quick answer.
beats.chinese: 那么，再见。谢谢你答了这一句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wanjiru lifts the folded paper slightly, keeping it tucked beneath her arm.
beats.chinese: Wanjiru稍稍抬了抬折好的报纸，仍把它夹在胳膊下面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My own column. A greengrocer explaining how he stacks crates. He said, 'Leave breathing room. My brothers could learn that.'
beats.chinese: 我自己的专栏，写一位蔬果商怎样码放筐子。他说：‘留点透气的空当。我那几个兄弟也该学学。’

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She opens to the paragraph and reads the printed sentence. Across the courtyard, her daughter raises a hand, and Wanjiru returns the wave.
beats.chinese: 她翻到那一段，读出印出来的句子。庭院另一边，女儿抬手示意，Wanjiru也挥了挥手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I printed 'Leave gaps between the crates.' He keeps asking where his brothers went. Ah, there's my daughter. Goodbye!
beats.chinese: 我登的是‘筐子之间留出空隙’。他老问我，他那几个兄弟去哪儿了。啊，我女儿到了。再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wanjiru returns your small wave without moving after you.
beats.chinese: Wanjiru也轻轻挥手，没有跟上来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. Enjoy your day too.
beats.chinese: 谢谢，也祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips the newspaper into her bag and turns her attention back to the courtyard.
beats.chinese: 她把报纸放进包里，重新望向庭院。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. I'll leave that in the bag for now.
beats.chinese: 好了，先把报纸放在包里吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the Nairobi National Museum courtyard, Wanjiru recognises you. She is holding her published community-paper column, with a pencil resting against the page.
beats.chinese: 在内罗毕国家博物馆庭院，Wanjiru认出了你。她手里拿着刊有自己专栏的社区报，铅笔贴在纸页上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. Today I want to read the whole piece through once before I start making pencil marks.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。今天我想先把整篇再读一遍，暂时不拿铅笔改。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She puts the pencil into her bag and reads a short passage. She keeps her attention on the paper without starting an interview.
beats.chinese: 她把铅笔收进包里，继续读了一小段。她的注意力仍在报纸上，暂时没有发起采访。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just a reader this time. Even the writer gets a turn to listen.
beats.chinese: 这一遍只当读者。写的人也该轮到我听一会儿。

causality.presenceReason: 她先到内罗毕国家博物馆庭院等女儿，准备一起参观，等候时重读自己已刊出的社区报专栏。
causality.placeAttitude: 这里是她与女儿会合、共度上午的地点，没有采访任务。她暂时用自己的文章打发等候时间。
causality.stayingConstraint: 女儿尚未到达，她留在庭院等候，始终不占入口通道。
causality.currentGoal: 等女儿到来，并就自己专栏标题给人的第一印象获得一个简短反应，不要求玩家解释或参与采访。
causality.currentState: 心情轻松，做事利落，注意力原本在文章上。她愿意主动问一句，但没有持续攀谈的要求，随身带着报纸、记事本和铅笔。
causality.contactTrigger: 报纸始终拿稳。她主动问附近的玩家，《这里的做法》听起来像写规矩还是人的做事方法，并明确这是自己的栏目、不是采访，也不用解释答案。玩家可以接一句玩笑，也可以直接礼貌告辞。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留她退休客服培训师、社区专栏作者的身份与干幽默。她虽然起初说不是采访，听到玩家的玩笑后仍顺手记下并宣布要用于专栏，呈现把公开谈话视作素材的原有缺点。明确收到不发表要求后立即划掉。另一分支仍展示她删去受访者笑话、只留下操作要点的刊文。
causality.reactionAndChange: a承接玩家关于规矩专栏已经够多的玩笑，她笑着记下原话。aa获准匿名使用后写明不署名并收起纸笔。ab收到不发表要求后立即划掉句子并道别。b承接直接告辞，她礼貌回应，不追问。玩家若再问她刚才读什么，ba仍展示删去笑话的已刊文字，随后与到场女儿会合。bb则回礼挥手、收好报纸，继续等候。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全部互动发生在博物馆正门外庭院，只使用随身报纸、包、记事本和铅笔。没有散页飞落、要求玩家挪开、新增设施或离开庭院的高潮。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Wanjiru Njoroge。本次重逢位于内罗毕国家博物馆庭院，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Outside the Nairobi National Museum's main entrance, Peter Okello is waiting for a colleague after his shift packing specimens for transport. His bulging daypack stands steadily at his feet. He takes out a jacket, then notices how close you are before spreading it open.
beats.chinese: 内罗毕国家博物馆正门外，Peter Okello结束了标本运输包装工作，正在等同事。鼓鼓的背包稳稳放在他脚边。他拿出外套，正准备展开，注意到你就在附近。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I need to put my jacket on here. Would you like to go past first, or shall I put it on?
beats.chinese: 我得在这儿套一下外套。你先过，还是我先穿？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lifts the pack closer to his feet and sets it firmly down, keeping the jacket folded over one arm.
beats.chinese: 他把背包提得离脚更近些，稳稳放好，外套仍折着搭在一条胳膊上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Batteries, jacket, biscuits. At least one of them is getting used today.
beats.chinese: 电池、外套、饼干，今天总算用上一样。

choices.english: You go first. That's a lot to carry for a short wait.
choices.chinese: 你先穿吧。就等一会儿，也带这么多东西啊。

choices.english: I'll go first. Thanks.
choices.chinese: 我先过。谢谢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Peter puts on his jacket, then looks down at the swollen pockets of his pack.
beats.chinese: Peter穿好外套，低头看了看背包上鼓起的几个口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I packed for the whole day. And apparently a second day nobody ordered.
beats.chinese: 我是照一整天准备的。看起来还多备了一天，虽然没人要求。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A pocket has caught on an old torch. He opens the zip farther and works the torch free.
beats.chinese: 一个口袋被旧手电筒卡住了。他又拉开一点拉链，把手电筒取出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This one doesn't even work. I meant to repair it after work. There's a working one underneath, naturally.
beats.chinese: 这支甚至还是坏的。我本来打算下班后修。当然，下面还有一支好的。

choices.english: So the working torch helps you find the broken one?
choices.chinese: 所以，好的那支是用来帮你找坏的这支？

choices.english: You could leave a few things at home.
choices.chinese: 你可以把几样东西留在家里。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Once you've passed, Peter puts on his jacket. His phone vibrates, and he reads the message without moving his bag.
beats.chinese: 等你经过后，Peter穿上外套。手机振了一下，他站在原地看消息，没有挪动背包。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My colleague. He's asking whether I've got a jacket he can borrow. He left his at home again.
beats.chinese: 是我同事。他问我有没有外套可以借。他又把自己的落在家里了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances down at the jacket he has just put on, then starts typing.
beats.chinese: 他低头看了一眼刚穿上的外套，开始打字。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I get cold on the way home. I'm keeping this one today.
beats.chinese: 我回家的路上会冷。今天这件得自己留着。

choices.english: Fair enough. Take care.
choices.chinese: 应该的。再见，保重。

choices.english: You can just say you need it yourself.
choices.chinese: 你直接说自己要用就行了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Peter glances from the old torch to the open pocket, then laughs.
beats.chinese: Peter看看旧手电筒，又看看敞开的口袋，笑了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Exactly. Though once they're both in the bag, neither is much help.
beats.chinese: 没错。不过两支都塞进包里以后，哪支都帮不上什么忙。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He fits the broken torch sideways into the pocket, closes the zip and lifts the pack onto one shoulder. The weight pulls that shoulder down.
beats.chinese: 他把坏手电横着放进口袋，拉好拉链，再把背包提到一边肩上。那边肩膀被重量压低了一截。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Everything accounted for, including the extra weight. Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 好了。东西都齐，包括这些多余的重量。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Peter holds the torch against the open pocket instead of putting it away.
beats.chinese: Peter拿着手电筒抵在敞开的口袋边，没有马上放回去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Easy to say until somebody needs a battery and nobody has bothered to bring—
beats.chinese: 说起来容易，等到有人要用电池，却谁都没想着带——

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stops, puts the torch into a different pocket and tightens the pack's straps. The bag remains on the ground.
beats.chinese: 他停住话头，把手电筒换了个口袋放好，再收紧背包的带子。包仍然放在地上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Listen to me. You only mentioned the bag. I'll leave it down while I wait. Take care.
beats.chinese: 瞧我说的。你不过是提了一句背包。我等人的时候先把它放地上吧。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Peter stops typing long enough to return your farewell.
beats.chinese: Peter暂时停下打字，回应你的道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. Take care.
beats.chinese: 你也保重。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He sends his message, slips the phone into his jacket pocket and turns his attention to the museum entrance.
beats.chinese: 他发出消息，把手机放进外套口袋，转头望向博物馆入口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. He knows I need it. I'll wait here for him.
beats.chinese: 好了。他知道我要自己用了。我就在这里等他。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Peter looks at the unfinished message on his phone.
beats.chinese: Peter看着手机上还没写完的消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've already written half a speech about checking his own bag. He has heard that speech.
beats.chinese: 我都写了半篇，让他先检查自己的包。那番话他已经听过了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He deletes several lines, types a shorter reply and sends it. Then he slips the phone into his jacket pocket.
beats.chinese: 他删掉几行，重新打了个短些的回复并发出去。随后他把手机放进外套口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sent. I need my jacket. That covers it. Good talking to you.
beats.chinese: 发了。我自己需要外套。这样就说清楚了。跟你聊得很愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On a later visit, you see Peter outside the Nairobi National Museum's main entrance. He is holding his phone while waiting for a colleague to come out, and he recognizes you.
beats.chinese: 在内罗毕国家博物馆，你在正门外看见Peter。他正拿着手机等同事出来，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. My colleague asked if I could make an extra stop with him today. I've already said I can't.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。同事问我今天能不能陪他再绕一趟。我已经回了，今天不行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts his phone away and settles the daypack on his shoulders. Looking tired after work, he stays where he is to wait for their agreed meeting.
beats.chinese: 他收起手机，把背包背稳。他下班后显得有些疲倦，仍留在原地，等着这次约好的会合。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Walking together is fine. An extra trip, I can't do today. I'd like to get home early too.
beats.chinese: 一起走没问题。多跑一趟，今天不行。我也想早点回去。

causality.presenceReason: Peter刚结束馆内的标本运输包装工作，已约好在正门外等同事。
causality.placeAttitude: 这里是他熟悉的工作地点，庭院只是下班后的会合处，他没有主动招待访客的任务。
causality.stayingConstraint: 同事尚未出来，他按约留在入口外等待，不需要玩家陪伴或帮忙。
causality.currentGoal: 穿上回家路上需要的外套，整理过满的背包，等到同事后离开。
causality.currentState: 下班后愿意简短闲聊，对自己背包过重有自知，也容易顺口训诫别人没准备。愿意借物不代表今天会让出自己需要的外套。
causality.contactTrigger: 背包始终稳放在他脚边。他准备穿外套时注意到展开衣服会占用附近空间，先询问玩家要先经过还是让他先穿，再自行把包提近，以随身物品清单接出过度准备的话题，不制造物件侵入或要求帮助。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留过度准备、旧电器维修兴趣、干幽默及直接守住自用物品的界限。职业通过下班缘由自然交代，保留基苏木家庭迁往内罗毕及他在内罗毕长大的原有经历。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家让他先穿并评论重包后，他穿好外套，接着整理手电筒。aa接住玩家的手电筒笑话，背起重包后道别。ab对精简物品的建议冒出说教，及时收住并让包留在地上。玩家选择先经过后，他等玩家通过再穿外套，随后收到同事借外套的消息。ba礼貌回应道别，发消息拒借后继续候人。bb删去对同事的长篇训话，简短拒借并收起手机后道别。两条借物分支中外套均已穿在身上，不再取出、折回或重复穿上。
causality.spatialContinuity: 初遇及重逢均发生在照片支持的博物馆正门外庭院。穿外套前先协商眼前空间，背包稳放脚边并由Peter自行提近，不挡通行，不增设设施，也不进入馆内。仅使用随身背包、手电筒、手机和外套。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Peter Okello。本次重逢位于内罗毕国家博物馆庭院，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Outside the Nairobi National Museum, Baraka Onyango is sketching the entrance from the edge of the courtyard. All the pages are clipped securely to the sketchbook.
beats.chinese: 内罗毕国家博物馆正门外，巴拉卡·奥尼扬戈正在庭院边缘画入口。所有纸页都牢牢夹在速写本上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Baraka. Drawing this entrance reminded me of something that happened at an old cinema. Would you like to hear it?
beats.chinese: 我叫巴拉卡。画这个入口，让我想起了一件老电影院里的事。想听吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka stops drawing and rests the pencil across the clipped pages, leaving you room to answer.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡停下笔，把铅笔横放在夹好的纸页上，等你回应。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It takes half a minute.
beats.chinese: 半分钟就能讲完。

choices.english: Yes. What made you choose this entrance?
choices.chinese: 好啊。你为什么选这个入口来画？

choices.english: No, thanks. I'll keep clear of your view.
choices.chinese: 不用了，谢谢。我不挡着你看了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka turns the sketchbook toward you without handing it over. The entrance outline fills most of the page.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡把速写本转向你，但没有递过来。入口的轮廓占了大半页。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Entrances catch my eye. Nearly forty years maintaining cinema projectors, and I remember the doors too. In 1983—no, '84—Joseph, our manager, opened ours early.
beats.chinese: 入口总能吸引我。我维修影院放映机将近四十年，连那些门也记得。1983年——不，是84年——我们的经理约瑟夫提前开了门。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka stops with their pencil suspended above the page. Their gaze moves from your eyes to your mouth, checking for a reaction.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡停下来，铅笔悬在纸上。目光从你的眼睛移到嘴边，观察你的反应。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I can skip Joseph if you'd rather look at the building.
beats.chinese: 要是你更想看建筑，约瑟夫这段就不讲了。

choices.english: I'm following. You don't need to keep checking my face.
choices.chinese: 我听着呢。不用一直看我的表情。

choices.english: Yes, I'd rather just look at the building.
choices.chinese: 好，我更想看看建筑。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka turns the sketchbook back toward the entrance and picks up the pencil again.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡把速写本重新转向入口，又拿起铅笔。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. There's plenty I haven't put down yet.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。还有不少地方没画下来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They add a short pencil line, then turn the book slightly to compare the drawing with the entrance.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡添上一小段铅笔线，又稍稍转动本子，对照画面和入口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This may become a paper model at home. Those take up rather more of my kitchen table than they should.
beats.chinese: 回家后，这幅画也许会做成纸模型。那些模型占了我的厨房桌子，地方占得实在有点多。

choices.english: You make paper buildings too?
choices.chinese: 你还做纸建筑模型？

choices.english: I'll leave you to your drawing. Goodbye, Baraka.
choices.chinese: 那不打扰你画画了。再见，巴拉卡。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka lowers the pencil and gives a small, slightly embarrassed smile.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡放下铅笔，露出一点略带尴尬的笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. Joseph let everyone in while my projector was in pieces. Then he spent ten minutes telling them how excellent the film would be.
beats.chinese: 好。约瑟夫把观众都放了进来，我的放映机却还拆着。他只好花了十分钟，向大家保证电影有多精彩。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka returns their attention to the page and writes a small date in one corner.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡把注意力放回纸上，在一角写下一个小小的日期。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We got it running. He claimed his speech had saved the evening. Thanks for hearing the end. I'll get back to this now.
beats.chinese: 最后机器开起来了。他说那晚全靠他的讲话才撑住。谢谢你听完，我接着画了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka closes their mouth on the unfinished story and turns the sketchbook back toward themselves.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡收住没讲完的故事，把速写本转回自己面前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I'll let you look.
beats.chinese: 当然。你慢慢看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They shift a little farther along the courtyard edge, leaving the view open, and begin drawing again.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡沿庭院边缘挪开一点，让出视野，重新画起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy the museum. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 祝你参观愉快。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka looks up, resting the pencil against the sketchbook.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡抬起头，把铅笔搭在速写本上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mostly old cinema fronts, in layers of paper. And I collect letters from dead cinema signs. Some are too large for the room I've given them.
beats.chinese: 主要用一层层纸做老电影院的门面。我也收集废弃影院招牌上的字母。有些太大，给它们留的地方根本放不下。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They check the entrance once more, add one final mark, and close the sketchbook with all the pages still clipped inside.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡又看了一眼入口，补上最后一笔，合上速写本，所有纸页仍夹在里面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My sister says I could simply stop bringing letters home. She has a very tidy house. That's enough drawing for me. Goodbye.
beats.chinese: 我姐姐说，不再往家里搬字母就行了。她家可整齐了。我今天就画到这里。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka gives you a brief nod, holding the sketchbook steady.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡向你轻轻点头，稳稳拿着速写本。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Goodbye. Thanks for leaving me the view.
beats.chinese: 再见。谢谢你给我让出视野。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They return their pencil to the unfinished outline.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡的铅笔重新落在尚未完成的轮廓上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A few more lines, then I'll be done.
beats.chinese: 再添几笔就画完了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the Nairobi National Museum courtyard, you see Baraka near the entrance with a thermos. They recognize you and lift a hand.
beats.chinese: 在内罗毕国家博物馆庭院，你看见巴拉卡拿着保温瓶站在入口附近。巴拉卡认出了你，抬手招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I'm meeting my sister here. I've arrived early enough for tea, apparently.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我约了姐姐在这里碰面。看来我早到的这点时间，够喝杯茶。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka unscrews the cup, pours a little tea, and checks the entrance before taking a careful sip.
beats.chinese: 巴拉卡旋下杯盖，倒了一点茶，先望了望入口，才小心地喝了一口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She asked me to be easy to spot. I nearly wore my brightest shirt, then remembered she'd have to spend the afternoon beside it.
beats.chinese: 她让我站得显眼一点。我差点穿上颜色最鲜艳的衬衫，后来想起，她还得挨着那件衣服待一下午。

causality.presenceReason: 巴拉卡在玩家到来前已到庭院边缘写生，打算把入口画作留作居家纸模型的素材。
causality.placeAttitude: 对入口建筑有个人兴趣，自愿在此短暂停留，不承担导览或教学职责。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须等玩家的理由，停留取决于速写进度。活动限于入口外庭院，不使用台阶，也不挡通行。
causality.currentGoal: 完成入口轮廓，为居家的分层纸模型取材。所有纸页已夹好，没有需要玩家处理的意外。
causality.currentState: 有闲心交谈，语气温和，借入口引起的影院回忆邀请附近的人聊半分钟，仍未直接表达想有人作伴。发出邀请后停笔等回应，不预判玩家是否愿意听。开始讲故事后，过度留意听者表情的习惯才显现。
causality.contactTrigger: 巴拉卡主动介绍自己，说明画入口时想起一件旧影院的事，询问玩家是否愿意听，并说明只需半分钟。玩家可接受，也可直接婉拒，无需帮忙或承担任何任务。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留退休35毫米放映设备技师、建筑速写、分层纸模型和废弃影院招牌字母收藏。通过纠正年份、提及经理及中途观察听者体现原有说话习惯。主动邀请交谈保留了想有人作伴却不直接承认的盲点。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家接受邀请并询问选材缘由后，巴拉卡接着讲入口与旧影院的故事。aa中玩家指出表情检查，巴拉卡接受提醒并讲完短故事后回到画面。ab中玩家选择看建筑，巴拉卡收住故事并移开让出视野。玩家最初婉拒时，巴拉卡不讲影院故事，继续作画，简短提及画作可能做成纸模型。ba中玩家主动追问纸模型，巴拉卡透露收藏占地方的小毛病，完成最后一笔并收本。bb中玩家告辞，巴拉卡道别并继续未完成的画。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程使用已知的博物馆正门、入口视野与庭院边缘。速写本、固定纸页的夹子、铅笔及重逢时的保温瓶均为自带物品。不新增设施，不进入其他场景。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Baraka Onyango。本次重逢位于内罗毕国家博物馆庭院，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

reviewEvidence: 结构校验、模型复核与正式编辑批准分别记录；本条保持草稿状态。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Brian Otieno has come to Karura Forest for a walk after his bike-share dispatch shift. He stands at the edge of the tree-lined dirt trail, his map notebook already closed and secured with its elastic band. The trail is clear.
beats.chinese: 共享单车调度员 Brian Otieno 下班后来卡鲁拉森林散步。他站在两侧树木密集的土路边，地图本已经合好，扣上了松紧带。步道一直畅通。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Notebook away. Now start walking.
beats.chinese: 本子收好了。现在开始散步。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He says it quietly to himself, then looks up at you nearby. The notebook stays tucked under his arm.
beats.chinese: 他低声对自己说完，抬头看向附近的你。笔记本仍夹在他的臂下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I dispatch bikes at work. Apparently I have to dispatch myself for a walk too.
beats.chinese: 我上班调度单车。看来散步还得调度自己。

choices.english: No rush. Are those maps?
choices.chinese: 不着急。那是地图吗？

choices.english: Have a good walk. I'll carry on.
choices.chinese: 祝你散步愉快。我继续往前走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Brian stays at the trail's edge with the closed notebook in his hands.
beats.chinese: Brian 留在步道边，双手拿着合上的笔记本。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A country I made up. One, the river needs a route. Two, the towns need water. Three, the trade routes need—
beats.chinese: 我编的一个国家。第一，河流得有走向。第二，城镇需要水源。第三，贸易路线需要——

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slips the elastic off the cover, then stops with one finger between the pages.
beats.chinese: 他把封面上的松紧带解开，一根手指夹在书页间，停了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I dispatch bike-share crews across Nairobi. Apparently I also assign work to imaginary rivers.
beats.chinese: 我在内罗毕调度共享单车搬运团队。看来我连虚构的河流也要安排工作。

choices.english: Show me the map, without the full explanation. Then I'll carry on.
choices.chinese: 给我看看地图就好，不用完整讲解。看完我就继续走。

choices.english: I'll leave the map to you. Enjoy your walk.
choices.chinese: 地图就留给你研究吧。散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the trail, Brian holds his notebook against his side.
beats.chinese: 你沿步道继续往前走，Brian 把笔记本贴在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. One, stop planning. Two, start walking—
beats.chinese: 谢谢。第一，别再计划。第二，开始走——

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He looks at the clear stretch of dirt beside him and cuts the explanation short.
beats.chinese: 他看了一眼身旁空出的土路，把说明截住了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm still standing here. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 我还站在这儿呢。散步愉快。

choices.english: Just start walking. Have a good walk.
choices.chinese: 直接开始走就行了。祝你散步愉快。

choices.english: Give him a friendly nod and continue along the trail.
choices.chinese: 友好地点点头，沿步道继续走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Brian opens the notebook toward you. A pencil-drawn river runs between small towns, with separate lines marking trade routes.
beats.chinese: Brian 朝你翻开笔记本。铅笔画的河流穿过几座小城镇，另有线条标着贸易路线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: River here. Towns here. I'll leave out the drainage report.
beats.chinese: 河在这里。城镇在这里。排水报告就省略了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: After your brief look, he closes the notebook without turning another page. You continue along the trail, and he resumes his own walk.
beats.chinese: 你短暂看过之后，他没有再翻页，直接合上本子。你沿步道继续前行，他也重新开始散步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy your walk. I'll put the country away for a bit.
beats.chinese: 散步愉快。我先把这个国家收一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Brian takes his finger out of the notebook and keeps the map closed.
beats.chinese: Brian 把夹在书页间的手指抽出来，没有打开地图。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. That explanation was getting longer than the walk.
beats.chinese: 好。那番说明都快比散步还长了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue on, he notices the elastic is caught under a page. He stays at the edge of the trail and carefully frees it.
beats.chinese: 你继续往前走。他发现松紧带压住了一页纸，便留在步道边，小心地把它抽出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Enjoy yours too.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。你也散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Brian gives one small nod at your correction.
beats.chinese: 听到你的提醒，Brian 轻轻点了一下头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Time to walk.
beats.chinese: 对。该走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He stays where he is until you have passed, then starts walking at his own pace without adding another explanation.
beats.chinese: 他站在原地等你经过，随后按自己的步速走起来，没有再补充说明。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. Bye.
beats.chinese: 你也是。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Brian returns your nod as you continue down the dirt trail.
beats.chinese: 你沿土路继续走，Brian 也向你点头致意。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye.
beats.chinese: 再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He remains clear of the walking space and reopens the notebook. His finger follows a river line before he presses a folded page corner flat.
beats.chinese: 他留在不妨碍通行的位置，重新打开笔记本。手指沿着一条河流线划过，又把折起的页角压平。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One page. Then I actually walk.
beats.chinese: 再看一页。然后真的去走路。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Karura Forest, you see Brian at the edge of the dirt trail, ready to continue walking. His closed map notebook is tucked under one arm. He recognizes you.
beats.chinese: 在卡鲁拉森林，你看见 Brian 站在土路边，正准备继续走。地图本已经收好，夹在一边臂下。他认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I've given myself one rule for today's walk. No stopping to draw maps.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天给自己的散步只留了一条规则。不再停下画地图。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His fingers find the notebook's elastic band. Then he lets go, leaving the notebook tucked under his arm.
beats.chinese: 他的手指下意识摸到本子的松紧带，随后又放开，没有把本子从臂下取出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm already thinking of a second rule. I'd better get walking before that one comes out too.
beats.chinese: 我已经开始想第二条了。先走，免得它也出来。

causality.presenceReason: Brian 在共享单车调度班次结束后来卡鲁拉森林散步，用户到来前已经收好虚构地图本，却仍站在土路边，迟迟没有开始走。
causality.placeAttitude: 他愿意来这里步行休息，却容易把时间花在地图和开始散步前的自我安排上。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须留下的任务，笔记本已合好并扣上松紧带，道路一直畅通。他的停留来自自己的拖延，不是让行或整理失误。
causality.currentGoal: 停止给自己安排步骤，真正开始散步。
causality.currentState: 下班后精神尚可，愿意主动简短闲谈。他意识到自己还没起步，却仍会不自觉地继续编号说明。
causality.contactTrigger: Brian 先低声催促自己收好本子后开始散步，再主动向附近的用户自嘲，工作时调度单车，散步时还得调度自己。接触不依赖让路、求助或物品故障。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留他在内罗毕从事共享单车调度的职业、虚构地图爱好、编号解释、过度说明、爱护物品和只针对自己的平淡自嘲。既有童年、居住史及其他人物背景不变。
causality.reactionAndChange: 用户可以询问地图，也可以简短告辞。aa 中按用户要求简短展示地图后收本散步。ab 中接受不看地图的选择，随后发现松紧带压住书页，留下小心整理。ba 中接受用户直接开始走的简短提醒，停止补充说明并起步。bb 中回应点头后重看一页地图，继续拖延起步。ab 的整理发生在重新解开又合上笔记本之后，不是初始接触的原因。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全部发生在卡鲁拉森林两侧密林的可见公共土路及其边缘。Brian 开场站在路边，步道始终畅通，不新增设施、岔路或场所，不以空间协商触发交谈。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Brian Otieno。本次重逢位于卡鲁拉森林步道，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

reviewEvidence: 结构校验、模型复核与正式编辑批准分别记录；本条保持草稿状态。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On Karura Forest's dirt trail, Baraka Kimani has stopped during a walk with two friends, fitted in before a coastal supply call. His friends have gone ahead after an argument. He stands at the trail's edge with his notebook, pen and bag close to him. He glances ahead, then speaks to you nearby.
beats.chinese: 卡鲁拉森林的土路上，Baraka Kimani 暂时停下脚步。他原本趁着给海岸供货方打电话前，和两位朋友散步。朋友争吵后已经走到前面。他靠着步道边站着，本子、笔和包都在自己身边。他朝前方望了一眼，然后向附近的你开口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If you heard any of that, you don't need to answer for them. I don't mediate.
beats.chinese: 你要是刚才也听见了，不用替他们接话。我不调解。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He writes the last few words in his notebook, held towards himself. Once his pen stops, he looks up at you.
beats.chinese: 他把本子朝着自己，写下最后几个字。停笔后，他抬头看向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Baraka.
beats.chinese: 我叫 Baraka。

choices.english: Why are you still writing?
choices.chinese: 那你为什么还在写？

choices.english: Hello, Baraka.
choices.chinese: 你好，Baraka。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka stays at the edge of the dirt trail, keeping the notebook angled towards himself.
beats.chinese: Baraka 仍站在土路边，本子朝着自己。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just finishing a few notes.
beats.chinese: 只是把几条记录写完。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rests the pen against the page, then looks towards his two friends farther along the same trail.
beats.chinese: 他把笔停在纸页上，又望了望沿着同一条步道走远的两位朋友。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Those two walk surprisingly fast when they're cross.
beats.chinese: 那两个人一生气，走得还真快。

choices.english: Are you going to help them settle it?
choices.chinese: 你会去帮他们把事情说开吗？

choices.english: I'll let you catch up with them.
choices.chinese: 那就不耽误你追上他们了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka closes his notebook and puts it in his bag.
beats.chinese: Baraka 合上本子，把它放进包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello. I've still got a few minutes here.
beats.chinese: 你好。我还能在这里待几分钟。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He clips the pen inside his bag. Dried glue edges one thumbnail, and he rubs at it with his other thumb.
beats.chinese: 他把笔夹在包内侧。一只拇指的指甲边沾着干胶，他用另一只拇指搓了搓。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I need to make a supply call soon, before I get back to my friend's drum.
beats.chinese: 一会儿得打个供货电话，然后再回去接着修朋友的鼓。

choices.english: I'll leave you to your call.
choices.chinese: 那你打电话吧，我不打扰了。

choices.english: What sort of drum?
choices.chinese: 是什么鼓？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka looks down the trail. Neither friend turns back. He shakes his head once.
beats.chinese: Baraka 朝步道前方望去，两位朋友都没有回头。他摇了一下头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. They can speak to each other. I won't carry messages.
beats.chinese: 不会。他们可以直接跟对方说。我不传话。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He remains at the trail's edge and opens the notebook towards himself. Under the first sentence, he writes the other friend's reply word for word.
beats.chinese: 他留在步道边，把本子朝着自己翻开，在第一句话下面逐字记下另一位朋友的回答。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll give them a little distance. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 我跟他们隔开一段再走。祝你散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka looks from the closed notebook to the two figures moving along the trail.
beats.chinese: Baraka 看看合上的本子，又看看步道上渐渐走远的两个人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd better. If they lose me, they'll have something else to disagree about.
beats.chinese: 是该跟上了。要是把我弄丢，他们又多了一件可以争的事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pushes the notebook deep into his bag, settles the strap on his shoulder and starts after his friends along the same dirt trail.
beats.chinese: 他把本子塞到包的深处，调整好肩带，沿着原来的土路去追两位朋友。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Have a good walk.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。慢慢逛。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka takes out his phone and stays clear of the walking space.
beats.chinese: Baraka 拿出手机，站在不妨碍行人通过的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. The coastal depot needs an answer about some tugboat pump seals.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。海岸那边的仓库还等着确认拖船水泵密封件的事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives you a brief parting nod, selects a number and raises the phone to his ear. After a pause, someone answers.
beats.chinese: 他简短地点头向你道别，选了号码，把手机举到耳边。稍等片刻后，电话接通了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello, Baraka here. I'm calling about those pump seals. Have they been packed yet?
beats.chinese: 你好，我是 Baraka。打来问问那批水泵密封件，已经装箱了吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka lowers his hand from the patch of dried glue. His expression brightens.
beats.chinese: Baraka 不再搓那块干胶，放下手，神情轻快了一些。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A djembe. Friends bring them to my kitchen table, usually with the words 'one tiny split.'
beats.chinese: 金贝鼓。朋友们会送到我家厨房桌上，通常还附带一句‘就裂了一个小口子’。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks the time on his phone, puts it away and turns back along the same stretch of trail, leaving his friends to walk ahead.
beats.chinese: 他拿手机看了眼时间，收好后沿着这段步道往回走，让朋友们继续往前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That one's nearly done. I've got a few more minutes for the trees before the call. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 那面鼓快修好了。打电话前，我还能再看几分钟树。祝你散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Karura Forest, you see Baraka at the side of the dirt trail. He recognises you, holding his phone while he waits for a supply call from the coastal depot.
beats.chinese: 在卡鲁拉森林，你看见 Baraka 站在土路边。他认出了你，手里拿着手机，等海岸仓库打来供货电话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I can only walk a little farther today. Once the depot calls, I'll have to stop.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我今天只能再走一小段。仓库那边一来电话，我就得停下来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He nods to you and glances at the phone, which has yet to ring. He lowers it again, leaving a pause without adding anything about work.
beats.chinese: 他向你点点头，看了一眼仍未响起的手机，又把手放低，停了一会儿，没有接着讲工作的事。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's quiet for now. I'll enjoy these few minutes.
beats.chinese: 现在倒还安静。我先享受这几分钟。

causality.presenceReason: 他趁与海岸仓库通话前，和两位朋友来森林短暂散步，朋友争吵后先走了。
causality.placeAttitude: 愿意把工作间隙用来走路看树，森林是日常休息地点，不承担导览职责。
causality.stayingConstraint: 稍后需要处理拖船零件供货电话，不能一直闲聊，但无需立刻离开。
causality.currentGoal: 靠土路边写完刚发生的争吵记录，再安排通话或继续散步。
causality.currentState: 对陌生人平静有礼，注意力一部分留在朋友的争执上，仍在私下保存原话，不主动展示或解释记录内容。
causality.contactTrigger: 他先望向已经走远的朋友，再向附近玩家有条件地说明，即使听见了争吵，也不必替朋友接话，自己不调解。他写完最后几个字、停笔后才自报姓名，不预设玩家确实听见争吵，也没有掉落物或物品侵占通道。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留秘密记录争执、拒绝调解和传话的边界，以及温和缓慢的语气、具体笑话和修鼓爱好。玩家追问时，他只简短说明在写记录，不公开本子用途，也不把玩家拉入争执。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家追问为何仍在写，进入关于前方朋友的简短交谈，随后可询问是否调解，通向aa继续记录并拒绝传话，或让他追赶朋友，通向ab收本追朋友。玩家只简短问候，则进入b，他收起本子并提到供货电话和朋友的鼓，随后ba结束寒暄并接通供货电话，bb短谈修鼓后独自沿原路往回走。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全部发生在树木夹着的同一段公共土路，停留均靠边，笔和包始终收在他自己身边。没有新增设施、岔路或场所，也不阻碍行人通过。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Baraka Kimani。本次重逢位于卡鲁拉森林步道，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。
