beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On the dirt trail in Karura Forest, Kiptoo Cheruiyot has paused during a walk after work. Dense trees line both sides. He holds a phone near his mouth as you come within earshot.
beats.chinese: 在卡鲁拉森林的土路上，Kiptoo Cheruiyot下班后来散步，此刻停了下来。道路两侧树木茂密。你走近时，他正把手机举到嘴边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Should I bring my own cup?
beats.chinese: 我要带自己的杯子吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He notices you, lowers the phone and shifts to one side of the trail.
beats.chinese: 他注意到你，放下手机，往步道一侧挪了挪。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry, I'm dictating a message to a colleague. I'm Kiptoo. That question wasn't meant for you.
beats.chinese: 不好意思，我在用语音输入给同事发消息。我叫Kiptoo。刚才不是在问你。

choices.english: I thought you meant me. Why your own cup?
choices.chinese: 我还以为你在问我。为什么要自己带杯子？

choices.english: No problem. I won't interrupt.
choices.chinese: 没关系。我不打扰你。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kiptoo keeps the phone lowered. His unfinished message is still on the screen.
beats.chinese: Kiptoo没有再举起手机，屏幕上还留着没写完的消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Tea at a colleague's place later. First visit. They've said I can help myself, but I don't even know where the cups live.
beats.chinese: 晚点去同事家喝茶，头一次去。他们说让我随意，可我连杯子放哪儿都不知道。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He types a cupboard question, reads it and deletes it. A moment later, he starts typing it again.
beats.chinese: 他打出一句询问杯子在哪个橱柜里的话，读了读，又删掉。过了一会儿，他又开始打同一句。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I fix ticket scanners for outdoor concerts. Nobody has to invite me to open those. Someone else's kitchen takes more preparation.
beats.chinese: 我是给露天演出修检票设备的，拆那些机器可不用人请。进别人家的厨房，我倒得多做点准备。

choices.english: You could ask them to show you when you arrive. I'll let you get back to your walk.
choices.chinese: 可以请他们等你到了再指给你看。我就不耽误你散步了。

choices.english: I'll leave you to your message and walk on.
choices.chinese: 那你慢慢写，我先往前走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kiptoo lowers his phone completely and gives you a small smile.
beats.chinese: Kiptoo彻底放下手机，朝你微微一笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You're fine. I'm the one talking out loud.
beats.chinese: 没事，是我自己说出声了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He locks the screen and puts the phone in his pocket, leaving the trail clear.
beats.chinese: 他锁上屏幕，把手机收进口袋，留出步道上的通行空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That can wait. I've spent all day fixing ticket scanners. I came here for a walk without a screen.
beats.chinese: 消息可以等会儿再发。我修了一整天检票机，来这儿就是想不看屏幕，走一走。

choices.english: I'll go ahead, then. Enjoy your walk.
choices.chinese: 那我先走了。祝你散步愉快。

choices.english: I'm stopping here for a moment. You go ahead.
choices.chinese: 我在这儿停一会儿，你先走吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kiptoo replaces the unfinished cupboard question with a short request and sends it.
beats.chinese: Kiptoo把没写完的橱柜问题换成一句简短的请求，发了出去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. I've asked them to show me when I get there.
beats.chinese: 好了。我请他们等我到了再指给我看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the phone away, checks that the path is clear and resumes his walk.
beats.chinese: 他收起手机，看了看步道上没有妨碍，便继续散步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's enough questions for one message. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 一条消息问这些就够了。祝你散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kiptoo stays at the side of the dirt trail as you continue past.
beats.chinese: 你继续往前走，Kiptoo仍站在土路一侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. Thanks for stopping.
beats.chinese: 好啊。谢谢你停下来聊了两句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He switches off voice input and returns to typing, his thumb pausing over the unfinished question.
beats.chinese: 他关掉语音输入，改用手打，拇指又停在那个尚未写完的问题上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll keep the next draft to myself. Have a good walk.
beats.chinese: 下一稿我就不念出来了。祝你散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kiptoo remains to one side while you pass him on the trail.
beats.chinese: 你从步道上经过他身旁，Kiptoo留在一侧让你先行。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. I'll give you some room.
beats.chinese: 你也是。我等你先走一段。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He waits until there is a clear gap, then sets off at an unhurried pace with his phone still pocketed.
beats.chinese: 他等距离拉开后才慢慢迈步，手机仍收在口袋里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care.
beats.chinese: 慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You stop to one side of the trail. Kiptoo turns toward the open path ahead.
beats.chinese: 你在步道一侧停下。Kiptoo转身朝向前方通畅的土路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. I'll carry on.
beats.chinese: 好，那我继续走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He passes with space between you and continues along the tree-lined trail without taking out his phone.
beats.chinese: 他与你留着距离经过，沿着两侧都是树木的步道继续前行，没有再拿出手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Have a good afternoon.
beats.chinese: 祝你下午过得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Karura Forest, you see Kiptoo at the side of the dirt trail. He has just finished reading messages in his Sunday football group and looks up, recognizing you.
beats.chinese: 在卡鲁拉森林，你看见Kiptoo站在土路一侧。他刚看完周日足球群里的消息，抬头认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. We've just got enough people for football on Sunday, and they're already arguing about which side will win.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。周日踢球的人刚凑齐，群里已经开始争哪边会赢了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Smiling, he types a quick reply predicting a win for his side and pockets his phone. Looking livelier now, he turns toward the clear trail and resumes his walk.
beats.chinese: 他笑着打出一句简短的回复，打趣说自己这边会赢，随后收起手机。他的神态比刚才活跃了些，转向前方通畅的步道，继续散步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nobody's even there yet, and they're already arguing over the score. We'll see on Sunday.
beats.chinese: 人还没到场，比分已经吵出来了。周日再看。

causality.presenceReason: Kiptoo修了一天演出检票设备，下班后先来森林步道散步，途中停下回复同事的喝茶邀请。
causality.placeAttitude: 他把这里当作暂时离开设备和屏幕、走一走的地方，不承担带路或讲解职责。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有工作要求他留在原地。他只为写消息短暂停步，随时可以沿公共土路继续走。
causality.currentGoal: 回复首次去同事家喝茶的邀请，同时完成自己的散步。
causality.currentState: 工作后想少看屏幕，待人随和，但想到第一次进同事家便开始反复斟酌小问题。
causality.contactTrigger: 他语音输入时说出是否自带杯子的问题，发现玩家走近后主动澄清，避免对方误以为是在问自己。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留演出检票设备技师身份和轻松口吻。反复输入橱柜问题，具体呈现他在陌生住宅中过分拘谨、难以直接接受随意招待的缺点。重逢保留周日足球群聊，通过凑齐球友后的赛前打趣，呈现他在熟人圈中轻松、爱开玩笑并期待一起踢球的一面。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa中他发出到场后请主人指点的请求并继续散步。ab中玩家离开，他留在原地继续斟酌消息。ba中玩家先行，他等拉开距离后再走。bb中玩家停留，他先行离开。重逢时他随口分享周日踢球人数刚凑齐、朋友已在争论胜负的小事，发出一句赛前打趣后收起手机，神态更活跃，转身继续散步，不要求玩家介入。
causality.spatialContinuity: 所有动作都发生在两侧树木密集的连贯公共土路上，只使用随身手机，不添加座椅、建筑或其他设施。重逢时他停在土路一侧看消息，收好手机后朝通畅的步道转身，继续散步。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Kiptoo Cheruiyot。本次重逢位于卡鲁拉森林步道，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Outside Nairobi City Market, Wanjiru Kamau has paused during her walk home from a seed-packing shift to admire the painted exterior. She stands in a safe spot in the outside pedestrian space, away from the entrance.
beats.chinese: 在内罗毕城市市场外，Wanjiru Kamau下了种子包装班，步行回家途中停下来欣赏彩绘外墙。她站在外侧通行空间的一处安全位置，离入口有些距离。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Those colours look so good together.
beats.chinese: 这几块颜色放在一起真好看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She notices you nearby and turns toward you with a smile, still standing where she stopped.
beats.chinese: 她注意到附近的你，笑着转向你，仍站在原先停下的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I took a little detour to have a look. I'm not buying anything today.
beats.chinese: 我特意绕过来看一眼，今天不买东西。

choices.english: What caught your eye about it?
choices.chinese: 你觉得它哪里好看？

choices.english: Thanks. I'm just passing through.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，我只是路过。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wanjiru turns slightly toward you. Her gaze keeps returning to the wall.
beats.chinese: Wanjiru稍稍转向你，目光却还不时回到墙面上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The colours show up so well from here. I pack vegetable seeds part-time, so I spend hours looking at little packets.
beats.chinese: 从这里看，颜色特别显眼。我兼职包装蔬菜种子，常常一连几个小时看着小包装袋。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She opens one hand toward the broad painted surface, then chuckles at the size of her gesture.
beats.chinese: 她摊开一只手，朝大幅彩绘墙面示意，随后被自己这夸张的手势逗笑了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A whole wall deserves a longer inspection. I can get equally involved with a well-made sleeve, unfortunately.
beats.chinese: 这么大一面墙，值得多看一会儿。可惜啊，一只做工好的袖子也能让我看得这么入神。

choices.english: I'll have a quick look too.
choices.chinese: 那我也看一小会儿。

choices.english: Are you thinking of painting your home?
choices.chinese: 你是打算给家里刷漆吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wanjiru gives a small nod without moving from her spot.
beats.chinese: Wanjiru轻轻点头，仍站在原处。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. Enjoy your day.
beats.chinese: 当然。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She loosely clasps her hands and turns her attention back to the exterior.
beats.chinese: 她松松地交握双手，把注意力重新放回外墙上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My grand inspection can continue from here.
beats.chinese: 我的这场隆重检查，站在这里也能继续。

choices.english: Would you like some company on your walk?
choices.chinese: 你散步想找个人作伴吗？

choices.english: Give a small wave and continue along the outside.
choices.chinese: 轻轻挥手，沿市场外侧继续走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You pause to look from the outside pedestrian space. Wanjiru looks at the wall with you.
beats.chinese: 你在外侧通行空间里停下来看看。Wanjiru和你一起看向墙面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, this is a good distance. You get the whole spread of colour.
beats.chinese: 对，这个距离正好。整片颜色都看得见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: After a brief look, she lowers her hand and turns in the direction of her walk home.
beats.chinese: 看了片刻，她放下手，转向回家的方向。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That will do for my inspection. Enjoy the rest of your day.
beats.chinese: 我这检查就到这里吧。祝你接下来过得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wanjiru turns fully toward you, looking mildly startled by the idea of buying paint.
beats.chinese: Wanjiru完全转向你，听到买漆的意思，显得有点意外。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, no. My walls are fine. I haven't chosen paint or measured anything. I only meant these colours look good here.
beats.chinese: 哦，没有。我家的墙好好的。我没选油漆，也没量尺寸。我只是说，这些颜色用在这里很好看。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She has begun counting her reasons on her fingers. She notices, drops her hand, and gives an embarrassed laugh before resuming her walk.
beats.chinese: 她说着说着，已经开始掰手指数理由。发现之后，她放下手，有些不好意思地笑了笑，接着继续走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That was a lot of explanation for something I'm not buying. I'll get on home now. Take care.
beats.chinese: 一样根本不打算买的东西，我倒解释了这么一大通。我这就回家了。保重。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Wanjiru turns back toward you with a friendly smile, though she does not move closer.
beats.chinese: Wanjiru转回来，友好地笑了笑，不过没有走近。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. I'd like to do the rest of this walk on my own today.
beats.chinese: 谢谢你。今天剩下这段路，我想自己走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives you a small farewell wave and sets off along the market exterior, keeping clear of the entrance.
beats.chinese: 她轻轻挥手道别，沿市场外侧迈步离开，没有经过入口正前方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Kind of you to offer. Have a good day.
beats.chinese: 谢谢你这份好意。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you wave and continue along the outside, Wanjiru returns the gesture without trying to hold your attention.
beats.chinese: 你挥手后沿外侧继续走，Wanjiru也挥手回应，没有再留住你的注意。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy your day.
beats.chinese: 祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stays clear of the entrance and looks up at the painted exterior once more.
beats.chinese: 她留在不挡入口的位置，又抬头看了一眼彩绘外墙。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, worth the little detour.
beats.chinese: 嗯，绕这点路，值得。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Outside Nairobi City Market, Wanjiru Kamau recognizes you as she walks home along the outside pedestrian space. She has been walking straight along, without stopping to browse.
beats.chinese: 在内罗毕城市市场街口，Wanjiru Kamau正沿外侧步行空间回家，认出了你。她一直径直走着，没有停下来挑看东西。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again! It's dance night tonight. No more detours for me today.
beats.chinese: 又见面了！今晚要去跳舞，今天我就不再绕路闲逛了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She smiles and glances at the painted exterior, pausing briefly while still facing in her homeward direction.
beats.chinese: 她笑着看了一眼彩绘外墙，稍稍站定，身体仍朝着原来的回家方向，只作简短的问候。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There'll still be lovely things to look at tomorrow. Today I need to keep the evening for myself.
beats.chinese: 好看的明天还能看。今天我得把晚上的时间留给自己。

causality.presenceReason: Wanjiru结束种子包装班后步行回家，特意稍绕路看城市市场的彩绘外墙，先于玩家停在这里。
causality.placeAttitude: 她真心欣赏墙面的颜色，把看得入神当作散步的小乐趣，没有购物计划，并坦然说出自己的兴致。

causality.currentState: 下班后心情轻松，愿意简短聊天，但今天仍想独自走完这段路。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At the street corner outside Nairobi City Market, Baraka Otieno waits beside the painted outer wall. He arrived early to discuss a chipped saucer with a friend who left it at his restoration studio. The saucer is securely wrapped in his bag, and the walking space is clear.
beats.chinese: 在内罗毕城市市场外的街口，Baraka Otieno正靠着彩绘外墙等人。他提早到了，要和一位朋友商量碟子的缺口怎么修。朋友之前把碟子留在了他的修复工作室。碟子稳稳包在他的包里，通行空间始终畅通。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: With walls, I like looking at the colours. With old plates, I like seeing the marks from use.
beats.chinese: 墙面我喜欢看颜色，轮到旧碟子，我倒喜欢看用过的痕迹。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances from the painted wall to you, his phone lowered in one hand.
beats.chinese: 他的目光从彩绘墙面转向你，一只手低低拿着手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My friend doesn't feel the same. He wants his saucer repaired so it looks like new.
beats.chinese: 我朋友不这么想。他那只要修得像新的一样。

choices.english: Is the saucer in your bag? What's happened to it?
choices.chinese: 碟子在你包里吗？它怎么了？

choices.english: I'll leave you to it, thanks.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，我就不打扰你等人了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka puts his phone away and takes the wrapped saucer from his bag. He keeps it flat on his palm, with the paper tucked around its edge.
beats.chinese: Baraka收起手机，从包里取出包好的碟子。他将碟子平托在掌心，包装纸掖在边缘。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's chipped. I run a small tableware restoration studio here in Nairobi. He's asked me to make the chip disappear.
beats.chinese: 磕了个缺口。我在内罗毕开了间小餐具修复工作室。他想把这个缺口修得完全看不出来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: His phone sounds from his pocket. He takes it out and reads the message, then starts typing a reply with his free thumb.
beats.chinese: 口袋里的手机响了。他拿出来读了消息，用空着的那只手开始打回复。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've suggested keeping a faint line twice. It follows the blue pattern so neatly. Maybe if I show him here—
beats.chinese: 我已经劝过他两回，留一道浅浅的线也挺好。它刚好顺着蓝色花纹。也许等他来了，我指给他看——

choices.english: Could I see the saucer? You can keep holding it.
choices.chinese: 我能看看碟子吗？你拿着就好。

choices.english: He sounds quite clear about wanting it to look new.
choices.chinese: 听起来，他已经说得很清楚了，就是想修得像新的一样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka nods and lowers his phone to his side. His bag stays close to his leg beside the painted wall.
beats.chinese: Baraka点点头，把手机垂到身侧。他的包仍贴着腿，放在彩绘外墙边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I caught you with half a conversation there.
beats.chinese: 当然。我这没头没尾的，突然就问上你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He glances toward the market entrance, then begins typing a message on his phone.
beats.chinese: 他朝市场入口看了一眼，随后开始在手机上写消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll wait here for him. Thanks for hearing me out.
beats.chinese: 我就在这儿等他。谢谢你听我说这几句。

choices.english: I'll let you finish your message. Take care.
choices.chinese: 你继续回消息吧。再见。

choices.english: Hope your friend gets here soon. Goodbye.
choices.chinese: 希望你朋友快到了。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka puts his phone away and peels back just enough paper to show the saucer's blue edge and a small missing patch.
beats.chinese: Baraka收起手机，只掀开一小片包装纸，露出碟子上的蓝边和一处小缺口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Here, beside that blue leaf. Easy to miss while it's wrapped.
beats.chinese: 这里，蓝色叶子旁边。包着的时候不太看得出来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tilts the saucer slightly toward you, keeping it in his own hands. Then he covers the edge again and folds the paper snugly around it.
beats.chinese: 他始终自己拿着碟子，略微向你倾斜。随后，他重新盖住碟沿，把包装纸贴着碟子折好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's enough unwrapping on a pavement. I'll keep it covered until he arrives. Have a good day.
beats.chinese: 在人行道上就不多拆了。等他来了再打开。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka stops typing. His thumb stays over the screen for a moment.
beats.chinese: Baraka停下打字，拇指在屏幕上方悬了一会儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm only suggesting it. He hasn't seen how the line would—ah. Twice already, yes.
beats.chinese: 我也只是提个建议。他还没看过那道线会——啊。对，已经提两回了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives a small, sheepish laugh and deletes the unfinished reply. He puts the phone away and tightens the wrapping around the saucer.
beats.chinese: 他有点不好意思地笑了一声，删掉没写完的回复。他收好手机，将碟子上的包装纸拢紧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll sort out the colour match with him when he gets here. He's chosen the finish. Right, take care.
beats.chinese: 等他到了，我就跟他确认补色。他已经选好要什么效果了。那，再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka looks at the unfinished message once more, then locks the screen.
beats.chinese: Baraka又看了一眼没写完的消息，随后锁上屏幕。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I'll leave the message for now.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。消息先不写了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slips the phone into his pocket. The wrapped saucer stays in his bag as he settles back beside the wall.
beats.chinese: 他把手机放进口袋，重新在墙边站定。包好的碟子仍放在包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care.
beats.chinese: 再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Baraka looks toward the entrance again, keeping his bag beside him and the walking space clear.
beats.chinese: Baraka又朝入口看了看，包仍放在身边，没有占着通行空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. I did get here early.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。是我来早了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers his phone and turns his attention back to the people arriving at the market, continuing to wait beside the painted wall.
beats.chinese: 他放低手机，把注意力转回来到市场的人群，继续在彩绘外墙旁等朋友。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Goodbye. Have a good day.
beats.chinese: 再见。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Nairobi City Market, you see Baraka beside the painted outer wall, drinking water from his own mug. He recognizes you and lowers it.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到内罗毕城市市场时，你看见Baraka站在彩绘外墙旁，用自己的杯子喝水。他认出你，放低了杯子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. I've finished a batch of work at the studio today. Finally, I can take my time with this water.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。今天工作室的一批活已经做完了，终于能慢慢喝这口水。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the mug in his hand, briefly revealing the small chip on its outer wall. He stays beside the wall with the mug in hand.
beats.chinese: 他转了转手里的杯子，外壁上的小缺口短暂露了出来。他仍拿着杯子，在墙边稍作停留。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This one doesn't have to go to anyone. As long as it works for me, I'm happy with it.
beats.chinese: 这个不用交给谁，我自己用着顺手就行。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Outside Nairobi City Market, Zawadi Mutua waits beside the painted outer wall for a coworker to browse with. An old classmate is already beside her. He asks about volleyball, then suggests browsing together.
beats.chinese: 内罗毕城市市场外，Zawadi Mutua站在彩绘外墙旁，等一位同事一起逛市场。一位老同学已经站在她身旁。他问起排球，接着提议一起逛逛。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: We can talk volleyball on Sunday. I've got other plans today.
beats.chinese: 排球周日再说，今天我另有安排。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her words come quickly. Her classmate looks toward the entrance for a moment. She turns to you nearby and lowers her voice without trying to keep him from hearing.
beats.chinese: 她说得很快。同学暂时看向入口。她转向站在附近的你，压低声音，却没有刻意避着他。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I only told him I'd be here. He's gone and made plans for my time too.
beats.chinese: 我只告诉他我会在这里。他就把时间也替我约好了。

choices.english: Did you actually say you were meeting someone else?
choices.chinese: 那你有说自己约了别人吗？

choices.english: No problem. I'll leave you to your plans.
choices.chinese: 没事，你忙你的吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Zawadi presses her lips together, then gives a small shake of her head.
beats.chinese: Zawadi抿了抿嘴，轻轻摇头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No. I said where I'd be. Left out the useful bit, apparently.
beats.chinese: 没有。我只说了我会在哪儿。看来把最有用的那句漏了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her classmate holds up his phone to show her the volleyball arrangements. She keeps her hands at her sides and addresses him directly.
beats.chinese: 同学举起手机，给她看排球活动的安排。她没有接手机，双手垂在身侧，直接对他说话。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sam, I'm meeting a workmate. I arranged this one separately.
beats.chinese: Sam，我约了一个同事。这次我是分开约的。

choices.english: I'll step aside so you can sort that out.
choices.chinese: 我往旁边让让，你们先说清楚。

choices.english: I can say a quick hello, if that's all right.
choices.chinese: 方便的话，我可以简单打个招呼。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Zawadi notices that she and her classmate have turned toward each other across the walking space. She moves closer to the wall, and he follows.
beats.chinese: Zawadi注意到自己和同学面对面站着，占了些通行空间。她往墙边靠了靠，同学也跟着挪过去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You don't need to move. We're the ones spreading ourselves everywhere.
beats.chinese: 你不用让。是我们站得太散了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her classmate points at his volleyball messages again. Zawadi folds her arms, though a smile briefly lifts one corner of her mouth.
beats.chinese: 同学又指了指手机里的排球消息。Zawadi抱起双臂，嘴角却短暂地翘了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He thinks volleyball beats any other plan. Usually I'd argue. Today I'm waiting for a workmate.
beats.chinese: 他觉得排球比什么安排都重要。平时我会跟他争几句。今天我在等同事。

choices.english: I'd choose volleyball too.
choices.chinese: 我也会选排球。

choices.english: Thanks. Take care. Continue on your way.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，那再见。继续走自己的路。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You step aside. Sam gestures toward the entrance as if he could simply join the outing. Zawadi shakes her head before he finishes.
beats.chinese: 你往旁边让开。Sam朝入口比画了一下，似乎觉得自己可以直接加入。还没等他说完，Zawadi就摇了头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You can't join this one, Sam. I'll see you at volleyball.
beats.chinese: 这次你不能一起，Sam。打排球的时候见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sam lowers his hand and leaves along the outside passage. When her coworker arrives, Zawadi unfolds her arms and gives you a brief farewell nod.
beats.chinese: Sam放下手，沿外侧通行空间离开。同事到了，Zawadi松开抱着的双臂，向你轻轻点头道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks for the space. Enjoy your day.
beats.chinese: 谢谢你让我们把话说完。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You offer a quick hello. Zawadi turns slightly so that Sam is included in the exchange.
beats.chinese: 你简单打了个招呼。Zawadi稍稍侧身，让Sam也加入这段交谈。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. This is Sam. We went to school together. He treats every free afternoon as volleyball practice.
beats.chinese: 当然。这是Sam，我们以前是同学。他觉得只要下午有空，就该去练排球。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sam laughs and points at her in return. Then her coworker arrives. Zawadi's quick delivery slows, and she raises one hand in a smaller greeting.
beats.chinese: Sam笑着反过来指了指她。这时她的同事到了。Zawadi飞快的语速慢下来，抬起一只手，小幅度地打招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. Yes, just us for the market. Good meeting you, and Sam, I'll see you at volleyball.
beats.chinese: 嗨。对，就我们俩逛市场。很高兴认识你。Sam，打排球的时候见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Zawadi turns back to you with an exaggerated look of disbelief. Sam grins at having someone on his side.
beats.chinese: Zawadi转回头，夸张地露出难以置信的表情。Sam见有人支持自己，咧嘴笑了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Even with his passes? He sends the ball so far, practice becomes a running club.
beats.chinese: 就算他来传球也选？他能把球传得老远，练排球直接变成跑步活动。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Sam protests with both palms raised. Zawadi laughs, then spots her coworker approaching. She drops her arms and greets her in a quieter voice.
beats.chinese: Sam举起双手表示抗议。Zawadi笑了，随后看见同事走近。她放下手臂，压低声音打招呼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hi. Yes, I'm ready. You two can defend his passing without me. Bye!
beats.chinese: 嗨。嗯，我准备好了。你们俩继续替他的传球辩护吧，我就不奉陪了。再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue on your way, Zawadi returns your goodbye with a small wave. She turns back to Sam without trying to keep you in the conversation.
beats.chinese: 你继续往前走，Zawadi轻轻挥手回应你的道别。她转回去面对Sam，没有把你继续留在谈话里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care.
beats.chinese: 再见，慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her coworker arrives beside the painted wall. Sam gestures toward the market, but Zawadi shakes her head and indicates herself and her coworker.
beats.chinese: 她的同事来到彩绘墙边。Sam朝市场示意，Zawadi却摇了摇头，指了指自己和同事。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've already made plans, Sam. I'll see you at volleyball.
beats.chinese: Sam，我已经约好了。打排球的时候见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Nairobi City Market, Zawadi stands near the painted outer wall, reading her phone. She looks up and recognizes you.
beats.chinese: 在内罗毕城市市场，Zawadi正站在彩绘外墙附近看手机。她抬起头，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. My cousin's sent me a shopping list with one item on it.
beats.chinese: 啊，又见面了。我表亲给我发了张购物清单，上面只有一项。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks the message again, raises her eyebrows and starts typing a reply.
beats.chinese: 她又看了一遍消息，扬起眉毛，开始打字回复。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She's written 'something nice.' That really narrows it down. I'd better ask what she means.
beats.chinese: 她写的是“好看的东西”。这范围可真小。我还是问问她到底指什么吧。

causality.presenceReason: Zawadi已约好与一位同事逛城市市场，提前在彩绘外墙旁等候。
causality.placeAttitude: 她把市场当作和同事随意逛逛的地方，今天原本只打算与这位同事同行。
causality.stayingConstraint: 同事尚未到，她需要留在约定的外墙附近等候，没有理由陪陌生人离开。
causality.currentGoal: 等到同事，同时向已经站在身旁的老同学Sam说明这次没有邀请他同行。
causality.currentState: 老同学问起排球并提出一起逛，她语速很快地说今天另有安排。两圈朋友即将碰面，使她急于划清这次安排，却尚未承认自己漏说了约人的信息。
causality.contactTrigger: 老同学暂时看向入口时，她转向附近玩家，低声但不遮掩地评论他替自己安排时间。接触来自她对眼前社交僵局的一句主动旁白，没有误认招呼对象，也不要求玩家介入。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留她与老同学爱争辩、与同事少言的节奏差异，以及分开约人却漏说关键安排、解释时过于直白的缺点。玩家追问后，她承认自己只说了地点，没有说明另约他人。Sam始终是她的老同学，她等待的是另一位同事。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa中玩家让开，她直接拒绝Sam加入，Sam离开。ab中玩家选择问候，形成短暂介绍，随后她恢复与同事单独出行的安排。ba中玩家支持排球，她立刻拿Sam的传球开玩笑，同事到来后语气放缓并结束交谈。bb中玩家告辞，她礼貌放行，再独自处理Sam想加入的要求。
causality.spatialContinuity: 所有互动都在市场街口的彩绘外墙、入口可见范围和外侧通行空间发生。人物主动收拢站位，不占用车行面。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Zawadi Mutua。本次重逢位于内罗毕城市市场街口，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Fort Charles in Port Royal, Cynthia Bailey waits in the stone-paved courtyard. Her friend chose the fort as the first stop on her birthday outing, before lunch and shopping back in Kingston. Cynthia raises a hand toward you, then lowers it with a laugh.
beats.chinese: 在皇家港查尔斯堡，辛西娅·贝利站在石铺庭院里等朋友。朋友选了这座堡垒作为生日出游的第一站，之后再回金斯敦市区吃饭、逛店。她朝你挥起手，随即笑着放了下来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, that wave was meant for my friend. Sorry, love. I'm Cynthia Bailey.
beats.chinese: 哎哟，我那是在跟朋友招手呢。不好意思，亲爱的。我叫辛西娅·贝利。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stays clear of the path and glances at the phone in her hand. A folded shopping tote hangs from her wrist.
beats.chinese: 她站在不妨碍通行的位置，低头看了看手里的手机。手腕上挂着一个折好的购物袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's her birthday outing, and she's sent me a link to the bag she wants. She's chosen her present before we've even started!
beats.chinese: 今天是陪她出来过生日，她倒先把想要的包的链接发来了。我们还没出发，她就把礼物选好了！

choices.english: What did you have planned for her birthday?
choices.chinese: 你原本打算怎么陪她过生日？

choices.english: No worries. I'll leave you to watch for her.
choices.chinese: 没关系。你继续等她吧，我不打扰了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cynthia turns toward you, still standing beside the path. She opens her friend's message again.
beats.chinese: 辛西娅转向你，仍站在小路边。她又点开了朋友的消息。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A look round here, patties back in Kingston, then a present she chooses herself. I used to schedule lighthouse tours. Getting thirty people out for a look was easier than this!
beats.chinese: 先逛逛堡垒，回金斯敦吃馅饼，再让她亲手挑件礼物。我以前负责安排灯塔导览。带三十个人出来看看，都没这么费劲！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She types a reply, pauses, then adds two more lines. Her thumb hovers over the send button.
beats.chinese: 她打了一段回复，停了停，又添了两行。拇指悬在发送键上方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've said we could try the handles. And see the other colours. And have a little look next door. Well, that last bit might be for me.
beats.chinese: 我说，可以试试提手，看看别的颜色，再顺便逛逛隔壁。好吧，最后那一项可能是我自己想去。

choices.english: I'd go along, but I'd want to agree on one shop first.
choices.chinese: 我会愿意一起去，不过得先说好只逛一家。

choices.english: I'd send a link too. Sometimes choosing online is the fun.
choices.chinese: 我也会发链接。有时候，网上挑选本身就很好玩。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cynthia lowers her phone and turns slightly toward the stone-paved walkway, keeping the way clear.
beats.chinese: 辛西娅放低手机，稍稍转向庭院石铺通道，给行人留足了空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you, love. She said she'd meet me here, so here I stay.
beats.chinese: 谢谢你，亲爱的。她说在这里碰面，那我就在这里等。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips the phone into her tote and folds her arms loosely, watching for her friend.
beats.chinese: 她把手机放进购物袋，松松地抱起双臂，留意着朋友有没有来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: If I wave at you again, you can count it as a proper hello.
beats.chinese: 我要是再朝你挥手，那就算是正经跟你打招呼了。

choices.english: Give her a small wave and continue along the path.
choices.chinese: 朝她轻轻挥手，沿小路继续走。

choices.english: Nod goodbye and stay nearby to look at the fort.
choices.chinese: 点头道别，留在附近看看堡墙。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cynthia looks down at her growing message and gives a small, reluctant laugh.
beats.chinese: 辛西娅低头看看越写越长的消息，有点不情愿地笑了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One shop? I'd have to make it a good one. Listen to me, already negotiating.
beats.chinese: 只逛一家？那我可得挑家值得逛的。听听，我这就开始讨价还价了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She replaces the long message with a one-shop suggestion and sends it. Then she lowers the phone and turns back to watch for her friend.
beats.chinese: 她把长消息改成只逛一家店的提议，发了出去。随后，她放低手机，转回去等朋友。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There, I've offered one shop, then patties. She can take it or leave it. Take care, love.
beats.chinese: 好了，我提议逛一家，然后吃馅饼。她愿不愿意都行。慢走，亲爱的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cynthia lifts an eyebrow at you, then looks back at the bag pictured on her phone.
beats.chinese: 辛西娅朝你扬了扬眉毛，又看向手机上那个包的图片。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too? I shall have nobody left to wander with at this rate. It is a nice bag, though. Very much her.
beats.chinese: 你也这样？照这么下去，都没人陪我逛了。不过这包确实好看，很像她会喜欢的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She deletes her extra suggestions and sends a short reply accepting her friend's choice. She puts the phone away and lets the folded tote hang at her side.
beats.chinese: 她删掉那些额外建议，发了条简短回复，接受朋友选好的包。随后收起手机，让折好的购物袋垂在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right, the bag is settled. I've asked her to keep the patties on the plan. Enjoy the courtyard, love.
beats.chinese: 好啦，包就这么定了。我请她把吃馅饼这一项留着。慢慢逛庭院吧，亲爱的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the stone-paved walkway, Cynthia returns your small wave. She remains beside the walkway's edge.
beats.chinese: 你沿庭院石铺通道继续走，辛西娅也轻轻挥手回应。她仍留在庭院边的小路旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There, that one reached the right person.
beats.chinese: 这回可算挥对人了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lowers her hand and looks along the walkway again. Other visitors pass over the open stone paving.
beats.chinese: 她放下手，再次望向通道。其他游客沿开阔的石铺地面走过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care, now.
beats.chinese: 慢走啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Cynthia returns your nod and leaves you to look at the red-brick fort wall. She keeps her place beside the path, away from your view.
beats.chinese: 辛西娅点头回应，让你自行欣赏红砖堡墙。她继续站在小路旁，没有挡住你的视线。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave you to your looking, then.
beats.chinese: 那我就不打扰你慢慢看了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her phone rings inside the tote. She takes it out and answers quietly, turning slightly away from you.
beats.chinese: 购物袋里的手机响了。她拿出来，稍稍背过身，压低声音接听。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, I'm in the courtyard. Take your time, I'm quite all right here.
beats.chinese: 对，我在庭院里。慢慢来，我在这里挺好的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Fort Charles, Cynthia Bailey recognises you from beside the stone-paved walkway. Her phone is already put away, and she leaves room for people to pass.
beats.chinese: 在皇家港查尔斯堡，站在庭院石铺通道旁的辛西娅·贝利认出了你。她已经收好手机，身边留着供人通行的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again, love! I've had a morning round the shops with my friend. Now I just want to look at these old brick walls for a little while, quietly.
beats.chinese: 哎哟，又见面了，亲爱的！上午已经陪朋友逛过店了。现在我只想安安静静地看看这些旧砖墙。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds her folded shopping tote in one hand and looks across the stone courtyard towards the fort wall. She adds no plans for another stop.
beats.chinese: 她一手握着折好的购物袋，目光越过石铺庭院，望向堡墙，没有再追加下一站的安排。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The afternoon's been lively enough. I'm not planning anything else just now. Take care, love!
beats.chinese: 下午已经够热闹了，这会儿不安排节目。慢走，亲爱的！

causality.presenceReason: 朋友把查尔斯堡选作生日出游的第一站。辛西娅按约先到石铺庭院，之后准备一起回金斯敦市区吃馅饼、挑礼物。
causality.placeAttitude: 她愿意陪朋友看堡垒，把停留作为共同出游的一部分，也会惦记接下来的逛店安排。
causality.stayingConstraint: 朋友尚未到达，她留在约定地点。全程站在小路旁，不占庭院铺地或阻碍行人。
causality.currentGoal: 等朋友到来，并说服对方保留一起到店挑选礼物的环节。
causality.currentState: 今天精神足、愿意聊天，收到朋友选好礼物的链接后略有不甘，但并未真正生气。
causality.contactTrigger: 她误把招呼朋友的挥手朝向玩家，随即主动道歉并介绍自己。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留退休灯塔展览讲解员兼导览排程员身份，以安排出游的口吻和不断追加购物建议的动作呈现热情、健谈与仪式上的固执。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa中她把长计划缩成一家店的提议。ab中她接受朋友线上选定的包，只争取保留吃馅饼。ba中玩家沿路离开，她挥手后继续等人。bb中玩家留下看堡墙，她停止搭话并低声接听电话。重逢时她已陪朋友逛完，社交上得到满足，当下只想安静看堡墙，热情招呼后不追加行程，轻快道别。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程使用查尔斯堡石铺庭院与砖砌炮位旁的通行空间。人物在展品之外停步，留出通道，不倚坐、移动或攀爬旧炮。购物、午餐和合唱安排由对话交代为此后在金斯敦市区的行程，不在堡内新增店铺或表演场地。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Cynthia Bailey。本次重逢位于皇家港查尔斯堡庭院，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Fort Charles in Port Royal, Marcia Bell waits on the stone-paved walkway for a walk with her sister. As she adjusts her bag, a pink star pendant slips off its chain and lands near your feet, beside the walkway's edge.
beats.chinese: 在金斯敦皇家港查尔斯堡，玛西娅·贝尔正在庭院石铺通道上等姐姐一起散步。她调整肩包时，一枚粉红星形吊坠从链子上滑落，掉在你脚边、庭院边界旁。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Mind that pink star by your foot. Mine, unfortunately. The clasp has resigned.
beats.chinese: 留神你脚边那颗粉红星星。可惜，是我的。搭扣辞职了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcia picks it up herself, then moves aside on the path so there is room to pass. She turns the bright plastic star between her fingers.
beats.chinese: 玛西娅自己捡起吊坠，随后往小径一侧让了让，留出通行空间。她用手指转着那颗鲜亮的塑料星星。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Marcia. Usually I manage to keep all my jewellery attached.
beats.chinese: 我叫玛西娅。平常我的首饰倒也不至于散得到处都是。

choices.english: It's lovely. That pink really works.
choices.chinese: 挺漂亮的。这个粉红色真好看。

choices.english: Glad you found it. I'll leave you to it.
choices.chinese: 捡回来就好。那我不打扰了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcia stops turning the pendant. Her fingers close around it, and one eyebrow lifts.
beats.chinese: 玛西娅不再转动吊坠。她把它攥进手心，挑起一边眉毛。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Lovely? You don't need to butter me up. I restore stained glass. That doesn't make this a collector's piece.
beats.chinese: 漂亮？不用恭维我。我是修复彩色玻璃的，可这东西也不会因此就成了收藏品。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She opens her hand again, exposing a small moulding seam along the plastic star.
beats.chinese: 她又摊开手，塑料星星边缘的一道细小模具接缝露了出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bargain stall. I went straight for the loudest pink.
beats.chinese: 便宜摊上买的。我直奔最扎眼的粉红色去了。

choices.english: I meant the colour. I didn't know about your workshop.
choices.chinese: 我说的是颜色。我之前不知道你开工作室。

choices.english: All right. Enjoy your afternoon.
choices.chinese: 好吧。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcia lowers the pendant and keeps the path clear. She makes no move to draw you closer.
beats.chinese: 玛西娅放低拿着吊坠的手，继续让出小径，没有招呼你靠近。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks, darling. I'm waiting for my sister. She'll spot this pink thing before she spots me.
beats.chinese: 谢谢，亲爱的。我在等姐姐。她准会先看见这团粉红色，再看见我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She places the pendant and loose chain together in her bag, then glances along the stone-paved walkway.
beats.chinese: 她把吊坠和松开的链子一起放进包里，随后沿庭院石铺通道望了望。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Though she'll certainly notice I've put it away. She keeps a proper inventory of my terrible jewellery.
beats.chinese: 不过，她肯定会发现我把它收起来了。我的那些俗气首饰，她可都记得清清楚楚。

choices.english: Before I go, does your sister like bright jewellery too?
choices.chinese: 走之前问一句，你姐姐也喜欢鲜艳的首饰吗？

choices.english: Give a small wave and continue along the path.
choices.chinese: 轻轻挥手，沿小径继续走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcia looks from the pendant to you. Her raised eyebrow drops, and she gives a short, sheepish laugh.
beats.chinese: 玛西娅看看吊坠，又看看你。她放下挑起的眉毛，有点不好意思地笑了一声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh. Then I supplied the whole argument myself. Sorry, darling.
beats.chinese: 哦。那这场争论全是我自己编出来的。抱歉，亲爱的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She holds the star against her jade-green top for a moment, then puts it safely inside her bag and closes the zip.
beats.chinese: 她把星星放在翡翠绿色上衣前比了一下，随后妥当地收进包里，拉好拉链。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Pink and green. Yes, I'm pleased with that. Enjoy your walk. I'll wait here for my sister.
beats.chinese: 粉红配绿色。嗯，我挺满意。祝你散步愉快，我在这儿等姐姐。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcia gives a small nod. Her hand closes over the pendant again, and she leaves the subject alone.
beats.chinese: 玛西娅轻轻点头，再次把吊坠握在手里，没有继续这个话题。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. Mind how you go.
beats.chinese: 你也是。慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tucks the star into her bag and watches the walkway again, standing beside the courtyard wall.
beats.chinese: 她把星星塞进包里，站在庭院墙边，重新望向通道另一头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right. Jewellery repairs can wait until I get home.
beats.chinese: 好了。修首饰这事，等回家再说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcia grins and rests one hand on her closed bag.
beats.chinese: 玛西娅咧嘴一笑，一只手搭在已经合上的包上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: She calls mine dreadful, then asks whether they had it in blue. Every market trip.
beats.chinese: 她先说我买的难看，然后又问有没有蓝色的。每次逛市场都这样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Farther along the walkway, a woman raises a hand. Marcia waves back and walks towards her over the open stone paving.
beats.chinese: 石铺通道稍远处，一位女子抬起手。玛西娅挥手回应，沿开阔的铺地朝她走去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There she is. Now she'll inspect the missing necklace. Take care, darling.
beats.chinese: 她来了。这下该检查我脖子上怎么少了条项链了。慢走，亲爱的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You give a small wave and continue along the stone-paved walkway. Marcia returns the wave without calling you back.
beats.chinese: 你轻轻挥手，沿庭院石铺通道继续走。玛西娅也挥了挥手，没有叫住你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye, darling.
beats.chinese: 再见，亲爱的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks that her bag is closed, then turns towards a woman approaching along the path.
beats.chinese: 她确认包已经合好，随后转向沿小径走来的一位女子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There you are, sis. Ready for our walk?
beats.chinese: 姐，你来了。准备好散步了吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Fort Charles, Marcia Bell stands beside the stone-paved walkway with a small notepad in her hand. She looks up and recognises you.
beats.chinese: 在皇家港查尔斯堡，玛西娅·贝尔站在庭院石铺通道旁，手里拿着一本小本子。她抬起头，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello, darling. I'm waiting for my sister. Sketched two window designs today. That's enough work while I'm waiting.
beats.chinese: 你好呀，亲爱的。我在等姐姐。今天随手画了两种窗样，等人的工夫就不接着干了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes the notepad, revealing a bright plastic bracelet on her wrist. Her gaze moves across the stone paving to the red-brick fort wall.
beats.chinese: 她合上本子，露出腕上一条鲜亮的塑料手链，目光越过庭院铺地，转向红砖堡墙。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll choose a design when I get home. For now, I'll wait for my sister. We're out for a walk today. See you, darling.
beats.chinese: 窗样回去再挑。现在先等我姐姐，今天是出来散步的。回见，亲爱的。

causality.presenceReason: 姐姐提议一起参观查尔斯堡。玛西娅提前到石铺庭院等她，准备在下班后的空闲里慢慢走一圈。

causality.stayingConstraint: 她与姐姐约在这里碰面，因此留在小径旁等候，不需要玩家陪伴。
causality.currentGoal: 捡好意外脱落的吊坠，收妥首饰，再等姐姐到来。
causality.currentState: 她已经放松下来，愿意开个小玩笑，但对听起来像专业身份恭维的话反应过快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Fort Charles in Port Royal, Yvonne Chambers has arrived early to meet her sister Denise for a walk. Beside the stone-paved walkway, she raises her phone toward the red-brick fort wall beyond the stone courtyard, then notices you near the edge of her frame.
beats.chinese: 在金斯敦的皇家港查尔斯堡，伊冯娜·钱伯斯提前到了，等妹妹丹妮丝一起散步。她站在庭院石铺通道旁，举起手机拍石铺庭院后方的红砖堡墙，随后发现你在画面边缘。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello, I'm Yvonne. Would you mind being in the background of a photograph?
beats.chinese: 你好，我叫伊冯娜。你介意出现在照片背景里吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lowers the phone without taking a picture. She stays beside the path, clear of the cannon emplacements and passing visitors.
beats.chinese: 她没有拍照，先放下了手机。她仍站在路径旁，没有跨过炮位边界，也没有挡住经过的游客。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's fine if you'd rather not. I'm waiting for my sister, so there's no hurry.
beats.chinese: 不愿意也没关系。我在等妹妹，不着急。

choices.english: Being in the background is fine.
choices.chinese: 出现在背景里没关系。

choices.english: I'd rather stay out of the photograph, thanks.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，我还是不入镜了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Yvonne checks that no other visitors are in the frame, takes one photograph and lowers her phone.
beats.chinese: 伊冯娜确认画面中没有其他游客，拍了一张，便放下手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. I've been proofreading food labels all morning. I was ready to come out.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。我整个上午都在校对食品标签，早就想出来走走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She opens another photograph and turns the screen toward you. It shows an empty kitchen after lunch. Almost immediately, she replaces it with the same room neatly set before the meal.
beats.chinese: 她打开另一张照片，把屏幕转向你。照片里是午饭后空无一人的厨房。几乎没等人看清，她就换成了同一个房间开饭前整齐摆好的样子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sunday lunch at mine. Oh, use this one. All six chairs are tucked in properly here.
beats.chinese: 这是我家星期天的午饭。哦，看这张吧。这张里的六把椅子都收得整整齐齐。

choices.english: Could I finish looking at the first photograph?
choices.chinese: 能让我把刚才那张看完吗？

choices.english: Six places. You must enjoy getting the table ready.
choices.chinese: 摆了六个人的位置。你一定很喜欢布置餐桌。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Yvonne closes the camera immediately. The red-brick wall is still in view, but she makes no attempt to find another angle around you.
beats.chinese: 伊冯娜立即关掉相机。红砖堡墙仍在眼前，她没有试着绕开你另找角度。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I'll put it away.
beats.chinese: 当然。我收起来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slips the phone into her pocket and turns slightly toward the stone-paved walkway, watching for Denise.
beats.chinese: 她把手机放进口袋，略微转向庭院石铺通道，留意丹妮丝有没有来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Denise picked our walk today. Usually I'm the one suggesting a bicycle ride.
beats.chinese: 今天散步的地方是丹妮丝挑的。平常都是我提议骑车。

choices.english: Do you cycle around Kingston much?
choices.chinese: 你经常在金斯敦骑车吗？

choices.english: Enjoy your walk. I'll leave you to it.
choices.chinese: 祝你散步愉快。我就不打扰了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Yvonne brings back the photograph taken after lunch. One chair is turned sideways, with a bag hanging from its back. The room is empty.
beats.chinese: 伊冯娜翻回午饭后的照片。一把椅子斜转着，椅背上挂着一个包。房间里没有人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, sorry. Denise turned that chair to hear the radio. I slid it back twice, with her bag still on it.
beats.chinese: 可以，抱歉。丹妮丝把那把椅子转过去听收音机。我给推回去了两次，她的包还挂在上面呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her thumb starts toward the screen again. She catches the movement and holds the photograph steady for a few seconds before lowering the phone.
beats.chinese: 她的拇指又朝屏幕挪去。她察觉后停住，让照片稳稳显示了几秒，才放下手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There, you've had a proper look now. I'd better watch for her. Enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 好了，这回让你看清楚了。我得留意她来了没有。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Yvonne keeps the neatly arranged kitchen on the screen. Six places fill the table, and every chair faces straight ahead.
beats.chinese: 伊冯娜让布置整齐的厨房照片留在屏幕上。桌上摆着六套餐具，每把椅子都朝向正前方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I do. My first flat barely fitted one guest. Now I can seat six, and I start laying things out far too early.
beats.chinese: 是啊。我第一套公寓勉强只能坐下一位客人。现在能坐六个人，我总是早早就开始摆东西。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She enlarges the photograph to straighten its angle, checks it once more, then closes it and pockets the phone.
beats.chinese: 她放大照片，调整倾斜的角度，又检查了一遍，才关掉照片，把手机收进口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You've seen six plates and had no lunch. Poor hospitality from me. I'll let you get on. Enjoy the courtyard.
beats.chinese: 让你看了六个盘子，却没给你吃午饭。我这招待可不周到。你继续逛吧，祝你逛得开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Yvonne turns back toward you, keeping enough room beside her for visitors to pass along the path.
beats.chinese: 伊冯娜转回来，身旁仍留着足够的空间，让游客沿路径经过。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Most Saturdays, to the markets. I change my route if I hear about a bargain. Denise picked the fort today. We've arranged to meet here, and I've left the bicycle at home.
beats.chinese: 大多数周六都骑去市场。听说哪里有便宜货，我就改路线。今天丹妮丝选了堡垒，我们约好在这里碰面，我把自行车留在家里了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: A woman approaching along the stone-paved walkway waves. Yvonne returns the wave and turns to meet her at the side of the path.
beats.chinese: 一位沿庭院石铺通道走来的女子挥了挥手。伊冯娜也挥手回应，转身在路径边迎她。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There's Denise. She gets to choose the pace today as well. Nice talking to you.
beats.chinese: 丹妮丝来了。今天走多快也由她定。很高兴和你聊了聊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Yvonne stays beside the path, leaving the way open. Her phone remains in her pocket.
beats.chinese: 伊冯娜留在路径旁，没有挡路。手机仍放在她口袋里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. Enjoy your visit.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives you a small wave, then turns her attention to the red-brick cannon emplacements while she waits.
beats.chinese: 她朝你轻轻挥了挥手，然后一边等人，一边看向庭院铺地旁的砖砌炮位。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll wait here for Denise. She'll spot this collar easily enough.
beats.chinese: 我就在这里等丹妮丝。这个大领子，她一眼就能认出来。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: In the stone-paved courtyard at Fort Charles, Yvonne is putting her phone into her bag. She looks up from beside the brick wall and recognises you.
beats.chinese: 在查尔斯堡的石铺庭院，伊冯娜正把手机收进包里。她从砖墙旁抬起头，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. I had guests for lunch before I came out today. They arrived before I got my usual photograph of the empty kitchen.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。今天出门前，我在家招待客人吃午饭。还没来得及像平常那样拍张空厨房，他们就到了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She glances down at her bag and pauses, her fingers lingering at the opening. Then she gives a little laugh and closes the bag, leaving the phone inside.
beats.chinese: 她低头看了看包，停了片刻，手指还搭在包口。随后她轻轻笑了一声，把包合上，没再拿出手机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Everyone had sat down. I couldn't ask them all to get up for a photograph. I'll just remember the meal this time. Good to see you. Enjoy your visit.
beats.chinese: 大家都坐下了，总不好让他们为了一张照片全站起来。这回就把那顿饭记在心里吧。见到你真好。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Fort Charles in Port Royal, Dwayne Chambers has arrived early to enjoy the courtyard before meeting a choir friend. The curatorial assistant stands at one edge of the path, leaving room to pass, and reads aloud from a paperback.
beats.chinese: 在金斯敦的皇家港查尔斯堡，策展助理德韦恩·钱伯斯提前到了，想在见合唱团朋友之前逛逛庭院。他站在庭院石铺通道的一侧，留着通行空间，正拿着一本平装书朗读。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You ignored three letters. Must I send the fourth with a drum?
beats.chinese: 你已经不理会三封信了。第四封难道要敲着鼓送来吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lowers the book of published letters and turns toward you. Behind him, cannon emplacements line the red-brick wall.
beats.chinese: 他放低那本收录已发表书信的书，转向你。他身后，一排旧炮位沿红砖堡墙排列。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sorry, that was the letter talking. I'm Dwayne. I got a bit loud there.
beats.chinese: 抱歉，那是信里的话。我叫德韦恩。刚才读得有点大声了。

choices.english: Go on. What does the next bit say?
choices.chinese: 继续吧。接下来写了什么？

choices.english: No reading for me, thanks. Are you on a choir break?
choices.chinese: 谢谢，我就不听朗读了。你是在合唱团排练间隙休息吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dwayne raises the book again. He lifts his chin and gives the writer a brisk, offended voice.
beats.chinese: 德韦恩重新举起书，抬了抬下巴，用利落又愤愤不平的语气演起写信人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No, I shall save the postage and complain to your sister instead. Oh, she's taking this straight to the family.
beats.chinese: 不，我还是省下邮资，直接向你姐姐告状吧。哎呀，她这是直接找上家里人了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He grins and holds his place with one finger. His other hand drops to his side.
beats.chinese: 他咧嘴一笑，用一根手指夹住读到的位置，另一只手垂在身侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I help curate a handwritten letters exhibition. I've been asked to stop doing the voices twice. Once, someone asked me to carry on.
beats.chinese: 我在一个手写书信展做策展助理。有两回，人家叫我别再变着声音读了。还有一回，有人让我继续。

choices.english: Can I hear the last line in a quieter voice?
choices.chinese: 能小声读一下最后一句吗？

choices.english: Do you write letters like that yourself?
choices.chinese: 你自己也会写这样的信吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dwayne lowers the paperback fully. He stays at the edge of the path rather than moving into your way.
beats.chinese: 德韦恩把书完全放低，仍站在路径一侧，没有挡到你面前。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. Choir's back in Kingston later. I'm meeting someone here first. Second tenor for me. I leave the very high notes to other people.
beats.chinese: 行啊。晚些时候回金斯敦唱合唱。我先在这里跟朋友碰面。我唱第二男高音，特别高的音交给别人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes the book, leaving a handmade braided bookmark between its pages. A short blue-and-yellow end hangs below the cover.
beats.chinese: 他合上书，把一条手工编织的书签夹在里面。一小截蓝黄相间的编绳垂在封面下方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I made this for our alto. She uses shopping lists as bookmarks, then takes them shopping and loses her place.
beats.chinese: 这是我给我们团的女低音编的。她总拿购物清单当书签，买东西时抽走清单，回来就找不到读到哪儿了。

choices.english: May I see the braid? You can hold it.
choices.chinese: 我能看看编绳吗？你拿着就好。

choices.english: Enjoy choir. I'll keep walking along the path.
choices.chinese: 祝你合唱愉快。我沿着这条路继续走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dwayne brings the book of published letters closer. He reads the final line in a voice low enough to reach only you.
beats.chinese: 德韦恩把那本收录已发表书信的书拿近些，压低声音读最后一句，音量只够你听见。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Your sister, I should add, answers her post.
beats.chinese: 顺便一提，你姐姐可是会回信的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes the paperback around its braided bookmark and tucks it under his arm. His attention returns to the courtyard as he waits for his friend.
beats.chinese: 他把编绳书签夹好，合上书，夹在臂下，目光重新转向庭院，继续等朋友。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's the end. I won't start another one. Enjoy your visit.
beats.chinese: 读完了。我就不再开下一封了。祝你逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dwayne's grin fades. He lowers the book, keeping his finger between the pages.
beats.chinese: 德韦恩收起笑容，放低书，手指仍夹在书页之间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That one I can't answer in public.
beats.chinese: 这个问题，我不能在公共场合回答。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes the book around its bookmark and turns toward the red-brick fort wall. He remains at the path's edge, leaving the way clear.
beats.chinese: 他夹好书签，合上书，转身望向红砖堡墙。他仍站在路径一侧，留出通行的地方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care.
beats.chinese: 慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Dwayne opens the book just enough to lift out the bookmark. He holds it across his palm for you to see without passing it over.
beats.chinese: 德韦恩把书打开一点，取出书签，摊在掌心里给你看，没有递过来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Blue and yellow. I'm giving it to her with the whole choir there. Yes, I want the fuss.
beats.chinese: 蓝色配黄色。我要等全团都在的时候送给她。对，我就是想让大家起起哄。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the braid once to show its other side, then slips it back between the pages. He tucks the book under his arm and resumes watching for his friend.
beats.chinese: 他把编绳翻过来，让你看看另一面，随后重新夹进书里。他把书夹在臂下，继续留意朋友有没有来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Right, that's put away till she gets here. Thanks for looking. Enjoy your afternoon.
beats.chinese: 好了，先收着，等她来了再拿。谢谢你愿意看。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the stone-paved walkway, Dwayne lifts the closed paperback in a small goodbye.
beats.chinese: 你沿庭院石铺通道继续走，德韦恩举了举合上的书，向你道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Enjoy the courtyard.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。祝你在庭院逛得愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens the book again and finds his place beside the braided bookmark. This time his lips move without any sound.
beats.chinese: 他重新翻开书，在编绳书签旁找到刚才的位置。这回他嘴唇微动，却没读出声音。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll read the sister's reply quietly. Enjoy the courtyard.
beats.chinese: 信里那位姐姐的回信，我就默读了。祝你逛庭院愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Fort Charles, Dwayne Chambers recognises you at the edge of the stone-paved walkway. A folded draft and pencil are in his hand.
beats.chinese: 在皇家港查尔斯堡庭院步道一侧，Dwayne Chambers手拿折好的草稿和铅笔，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Exhibition caption. Eleventh draft. The tenth was fine. That's rather the problem.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。展览说明，第十一稿。第十稿就挺好。这才麻烦。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He changes one word, reads the line silently and leaves the pencil against the page instead of putting it away.
beats.chinese: 他改了一个词，默读那一行，铅笔仍抵在纸上，没有收起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Choir later. I've got time to make it worse before then. Good seeing you.
beats.chinese: 晚点去合唱。那之前还有时间把它改糟。很高兴见到你。

causality.presenceReason: 德韦恩与合唱团朋友约好参观查尔斯堡，之后再回金斯敦参加排练。他先到庭院，等候时翻读自带的书信选集。
causality.placeAttitude: 他乐意在排练前与朋友出游。等人时沉浸在读物里，也容易把信中的语气读得太响。
causality.stayingConstraint: 他在原处等朋友，稍后还有不可随意取消的合唱安排，无需玩家陪伴或帮忙。
causality.currentGoal: 读完眼前的一页，并把给团友编的书签带到碰面处。
causality.currentState: 今天有空闲，读得投入而略显张扬，愿意短聊，但私人表达仍有明确边界。
causality.contactTrigger: 他把信中责问收信人的句子读出了声，随后主动向附近的玩家说明那是信里的话并自报姓名。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Kingston's Emancipation Park, Shanice Rowe is taking her usual break from her workshop near a blue mahoe tree. She stands to one side of the park path, holding a small camera without raising it.
beats.chinese: 在金斯敦的解放公园，Shanice Rowe像平常一样，离开工作室到公园里歇一会儿。她停在蓝马霍树附近的园路一侧，手里拿着小相机，还没有举起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Excuse me. From here, do the two main branches look as if they overlap a little? I'm Shanice.
beats.chinese: 打扰一下。从这里看，两条主枝是不是有一点重叠？我叫 Shanice。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She indicates the direction with her free hand, keeping the camera down and the public path clear.
beats.chinese: 她用空着的手比出方向，相机仍然垂着，也没有挡住公共步道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I stand in this same spot every time. A friend lent me this camera. Now I'm actually thinking about trying a different angle.
beats.chinese: 我每次都站在这个位置。朋友借了这台相机给我，我这才认真想起要换个角度试试。

choices.english: A little, yes. Is this your usual view?
choices.chinese: 是有一点。这就是你平常看的角度吗？

choices.english: Sorry, I can't stop to talk. Have a good day.
choices.chinese: 不好意思，我没法停下来聊。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Shanice turns slightly toward the tree, keeping the camera down.
beats.chinese: Shanice 稍稍转向树，相机仍然垂着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. Same side, same spot. I restore old radio cabinets, then come here to give my hands a break.
beats.chinese: 对。同一侧，同一个位置。我修复老式收音机的外壳，干完一阵就来这里让双手歇歇。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes a step along the park path, checks the view, then shifts straight back to where she was.
beats.chinese: 她沿树旁步道挪了一步，看了看眼前的景象，又直接挪回原位。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: See what I've done? Borrowed a different camera and put my feet in exactly the same place.
beats.chinese: 你看我干了什么？相机换了，脚倒是一点没换地方。

choices.english: Try one step sideways. I'll stay behind you.
choices.chinese: 试着往旁边挪一步吧。我待在你身后。

choices.english: I'll leave you to your usual spot.
choices.chinese: 那我就不打扰你在老位置拍照了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Shanice lowers her pointing hand, leaving the camera switched off.
beats.chinese: Shanice 放下指方向的手，相机仍然关着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Of course. I won't keep you.
beats.chinese: 当然，那就不耽搁你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She fits the lens cap into place and holds the camera against her bag.
beats.chinese: 她盖好镜头盖，把相机贴着自己的包拿着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I might take a photograph first. Then I'll finish my walk. Have a good day too.
beats.chinese: 我可能先拍张照，再继续散步。也祝你今天愉快。

choices.english: I'll leave you to your photo.
choices.chinese: 那就不打扰你拍照了。

choices.english: Enjoy your walk.
choices.chinese: 祝你散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: With you behind her, Shanice studies the clear patch of path beside her feet.
beats.chinese: 你待在她身后。Shanice 低头看了看脚边空着的一块步道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: One step. I can manage one step. Hold on, let me get the strap out of the way.
beats.chinese: 一步嘛。一步我还是迈得出去的。等一下，我先把带子弄开。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She moves sideways, lifts the camera and takes a photograph. After checking the screen, she switches it off and starts along the park path.
beats.chinese: 她横着挪了一步，举起相机拍了一张。看过屏幕后，她关掉相机，沿树旁步道继续走。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That separates the branches a little. Right, I'm keeping that one. Enjoy the park.
beats.chinese: 这样枝条就分开一点了。好，这张留着。祝你逛得开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Shanice settles both feet back into her familiar position, with the lens still pointing down.
beats.chinese: Shanice 把双脚踏实地放回熟悉的位置，镜头依旧朝下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Fair enough. I've spent all morning turning a radio cabinet round. This one can stay where it is.
beats.chinese: 也好。我一上午都在把一个收音机木壳转来转去。这回就让位置保持原样吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She turns the camera so the screen faces only her and opens the settings. The lens stays lowered as she works through the buttons.
beats.chinese: 她把相机屏幕转向自己，打开设置，一边按按钮，一边让镜头保持朝下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd better learn which button does what before I borrow any more equipment. Take care.
beats.chinese: 我还是先弄明白这些按钮都干什么，再借别的器材吧。慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Shanice stays beside the tree with the capped camera as you finish saying goodbye.
beats.chinese: 你道别时，Shanice 留在树旁，相机的镜头盖仍盖着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. Take care.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。慢走。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She uncaps the lens and waits for a clear view of the tree. She takes one photograph, then lowers the camera.
beats.chinese: 她取下镜头盖，等树前没有路人经过时拍了一张，随即放下相机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Got it. That'll do for today.
beats.chinese: 拍好了。今天就拍这一张吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Shanice opens her bag and puts the camera inside without switching it on again.
beats.chinese: Shanice 打开包，把相机放进去，没有再开机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. The tree isn't going anywhere.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。树又不会跑。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She closes the bag, frees her scarf from under its strap and turns along the public path, leaving your space clear.
beats.chinese: 她合上包，把压在包带下面的围巾抽出来，转身沿公共步道走去，没有占着你身旁的位置。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll finish my walk. Then it's back to three unfinished radio cabinets. I really should have stopped at two. Enjoy your visit.
beats.chinese: 我继续走完这一圈，然后回去对付那三个没修完的收音机外壳。真该接到第二个就打住的。祝你逛得开心。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Emancipation Park, Shanice has stopped near the blue mahoe tree. She recognises you and steps to one side of the park path.
beats.chinese: 后来一次来到解放公园时，Shanice在蓝马霍树附近停下。她认出你，站到园路一侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again. I'm heading back the way I came today. I've still got a few cabinets to finish at the workshop.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了。今天我准备原路回去，不走平常那一圈了。工作室还有几个收音机外壳没收尾。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks farther along the park path, where she would usually continue her walk. After a moment, she turns back towards the entrance.
beats.chinese: 她看向园路前方，平常她会继续往那边走。停了一会儿，她转身朝入口方向走去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I don't have to do the whole round every time. This is enough for today. I'll head back. Take care.
beats.chinese: 也不用每次出来都走满一圈。今天这点就够了。我这就回去了。慢走。

causality.presenceReason: Shanice在工作室修复收音机外壳后，照例到解放公园休息。今天她带来朋友借的小相机，在蓝马霍树附近试拍分枝。
causality.placeAttitude: 她熟悉这条休息路线，习惯从固定位置看树。借来的相机让她想试试别的角度，实际挪步时仍会退回老位置。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须留下的外部约束。她想完成这次短暂休息和试拍，之后回工作室。重逢当天还有几件修复工作没收尾，她因此决定缩短散步。
causality.currentGoal: 看看惯常位置是否让两条主枝在视线上重叠，决定是否换角度，并尝试用借来的相机拍一张没有路人入镜的树照片。
causality.currentState: 动作不急，愿意简短交谈，对借来的相机还不熟悉。她提出的问题范围有限，不要求玩家移动、协助操作或继续聊天。

causality.characterContinuity: 保留修复旧收音机外壳的职业、对熟悉路线与方法的依赖，以及今天想试借来相机的意愿。初次提问范围有限，离场和拍摄均由她自己决定。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Emancipation Park in Kingston, Marlon Beckford has stopped near a blue mahoe tree during a short walk after a shift printing skateboard decks. They watch the shadows on the grass, leaving room on the path for people to pass.
beats.chinese: 在金斯敦解放公园，Marlon Beckford刚结束滑板板面丝网印刷的工作，来这里短暂散步。他们停在蓝马霍树附近，看着草地上的树影，给园路上经过的人留出空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The trunk stays put. Its shadow's done a whole shift already. And—no, scrapping that next one.
beats.chinese: 树干待在原地，影子已经忙了一整个班。还有——不，后面那句笑话撤了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlon turns toward you with a small smile. Their bag stays closed against their hip.
beats.chinese: Marlon 带着一点笑意转向附近的你。包仍然关着，贴在胯侧。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Marlon. That's enough small sightings saved for today. Just a short walk now. The footbag can wait until Thursday.
beats.chinese: 我叫 Marlon。今天的小见闻已经存够了。现在就走一小段。踢布球的事留到周四。

choices.english: What happens on Thursdays?
choices.chinese: 周四有什么活动？

choices.english: Enjoy your walk. I'll give you some room.
choices.chinese: 祝你散步愉快。我给你让点地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlon takes a small fabric ball from their bag and turns it once in their palm. Their smile widens.
beats.chinese: Marlon 从包里取出一个小布球，在掌心里转了转，笑容更明显了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Two neighbours and I try to keep it in the air. We spend quite a lot of Thursday picking it up.
beats.chinese: 我和两个邻居尽量不让它落地。不过周四有不少时间都花在捡球上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They tuck the ball deep into the bag and draw the zip halfway across.
beats.chinese: 他们把球塞到包的深处，将拉链拉上一半。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Coming from the deck shop, I saw a man carrying one shoe in a cake box. That's my small sighting for the day. I save those to tell in person.
beats.chinese: 从滑板店过来时，我看见一个人用蛋糕盒装着一只鞋。那就是我今天收集的小见闻。我都留着当面讲。

choices.english: Go on. What did he do with it?
choices.chinese: 接着说。他拿那只鞋做什么了？

choices.english: I'll pass on the story. Enjoy your walk. [Continue along the path.]
choices.chinese: 故事就不听了。祝你散步愉快。[沿小路继续走。]

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: With the space you leave, Marlon settles the bag against their hip. They remain clear of passing walkers.
beats.chinese: 你让出地方后，Marlon 把包放稳在胯侧，始终没有挡住其他行人的路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. That's plenty. Just checking I've got my ball for Thursday.
beats.chinese: 谢谢，这些地方够了。我就确认一下周四要用的球带着没有。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They open the bag and briefly lift out a small fabric ball. They tuck it back in, then stop pulling when the zip catches a fold of lining.
beats.chinese: 他们打开包，短暂取出一个小布球，随后收了回去。拉链夹住了一点内衬，他们便立刻停了手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll sort this out here. You can get past easily.
beats.chinese: 我在这儿弄好就行。你从旁边过去很方便。

choices.english: I'll carry on, then. Take care.
choices.chinese: 那我先走了。保重。

choices.english: Before I go, what is that little ball called?
choices.chinese: 走之前问一句，那个小球叫什么？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlon leaves the zip alone and turns their attention fully to you.
beats.chinese: Marlon 暂时不管拉链，转过来专心对你讲。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He opened the lid twice to check it. Then he lifted the whole box to eye level. The shoe was getting very careful treatment.
beats.chinese: 他打开盒盖检查了两回，接着把整个盒子举到眼前。那只鞋受到的照顾可真周到。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They chuckle, close the bag, and turn along the public path near the tree.
beats.chinese: 他们轻声笑起来，拉好包，转身沿着树旁的公共步道走去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A sole passenger. No, scrapping that one. Enjoy your walk.
beats.chinese: 真是位贵宾鞋客。不，这句撤回。祝你散步愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you continue along the path, Marlon's smile fades. They look down at the half-closed bag.
beats.chinese: 你沿小路继续走时，Marlon 的笑容淡了下来，低头看着只拉上一半的包。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right.
beats.chinese: 好。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They square the bag against their hip and finish closing it with small, deliberate movements, remaining beside the path.
beats.chinese: 他们把包在胯侧摆正，动作细致地将拉链拉好，仍留在步道旁边。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Goodbye. Take care.
beats.chinese: 再见。保重。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You continue along the path. Marlon stays to one side with the caught zip held between two fingers.
beats.chinese: 你沿步道继续走。Marlon 留在一旁，用两根手指捏住卡住的拉链。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. Enjoy the park.
beats.chinese: 你也是。好好逛逛公园。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They ease the lining free, close the bag, and give you a brief wave before turning their attention to the tree.
beats.chinese: 他们轻轻抽出内衬，拉好包，朝你简短地挥挥手，然后转头望向树冠。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There. Everything staying inside now.
beats.chinese: 好了。这下东西都待在里面了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marlon pauses with the zip open and tips the bag just enough for you to see the fabric ball.
beats.chinese: Marlon 暂时停下，把尚未拉好的包稍稍倾斜，让你能看见里面的布球。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: A footbag. People call it a hacky sack too. This one's been kicked about by the same three people for years.
beats.chinese: 叫 footbag，也有人叫 hacky sack。这一个被我们三个人踢了好多年了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They free the lining with a fingertip, close the bag, and turn toward the park path.
beats.chinese: 他们用指尖拨开内衬，拉好包，转向树旁的步道。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It can rest until Thursday. I'm off for my walk. Take care.
beats.chinese: 让它歇到周四吧。我去散步了。保重。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Emancipation Park, Marlon recognizes you in the park near the blue mahoe tree and gives you a small wave.
beats.chinese: 在解放公园，Marlon 在 蓝马霍树附近的园路认出你，轻轻挥了挥手。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Good to see you. I haven't got the energy for stories today. Just a short walk.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。很高兴见到你。今天没什么讲故事的精神，只想走一小段。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: They glance toward the tree and open their mouth as if to add a joke, then shake their head. With a friendly nod to you, they begin walking along the public path.
beats.chinese: 他们看向树冠，张了张嘴，像要补一个笑话，又摇了摇头。他们友善地朝你点点头，开始沿公共步道散步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave that one out. Let it stay quiet today. Take care.
beats.chinese: 这句不讲，今天让它空着。保重。

causality.presenceReason: Marlon在滑板板面丝网印刷工作结束后，来到解放公园短暂散步，在蓝马霍树附近看树影。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Emancipation Park in Kingston, Kemesha Wint stands to one side of the public path beside the blue mahoe tree. She came to finish a sock heel while listening to a short radio drama. Ready to leave, she takes out one earbud and turns towards you.
beats.chinese: 在金斯敦解放公园，Kemesha Wint站在蓝马霍树附近公共路径一侧。她来这里边听一出短广播剧，边收完袜跟。准备离开时，她摘下一只耳机，转向你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Excuse me. Can you hear the sound from my earphones over there?
beats.chinese: 不好意思。你在那边能听见我耳机里漏出来的声音吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She pauses the playback on her phone, then folds the sock and puts it into her bag. She gives the finished heel a satisfied glance before tucking it inside.
beats.chinese: 她在手机上暂停播放，随后把袜子叠好放进包里。把袜跟收进去之前，她满意地看了它一眼。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Kemesha. That's the heel finished too.
beats.chinese: 我叫Kemesha。袜跟也收好了。

choices.english: You made it? That heel looks complicated.
choices.chinese: 你自己织的？那个袜跟看起来挺复杂。

choices.english: No harm done. I'll let you get going.
choices.chinese: 没事。那我不耽误你了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kemesha's smile widens. She lifts the folded sock just above the opening of her bag.
beats.chinese: Kemesha笑得更开了，把叠好的袜子举到包口上方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes. Socks in the evenings. Kitchen tile mosaics for work. This heel finally fits properly.
beats.chinese: 是啊。晚上织袜子，工作是铺厨房马赛克瓷砖。这个袜跟总算合脚了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: The sock disappears into the bag. She coils the earbud wire, closes the zip and turns towards the path ahead while you are still facing her.
beats.chinese: 袜子收进包里。她卷好耳机线，拉上拉链。你还面朝着她，她已经转向了前方的园路。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's everything put away. Right, I'd better go.
beats.chinese: 都收好了。好，那我走了。

choices.english: Would you stay a minute? I'd like to hear about the radio play.
choices.chinese: 愿意再待一会儿吗？我想听听那出广播剧。

choices.english: All right. Have a good day, Kemesha.
choices.chinese: 好。祝你今天愉快，Kemesha。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kemesha settles the bag against her hip. Her phone is still in her hand, with the radio drama paused.
beats.chinese: Kemesha把包挪到胯侧。手机还拿在手里，广播剧已经暂停了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. The play's finished too. I came for the ending.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。剧也播完了。我是来听结局的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She reaches for the earbud, then checks the closed zip with two quick pulls. Her feet are already angled along the park path.
beats.chinese: 她伸手去拿耳机，又在已经拉好的拉链上迅速拽了两下。双脚已经朝向园路前方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Sock away. Nothing left out. Good.
beats.chinese: 袜子装好了。没落东西。好。

choices.english: Was the ending worth coming for?
choices.chinese: 那个结局值得特意来听吗？

choices.english: I'm going to look at the tree. Take care.
choices.chinese: 我去看看树。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kemesha turns back towards you. She leaves the bag closed, though her fingers keep sliding along its strap.
beats.chinese: Kemesha转回来面向你。她没再打开包，手指却一直沿着肩带来回滑动。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh. Yes, I can stay a minute. A woman hid a missing letter in a flour tin. Her brother used the flour.
beats.chinese: 哦。行，我可以再待一会儿。有个女人把一封失踪的信藏进面粉罐。她弟弟把面粉用了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She spends the next minute recounting the brother's attempt to explain scraps of paper in his dumplings. Her fingers pause while she imitates his offended voice, then she lifts a hand in farewell.
beats.chinese: 接下来的一分钟，她讲起那个弟弟怎么解释饺子里的碎纸。模仿他委屈的口气时，她的手指停了下来。讲完后，她抬手道别。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: He blamed the flour seller. Very firm about it, too. Thanks for asking me to stay. Bye, now.
beats.chinese: 他怪卖面粉的人，还说得特别理直气壮。谢谢你叫我多待一会儿。再见啦。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kemesha gives a cheerful nod and starts along the park path.
beats.chinese: Kemesha愉快地点点头，沿园路迈开脚步。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. Glad that heel's finished.
beats.chinese: 你也是。袜跟收好了，真高兴。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: After a few steps, she pats the closed bag once. She raises her free hand without stopping.
beats.chinese: 走了几步，她在合好的包上拍了一下，又举起空着的手，脚步没有停。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Bye!
beats.chinese: 再见！

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Kemesha stops reaching for the bag strap and holds up the earbud.
beats.chinese: Kemesha不再伸手去抓肩带，而是举了举耳机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I thought it was. Then they announced another part. The missing letter's been baked into dinner.
beats.chinese: 本来觉得值。结果他们又说还有下一集。那封失踪的信都被做进晚饭里了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks her phone and gives a short laugh. She moves a little farther along the park path, clear of passing people, and puts the earbud in.
beats.chinese: 她看了眼手机，短促地笑了一声。她沿树旁园路挪开一点，避开来往的人，戴上耳机。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The next part's on here. I'm staying for that. Enjoy your day.
beats.chinese: 这里能接着听下一集。那我再待一会儿。祝你今天愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you turn towards the tree, Kemesha keeps her bag close and gives you room to pass.
beats.chinese: 你转身走向树时，Kemesha把包拢在身边，给你留出通过的空间。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: You too. Bye.
beats.chinese: 你也是。再见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She notices a corner of the sock caught in the zip. Remaining where she is, she opens the bag and tucks it fully inside.
beats.chinese: 她发现袜子的一角夹在拉链里，便留在原地打开包，把它全部塞好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Nearly shut you in the zip.
beats.chinese: 差点把你夹进拉链里。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Emancipation Park, Kemesha is beside the blue mahoe tree. She recognises you while checking the screen of her phone.
beats.chinese: 在解放公园，你在蓝马霍树附近看见Kemesha。她正在看手机屏幕，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. I've come to hear a short play. So far, I've had three minutes of cast names.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。我来听一出短剧。到现在已经听了三分钟演员名单。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lowers one earbud as another name sounds faintly through it, then glances back at the running time.
beats.chinese: 她放低一只耳机，里面又隐约传出一个名字。她低头再看了一眼播放时长。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There can't be many people left to introduce. Anyway, good to see you.
beats.chinese: 应该没剩几个人要介绍了。总之，很高兴见到你。

causality.presenceReason: 她来到解放公园蓝马霍树附近，边听短广播剧的结尾，边完成袜跟。玩家出现时，她已经做完，准备收包离开。

causality.stayingConstraint: 没有外部时限，但事情一做完就立即收拾离开。玩家明确邀请时，她愿意多留片刻。
causality.currentGoal: 确认耳机的声音是否漏到旁人那里，暂停播放，收好完成的袜子和耳机，然后结束这次停留。
causality.currentState: 对袜跟完成且合脚很满意，心情轻快，注意力已转向检查物品和离开。愿意礼貌交谈，却不会自然地把闲聊当作留下的理由。
causality.contactTrigger: 她耳机里仍在播放广播剧，因此摘下一只耳机，向附近玩家确认是否能听见漏出来的声音，随后主动暂停播放、自报姓名并收好袜子。袜子没有掉落，也不需要玩家帮忙。

causality.reactionAndChange: a中她回应玩家对袜跟的兴趣，但收好东西便转身。aa因明确邀请留下讲完一段剧情后道别，ab迅速收尾并穿过园路离开。b承接玩家不耽误她离开的回应。ba因玩家询问结局，查看手机后为下一集转而独自留在树旁听剧。bb玩家先去看树，她留在原处处理夹住的袜角。
