beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Kingston Waterfront, Marcia Whyte sits in the pavilion with a small recorder and her bag on her lap. She came to collect sea wind for her friend Pearl's evening gathering. As you reach the pavilion, she finishes a recording. The seat beside her is empty.
beats.chinese: 在金斯敦海滨广场，Marcia Whyte坐在凉亭里，手里拿着小录音机，包放在膝上。她来录些海风，准备给朋友Pearl的晚间聚会用。你来到凉亭时，她刚录完一段。她身旁的座位空着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I've finished this bit, eh. No need to keep your voice down for the recording.
beats.chinese: 我这段录完了。不用为了录音压低声音。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks that the recording has stopped, then looks up at you, keeping her bag on her lap.
beats.chinese: 她确认录音已经停止，随后抬头看向你，包仍放在膝上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Marcia. That was for Pearl. There I go, starting in the middle again.
beats.chinese: 我叫Marcia。刚才那段是给Pearl的。瞧，我又从中间讲起了。

choices.english: I'll sit for a minute. What's the wind for?
choices.chinese: 我坐一会儿。录风声做什么用？

choices.english: I'll stay on my feet, thanks. Were you recording?
choices.chinese: 谢谢，我站着就好。你刚才在录音吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You sit beside her. Marcia turns the recorder over in her hands, then looks up before starting her explanation again.
beats.chinese: 你在她身旁坐下。Marcia把录音机在手里翻了个面，抬起头，重新开始解释。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Pearl's having a little evening gathering. I'm bringing shadow puppets and sounds. Anyone can leave halfway. That part's settled.
beats.chinese: Pearl要办个小小的晚间聚会。我带影偶和录好的声音去。谁想中途走都可以，这条已经说定了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Her thumb pauses over the playback button. She keeps the speaker quiet.
beats.chinese: 她的拇指停在播放键上，没有让扬声器出声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I repair auditorium seats all week. Springs, bolts, squeaks. I thought Pearl deserved an evening without me mentioning a loose nut. Ah. Too late.
beats.chinese: 我一星期都在修礼堂座椅，弹簧、螺栓，还有吱呀声。我本来想让Pearl过个不用听我提松螺母的晚上。啊，已经提了。

choices.english: I'd like to hear a little of the recording.
choices.chinese: 我想听一小段录音。

choices.english: I hope the gathering goes well. I'll get going.
choices.chinese: 祝聚会顺利。我先走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You remain standing beside the seats. Marcia angles the recorder so she can check its display, keeping her bag on her lap.
beats.chinese: 你留在座位旁站着。Marcia把录音机转向自己，检查显示屏，包仍放在膝上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, sea wind. It's stopped now. I don't need our conversation on there.
beats.chinese: 对，在录海风。现在停了。我不用把咱们说话也录进去。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She switches the recorder off completely and starts to put it away, then stops with it halfway into her bag.
beats.chinese: 她彻底关掉录音机，准备收起来，放到一半又停住了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Pearl's getting an evening of sounds and shadows. That's the short version. Probably too short. Anyhow, I won't hold you here.
beats.chinese: Pearl会有个听声音、看影子的晚上。这是简短版。大概太短了。总之，我不耽误你。

choices.english: I can listen to the longer version.
choices.chinese: 我可以听听详细版。

choices.english: You can get back to recording. I'll move on.
choices.chinese: 你继续录吧。我先走了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcia plays a few seconds at low volume. Wind rustles against the microphone, followed by a faint scrape from her hand.
beats.chinese: Marcia调低音量，播放了几秒。风擦着麦克风沙沙作响，后面跟着一声轻微的手指摩擦声。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That scrape's my thumb. Thirty years repairing seats, and I still put a finger in the wrong place.
beats.chinese: 那声是我的拇指蹭的。修了三十年座椅，我还是会把手指放错地方。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stops playback and puts the recorder away. With a brief farewell nod, she turns her attention back toward the open waterfront.
beats.chinese: 她停止播放，收起录音机，轻轻点头道别，重新望向开阔的海滨。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll listen with my own ears for a bit. Enjoy your afternoon, eh.
beats.chinese: 接下来我先用自己的耳朵听一会儿。祝你下午愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you rise to leave, Marcia draws her bag closer to her knees so the space beside the seat stays clear.
beats.chinese: 你起身离开时，Marcia把包往膝前收了收，让座位旁的空间保持畅通。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. I'm hoping the puppets behave. Fabric scraps are easier than seat springs, usually.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。希望那些影偶听话点。碎布头通常比座椅弹簧好对付。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives you a small wave, then winds the recorder's wrist strap neatly around her fingers without starting another recording.
beats.chinese: 她朝你轻轻挥手，随后把录音机的腕带整齐地绕在手指上，没有再开始录音。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Alright, take care. I'll sort this little tangle before I do anything else.
beats.chinese: 好，慢走。我先把这点缠在一起的带子理顺。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Marcia takes her hand out of the bag and gives you her full attention. The recorder stays put.
beats.chinese: Marcia把手从包里抽出来，专心看着你。录音机留在包中。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I make little shadow puppets from seat-fabric scraps for my niece's children. Pearl wanted some for her gathering. I'm adding sounds I record around Kingston.
beats.chinese: 我用座椅布料的碎片给外甥女的孩子们做小影偶。Pearl想在聚会上用一些。我还会配上自己在金斯敦各处录的声音。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She starts to wave away the rest, catches herself, and finishes before closing her bag. Then she stands beside the seat, ready to leave.
beats.chinese: 她刚想挥挥手略过后半段，又收住动作，把话说完才合上包。随后她站到座位旁，准备离开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And people can leave halfway without a fuss. I wanted that said properly. There, the whole explanation. I'll be heading along now. Take care.
beats.chinese: 还有，大家中途离开也没关系，用不着郑重其事。这句我想说明白。好了，解释完整了。我也该走了。保重。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You move on from the pavilion. Marcia stays seated and gives you a brief wave, leaving the recorder switched off.
beats.chinese: 你离开凉亭继续往前。Marcia仍坐着，朝你简短地挥了挥手，录音机依然关着。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Alright. Thanks for the company, brief as it was.
beats.chinese: 好。谢谢你陪我说了几句，虽然就这么一小会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She waits until you are farther along the walkway before taking the recorder out again. She holds it clear of her sleeve.
beats.chinese: 等你沿步道走远一些，她才重新拿出录音机，特意让它离衣袖远一点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now, no sleeve rustling this time, Marcia.
beats.chinese: 好了，Marcia，这回别再把袖子的摩擦声录进去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Kingston Waterfront, you see Marcia sitting in the pavilion with a few of her fabric scraps in her hands. She recognizes you and smiles.
beats.chinese: 在金斯敦海滨广场，你看见Marcia坐在凉亭的座位上，手里拿着几块自己的碎布。她认出了你，露出笑容。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh, hello again! I'm choosing shapes for the shadow puppets today. Left the recorder at home on purpose, eh.
beats.chinese: 哦，又见面了！我今天在挑影偶要用的轮廓。特意把录音机留在家里了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lays two scraps over each other and studies their edges. She picks one and puts the others back in her bag.
beats.chinese: 她把两块碎布叠在一起，看了看边缘，选定其中一块，把其余的收回包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Just choosing this today. The rest can wait. I mean the fabric for the puppets! Anyhow, good seeing you. Take care, eh.
beats.chinese: 今天只定这个，别的下回再想。我是说影偶的布！总之，见到你真好。慢走啊。

causality.presenceReason: Marcia先到金斯敦海滨广场的凉亭，为Pearl筹备的晚间聚会采集海风声。
causality.placeAttitude: 她喜欢这里能听海风，对细小的录音杂声也会留意。她不承担接待或导览职责，也不要求公共空间里的其他人为她的录音保持安静。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须久留的任务，录到短片段即可收工，也不会为了交谈强留陌生人。
causality.currentGoal: 采集可用的环境声，并在有人询问时说明Pearl的声音与影偶聚会。
causality.currentState: 今天心情轻快，注意力在录音和来人之间切换，怕占用谈话时间而把解释压缩过头。
causality.contactTrigger: 玩家来到凉亭时，Marcia刚结束一段海风录音，主动说明不用为了录音压低声音，随后提到Pearl，意识到自己又从中间讲起。她的包始终放在膝上，相邻座位空着，没有通过移包或邀请入座触发接触，也不假定玩家此前曾安静或配合。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留礼堂座椅维修职业、金斯敦生活、环境录音、碎布影偶、Pearl聚会及中途离场规则，以省略解释和零件玩笑呈现个性。重逢保留她挑选手作材料的乐趣，以及说得太简略后自行补全的说话习惯。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Kingston Waterfront, Shanique Peart is resting in the pavilion during her evening walk, with a paper bag of patties on her lap. As you pass near the seating, she looks at the shop name on the bag and laughs.
beats.chinese: 在金斯敦海滨广场，Shanique Peart 散步途中正在凉亭里歇脚，腿上放着一袋肉饼。你经过座位附近时，她看着袋上的店名笑了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Business picks up, and I'm happy for her. Then I join the queue and complain about the crowd. Both things came out of my mouth.
beats.chinese: 生意好了，我替她高兴。轮到自己排队，又嫌人多。两句话都是我说的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She looks up at you, still smiling, and opens the bag on her lap.
beats.chinese: 她抬头看向你，脸上还带着笑，打开了腿上的纸袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Shanique. I'll be eating this while it's hot, though.
beats.chinese: 我叫 Shanique。不过这肉饼，我可得趁热吃。

choices.english: I'll sit for a moment. That smells good.
choices.chinese: 我坐一会儿。闻着真香。

choices.english: I'll stay standing. Are you taking a break from work?
choices.chinese: 我站着就好。你是工作间隙出来歇歇吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You take an empty seat nearby. Shanique folds back the top of the bag, releasing the smell of warm pastry.
beats.chinese: 你在旁边的空位坐下。Shanique 把袋口往下折了折，热酥皮的香气飘了出来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My usual little diner. Bev's finally getting a proper queue. Lovely for her. Three people ahead of me when I wanted my dinner, though.
beats.chinese: 我常去的那家小餐馆。Bev 那儿总算有人排队了。替她高兴。不过我想吃晚饭的时候，前面居然排了三个人。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She laughs at herself, then turns the bag's printed side toward her knees.
beats.chinese: 她自己先笑了，随后把袋子印着字的那一面转向膝盖。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I spent years telling her she deserved more customers. Apparently I meant customers who eat after me.
beats.chinese: 这些年我一直说，她值得有更多客人。看来我指的是排在我后面吃饭的客人。

choices.english: Would you tell me the name before I go? It's fine if you'd rather keep it to yourself.
choices.chinese: 我走之前，能告诉我店名吗？想保密也没关系。

choices.english: Enjoy your dinner. I'll rest here without keeping you talking.
choices.chinese: 你好好吃吧。我在这儿歇会儿，就不拉着你聊天了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You remain beside the seating, clear of the walkway. Shanique keeps the bag on her lap.
beats.chinese: 你留在座位旁，没有挡住步道。Shanique 仍把纸袋放在腿上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Work's finished. I appraise secondhand bicycles part-time. This is my walk, with a dinner stop I hadn't planned.
beats.chinese: 已经收工了。我兼职给二手自行车估价。现在出来散步，临时加了一顿晚饭。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes out a patty, keeping its lower half inside the paper bag.
beats.chinese: 她拿出一个肉饼，下半截仍包在纸袋里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I passed a place I like. Told myself I'd only look through the door. Very convincing, I was.
beats.chinese: 路过一家喜欢的店，我跟自己说，就往门里看一眼。我还真会说服自己。

choices.english: I'll leave you to your dinner, then. Enjoy your evening.
choices.chinese: 那我不打扰你吃饭了。祝你今晚愉快。

choices.english: I'll take the seat after all. Please don't let me interrupt your walk.
choices.chinese: 那我还是坐一会儿吧。你想继续散步就去，不用顾着我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Shanique leaves the printed side of the bag against her knees.
beats.chinese: Shanique 让纸袋印着字的那一面继续贴着膝盖。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd rather keep that one to myself for now. Bev would have something to say about my advertising skills.
beats.chinese: 这家店我暂时还想藏一藏。Bev 要知道我这么替她宣传，准得说我几句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you get up to leave, she gives you a small wave with her free hand.
beats.chinese: 你起身离开时，她用空着的那只手轻轻挥了挥。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care, now. Enjoy your evening.
beats.chinese: 慢走啊。祝你今晚愉快。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You settle back in the seat. Shanique folds the top of the bag down so she can reach her dinner.
beats.chinese: 你在座位上坐定。Shanique 把袋口往下折，好拿着肉饼吃。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thank you. I've done enough talking to let this cool already.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。光顾着说话，这都快让我聊凉了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes a bite, catches a flake of pastry in the bag, and turns her attention to her meal.
beats.chinese: 她咬了一口，用纸袋接住掉下的酥皮，专心吃起饭来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There we go. That's what I stopped for.
beats.chinese: 这就对了。我停下来就是为了这一口。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You turn to continue along the waterfront. Shanique remains seated with her dinner.
beats.chinese: 你转身沿海滨继续走。Shanique 留在座位上吃晚饭。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And you. That was a very successful quick conversation. My dinner's still warm.
beats.chinese: 你也是。这段短聊很成功，饭还热着呢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She raises the wrapped patty in a brief farewell, then lowers it for a bite as you leave.
beats.chinese: 她举了举包着纸的肉饼，算是道别。你离开时，她已经低头咬了一口。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care along there.
beats.chinese: 慢慢走啊。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You take an empty seat nearby. Shanique folds the paper around her patty and gathers the bag into one hand.
beats.chinese: 你在旁边的空位坐下。Shanique 用纸包好肉饼，把袋子拢到一只手里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I will get moving, actually. If I sit much longer, I'll start calling this my evening sit.
beats.chinese: 我还真该接着走了。再坐下去，今晚的散步就该改叫静坐了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She stands, checks that she has left no paper behind, and heads along the walkway with her dinner.
beats.chinese: 她站起来，检查没有留下纸屑，便拿着晚饭沿步道走去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Enjoy the seat. Bye, now.
beats.chinese: 你慢慢坐。再见啦。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: On another outing at Kingston Waterfront, Shanique is beside the pavilion seating, ready to continue her walk. She recognizes you and smiles.
beats.chinese: 在金斯敦海滨广场，Shanique 正在凉亭座位旁，准备继续散步。她认出你，笑了起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Can't be bothered deciding where to have dinner today. I'll go to my usual place. I complain about the queue, then it's still the place I want.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。今天懒得琢磨晚饭去哪家，还是照旧吧。嘴上嫌人家排队，真要选了，惦记的还是那里。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She laughs at her own admission, gives you a small wave, and starts along the walkway.
beats.chinese: 她说完自己也笑了，向你轻轻挥手，迈步沿步道离开。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No recommendations today. I haven't even got there myself. Good to see you. Take care, now.
beats.chinese: 今天不作推荐，我自己都还没走到呢。见到你真好。慢走啊。

causality.presenceReason: Shanique 在金斯敦海滨进行晚间散步，途中买了熟悉小店的肉饼，在凉亭座位上歇脚吃饭。
causality.placeAttitude: 她把海滨当作普通散步地点，愿意主动说几句，也明确想趁热吃饭。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须久留的事务，停留取决于吃饭和继续散步的打算，不因玩家出现而承担陪聊义务。
causality.currentGoal: 趁热吃肉饼，歇脚后继续散步。
causality.currentState: 工作已经结束，心情轻松、肚子饿。她此刻愿意分享一句自嘲，但并未因此愿意向陌生人推荐熟店。
causality.contactTrigger: 纸袋从开场起一直放在她腿上。她正要吃肉饼，看见袋上的店名，笑着向附近玩家说出自己既盼店家生意好、又嫌排队人多的矛盾，随后自报姓名并说明要趁热吃。接触不再依赖挪袋让座。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留她在金斯敦成长并长期居住的经历、二手自行车兼职估价工作、散步与小店兴趣。她替熟店生意变好高兴，又抱怨排队，能笑认自己的矛盾。坐下谈食物的分支中，她仍转动纸袋遮住店名，并可礼貌婉拒推荐，不向店家索取特殊待遇。
causality.reactionAndChange: 玩家可坐下谈食物，也可站着短聊工作。aa 中她婉拒透露店名，玩家告别离开。ab 中玩家留下休息，她结束聊天专心吃饭。ba 中玩家继续走，她留座吃饭并挥手道别。bb 中玩家改为坐下，她收好食物继续散步。四种结局保持不变。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程仅使用照片说明允许的金斯敦海滨凉亭、座位与步道。玩家坐的是原有空位，不是她挪袋腾出的座位。餐馆只在对话中出现，初遇与重逢均不切换到餐馆场景。
causality.reunionCommonFacts: 已有相遇记录确认用户此前见过Shanique Peart。本次重逢位于金斯敦海滨广场，地点属于当前情境。其余信息由本次可见状态和稳定人物设定提供，适用于新版四条初遇路径与旧活动联系人。

stories.titleZh: 球拍袋也占了一个座位

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Kingston Waterfront, Tia Bogle is resting under the pavilion after work at the speaker-cabinet workshop. Before heading to badminton, she is giving her hands a break. Her cloth racket bag occupies the next seat.
beats.chinese: 在金斯敦海滨广场，Tia Bogle 从音箱箱体作坊下班后，正在凉亭里歇脚。去打羽毛球之前，她想让双手休息一下。她的布球拍袋占着旁边的座位。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: This seat's free. My bag doesn't need its own.
beats.chinese: 这个位子可以坐。我的袋子用不着单独占一个。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She lifts the bag onto her lap. A racket handle sticks out of the top, and a shuttlecock sits in a narrow side pocket.
beats.chinese: 她把袋子放到腿上。球拍柄从袋口露出来，窄窄的侧袋里装着一只羽毛球。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'm Tia. Taking five before badminton. I've been cutting fabric samples all afternoon.
beats.chinese: 我叫 Tia。打羽毛球之前歇一会儿。我整个下午都在裁布料样片。

choices.english: Thanks. I'll sit for a moment. That's a clever racket bag.
choices.chinese: 谢谢，我坐一会儿。这个球拍袋设计得真巧。

choices.english: I'll stand, thanks. Do you play badminton often?
choices.chinese: 谢谢，我站着就好。你经常打羽毛球吗？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: As you sit, Tia turns the bag so its side pocket faces you. Then she reaches inside for a small notebook.
beats.chinese: 你坐下后，Tia 把袋子的侧袋转向你，接着从袋子里拿出一本小记事本。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Made it myself. I could do another. What would yours need to hold?
beats.chinese: 我自己做的。可以再做一个。你那个需要装些什么？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She writes “bag” before you have answered, then holds her pencil above the next line.
beats.chinese: 还没等你回答，她就写下了“袋子”，随后把铅笔停在下一行上方。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I cut grille cloth for speaker cabinets as an apprentice. A whole bag is a nice change. No, wait, size first.
beats.chinese: 我在作坊当学徒，给音箱箱体裁网罩布。做个完整的袋子正好换换手。不，等等，先定尺寸。

choices.english: Please don't make me one. I only meant yours looks good.
choices.chinese: 不用给我做。我只是说你这个很好看。

choices.english: I'm only curious about yours. Why the side pocket?
choices.chinese: 我只是好奇你这个袋子。为什么要加侧袋？

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tia keeps the bag on her lap while you remain standing. She nudges the shuttlecock farther into its pocket.
beats.chinese: 你仍站着，Tia 把袋子留在腿上，又将羽毛球往侧袋里塞稳了一点。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Regularly. Church hall court. My attendance is much better than my backhand.
beats.chinese: 经常去，在教堂礼堂的球场打。我的出勤率可比反手水平强多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She checks a frayed bit of thread on the bag, then leaves it alone and spreads her fingers.
beats.chinese: 她看了看袋子上一小段磨毛的线头，随后没再碰它，张开手指活动了一下。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I go even when I'm playing badly. Which gives me a very reliable schedule.
beats.chinese: 就算打得很差我也照去。所以我的出勤一直很稳定。

choices.english: You sound competitive.
choices.chinese: 听起来你还挺好胜的。

choices.english: Enjoy your game. I'll carry on and let your hands rest.
choices.chinese: 祝你打得开心。我继续走了，你让手歇歇吧。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tia looks from you to the word she has already written.
beats.chinese: Tia 看看你，又看看自己已经写下的那个词。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Oh. Just mine. Right, I've got ahead of you.
beats.chinese: 哦，只是夸我这个。明白，我想得太快了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She crosses out “bag,” puts the notebook away, and rests her open hands on top of the cloth.
beats.chinese: 她划掉“袋子”，收起记事本，把摊开的双手放在布袋上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks for saying so plainly. I'm putting the pencil away for this break.
beats.chinese: 谢谢你直接说清楚。这回休息，我就把铅笔收起来了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tia sets the pencil inside the notebook and lifts the shuttlecock out of the side pocket.
beats.chinese: Tia 把铅笔夹进记事本，从侧袋里取出羽毛球。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Ah, you're asking about this one. The shuttle kept getting crushed under the racket.
beats.chinese: 啊，你是在问这个袋子。羽毛球以前总被球拍压着。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She slides it back into its separate pocket, packs away the notebook, and stands with the bag over her shoulder.
beats.chinese: 她把羽毛球放回独立的侧袋，收好记事本，站起来把袋子背上肩。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That pocket has saved me a few feathers. Right, break's over. Enjoy the seat.
beats.chinese: 这个侧袋替我保住了不少羽毛。好了，歇够了。你慢慢坐。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tia raises her eyebrows and takes the racket partway out of its bag.
beats.chinese: Tia 挑起眉毛，把球拍从袋子里抽出一半。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I count every point. Being bad at something doesn't stop me wanting to win.
beats.chinese: 每一分我都算得清清楚楚。打得不好，也不妨碍我想赢。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She tests her grip once, puts the racket back, and gets up beside the seat.
beats.chinese: 她握了一下拍柄，随即把球拍放回去，在座位旁站起身。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And if I say one more game, I mean one. They've learned to ask before I put the racket away. Off I go.
beats.chinese: 还有，我说再打一局，就真的是一局。他们已经知道，要加局得赶在我收拍之前问。我走啦。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Tia settles the racket bag securely across her lap as you turn along the waterfront path.
beats.chinese: 你转身沿海滨步道继续走，Tia 把球拍袋稳稳放在腿上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Thanks. These fingers have done enough fiddly work for a bit.
beats.chinese: 谢谢。这些手指刚才做的细活已经够多了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She gives a small wave, then tucks both hands beneath her elbows, leaving the loose thread untouched.
beats.chinese: 她轻轻挥了挥手，随后把双手 tucked 在臂弯下，没有再去动那根线头。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Take care. I'm staying right here a little longer.
beats.chinese: 慢走。我还要在这里多歇一会儿。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: At Kingston Waterfront, Tia sits under the pavilion with her racket bag resting securely on her lap. She is stretching her fingers when she recognizes you.
beats.chinese: 在金斯敦海滨广场，Tia 坐在凉亭里，球拍袋稳稳放在腿上。她正舒展手指，认出了你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hey, good to see you. Finished cutting samples for today. These hands have had their rest, and I want to go play badminton.
beats.chinese: 嘿，见到你真好。今天裁样片的活已经做完了。手也歇够了，现在想去打羽毛球。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: She takes her time putting the shuttlecock back into the bag's side pocket. Then she stands, lifts the bag onto her shoulder, and starts toward the waterfront path.
beats.chinese: 她不急着起身，先从容地把羽毛球放回袋子侧袋。随后她站起来，提起袋子背上肩，向海滨步道走去。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: My backhand's still nothing special. No, wait, neither is the rest of my game. Still, I really want a proper match today. See you!
beats.chinese: 我的反手还是很一般。不，等等，其他方面也没好到哪儿去。不过今天我真想认认真真打一场。回头见！

causality.presenceReason: Tia 从音箱箱体作坊下班，去教堂礼堂打羽毛球前，已在海滨凉亭坐下让双手休息。
causality.placeAttitude: 她把这里当作途中能坐一会儿的地方，愿意简短聊天，也确实想歇手。
causality.stayingConstraint: 没有必须留守的责任，只打算短暂停留，之后照常去打球。
causality.currentGoal: 初遇时把袋子从公共座位挪开，再休息片刻。重逢时当天裁样片的工作已经完成，双手也已休息够，她准备去打羽毛球。
causality.currentState: 初遇时语气热络、反应快，双手做了一下午细活，听见夸奖仍会立刻拿笔安排制作。重逢时精神充足，动作从容，很想认真打一场球。
causality.contactTrigger: 初遇时球拍袋占了相邻座位，她主动向玩家说明座位可用并挪开袋子。重逢时她坐在凉亭里舒展手指，认出玩家后主动招呼。
causality.characterContinuity: 保留音箱网罩布设计学徒身份、把称赞当委托的习惯、说到做到的要求，以及水平普通却坚持打羽毛球的兴趣。重逢只谈眼下完成的裁样工作与打球意愿，不追讨旧称赞，也不假定玩家曾作出承诺。
causality.reactionAndChange: aa中玩家拒绝制作，她划掉记录并继续歇手。ab中玩家只问现有袋子，她展示侧袋后收拾起身。ba中她承认好胜并说明加局边界，随后准备离开。bb中玩家继续走，她挥手结束交谈并留下休息。重逢中她简短招呼，从容放好羽毛球，提袋走向步道并道别，没有物件意外或临时求助。
causality.spatialContinuity: 全程使用已提供的凉亭、座位与步道。袋子、球拍、羽毛球和记事本均为她自带，不增加公共设施。重逢结束于她向步道走去，不转入球场或其他新场景。

media.cityEvidence: Colorful houses in Wale Street, Cape Town, Western Cape, South AfricaBo-Kaap is a historic neighborhood above the center of Cape Town. It was established in the 18th century when the Dutch colonial administration built houses for enslaved people from Southeast Asia, India, and East Africa. Many of them were Muslims and later became known as “Cape Malays”.After their liberation in the 19th century, Bo-Kaap developed into a center of Islamic culture in the Cape. Mosques such as the Auwal Mosque from 1794 bear witness to this tradition.The colourfully painted houses, originally an expression of newly won freedom, now characterise the image of the neighbourhood.
